tei:div.tei:p: ༷// ༷hūṃ rgirdoṭ+wāṃ: hūṃ/ //ni byedi/hūṃ /ṭ+wāṃ~X 5 51 dī ཿ dro7shāshā shā 20 ༵ chi 30 ༵ mi3sdulta 7
/ /ba bheshe) ) ga ༄ ༄༄ ) — )༷)) she tsu ))
༄7/ / gung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/(cha)gung thang bstan pa'i sgon mes brtsams/mirigasadaposkrunakhab/

༅goza za/01ba/ma bocho mam4khyezomaza 6ཿ7zo ma1rgazazo shādizo zalomalornye1 2005 12132ma 7—105—07447—71 bo khya bo ①bocho ma’ ri/khyer+sā maza— khyo④zazapo+othaza(1737—1802)—tsho1bu— thos 3946 6—53rgadzalo gotho01gamatshoṣ+ṭhaja(2ཿ5)zo153682byuzamamaloṣ+ṭhamalotsho po(shā3 som za 6mo14 lo 1khya13) ༅77444 4sa ba4 dizorwamabablo//ngagami/thomamolnga lotham2ཿca zaza1lo 2khru6ro1tha 6 zo1mthamaza 8mtshamathamo114par 1 2 gram17 17grum ཿ1—24zla zayi34mazam yotshogrungolorwa rdzo5smozlom+mutshobomajaza zam

/ /gu tshan 'ag kha'i gagung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/dpar sgrig dpe sgrun mi sna/blo 'dri sa/ bse tshang blo bzang dpal ldan/dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo/gling rgya bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/gung thang thub bstan/bsod nams rgya mtsho/gtso sgrig pa/gtso sgrig pa gzhon pa/ 'jam dga'/sbyikhyabajus 'god pa/ tsha lag tshe ring rgyal/rtsom sgrigasangs mi/ mgon po dar rgyas/ phur kho/ rta mgrin rdo rje/'phrin las rgyal mtshan/ pan de mkhar/ting 'dzin bkra shis/ rta rdo/ lag bstarartsom sgrig pa/ 'brug mo skyid/

dam 4gakun 4 'jirka'ad da4ཿ so/ /tshod ba r+yāpa'ijagapor bang༄rabs /lung rtorkanya zungargatshu mer+yā/ /bye ste'i mo4 munasel ba 'di sa nga /r+ṣa da4 mang panib 4da pa'i mkha 4da ྾ 4na ༄sa te mal grub yo4 kyi ga4 ma rje ༅na dar+ṣa 4ga ༄na pa'i za me'i ༄ngakhum dpesnan byed par 4 ma spyar mal a ri'i 4 pa'i d+ku mchosaparabug — chebu/ khu 4 mi bca cho

ra / /nga〈pe ra da/dpe skrun gsal bshad/de yang gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'am mtshan yongs gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon me dbang phyug sder 'bod pa'i dam pa de nyid rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu pho rta lo ste spyi lo 1762lor mdo smad shar lho'i mdzod dge'i smadakyi yul du yab the bo lcags po byams pa dang / yum bo chog gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ khong dgung lo bdun par phebs dus kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang pos khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs kyi yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad de bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs/ khong gis kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po'i drung nas dge bsnyen dang rab byung dge tshul bcas dkyus gcig tu zhus shing mtshan la dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon me zhes gsol/ de nas rdo rams pa blo bzang rin chen slob dpon du bsten nas yi ge'i sbyor klog dang blo 'dzin sogs legs par sbyangs pa ma zad/rim gyis rgya dang sog po'i skad yig sbyangs pas thugs su chud/ dgung lo bcu bdun par dbus su phebs nas 'bras srungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi chos grwar zhugs/ hor skal bzang dngos grub dge rgan du bsten nas dbu ma dang /mdzod/ 'dul ba/ tshad ma/ phar phyin bcas gzhung bka' pod lnga la brdar sha chod par sbyangs/ dgung lo nyer gcig par rgyal ba blo bzang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i sku mdun nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa mnos/dgung lo nyer gnyis par dge bshes lha rams pa'i mtshan btags blangs/1

/ /gung 'izla ma'ag ngathabasadabus su lo brgyad tsam bzhugs pa'i ring la mdo sngags rig gnas kyi gzhung kun la mkhyen pa thogs med du gyur cing / dbus gtsang gi mkhas mang dkyil na rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar kun gyis gtsug tu bkur ba'i gnas su gyur/dgung lo nyer lnga bar yul mdo smad bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/dgung lo sum cu bar chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi khri chen du 'khod pas gdan rabs nyer gcig pa yin/ de nas bzung yul mdo smad lho byang gi chos grwa chen po rnams su 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bya ba'i yo lang kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad cing / rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i chu mo lug lo ste spyi lo 1823lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su 'thim/ dbal mang paṇ+ḍi ta dkon mchog rgyal mtshan sogs slob ma mkhas chen mang du byung ngo / /khong gi gsung rtsom ni phar phyin sdom dang / mdzod sdom/ 'dul ba sdom/ sgra dang snyan ngag sman dang rtsis/ lha ris thig tshad sogs sgyu rtsal skor gyi bstan bcos rnams gcig tu bsdus te po ti bcu gcig byas nas shing par du brkos yod pa de dag kun kyang tshad mar 'dzin pa'i legs bshad sha stagayin pas nged cag dpe skrun khang gis bla brang gi shing par gzhir bzung nas dpar du btab pa'i dge ba 'di yis thams cad bkra shis bde legs su gyur cig /mi rigs dpe sgrun khang /2
da༅༅//rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i maba'ajadag jebatsun blojazang tshos kyiste ma'i gsab gsum rmad du byungaba'i rtogasabarjod pad+ma dkar po zhes byabazhugs/stod chami rigs dpe skrun khang /

༄/ /yo bstan pa'i me'i sku 'bum/dkar chag 'dab ma dang po/ sku bltams pa'i tshul/ (1)'dab ma gnyis pa/ gdan sar phebs pa'i tshul/ (15)'dab ma gsum pa/ bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas rab tu byung pa'i tshul/(25)'dab ma bzhi pa/ mdo smad du gsan spyong ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul/(36)'dab ma lnga pa/ bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes pa'i tshul/ (58)'dab ma drug pa/ dbus 'gyur chos kyi zhing du gsan sbyong mdzad nga /ste/ gre1pa // (85)'dab ma bdun pa/ pe cin du phebs shing don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa:re 〈〈95/ (126)'dab ma brgyad pa/ rten bzhengs sogs bya ba las kyi 'khor lo mdzad pa:re dzabyerngub/ (189)'dab ma dgu pa/ pe cin du lan gnyis par phebs shing bstan 'gro'i don mdzad pa'i tshul/ (235)'dab ma bcu pa/ bka' rtsom spel ba sogs bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad pa:re 〈〈05/ (260)'dab ma bcu gcig pa/ pe cin du lan gsum par phebs shing 'gro don mdzad pa'i tshul/ (345)1

/ /yo bang bstan pa'ithonaḥ g.yo 'bum/'dab ma bcu gnyis pa/ mdo sngags kyi 'chad spel gtso bor gnang pa'i ///pa ga/ (/5(1(1)'dab ma gsum pa/ byang phyogs kyi ljongs su gdul bya rnams smin cing grol ba'i phyir chibs bskyod mdzad pa'i tshul/ (845)'dab ma bcu bzhi pa/ gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa'i tshul gdung mchod kyi rim pa rnam thar gyi don bsdu ba pa/pas thabacathab (901)'dab ma bco lnga pa/ slar yang 'dzum zhal mngon du gyur pa'i tshul/ (998)

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /༄༅/ / 'dab ma dang po/ sku bltams pa'i tshul/rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum rmad du byung ba'i mdzad bzang 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal gyi cha tsam gtam du bya ba rtogs brjod pad+ma dkar po zhes bya ba/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshe rabs kyi 'phreng bar rjes su gzung du gsol/ /'od gsal chos kyi dbyings dang dbyer med blo bzang mkhyen pa'i lha lam ngos/ gsang gsum chos kyi longs spyod rab rdzogs bde chen nyi ma gzhon nu'i gar/ theg gsum chos kyi snang ba 'bum 'gyed dpag yas sprul pas rnam rol pa/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po gang gi zhabs bsten pad+ma gtsug gis mchod/ rgyal kun mkhyen rab gser sbyangs khams las 'od bzang pir gyis bris pa'i trī / /bde chen snying rje'i do rar yongs smin mtshan dpe'i yal ga rdzogs pa'i ljon/ / kun rmongs dri mas bsnyen par mi bzod 'dab yangs ral gri'i rno rgyun can/ / 'jam dpal dpa' bo gar gyis rtsen pas the tshom 'ching brgya'i dra ba phyungs/ / dbyangs can bu mo gzhung bzang ma kye sngon tshe khyod dang lhan cig tu/ / snyan dgu'i chos kyi glu dbyangs len mkhas 'jam pa'i rdo rje gnyis pa da'i/ /rtogs pa brdzod la gus pa lhur len rigs kyi bus pa bdag la yang / / rang skal la 'os snyan dngags gtam gyi pi wang gsar ba deng stsol cig /kun rtog spros dang bral ba'i 'od gsal thugs/ /gang 'dul cir yang 'char ba sgyu ma'i sku/ /zung 'jug 'gog pa med par rtag rol pa'i/ /pha mtha' nam mkha'i 1

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /rnam grol don gnyer las la bskul bar bya/ / 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rnam thar sgron me yis/ / blo ldan snying gi mun pa bsal bar bya/ / rlabs chen bya ba las kyi dbyar rnga'i sgras/ / dad ldan bsod nams mdongs mtha' sprum par bya/ / dpal 'byor ngang gis 'du ba rgya mtsho'i sgras/ / blo chung khron pa'i rus sbal skrag par bya/ / sa 'dzin mchog gi spo na 'bar ba'i gzis/ / cher rlom phal gye snyems pa 'phrog par bya/ / mthu stobs nus pa gdong lnga'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ / ma rungs bdud sde'i snying rtsa 'gem par bya/ / snyigs ma bdo yang lhag bsam brtson pa'i go / mi lhod dpa' bo'i snying stobs mtshon par bya/ / gzhan phan thabs kyi rnam pa kun rdzogs pas/ / rgyal sras bye ba'i 'jug ngogs gsal bar bya/ / skal bzang bde chen gnas su bkri ba yis/ / gsang sngags myur lam che ba 'byin par bya/ / mdor na khams dang bsam pa tha dad dad brtson blo yi rim pa bzhin/ / mngon par mtho dang nges legs lam du du ma'i gdul bya bkri ba'i thabs/ / ma tshang med pa sgrub par mdzad de de bzhin gsong por brjod pa yis/ / legs bshad gtam gyi dga' ston 'gyed ngo do ger bzhin du spyi bos longs/ / de'ang ris su ma chad pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag la rgyu med par mnyes gshin pa'i brtse ba snying rje chen po'i rlan gyis yongs su bsgos pa/ theg mchog rigs kyi sa bon grung po gnyis su med pa'i blo gros dbyar gyi lang tsho'i dus su son pa las dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi rigs kyi thig le rin chen byang chub sems kyi myu gu mngon par thon cing / rlabs chen tshogs gnyis kyi spyod pa'i yal ga 'bum du bres pa'i rtse mor stobs bcu'i 'dab 'phreng rnam par bzhad pa/ bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i ge sar snying por smin pas gsang gsum 'azin las kyi dri bsung mngar po nam mkha'i mtha' dang 'khor ba srid du nam yang 'gog pa med par 3

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/spro ba'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mnga' brnyes pa ni rnam par thar pa'i cha shas du ma zhig gis mtshon par nus pa'i bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi mkhyen pa'i yul du gyur ba gdon mi za na'ang / bdag dang bdag 'dra'i skye bo mos dge blo gros gsum gyi mthu dman pa rnams bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas de lta bu ji lta ba bzhin du dpog par ga la nus/ der ma zad gnas gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag la lkog tu ma gyur pa'i ye shes kyi spyan mnga' ba/ thub pa'i bstan pa yongs kyi mnga' bdag / blang dor gyi gnasagang la yang bslu ba med pa'i tshad ma'i skyes bu du mas mgrin dbyangs gcig gi sgo nas/ 'phags bod gnyis dang / ma hā tsi na'i yul sogs su gang la gang 'dul gyi skye ba'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhes te/ thub bstan rin po che'i rtsa lag dam par gyur cing / so so'i skal ba bzhin gang la gang 'tsham gyi mdzad pas ris med kyi 'gro ba rnams la phan bde'i lam bzang gsal bar mdzad pa sogs kyi rnam thar brjod las 'das pa mngon du bstan pa'i tshul gsungs pa rnams kyang re zhig btang snyoms su byas te/skabs su babs pa sku 'phreng 'di nyid kyi rnam par thar pa phyogs lhung sgo skur sogs kyis ma bslad par mthong thos kyi rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du gleng ba la 'jug par bya'o/ / de'ang sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi sogs nang don rig pa'i gnad mtha' dag dang / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mkhas par bya ba'i dngos po kun la phyogs re ba dang 'ol spyi tsam ma yin par/ mkhyen rab me 'bar ba lta bu'i sgo nas sbyangs pa mthar son pas 'chad pa dang rtsod pa dang rtsom pa la sa'i steng 'dir 'gran pa'i zla dang bral ba 'dzam gling mkhas pa kunagyi gtsug gi nor bu/ thub pa'i bstan pa spyi bab dang mthun par lhag pa'i bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas dul zhing zhi la nye bar zhi bas 4

sa / /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum parwa dkar rmad byung / thubapa mchog gi gdung 'tshob dam par gyur cing / khyad par du'ang thos bsam sgom gsum sogs bstan pa'i bya ba kun gyi rmang gzhi dang / mchog thun dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas gcig pur dgongs te sdom pa gsum gyi bcas mtshams mtha' dag las cung zad tsam yang mi 'da' bar mig gi 'brasakhu bzhin du bsrung bar mdzad pa'i gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po/sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa mtha' dag bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i lhag bsam kho na'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i stobs kyis ches shin tu snyigs ma bdo ba'i yul dus kyi skye bo'i ngo bsrung dang / 'jig rten blun po'i grags tshod sogasa'i ltos pa med par bstan pa dang 'gro ba spyi la phan pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig thugs la brnag pa'i dbang gis/ rnam par dkar ba'i 'azin las kyi snangab rnam 'dren thub pa kun gyi thugs rje dang chabs cig par 'dzin ma'i khor yug kun tu khyab pas lus can yongs kyi mgon skyabs gcig pu/ khyad par du'ang dpal te ru ka dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs yi dam gyi lhas mngon sum du rjes su bzung nas gsang chen zab mo'i myur lam du smin par mdzad cing / tha mal snang zhen gyi dri ma yongs su sbyangs te/ bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i rtogs pa klong du gyur ba mthu stobs nus pa'i yon tan sngon 'phags yul gyi grub pa'i dpa' bo rnams dang dngos dbyer ma mchis pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po/ rang gis mngon du mdzad pa'i lam bzangapo der skal ldan rdo rje'i rigs kyi gdul bya mtha' dag smin cing grol bar mdzad pa rigs brgya'i khyab bdag bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'am/ mtshan gzhan rje btsun dam pa dharma badz+ra zhes snyan par grags pa'i gdugs dkar gcig gis rgya mtsho'i ska rags can gyi gser ldanayangs pa'i khyon kun yongs su khyab par mdzad pa 'di nyid gang du thog 5

/ /gung bang bstanaba'ithoname'igasung 'bum/—maragazigs pa rnam pa lnga'i sgo nas skye ba'i zlos gar bsgyur bar mdzad pa'i yul ni byang phyogs kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'di la bod dang bod chen po gnyis su phye bas bod chen po yin zhing / de la a mdo/ chab mdo/ chu mdo zhes mdo gsum du grags pa las a mdo/ de la'ang lho byang gnyis las byang phyogs pa/ de la'ang dpa' ris dang pho rod gnyis su yod pas/ pho rod kyi phyogs de sngon gyi dus su hor rgyal pos 'jam mgon sa paṇa khu dpon dang / garma pak+shi sogs gdan drangs te byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas lang gru'u sde bzhi zhes grags pa las/ shar sprul pa'i sde dang ha cang thag mi ring ba'i sa'i cha 'brog gi gnas ri brag du ma tshar du dngar ba la/ nags tshal dang rtsi sman me tog sna tshogs 'khrungs shing / rdza chu sil ma phyogs kun nas 'bab pa/ spangs ljongs dang ne'u gsing gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba du ma dang ldan pa/ yul lha'i rgyal po lha'i dge bsnyen gzi brjid 'phags gnas pa'ir ri chen po rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa lta bu'i lha zhol/ lung pa'i minga'i hor gyi dus su cha glan pol zhes lung dkar du 'bod cing / da lta phun tshogs lung pa zhes grags pa'i nang yin la/ khyad par du rje bla ma nyid 'khrungs pa'i gnas dngos gzhi ni rgyab ri nor bu srungs pa lta bu'i dbyibs su yod pas nor bu thang zhes ming du chags shing / rtsi shing lo 'bras smin pas rab tu mdzes pa/ dge bcu'i dpal 'byor ma tshang ba med pa'i gnas phun sum tshogs pa/ shin tu yid spro la byin chags pa zhig yin no/ / rigs rus ni spyir mdo khams kyi mi'i rigs rgyud rta mog gi spu ltar dbye 'byed shes dka' ba zhig snang mod/ 'on kyang rje bla ma mchog gang du bltams pa'i rigs rgyud 'di ni sngon gyi lo rgyus sogs la brtags na rje'u rigs su gtogs pa zhig yin par mngon/ rus ni/ bod kyi rus chen bra 'bru ldong gsum las bra yin te/6

༄/ /rje bamazla ba4 chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bra'i sde tsho che ba zhig dbus nas mdo smad du chad pa la bra sde zhes 'bod pa phyis su skad zur nyams pas bra ste zhes grags pa yin no/ / dbus nas mdo smad du chad tshul ni/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan mkhan chen po dhi satwa dang 'om bu tshal du mjal skabs/ rgyal pos zhwa lham gyon cing ske rags med par phyag rten gser ka ṭo ra gang phul ba la/ mkhan chen gyis/ rgyal po khyod kyis zhwa gyon pa'i rten 'brel gyis bod chos rgyal gyi gdung brgyud stod kyi mnga' ris su zhwa tsam dang / lham gyon pas mdo smad du lham tsam zhig 'byung / ske rags ma bcings pas bar du rgyal khrims lhod/ 'on kyang gser phul bas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba lta bu 'byung zhes lung bstan pa bzhin du/ khri srongagi sras chung ba mu tig btsan po 'am sad na legs mjing yon/ de'i sras dar ma/ de'i sras gnam lde 'od srung / de'i sras mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan/ de'i sras khri bkra shis rtsegs pa dpal/ de'i sras 'od lde la sras bzhi byung ba'i gnyis pa khri lde 'bangs ha cang mi mang tsam dang bcas mdo smad du byon/ de dus bra sde'ang rgyal po dang lhan du mdo smad du thon cing / mtsho khri shog rgyal mo'i 'gram bod kyis bzung ste chos rgyal gdung brgyud des khri dpon mdzad cing / bra nyang btsan bya bas rgyal po'i blon gyi gtso bo byas tshul rus mdzod za 'og ras ma bya ba las 'byung / rus mdzod der chos rgyal gyi gdung brgyud phyi ma ji ltar byung tshul mi gsal zhing / bra sde'i brgyud pa byung tshul ni/ jo bo rje bod du ma byon gong tsam du bra sgom chos kyi rdo rje sku 'khrungs/ 'di ba mtsho snying ma hā de war byon nas sgrub pa mdzad pas mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul thob/ de dus phur sgom bya ba'i tog ge ba zhig kyang gnas der sgrub pa mdzad cing bzhugs pas/ thog mar brag sgom blun po zer zhing smod pa la/ nyin gcig bra sgom gyis chab gsang skabs chos gos 7

/ /gung bstananga'i napo ga 'bumanyi zer la bkal ba mthong nas dad pa skyes te gdams pa zhus/ chos thun ma rdzogs par nyi ma nub tu nye ba la/ bra sgom gyis rten 'brel zhig mdzad pas chos thun rdzogs kyi bar du nyi ma ma nub pas bra phur nyi ma thag stod du grags/de dus mtsho 'gram gyi bod sde'i dpon ke khong rgya bya ba yin la/ 'di chos rgyal gyi brgyud pa yin min gsal ba mi 'dug / bod sde dang 'dab chags par kla klo'i dpon po mi srun pa zhig yod pas/ bod khri dpon gyis kho la lo re bzhin bu lnga dang bu mo lnga ste mi bcu re khral du ster dgos pa la/ skabs shig kla klo'i dpon nad drag pos btab pas thabs cis kyang ma phan par bra sgom la gsol ba btab pas/ da lta khyod kyi nad ngas bsal gyi/ rjes su do gal che ba zhig ngas zer ba bzhin bya dgos zhes gsungs nas rten 'brel zhig byas pas kho nad las grol/ gtang rag tu khri dpon las mi khral mi len pa dgos gsungs pa ma nyan pa la/ snga ma'i chad don gsungs pas kla klos kyang khasablangs/ des khri dpon ke khod rgya dga' nas bra sgom la rta stong ri tshil dkar gyis gtsos pa'i 'bul chen phul te bla mar bkur/ bod 'bangs thams cad kyis bra sgom kho na bla mar bzung dgos pa'i dril bsgrags/ sa thag ring po na 'khod pa'i bod sde rnams la bra sgom gyi grwa pa ra mchod gnas su btang bas bra sde'i sgar ba bcu gsum sogs byung ba yin par snang / skabs shig khri dpon 'chi nad kyis thebs par bra sgom gdan drangs te ngan song spyong ba'i dbang zhus/ re zhig bzhugs par zhus kyang ma gsan pa la/ nged 'chi ga'i dus su cis kyang phebs dgos zhus par zhal gyis bzhes te/ khyod dbyar dus kyi skabs 'chi srid pas de dus mtsho 'gram nas bsang dud chen po thongs shig dang kho bos sleb pa bya'o gsungs nas mtsho snying du phebs/ phyi lo dbyar dus 'chi ba la mngon du phyogs pas bsang dud chen po btang pa na 8

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /'ga' zhig gis bra sgom mtsho'i steng nas tshur dar lam then nas 'byon pa dang /la las zhabs chu la mi bying bar 'byon pa sogs mthong snang sna tshogs kyis byon/khri dpon la dbang dang 'pho ba sogs mdzad nas slar yang rdzu 'phrul gyis rang gnas su phebs/ skabs shig klung chen 'ju lag gi 'gram du 'khod pa'i sde rnams kyis spyan drangs te mchod bkur bgyis par/ bon bo'i gtso bo zhig yod pas phrag dog gis bra sgom dang nus pa 'gran dgos zer ba la/ bra sgom gyi zhal nas/ lta log bon nag 'di la nus pa ma thon na gsang sngags kyi che ba mi thon pas/ sa gnam chu gsum ga gru gsum gyi dbyibs su yod pa zhig tu bon nag 'di brub dgos gsung / 'ju lag gi klung 'gram du khang chung zhig brtsigs nas der mthu sgrub mdzad pas/ bon po 'ju lag gi phar khar donaspyod cig la 'gro skabs chus khyer ba/ mthar chu phyogs gnyis su gyes pa'i dbus kyi sa gru gsum du yod pa zhig tu shi nas mthon pas/ da lta'ang gnasade gru gsum 'brub khung gi rnam pa ma nyams par yod la/ chu brgal nas khyer ba'i rab de la bon rab ces phyogs der da lta'i bar du grags shing /bra sgom gyi sgrub khang gi shul yang da dung yod do/ / 'ju lag gi chu klung chen po 'di'i ming la sngon gyi dus su chu sngon zer kyang / bar skabs shig klu srin ma rung ba zhig gis gnas bcas te chu 'gram gyi mi phyugs mang po zos pas/nged kyi mi phyugs 'di lta bu chu nang gi srog chags des glo bur du 'jus nas brlag go zhes cho nge byas pas chu'i ming la 'ju brlag zer ba da lta sgra zur nyams pas 'ju lag tu 'bod pa yin zhes rgan rabs kyi zer sgos las 'byung ba bden par snang ste/ klu srin de thabs gang gis kyang mthul ba bra sgom gyes rten 'brel zhig mdzad nas chu khar bton te bsgral ba yin zhes rus mdzod za 'og ras ma las 'byung ngo / / skabs shig byang lam du bud med cig shi ba'i 9

༄/ /gung thang bstanami'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/ro la 'dre zhugs nas dbus su 'gro mkhan rnams bcom pas/ lo mang por mdo smad nas dbus su 'gro ba'i rgyun chad pas/ bra sgom byon nas btul te 'dre mo'i thod pa blangs pa deng sang sgar ba zhig gi rten gras su yod 'dug /bra sgom bod du byon nas bsam yas su bzhugs skabs rgyal pos mtho brtsams pa la rgyal po ar gtad kyi gdams pa'i skor gter nas bton te btul ba'i lo rgyus gter ma'i bla rgyud rnam thar las bshad cing / gter chos de ni spu gri las rgyud dam/ rā tsa srog gi sru gri'i rgyud du grags pa de yin par snang ngo / / sku tshe'i mthar 'ja' tshon zhig tu gyur nas gnam la yal zhes rus mdzod du 'byung bas/ 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes par gor ma chag go /bra sgom chos kyi rdo rje'i dpon rgyud la grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor ba mang du thon pas/ bra sde'i gdung brgyud 'di mdo khams kyi gdung brgyud byin rlabs can du byed pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin par snang / skabs shig bra sde'i tshe phyug 'phan bya ba zhig bod kyi khri dpon la dbang bsgyur/ mi rabs kha shas kyi mtshams nas khri dpon gyi mnga' thang nyams pas/ tshe phyug 'phan gyi brgyud pa gle gshin bon dmar bya ba bon lugs kyi grub thob cig byung ba des bra sde gtsosapa'i bod 'bangs mi nyung tsam khrid nas mdo smad kyi byang gi mtha' ri brag nags tshal yod pa'i gnas bzung / nyin gcig nub phyogs nas ser ba drag po zhig shar phyogs su song ba'i shul du dkar gro zer ba'i rdza gseb tu rta dkar po gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos can zhig rkang pa 'theng nas 'gro ma thub par lus 'dug pa rnyed nas bltas pas/ rkang rmig gi gseb tu yungs gar 'bru bzhi zug 'dug / de bton nas rma sos pa'i sngags btab pas de ma thag rta sprin gyes btums nas nam mkha' la khyer/ de nub mi lam du/ rta de rma chen spom ra'i chibs yin/ ser ba srung ba'i sngags pas thun 10

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /rgyab pa rkang par zug nas lus pa khyod kyis bton pas legs/ sang nyin nubaphyogs kyi brag dkar po shel gye mchod rten 'dra ba'i rtsar shog la dngos grubalong zer ba rmis/ der phyin pas bu mo gzugs byad blta bas chog mi shes pa zhig dang / mo 'debs pa'i bcu thig cig 'dug pa blangs nas rang gnas su log / bu mo de dang khyim thab byas nas lo gcig song ba na grod pa zhig btsas pa'i nang nas khye'u yid du 'ong ba brgyad byung / de ma thag bu mo de mi snang bar gyur/ khye'u brgyad kyi ma brag rtsa nas rnyed pas brag tsha brgyad du grags/ bu mo de rma chen gyi sras mo yin pas brag tsha brgyad rma chen gye tsha bo dang / rma chen yang bra'i rus lha yin par bshad/ li shi bon dmar gyis bcu thig de la mo btab pas shin tu thig pa byung ste hor rgyal pos kyang blang dor 'dri ba byung / hor gyi blon po yas sku gro lod zer bar bu mo byad gzugs phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod pa bon dmar gyi bu brag tsha che ba'i khyim thabs su blangs pa la bu gsum byung ba'i che ba des sog po'i cha byad kyis zhwa'i steng du phod kha dmar po btsugs pas zhwa dmar du grags/ 'bring po la brgyud pa ma byung / tha chung la bu bdun byung ba'i gsum pa'i brgyud pa bra ste tshangs pa thog 'chabs bya ba phyag rdor gyi rnal 'byor pa 'gran zla byed pa la thog dngos su 'bebs thub pa zhig byung / de'i bu tshangs pa a gar bya ba/de nas brgyud pa lnga'i bar du sngags pa nus ldan sha stag byung ba'i rjes ma gsang bdag rdo rje'i bu dpang skyabs rgyal bya ba rje 'di'i yab yin la/gzhon dus lang tsho'i dregs pas dga' dga' skyid skyid kyi ngang la mi tshe btang nas lha'i sgrub phrin nyams len sogs ma byas pas pha mes kyi sngags rgyud ma zin par 'dug kyang / shes rab che bas yi ge 'bri klog sogs zhar la bslab cing / rgyun du phyag mchod la brtson pa dang / dus bzang rnams su bsnyen 11

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/gnasadang bskung gnas bsrung ba zhig yin par 'dug / khyad par du rgya sog gi dus 'khrugs skabs 'di phyogs kyi bod rnams sog po'i mnga' 'bangs yin par brten rgya dmag khri phrag mang pos bod thams cad ri la bskor nas ri dwags rgya la 'thum pa lta bur gyur skabs 'di pa tsham tshom med par rgya'i dmag sgar du phyin nas dmag dpon cang jun chen por bzed grol gyi zhu ba phul te mgo btags pas bod rnams srog gi chad pa las thar te rang rang gi gnas bdag gir byed rgyu byung bas/ yul phyogs der kun gyis drin che bar gleng zhing / rgya'i dpon chen rnams kyis gong mar zhus nas 'di pa la chen hu'i lung las gnang ste de phyogs kyi bod kyi dpon por bskos/ chung ma snga phyi gnyis blangs pa'i snga ma la bu kha shas skyes kyang mi ring bar 'das/ phyi ma la ri bza' chos mtsho skyid bya ba rje 'di nyid kyi yum yin zhing / de'ang rgyun du rje btsun sgrol ma yi dam du byed pa/ dkon mchog dang las 'bras la dad gus che zhing / nyam thag rnams la snying brtse ba sogs bud med phal ba'i spyod tshul las 'das pa/ rjes sor 'das pa'i skabs su gdung sbyangs pas thod pa'i rus pa la a yig 'bur dod du byon pa sogs ya mtshan shin tu che ba zhig go / de'ang yab de nyid kyi rigs rgyud snga ma byung ba rnams bar chad kyi dbang gis 'das shing / rje 'di nyid ma 'khrungs pa'i skabs der bu med pa'i sdug bsngal gyis bla ma chos skyong mo phywa byed pa kun la rigs brgyud yod pa'i thabs dris nas rim gro mang du bgyis skabs/ a khu zhabs drung bstan 'dzin snyan grags bya ba zhig yod pa de'i rmi lam du dpang skyabs rgyal gyis bla brang gi rten gyi gtso bo la g.yu legs pa zhig phul na bu khyad par du 'phags pa zhigakhye zer ba rmis pa bzhin rje 'di'i yab kyis g.yu bzang po zhig nyos nas bra ste bla brang gi rten gyi gtso bo la phul te phyag mchod rgyun ring tsam byas skabs 12

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /glo bur du snang ba gzhan thams cad 'gags te mdun gyi nam mkha' 'od dmar pozhig gis khyab pa'i dbus na rgyal ba 'od dpag med chos gos kyi grwa gcig rlung gis bskyod bzhin bzhugs pa zhig gi nyams snang shar/ yang nub gcig bla ma gzi brjid can rgya'i lugs kyi na bza' phu thung bzhes pa rgya dpon gnyis dang bcas 'ongs nas bla ma khyim gyi phugs su bzhugs shing /dpon po gnyis khyim gyi sgo'i g.yas g.yon du bsrung ba'i tshul gyis sdod pa zhig rmis/ yum gyi rmi lam du brag dkar po zhig gi rtsa nas gdan gser 'brug ma zhigadang spub cha legs pa zhig rnyed nas khyim du khyer yong ba rmis/ skabs 'ga' zhig tu sbra'i mtha' skor du 'ja' tshon 'khrigs pa dang / sngar med pa'i bya rog chen po zhig yang yang 'khor ba'ang byung 'dug la/ gzhan yang dge mtshan gyi ltas ya mtshan pa sna tshogs dang / yul gyi rmi ltas gsal ba can 'ga' zhig la'ang rmi lam shin tu ngo mtshar ba ci rigs byung tshul gyi lo rgyus yod 'dug kyang zhib cha ngos dag rtsad ma chod pas ma bris/ de nas 'phags pa'i yul du pigo la ste dmar ser can du grags shing dbang thang bstun pa me mo sgrul gyi lo hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bdun gza' skar 'phrod sbyor phun sum tshogs pa dkar po'i phyogs kyi bzang po gnyis pa'i nyi dros kyi skabs su yum la gnod pa med par khye'u mdog dkar zhing dbyibs mdzes pa/yan lag dang nying lag rnam par 'byes shing / dpral pa'i dbyes che pa/dge mtshan du ma'i snang brnyan gcig tu bsdus pa bzhin mthong na mi mthun pa med pa zhig mngon par bltams te 'jig rten kun gye mig gi bdud rtsir gyur /bhe/ hūṃ/༈༵ byehūṃ/ bye byeṭ+wāṃm ༷ ༵/༷brteṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ~X ༷ ṭ+wāṃ /༷ ṭ+wāṃ ngh+ru /zlordo/ bye bye t+t+waṃ rdo byeṭ+wāṃ 13

༄/ /gung tha bstanaba'i namatha gsung ཿma/dbyig gi phung po 'di/ / bskyed pa'i yum mchog don gyi dpal mo ste/ / ri bo'i nu 'bur g.yo ba'i gser ldan la/ / nor 'dzin dpal mor grags pa gtam du zad/ / mtho mtho'i sa 'dzin rtse mor re dogs kyi/ / dkar nag 'dres ma'i mda' rgod btsugs min par/ / bar ma'i cho rigs gtsang ma'i lha sdings su/ / rang 'khrangs tsan dan ljon pa skyes pa'i dngos/ / chos kyi rgya mtsho 'di na mchis so zhes/ / dam can srung ma'i chu skyar lding ba na/ / sngon gnas dran pa'i me yis brjed nges kyi/ / bud shing bsregs pa'i gsung ngag dud pa'ang 'thul/ / brtse ldan sman gye myu gu khyod bltams tshe/ / ngo mtshar ltas kyi dri bzang 'thul bas kyang / / srid na gnyug mar gnas pa rgud pa'i nad/ / ma lus dmigs med dbyings su 'bros par rtsom/ / 'jig rten snyigs ma'i mdangs kyis mgrin sngo yang / / mchog sprul zla ba'i cod paṇa gsar tshes kyi/ / 'dzum dkar phan dang bde ba'i snang ba yis/ / dbang phyug yon tan dar ba rdzogs ldan bzhin/ / spangs rtogs yon tan bri gang ma dmigs kyang / / rga ba'i ri mo grub pa'i bcud len gyes/ / sbyangs te gzhon nur grub pa'i lang tsho yis/ / mig dang yid la kun dga'i char gyis bran/ /zhes rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum rmad du byung ba'i mdzad bzang 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal gyi cha tsam gtam du byas pa rtogs brjod pad+ma dkar po las/ rigs phun sum tshogs par sku bltams pa'i tshul gyi 'dab ma ste dang po'o/ /14

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /༄7/ / 'dab ma gnyis pa/ gdan sar phebs pa'i tshul/de nas sku bltams pa'i gnas tshul de nyid a khu zhabs drung la sbran pas khong gis de ma thag dkon mchog gi rten rnams la gtsang zhing gya nom pa'i mchod 'bul dang / yul lha'i gsol mchod gang rgyas byas/ de nas cher ma 'gyang bar bra ste dgon pa'i chos skyong sku phebs kyi lha tshes nyin yum gyis lha mjal du khyer bas chos skyong gis thog ma nas dar tshon sna lnga zhig phyag tu thogs nas bzhugs te mjal ba thams cad la rim pa bzhin byin rlabs gnang bas/ bar mtshams shig tu ma yum gyis mjal skabs/ byis pa bang du bzung yod pa la dar tshon sna lnga de nyid kyis dkris nas byis pa 'di la gtsang sbra gal che tshul nan tan gnang / de'i tshe yab kyi mag pa rgyab tshe khya li zer bas/ de ring chos skyong gi byed lugs la dpag na nged kyi a zhang rgad pos lha klu mi gsum la 'o dod pos bos nas rnyed pa'i bu chung de rgad po la mi dbang ba zhig byed 'dod yod pa 'dra zhes ma dga' ba byas zer/ zla shas kyi mtshams nas a khu zhabs drung gis bu chung 'di snga phyi'i mi ltas sogs la dpag na rang ga ba zhig min thag chod yin pas dgon par blangs nas nged kyis do dmabyed dgos zhes yab yum gnyis la lab pas yab yum gnyis sras ming sring dang bcas pa dgon par btegs/ yab yum sogs dgon pa'i gling 'dabs su spra phug nas bsdad cing / nyid a khu zhabs drung gi gam du bzhag / de'i tshe a khu zhabs drung gis kyang shin tu gces pas/ khong rang gis bod nas spyon 'ongs pa'i zhwa snam gyi zhwa mo chen po zhig yod pa phyi nang slog 15

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/pa'i khud du bzhag nas nom bu snyod pa sogs mas bu la ji ltar bya ba bzhin gces par bskyangs/ de'i tshe rgyu mtshan ma rtogs pa'i skye bo 'ga' zhig gis don med pa'i sgro skur gyi ya ga phran tshegs byung bar brten cher ma 'gyangs par yab yum dang bcas sngar gyi gnas rnying bar spos/ 'on kyang nyid khyim du bzhugs pa la gtan nas mi dgyes par dgon pa'i phyogs su yang yang bros pas/ skabs skabs su yab kyis rta zhon pa'i pang du thogs te dgon par khyer nas zhag shas re sdod dgos pa byung / lan cig dgon par phebs pa'i lam skabs su spro nyams chen pos gru mang po zhig len gin 'dug pa yab kyis zhib tu nyan pas/ dgon pa khra khrar 'gro rgyu yin/ / de na grwa ba mang po yod/ / rgya gling bus pa sing sing byed/ / dung dkar bus pa 'ur 'ur byed/ / rnga spub brdungs pa chem chem byed/ / nga rang khri la skyil krung byas/ / dge 'dun mang pos me tog gtor/ / nga yis am ring bshad rgyu yin/ / zhes gsung gin 'dug pa ci zhig yin snyam the tshom du gyur te a khu zhabs drung sogs la lab pas/ zhabs drung gis/ lam rim bshad rgyu yin zer 'dod par 'dug kyang tshig dag po ma thon par am ring bshad rgyu yin byas pa red zer/ grwa pa zhig gis 'o na khyod rang gis am ring shod dang nged tshos nyan byas pas/ nam mkha' la mdzub mos bstan nas lha mi zer/sa la mdzub mo btsugs nas khyi phag zer/ bar snang la lag pa yug yug byed cing nag po dkar po zer/ lag pa mnyam bzhag byas nas/ bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ / sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ / chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ / dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ / zer nas mgo btum nas bsdad pa la/ de mur slob rgan zer pa'i dge bshes shig gis/ bde 'gro dang ngan 'gro gang du skye ba dkar nag gi las la rag las/ dkon mchog la 16

༄za/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /skyabs 'gro dgos zer rgyu yin 'dug / byis pa 'di tha mal pa zhig min par thag chod zer langs nas phyag btsal bas gzhan rnams kyang shin tu ngo mtshar nas mang po zhig gis phyag btsal zhing ya mtshan che ba'i tshad du byed pa byung /dge bshes de ni dpyod tshul gyi nyams shin tu che zhing blo gros zab pa zhig yin snang bas khong gis dpyad tshul de ltar du nges par don la gnas shing de nyid rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mthar thug pa'ang yin te/ mdo rtsa ba las/ sgo khang du 'khor ba'i 'khor lo cha lnga pa bya'o/ / steng du lha dang mi dag go / zhes sogs kyis steng 'og tu bde 'gro dang ngan 'gro / mthar yan lag bcu gnyisakyi sgo nas 'khor tshul/ dbus su de dag gi rtsa ba dang so sor 'gro ba'i lam/ steng du 'gog pa myang 'das mtshon pa'i zla ba/ de thob byed kyi lam bden ston pa'i tshigs bcad/ de ston pa po'i sangs rgyas dang bcas bden bzhi'i 'jug ldog skyabs gsum dang bcas ri mo'i lam nas mtshon tshul gsungs pa dang gnad gcig tu snang ngo / / sku na shin tu phra ba'i skabs der yang gtsang spe med par gang byung gi sar bag med du sdod pa dang ngu ba sogs byis pa'i rgud pa mtha' dag ring du spangs te/ phebs bzhugs sogs kyi spyod lam mtha' dag shin tu gtsang zhing dang ba 'dren pa dang /rtsed mo'i rnam grangs mdzad pa'ang dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ gos dag glaci'i dri dang ldan pa bzhin/ / skyes bu snying stobs dben pa'i gnyen ldan pa/ / bsod nams nye bar rdzogs pa'i mthu chen gang / / ci yang de ni lus brgyar med mi 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ sku tshe du mar 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang mtha' yas pa la ring du 'dris pa'i bag chags thugs la zhen pa'i stobs kyis lha khang bzhengs pa/ dge 'dun mang po tshogs la 'tshogs pa/ chos 'chad pa/ phyag mnyam bzhag mdzad de ting nge 'dzin 17

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i na 'i gsung 'bum/bsgom pa'i rnam pa sogs dang / 'jim pas mi gzugs shig bzos te sa la dong brus pa'i nang du bzhag nas steng g.yam pas bkab/ 'di na dam can chos rgyal yod zer zhing / byis pa gzhan gyis gtses pa na de'i mdun du phebs nas zhu gtugs byed/ gtor ma 'phen pa dang sbyin sreg byed pa sogs sngar gsan gzigs myong ba med kyang / rdo zur gsum lta bu re phyag tu thogasanas kā la rū pa hūṃ phaṭa zer zhing 'phen pa dang / thab ga'i nang du shing bu bcug pa'i steng du snum gyi rigs gang byung blugs nas yasna ye zer ba sogs sngags dang cho ga'i tshig ris du ma thol thol gsung bas skye bo rnams shin tu ya mtshan par gyur/ dgung lo gsum pa'i dus nged rang bla ma tshan po zhig yin gsung ba dang / dgon lung phyogs su mdzub mo btsugs nas 'di na nga'i dgon pa dang rten gsum grwa pa mang po yod gsung ba la/ yab kyis khyod bla ma su zer ba yin byas pas/ tham ga tham ga bya ba yin gsung / grwa pa ming ci 'dra can yod ces par/ bsam 'grub yod/ chos bzang yod/ces gsung / nyin gcig na bza' 'ga' zhig bres po byas te khur nas gshed cig tu phebs song ba yab kyis gar 'gro bltas pas dgon lung gi phyogs su 'gro ba'i lam zhig yod pa la zhugs nas phebs song pa dang rjes su bsnyegs pas rgyang grags gsum tsam gyi sa nas rjes zin pa byung / gar 'gro rgyu yin byas pas dgon lung du 'gro gsung ba la/ yab kyis dgon lung zer ba der zhag ma drug bdun ma byas pas mi gleb/ lam bar du nags mthug po dang / gcan gzan mang bas 'gro dka' zhes lab par/ nags mthug po gcan gzan yod sar sdod myong / gcan gzan dang ri dwags la rtsed grogs byas na bzang / khyed rang khyim du phyir log / nga do nub nags gseb 'dir bsdad/ sang nyin yang gar sleb cig tu 'gro rgyu yin gsung ba 18

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /sogs ni/ thams cad sgrol gyi skyes rabs las/ gzhon yang rgan pa'i nye bar zhi la dga'/ / gsungs pa bzhin sku tshe du mar dpen pa'i ri sul dang nags khrod sogs su sgrub pa la gzhol ba'i bag chags sad pa'i gsung du the mi tshom zhing / gsung tshul yang gom rgyus can gyi mi rgan po zhig gis bshad tshul lta bur snang ba ya mtshan no/ / de nas yab kyis 'o na de ring khyim du phyir 'gro/nyi skar bzang nyin zhig dpon g.yog mang po byas nas dgon lung du skyel zer ba sogs thabs sna tshogs kyis brid pas phyir slog thub tsam byung / rgyu mtshan de dag la brten nas yab yum sogs la dgon lung gi bla ma zhig gi sku skye yin nam snyam pa'i dogs pa che ba byung na'ang / sa khad ring zhing dgon lung dang snga ma 'brel ba gtan nas med pa dang / lhag par rje thu'u bkwan pa'i mtshan tsam yang thos yod med lta bu yin gshis khong gi yang srid yin snyam pa mi lam du'ang med pa la/ skabs shig sngar gyi dgon pa'i chos skyong des/ bu chung 'di pa thu'u bkwan rin po che'i sprul sku yin/ dgon lung du khong gi grwa rigs rnams la gnas tshul ma bsnyad na sprul sku nor dogs yod pas mgyogs par 'phrin btang na legs zhes lung bstan byung / yab yum gnyis la sras gcig pu las med pa dang / dgon lung sa thag ring ba sogs kyis 'dod pa gtan nas med pa la/ a khu zhabs drung gis bu chung 'di'i don du sngar nged nas gzhan gyi mi kha yan chad la ma 'dzem par do dam dka' las de tsam byas pa 'di gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig yong rgyu'i re ba kho nas byas pa yin/ byis pa 'di'i byed spyod dang zer lugs kyang ya mtshan pa zhig 'dug / da res chos skyong gis kyang gsal kha gnang byung bas dgon lung du gnas tshul gyi yi ge mi gtong thabs med pa yin zhes 'dun gros btsan chod byas pas yab yum gnyis kyang mi nyan kha med byung / de nas a khu zhabs drung gis dgon lung 19

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'izlaname'igasung ཿma/du tho'u bkwan rin po che'i gra pa rnams la gnas tshul zhib 'khod kyi yi ge bskur ba dbon po dge legs/ ngag dbang chos bzang / blo bzang bsam 'grub/ bstan 'dzin chos 'phel rnams 'dzom thog tu yi ge kha phye ba dang dus mtshungs su lo de'i 'brug skad thog mar grags pas rten 'brel bzang zhes thams cad la dga' tshor chen po byung / dpon po bstan 'dzin chos 'phel ngo g.yog rtog dpyod byed par bra ste dgon par slebs/ a khu zhabs drung la rgyu mtshan bsnyad pas zhabs drung gis dgon par blangs/ dgon lung nas 'ongs pa tshos zas sna mang tsam dang bcas rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtshos yun ring bsnams pa'i phyag 'phreng / rdo dril/ thugs dam rten thub dbang gi sku rnams 'dra min re bcas rjes nyid kyi spyan lam du phab ste/ 'di khrod nas khyed rang gi yin pa tsho ngos 'dzin mdzod ces zhus pas/ phyag phreng rnyingab spos shel gyi 'phreng ba zhig yod pa bzhes/ rdo dril dngos dang 'dra min gnyis ka dkrol/ thub pa'i sku gnyis ga'i mdun du khur mang gi me tog kha shas bzhag pa la/ phyag 'phreng ngos 'dzin mdzad pa bka' drin che/ da dungardo dril dang sku 'dra ngos 'dzin mdzad dgos zhes nan tan bgyis pa la thugs khros pa'i tshul gyis thams cad la brdungs/ shing thog lder ma gang thugasadam rten gyi sku de'i drung du bzhag / rdo dril ngo ma de phyag tu blangs nas dkrol zhing gar gyi rnam pa mang po zhig mdzad do/ / dang po'i ngos 'dzin bzhes tshul de nyid dgongs pa shin tu zab pa zhig yin snang ste/ khong rnams kyi 'dod pa ltar na thugs dam rten gyi sku de yar bzhes nas gcig shos mar dor na dga' rgyu yin 'dug kyang / nyid kyi thugs la snga ma'i thugs dam rten yinamin ji ltar yang khyad med du sangs rgyas dngos dang 'dra bar phyag dang mchod pa'i gnas su byed dgos par dgongs nas de ltar mdzad pa ni bstan 20

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /pa'i 'jug sgo skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya khyad par du 'phags pa zhig yin la/rdo dril yang gnyis ka dkrol ba gsang chen rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi bdag por 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin nam snyam/ de nas dpon po bstan 'dzin chos 'phel sogs dgon lung du 'byor nas grwa rigs rnams gros bsdur thog pe'i cing du lcang skya rin po che dang / dga' ldan khri sprul rnam gnyis la gnas tshul gyi yi ge rgyas pa phul/ lcang skya rin po che nas thugs dam brtags pa gnang bar/ rje thu'u bkwan pa'i gra pa yin zer ba'i migazi brjid can zhig gis me long zhig bstan byung ba'i nang du rten 'brel snying po mgo 'bus tsam zhig 'dug / mi des sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi sku brnyan stong bzhengs na yi ge 'di yongs rdzogs gsal bar 'gyur zhes zer ba zhig mnal lam du byung ba bzhin a mdor grwa rigs rnams la gsung shog stsal pas/ grwa pa rnams kyis sku brnyan shing par gos dar la btab bas stong tshar bzhengs te/ dgon lung gi tshogs pa la dad rten tu bkye ba bgyis/dogs gnas kyi bu chung gzhan yang bzhi tsam yod 'dug pas/ de bzhi ga dang rje 'di nyid bcas lnga char gyi yul phyogs pha ma'i rigs rus/ so so'i ming sogs bris te pe'i cing nas rje bla ma rnam gnyis kyis bod du rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa bskal bzang rgya mtshor gsung brtags kyi yi ge 'bul ba gnang ba'i phyir phebs la/ bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba btab nas brtags pa zhib tu bgyis par blo bzang bstan 'dzin nyi ma 'di nyid sku skye yin pa babs zhes phebs/ gsung brtags kyi 'byor lan ma 'byor pa'i sngon tsamal/ a mdo nas lung bstan snga ma 'ga' zhig gi dgongs don len ma shes par/ sngo skor zer ba'i 'brog khrod kyi bu chung zhig la rje thu'u bkwan pa'i yangasred du ngos bzung nas/ thu'u bkwan rin po che'i dpon po rnams kyis 21

༄/ /gung thangabastanaba'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/thog ma'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa sogs bgyis/ chos bzang ri khrod kyi grwa ba thu'u bkwan dge slong blo bzang mkhas mchog bya bas/ bu chung shi mdog can 'di byad dbyibs la ltos kyang bla ma de nyid kyi sku skye min pa thag chod ces khrom dbus su lab pa la phal cher gyis ma rangs pa'i rnam pa byas zer/ mi ring bar pe'i cing nas bla ma dam pa rnam gnyis kyis sprul sku'i don skor rgyal dbang mchog la zhus par/ lang gru'i phyogs kyi bra ste dpang skyabs rgyal gyi bu chung de nyid sku skyer thag chod pa'i gsung shog phebs pas myur du gdan sar 'jog pa'i rtsol ba gyis zhes pa'i bka' shog dang / bod du phul ba'i lung zhus ngo ma bcas gnang ba 'byor pas/ grwa rigs rnams re zhig gi bar byed dka' la thug / blo bzang mkhas mchog na re/ 'jig rten kha dpe la/ glen pa 'phyugs kyang mtho gang yin/ / mkhas pa 'phyugs na 'dom gang 'phyugs/ / zer ba bden pa 'dug / phyag mdzod mkhas grags can dang /grwa rigs de tsam gyis 'brog phrug rtswa'i 'bu lta bu zhig la phyag btsal/ lag pa mgol 'jog tu bcug pa chud zos su song bas/ 'dom gang gis kyang mi tshad pa 'phyugs zhes zer skad/ de nas bla ma rnam gnyis kyi bka' bzhin dgon lung nas dpon po ngag dbang dge legs/ hor du ma chos rje sogs dpon g.yog mang tsam 'byor te gza' tshes bzang po'i nyin sku gsung thugs rten na bza' sogs 'phral du nyer mkho'i yo byad rnams phul/ de ga'i gzhi dgon la'ang mang 'gyed spyi 'jog gya nom pa bgyis/ de nas dgung lo drug bzhes pa chu pho khyi'i lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes bzhi'i nyin lam du zhugs/ lhun po zer ba'i ri bo chen po zhig yod pa'i rtse nas gzhi bdag du ma'i ming nas smos te mchod yar ring po zhig mdzad/ zhabs 'brangs pa rnams som nyir gyur te rgyu mtshan dris pas rang yul gyi gzhi bdag mang po skyel mar sleb byung 22

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /gsung / mchod rten thang dgon pa bkra shis dar rgyas gling nas bsu ba ser sbrengs dang bcas dgon par gdan drangs/ dgon lung khri pa zhal snga nas bde rgu ngag dbang dge legs rgya mtsho pas gtso mdzad/ dgon lung gi spyi bla brang thams cad kyi bsu mi mang po slebs/ mchod rten thang dgon pas 'du khang du gdan drangs 'bul nod dang bcas tshogs pas mjal kha zhus shing /gzhi byes tshang mar ston mo gzab rgyas byas/ 'jug lag gi chu la gzings kyis thon nas rang thag zer ba'i lung pa chu brag nags gsum gyis bgrod dka' ba der slebs pa na/ glo bur du chu brub pas khal ma 'ga' zhig dang /chos 'phel rgya mtsho zer ba'i btsun chung zhig chus khyer kyang dkon mchog gi thugs rjes nyes skyon med par thon/ de'i nyin snga ma der nyid nas 'dir nyin gcig bcag mal bgyis te rim gro zhig byed dgos/ khyed tshos mdo sgrol thon/ nged kyis rdo zor 'phen zhes gsung 'dug pa chu brub rgyu 'di mkhyen pa yin zhes gleng ba byung / rnga chen zer ba'i sa char dgon lung gi zhabs drung dka' ram mang tsam dang / gzhan yang phyogs 'dus kyi bsu mi mang po slebs/ rdo dkar thang zhes par dgon lung spyi nas thab bsu rgyas pa zhus shing / de nas dgon par slebs kyi bar du dgon mchod gzhis dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang bu dgon 'ga' zhig gser khog chu bzang sogs kyi bsu mi rim par byung / dgon pa'i nye 'dabs su dur smrig 'chang ba'i dge 'dun nyis stong tsam gyis ser sprengs byas te 'phan gdugs/ rgyal mtshan sogs mchod rdzas du ma thogs shing rol mo 'bud dkrol sna tshogs dang / rje gong ma dran pa'i skyo shas dang dad gus/ mchog gi sprul sku'i zhal bzang mngon du gyur pa'i dga' ba sogs 'du shes sna tshogs kyis rang dbang med par bsgyur bas dad gus kyi rnam 'gyur sna tshogs pa byed cing / gsol ba 23

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/'debs pa'i gdangs dbyangs snyan por sgrogs pa sogs bkur ste rgya chen po dang bcas chos sde chen po dgon lung byams pa gling gi thu'u bkwan bla brang du phyag phebs nas/ chos dang srid kyi dregs ldan ma lus pa'i gdengs ka nor bu'i cod paṇa dang mngon par 'grogs pa'i sems dpa' chen po rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho'i chos kyi khri 'phangs mthon por zhabs zung 'khor lo'i ri mo nye bar bkod de bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan dang po'i dus ston mngon du gyur to/ / smras pa/ rgyal kun shis pa'i me tog char du bsnyil/ / grub pa'i bden tshig rgyud mangs glu ru len/ / bgegs 'joms khro bo rol pas sa chen g.yo/ / rdo rje ma rnams mchod pa'i gar gyis brel/ / de lta'i ngo mtshar ma tshang med pa yi/ / phun tshogs 'dod dgur 'khyil ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /gzhom med chos kyi khri la dbang bskur tshe/ / yangs pa'i 'jig rten rdzogs ldan sprin gyis khyab/ / zhabs mthil zla ba rgyas pa'i me long ngos/ / dregs ldan zur phud ri mos rab mdzes te/ / dka' thub gdung ba'i nyams ldan zhabs sen gyi/ / zla tshes phra yang skye dgu'i phyag gi yul/ / mi mngon sbas pa'i brtul zhugs chu 'dzin gyi/ / dra bar bsdams kyang gzi brjid snang ba'i gter/ / legs byas dpal gyi 'dab brgya 'grol ba la/ / snang byed dkyil 'khoragazhan gyi do zla min/ / de tshe ngo mtshar ha ri tsajan gyi/ / dri bzang snying por 'chang ba grags pa'i bsung / / skal bzang grub pa'i skye bo mtha' dag gis/ / phan tshun spel ba'i skyes kyi dngos por gyur/ / ces rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum rmad du byung ba'i mdzad bzang 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal gyi cha tsam gtam du byas pa rtogs brjod pad+ma dkar po las gdan sar phebs pa'i tshul gyi 'dab ma ste gnyis pa'o/ /24

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /༄tsho/ / 'dab ma gsum pa/ bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas rab byung pa'i tshul/de nas khri rin po ches gtsos pa'i gzhi byes tshang ma gdan 'dzom pa la bla brang nas gsol ston rgyas par bstar/ ston mo grol nas skya ser gyi khrom shin tu che bar phyag dbang gnang skabs sku gong ma'i grwa rigs dang sbyin bdag 'ga' zhig la ched du dgyes pa'i 'dzum ston pa dang / khams 'dri sogs mdzad pas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur/ mjal kha gtong skabs rwa skor du bzhugs sa'i stegs shig bshams 'dug pa la gzigs nas 'di mi legs par 'dug / mā gyu zi yod pa khyer shog gsung bas de 'dra med zhus/mjal kha grub rjes su khang ba 'ga' zhig gi nang la phebs pas/ de'i gcig na sku gong ma rgyun du byams bzhugs mdzad pa'i mā gyu zi zhig yod pa gzigs te/ da ga'i khyed tshos med zer ba de 'di na 'dug ces cung zad thugs ma mnyes pa'i rnam pa mdzad/ khong rnams der sdod bzhin pa yin kyang ma dran pa/ nyid nas de ltar gsung ba ni ko sā la'i rgyal po'i skyes rabs las/gnyid las sad pa bzhin du skye ba nges dran pa/ / zhes gsungs pa ji lta bar snang ngo / / mchod khang du mjal skabs phyag mang du btsal zhing / sku brnyan rnams la re re bzhin du zhib gzigs dang / de'i nang nas 'ga' zhig la 'di gang dang gang yin zhes bka' 'dri gnang bar/ dpon po ngag dbang chos bzang gis rtogs pa bcug pas/ btang snyoms su bzhag pa rnams sku gong ma rang gis bzhengs pa'i gras yin la/ ma mkhyen pa bzhin mdzad de 25

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronami'i gsung 'bum/rtsad gcod gnang ba tsho gzhan gyis phul ba'i rigs su 'dug ces gleng zhing ngo mtshar du byed pa byung / de nas 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po zhal snga nas ngag dbang dge legs rgya mtsho'i drung nas dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes shing de'i bsrung bya rnams rtsad bcad de nan tan che bar mdzad/ gdan sar phebs pa'i dga' ston du dgon lung tshogs chen la mang 'gyed rgyas par bstar/pe'i cing nas lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gis sku gsung thugs rten/ bzhugs gdan rgyab yol/ pan chas cha tshang / dngul gos dar sogs kyi gnang skyes dang / dge legs kyi tshig bkra phun sum tshogs pa'i gsung shog rgyas pa/de mtshungs dga' ldan khri rin po che nas kyang gsung bris rten chas rgyas pa bcas bskur gnang mdzad pa rnams spyan lam du bstar/ snga sor sprul sku thag chod pa'i rgyu mtshan tsam gong ma chen por snyan 'bul zhus yod 'dug cing /da res gdan sar phebs grub pas/ mi sna ched mngags kyis sku gsung thugs rten snam spos sogs bdog pa'i dngos po mtshon byed dang bcas 'jam pa'i dbyangs 7gong ma chen por mtshams zhus phul par dgyes pa chen pos bka' 'dri dang legs skyes kyi kha dar gnang / lcang skya rdo rje 'chang nas bka' phebs pa bzhin ye ge 'bri klog sogs slob pa'i dge rgan du mar tshang dpon chung blo bzang chos 'dzin bya ba'i gnas brtan bgres po zhig mdun du bcar bzhugs mdzad/ yi ge phyi mo dang sbyor klog gang la'ang dka' tshegs med par brda sprad pa tsam gyis mkhyen cing / chos spyod 'ga' zhig ched du thugs 'dzin gnang ma dgos par gzhan gyis kha ton byed pa lan re gnyis tsam gsan pas thugs la zin pa byung / klog gi slob dpon pa'ang nyid kyi mkhyen rab la shin tu ha las pa lta bus 'dzin skyor sogs kyi don du tshig tsub mo zur tsam yang mi zhu zhing / der ma zad mdun du mi byung tshad la'ang 26

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /thugs rab bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bsngags bajod kho na sgrogs pa byung /bka' las kyang / kho bos nyin gcig rtsed mo byed skabs lag thal te phye ma leb cig bsad pa gzigs nas/ khyed rang skyes bu dam pa'i yang srid yin kyang sdig pa la 'dzem dgos/ skyes bu dam pa mthon po 'ga' zhig la'ang lasakyi rnam smin rang dbang med par thog tu babs tshul 'di dang 'di 'dra yod/ las kyi rnam smin sus kyang bzlog mi thub/ sprul sku chen po yin zer nas las 'bras la dbang shed mi 'gro zhes gsung gdangs drag pos phyag yug yug mdzad/ de tsam ma gtogs nged dang lhan du lo mang po bzhugs kyang thugs khro ba dang bka' bkyon gyi rnam pa gnang ba ye mi dran pa 'dug / dam pa de nyid thugs rgyud shin tu dul zhing / chos tshugs btsun pa sogs gang ci nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen du 'os pa zhig yin pas ye ge 'bri klog sogs slob pa'i zhar la/ bla ma dkon mchog gi yon tan/ sangs rgyas byang sems du ma'i rnam thar/ las 'bras kyi rnam gzhag sogs gsung 'phros dang 'brel bar yang yang rna lam du bsgrags pas/ nged rang de dus byis pa'i sems g.yo rgyu sogs kyis ma bslad cing dred por ma song ba dang / ha cang dkor gyis ma tshig pa'i skabs yin pa'i dbang gis gang gsung tshad mar bzung bas dad pa dang yid ches sogs dga' rab byung / deng sang gi dus su/'dab chags snyi las shor ba dang / / bud med khyo gsum 'grim pa dang / /ban btsun chos la dred pa gsum/ / g.yo yi nang nas de gsum ngan/ / zer ba bzhin rgyud chos dred ma rung bar gyur pa'i steng du dad gshin gyi dkor gyis sa tshos rdo tshos su song bas ji lta bu'i chos zab mo thos kyang 'khyags pa'i steng du chu grang bkram pa bzhin 'gro ba las/ dad pa dang nges 'byung skyo shas sogs than thun re tsam yang yong gi mi 'dug / deng sang klog slob mkhan la 27

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/bla mar 'dzin pa dkon par snang yang / kho bos bsam na thos bsam sgom gsum gang byed kyang yi ge ma shes na long ba gzugs la rtogs pa dang mtshungs par 'gyur bas na bla ma'i nang nas kyang drin che shos yin par 'dug ces gsungs so/ / gsung 'di rnams kyi don spyir chos byed 'dod pa thams cad kyis go dgos pa zhig yin la/ khyad par du kho bo cag lta bu snyigs dus kyi bla sprul lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gang yang gdul bya la snang du med kyang ngo bo nyid kyis yon tan thams cad tshang bas/ bla ma'i sten tshul/ dam tshig gi srung mtshams/ thos bsam sgom pa sogs rgyu rkyen rtsol ba gang la'ang mi ltos par/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rang byung lhun grub gdod ma nas rang chas su rdzogs par grags pa jo nang pa'i snying po rtag brtan lta bu rnams kyis ci nas kyang shes par bya dgos te/ kun gzigs lnga pa chen pos/slob dpon bsten dang brtson pa ma dgos par/ / chos kun ma lus mkhyen par khas 'che bas/ / skye dgu'i 'dren par rlom pa'i tshul bden na/ / mdo las rgyu 'bras gsungs pa gtam du zad/ / ces gsungs pa bzhin no/ / de nas sku gong mas sgrub pa mdzad pa'i gnas chos bzang ri khrod dang / dgon lung gi rgyab ri'i brag rtsa'i gzim khang gnyis su res mos kyis bzhugs te dpe 'dzin sogs la shin tu 'grus par mdzad/ de dus bla brang du'ang rje gong ma'i dus kyi phyag rdzas nyag je phrar song / gnas skabs yong sgo cher med pas/bzhes pa dang na bza' sogs mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba tsam las dgongs par 'byor pa zhig zhus med cing / der ma zad sku skye'i rigs chung dus gces lang la btang na nor nyan mi yong ba la bsams nas/ mdun du sdod mkhan rnams kyis kyang ha cang gces pa'i rnam pa byas med tshod 'dug ste/bka' las kyang / nged rang chung dus dbon po blo bzang dge legs kyis 28

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /phyag mdzod kyi las khur dor nas zur du bsdad/ dbon po rab 'byams pa dag dbang chos bzang phyag mdzod byas/ bla brang du phyag rdzas ha cang srab pas lo re zhig gi bar zas gos ngan ngan tsam las gang 'dod du longs spyod rgyu ma byung / de'i khar nged rang cung zad rgod pas gam du bcar sdod byed mkhan rnams kyis kyang do dam byed pa'i khul gyis mtshams mtshams su bsdeg 'tshogakhyed pas shin tu spyong che ba byung / 'on kyang / deng sang gi sku skye btsas ma thag nas gos dar gyis dkris/ lto gang bzang za/ bslab rgyu'i yon tan mi slob par/ mi slob rgyu'i byed ngan thams cad bslab/ bag med 'ba' zhig gis dus 'das pas cher lon pa na sdug sran mi theg /gzhan sbyong ba la cir yang mi sems/ gcig pur sdod mi tshugs/ dad zas thams cad don med kyi phyogs samed brlag la gtong / mthar chos 'jig rten gang yang mgo mi thon pa gces phrug rgyags lang du shor ba tsho dang mi 'dra bar nged rang da lta'i dus su rkyen ngan la bzod sran cung zad thub/rang la mi 'dod pa byung ba gzhan la 'geb shes pas rang bde thabs su gzhan sdug las la mi sbyor/ khog pa yangs pas tshig ngan re yan chad kyi brdar sha migacod/ rnyed pa byung ba rnams sol ba'i ched du tsan dan sreg pa bzhin don med du chud zos mi byed pa sogs skyes bu ya rabs kyi mtshan nyid re gnyis dang ldan pa 'di chung dus su rkyen rang thog tu babs pa'i lag rjes yin 'dugapas/ cha gcig nas bsam na de dus lus sems shin tu sbyong ba de bdag la phan thogs su gyur 'dug snyam mo zhes gsung / de ltar sku sbyong che ba ji tsam byung yang thugs zhum pa sogs su mi 'gyur ba ni/ sum cu pa bde ba'i tshoms las/ 'jig rten 'di na bde dang sdug bsngal gyis/ / skyes bu dam pa mtho dman mi 'gyur zhing / / gsungs pa ltar dam pa'i rang rtags bla 29

༄/ /yo ca bstanapa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/na med pa'o/ / der ma zad chung dus rkyen rang thog tu babs pa'i stobs kyis/rang dpe gzhan la 'gebs shes shing / rang bde thabs su gzhan sdug la mi sbyor bar gsung ba'ang dgongs pa shin tu mad par snang ste/ mdza' bo'i bu mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab las/ skye bo rang gi gdung med pas/ / gzhan gyi gdung ba yongs mi shes/ / zhes dang / nyer gsum pa bdag gi tshoms las/ bdag nyid dang por rig par gnas byas nas/ /phyi nas bdag bzhin gzhan dag gdul bar bya/ / bdag nyid dang por rig par gnas byas nas/ / phyi dus 'dul tshe mkhas pa nyon mi mongs/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin yin zhing / blo spyong gi dam tshig tu'ang / skyid kyi yan lag tu sdug ma 'tshol/ zhes gsungs pa dang gnad gcig go / sum pa mkhan chen de dus pe'i cing du byon nas phyir phebs phral yin 'dug pas/nyinagacig nyid kyi rtsar byon/ rgya nag nas phebs skyos kyi dngos po 'ga' zhig dang / sam ṭa legs pa zhig gnang ba yi ge 'dri bar phan thogs pa byung / khyed rang la grwa pa 'di tshos zhabs tog bzang po byed kin e 'dug gsungs pa la/ sku na phra'ang mkhyen rab dang spobs pa'i rtsal shin tu che bas/sam ṭa'i ngos la/ gsung rus pa can 'ga' zhig bris nas gzigs bcug par/ bzhad mo gnang zhing sprul sku 'di mkhyen rab gzhan 'gran mi 'dug cing / rim gyis rtsal sbyangs dus mkhyen rab kyi klong lhag par rdol bar 'gyur ba yin pas/ khyed tshos yon tan slob rgyu'i don du sems khral dang snyan sun mang du zhu dgos pa mi 'dug gsung / skabs der grib kyi rnam pas sku khams cung zad ma bde ba zhig byung ba mkhan chen gyes rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i byab khrus shig mdzad pas phan che ba byung / da lta yi dam gyi bzlas bsgom 'dra gnang gi e yod gsung bar/ dmar tshang dbon chung 30

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsangagasum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /gis da dung sku na phra bas lha'i bsgom bzlas kyi rtsol ba ma byas zhus pa la/ sku gong ma'i dus kyi yi dam srung ma rgyang skyur bgyis na sku tshe 'phrin las sogs la bar chad yong bas/ bsgom bzlas gtor 'bul sogs da lta nas mdzad na legs gsungs pas/ dbon chung gis yi dam srung ma'i dbang lung sogs ma gsan tshul zhus/ mi ring bar phyag mdzod chos bzang / dge legs sogs che bgres rnams 'dus sar dmar tshang dbon chung gis mkhan po'i gsung rnams bskyar nas khong la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang zhus na e 'gagasprul sku nas dbang lung man ngag gi rigs mi gsan na der zad/ gsan rgyu yin tshe nye 'khor 'dir bla mar 'os pa sum pa mkhan po las med pa 'dra zer/dbon po chos bzang gis/ rgyud pa bla zur rag gdong chos rje tshul khrims dar rgyas dbang lung sogs gsan rgya che zhing / skye ba gong ma'i slob ma dam gtsang yin pas da res dbang yang khong la zhus/ slar chos bka' gang dgos kyang rim pas gsan pa stabs bde bas 'thad zer/ de nyin 'then khyer gyis thag ma chod/ nyin kha shas song mtshams su zhabs sdod rnams gros mthun gyi sgo nas sum pa mkhan rin po cher dbang zhu rgyur thag bcad de/snyan gsan 'bebs par dmar tshang chos rje song bas dgyes bzhin zhal gyis bzhes/ de rjes nyin gcig sum pa mkhan po dbang gnang bar phebs rgyu yin zhes thams cad kyis gra sgrig byed ken yod pa'i thog rje nyid gzim khang steng du phebs pas rkyen ci'ang med par skas 'dzeg steng nas lhung ste 'khur bar rma bzos/ re zhig bzhengs kyang ma thub pas thams cad ci drag gang drag la thug / mkhan pos gsan na mi legs pas mi zhu rgyu'i khrims bsdams/khang ba 'gol ba zhig tu rma la gzhob glan pa sogs bgyis/ de ni chos zab dngabadud zab kyi dpe bzhin bdud rigs kyi 'byung po mi srun pa zhig gis 31

༄/ /gung bang bstanaba'isgranarme'i gsung 'bum/bar chad brtsams pa yin 'dug kyang / chos kyi gegs su ma gyur par dbang gi dngos sta nyin snga phyir gnang ba la legs par bzhugs thub pa byung / de nas bzung ste nyin re bzhin rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i cho ga zhal 'don ma chag par mdzad/ nyin gcig chos rje ngag dbang chos bzang gis 'jigs byed 'don skabs dmigs rim 'di 'dra byed dgos pa yin zer nas rags rim zhig zhus pas mngon rtogs kyi 'gros la go ba legs par chags pa byung / skabs shig stong skor rin po che dang kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul pa'i sku rin po che rnam gnyis dgon lung du phebs/'jam dbyangs chos la gdan drangs par rten 'brel gyi khyad du dgongs nas dge 'dun mang dang phyogs 'dus bcas ser skya'i khrom chen por lam rim chen mo'i mchod brjod kyi steng nas sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan las brtsams pa'i gsung bshad shin tu 'byam klas pa lung dang rigs pa dpe dang gtan tshigs thams cad 'phal kha sbyar ba'i legs bshad kyi skyes ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba zhig stsal bar bshes gnyen mang po'i yid kyi brtan pa rang dbang med par 'phrog ste lus kyi ba sru ldang zhing mig nas mchi ma 'khrugs pa byung / rjes sor slob chung 'phan yul bdag bshes blo bzang rgya mtsho dang ser brgya dge bshes blo bzang 'jigs med rgya tig zhabs drung sogs mol mchid byed skabs kyang / slob chung gis mdo dbus gang du'ang gsung rab kyi gnad mkhyen pa'i mkhas pa mang po yod mod kyang / nyan pa po'i blo ngo la sbyar gtong mkhan 'di 'dra'i gsung mkhas pa zhig mthong ma myong zhes ya mtshan pa'i tshad byas 'dug pa ni mkhas pa legs bshad gtam gyis mgu ba'i khyad chos su snang / byams pa'i gos sku bkram par dge 'dun dang lhan du khrus gsol dang smon lam gsungs/ 'cham gyi 32

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung / gzigs mo bstar ba'ang gzigs/ 'di res gos sku rnying drag pa la thugs kyis ma bzod par 'di ha cang dgung lo bgres 'dug ang gsung ba la/ sngo kho bla zur gyis gos sku 'di 'dra zhig gsar bzhengaso byed na dka' sla ci 'dra yin zhus pas/ ha cang dka' rgyu med pa 'dra zhes bzhengs sla ba'i phyogs gsungs/ de la brten nas sngo kho bla zur gyis gtsos pa'i sbyin bdag 'ga' zhigagis rgyu yon sbyar te/ rje nyid la gos sku gsar bzhengs kyi mgo 'dren gtad gnyer zhus par sgrub rgyu'i zhal len gnang / tshogs dbur gdan drangs te chos 'khor gyi tshogs gleng dang bcas gsol ston dkar spro maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten gyis sna drangs pa'i dngos 'bul tshan grangs brgya phrag mang po bstar te/ sngo kho bla ma zur pas zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab par dgyes pa'i bka' lan dang dge 'dun mang por phyag dbang gnang / dgon pa'i bla ma rnams la 'bul ba dang dge 'dun gyi sder mang 'gyed kyi bsnyen bkur gzabs/ bzhugs ring la nyin re bzhin dad 'dus kyi mjal ba mang por phyag dbang chos 'brel sogs chag med du stsal/ gsung brtag dang skye brtag zhu mkhan rnams la gang gsung thams cad thog tu khel ba'i lo rgyus mang du yod snang na'ang yi ges 'jigs nas ma bris/ sngo kho sgar ba gnyis dang bde rgu sgar/ rgya tig sgar/ zang nga sgar/ ma chi sgar rnams dang / sku rten chos rje/ stobs tshang dbu mdzad/ stobs tshang sman pa sogs grwa pa 'byor ldan 'ga' zhig gis gshag tu gdan dpal mgon zhal gyi 'phrin bcol/ gzhi bdag gi bsang mchod sogs tshigs bcad thor bu mang du ljags rtsom mdzad/ tshul 'di'ang sngon gyi dam pa 'ga' zhig gi rnam thar du yod pa tsam las/ da ltar gyi dus la ltosan gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i khyad chos bla na med par mngon pa ni gzu 33

༄/ /gung bangang napa'i name'igasung 'bum/bo'i blos brtags na gsal lo/ / de nas rab byung bcu gsum pa'i thog ma me mo yos kyi lo dgung lo bcu gcig la phebs pa'i steng du dge rgan dang phyag mdzod sogs kyis sngar dge bsnyen tsam las rab byung gi tshul khrimayom bzhes pas dge 'dun gyi phyag dang bsnyen bkur len pa ni dmigs ltos la mi legs par 'dug / da cha bar ma rab byung tsam sgrub dgos 'dug cing / de'ang sum pa mkhan po dbang zhus pa'i bla ma yin stabs khong la zhus pa layo'os med zer nas thag bcad pa bzhin brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i mkhan po rin po che ye shes dpal 'byor pa'i drung nas rab byung mdzad de tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i bdud rtsis thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su 'gengs par mdzad do/ / smras pa/ mi mnyam thugs bskyed gser sbyang gar bu dang / / lhan skyes mchog tu gsal pa'i rang 'od bzhin/ / rnam par dag pa'i tshul khrims pha rol phyin/ / byang chub snying po mchog gi mthas gtugs kyang / / sum rtsen bdag pos rnam rgyal khang bzang du/ / 'chi med gzhon nu'i tshogs rnams 'khrid pa bzhin/ / thar 'dod yongs kyi 'jug ngogs mtshon pa'i phyir/ / bstan la gsar du 'jug pa'i brtul zhugs ṭ+wāṃ/shaṃ /ni // bhe ༷ṭ+wāṃ sdel+lī rte/ ༷za/ da / ༷ skro hūṃX ༵/ sa /༷/bye ṭ+wāṃbhe mtshams sprin ngur sprig gos 'chang ste/ / thub bstan nam mkha'i dbyings su lham mer gsal/ / rang khyim kha sgo gsal ba'i me khyer dang / / srid 'byor kurdo bzhad pa zla ba'i 'od/ / ma yin skye dgu'i snying gi mun sel ba'i/ /chos kyi nyi mar mtshan gsol don dang mthun/ / dri bzang rdzogs pa'i gur 34

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /kum me tog gi / ge sar snying po gser bzang thig le'i 'od/ / mtha' dag phyogs su dge mtshan 'bri byed na/ / tshangs spyod rgyal sras gzhon nu'i dpe zlar 'os/ / thos bsam sgom pa'i ka ba stong ldan pa/ / mdo sngags thub bstan nor bu'i ba gam gyi/ / rmang gzhi brtan por gyur pa gtsang ma'i khrims/ / gzhig bral rdo rje'i rang bzhin lhun gyis grub/ / ces rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum rmad du byung ba'i mdzad bzang 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal gyi cha tsam gtam du byas pa rtogs brjod pad+ma dkar po las/ thog mar bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas rab byung gi tshul khrims bzhes pa'i 'dab ma ste gsum pa'o /35

༄/ /gung thang bstan yozlaname'i gsung 'bum/༄༅/ / 'dab ma bzhi pa/ mdo smad du gsan spyong ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul/de nas dge rgan dmar tshang dbon chung dang / phyag mdzod ngag dbang chos bzang sogs gros dbang pa rnams nas da ni sprul pa'i sku thugs gnyer mdzad ran pas/ bla brang du gra ba kha shas bsten nas phan tshun bgro gleng sogs kyis slob gnyer bgyis na legs pa 'dra/ bla chen gyi sprul sku chos grwar zhugs na che ba nyams 'gro bas mi legs sam zer/ sum pa mkhan rin po che de dus dgon lung gi khri pa mdzad pas khong la zhus par/ khyed tshos glen gtam de 'dra ma zer/ sngon gyi bla chen thams cad slob gnyer mdzad dusaganyom chung gra rkyang lugs kyi chos grwa 'grim pa sha stag yin/ chung dus nas mi mang po dang 'grogs 'dris ye ma byas par khang pa'i phugs su sbas nas bzhag pa de rigs slar cher lon skabs khrom dbus 'grim pa la bag 'khums pa zhig yong / rtsod pa'ang brdar sha mi chod pas de las sprul pa'i sku chos grwar pheb rgyur thag bcad na legs gsung ba bzhin dpyid chos la yul mdo smad kyi bshad grwa kun gyi thog ma lung dang rigs pa smra ba'i dbang po brgya phrag du ma'i bste gnas chos sde chen po dgon lung byams pa gling gi chos grwar zhugs/thog mar bsdus chung gi 'dzin grwa 'grim pas/ bsdus grwa'i rtags gsal legs par chags shing bgro gleng sogs chig skya thub pa byung / btsan po'i bsdus grwa cha tshang dang rwa ba stod pa'i bsdus grwa chen mo'ang phal cher thugs 'dzin gnang / rigs grwa'i skabs tshogs chen du nyid kyis snga rgol dang /36

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /rtsangangag dbang 'azin las zer bas phyi rgol byas te tshogs gleng mdzad pa na thugs rig rno zhing gsung ngag gsal la dag pa dang sbobs pa shin tu che pas dge 'dun pa rnams dgyes tshor dang mos gus kyis spu long g.yo bar gyur/loganyis kyi khongs su rigs lam chung 'bring che gsum gyi rtsod pa cha tshang bar song ste rtog ge'i rigs pa'i gsang tshig la shin tu byang ba byung / de nas kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i blo rtags kyi yig cha thugs 'dzin dang /rnam 'grel ṭīka chen rigs pa'i rgya mtsho/ sde bdun yid kyi mun sel/tshad ma rigs pa'i rgyan sogs tshad ma'i skor gyi gzhung mang por zhib gzigs dang rtsod pa brdar sha chod par gnang pas g.yam la rgyug gi kha bshad tsam ma yin par/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang dngos po'i stobs shugs kyi rigs pas bsgrub pa la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhyen rab kyi lus rtsal yongs su rdzogs/ skabs der dpon po blo bzang dge legs dgon pa spyi nas lcang skya rin po che gdan 'dren rgyu'i don la pho brang chen por phyin pa phyir slebs/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang lo phyi mar mdo smad du phebs rgyu'i zhal bzhes kyi gsung shog gnang 'dug pa gzigs pas thugs la dga' ba dpag tu med pa 'khrungs/ bka' las kyang / zla ba re song mtshams su da ni zla grangs 'di tsam na mjal rgyu yong / de bar du ma shi na legs snyam pa byung zhes gsungs te/ thugs kyi dgongs tshul 'di 'dra shin tu ya mtshan ba'i gnas so/ / de dus smad phyogs nas sku gong ma'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis yi ge dngadangos chas sna tshogs/ khyad par du har chen wang yi dam skyabs kyi bu rat+na sirnyis dngul gros dar sogs khyad nor gyi skyes du ma 'bul rgyu bskur ba rnams phyag tu 'byor/ 'di ni sku tshe 'dir gzhan gyi dngos 'bul rlabs che babyung ba'i thog ma lta bur snang / dgung lo bcu gsum la phebs pa sa mo 37

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/sbrul gyi lo srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa mdo smad du byon pa'i chibs bsur phebs/ lam nas dmar tshang du bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyi sku gdung nang rten du bzhugs pa'i sku brnyan rin po che mjal skabs tha mal gye rnam rtog rags pa nub nas sku brnyan de la bla chen dngos kyi 'du shes dang sems la sngar med pa'i nyams bzang po shar byung gsung ba ni dgongs pa shin tu zab pa zhig go / tsong chu brgal nas pheng grong ye zer ba'i mkhar chung las rgyang grags tsam gyi sa char lcang skya rdo rje 'chang dang mjal/rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid nas kyang rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho de nyid rang gi rigs kyi bdag por gyur pa thugs la bzhag nas gzigs ma thag chibs bshol ba dang / phyag gnyis kyis kha btags rtser son zhig gnang zhing dgyes tshor dang bkur ste dpe med mdzad pa sogs dam pa gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar gtsang ma bdag gir bzhes pas der 'tshogs kyi rgya'i mi dpon drag zhan thams cad ha las pa lta bu byed do/ / bzhugs zhag gi sar gsol ston mtshon tsam dang rta bzang po sga 'khor tshang ma can phul/ sku drung du bzhugs khri mtho dma' mnyam pa zhig la bzhugs su bcug nas thugs nang gshin pa'i gsung 'phros yun ring po'i bar du gnang ba sogs brtse gzigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad/ slar zi lang nas gro zhun zla ba'i mar ngo'i tshes gsum la dgon lung du phebs skabs/ gdong yon thang zer bar chibs bsur phebs pas snga ma bzhin gzigs pa chen pos bskyangs/ dgon lung du phebs pa nas bzhugs ring la rgyun par sku drung du bzhugs pas skabs 'ga' zhig tu chos kyi bka' 'dri/ la la'i skabs rtsed mo'i rnam pas co 'dri ba/ bgro gleng byed 'jug pa/ zhabs drung na tshod mnyam pa 'ga' zhig dang shed 'gran du 'jug pa sogs thugs shin tu brtse ba'i rnam pa kho na mdzad/ lag 38

༄༅/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /ris la zhib tu gzigs nas shes rab che ba zhig yong ba 'dug ces yang yang gsungs/ byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i khrid mdor bsdus/ snar thang brgya rtsa'i lha rnams kyi rjes gnang / gcod stan thog gcig ma'i khrid/ 'jam dpal mtshan bajod sogs lung 'ga' zhig bcas bzhugs ring la bka' chos gang gnang thams cad gcig kyang ma chad par gsan/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang nas skyes kyi tshul du gos chen legs pa bzhi/ nang mdzod bcu spags gcig /dngul rta mig ma gnyis/ rgya khug cha kha shas/ sna tha'i khu khur/shel da sogs gnang sbyin bzang po stsal/ gza' skar tshes grangs legs pa'i nyin thu'u bkwan bla brang du gdan drangs gsol ston rgyas pa dang dngos 'byor gyi 'bul ba mtshon tsam phul/ lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa nyid nas dge tshul du sgrub pa'i slob dpon dang / bde rgu zhabs drung ngag dbang blo gsal rgya mtshos dus go ba/ sum pa mkhan rin po che sogs kyis kha skong mdzad de/ tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa yang dag par bzhes/ 'di skabs/ thar pa'i rgyal mtshan brtan par gyur cig/ ces sogs smon lam mdzad cing me tog 'thor ba gnang dus/ 'di lta bu'i skal ba bzang ba snyam du dga' spro dang dad pa'i shugs kyis spyan chab dbang med du shor bas/ rje bla ma mchog nas bag chags bzang po sad pa'i ltas yin gsung mnyes tshor chenapo mdzad/ sum pa mkhan rin po che nas yul lugs kyi zhu 'bul phul ba'i bka' lan du/ rje thu'u bkwan pa de nyid nged rdo rje theg pa'i sgor thog mar 'jug pa'i rdo rje slob dpon yin cing / chos srid gnyis cha nas deng na phra mo'i dus su bka' drin tshad med pas bskyangs pa yin/ bla ma de nyid kyi sprul pa'i sku dang dngos 'phrad kyi skabs 'dir gsung ba'i mtshams su rje gong ma de nyid thugs la dran pa'i stobs kyis spyan chab lhug par phebs pas gsung 39

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/'phro gnang ma thub par re zhig 'gyang / der tshogs pa thams cad kyang sems shin tu skyo bas mchi ma 'don pa la sum pa mkhan rin po ches nyams mtshar gye rtsed mo 'ga' zhig gyal ga'i tshul du zhus pas bshum 'phro gcod thub tsam byung / de nas nyid la thos bsam sogs brtson pa nan tan gnang dgos tshul dang / zhabs 'brangs pa rnams la'ang chos srid kyi bgyi 'os rnams so sos 'di dang 'di ltar gyis zhes pa'i bslab ston smin rgyas bka' drin la/ yang nyin gcig rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid rgyab ri'i rtser rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho'i sku gdung mchod rten gye drung du phebs/ dngul maṇa che ba nang mdzod sna lnga'i sne 'dogs can zhig 'bul ba gnang zhing phyag mchod smon lam rgyas pa mdzad/ thugs bag phebs pa'i rnam pas gsung gleng mang po dang rje gong ma de nyid kyi rnam thar 'ga' zhig gsungs te khyed de'i skye ba yin gshis rnam thar de rnams bdag gir byed dgos zhes sogs bslab bya mang du gnang / yang nyin gcig chos bzang ri khrod du phebs/ rje gong ma'i gzim khang zhig tu bzhugs nas thugs nyams spro ba'i rnam pas gsung mgur mang po zhig 'then pa gnang / rje 'di la khyed kyi skye ba gong ma de 'dir bzhugs nas thugs dam nyams rtogs shin tu 'phel/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ sangs rgyas so lnga/ gnas brtan bcu drug rnams kyi zhal gzigs/phyis su pe'i cing du bzhugs skabs chos bzang ri khrod du da lta'i bar dge spyor gyi mu mthud pa yin na da tshod dga' mo yong ba yod pas yang yang gsung gi yod/ khyod re zhig thos bsam gnad smin zhig gyis la/ mthar 'di lta bu'i dben pa'i gnas su sgrub pa byed pa'i 'dun pa da lta nas thongs/ de'i ched du bla ma dkon mchog la gsol 'debs yang yang mdzod/ ces sogs thugs brtse ba'i zhal ta mang po mdzad/ der nyid dang ri khrod pa rnams la rje 40

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung / 4 gong mas mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi lud yang bkar drin stso'i/ de skabasakun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyabs bzhad pa'i sprul pa'i skra rin po che lcangashā rdo rje 'chang la mjal bar phebs pa thu'u bkwan bla brang du byon nas rgyun du thugs nang gshin pa'i gsung 'phros dmar bar mdzad/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gi sku drung du'ang rnam pa gnyis ka yang yang gdan 'dzom par nyin gcig thugs dam rten kha shas kyi mjal kha gnang / mnga' ris sprul skus rang gi gzigs snang bzhin phyag ris mdzad pa'i dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i sku thang ston pa gnang zhing rnam pa gnyis ga'i dbur lhan du bzhag nas bka' bsgo byin rlabs mdzad pas shin tu zil che ba zhig byung / dgon lung gi 'du khang rab gnas skabs lcang skya rdo rje 'chang dbus su bzhugs/ g.yon gyi gral mgor rje 'di nyid bzhugs te spyan dbye'i cho ga rgyas par mdzad/ rdo rje 'chang nyid nas rab gnas kyi bshad pa rgyas par gnang zhing / rab gnas grol nas gzim chung du pheb skabs rje 'dir nged kyis rab gnas bshad pa bgyis pa rnams skyor cig gsung ba la/ tshig ris cung zad mi tshang yang don gyigand che ba rnams ma lus pa'i sdoms lta bu zhig thar chags su zhus pas/khyed rang nges par shes rab kyi rtsal gzhan dang mi 'dra ba 'dug ces rje 'di'i dbu la phyag gis byil byil gnang zhing dgyes pa'i rnam pa mdzad/ nyin gcig rje nyid gcig pu sku drung na bzhugs skabs gsung 'phros kyi lhong la khyod la lo 'dir 'brum pa yong nyen che bas sman 'di tshags kyis gsung nas rgya sman ril bu che ba spra tshil gyis btums pa kha shas shig gnang / cung zad bzhugs nas a cang ngas khyod la rdzun lab pa yin khyod kyis mi thams cad la lcang skya rin po ches nged la lo 'dir 'brum nad yong gsung byung zhes bsgrags nyen che zhes phebs pe'i cing du chibs bskyod nye ba'i skabs tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan 41

/ /gu ba naba'ithonaḥ gsu 'bum/— zhig dad rten du gnang zhing /— bsla—gebya'i rim pa dang 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan lta bu zorga tu ma gleb bar du shes dka' ba mang po zhig kyang gnang /de nas hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bzhi la lcang skya rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid pe'i cing du phebs rgyur chibs bskyod gnang ba'i skabs ba yan zer ba'i grong 'dababar du chibs skyel la phebs/ de gar rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid kyang chibs bshol/ nyid nas chibs skyel gyi kha btags 'bul skabs thugs shin tuskyo bas mchi mas brnangs te zhu tshig ci'ang ma thon pa la/ rdo rje 'chang chenapo nyid nas thugs shin tu brtse ba'i rnam pas phyag gnyis kyis byil byil mdzadade ma ngu zhig rang re mi ring bar mjal lo zhes gsungs/ 'on kyang thugs shin tu 'phrang bas phyir gzim khang du slebs kyi bar spyan chab gcod ma thub cing zhag shas kyi bar bzhes pa'i bro ba tsam yang mi myong bar thugs skyo phyad de ba zhig byung / phyag mdzod ngag dbang chos bzang grong lang bar du chibs skyel la phyin pa phyir log skabs khyod rang dgon lung du slebs phral nas sprul sku bsnyen mtshams rgyun ring mdzad bcug na legs zhes gnang 'dug pa bzhin/ zla ba gsum tsam gyi bar du mtshams kyi bcad rgya mdzad/ snga sor skyabs mgon mchog nas 'brum dogs yod pa'i bka' lung phebs pa bzhin bcad rgya'i mjug tu 'brum nad shin tu lce ba byung / bskun shin tu drag po'i skabs der dbu sngas kyi mgor lcang skya rdo rje 'chang bzhugs yod pa lta bu'i nyams snang byung ste/ nga rang lcang skya rin po che'i drung du 'gro rgyu yin gsungs nas shor shor gnang bas bsnyun g.yog rnams kyis la nye mi legs zer nas ci dragagang drag la thug / 'on kyang de nas bzung bsnyun gyi bab yang du song bas/ bka' las kyang bla ma'i skyabs 'og nas srog rnyed pa yin 'dug ces gsung / dgung lo bcu bzhi'i skabs/ cho 'phrul smon lam gyi dus su 42

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /dgon lung khri pa phyogs gzhan du phebs nas ma bzhugs pas/ las byed rnams nas smon lam gyi tshogs dbu mdzad dgos tshul gyi gsol ba nan tan du btab pa bzhin zhag bcu gsum gyi ring la tshogs dbur phebs/ de skabs phal cher gyi sems la sku na phra ba'i dbang gis skyes rabs kyi bklags lung tsam las bshad pa rgya chen po zhig gnang yong snyam pa med kyang / nyin re bzhin snga dro chos grwar skyes rabs so bzhi pa'i bshad pa tshig gi 'bru gnyer tshul go bde zhing don gyi khogs phub shin tu 'gang che ba'i bshad pa rgyas bsdus 'tsham la go ba bogs chod du ster ba/ mkhas pa rnam dpyod can rnams mgu ba skyed pa zhig gnang bas 'dus tshogs thams cad thugs shin tu ngo mtshar bar gyur te blo ldan chos kyi rjes 'brang rnams ngo mtshar ba'i gnas la ni 'di lta bu las lhag pa med do/ / sku gong ma'i gra slob rag gdong chos rje'ang ched gnyer gyis chos nyan la phebs pas chos bshad thos nas dad pas mig nas mchi ma 'khrug cing / gsung chos grol ma thag mdun du phebs nas nga'i bla ma'i sku'i skye ba ma 'khrul ba yin pa'i nges shes de ring skyes byung zhes sogs bsngags brjod dpe med mdzad/ phyi dro 'du khang du smon lam gye tshogs dbur phebs te bsngo ba dang bde smon bstan 'bar ma rnams sgra dag gsal gsum gyis gsungs shing / nyin re bzhin bsngo ba mi 'dra ba re thugs thog nas 'phral 'phral du thogs pa med par gsungs pas/ blo mchog dman thams cad ha las pa bzhin du gyur/ bka' las kyang / de skabs mi rnams ha cang ya mtshan pa bzhinasnyed kyin 'dug kyang nged rang gi bsam pa la sngon byung gi skyes bu dam pa'i rnam thar du dgung lo brgyad dgu'i dus nas mkhas pa'i bya ba chen po rnamasabadag gir mdzad pa la ltos na 'di tsam la ngo mtshar ci yod/ 'on kyang deng dus bstan 'dzin chen po'i go sar bzhugs pa'i bla ma sku yar bgres 43

༄/ /gung bang bstanaba'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/'ga' zhig kyang sder bzo'i sku brnyan gyi rnam thar bdag gir bzhes 'dug pa la ltos na dga' rab kyang yin 'dug snyam pa byung zhes gsung / dpyid chos nasabartsams te gzhung shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don la thugs gnyer gnang ba'i dbu brtsams te/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i don bdun cu dang skabs dang po'i yig cha/ gung ru chos 'byung gi dge 'dun nyi shu bcas thugs 'dzin gnang / skyes sbyang gi mkhyen rab thogs pa med pa'i steng du rtag sbyor gus sbyor gyi brtson pa drag pos gsan sbyong lhur bzhes pas rnam dpyod kyi rtsal dbyar gyi chu gter bzhin gong 'phel du rgyas/ de'i zhar la snyan dngags/ sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi skor la'ang dpe klog mang du mdzad/ dpal sgang lo tsā ba'i snyan ngag gi dper brjod bklags pas kun shes bya ba la gzigs rtog mdzad pas rgyan gyi khyad par cung zad ngos zin dka' bar byung ste/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i bsgom bzlas mdzad pas rgyan phal cher gye mtshan nyid dka' tshegs med par thugs su chud/ yang re re tsam ma dgongs pa na dpe la lta rtog byed pa bzhag nas dbyangs can ma'i bsgom bzlas dang gsol btab nan tan re mdzad de gzigs pas de ma thag thugs la 'char ba byung gsung ba ni khyad chos bla na med pa ste/ slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mi dang / jo bo rje sogs re gnyis ma gtogs rgya bod gang du'ang lhag pa'i lhas sgo 'dogs 'phral 'phral du gcod pa de 'dra ba byung ba'i lo rgyus cher mi snang ngo / / de lta bu'i tshul gyis le'u gsum ga'i rgyan rnams kyi khyad par mtha' dag ma 'dres par gzigs nas so so'i dper brjod kyang phral phral du ljags rtsom mdzad/ skabs der sgra rig pa la gsan sbyong mdzad rgyur ma song yang skad dod kyi steng nas yi ge'i lce yang sogs bsgrig thub pa byung / dmar tshang blo bzang bstan 'dzin zer 44
