༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /ba dang lhan du chos 'khor gyi tshogs gleng gnang bas lung dang rigs pa dri ma med pa'i rtsal gyes mkhas kun yid kyi brtan pa gcig car phrogs/ dgung lo bco lnga pa'i skabs su cho 'phrul smon lam kyi tshogs dbu sngar lo bzhin dang /gzhanayang dad ldan don gnyer can du ma la so so'i 'dod mos bzhin lung khrid sogs chos kyi bdud rtsi'i dga' ston bka' drin bskyangs/ skabs shig tu sum pa mkhan rin po che nas gzhung gi go don gnad 'gag mi 'tshol bar mtshan nyid kyi slob gnyer tshig skam po 'ba' zhig rtsod pa la mgo 'khor ba 'di la dgos pa ci'ang med/ po ti lnga ga'i snying po lam gyi gtso bo gsum yin pasade nyams su len tshul gyi gnad mdor bsdus pa bla ma'i zhal nas legs par shes pa zhig bgyis na de tsam gyis chog ces yang yang gsungs pa'i rkyen gyis rtsod pa'i brdar sha zhib tu gcod rgyu de cung zad lhod pa'i rnam pa lta bu zhig byung yang / slar thugs dpyad zhib tu mdzad pa na mtshan nyid kyi gzhung gi brjod bya lam gyi gtso bo gsum du 'du lugs shig yong kyang / de gsum dbyis phyin pa shes pa la mtshan nyid kyi slob gnyer gsha' ma zhig ma byas par khrid yig chung ngu re thos pa tsam gyis ci'ang mi yong pa'ang / bka' gdams gong ma rnams kyis kyang rnam grol sgrub pa la po ti mdzo khal tsam la bya ba ma byas par le'u bum lag mthil tsam zhig ston pa tsug / sped btsug byas pas gar yang mi phyin gsungs shing / rje bdag nyid chen pos kyang man ngag gi mthar thug gzhung chen mo rnams yin par gsung 'dug / des na mkhan rin po che nas gsung ba de thos bsam kha phyir bltas su 'gro mi nyan pa la dgongs pas drang don dgongs pa can gyi gsung yin pa la/ sgra ji bzhin du mtshan nyid kyi slob gnyer snying po med par gsungs pa bzhin bzung pa ni 'dun ma nyes pa'i rgyur song 'dug snyam du dgongs te slar yang brtson pa shugs drag po'i go cha 45

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname' gsung 'bum/bzhes pa ni gzhan gyis dring la mi 'jog pa'i rnam thar mchog tu khums so/ /de dus mkhan rin po che nas phyag mdzod sogs la da lta sprul sku dgung lo gzhon pa'i skabs 'dir dbang lung man ngag sogs kyi gsan rgya che ba mdzad na legs/ re zhig nged kyis thos pa'i chos rnams sprul pa'i sku nas gsan bzhes mdzad pas kyang slad ma'i dus su phyag mi thogs pa tsam yong ba yod ces yang yang bskul ma gnang ba la/ phyag mdzod chos rje sogs kyis de thugs mad par 'dug / da lta sprul sku la gzhan mi dgos mi zhig gis skyabs 'gro smon lam gyi lung zhus byung na'ang lung rgyun med/ lar rgya sog gi yul du phebasadagos pas de dus dbang lung man ngag gi 'gro sgo las der thal de'i phyir mkho dgos mi 'ong / des na da cha chos nyan gtso bo bgyis na legs shing / nye skor 'di na sum pa mkhan po las gsan rgya che ba gzhan med cing khongasngar bla mar bzung yang tshar bas khong la nyan pa rang bab mtshungs zhes thag bcad/ de nas sum pa mkhan rin po che'i bzhugs gnas lung dkar rikhrod du phebs/ zla ba kha shas kyi ring der phyag phab nas chos bka' 'gro gang che gsan/ dben sa pa'i snyan brgyud glegs bam gyi lung grub pa'i nyin glegasabam nyid kyi phyag tu gtad nas rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i snyan brgyud zin pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs shing byin rlabs mdzad/ nyid nas kyang bla ma'i bka' bzhin 'grub pa'i thugs smon gnang zhing / mkhan rin po cher zhabs brtan gsol 'debs shig gsar rtsom mdzad de phul ba dgyes pa'i mchod sprin du gyur/ 'dul ba dgon/ tha yān chi dgon/ nom chi dgon so sos gdan drangs par phebs nas tshogs pa la mang 'gyed stsal cing so sos kyang ston mo dang 'bul nod gzab rgyas zhus/ de dus 'dul ba dgon gyi gnas der thugs shin tu bag phebs shing / slar dgon pa 'dir yun ring 46

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /sdod rgyu byung na snyam pa yang yang shar gsung ba ni/ phyis su dgon de'i khri mdzad cing der gnas gzhi bzung ba sogs 'byung 'gyur gye cha la dgongs pa'i gsung du mngon/ dgung lo bcu drug pa'i dus chos bzang ri khrod du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i bsnyen mtshams zla ba gcig lhag gi bar du nanatan gnang ste kha skong gi sbyin sreg kyang mtshams nang der grub pa mdzad/zhag shas kyi mtshams nas bstan pa spyi'i rim gror dmigs te zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sbyinasreg gnad smin bsgrubs pas ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan ma mang du shar/spyir rje nyid sku na shin tu phra mo'i dus nas bzung ste shugs 'byung gis thugs laskyo shas kyi nyams che zhing dbon pa'i gnas su phebs 'dod rgyun chags su 'byung ba zhig yod pa'i thog chos bzang ri khrod du bsnyen mtshams gnang ba'i skabs 'di 'dra zhig nas snga ma'i bag chags kyi nus pa lhag par 'phel ba lta bus 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la snying po mi 'dug snyam pa dang / dben pa'i ri khrodakho na 'grims nas sgrub pa rnam par dag pa tshe dang snyoms pa zhig bgyis te rje mi la ras pa lta bu zhig byed snyam pa rgyun du byung / zhal nas kyang / ri mthon po dbe+en zhing yid du 'ong ba mthong na bdag da lta rang der song nas sgrub pa byed snyam pa dang / khyim pa las gas brel ba dang / rab byung pa lto gos kho na'i don du mi tshe skyel ba rnams mthong tshe skyo ba drag pos mchi ma 'chor ba yong / nags tshal chu gtsang spangs ljongs me tog sogs mthong na de la brten nas yid kyi yul du bde ba gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig myong rgyu yod pa phyis su med song ba rtsa thig gi byed las shig yin pa 'dra bsam/ mtshan mo 'ga' zhig mi rtag pa bsgom pas sang nang bar tshun la 'chi bar thag chod nas grab 'ga' zhig gnyid log pa bslang ste kha chems lab/ phyi nyin grwa pa tshos khyed ma grong ba e yin zer nas bzhad gad byed pa'ang byung / de 'dra skabs 47

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/du mar byung yang srog rlung lta bu zhig yin pa 'dra/ 'chi ba dran pa'i blo rnal ma yin mdog mi 'dug / der ma zad khyi zhig 'chi la khad pa mthong nas snying rje drag po mi non pa zhig skyes te/ rang gi sha bcad nas ster bsam pas gri ma rnyed nas bzhag pa snying rje mtshan nyid pa zhig min pa 'dra/ rlung gseng gi stabs shig byung bar mngon/ zhes gsungs pa ni khengs bskyungs pa tsam las nges pa'i don du sku tshe gong ma mang por sbyangs pa'i sa lam gyi rtogs pa'i drodatags khyad par can rnams mngon du gyur par the tshom med do/ / ngang tshul de dag yid srub sde dang bcas pa'i snying la zug rngur gyur pa ni/ ji skad du/ dga' ba'i gong bu'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab las/ yon tan can la sdang ba ni/ / bdag nyid ngan pa'i rang bzhin yin/ / zhes dang / a gra skyong ma'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab las/ lce gnyis gya gyusasgon pa yi/ / jo bo tsan dan rkang 'thung ni/ / don bya byed cing yon tan dang / / ldan yang brten bya nyid mi 'gyur/ / gsungs pa bzhin de skabs kyi dgon pa'i dge bskos blo bzang blo gros dang / ngag dbang bstan 'dzin zer ba gnyis me tog mda' can gyis rgyud brlams pa'i dbang gis rje 'di la rgyu med par dgra bzhin du blta ba zhig byung ste/ gnas skabs kye dgon pa'i khri thog pa la snyan phra sna tshogs zhus pa sogs lham nang gi tsher ma bzhin bsnyad gtser mang po yang nas yang du byas pas/ thugs sun nas lung pa'i phur lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pas gsar bzung mdzad pa'i dben dgon gsang sngags bde chen pho brang bya ba zhi yod pa der phebs nas re zhig bzhugs/ nang nub tu zhal 'don dang / gung gi dus su dpe gzigs gang 'grub/ skabs skabs su brag phugs ri rtse sogs su phebs nas mgur ma 'azen pa sogs mdzad/ zhal nas kyang / de skabs khong tshos sos mi 48

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bde ba la gtad pa'i rtsis yin mod kyang / nged rang ni 'ba' ra bas/mthun rkyen 'dzom pa'i dus su dge sbyor byed/ / ma 'dzom dus su ltos med ri la 'khyams/ / phral snang gang bde byed pa nam yong na/ / skyid chos mkhan la bla mas thugs rjes gzigs/ / zhes gsungs pa dang mthun pas re dogs dang bral bas snang ba bde zhing skyid pa'i tshad du 'khyol ba byung gsung /bdag nyid chen po rnams la pha rol ba dag gis gnod 'tshe ji ltar byas kyang sun 'byin mi nus par de'i rgyan du 'gro ba chos nyid yin te/ 'khri shing las/rnam sdang skyon gyi dug gis yid ni sun phyung gyur rnams kyi/ / dam pa dag la gnodapa bsgrub la 'bad pa rab rno gang / / de nyid gal te de yi yon tan rab 'bar rjes byed par/ / gyur na srid 'dir su zhig rgya cher gnod pa ldan par 'gyur/ / zhes dang / dpal nā ro pas/ khyed cag tshig rtsub mtshon cha de ni bzod pa'i go cha 'chang ba'i grogs/ / ngan sems dug gi 'phreng ba deni grub pa'i rma bya mdzes pa'i rgyu/ / bzod dka' tsan dan me chen de ni bde chen pad+ma'i dzing yangs te/ / khyed cag lhan cig khrims su bcas pa nges par bdag la dga' ba 'phel/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / snang byed bdag pos srin bya mun par byed/ / so ga zla ba'i zer gyis yi dwags bsregs/ / 'o ma'i rgyun gyis brang 'gro'i dug 'phel zhing / / dul ba'i tshul kyis yid srub gdungs byed pa/ / gnasamin gnas su gyur pa 'gal ba'i ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ bhe/ ṭ+wāṃhūṃ/ ra/ ༷༷/ bye nidī ༵ la ṭ+wāṃsdi/ t+t+waṃ ༷ ba nidī r+sha/ lda/ ༷ ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ/༷ ༷/ sgyur byed pa'i/ / bzod pa'i go cha brtan pa'i dpa' bo la/ / gnod pa'i rgyur 'gyur 'ga' yang dmigs su med/ / dgon lung gi blo gsal rnam 49

sa / /gung thang bstanapa'isgraname' gsung 'bum/dpyod can 'ga' zhig chos zhu bar yang yang 'ongs pa rnams la bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ blo sbyong don bdun ma/ lta khrid sogs stsal te 'dun pa bskangs/nyinagacig gnas kyi g.yon ngos kyi ri rtser skyo sangs la phebs skabs zhabs lhamanang du grog ma zhugs pas phud nas zhabs rjen gyis brag gseb na yar pheb pa dang dka' bcu shes rab bkra shis ngag dbang bstan dar gnyis phyi bzhin 'ongs pas/ mtshams shig tu rdo la zhabs rjes babs pa shes rab bkra shis kyis mthong ste/ ya ya sku phyogs nas rdo la zhabs rjes 'jog pa gnang song zer zhing gting nas ha las par gyur/ bka' las/ khong gnyis brda phyogs byed kin 'dug pas nged rang gis kyang phyir log nas bltas par/ rkang pa bzhag shul zhig tu rdo la rkang rjes lta bu zhig byung 'dug mod kyang / snga mo nas de 'dra zhig yod pa la nga rang gi rkang pa bzhag pa stabs 'grig byung ba las/ gsar du rdo lta zhog / sa mkhregs la'ang rkang rjes 'bab ki mi 'dug pa rang la mngon sum gyis grub bo/ / zhes gsungs te/zhabs rjes yin rgyu'i zhal bzhes gtan nas mi mdzad do/ / gnas der thugs dam dang dpe gzigs sogs shin tu 'phel bas thugs spro bar byung yang dgon lung nas blo ldan gzu bor gnas pa mang po yang yang mjal du 'ongasapa snga ma'i dge bskos sogs kyi snying la gzan pa'i rnam 'gyur che tsam d+dhāde ༷༵ dīsdi rnyi ṭ+wāṃ ༷ rdordo diṭ+wāṃspra dīhūṃ ༵༵ ༵ra/ phehūṃ~X ༵ dī~X byedī ༷༵dī ṭ+wāṃdī —gye lhag pas gzhung don la go ba rdol zhing kyi dga' ba des nyin mtshan 'da' ba byung / snga phyir mgur ma mang po dang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi bstod pa/lhag lha du ma'i mngon rtogs sogs gsung rtsom thor bu ba mang du mdzad/bka' las kyang / de dus 'di ltar bsams te rje mi las/ pha yul bdud 50

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /kyi btson ra yin/ / thar par dka' bas myur du bros/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ pha yul gye nyes dmigs kyang mngon sum du mthong / lo yang nar son pas bod dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing der slebs nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan ldan rnams kyi zhabs la gtugs te nyams len gyi gnad ma 'phyugs pa'i thos bsam tshad dang ldan pa zhig bgyis te/ ljongs der mi med kyi lung ba zhig tu mi tshe chos la skyel ba zhig byed rgyu byung na ci ma rung snyam pa skom pa'i chu gdung lta bu nar mar byung zhes gsungs/ zhal snga nas bde rgu ngag dbang dge legs rgya mtsho pa pe'i cing du lcang skya rin po che'i mtshams zhur 'byon rgyu la khong brgyud nas lcang skya rdo rje 'chang la de lugs kyi rgyu mtshan zhib 'khorakyi zhu yig phul/ phyag mdzod nas sprul sku bod du 'byon bzhed che ba 'dug rung da cha phyag rdzas srab pas bod du gtong sgo sogs dka' tshul gyi zhu yig phul ba yin snang / dgung lo bcu bdun gyi skabs su mi thams cad kyi kha 'dres bskyod pa lta bus khungs dang rgyu mtshan ci yang med par dus 'khrugs yong rgyu'i zi ber gyis grwa pa tshos yo byad dang nor rdzas sogs grong du skyel ba dang / sa 'og tu sped pa sogs 'ur zhog chen po byed pa la bstan pa'i gegs chag 'dra e yin gyi dogs pas thugs ma bde bar nyin re bzhin dam can chos rgyal la gtor 'bul bskul ba nan tan dang dbyu gu drug cu pa'i gtor ma mang du btang / de skabs mnal lam du mkhas grub chos rje yin zer ba'i bla ma dar yol gyi rnam pa can zhig gis rdo dril zhig nyid kyi phyag tu gtadanas 'di dkrol la rim gro 'dra mdzod/ mi mang gi gtam lab la rgyu mtshan med pas sems bde mo gyis gsungs pa zhig rmis/ mi ring bar pe'i cing nas bde rgu zhal snga nas 'byor byung bas rgya yul du 'khrungs pa sogs kyi 'phros tsam yang med par dus bde zhod 'jags yin tshul thos pas zar zir 51

༄/ /gu ba bstanapa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/sbarasper thams cad rang sar zhi/ snga lo lcang skya rin po cher phul ba'i zhu yig gi gsung lan 'byon par nyid dbus gtsang du 'byon pa cis kyang legs/da cha slob gnyer gyi ched du pheb rgyu yin gshis mang 'gyed 'bul ba sogs rgya chen mi dgos/ lcang skya gong ma/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sogs thog mar grwa sar bzhugs dus grwa rkyang lugs kyis chos grwa 'grim pa ma gtogs 'gyed mang skol sogs rgya chen byas pa'i lo rgyus med/ deng sang 'ga' zhig gis de 'dra byed pa chos mi yong ba'i snga ltas yin/ sku yon yag po byung tshe sku bsod dang snyan grags slar rgyas rgyu yin pas gtong sgo sogs de dus byas chog / sprul sku bod du bzhugs ring la chas ka 'dang tsam gyi phan grogs nged nas kyang bgyid/ ces sogs zhal ta zhib lhugs su gnang ba mjal bas thugs la bsam don 'grub byung snyam du dgyes tshor dpe med byung / phyag mdzod nas lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gis de ltar gsungs kyang dngos chas gang yang med par gnas skor ba lta bu byas nas 'gro lugs mi 'dug pas da ci drag zer nas blo 'tshub lang / snga mo lcang skya rin po che chos bzang ri khrod du phebs skabs 'du khang ha cang rnying kog che ba sku gong ma'i grwa pa cha gar sman ram pa dar rgyas rgya mtshos mthong nas ma bzod par 'di nas mi go chod cig nged kyi rogs la btang na/ nged kyis phyogs yas mas su 'bul sdud cig bgyid rnyed pa dga' mo byung na 'du khang zhig gsos dang bla brang gi 'dzin skyong gi thebs kyang thon pa yong 'gro zer ba bzhin mi kha shas btang ba rnams kyang skabs 'dir 'byor nas rnyed pa'i dngos po rnams sprad pas pheb 'dug sogasakhya byed gang thad nas byed dka' bar yod pa la phan pa'i yan lag tu gyur/ zhal nas kyang / khong tsho rnyed pa ha cang mi che'ang dngul srang stong tsam gyi rtsa ba rnyed 'dug pa rnams sprad byung bas phyag mdzod zhal ras bco lnga'i 52

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /zlab gang ba la 'gran bzod pa gyur/ dngul srang nyis brgya lhag tsam gyis chos bzang gi 'du khang zhig gsos bgyis pa dngos gtsang rang byung ma song /lhag ma gang yod bla brang gi mdzod phugs su rgya rim pa bdun dang skal ldan las 'phro can dang phrad par shog gi smon lam gtad rgya dang bcas gter du sdes so/ / gsungs pa bzhin byas pa yin snang / de nas zi lang am bhan brgyudanas lo rjes mar dbus su phebs rgyu'i don skor gong ma chen por snyan zhus kyi yi ge phul/ lo snga phyi 'dir yab yum gnyis ka 'das te zhal nas kyang / lo snga ma pha rgan lo bdun cu don bzhi pa lnga ba'i lam du gyur cing 'di lo ma rgan drin mo che tshe'i dus byas par thog mar sems la gdung ba che tsam byung yang / 'khor ba thog med nas pha mar ma gyur ba'i sems can med tshul dang pha ma shi ba'i rjes su mya ngan byed pa las de'i don du dmigs nas bzang spyod tshar gcig tsam 'don rgyu byung na kho la des phan/ khyad par du tshe 'dir chos3ma dag cig byed rgyu byung na pha ma'i drin lan kyang des 'khor ba 'dug tshul rnams bsam pas mya ngan srab tu song / nor rdzas phran bu gang yod rnams dge phyogs su btang / rang gis kyang snga ma pha 'das dus dang da res gnyis gar zhag zhe dgu'i bar du dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i lho sgo'i cho ga tshad ldan bgyis/ ma'i gdung sbyangs pas ltas bzang zhing thod rus 'theb rgya tsam ma tshigs pa la a yig 'bur dod shin tu gsal ba zhig byon/ da ni bod du 'gro ba la shul na 'phrang dgos pa gcig kyang med pas zhe blo bde'o snyam pa'ang byung gsung / de nas 'khrungs yul zhwa dmar dgon grong spyi nas gdan 'dren gyi zhu ba phul ba bzhin btegs/ lam bar du mchod rten thang dgon pas bsu ba ser 'phreng dang bcas gdan drangs/'du khang du tshogs pas mjal kha dang gsol ston 'bul nod gzab/ rim 53

༄/ /gung bstanapa'i name'i gsung 'bum/gyis zhwa dmar ba'i rta bsu thab bsu rim pa mang po dang bcas dgon par babs/ a khu zhabs drung dang mjal bas shin tu mnyes shing der bzhugs ring la zhabs drung nyid nas dpon g.yog tshang mar bsnyen bkur yang dag bsgrubs/ bla brang nas brtan bzhugs dang 'brel ba'i 'bul ba gzab rgyas dang gsol ston/ dgon pa spyi nas 'du khang du gdan drangs te ston mo dang dngos 'bul rgya cher bstabs/ chos skyong sku khog tu phebs nas phyis 'byung gi lung mang po zhig gnang ba phal cher thog tu khel ba byung / 'du khang du tshe dpag med kyi li sku khru tshad ma gcig dang dge 'dun la mang 'gyed 'bul ba sogs gya nom pa gnang / lung dang rjes gnang sna tshogs zhu mkhan mang du byung ba kun gyi 'dun pa bskangs/ mchod gzhi'i tsho ba so sos gdan 'dren zhus pa bzhin rta shog drug gi 'brog khyim phal cher du phebs par tshang mas rta nor lug gsum dngul gos dar sogs 'byor bstun gyi dad 'bul gang gzab zhus/ spyan gzigs thang du skyes lhar gsol mchod gzab rgyas btang / de dus 'brog sde'i khrod rnams su grub thob yin zer ba'i rdzun ma zhig gis khyod kye rta bzang po de nged la phul cig dang nged kyes khyod bar do 'grim dus rta de la bskyon nas lha yul du 'khrid zer ba dang / skye rtags zhu ba 'ga' zhig la skye ba phyi mar dgra bcom pa zhig tu skye bar 'gyur ro zhes lung ston pa dang / rab byung dang dge tshul bsnyen rdzogs zhu mkhan rnams stabs gcig tu bzhag nas bgegs gtor zhig btang rjes nas 'thor zhing /khyod dge slong du gyur cig sogs brjod nas des chog par byed pa sogs g.yo khram sna tshogs kyis dad ldan rnams bsru zhing bstan pa la rma 'byin pa zhig byung ste/ legs bshad tshol gyi yal 'dab las/ ring du yon tan bskrun par gragasagyur kyang / / mngon du ngan pa'i spyod pa mtshon gyur pa/ / bsam pa 54

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /gya gyu rnams kyis grags pa gzhan/ / de bzhin spyod tshul gzhan de mtshungs pa min/ / gsungs pa ltar/ byed spyod thams cad chos dang rgyab 'gal skye bo ma rung ba'i spyod pa kho na yin pa la da dung rang nyid gang zag khyad par can yin rgyu'i 'o zob byed/ skye bo rmongs pa rnams kyis kyang des phyin ci log tu bshad tshad bden par bzung nas grub thob ya med du 'khrul zhing gnas ma yin pa la blun dad kyis shin tu gus pa byung ste/ bla ma zhang gis/ snyigs dus skye bo bsod nams zad pa'i rgyus/ / log par bshad na yid dang rna bar 'bab/ / khrims 'chal spyod la grub thob yin zhes gus/ / phung byed 'dre la gtan gyi skyabs gnas zhu/ / gsungs pa bzhin long bas long ba khrid de lam log par 'gro ba'i brtse ba'i thugs kyis ma bzod par khram pa de'i rdzun phugs gsal bar byas pas/ kho shin tu khros nas rje 'di la khyab 'jug rbad rgyu yin zhes bsdigs mo byas kyang / zhal nas/ nged de la sbu g.yo ba tsam yang ma byung gsungs te/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms las/ gang zhig byis pa'i mthu stobs can/ / de yi stobs ni stobs med yin/ / zhes pa de kho la byung bar mngon/ phyir phebs pa'i lam du dor zhi dgon pas gdan drangs te 'bul nod phul/ za lung rdo dkar ri khrod pas bsnyen bkur zhus shing rim gyis dgon lung du 'byor/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa'i tshe dbus phyogs su pheb rgyu'i gra bsgrig dgos pa thams cad tshar nas dgon sgrub sde bla dpon lha sde mi sde thams cad kyis gser dngul/ gos dar/ rta sogs pheb rdzong gi bdog pa'ang mang du spel/ 'on kyang lo snga mar dbus pheb kyi don du brtags pa gnangabs/ rmi lam gyi tshul du khye'u dkar po zhig gis/ khyi la zhon nas bgrod pa dka'/ / phag la zhon na bde bar slebs/ / gnub kyi rje dang las 'brel yod/ / dga' ldan mgon gyis rjes su 'dzin/ / u dum wa ra gang 55

༄/ /gung ba napa'i name gsung 'bum/'dod 'thu/ / zhes lo snga phyir pheb thub mi thub dang / phebs nas kyang stag phu rin po che dang / byams mgon bla ma rin po che sogs bsten te chos kyi snying po mtha' dag gang 'dod du bzhes rgyu sogs 'byung 'gyur mtha' dag lhag pa'i lhas gsal bar lung bstan pa'i don bzhin du khyi lo 'dir gong ma chen por snyan zhus kyi pheb lan ma 'byor stabs dbus su pheb rgyur ma song /der ma zad bgrod dka' gsung ba'i don lo der dbus pa song ba rnams lam du jag pas bcom 'dug pas de'i lo pheb bzhud phyir 'gyang ba'ang yid ma chosasbang gi 'phrin las su gsal lo/ / smras pa/ kun tu rmongs pa'i rlung thub bcom pa na/ / blo dang brtson pa 'bar ba'i gdung shugs kyis/ /ljongs 'dir 'bab pa'i chos tshul chu bo kun/ / snyim par btung yang ma ngoms a ka sta/ / gang thugs zab cing 'das pa'i sa mu tra/ / mi zad legs bshad chu yi gter gyur kyang / / phyi phyir zab rgyas gdams pa'i chu bo kun/ / sdud la ngoms pa med 'di e ma rmad/ / thub bstan zla ba'i snang ba ches dkar yang / / mtha' 'khob mun par grags pa'i yid 'byung gi /dbus 'gyur chos kyi nyin byed snang ba la/ / mngon du phyogs pa'i skya rengs dang por shar/ / 'on kyang khyod kyi mkhyen zab ba ku la/ / rgyal kun spyi gzugs bshes gnyen 'gram chang gis/ / nyin mtshan kun tu 'byed kye de las gzhan/ / mkhas mkhas phal gyi nyi zlas nam yang min/ / yang na mkha' la kun gsal zhes grags te/ / phyogs phyogs snang byed phreng bas rim ldan du/ / bzung ba'i drin la ltos phyir mgon khyod kyang / / gzhan phan thugs bskyed go las drangs sam snyam/ / zhes rigs dang dkyil 'kher rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum rmad du byung ba'i mdzad bzang 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal gyi cha tsam gtam du byas pa rtogs 56
༄7/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bajod pad+ma dkar po las/ yul mdo smad du gsan sbyong ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul gyi 'dab ma ste bzhi pa'o/ /57

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/༄༅/ / 'dab ma lnga ba/ bsnyen rjogs kyi sdom pa bzhes pa'i tshul/ston ga'i dus 7gong nas bod du song chog pa'i bka' lan gser yig 'byor/ sum pa mkhan rin po che nas bsnyen rdzogs sgrub pa legs gsung 'dug par/ lo nyi shu ma lon pas mi rung ngam zhus par sngon gyi dam pa mang po'i rnam thar du dgung lo bco brgyad dus bsnyen rdzogs mdzad pa'i lo rgyus yod/ mnga' zla dang bshol zla so sor byas pas nyi shu lon par rtsis chog gsung / de nas mkhan rin po che gsang stabs kyis chos bzang ri khrod du byon/ khong rang nas mkhan slob sbrags ma gnang / dge slong ri khrod pa gsum dang bcas pas bsnyen rdzogs kye sdom pa stsal/ bar chad 'dri skabs/lo nyi shu ma lon pa ma yin nam zhes pa la ma yin lags/ zhes lan btab kyang blo ngo na rdzun lab dgos byung snyam pa shar gsung / dgung lo bcu dgu bzhes pa sa mo phag gi lo zla ba lnga pa'i nang du dbus gtsang chos kyi mdun sar chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur ba'i phyir lam du zhugs/ dgon lung nas thon nyin dge 'dun bgres gzhon tshang mas gling 'dabs su skyel ma gnang zhing / rta bsgyur lan gsum dang sbrags 'bod pa'i tshul gyis thal skad dar g.yab sogs myur mjal gye rten 'brel bsgrigs/ spyi pa dang bla brang che phra rnams kyis tsher 'gag gi rgya sgo thon gyi bar du skyel ma bgyis/ lung dkar ri khrod du phebs nas mkhan rin po cher mjal te zhag gcig bzhugs/ snyan bskul dri za'i rgyud mang bya ba'i zhal gdams yi ger 'khod pa gcig dang zhal 58

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /ta mang du gnang zhing rta bzang gcig dang dngul srang sum cu'i pheb rdzong bstar/ mkhan rin po ches gtsos de phyogs kyi dgon sgrub sde bla grwa mang tsam dang bcas pas tsha lam gyi bar du skyel ma mdzad/ rim gyis mtsho sngon du thon/phyag rdor skyabs pe'i zi'i yur ger gdan drangs zhag shas bzhugs par ston mogazab rgyas dang rta drug gos chen dngul sogs kyi rdzong ba gang legs zhus/dar rgyas ja sag gi yur ger gdan drangs nas ston mo dang rdzong ba gzabs/po ha'i chu ha cang che bas zhag shas bzhugs dgos byung bar kun bzang bla ma dang hul chang thu sa lag chis bsnyen bkur bzang po bstab cing chu la sgrol 'don gyi rogs ram yang dag bgyis/ chas dam du bkra shis lhun po'i yel chi mkhan po sogs 'grul ba rnams dang skyel ma'i sog dmag bcas 'dzom/zhag shas bcag mal dang / de nayorim gyis byon pas yu lān mu ru brgal skabs chibs chu dkyil du 'dam la zug nas 'gyel bas sku bskyod de mgrin pa man chad chur nub kyang de ma thag rta 'dam las thon pa la slar bcibs thub pa byung bas skyon med par chu las bde bar thon/ 'bri chu ha cang che bas lug gu rab brgyud lding la thon nas nag chur 'byor/ der yod pa'i gzhung gi mkhan nang gis bsnyen bkur gzab cing lha sar gnas tshul gyi yi ge rta zam thog nas btang / rdzong skyel gyis rta khal gyi u lā dang cha zhag gar babs su thab shing thab g.yog / kha rtsar bkag med kyi yi gi ster ba sogs mthun rkyen gang bzang bsgrubs/ rim gyis rwa sgreng rgyal ba'i dben gnas su phyag phebs/ jo bo 'jam pa'i rdo rje sogs rten rnams la mchod mjal zhib tu gnang / sku na phra mo'i dus nas bka' gdams kyi rnam thar la thugs lhag par mos pa zhig yod pa 'di res gdan sa mjal bas rnam par thar pa mthong thos rnams gsal 'debs lta bur song ste dad pa'i shugs kyis spyan chab 59

༄/ /gung bang bstanapa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/bsil zhing sku lus kyi ba spu g.yo ba byung / rwa sgreng gi 'dab tsam du 7gong sa mchog nas thon pa rje drung / bka' blon thun mong gi drung 'khor gcig bcas bsu mi gnang ba dang phrad/ gong sa thams cad mkhyen pas gsung shog gnang ba mjal zhing shing thog bu ram khur ba sogs kyi gsol ras rgya cher gnang 'dug pa rnams zhus/ stag lung mdar zhag bab bgyis pas dgon pa mjal du phebs shing / gtsug lag khang rnams su mchod mjal zhib rgyas mdzad pas bka' rgyud gong ma rnams kyi mdzad pa phyag rjes pa'ang mos gus lhag par 'phel/ bra ste'i nang so gong ma rnams stag lung dang 'brel che bas sgarab khag gi nang rten du stag lung nas byung ba'i rten byin can mang zhing /brag btsan srung mar bsten pa bcas kyi rgyu mtshan la brten zhabs drung gdan sa pa zhig bzhugs 'dug pa la mjal phrad gnang bar/ gdan sa pa'i sprul sku de rang nyid dri mthon po zhig la bzhugs/ g.yas g.yon du brom ci'i khar grwa pa yar bgres lto ba lug ge ba gnyis 'khod/ rje 'di stag gdan kha gang ma chig rkyang zhig la bzhugs su bcug pa sogs chen po'i sgob ha cang che bar 'dug pa la chos phyogs kyi dri ba 'ga' zhig zhus pas zhabs drung nas sku mdun pa gnyis la spyan hrig hrig byed pa las gsung gang yang pheb ma byung / sku mdun pa sma ra zing nge ba zhig 'dug pa des de skor rnams bka' rgyud gsung 'bum na gsal bar bzhugs zer gdong dmar hur re byas byung bas dri ba mang po byed ma spobs gsung / chos kyi gnas tshul lta zhog / 'jam dbyangs 7gong ma chen pos chan shi'i lung gis bsngags pa zhig la 'di ltar byedapa ni 'jig rten gyi gnas lugs kyang ma shes pa'i 'bras rtags su snang mod/ 'on kyang da lta dus kyi dbang gis skye sprul gyi ming tsam la blo phugs gtad de rmongs pa'i 'khor gyi dbus su che tshugs kho nas chos srid gnyis ga'i 60

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /don thams cad 'grub pa bzhin byed pa ni rang nyid nam 'phangs mthon por mi 'gyur ba tsam du ma zad/ bstan pa'i dbu 'phang smod byed yin te/kun mkhyen lnga pa'i chab shog las/ tshe rabs snga phyi med pa'i 'gro ba dag /medaphyir skye ba tsam la su zhig mtshar/ / rmongs rtul rigs mthun dbus na chen po'i gar/ / 'gyeng ba yis kyang thub bstan ches cher smad/ / gsungs pa bzhin no/ / lha sar 'byor pa'i nyin sku 'bum thang du gzhung nas thab bsu rtse drung bka' blon bzhi'i sku tshab sogs mi drag mang tsam dang / 'bras spungs sde pa/ sgo mang sde pa/ khang tshan mi tshan gyi rgan pa grwa rgyun sku skye chos mdzad 'ga' zhig bcas bsu mi mang tsam byung / dpal grub khang gsar du bzhugs gnas gra bsgrig byas yod par phyag babs/ ja gral thon ma thag lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du mchod mjal la phebs/ jo bo rin po cher mjal bas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dngos dang mjal ba lta bu'i mos gus dang dgyes tshor sku lus kyi ba spu g.yo ba byung / gzhan yang rang byon lnga ldan/ rje nga 'dra ma sogs steng 'og gi lha rten rnams la zhib tu mjal/ de nas grwa sa'i gra pa mang tsam mjal du 'ongs pas chos kyi gsung gleng 'phel zhing khang tshan mi tshan so sos dkar spro dang dga' dar phul/ gzhung nas sna zhen parartse drung klu sde chos mdzad gtong ba gnang zhing zur gsos dang nar ma'i phog / thab shing / gzan pa/ rta thab kyi g.yog po sogs shangs len shin tu gzab rgyas mdzad/ phyi nyin gru 'dzin gnyis pa pho brang chen po po ta lar phebs te 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs ngur smrig gar gyis rnam par rol pa rgyal ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mjal/ thugs shin༄ brtse ba'i rnam pas bka' 'dri mang du phebs/ sku mdun du 'bol nyis brtsegs rgyab yol zhal dkar yu ring 61

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/gtod pa sogs sprul sku che gras kyi gzos sgo dang bcas ja gral gnang /mjal kha thon nas gnas bcu khang du gsol ston rgyas par stsal/ rtse'i mgron gnyer skal bzang gis rgyus yod byas te 'phags pa lo ke sha ra dang gser gdung 'dzam gling rgyan gcig sogs kyi mchod khang mang tsam la rten mjalaganang / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sbrul pa'i sku rin po che 'bras srungs nas byon te mjal phrad gnang bsam dang bu phrad pa lta bu'i dgyes pa 'phel zhing / nang sbyar gyi bka' mchid rgyun ring gnang /gza' tshes bzang po'i nyin kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang bo mchog gi zhabs drung du dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal/ sku gsung thugs rten/ na bza' nyer spyad cha tshang / gser 'ba' zhig las grub pa'i 'khor lo dang / gser dngul 'dres ma'i bkra shis rtags brgyad rin po che sna tshogs kyi phra rgyan can bzo bkod khyad du mtshar ba sogs mchod rdzas kye rnam grangs mang tsam dang /dngul gos dang / ras zam sogs bdog pa'i dngos po mi nyung tsam spyan lam du bstar te maṇ+ḍal phyag tu thogs nas rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku che ba'i yon tan las brtsams te bstod bsngags brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa'i gsol 'debs kyi zhu 'bul zab cing brling la snyan cing 'brel chags pa'i tshig don phun sum tshogs pa/ mkhas pa mgu ba'i skyes kyi rtse mor gyur ba zhig thogs med du zhus pa na 7gong sa thams cad mkhyen pa chen po thugs lhag par dgyes pa'i rnam pa dang bcas bka' lan bzang po stsal/ sku mdun nas ja gral thog sngar gsan spyong ji ltar mdzad pa sogs kyi bka' 'dri mang tsam phebs/ de nas phur bu lcog byang chub gling du rje bla ma thub dbang rdo rje 'chang byams pa'i mtshan can dang mjal du byon/ zhal mjal tsam nas dad pa shugs drag skyes shing bla ma dam 62

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /pa 'di nyid kyi zhabs pang bsten nas gsung gi bdud rtsi yun ring du longs spyod rgyu byung na ci ma rung snyam pa rtsol med du byung ba sngon gyi las 'brel zhig yod pa'i dbang gis yin pa 'dra gsung / mdo smad nas 'byon khar sum pa mkhan rin po che'i zhal ta la phur bu spyog bla ma la lta khrid cig cis kyang zhus shig gsungs yod pa bzhin lta ba'i khrid cig gnang rgyu'i gsol ba btab par/lamal rim gyes 'khrid dgos dang po nyid nas dbu ma'i lta ba la thod rgal bgyis pas ci'ang mi yong / slar 'di nas 'phren zhig gtong / de dus shog dang lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi khrid cig bgyid pa yin gsung / sku mdun du rgyun ring tsam bzhugs pas sngar bla ma su 'dra bsten/ chos ci nyan/slob gnyer ga 'dra bgyis pa sogs kyi bka' 'dri zhib tu gnang zhing yun ring 'dris pa lta bur thugs bag phebs pa'i gsung 'phros ci mang lhug par stsal/zhabs drung snying rje bo rang zhig 'dug gsung thugs shin tu brtse ba'i rnam pa mdzad/ de nas gza' mas bzang po'i nyin 'bras spungs su pheb skabs 7gong sa mchog nas na len+d+ra'i mkhan po dpal 'byor skyel mar gtong ba gnang / gsol tshigs ra ba'i gling kha der sgo mang dpon slob sangs rgyas rdo rje dang / 'dul ba dpon slob/ khang tshan rgan pa sogs bsu bar slebs/thog mar bsam blo khang ser gyi tshom du khang tshan spyi nas dkar spro zhus/ de nas lcang skya khang gsar du thog mar dgon lung mi tshan gyi tshom du gsol ja bzhes 'bras thog gra rgyun tshang mas mjal kha zhus/ spyi khang gi bar thog der bzhugs gnas kyi gra bsgrigs byas 'dug pas der gdan phebs/ mkhan po dpal 'byor gyis 7gong sa mchog nas stsal pa'i ku shu gsar ba sogs kyi gsol ras dang / zur gsos kyi ja mar zhib chen khal rgyab mang tsam rnams spyanalam du bstar te bkra shis pa'i tshig gi mtshams spyor dang bcas dri bral 63

/ /gung bamaba'i sgronatshogasung 'bum/srid du ring ba'i lha rdzas kyi mgul dar sprod pa gnang / sa dkar chos thog gi yar 'tshogs la blo gsal bye ba'i 'byung gnas dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mang gi chos grwar gzhung gsar ba'i 'dzin grwa la zhugs/ snga sor pe'i cing nas lcang skya rin po ches gsung shog gnang bar/ deng dus zhabs drung sku skyes kyi rigs bod du 'gro ba rnams thos bsam gyi ched du song ba mi 'dra bar mang skol la song ba bzhin thog mar mang 'gyed 'bul ba sogs rgya gang che byas/'dug ring la dman cha mi 'dzin par bla chen gyi gras shom kho na byed/ rgyal srid kyi bya ba tshun chad la 'tshang ci thub byed mkhan sha stag 'dug / de chos mi yong ba'i rgyu yin pas khyod de ltar ma byed par gra rkyang lugs kyis slob gnyer la 'bad pa mdzod/ ces gsungs pa thugs la bcangs te gra rkyang gnyom chung gi 'dzin tshugs kho na gnang / sgo mang gi chos grwar sprul sku che kha rnams bzhugs gdan khyer te sa khri'i khar sdod srol yod pa bzhin/ nyid kyis kyang de ltar gnang dgos tshul nan tan du zhus kyang dang du ma bzhes par dge 'dun mang dang mnyam du bzhugs pa sogs che sgrob kyi rigs rgyang ring du dor/ gzhi nas phyag rdzas che ba med pas 'bras spungs tshogs chen dang sgo mang grwa tshang / bsam blo khang tshan dgon lung mi tshan rnams la mang 'gyed kyang mtshon tsam res chog pa gnang / spyir dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur sogs rgya gang che byas pa bzang mod kyang / myos byed ma'i skyes rabs las/'di ltar sbyin pa thams cad du/ / chos sgrub pa yi grogs ma yin/ / gsungs pa ltar/ 'di lta bu'i skabs su de 'dra la gtsor 'don byas na chos kyi grogs su mi 'gyur ba'ang yod pas dgag bya dang dgos pa'i gtso che chung legs par phyed pa dgos so/ / lung rtogs yon tan reg bya ma mchis kyang / / zang zing 'byor pa'i sprin gyi 'du 'god can/ / ltar snang mdzes pa'i zob kyi be+e 64

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /skur mdangs/ / dgung sngon mthon por grags pa'i stong pa la/ / 'phya ba gsalabyed kurdo rab rgod cing / / lung rigs rlabs kyi phreng ba'i rol gar mkhan/ / dma' ba'i gshong bur 'khyil ba dwangs pa'i mtsho/ / blo gsal ngang mo 'bum gyi rtse dga'i gnas/ / zhes bya ba'ang nyams dga'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ / sngar mdo smad du chos grwa 'grim pa gnang ba'i stobs kyis dam bca' 'jog pa dang bgro gleng gtong ba sogs la dang po nas rnam dpyod kyi rtsal gzhan dang mi 'dra ba blo ldan rnams kyis bsngags pa'i gnas su gyur/lugasaspol la phar phyin ston mo mthon pas gzhan gyi dge rgan byas mi chog 'dug cing rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul pa'i sku rin po che phar phyin ston mo mthon kyang sprul sku che grar dmigs bsal yod 'dug pas dge rgan du bsten/ zhal nas kyang / dge bshes su grags pa 'ga' zhig gis rang rang la dge rgan bcol yong snyam pa'i re ba yod tshod 'dug pas ma dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur dang gtam ci rigs gtong ba byung / de dus dge bshes su ming btags pa'i sdig bshes shig la ma brten par theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i skyes bu dam pa 'di 'dra bsten rgyu byung ba rang nyid sngon bsags kyi bsod nams mi dman par go zhes gsungs/ chos grwar zhugs nas nyin kha shas kyi mtshams su gong sa rin po che'imajal kha la po ta lar phebs pas/ sku mdun du ja gral thog / thub pa'i dbang po dang rje btsun tsong kha pa'i sku brnyan re rgyal ba rang gi phyag gis gnang zhing / gzan sham/ stod 'gag / zla gam/ rtse zhwa/ ske rags/lham dang bcas pa'i gnang sbyin rgya che ba stsal/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog nas khyed rang gi skye ba snga ma 7gong ma'i bla mchod mdzad cing rang bstan la bka' drin che ba'i skyes bu dam pa yin par ma zad/ ngos cag sku 65

༄/ /gung bang bstan ba'izlanalo gsung 'bum/'bum nas bod du yong skabs 7gong ma'i mi snar phebs pas bstan srid la rgyar legs lam gyi phan cha gang drag mdzad pa sogs sgo du ma nas ngos dang 'brelab zab/ da lan sprul pa'i sku nyid sku na gzhon kyang mkhyen rab phun sum tshogs pa 'di 'dra la thos bsam gyi ched du bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir phebs nas grwa tshang tshad ldan gyi chos grwar zhugs pa shin tu legs/slad nas sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa'i rjes su zhugs te rgyalaba'i bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa la thos bsam tshad dang ldan pa mdzad nas rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa rin po che la phan thogs nges shig gnang dgos/ lcang skya mchog sbrul rin po che nas nged la gtad gnyer gye gsung bris kyang byung bas ngos nas kyang gang ci'i sar yid 'jags bgyid pa yin/zhes sogs thugs la bcags pa'i bka' slob brtse gzigs gnang / 'bras spungs su 'byor te zhag shas kyi mtshams nas phur bu lcog tu phebs/ byams mgon bla ma mchog dang mjal/ snga ma snyan gsan phul ba'i lam gtso'i khrid mdor sdus la gnad tshang ba zhig bka' drin stsal/ rje rin po che'i sku brnyan rje rang gi rab gnas ma zhig dang 'jam dbyangs kyi gser thang byin can zhig gnang nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung la thos bsam byed lugs dang / de'ang kha phyir bltas su ma song bar rang gi rgyud thog tu smin pa dgos tshul sogs bslab bya rus pa can mang du stsal te thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa byung / bka' las kyang / bod du slebs nas chos nyan pa'i thog ma 'di yin pas sgrub gnas tshad ldan du bla ma tshad ldan las chos tshad ldan nyan rgyu byung / byin rten tshad ldan stsal bslab bya tshad ldan gnang brten 'brel gyi sgo dang po phun sum tshogs pa 'grigs byung snyam/ dad gus dang dga' spro 'gran pa bzhin du 'phel zhes gsungs/ dgung lo nyi shu pa me byi'i lo lha ldan smon lam du 66

༄za/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /phebs/ dge 'dun khri phrag gnyis lhag dang lhan du nyin re bzhin bstan 'gro'i phan bde 'phel ba'i thugs smon rgya gang che gnang / jo bo rnam gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i rten rnams la gser chab spron te brgya mchod phul/ 'phrul snangagi gtsug lag khang steng 'og dang ra mo che'i mchod mjal 'chag med du gnang ste brgya phyag tshar gang 'grub dang sbrags thos bsam sogs bstan pa'i bya ba yar rgyas su 'phel ba'i gsol 'debs smon lam shugs drag mdzad/zhal nas bod du sdod ring la smon lam dang tshogs mchod skabs nyin bzhin 'diltar ma chag pa bgyis shing skabs gzhan du'ang lha sar phyin res kyis jo mjal bya ba che bzhag chung bzhag gis ma chad pa byas/ phyis su rang yul nas skuram sogs ma sleb pas bkren po byung skabs kyang gser chab sgon pa dang mchod 'bul ma chad pa bgyis pa tshe 'di la lus dang longs spyod la snying po blangs par 'di kho na chos brgyad dang ma 'dres pa'i dngos gtsang byung bar sems so/ / zhes gsungs/ 'di lo rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pas gsung chos dang smon lam lan 'ga' gnang ba rnams 'chag med du phebs nas gsan/ smon lam grol nas 'bras spungs su dpe mtshams gnang ste brtsi bzhag 'dzin skyor sogs la chig dril du brtson par mdzad/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul pa'i sku rin po che dge rgan yin par ma zad mdo smad du bzhugs dus nas thugs nang shin tu gtsang ba'i dbang gis chos dang 'jig rten gyi bya bzhag tha na nyin gcig gi 'gro bsdad gal che ba tshun chad kyi blang dor khong gis ci gsung ltar bsgrubs bzhin la/ dbyed ka rje bla ma thub dbang rdo rje 'chang byams pa'i mtshan can gyi gsung chos tshugs par nye skabs zhal ta phebs par/ spyir grwa tshang gi 'grig lam la phar phyin ston mo ma thon bar du chos nyan la 'gro mi tshog kyang / khyod kyis sngar lam rim gyi khrid 67

༄/ /gung thang bstanami'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/gnad smin zhig nyan mi 'dug cing lam rim 'chad pa la rje bla ma byams pa'i mtshan can lta bu bod na med pas da res phur bu spyog tu chos nyan par phyin na legs/ bla ma 'di'i gsung chos sems la shin tu phan pa zhig yong gi yod pas khyod mi gzhi ngan rgyu mi 'dug na'ang / rnal du mi phebs pa'i rgod po zhig snang ba'ang dul du 'gro'am snyam zhes bka' gnang pas/ rje nyid chos nyan la phebs 'dun shin tu che ba'i khar gsung de ltar gnang ba'i stabs kyis da lta rang 'gro snyam du thugs brel ba byung gsung / de nas bka' chos tshugs nye ba na phur bu lcog tu phebs nas bla ma dang mjal bas khyod chos nyan la 'ongs pa shin tu legs/ 'on kyang gral du bsdad pa tsam la cha ma bzhag par sems la 'char rgyu yod pa gyis la nyon cig gsung ba sogs thugs rjes 'dzin pa'i pheb sgo mang du stsal/ chos nyan gyi gral du sprul sku che gra kha shas yod kyang bla ma nyid nas bka' phebs te rje 'di nyid mdun rang du 'jog pa gnang /ser 'bras dge gsum rgyud stod smad bkra shis lhun po sogs dgon ri khrod mtha' dag nas 'dus pa'i chos nyan mkhan nyis stong lnga brgya tsam tshogs pa'i dbus su rje bla ma thub dbang rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis shing / snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bshad sgrub gser gyi 'khor los thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i srid la 'dod dgur dbang bsgyur ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba chen po wā gi n+d+ra mi tri shrī bha dra nyid chos kyi khri la bzhugs te/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi gshegs shul/ chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi nying khu/thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen par bgrod pa'ilam cha tshang la ma nor ba/ che ba bzhi dang ldan pa byang chub lam gye rim pa'i khrid kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang bo lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa'i khrid yig 'jam dpal zhal lung gi steng nas zla ba gcig gi bar du nyin re bzhin gsol tshigs snga thogs kyi rjes nas/ srod 68

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /tshab tshub kyi bar chos thun re gnang zhing / thog mar sher snying bdud bzlog / de nas bla brgyud gsol 'debs yon tan gzhir gyur ma dang bcas rje bla ma nyid kyis mgo bskul te dpon slob tshang mas gsungs pa'i mjug tu maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas zhal gyi dkyil 'khor 'dzum pa dang bcas gsung snyan po gam du nye ba la mi che ring ba la mi chung ba'i ngo mtshar can gyis go ba skyed pa'i yan lag tu sngon 'gro'i bshad pa lung rigs kyis brgyan cing mtha' chod pa'i rgyas pa dang / dngos gzhi la 'jam dpal zhal lung gi brtsi bzhag 'dzin chos su gnang ba'i steng nas khrid dmigs blo la 'char bde zhing yid 'khul che ba dang / mjug tu bsdus don lta bu'i bshad pa rnams kyi 'gag don mdor dril ba dang bcas gsungs pa gnang zhing / chos thun gyi mthar bla ma dam pa nyid kyis mgo bskul mdzad nas lam rim smon lam gsungs pa'i mjug tu chos grol ba sogs rje sgrub khang ba'i phyag srol ma nyams par mdzad de smin rgyas su stsal ba legs par gsan/ zhal nas/ nyin dang po'i chos thun skabs blo ha cang 'khul ba rang ma byung zhing / bla ma 'di bshad yam la 'phyan pa zhig 'dug snyam pa'i log lta skyes byung bar/ chos grolanas rang gi sna la rang gis mdzub mo btsugs te rigs chad khyod lta bu snyam zhe bdas mang du byas shing / mtshan thog thag tu bshags pa dang bla ma la gsol 'debs shugs drag byas pas sang nyin nas gang gsung thams cad spa ba dang me lcag phrad pa bzhin rgyud la lam lam 'dres pas 'khul che ba zhig byung / nga rgyal 'di bla ma'i chos kyis rkyang rgyud la phan thogs pa'i gegs che shos dang / tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong ni nyams len dngos gzhi'i dus su ma zadatshos nyan pa la'ang sngon du 'gro dgos pa 'dug snyam pa'i nges shes skyes/de nas bzung ste da lta'i bar du rje mi tri'i mtshan can la bla ma 'di tha mal pa 69

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/zhig yin nam snyam pa'i log rtog mngon gyur skyes pa mi dran no/ / zhes gsungs pa ni legs tshogs thams cad kyi rtsa ba tshugs pa'i rten 'brel gyi thog ma shin tu 'gang che ba'i rnam thar zhig go / bka' chos grol nas gshag tu phebasam thag rang nyid kyis chu be+em khur nas chu blangs pas yon chab sogs phul te/ gnas tshang du mi mang skabs ri sul dben pa rer phebs nas khrid dmigs gang gnang la gshar sgom nan tan nyin bzhin ma chag pa gnang /de'ibar skabs su 'du khang sgor brkyang phyag mang du btsal ba dang lam rim chen mo sogs la gzigs rtog / gdan sa gsum gyi dge bshes mang la rags pa phebs 'dug par dogs gcod sogs chos kyi bya bas nyin mtshan khor yug tu 'da' ba byung / zhal nas/ chos nyan gyi ring la shes rgyud ma rung ba de 'jam nyal gyis 'gro zhing tshe 'di'i mngon zhen las blo log ste chos la 'dun pa cher 'gro bas/ 'di ga'i mu mthud na zur du ma bsgom yang gsung chos nyan pa rang gis lam rim gyi rtogs pa rgyud la skye'am snyam pa byung /spyir mtshan nyid kyi slob gnyer la shes 'dod che'ang / deng sang gi mtshan nyid pa 'ga' zhig gzhung don gal che shos kyi lam dang 'bras bu'i gnad rnams la rtog dpyod tsam yang ma zhugs par tshig gi zer lugs re'i steng nas rigs lam nyi tshe 'ba' zhig la mgo 'khor te shes tshad kha bshad du khyer ba las rgyud la sbyor ba'i nyams len thun gcig kyang mi byed cing / sangs rgyas la'ang 'khor gsum bskor chog snyam pa'i rang mthong can zhig tu gyur na phung tshab de las che ba mi 'dug / des na mnyam med jo bo chen pos/ tshe ni yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang / / tshe yi tshad kyang ci tsam mi shes pas/ /ngang bas chu las 'o ma len pa bzhin/ / rang gi 'dod pa dang du blang bar bya/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ slob gnyer rgya chen byed rgyu ma byung yang bla 70

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /ma'i drung nas lam gyi rim pa'i gnad 'gag rnams la sgro 'dogs legs par bcad de gang shes rgyud la sbyor ba zhig byung na de gas chog pa 'dug snyam pa byung / zhes gsungs/ de'i tshe thugs la ji ltar brnag pa bzhin nyams 'gur du bzhes pa ni/ mdo sngags legs bshad kyi gru char g.yo bas/ /bdag rgyud zhing sa ru dge ba'i lo tog / rgyas mdzad bshes gnyen gyi sprin chen de dag / dang ba'i yid mkha' ru rtag tu bsten no/ / deng dus dal 'byor gye gru chen rnyed kyang / / yon tan rin chen tshogs len pa dor nas/ / rmongs pa'i srin gling du rang gar 'khyams te/ / rang gi chos kyi srog 'dor ba mang yang / / kho bo sa mtha' ru skyes pa'i tshong phrug / dbus gtsang rin chen gyi gling 'dir 'ongs nas/ / bshes gnyen ded dpon gyi drin gyes bskyangs pas/ gdams ngag nor bu'i tshogs 'dod rgur blangs so/ / khyad par yongs rdzogs kyi lam gye rim pa'i/ / man ngag yid bzhin gyi nor bu thob byung / / da ni sgom sgrub kyi rgyal mtshan rtse mor/ / bkod de dngosagrub kyi char chen 'bebs so/ / deng dus bla chen dang ston chen 'di rnams/ / g.yo sgyu khram gsum gyi bya ba du mas/ / tshe 'di kho na la shi spar 'tham nas/ / 'jig rten khyim pa yi rnam thar 'dzin no/ / kho bos shes rab kyi mig gis bltas pas/ / 'jig rten phyi ma yi g.yang sa mthong nas/ / mtho risathar lam de tshol la zhugs shing / / dam pa'i rnam thar la smon gnas byas so/ / de 'dra'i rnam thar zhig zin pa byung na/ / 'jig rten stong 'ur gye grags pa med kyang / / blo chung kho bo ni de yis 'tshengs pas/ / rnyed bkur skal ba de gzhan la sbyin no/ / byams dang snying rje sogs theg chen chos skad/ / gzhan pham sdang tshig tu sgrogs pa'i dge bshes/ / kha zhe rgyab 'gal du song ba 'di rnams/ / bzang ngan gang du yang thag gcod dka'o/ / kho 71

/ /gung bangabastan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/bos de 'dra yi mkhas gral shor yang / / bla mas gang gsungs la yid ches byas nas/ / gang shes nyams len du sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus/ / blun po'i u tshugs shig byed 'dun mchis so/ / lung rigs dam chos kyi char ba phab kyang / / zhe rgyud gyong po 'di yan par bzhag na/ / dge sems myu gu de skye ba dka'abs/ / chos kyi gnad dga' zhig de na 'dug go / ha ha bla ma yi drin la brten nas/ / rang sems 'dul thabs kyi gnad cig thig byung / /da ni 'di snang gi 'khri ba bcad nas/ / gtan gyi 'dun ma zhig sgrub par smon no/ / phar ltos dpon po dang tshur ltos g.yog po/ / 'dul rgyu'i dgra bo dang skyong rgyu'i nye du/ / gang yang med pa yi dben gnas nyams dgar/ /gcig pur gnas dus shig nam zhig yong na/ / spang ljongs me tog gis phyogs kun khyab cing / / 'bab chu nags tshal gyis khor yug brgyan pa/ / bya dang ri dwags tshogs rtse dgas rol pa'i/ / dben gnas de 'dra zhig nam zhig 'grim na/ / shing drung brag phug sogs gang 'dod gnas su/ / lto gos 'tsho tsam gyi chog shes brten nas/ / rtse gcig ting 'dzin gyi ro mchog myang ba'i/ / skal bzang de 'dra zhig nam zhig thob na/ / bla ma mchog gsum gyi thugs rjes dgongs la/ / sprang po'i yid la ni brnag pa'i don 'di/ /gegs med smon pa bzhin myur du 'grub pa'i/ / byin rlabs dngos grub cig da lta stsol cig / ces pa 'di ni btsun gzugs snyoms las pa blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas rang gis sngar thos bsam byas pa gnad du song 'dug pa la dga' ba bsgom zhing / slar thos pa'i don de la sgrub pa snying por byed rgyu zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam du smon pa tshig gi lam du byas te glur blangs pa'o/ / zhes so/ / nyin gcig byams mgon bla ma rin po che tshogs dbur gdan drangs te 'byor bstun gyi dngos 'bul cung zad phul nas zhabs pad yun ring du 72

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /brtan pa'i gsol 'debs bla ma'i thugs rje dang slobama'i shes rgyud gnyis ka 'khul nus pa zhig zhus pas dgyes pa'i zhal bzhes bzang po mdzad/ lam rimagyi bka' chos grub pa'i mjug tu sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi gnyis kyi rim pas sems bskyed cho ga lam rim chen mo las 'byung ba bzhin gnang zhing sems bskyed pa'i phan yon rgyas par bka' stsal pas 'di lta bu'i skal ba bzang po nyams su myong ba snyam pa'i spro dga' tshad las 'das pa 'khrungs/skye ba 'di dang gzhan du sems bskyed mi nyams pa'i rgyu brgyad gsungs pa rnams cung zad kyang ma nyams par phyag len du 'debs par mdzad do/ /chos grol nyin gzim gshag tu mjal phyag zhus pas chos bshad sems la phan po e byung gsung bar/ sems la phan pa chen po byung bas slad mar yang bka' chos la yong chog pa zhu zhus par de ka mdzad pas chog / khyed rang lo gzhon kyang chos la 'dun pa che ba dang da res chos nyan skabs sems gzhan du migayeng bar rna ba gtod pa sogs chos nyan lugs yag po 'dug / blo skyed ci 'dra byung shod cig phebs pa la/ thar pa mi 'dod na der zad/'dod phyin byang chub lam rim las gzhan pa'i thar pa sgrub pa'i thabs mi 'dug snyam pa byung zhes zhus par/ 'o de go ba legs/ 'on kyang khyed gzhon nu'i dad pa glo bur yin pas 'gyur rkyen/ rtogs ldan kha chang dri thul le ba zhig gis nged kyi gdams pa 'di nub sgom na nub 'tshang rgya/ nang sgom na nang 'tshang rgya zer ba'i kha bo dpe med byed pa zhig thos na lam rim la zhen pa log nas kho'i rjes su 'jug srid pas/ chos zab zab gzhan la 'gram chu ma ldang bar lam rim 'di kho na la long bas glang mjug gi dpe bzhin 'jus nas ma shor ba zhig cis kyang mdzod/ ces sogs thugs la btags pa'i bslab bya gnad che ba mang po zhig bka' drin stsal/ blo skyed byung tshul 'di ni 73

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/gnad bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig tu snang ste/ snyan brgyud bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal nas kyang chos nyan pa la blo skyed len shes dgos/ sngon rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtshos lam rim chen mo gnang skabs 'phan po zhig chos nyan la yong ba phyir song dus blo skyed ci 'dra byung dris par/ blo skyed tshad med byung / rma'i bya mkhar zer ba de nga tsho'i lhun 'grub rdzong yin pa red zer ba'i dpe bzhin song na dgos pa ci'ang med/ chos nyan gnad du song na rgyal bu zla ba'i skyes rabs las gsungs pa bzhin rang gi sngar byas thams cad skyon du mthong nas phyin chad chos rnam dag cig ma gtogs bsam rgyu med pa zhig byung tshe blo skyed len tshul gnad du song ba yin/ zhes bka' chos skabs yang yang gsung gan 'dug pa dang dgongs pa gcig tu snang ngo / / lam rim gyi bka' chos grub nas mi ring bar rgyud stod smad kyi dge 'dun mang pos zhus ngor dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bka' srol kun gyi phyi mo lta bu grub chen lu i ba'i lugs kyi 'khor lo bde mchog gi smin byed bskyed rim dang / grol byed rdzogs rim gyi khrid zab mo brgyudaldan bla ma dam pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin gye sgyu lus mchod pa dang bcas nyin bco lnga'i bar smin rgyas su stsal pa legs par gsan/ slar 'bras spungs su phebs pa na 'dzin gra gtug pa'i skabs yin 'dug pas/ mi 'ga' zhig gis chos grwa 'grim pa gtso bo mi byed par ri khrod du chos nyan la yang yang 'gro ba 'di grwa tshang gi sgrig lam dang 'gal zhing yon tan mi yong ba'i rgyu yin/ der ma zad da cha 'dzin grwa gtug skabs 'dir khrom dmar nag gi dbus su bgro gleng gtong dgos pas rkang 'dren yod zer ba sogs chos nyan la phebs pa de yid la ma bab pa'i gtam cal col mang po nyid la zhus shing gzhan la'ang de skad zer mkhan du ma byung snang / de nas 'dzin grwa 74

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /gtugapa'i nyin dang po skyor dpon gyis bgro gleng btang pa ma song zhing khyab log kha shas bcad nas dam bca' pas phyir slog pa byung / de 'phros rje 'di bzhengs te rten 'brel gyi rtags kyis myu gu bden med du bsgrub pa'i tshe mtha' gnyis gcig car du sel tshul dang / mtshon bya don gyi dge 'dun nyi shu'i rnam gzhag sogs las brtsams te bgro gleng gnang bas/ mtshams shig nas khas len shor tshab che bas blo rtse stor nas gar 'gro 'dir 'gro med par gyur pa na ngas phur bu lcog gi brag gseb nas lung rigs 'di 'dra rnyed byung /khyed tsho gra sar ro nyal brgyab nas bsdad pa red yang zhes zhal pho mdzad pas sngar kha gtong mkhan rnams shin tu ngo gnong zhing / blo gzu bor gnas pa'i mkhas pa gzhan mtha' dag thu'u bkwan sprul pa'i sku'i rigs lam 'di 'dra'i go rgyu bzang la rno zhag che ba zhig nges par dka' ba 'dug ces bsngags pa'i me tog 'thor ba byung ste/ 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyes mdzad pa'i sdeb spyor gyi bstan bcos las/ mkhas pa la la mtsho bzhin ngang gis gang / / la la rgyal po'i bu bzhin lhun gyes grub/ / ces gsungs pa kho na bzhin du gyur to/ /shing slong gi nyin gnad chen gtong bas grwa pa rnams gleng kha sogs su bag yangs la 'gro bas de 'dra'i skabs/ klu 'bum pa sgom chung blo bzang don grub bya ba zhig bzhugs pa gzim gshag tu gdan drangs te dpe chos rin chen spungs pa dang be'u bum sngon mo rtsa 'grel/ 'gro mgon dpal yes mdzad pa'i blo sbyong snyan brgyud chen mo/ dkon mchog 'bangs kyi blo sbyong legs bshad kun 'dus/ byang sems rwa sgreng pas mdzad pa'i blo sbyong byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun/ hor ston nam mkha' dpal gyis mdzad pa'i blo sbyong nyi ma'i 'od zer/ 'dul 'dzin gyi gzhi gsum cho ga sogs bklag lung mang du gsan/ snyigs dus kyi chen por rlom pa 'ga' zhig che tshugs kho na rnam pa 75

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/kun tu mig gi 'bras bu bzhin bsrung ba'i stobs kyis chos nyan pa'i tshe'ang 'bangs las dpya khral len pa bzhin byed pa snang mod kyang / de ni chos nyan pa'i thog ma nyid nas chos dang rgyab 'gal du song ba'i ngan spyod tha shal du gzigs te/ chos gsan yul 'di ba spyir grwa rkyang dkyus ma zhig yin kyang chos kyi che bas khri la bzhugs su brtug nas rang nyid stan dma' bar 'khod de phyag la sogs pa chos nyan tshul rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dang mthun par mdzad/rje bla ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul pa'i sku rin po che'i drung nas chos nyan gyi thog mar sgrol dkar bka' bab dgu ldan gyi rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa/de'i yig rnying rnams kyi lung dang bcas pa gsan cing / de nas rim pas thugs brel gyi gseng bar rnams su sa lugs 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/'jam dbyangs dkar po ma ti'i lugs/ dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub rnams kyi rjes gnang so so'i yig cha rnams kyi lung dang bcas pa/dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa sgrub skor gyi lung bcas/ seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma dang sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang /spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa/ phyag rdor gtum po khyung lnga/ grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dpag med lha gcig bum gcig / tshe dpag med dkar po mi tra lugs/ shangs lugs rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ srad rgyud lugs kyi lo ma gyon ma gtso 'khor gsum ma/ 'phags lugs dzam lha ser po zhal phyag bco brgyad pa/ seng gdong ma gtso 'khor gsum ma/ bka' gdams lha bzhi sor 'brang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ sna tshogs yum/ khyung nag rnams kyi rjes gnang / so so'i sgrub thabs dang las tshogs gang yod kyi lung / dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i ye shes khyung khra'i rjes gnang / sngags 'chang gzungs pas bsgrigs pa'i de'i chos skor gye lung sogs dang / gzhan yang 76

༄7/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bklag lung thor bu ba mdza ba nisardo/ zla ba drug palimajug tsam la7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa 'bras spungs su chibs bsgyur gnang ba'i phebs bsur phyin/ gsol tshigs ra ba nas mjal phyag dang 'bras spungs bar du chibs rags kyi zhabs phyi zhus/ dga' ldan pho brang du phebs nas ja gral thog slob gnyer ci 'dra byed kyin yod pa'i bka' 'dri dang gsol ras sogs gnang / tshogs chen dang grwa tshang so so'i chos grwar phebs nas bgro gleng gsan pa ma gtogs sku 'khrugs bzhes tshul skabs la song bas gsung chos rgyas pa ma gnang yang lam rim chen mo/ rtsa shes ṭīka chen/ rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal/ legs bshad snying po rnams kyi dbu nas bklag lung thun re gnang ba rnams gsan/ sku zhang byams chen mkhan po bsod nams bkra shis kyis da res khyed kyis rgyal dbang rin po cher bsnyen bkur rgyas pa ma grub kyang / gsol ja bzhes 'bras shig zhus thog 'bul ba phran dang bcas bka' chos shigazhus na legs tshul nan tan byed pa bzhin bka' chos zhu 'dod nyid kyi thugs la'ang bzhed pa ha cang che rung / thams cad mkhyenapa sku khams cher mi dwangs pas zhu ma phod par gsol ja bzhes 'bras dang tshan grangs kha shas tsam phul/ zhal nas kyang / sngar mdo smad du yod dus rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa 'di labla ma rnam pa 'ga' zhig thugs mi mos pa'i rnam pa gnang gi yod pas g.yam la rgyugs lta bus mos gus de tsam ma byung yang / phyi nas zhal mjal zhing gsung thos pa dang lhag par ljags rtsom gyi legs bshad rnams mthong bas dad gus lhag par 'phel te/ phyis su sngar bsags kyi las ngan sbyong ched du bsams nas gsung 'bum rin po che tshang ma pe'i cing du rang gis rgyu rkyen sbyar te dpar du brko ba sogs bgyis pa yin gsungs/ skabs shig dge rgan rje 'jam dbyangs bla ma dang lhan cig 77

༄/ /gung nga yopa'izlaname'i gsu 'bum/par skyor mo lungaduphebs rjerinapoche 'i —shedzi khongamar khu bur skyu'i sgrub phugs sogs 'jal nas dpe mtshams mdzad/ bla ma mchog nas thal phreng gi yig cha blo 'dzin dga' rab byas 'dug pas re zhig de gas chog pa 'dug /grub mtha'i 'dod tshul shes pa gal che bas da res rje btsun pa'i grubamatha 'i yig cha tshang ma blo 'dzin gyis gsungs pa bzhin nyin kha shas kyis byang bar bzung nas sku mdun du rgyug phul pas thugs shin tu mnyes/ rje 'dini mkhyen rab nam mkha' ltar rgya che la shin tu brling ba gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig yong pa'i stobs kyis dge rgan 'jam dbyangs bla ma rin po che nas kyang rang bzhin pa'i dpe khrid lta bu khyab skor re gnyis kyi 'phen tshul 'dzin tshul slob pa tsam ma yin par/ bstan pa spyi'i gnad la nges pa skyed pa'i 'khrid tshul rlabs che ba kho na mdzad cing / khyad par du theg pa chen po'i sa lam gyi gnad ma tshang ba med par ston pa mdo sde rgyan dang de'i don 'grel chen po byang chub sems dpa'i sa gnyis sbyar te theg pa chen po'i sde snod ma lus pa nyams len du 'khyer ba'i tshul rtog ge pa phal gyis dpyod pa zur tsam yang ma zhugs pa'i man ngag gi gnad du ma gces nor bu la 'bogs pa bzhin du stsal pas thugs kyi bum bzang legs bshad kyi bdud rtsis yongs su gtams/ de skabs gsan pa'i don rnams ma bsnyel bar thugs la bcangs te phyi nas sa rgyan sbyar ba'i bshad pa theg chen lam bzang gsal ba'i nyi ma zhes sngon med legs bshad 'di nyid kyang bka' rtsom mdzad pa yin snang /sngar nas mkhyen rab 'gran zla med pa'i steng du yab sras gnyis 'dir phebs te thugs dam dang dpe khrid gnang ba nas bzung lhag par yang blo gros dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pas mdo sngags rig gnas kyi gzhung gang la'ang gzigs tsam nyid nas don gyi 'gang gshog cing phra zhib kyi dka' gnad mtha' dag 78

༄khya/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /rjen cher du 'char ba byung / sngon rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho la'ang kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes khyed skyor mo lung du song nas rje'i sgrub khang du mtshams shig gyis gsungs pa bzhin mdzad pa'i tshe mi nag po zhig gis ral gri phra rgyan zhig thugs gar bstem pa'i mnal lam byung ba nas bzung mkhyen pa'i gter rdol bar gsung pa dang rten 'brel gyi sgo shin tu mtshungs pas tshul 'di ni yab sras gnyis ka la yid ches khyad par can skyed pa'i dan rtags bla na med pa'o/ / de'i tshe rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi gnad la thos bsam rdoches thugs pa mdzad de/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi mkhyen rab ji ltar rgyas pa bzhin du nges 'byung skyo shas sogs kyang lhag par 'phel nas nyams mgur bzhes pa ni/ rje sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag / chos brgyad khri bzhi stong 'byung ba'i gnas/ / tshogs 'phags pa'i dbus na 'gran zla bral/ / pha ye shes dpal 'byor gtsug na rgyal/ / smad mdo khams phyogs kyi btsun pa nga / / sngon bsags pa'i las smon bzang po'i mthus/ /rten dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus thob/ / mjal dka' ba'i bstan dang bshes la mjal/ / rigs kun bdag rdo rje 'chang chen nyid/ / mi'i zol rten dpal ldan bla ma las/ / dbang rjes lung man ngag mang nyan pas/ / blo sbyong thabs cung zad shes tsam byung / / lo bcu bdun thog tu rkyen gyis bskul/ / gnas 'khor ba 'di la skyo ba skyes/ / nyes mang ldan pha yul nye du spangs/ / gnas dben par sgrub pa byed bsams nas/ / lo bcu dgu lon pa phag gi lor/ / lung rig pa'i rgya mtsho chen po la/ / khong mkhas mang ngang tshogs 'dus pa'i gnas/ / stod gangs ri'i rwa ba'i ljongs su phyin/ / lha jo shākya la sogs rten gsum mjal/ sna gnas khyad 'phags dpal ldan 'bras srungs su/ / skyabs dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po'i drung / / rgyu phar 79

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'isgoname'i gsung 'bum/phyin theg par slob gnyer byas/ / dus de tshe rang gzhan mang po yi/ / las bya byed spyod pa sna tshogs mthong / / sems shin tu skyo ba dang bcas pas /gnas dben par sgrub pa byed snyam shar/ / sngon dus su mi la ras pa des/ / tshe blos btang sgrub pa snying por byas/ / yun thung ngu tshe gcig lus gcig la/ / mchog sangs rgyas go 'phang mngon du mdzad/ / dus da lta phal cher snyan grags phyir/ / rang rgyud thog mi khel kha bshad kyi/ / sdig khong khro nga rgyal 'phel byas te/ / tshe phyi mar ngan 'gror nan gyis 'phen/ / nyin mtshan du 'bad nas chos sgrub kyang / / me 'bar ba'i nang du snum blug bzhin/ / nyon mongs pa'i grogs su 'gro ba yi/ / tshul 'di la bsam gyin gting nas skyo/ / rang bslab bya phra mo'ang mi bsrung bar/ / gzhan skye bo mchog dman thams cad la/ / smod tshig mda' drag po mang du 'phen/ /rang rgyud kyi dge rtsa lhag med 'joms/ / 'di bsam gyin chos kyi nyi ma bdag / rje mi la'i rnam thar snying nas dran/ / gnas dben pa'i ri khrod nyams dga' ru/ dus da lta song na dga' ba la/ / mi bdag gis nyams su blang bya'i tshes/ / rje rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi gnad/ / lta sgom dang spyod pa ma 'khrul ba/ / blo rab 'bring kun la phan pa'i chos/ / gzhung byang chub lam rim las lhag med/ / de tshul bzhin nyams su len nus na/ / tshig skam po kha bshad ma shes kyang / / dgra 'chi bdag sleb tshe 'gyod mi dgos/ /dus rgyun du tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong dang / / mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs pa dang / / rang sems la bya ra byed nus na/ / tshul de las mchog gyur nyams len gang / / rkyen gang byung byang chub lam bsgyur na/ / dgra na tsha sdug bsngal la sogs pa/ / rkyen bzang ngan gang zhig byung na yang / /dus kun tu yid bde 'ba' zhig 'byung / / tshe gcig la sangs rgyas thob byed 80

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /thabs/ / sngags bla med rim gnyis rnal 'byor la/ / 'bad nus na bdag la de nyid las/ / chos zab zab skad pa cang mi dgos/ / dus deng sang snyigs ma cher bdos pas/ / phar gzhan la phan par smras na yang / / tshur khon du 'dzin par byed pa la/ / snying brtse ba'i gros kyis ci zhig phan/ / rje rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin chen yang / / bstan 'dzin par rlom pa rnams kyis dkrugs/ /dus 'di ru bstan pa'i khur 'degs las/ / rang gcig pur zhe gyong btul na legs/ / rang sangs rgyas go 'phang thob pa'i tshe/ ma 'gro ba'i don yang de dus nus/ / khong sangs rgyas bstan pa'ang de tshe spel/ /don de phyir da lta rang mgo thon/ / rten dal 'byor thob pa shin tu dka'/ / tshe mi rtag nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra/ / dus de ring 'ang mi 'chi'i nges med pas/ / ches myur bar sgrub la gzhol bar rigs/ / sngon sdig ltung rgyal po'i mdzod tsam bsags/ / dus da lta'ang nyin bzhin ches mang bsogs/ / dge rnam dag sna gcig tsam ma grub/ / tshe phyi mar gar 'gro som dang kwa/ / gnas 'khor ba sdug bsngal rang bzhin las/ / dus myur du thar par 'dod na ni/ / da kha bshad rlung la ma skur bar/ / rang rgyud steng skor la nyams su longs/ / sngon byon pa'i skyes chen bgrang yas kyis/ / tshe hril por sgrub pa mdzad pa bzhin/ /mi bdag kyang dben pa'i ri sul du/ / chos tshul bzhin nyams su len par smon/ / mi gzhan gyi bya byed mang mthong nas/ / bdag rang gis rang la gros btab pa/ / 'dis rang dang gzhan la sman pa dang / / sgom sgrub brgyud bstan pa dar rgyas shog / ces pa'o/ /ston ga'i dus byams mgon bla ma rin po che nas byang chub bde lam gyi dmar khrid 'char can du gnang ba gsan par phur bu spyog tu phebs/ zhag bco lnga'i ring lung rigs man ngag gis brgyan pa'i nyams khrid shin tu rgyas pa bde 81

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'i sgronaḥ gsung 'bum/lam rang gi lugs bzhin smon 'jug gi sems bskyed stabs gcig tu 'bogs pa'i sems bskyed cho ga bcas gnang ba rnams legs par gsan cing / gsan pa de'ang thob blo tsam ma yin par rim pa bzhin du khrid dmigs skyong ba sogs khrid kyi mtshan nyid tshang nges pa sngar rgyun bzhin du mdzad/ bar chos gnyis dang dgun chos sogs su chos grwa 'chag med kyis thal phreng zur bkol kun la rtsod pa brdar sha chod nges dang / chos mtshams rnams su 'phags bod kyi gzhung chen mo du ma 'dzin skyor dang dpe gzigs sogs brtson pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bskyangs/ dgung lo nyer gcig pa me glang gi lor cho 'phrul smon lam skabs nyin re bzhin mchod mjal dang thugs smon rgya gang che gser gsos mchod 'bul sogs sngar lo bzhin gnang /dgung mo smon lam gra skor ba 'ga' zhig la dam bca' bzhengs te dri ma med pa'i lung rigs kyi 'phreng ba spel bas/ de nas bzung ste gdan sa gsum gyi mkhas pa mtha' dag rje 'di'i mkhyen rab kyi bsngags brjod phyogs kun tu sgrogs par gyur/ 7gong sa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus par thugs la skyo ngal chen po byung zhing gdung mjal du phebs te mchod thebs dngul srang lnga bcu sogs phul/ dbyid phur bu spyog gi bka' chos la phebs te sngar lo bzhin 'jam dpal zhal lung gi bka' khrid zab rgyas sems bskyed mchod pa bcas dang / rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid zab mo 'phags pa yab sras kyi man ngag gi gnad mtha' dag rjen cher du phyung ste gnang ba legs par gsan pas rgyud don man ngag gis 'grel tshul la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa brnyes/ snga sor mdo smad du bsnyen rdzogs gnang yang de skabs dgung lo bco brgyad las ma lon pas/ lo 'dir sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin grub 82

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /pa'i bste gnas phur bu lcog tu lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa yongs kyi mnga' bdag / bstan 'dzin mkhas pa mtha' dag gi gtsug gi nor bu/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i chos kyi rgyal tshab/ rje bla ma ngag dbang byams pa'i zhal snga nas kyis mkhan slob sbrags ma mdzad nas dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i gtso bo bsnyen rdzogs kye sdom pa rnam par dag pa bzhes te ngur smrig 'chang ba yongs kyi gtsug rgyan dam par gyur to/ / smras pa/ gnang bkag rlabs 'phreng rol pas mtshan pa chos 'dul yid bzhin rgya mtsho'i ngogs/ / ded dpon dpa' bo mi tris legs sbyar gsol bzhi'i las kyi gru bo che/ / nyes pa lnga bral phun tshogs rtse mo mthun pa'i rlung gis bskyod pa yis/ / yongs rdzogs bslab pa nor bu'i dpal thob thar pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgrengs/ / ston pa mchog de'i thugs kyi gces mdzod bstan pa'i snying po sde bzhi'i lung / / rtag gus spyor ba'i brtun pa ma snyigs rnam 'byed blo yis ji bzhin gzigs/ / de nyid sgrub pa snying por mdzad pas thub dbang chos kyi rgyal srid la/ / mngon par dbang bskur 'gro ba'i bla ma de yi zhabs rdul gtsug gis mchod/ / nges par 'byung ba ma la yar skyes kyi/ / tshul khrims phung po rdzogs pa'i tsan dan ljon/ / spong bdun yal ga'i khyon yangs bsil ba'i ngad/ / srid pa'i gdung ba 'phrog pa'i dpyid du 'bebs/ / bcas rang nyes pa'i sprin bral rnam par dag / ting 'dzin shes rab nyi zla'i 'od 'bar ba/ / gang thugs thun mong lam gyi kun gsal de/ / rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha yi lam yang yin/ / khyod sku ngur smrig rgyal mtshan gos kyis klubs/ / khyod gsung 'gag med chos dung dbyangs su sgogs/ / khyod thugs bum bzang zab lam bdud rtsis gtams/ / khyod zhabs pad+mo srid zhi'i gtsug na mdzes/ / zhes rigs dang 83

/ /gung thang bstanapa'isgroname'i gsung ཿma/dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum rmad du byung ba'i mdzad bzang 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal gyi cha tsam gtam du byas pa rtogs brjod pad+ma dkar po las bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes pa'i tshul gyi 'dab ma ste lnga pa'o/ /

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /༄༅/ / 'dab ma drug pa/ dbus 'gyur chos kyi zhing du gsan spyong mdzad pa'i tshul/dbyar ga ri bo dge 'phel du dpe mtshams gnang ste 'dzin skyor dang /bar mtshams kun tu lam rim blo sbyong sogs la yang yang gzigs nas thugs rgyud 'dul ba'i thabs kho na lhur bzhes/ zhal nas/ de dus dge 'phel du 'dug ring la gnas kyi khyad yin nam sems skyo shas shin tu che ba zhig byung zhing phyi rol gyi dngos po thams cad dang / khyad par du gtsang jo mo kha rag gi rtse mor sprin 'du gyes byed pa mthong res kyis bdag kyang 'di lta bu'i chos nyid do snyam du yang yang sems la 'char ba dang / da lta rang dben gnas shig tu phyin nas 'chi dus su mi 'gyod pa zhig byed rgyu byung na ci ma rung snyam du sems bzung yang mi thub pa'i tshod tsam byung / de dang mu mthud nas ri khrod cig 'grim rgyu byung na tshod tsam la dga' mo yong tshod du 'dug kyang bsod namasakyi bsags rgyab shin tu chung bas thog tu ma khel zhes gsungs te phyis kyang thugs 'grod yang yang gnang / ston ga'i dus do dam pa dang khang tshan 'dzin grwa sogs kyi gra ba du mas khyed bka' chos rang la rgyun du phebs pa 'di rtsod gra la gnod pa 'dug pas/ lo 'dir phur bu lcog tu ma phebs par chos grwa 'grim pa legs zhes sogs thabs sna tshogs kyis bshol btab kyang ma gsan par phur bu lcog tu bde lam gyi bka' chos la phebs pas lo re las lo re bzhin blo skyed je che dang thugs rgyud je 'khul gyes nyams rtogs dbyar mtsho bzhin du 'phel ba byung / de'i stobs kyis 'di snang gi mthun 'jug sogs 85

༄/ /gung b.lo pa'isgronaḥ gsung 'bum/'jig rten phyogs kyi gros 'debs rnams la thugs log cing 'di snang gi 'khri ba bcad de chos byang chub lam rim ma gtogs bsam rgyu med pa rnams la shin tu rjes su yi rang gis rang nyid kyang de 'dra ba zhig byed dgongs nas thugs kyi bzhed don mgur du bzhes pa ni/ phur lcogs dben pa yi gnas su/ /rang shong khang bu yi nang na/ / zog po tshul 'chos kyi skyal ba/ / de yis glu dbyangs 'di 'then no/ / deng sang 'jig rten gyi khams na/ / chos byed sgom chen las skyid pa/ / gang la bltas kyang ni mi 'dug / skyid pa'i spyid lugs shig bshad na/ / gang bsdad pha yul du 'dug cing / / su byams gnyen bshes su gda' la/ / 'dun ma gang byung gis chog pa'i/ / sems bde lus bde rnams skyid pa/ / dgra bo ma thul gyi sdug bsngal/ / nye 'brel ma 'khyongs kyi dogs pa/ /nor rdzas gsog srung gi sems khral/ / gang yang med pa rnams skyid pa/ / mthun 'jug ngo srung ni mi dgos/ / rang dbang rang nyid kyis bzung bas/ / ci byed ku yangs kyi yan pa/ / sna thag mgo dkris rnams skyid pa/ / lto gos srog 'tsho tsam ma gtogs/ / bzang dgu'i sred pa ni med pas/ / rtsol sgrub rnam g.yeng dang bral ba'i/ / 'dod chung chog shes rnams skyid pa/ / skyid sdug ji 'dra zhig byung yang / / sngon las 'bras bu ru shes nas/ / khengs dang zhum pa ni med pa'i/ / yid bde thag chod rnams skyid pa/ / le lan bdag 'dzin la bdas nas/ / 'bur 'joms ci thub la 'bad pas/ / 'khor ba rang zhig tu gtong ba'i/ /dpa' bo khrom gshog rnams skyid pa/ / chos kun rang bzhin gyis stong yang / / tha snyad 'thad pa ru shes nas/ / las 'bras tshul bzhin du byed pa'i/ / spyang grung 'ardzoms pa rnams skyed pa/ / 'gro drug pha ma yi don du/ / sangs rgyas thob phyir du brel nas/ / gsang sngags nye lam du zhugs 86

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /pa'i/ / pho rgod rnal 'byor rnams skyid pa/ / 'di 'dra'i skyid pa de dor nas/ / rang phung gzhan phung gi bya bas/ / 'di phyi gnyis med la spyor ba'i/ /snying rul bdag 'dra tsho sdug pa/ / bde ba chung ngu tsam ched du/ /sdig ltung ri rab tsam bsags nas/ / gtan du sdug bsngal la spyor ba'i/ /glen pa bdag 'dra tsho sdug pa/ / rnam dag nges 'byung ni med pas/ / srid pa'i bde ba la chags nas/ / 'khor ba mtha' med du gtong ba'i/ / 'dun ma gtan nyes 'di sdug pa/ / gang shar tshogs drug gi snang ba/ / 'khrul ba a 'thas su song bas/ / rten 'byung gnas tshul la rmongs pa'i/ / thar med gtan sdug 'di skyo ba/ / skyo shas glu dbyangs kyi char bas/ / rang sems byi'u de gsos kyang / / ngan goms bag chags kyi dbang gis/ / bya lam rjes med du btang ngo / / kye ho tshe phyed de thal lo/ / da ni blo sna de bstung nas/ / tshe lhag don ldan du 'gyur bar/ / bla ma dkon mchog rang mkhyen no/ / zhes pa'o/ / snga mo nas rje phur bu sbog pas dgung lo nyer gcig gi steng du bar chadache bar 'dug pas rim gro 'di dang 'di gyis zhes bka' lung phebs pa rnams bsgrubs kyang bka' gnang ltar tsha ba'i bskun gzhi shin tu shugs drag pa zhig gis btab nas zla ba gcig lhag tsam la bskungs/ zhabs phyi rnams kyis de dus dngos chas gang yod rim gror btang / lung bstan gnang bzhin pa thams cad la zhus pas phal che bas sku tshe la bar chad 'byung nyen che bar gsungs kyang / rje phur bu lcog pas mo bden na sku srog la skyon med ces gsung 'dug pa bzhin bsnyun las grol/ zhal nas/ grwa sa na yod dus tsha ba'i nad drag pos na nas 'chi la khad byung bar nga rang gi sems la ma shi na nad las thar ma thag ri khrod cig tu phyin nas sgrub pa rnam dag cig byed/gal te shi na blo gdeng gzhan ni med so thar gyi bslab pa ni ma nyams/ / bla ma 87

༄/ /gung tha bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/rnams dang dam tshig gi sel zhugs pa med/ gang du skye ba rje bla ma phur bu lcog pa nyid mkhyen snyam pa yang yang shar/ phan tshun du 'gro thub tsam gyi dus phur bu lcog tu phyin nas bla ma dang mjal bas thugs shin tu mnyes nas gsung mchid mang du gnang / khyad par du da reb kyi nad 'di dge ba'i bskul ma dang mi rtag pa ston pa'i slob dpon du shes par gyis la dge spyor la 'bungs zhes gsung ba snying la lcags gzer btab pa bzhin du gyur te/ de ma thag tu nged rang gi sems la da ni tshe'i lhag ma ci tsam yod pa mi shes pa 'dug /sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal yang de las lhag pa ston rgyu med pa'i gad mas pa zab mo 'di rnams thob nas rgyud la spyor ba'i nyams len zhig byed rgyu ma byung na shin tu phangs par 'dug pas/ mi gzhan dag gis ci zer kyang mgyogs par ri khrod cig tu 'gro dgos snyam du bsams nas ri bo dge 'phel/ rwa sgrengayang dgon/ 'ol kha chos lung gsum gang du song na legs pa rje grub pa'idabang phyug phur bu lcog pa de nyid la gsung brtag zhus par/ sgrub pa byed 'dod pa shin tu legs thog tu khel na rwa sgreng yang dgon bzang gsungs pa bzhin rwa sgreng yang dgon du 'gro rtsis byas yod skabs rgya nag nas skyabs mgonado rje 'chang lcang skya rin po che dbus gtsang du phebs rgyu'i gtam snyan thos pas ri khrod du 'gro ba bshol ba yin gsung / de nas mi ring bar lcang skya rdo rje 'chang rgya nag nas chibs bsgyur gnang bar/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul sku rin po che dang lhan du mi gro ru thog gi chab chen kha bar du chibs bsur phebs/ de nas zhag bab kyi sa sogs su bcar bzhugs lta bu gnang nas chos kyi gsung gleng mang du mdzad cing / khyad par du da skabs bod na bla ma sprul sku dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyad du 'phags pa ci 'dra yod so so'i gnas tshul dang bcas bka' 'dri zhib mo dang / nged snga sor 'ongs 88

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /skabs 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje dang bla ma byams pa sogs la gus po zhig byed rgyu ma byung / da cha 'jam dbyangs pa mi bzhugs 'dug pas bla ma byams pa dang mjal nas thugs yid gcig 'dres lta bu zhig byed bsam pa yod gsung / lha sar 'byor nas ma 'gyang bar nyid phur bu spyog tu phebs te lcang skya rin po ches gsungs tshul rnams bla ma la zhus pa na khong thugs mad/ da res nged kyang mi ring bar mjal phyag 'bul bar 'gro rtsis yod gsung / de nas nyin gcig rje phur bu spyog pa ched gtad kyis lcang skya rdo rje 'chang la mjal bar phebs pa na rdo rje 'chang nyid nas kyang rwa skor du phebs nas bsus te mnyam phyag dang khri gcig la bzhugs pa sogs bkur gzos che bar mdzad cing chos kyi gsung 'phros du ma dang phan tshun chos bka' du ma gsan res gnang rgyu'i gsung gleng mdzad/ rje phur bu lcog pa phyir phebs rjes su nyid lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gi mdun du phebs te da res byams 'jam dbyangs gnyis zhal 'dzom nas chos kyi bgro ba yun ring mdzad cing thugs rgyud kyi mkhyen brtse gnyis kyang gcig tu 'dres pa bka' drin che zhus par/ bzhad mo gnang ste 'dres so/ / legs par 'dres so/ / shin tu 'dres so/ / khyod phur bu lcog tubargyu gnas thabs yin no zhes brjod pa la/ bla ma byams pas legs so zhesagasungs pa de de bzhin du gyur ces rje 'di nyid kyis bla ma rnam gnyis thugs nang shin tu dag pa 'ong ba'i thabs la sgo du ma nas 'bad pa lhur bzhes pa mngon mkhyen gyis gzigs pa'i gsung phebs/ so ga'i dus ston byed po ma yin kyang / / khu byug dbyangs kyis mi rnams dga' byed na/ /mkha' mnyam dge mtshan mgron du 'gug byed pa'i/ / khyod gsung snying gi bdud rtsi cis ma yin/ / mdo sngags bshad sgrub nor bus yongs gtams pa/ / dge ldan ring lugs gser gye shing rta che/ / 'degs bzod bstan 89

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/pa'i rtsa lag 'khor lo zung / / dgongs pa gcig tu sbyor ba'i gzer bu bzhin/ / don ldan tshig ni gcig gis kyang / / mkhas pa'i bya ba byed pa ni/ / mtha' klas bstan 'gro'i don 'gyur ba'i/ / khyod gsung 'di ltar bdag gis khums/ / lcang skya rdo rje 'chang der bzhugs ring la bka' chos sogasanam yod kyi tshe phal cher bcar bzhugs lta bu mdzad nas ma chag par gsan/ de'ang lo snga phyir gsan pa'i skor rags rim tsam phyogs sdoms su bkod na 'phags lugs gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje/ lca yi pa'i lugasakyi dpal 'khor lo sdom pa/ dza ba ri pa'i lugs kyi dpal phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po/ rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa/ rnam snang mngon byang rnams kyi dbang / ri bo dge ldan pa'i zab chos srad rgyud lugs kyi khrid chen drug dang de'i steng du 'khor lo chen po'i byin rlabs bzhi ldan/'phokhrid gser gyi sgo 'byed gnyis bsnan pa'i smad rgyud lugs kyi khrid chen brgyad/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas mdzad pa'i rdo rje'i tshig sbram gye rnam bshad che chung gi steng nas zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi khrid thun mong ma yin pa dang / dpa' bo gcig pa dang sbyar ba'i zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi khrid/ lta khrid dang lam gtso'i bshad lung / bla mchod kyi khrid/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po/'jam dbyangs smra seng / bde mchog dkar po/ drag po sum dril/ rnam 'joms rnams kyi rjes gnang sogs mang du gsan/ yang rgyal sras sprul ba'isku dang rje 'di nyid rnam gnyis nas gsol ba nan cher btab ste gsan mkhan drag bsdus sum cu skor dang lhan du rnal 'byor dbang phyug dril bu pa'i lugs kyi dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lus dkyil gyi dbang chen dang / de'i bskyed rdzogs kyi dmar khrid dben sa dang srad rgyud gnyis kha'i snyan brgyud kyi chu bo gcig tu 'dres pa'i gdams pa zab mo mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud 90

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /gsang chen bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su 'gengs par mdzad/ rje nyid nas sger du zhus pa la'ang nyin bdun gye ring byang chub bde lam gyi dmar khrid/ khrid rgyun mang po'i dmigs rim gyi gnad gcig tu dril te myong ba 'don tshul zhal shes thun mong ma yin pa'i gnad du ma dang bcas pa/ ri bo dge ldan pa'i gser chos bla na med pa thun drug gi rnal 'byor gyi khrid/ thugs rje chen po'i bka' srol rnams kyi nang nas byin rlabs kyi 'jug pa myur zhing bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad tshang ba tshem bu pa'i lugs kyi dmar khrid/ glang ri thang pa'i blo sbyong tshig brgyad ma'i khrid shin tu rgyas pa/rdor sems yum bcas kyi rjes gnang rnams legs par gsan te gtang rag gi yon 'bul sogs kyang gya nom pa btegs/ thun drug gi rnal 'byor ni rig pa 'dzin pa mtha' dag gi nyams len gyi snying po rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam srol bla na med pa zhig yin pas paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi bar du khrid rgyun ma chad par byon yang / de nas rim gyis nyag je phrar song ste skabs der lcang skya rdo rje 'chang ma gtogs gzhan la mi bzhugs pa dang / rdor sems bskom bzlas kyang rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor mtha' dag gi sngon 'gror med mi rung yin kyang skabs der bod du rdor sems yum bcas kyi rjes su gnang ba'i rgyun chad yod pa thugs kyis ma bzod par zhus nas spel bar mdzad pa ni bstan pa kho na thugs la bcangs pa'i rnam thar dang rjes 'jug rnams la bka' drin gzhal du med par gyur to/ / khru i pa'i dbang gi skabs rje nyid kyi gsang mtshan la chos kyi rdo rje zhes 'dogs pa gnang nas ma brjed pa gyis gsungs shing / phyis pe'i cing du mjal skabs khyed kyi gsang mtshan la nged kyis bod du bde mchog gi dbang bskur dus dharma badz+ra zhes btags pa ma brjed dam zhes thugs nan cher mdzad kyin 'dug pa rten 'brel gyi gnad 91
