༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/khyad par can zhig yod pa yin snang ste 'og tu bshad par bya'o/ / lcang skya rin po che 'bras spungs su phebs skabs bsam blo khang tshan gyi rgyud khang du dkar spro zhus thog rje 'di pa dang hal ha dge bshes rgya mtsho gnyis kyis tshogs gleng mdzad par thugs dgyes pa chen po mdzad/ dgon lung mi tshan nas tshom du shing thog bzhes 'bras sogs kyi bsnyen bkur dang mjal kha zhus rjes tshom gyi bar thog tu rje nyid bzhugs pa'i khang chung du phebs/ dkar spro dang 'bul nod 'ga' zhig phul/ nang gtsang lugs kyis thugs bag phab nas yun ring por bzhugs te nyid la gsung 'phros du ma gnang zhing bka' blon mdo mkhar ba zhabs phyir yod pa la chos kyi 'bel gtam mang du mdzad/dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa stag lor lcang skya rdo rje 'chang dga' ldan du phebs pa'i zhabs phyir byon/ yar lam mtshal gung thang gi rten rnams mjal/ de nas 'brog ri chen por phyag babs te rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu snying por bzhugs pa'i gser gdung rin po che'i mdun du mchod pa rgya chen po phul/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang dang yab sras lhan du dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod rgyas par mdzad/ rje'i gzim chung dang mchod khang so sor yang rten rnams la zhib mjal mdzad de thugs smon rgya chen po gnang / tshur lam gnyan mgon phugs kyi mgon khang nang mar mjal te thugs dam bskar gso'i zhabs phyi zhus/ de nas yer ba lha rir phebs te gnas dang rten rnams la zhib tu mjal/ yab sras gnyis ka thugs shin tu spro ba'i nyams kyis gnas 'di 'dra zhig tu sgrub pa rnam par dag pa byed rgyu byung na ang zhes thugs smon mdzad cing / bka' gdams gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar las brtsams pa'i bka' mchid mang du 'phel/ de'i dge 'dun rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor thig le bcu drug gi dbang 92

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /rgyas par stsal pa legs par gsan/ de'ang rje nyid sngar mdo smad du bzhugs skabs mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar mo zhig gi bris thang gzigs pas skabs der thugs la dad pa shugs drag po rang shugs kyis skyes pa byung yang lha 'di yin pa'i gsal kha ma mkhyen/ phyis rje btsun ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sku yin par mkhyen kyang de'i chos skor sogs gsan bzhes kyi rtsol ba gnang rgyur ma song / skabs shig tu rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che nas mkha' spyod ma'i be'u bum gsar du bris pa ched gtad kyis rje 'di la zhu dag byed rgyu stsal pas/ zhib gzigs kyi sgo nas tshar gcig klog pa na ma rgyud spyi dang / khyad par dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi zab gnad thams cad 'dus shing phyi nang gi mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i man ngag sogs shin tu gsal zhing 'khyer bde bar gzigs nas sngon goms kyi bag chags yongs su sad de mos gus thun mong ma yin pa 'khrungs/ de'ang bla ma gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes kyi mthu dang ldan pas slob ma'i rgyud la brtags te snga ma'i sa lam gye bgrod pa'i mtshams nas khrid pa'i stobs kyis rtogs pa gong mar 'gro ba shin tu sla bar mdzod 'grel dang dpe chos sogs las gsungs pa bzhin/tshul 'di lta bu ni bla slob gnyi ga'i che ba rmad du byung ba 'don byed du snang /de nas 'di'i dbang dang man ngag rnams cha tshang ba zhig gsan nas rgya gar lha gcig gi tshul du 'di nyid lhag pa'i lha gcig pur 'dzin dgos pa 'dug snyam pa'i 'dun pa bzlog tu med pa 'khrungs/ thog mar 'di nyid kyi bris thang zhig bzhengs dgongs pa na sgo drung du lha bris pa e ba zhig gis thang ga zhig blu rgyu khyer yong ba zhal phyes pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sku thang du 'dug pas sngar las kyang thugs dad shugs drag tu song zhing thang sku de'ang gdan drangs yon sprod rag la mi de gar song cha med du gyur 'dug / rkyen 93

mi/ /gung bstan ba'isgronaḥ gsung 'bum/snga phyi kun gyi stobs kyis 'di'i dbang dang man ngag sogs chos skor rnams gsan bzhed skom pa chu tshol ba lta bur yod pas nyin gcig lcang skya rje 'chang gi drung du phebs te/ rje btsun ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i man ngag dang byin rlabs rnams brtse gzigs dgos tshul gsol ba btab par de sa lugs kyi man ngag yin pa la khyod kyis don gnyer byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin gsung /snga ma'i rgyu mtshan de rnams zhus pas zhal 'dzum pa mdzad de khyed kyi skye ba gong ma de'ang rnal 'byor ma la gtso bor thugs dam mdzad kyin yod kyang gsang shin tu dam pas nged rang ma gtogs gzhan gyis mi shes/ da gzhan gyis ma tshor ba gyis dang tshes bcu zhig dang dus bsgrigs nas byin rlabs dang khrid kyi skor rnams byed ces dgyes bzhin du zhal gyis bzhes/ rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyis spyir bde mchog yab yum gyi chos bka' su yin la mi gnang zhing / gal teganang na'ang lo dang zla ba'i bar du gsol ba yang yang 'debs dgos pa zhig yod pa la/ nyid kyis zhus ma thag zhal bzhes lhug par mdzad pa ni 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa'i bka' bab tu gzigs par nges so/ / de nas tshes bcu zhig la siju ra'i dkyil 'khor du bcom ldan 'das ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs zab mo smin rgyas su stsal/ de nas thugs brel gyi gsang bar rnams su nyid gcig pu la bla ma gong ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang sems 'dzin zung du 'jug pa'i sgo nas gsang chen slob bshad lugs kyi bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig dang rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma'i dmar khrid shin tu gsang ba'i zhal shes kyi gnad du mas brgyan pa dang / be'u bum khrod kyi chos tshan nyer mkho 'ga' zhig gi bklag lung bcas gdams pa cha tshang bar dgyes bzhin du stsal/ 'di dus khams nags shod nas rje tsong kha pa'i dngos slob mi dbang gtsug na mdzes 94

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /pa'iti shri gnyis kyi nang tshan ti thi dpal ldan don grub kyi sku'i skye ba rdo rje 'chang stag phu rin po che bka' chos mang po gsan rgyu'i don du lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gis gdan drangs te dbus su phebs yod pas/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che nas rje 'di nyid la khyed kyis chos bka' zab mo'i rigs don gnyer byed rgyu yin na rdo rje 'chang stag phu rin po che 'di gar chos sgo skyel du phebs pa'i skabs 'dir khong gi zhabs la gtugs na khong mdo sngags bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chen po yin/ khyad par du snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag yin pas cis kyang khong gi drung du chos nyan par song gsungs pas/ thog mar rdo rje 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor dang zhe dgu ma'i dbang gnang ba dang 'grigs nas gsan/ de rjes gnyan mgon stobs 'phrog nag po gdong bzhi pa'i rjes gnang man ngag gi skor rnams rje nyid kyis zhus par/ spyir na zhal 'di shin tu gnyan pas 'di'i chos bka' rnams mang po la byin gyin med rung da res khyed la ster gsungs nas rje nyid dang skal ldan gyi slob ma dam tshig can kha shas la rnam 'gyur bcu drug gi rjes gnang la gsum ma gtogs thams cad dang / be'u bum char chen gyi dkar chag ltar yongs rdzogs rnams gnang zhing / bram ze mngags gtad dang spog chog gi mgon po/ shis bstan pa'i mgon po'i rjes gnang rnams rje nyid bcas gsum kho na la gnang / snying thig ha la nag po'i be'u bum lo rer lan re las gnang srol med pas skyabs mgon lcang skya rin po cher 'bul skabs lhan du yong gsungs pa bzhin rjes sor lha sar bsam 'grub khang gsar du lcang skya rin po che dang lhan du gsan/ gzhan yang rnam sras bka' bcu drug gi dregs byed thun mong ma yin pa dang gsung mchog lus ngan po'i rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ lha bzhi dril sgrub/ bla mgon dbyer med/95

༄/ /gung bangabastan ba'ithonar+yā gsung 'bum/grib sel/ mkha' 'gro dbang sdud/ snying zhugs 'pho ba dang bcas pa/mchog grub pa'i rlung sgrub/ gtor chen thun mong ma yin pa'i khrid sogs mgon po phyag drug gi bka' khrid rgyud gang yod rnams dang / rig byed ma'i rjes gnang be'u bum gyi lung dang bcas pa/ bde mchog sngags btu'i rjes gnang bla ma 'jam dbyangs pa'i gsung gi skor gang yod kyi lung / dgra nag gshed dmar gnyis kyi dbang sogs zab rgyas kyi gdams pa'i bgo skal rgya cher bzhes/ mkha' spyod ma'i dbang khrid sogs sngar lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gi mdun du gsan zin pas 'thus pa gnang rtsis la nyin gcig lcang skya rdo rje 'chang nas stag phu rin po che ma rgyud kyi bdag po yin pas da dung mkha' spyod ma'i dbang khrid cha tshang ba zhig khong gi mdun nas kyang nyan na legs zhes bskul ma mdzad pa bzhin/ rdo rje 'chang stag phu rin po che'i mdun nas mkha' spyod ma'i byen rlabs/ rim gnyis kyi khrid/ be'u bum gyi lung dang bcas rdzogs par gsan/ stag phu rin po cher 'di'i chos bka' rnams zhu rtsisakyis lha sar phebs pa'i skabs su gnas tshang na dpe cha 'ga' zhig yod pa'i nang nas po ti gcig blangs te gzigs par mkha' spyod ma'i be'u bum yin 'dug pas/ rten 'brel rang 'grig tu byung ba la thugs shin tu dgyes nas dpe cha'i bdag po de la 'di nga la byin e chog gsung bar/ khos shin tu nas kyang rung zhes dga' bzhin du phul/ ji skad du/ legs pa'i cha la rten 'brel thams cad 'grig / phun sum tshogs pa rang gis byas pa yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar lan gcig ma yin par legs pa'i rten 'brel gyi rgyu tshogs mtha' dag yang yang bsgrub pa sngon du song ba'i stobs kyis sngar mkha'aspyod ma'i sku thang zhig gi rtsol ba gnang bzhed yod pa'i tshe de'i bris sku sgor skyel du byung ba dang / da res chos skor gsan rgyu'i thog mar be'u bum 96

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /gyi dpe rang 'grig tu phyag la byung ba ni nges pa'i don du yi dam lhas stsal pa kho na yin pas rjes sor rgya rdog zhabs drung blo bzang 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho sogs la 'di'i dbang gnang skabs/ mkha' spyod ma'i sku dang glegs bam nged rang gis phar 'tshol ma dgos par tshur btsal nas 'ongs pa yin zhes gsung 'dug / de ltar dpal he ru ka dang gnyis su med pa'i bshes gnyen 'khor lo'i mgon po du ma las 'di'i chos skor cha tshang ba gsan zhing gang gsan thams cad de ma thag nas phyag len du btab ste nyams len chig dril mdzad/ bla ma dam pa'i gsung rgyun dang rang gi nyams myong rgyud sde'i bshad srol mtha' dag gung bsgrigs pa'i steng nas mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi snying po mkha' spyod nye lam dang / zhal shes mkha' 'gro'i gsang gtam/sgrub thabs bde chen nye lam/ sgrub mchod rgyas pa sogs kyi yig cha mang po'ang bod du bzhugs ring der ljags rtsom mdzad/ phyis su lcang skya rdo rje 'chang nas rang gi zhal slob mkha' spyod ma'i byen rlabs rdo rje 'chang rang nyid las thob myong ba 'ga' zhig la'ang khyed tshos da dung yang mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs thu'u bkwan sprul sku las thob rgyu byung na legs zhes rje nyid las 'di'i byinazlabs len par gtong ba gnang ba'i tshul la dpag na sku 'phreng du mar 'brel ba'i sgos kyi lha skal dang chos skal du gyur pa zhig yin par mngon/der ma zad 'ja' klong 'khyil bar/ 'bras spungs su yod skabs nyin gcig gtsang sa skya nas 'ongs zer ba'i mi nag pa zhig gis sa skya nas khams pa bla mas khyed la bskur byung zer nas po ti zhig sprad byung ba zhal phyis nas bltas pas mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung ngag slob bshad kyi dpe yin par 'dug / mi de la rgyu mtshan 'dri dgos bsam de ma thag btsal pas gar song cha med/ spyi khang phyi nang steng 'og na grwa pa mang po 97

/ /gung bang ba7ba'izlanaḥ gsung 'bum/'dug pa la rtsad bcad pas/ mi de 'gro 'ong sus kyang ma mthong 'dug /rjes sor rtsad bcad pas/ sa skya na khams pa bla ma de 'dra'ang yod skad ma byung / phyis su paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa sku 'bum du bzhugs skabs rgyu mtshan zhus pas mi de sa skya'i chos skyong zhig yin nges gsung / gang ltar yang tshar chen bkra shis lhun por bzhugs skabs btsun ma'i rnam can zhig gis mkha'astod ma'i be'u bum phul ba dang rnam pa mtshungs pa 'dug ces gsungs pa'ang skabs 'di 'dra zhig tu byung ba'i tshod yin par 'dug pas/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho la rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bskul ma mdzad de/ rdo ring ba kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i drung du phebs nas sa skya'i bstan pa mtha' dag gi bdag por gyur ba bzhin/ rje nyid la'ang sku 'phreng snga mar dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i srog shing lta bur gyur pa'i dus kyi lha chos man ngag mtha' dag bdag gir bzhes te nyams len mdzad dgos pa'i don du snga ma'i yi dam chos srung rnams kyis bskul ma sgo du ma nas mdzad par gdon mi za'o/ /dbyar thog rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che brag g.yab sprul ba'i skus rwa stod du gdan drangs te bka' chos zhus skabs lhan du phebs te sgrub thabs rgya mtsho/ ba ri brgya rtsa/ snar thang brgya rtsa rnams kyi rjes gnang dang so so'i rgya gzhung gi lung / rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dug dbang / rwa pota/ mgon po'i be'u bum/ phreng ba skor gsum gyi rgya gzhung / 'grel pa don gsal/grol mchog gi khrid brgya/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba/ mdzod rtsa/ rigs tshogs drug / bzhi brgya pa/ byams chos sde lnga/ byang sa/ bslab spyod/ skyes tshoms/ rnam 'grel rtsa ba/ rnam nges/ rigs thig sogs kyi lngags lung dang / gzhan yang chos bka' mang du bka' drin stsal ba rnams legs par gsan/ ston phur bu spyog tu lam rim gyi bka' chos dang yi dam rdo rje 98

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /'jigasasted chen po'i bskyed rdzogs kyi dmar khrid rnams legs par gsan te khrid dmigs skyong ba sogs sngar rgyun bzhin mdzad/ de'i tshe mi rtag pa'i 'du shes shugs drag pos thugs rgyud rang dbang med par bskyod de nyams mgur gnang ba ni/ mi rtag 'chi ba kho mi sdod tshur tshur 'ong / / 'tsho ba'i tshe lhag de nyin bzhin phar phar bsnyegs/ / nyin gcig lus sems gnyis 'bralaba'i dus shig 'ong / / ngang tshul 'di la rang gting nas skyo ba la/ /gson rkyen phal cher yang 'chi ba'i rkyen du che/ / 'chi rkyen rlung dmar ltar 'tshub pa'i nang na gda'/ / tshe srog mar me ltar nyam chung 'jig sla bas/ /donub sang khom zhig yod dam blo ma bde/ / gar skye dkar nag gi las kyi gzhan dbang yin/ / phan pa'i dge ba yi las ni bdag la med/ / gnod pa'i sdig ltung gis rang rgyud gang nas 'dug / da ni ci rang drag bsam zhing yi re mug / dge sdig rnam dbye tsam shes pa'i rten 'dir yang / /bcas rang nyes ltung la 'dzem med spyod lugs la/ / sngon chad grangs med kyi sna tshogs lus blangs tshe/ / sdig ltung ri rab tsam bsags nas yod par nges/ / dmyal ba'i rgyu de ni sgrub tu zin 'dug pas/ / 'bras bu sdug bsngal de thog tu nam yong na/ / kye hud nyes can gyi mgon med skyabs med bdag / da ni ci rang drag bsam zhing mchi ma dku / bzod med ngan song gi sdug bsngal drag po dang / / da lta'i bde skyid du 'dzom pa'i tshe 'di'i bar/ / dbugs tsam gya gyu ba 'di las mi 'dug na/ / zhe blo bde mo rang 'dug pa phod 'di mtshar/ / dmyal ba ri mo ru bris pa mthong bas kyang / /'jigs 'jigs skrag skrag ltar snang na mngon sum du/ / rang gi lus sems kyi steng du bab pa'i tshe/ / sran tshugs bzod thabs shig yod dam a tsa ma/ /'di lta'i ngang tshul de sems la dran tsa na/ / blo sems bde mo zhig 99

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/yong ba mi 'dug kyang / / dga' dga' skyid skyid du mi tshe skyel mkhan rnams/ / nyin gcig 'gyod po zhig yong ba shes sam kye/ / sngar byung ma shi ba'i mi ni gcig ma byung / / rang la'ang 'chi med kyi rig 'dzin thob pa med/ / nyin gcig brang lag gnyis 'thab mo 'chor dogs yod/ / de bas da lta nas lam rgyag sgrub na legs/ / da res snying gtam 'di khyod kyis ma nyan par/ / sngar bzhin yal yol du stong par 'dug byed na/ / 'chor med zhags thogs kho nyin gcig slebs 'ong bas/ / de tshe 'gyod kyang ni bya thabs gangayang med/ / rang dang rang 'dra yi grogs po gzhan dag kyang / / rang la rang nyid kyis nges par snying brtse na/ / rang la rang gros su bsnyad 'di legs soms la/ / rang mgo rang nyid kyis thon thabs byas na legs/ /ces pa 'di'ang btsun gzugs blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas dben gnas phur bu lcog tu bris pa'o/ / zhes dang / yang rang la khrel bdas kyi tshul du nyes dmigs dmar 'byin gyi sgo nas gsung ba ni/ chos sku nam mkha' yi dbyings las/ / 'gog med gzugs sku yi nyi mas/ / 'azin las 'od zer 'bum 'gyed pas/ / 'gro ba'i blo mun kun sel mdzad/ / skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo/ / dgos 'dod kun 'byung gi nor bu/ / bka' drin 'khor med kyi bla ma/ / mi tri'i mtshan can la 'dud do/ / skyid dus mdza' grogs dang gnyen bshes/ / ngo 'dzum tshig 'jam can mang yang 'chi nad drag po yis thebs nas/ / ci bya gtol med la thug tshe/ / blo rtse gtad thub kyi skyabs gnas/ / bla ma mchog gsum las med cing / / dam pa'i lha chos las gzhan pa'i/ / phan nus gcig kyang ni mi 'dug / gshin rje chos rgyal gyi drung du/ / dge sdig dbye ba de 'byed kyi/ / spyang po'i kha mkhas kyi gtam dang / / tshig 'khri'i rtsod pa 'di mi 'gro/ / da lta'i byed spyod la 100

༄༅/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bltas na/ / phyi ma'i bde skyid kyi phyogs la/ / re ba cung zad kyang mi 'dug /dmyal bar ga le rang phebs dang / / khyod kyi thugs bskyed las grub pa'i/ / lcags kyi khang bzang gi nang du/ / khro chu khol ma yi mchod yon/ / rno ngar mtshon char gyi me tog / 'bar ba'i me lce yi snang gsal/ /tho lum me 'bar gyi zhal zas/ / mchod pa 'di dag kun bzhes la/ / dmyal srung 'khor tshogs kyi dbus su/ / sdug bsngal chos 'khor de bskor bzhin/ / 'khor ba ma stong bar bzhugs shig / de lta'i glu dbyangs 'di lto4dang / / tshig la ku re ltar yod kyang / / don ni gnas tshul rang yin pas/ / rang gi rgyud thog tu soms shig / ces pa'o/ / ston mjug la 'dul 'dzin dar rgyas rgya mtsho sogs 'khor kha shas dang bcas te/ glang thang / shar 'bum pa/ khams lung / sne'u zur sogs bka' gdams pa'i gdan sa rnams dang / dur khrod klu mo rgyal sogs la gnas mjal zhib par mdzad/ 'di dus sne'u zur du dpon g.yog rnams tsha bab gnang yod pa'i thog tu grub pa pho mo gnyis 'ongs par rgyun du de 'dra'i rigs la gsung gleng cher mi gnang yang / 'di res spro nyams chen pos thugs 'ur ba lta bu'i khong gnyis la bka' rgyud pa'i chos lugs kyi dri rmed sogs chos kyi gsung gleng mang po brag thog nas chu 'byo ba bzhin lhug par gnang ste ha cang 'gor bas/zhabs phyi rnams kyis khrog ma chung chung 'dis rgyun par nged dpon g.yog la'ang 'dang mi 'dang byed pa'i thog tu de ring grub pa gnyis kyang mdun du bsdad 'dug pas/ nga tshos yang bskyar ja gcig skol dgos rgyu yin nam zhes gleng yang ja des thams cad la rgyas par 'dang ba dang / gsol tshigs kyi sha cung zad cig yod pa des kyang thams cad la lto 'grang ba re za rgyu them pa byung bas 'khor rnams gcig gis gcig la de ci yin zhes mtshar du rtsi ba 101

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'i sgronaḥ gsung 'bum/byung / mtshams der nam mkha' la 'ja' sprin zhig 'thibs nas kha ba me togagi rnam pa can/ 'dab ma bdun brgyad re yod pa thor tsam zhig kyang babs/ slar 'bras srungs su phebs te mkha' spyod ma'i sku mtha' skor du dpa' bo dpa' mos tshogs 'khor byas shing / nam mkha' nas me tog gi char 'bab ba/ 'og tu gnas skor la phebs mkhan dpon g.yog rnams bsdad yod pa'i ri mo zhig phyag bris gnang ste/ kha byang du bya bral ba 'ga' zhig gnas skor du song bar sne'u zur nas nam mkha' la dpa' bo dpa' mos tshogs 'khor byas te me tog gi char bab pa zhes bkod nas gzim chung gi gyang logs su glan pa phyis mdo smad du phebs rjes wang zhabs drung gi nang du yod cesaganas skor du zhabs phyi zhu mi ser lding dka' bcu ngag dbang blo bzang sogs rgyu4yod 'ga' zhig gleng bas/ de skabs sku 'khor rnams kyi snang ba la grub pa pho mo rnams dang lhan du gsol tshigs byas pa ltar snang yang rje nyid kyi ye shes gzigs pa dag pa'i snang bar dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams dang lhan cig tu tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshim pa drug ldan du rol ba'i ngo mtshar bsam las 'das pa zhig byung bar snang ngo / / dgon lung gi wang zhabs drung ye shes dar rgyas grwa rkyang rnal ma'i tshul du slob gnyer la byon par las sne sogs la de dmigs bsal gtong rgyu'i zhal bkod dang mthun rkyen sbyor ba gnang ste dgon lung gi sprul sku che kha'i lugs kyis 'grig la zhugs/ de nas bzung ste rje nyid bod du bzhugs ring la bslab sbyangs mdzad tshul sogs kyi zhal ta gnang zhing zhabs drung rang yang sku mdun du bcar sdod lta bus phyag g.yog tshul bzhin zhus pas thugs zin pa byung / dgung lo nyer gsum pa yos lor rgyal dbang mchog gi yang srid thag gcod rgyu'i don la paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dbus su chibs bsgyur bar lcang skya rdo rje 'chang nas dpal dus kyi 102

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /'khor lo'i dbang zhu ba gnang ste/ dus phun sum tshogs pa ston pas rtsa rgyud gsungs pa'i dus chen nag zla'i nya dang sbyar te/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa 'phagasapa 'jigs rten dbang phyug gi pho brang chen po po ta lar/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa rgyud sdud pa por lung bstan pa rigs ldan dang po 'jam dpal grags pa de nyid slar yang ljongs 'dir ngur sprig 'chang ba'i zol gyis byon pa paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan ye shes dbang po nyid/ bden don rnam pa bcu gcig gi bdag nyid/ de nyid rnam pa bcu drug rig pa/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo dang mnyam par spyor ba'i bde chen rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i skur bzhengs te/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa lcangs thams cad mkhyen pa sogs gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu'i skyes chen bsam gyes mi khyab ba du ma dang lhan du/ chos phun sum tshogs pa rgyud sde gzhan dang bshad srol mi 'dra ba'i shing rta'i srol chen dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur zab mo sngon 'gro slob ma rjes 'dzin sta gon gyi rim pa dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i skor rnams dang / bskyed rim sgom pa'i snod rung du byed pa byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun/ rdzogs rim gyi snod rung du byed pa gong ma gong chen rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang dang bcas pa so so'i skabs su rgyud don lam gyi rim par bsgrigs tshul gyi gsung bshad 'byams klas padang sprags te rje yab sras kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag bzhes ji lta ba bzhin smin rgyas su grul pa legs par gsan pas thugs kyi bum bzang byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i zil mngar gyes yongs su gtams par gyur to/ /'di dus so shid dor ba maṇ+ḍal gye dbus nas gyen 'greng du bsdad pas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa thugs shin tu dgyes nas khyed kyis dus 'khor la 103

༄/ /gung ba napa'izlaname'i gsung ཿma/nyams len byas na legs po zhig 'ongs pa 'dug gsung / 'ja' klong 'khyil bar/ chung dus nas nyams snang la mun khrod du thig le dkar po shin tu che ba zhig gyen du 'gro ba dang thur du 'bab pa'i snang ba yang yang 'char ba lcang skya rin po ches nyams shig yin pa 'dug gsungs pa las dmigs bsal 'di yin ma gsungs/ bla ma 'ga' zhig gis khyed skye ba snga mar dus 'khor gye rdzogs rim spyor drug la goms pa zhig yin nam gsungs zhes 'byung ba dang snga phyi thams cad shin tu 'grig par snang ngo / / der ma zad gsang ba spyi rgyud dang 'phreng ba mkhan po/ shārnyi ba sogs rgyud dang grub chen du mas rtse mo steng du bltas na rig 'dzin gye dngos grub thob par gsungs la/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas kyang / rdo rje btsun mo'i thugs rjes ring nas bskyangs/ / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams dang snying thag nye/ / gsang lam bgrod pa'i cha rgyus mchis pa'i phyir/ / mkha' spyod rig 'dzin tshogs gral thob tu re/ / gsungs pa rnams 'phal kha bsgrigs na stabs legs tsam ma yin par mkha' spyod rig pa 'dzin pa'i go 'phang 'grub par dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas nyid kyis dngos su lung bstan par gdon mi za'o/ / nyin gcig po ta lar paṇa chen rin po che'imajal khar byon pas rje nyid gcig pu gzim khang nang mar sku mdun du rgyun ring tsam bzhugs bcug nas gsung 'phros mang du gnang zhing / khyed rang gis sgo mang chos grwa nas nged kyi mdun du drang nges rnam 'byed kyi dka' gnad las brtsams pa'i bgro gleng gtong ba de shin tu legs po byung / slar bkra shis lhun por cis kyang shog gsungs te thugs shin tu dgyes pa'i rnam pa mdzad/ skabs shig rje phur bu sngog pa rin po cher nyid kyi bka' 'bum gyi lung zhus par nged rang da lta mig mi gsal bas mi yong / 'brul mkhan chen la zhus pas chog gsungs pa ltar mkhan chen ye shes bstan sgon gyi zhal snga nas 104

༄/ / rje btsunazla bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung / las rje bla ma de nyid kyi gsung 'bum tshang ma'i bklag yung zhus/ rdo rje 'chang yangadagon pa'i drung nas rje btsun tā ra nā thas phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas gyi rjes gnang sum brgya dang gcig gi grangs ldan gsan/ 'di skabs gzhungs rin po che nas rtsang zhwa lu gser bkang gi gdan sa bskyang dgos kyi bka' rgya phebs/ lcang skya rin po cherami nus pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus kyang snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che'i gdan sa bskyangs rgyu byung ba skal ba bzang zhing rten 'brel gyi gnad kyang che bas phyin pa 'gab tshul gsungs pa ltar gdan sa 'dzin rgyu gnang / skyabs mgon lcang skya rin po che rgyal po'i bkas rgya nag tu chibs kha bsgyur du nye ba na rje 'dis rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid gser gyi rgyal khab tu phebs rgyu yin gshis re zhig zhal mjal ba e yong mi shis pas/ sngar rje bla ma nyid kyis ji ltar gsungs pa'i don rnams la sgrub pa byed tshul gye zhal gdams sems la bcang rgyu zhig thugs rjes gzigs dgos zhes gsol ba yang yang btab par brten/ sgrub pa snying por byed tshul gye bslab bya snying gi thig le zhes bya ba gnad mdor bsdus na/ thog mar bshes gnyen tshad ldan zhig tshul bzhin du bsten te sdom pa gsum gyi bcas mtshams legs par nyan nas tshul bzhin du bsrung ba gzhir byas/ de nas byang chub lam gye rim pa'i myong khrid sems 'dul ba gtso bor byas te bskyangs pas thos bsam gang byas thams cad de dang ngo 'phrod nas gzhung lugs gdams par 'char ba zhig 'byung / de'i tshe rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig la brten nas gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs dam sdom srog dang bsdos te bsrung bas dngos grub kyi rmang gzhi brtan par byas la/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i dkar chag tho'i yig chung bzhin spyir bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi nyams 105

༄/ /yo bangabayoba'ithonamo gsungar+yām/len ya ma bral ba dang / khyad par gsang bde gnyis kyi rgyud la zhib tu sbyangs nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa la mi 'phyugs pa'i gzer thebs pa zhig bya/ de nas 'di snang gi 'khri ba bcad de dam tshig gtsang ba'i grogs nyung shas dang lhan cig dben par sgrub pa la zhugs te lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa la rim gyis myong ba 'don lugs/ thun dang thun mtshamasakyi bya ba/ rgyun gyi kun spyod sogs mdor na phas bu la gdams pa bzhin chos tshul bzhin sgrub pa la med mi rung gi gnad gang che mtha' dag ma tshang ba med pa'i man ngag sil ma thugs kyi ze'u 'brur blugs/ bslab bya de nyid lcang skya rin po che'i rnam thar du 'god pa gnang 'dug pas 'dir mang gisadogs nas ma bris kyang mdo sngags kyi bstan pa'i gnad cha tshang ba lag len du thebs pa zhig byed pa la gal che nges su snang bas don gnyer can rnams kyis gzigs par 'tshal lo/ / de nas rje nyid gtsang phyogs su chibs bskyod yar lam rgyang rtse brgyud de dpal 'khor chos sde'i sku 'bum chen mo sogs la mchod mjal mdzad/ de nas bkra shis lhun por byon/ kun gzigs ye shes kyi nyi ma chen po paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mjal bar dgyes gzigs kyi spyan bskyangs bla na med pa mdzad/ sku mdun du bzhugs khri rgyab yol sogs bla chen lugs kyi gzos sgo shin tu che ba dang bzhugs ring la nyin re bzhin mjal kha zhus pa'i thog chos kyi bka' mchid mang du stsal/ thab gsol sogs spyi 'gro ltar gye steng du gsol thab rang nas kyang ja bur sogs rgyun chags su gnang / dngos 'byor gyi mchod sprin bstar te gsol ba btab par nyid dpon g.yog kha shas la sger du rdo rje 'jigasabyed chen po'i rgyud rtogs pa bdun pa'i lung / bkras lhun tshogs mang dang lhan du lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi bka' khrid lung rigs kyis 106

༄za/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /brgyan pa nyin gsum gyi bar du gnang ba legs par gsan/ thub dbang dang sgol ma'i sku brnyan/ mkhan chas cha tshang / spos snam bu sogs kyi gnang sbyin kyang bla med mdzad/ paṇa chen gong ma'i gser gdung gnyis dnganang rten rnams la zhib mjal zhus/ de nas snar thang dang lhun po rtse rnams la mjal zhing srad rgyud du phebs/ zhal nas/ srad rgyud du 'byor ma thag sus bshad mi shes par 'dul nag pa dpal ldan bzang po'i rnam 'phrul phebs 'dug ces gling du dril bsgrags te grwa pa thams cad 'ur zhog langs nas mjal khar 'dus shing / mkhan rin po ches gtsos pa'i rgyud pa'i tshogs pa la 'grel pa bzhi sbrags kyi mgo nas chos thun cig bshad pa byas pas 'chad nyan byed rgyu'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar yang de nas phye gsung /mkhan po bsam gtan rgya mtsho par gsang chos 'ga' zhig kyang gnang /sngar 'bras spungs su bzhugs skabs sa skya bdag chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kunadaga' blo gros lha sar phebs 'dug pa la gsang stabs kyis mjal kha zhu bar phebs dus gra rkyang dkyus ma'i rnam pa byas nas mjal mkhan gyi gra pa mang po'i grangs shig tu mngon chung gis phebs pa na sngar nga mkhyen pa med kyang mdun du mjal ma thag nas thugs 'dris che ba lta bu'i nyams dang bcas bka' 'dri mang tsam gnang zhing srung mdud dang bdud rtsi ril bu phon che ba stsal/ slar rgyal khab pe'i cing su phebs rgyu yin mod ces sngon dang phyis 'byung thams cad mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i gsung phebs par thugs dad chen po byung ba bzhin sa skya dgon chen du ched gtad kyis bdag chen rdo rje 'chang dang mjal bar phebs/ gdan sa gzigs tsam nyid nas thugs dad dang skyo ba 'dres ma zhig gis spyan chab lhug par 'chor ba byung zhing sa skya chen mo der sngar yun ring bzhugs myong ba lta bu'i bag chags kyi snang ba shar/107

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgoname'i gsung 'bum/bdag chen chab tshan du phebs pa dang thug pas nyin kha shas bzhugs ring sa skya'i rten gsum rnams la zhib mjal mdzad/ de nas mi ring bar bdag chen rdo rje 'chang phebs te mjal phrad mdzad skabs thugs dgyes tshor shin tu che ba dang bkur gzos bla na med pa gnang / rje btsun rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs zhus par deng sang nged kyis gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi sgrub mchod cig byed skabs yin pas thog mar 'jam rdor gyi dbang zhig bskur na 'jam rdor 'di sa skya'i yab chos yin pas rten 'brel gyi gnad cig yod gsung nas gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dbang nyin gnyis dang / mkha' spyod ma'i dbang nyin gcig la bka' drin stsal pa gsan te dngos 'byor gyi 'bul ba phon che tsam phul/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang nas bka' rgya legs par grol te bse mgon sogs nang rten khyad par ba thams cad kyi mjal kha'ang bzhed pa bzhin du gnang / sa skya'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gdan sa khyad par can rnams la mchod mjal dang thugs smon re mdzad na legs zhes bka' gnang ba bzhin kha'u brag rdzong du phebs/ gnyan mgon stobs 'phrog gdong bzhi pa la mchod gtor bskang gso rgyas par mdzad/bsam gling du dpal ldan lha mo rang byon sogs dang mjal/ tshur phebs skabs bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mkha' spyod ma'i sku brnyan tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gis mkhan chen gzhon nu blo gros la 'di rje btsun rnal 'byor ma dngos dang khyad par med pas khyed kyes thugs dam rten mdzod cig ces gnang zhing / de nas rim gyes bdag chen a mes drung gi phyag tu byung ste khong gis zhal byang btab pa gzhi thog bla brang gi nang rten du bzhugs pa de nyid dang rdo dril khyad 'phags 'gan sbyar sogs gnang skyes gya nom pa dang thugs nang nye ba'i bslab ston 'byung 'gyur gyi gsang lung du ma sogs bka' 108

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /drin tshad med pa bskyangs/ 'ja' klong 'khyil bar/ 'jam rdor gyi dbang ma zhus par gnang byung bas dga' dad bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / 'di dga'i dpag na kho bo skye ba snga ma mang por sa skya pa'i chos lugs la zhugs pa zhig yin pa 'dra bsam/ sa skyar 'dug ring bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis mthongagazos bdag rkyen bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnang zhing sa skya'i phyi nang gi rtenagasum thams cad la mchod mjal zhib tu zhus par bse mgon gyi zhal ras snum zhag che ba lta bu dang / bu tra'i bla mtsho'ang snum zhag yod pa lta bu mthong ba phyis su longs spyod 'byung ba'i ltas yin pa 'dug gsungs pa dang /bdag chen rin po ches byes 'gyur du e song gsung byung bar gar yod rgyus med pas 'gro ba ma byung zhus par/ der cis kyang 'gro dgos pa yin te rang re'i bla ma gong ma thams cad kyi sgrub gnas yin pa la gsung byung bas nged kyi bsam pa la/ nga rang dge lugs pa yin pa la bdag chen rin po ches rang re zhes gsungs pa ci yin nam snyam pa shar zhes gsungs mod kyang / sku 'phrengasnga ma mang po'i ngang tshul yab sras gnyis ga'i sgrib bral ye shes kyi me long ngos la ji lta ba bzhin shar ba'i ya mtshan gyi bkod pa mtha' yas pa zhig byung yod pa'i tshod du snang ngo / / de nas brag ram du grub thob 'dar 'phyar ba'i sku gdung dang beg tse'i sku byin rlabs can rnams la mjal/ rtag brtan phun tshogs gling du phebs mchod mjal zhib rgyas mdzad/ jo nang du mchod rten mthong grol chen mo mjal/ slar yang bkra shis lhun por phebs/paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen par thon phyag zhus sku brnyan dngul snam spos sogs gnang sbyin bzang po dang / paṇa chen rang gi dbu zhwa sne ring bzhes 'phro zhig phyag gis gnang ste 'phral phugs kyi zhal ta bslab bya'i rim pa rgyas par stsal/ rje nyid bkra shis lhun por bzhugs ring la gzim khang bkra shis 109

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'izlanalo ga4 'bum/bde legs su bzhugs pas de na bkra shis lhun po pa'i dpar dpon zhig 'dug pa nyin snga ma rnams la rje 'di par phyag 'tshal ba sogs mi byed pa la/nyinagacig gsol ja zhu rgyu khur 'ongs nas brkyang phyag mang tsam dang bcas dad gus shin tu che ba'i rnam pa byed kyin 'dug pas/ kho la de'i rgyu mtshan bka' 'dri gnang bar kha sang paṇa chen rin po ches nyid rang gi sku tshe sngon ma 'ga' zhig ngos 'dzin mdzad cing / khyad par du dkyil khang grwa tshang gi dpon slob che ge mo zhig gi sku'i skye ba yin gsung byung bas nged kyis de thos nas dang pa skyes pa yin zhes zhus/ de nas zhwa lur phebs zhwa lu pa'i chen po rnam gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i las sne rnams kyis bsu ba dang ngur sprig 'chang ba'i dge 'dun rnams kyis mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pas ser sbrengs/grong ba'i skye bo rnams kyis bro gzhas sogs bkur ste chen po dang bcas phebs te thog mar rgyan ging gi lha mo rdo rje rab brtan mar 'azin bcol nyer gtang gang rgyas mdzad cing de nas gdan sar phyag phab/ tshes grangs bzang por snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub kyis mdo dang rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i chos kye 'khor lo rgya cher bskor ba'i khri 'phang mthon por zhabs sen nye bar bkod/ de'i tshe bkra shis lhun po nas tshogs 'dus sde pa ched mngags kyis tshogs par mang 'gyed dang rje nyid la khri 'bul gzab rgyas/de mtshungs gzhis ka rtse nas kyang khri 'bul sogs rgya che ba bstar/ zhwa lur bzhugs skabs mkhan po snga ma rnams kyi mtshams khang zhig 'dug par rig byed lha mo'i sku thang man ngag bzhin rang gis phyag ris dang rab gnas mdzad de bsnyen mtshams gnad smin zhig dang mjug tu sbyin sreg dang bcas pa sgrub par mdzad/ snga sor stag phu rin po cher rig byed ma'i chos skor zhus skabs gnad yig gago'i chu rgyun steng nas dogs pa mang po zhus pa la khyed kyis de 110

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /tsam gnang mi dgos/ bsnyen pa dang sbyin sreg tsam gyis 'grub yong gsungs pa bzhin 'di'i sgrub pa gnang skabs 'bad rtsol cher ma dgos par dngos nyams ci rigs su byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan du ma ma 'gyang bar byung /bcad rgya grol nyin grub pa zhig gis ras yug me tog dmar po'i ri mo can zhig phul bas dbang sdud kyi rten 'brel legs par 'grigs/ phur bu spyog pa'i slob ma bya btang skal bzang chos dbang byon par rje phur bu spyog pa'i gsung 'bum gyi bklag lung gnang zhing khong la me tog bcud len gyi gdams pa zhus/ de nas ri sbugs su phebs rje btsun ma sgol ma'i bsnyen pa bdun mtshams shig mdzad par thugs dam shin tu 'phel ba byung / bu ston rin po che'i sku brnyan gsung 'byon ma dang mchod rten sogs ri mthil gyi gtsug lag khang so so'i rten rnams la zhib tu mjal zhing mchod sprin rgya cher spros te bstan 'gror sman pa'i thugs bskyed nan tan gnang / 'di lo zhwa lung ma te mchod pa'i lo yin pas stod gangs te se nas lho rtsa kong tshun chad kyi gnas chen thams cad du mi ma yin gyi mgron rnams ma te'i dus ston la skad gtong ba'i ched du rlung sems la dbang thob pa'i rtogs ldan pa zhig rdzong brda gnang /zhal nas/ ma he'i mchod pa'i skabs sngon gyi dus su g.yung ston rdo rje dpal dang / de rjes tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po dang / paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos rgyan rnams kyis ma he la bka' bsgo mdzad 'dug pa las gzhan pa'i gong sa lnga ba'i yongs 'dzin mkhan chen bsod mchog pa dang /mkhan chen 'jam dpal ba sogs kyis kyang bka' bsgo ma gnang 'dug /des na bdag lta bus dam pa gong ma de rnams dang 'gran par rlom pa ni byis pa gri khar rtse ba dang mtshungs pas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas nged la 'di lo zhwa lur ma te'i mchod pa'i skabs yin 'dug pas khyed rang zhwa lur bsdad 111

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'isgoname'i gsung 'bum/nas ma te'i bka' bsgo sogs byas na legs pa 'dug ces nan chags gsungs kyang mi nus pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus pa yin gsung / 'on kyang de ltar byed pa'i nyams rtogs kyi gdeng dang mi ldan pa zhig la paṇa chen snang ba mtha' yas kyis gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes kyis gzigs nas de ltar mi gsungs kyang / nyid nas sbas pa'i brtul zhugs lhur mdzad de gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i grags pa sogs la mi dgyes pas de lta ra ma gnang ba yin 'dug / de'i grwa rigs sbyin bdag thams cad kyis kyang gus 'dud lhur blangs te chos bka' thor bu sogs gang zhus kyi re ba 'bras ldan du mdzad/slar yang rgyang rtse brgyud de dbus su phebs/ 'di lo phar phyin ston mo'i skabs yin pas 'dzin grwa'i dge 'dun rnams la lnga mchod dus bzang gi bsnyen bkur gnang / lo snga phyi de dag tu bla ma dam pa rnams las bka' chos du ma gsan rgyu dang gtsang phyogs su phebs pa sogs kyis chos grwar rgyun chags su phebs pa ma byung zhing phar phyin ston mo'i dam bca' dang dus gtugs pas nyin bcu'i ring dpe mtshams mdzad de thal 'phreng zur bkol gyi yig cha kun la gzigs rtog zhib tu mdzad pa na gzhung gi mgo mjug cha tshang ba thugs la legs par nges pa byung / de'ang dper na sa 'dzin mthon po'i rtse mor phyin pa na ri phran dang klung thams cad gcig car mthong ba bzhin/gzhungagi brjod bya'i gnad mthar thug pa la go ba gting tshugs pa'i stobs kyis de'i yan lag thams cad la sgro 'dogs lhag ma med par chod de nges pa rnyed pa'i tshul 'di ni paṇ+ḍi ta sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhin lhag pa'i lhas byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'bras rtags kho na yin te/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas kyang /kho bo bod na yod dus 'chad rtsom dang gzhan la rtsod pa byed dgos pa gal che ba'i dus su rje phur bu spyog pas gnang ba'i 'jam dpal gyi gser thang zhig 112

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /yod pa de nyid bshams nas gsol ba btab pas byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma lan du mar byung ba yin zhes gsungs pa dang / de skabs dgon lung mi tshan gyi rab 'byams pa bzang po don grub zer ba'i rmi lam du rje 'di la 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i gser yig babs 'dug ces sngon nas dad pa yod med kyi grwa ba che phra thams cad 'ur langs nas mjal khar rgyug pas kho'ang mjal bar phyin/ mdun cog steng du gong ma'i gser yig yin khul gyi brgyad stong pa'i glegs bam gser bris shig 'dug pa'i yi ge rnams lngags kyis bldag nas yongasardzogs bzhes song ba zhig rmis 'dug pa ni rje bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dgongs don thugs su chud pa'i mtshan mar snang ngo / / de dang don mthun par dgun chos steng du dka' ram nas bsdus grwa'i bar gyi 'dzin grwa thams cad la dam bca' bzhag pa na phal cher zhig rtsod grwa thar chags su gnang rgyur ma song ba'i dbang gis gzhung mgo mjug cha mnyam zhig nges pa med 'gro snyam yang / bgro gleng gang nas btang ba thams cadal lan thogs pa med par gnang zhing gzhung gi go don dang rigs pa'i zhib cha gang thad nas khas blang shor ba gcig kyang ma byung bas thams cad ya mtshan du gyur te phal mo che zhig de lta bu'i mkhyen rab ces bsngags brjod byed la/ rtog dpyod can 'ga' zhig gis 'di mkhyen rab kyi stobs tsam ma yin par lhag pa'i lhas mngon sum du rjes su bzung ba zhig yin par the tshom mi 'dug ces gleng ba byung / de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ sngon goms mthu dang mkhyen gter byin rlabs kyis/ / chab dang mi ldan ngal brgya'i bye thang du/ /yun ring 'dren dka' sher phyin gru bo che/ / khyod thugs rgya mtsho'i klung der yud kyis bgrod/ / de tshe ltar snang rigs pa'i myur rtsal gyis/ / rang mthong ldan pa ka lan+ta ga'i tshogs/ / mkha' lding dbang po dal gyis gshegs pa'i 113

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/bshul/ / ma stogs ri mor bris bzhin cer gyis blta/ / kha cig rgyu med 'bras zhes rten 'byung la/ / log par lta ba rmongs pa'i 'chal gtam ste/ /tshe gcig tsam dang bskal brgyar goms pa gnyis/ / mtshungs min de nyid las 'bras mi bsru'i rtags/ / zhes kyang gtam du bya'o/ / dgung lo nyer bzhi pa lcags 'brug gi lor rje yab sras kyi gsung rab du ma dang lung rigs gter mdzod sogs dbu ma'i gzhung lugs rnams la zhib tu sbyangs pas zab mo'i don la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i sbobs pa brnyes/ rdo rje 'chang kun spangs pa ri pa'i drung nas byang chub lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung / 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang / 'jam lugs tshe dpag med lha lnga dang jo bo lugs kyi dzam lha 'brug zhon gyi rjes gnang rnams zhus shing / phar yang lcang skya rin po ches mdzad pa'i bde mchog lus dkyil gyi bskyed rim gtum mo'i khrid yig / mgon po snying zhugs kyi khrid yig sogs kyi bklag lung phul/'bras srungs su bzhugs ring la lung rjes gnang khrid kyi rim pa sogs snga phyir gnang ba rags bsdus tsam phyogs gcig tu bkod na/ mnga' ris dge bshes blo bzang sbyin pa/ bra nye dge bshes ngag dbang dge legs/ bis mdo dge bshes blo bzang chos dar/ bkra shis 'khyil ba dge bshes bsod nams grags pa/ thor god dge bshes blo bzang snyan grags/ rog shu'u dge bshes ngag dbang dpal bzang / ma thi dge bshes ngag dbang shes rab/ mdung nag dge bshes ye shes bstan 'dzin/ blo gling spom por kham pa dge bshes blo bzang ye shes sogs dge bshes dka' ram mang po dang /phur bu spyog gi ri khrod pa 'ga' zhig bcas don gnyer can brgya phrag brgal bar rje bla ma'i gsung gi snying po byang chub lam rim chen mo mtshan sum sprags kyi bshad lung dang byang chub bde lam gyi dmar khrid/ 'jam dpal zhal 114

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /lung gi khrid sogs lung rigs kyi spros pa 'byams mas shing myong steng du bskor bas rgyud 'khul nges par gnang ba na mkhas pa rnam dpyod can mtha' dag gi yidakyi brtan pa rang dbang med par phrogs te bsngags pa'i rol mo kun tu 'khrol ba byung / de nas 'phrin las kyi sgo phyes te bka' chos dang gsung rtsom zhu mkhan mang du byung ba so so'i mos pa bzhin bde lam gyi sngon 'gro kun mkhyen lam bzang dang 'jam dpal zhal lung gi sngon 'gro blo bzang zhal lung yang ljags rtsom gnang / chos nyan pa mang nyung ci rigs la ba ri brgya rtsa dang 'jam dbyangs chos skor/ mgon chen bcu gsum/ chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi/ dbyangs can ma dkar dmar/'jam dbyangs dkar mo/ rnam rgyal ma sogs kyi rjes gnang / tshe dpag grub rgyal lugs dang 'jam lugs kyi tshe dbang / paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi gsung 'bum nang tshan bka' rgya ma'i skor gye lung / nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang dang gcod khrid/ me tog bcud len gyi khrid/ nyams len la shin tu gzhol ba'i slob ma 'ga' zhig gis nan tan chen pos gsol pa yang yang btab par nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang dang bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid kyang tshar kha shas stsal/ gzhan yang mgon po'i drag po'i gtor chen thun mong ma yin pa bka' rgya can dang gcod kyi gdams pa thar pa'i sgo 'byed/ lam gye rim pa'i dmigs rnam yid la byed tshul gnad don gsal ba/ 'jam dbyangs smra seng yab yum gyi bsnyen yig / 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi bsnyen sgrub/ 'jam dbyangs zhi khro sprags sgrub/ 'jigs byed dang 'jam dbyangs dkar po sprags sgrub sogs don gnyer can so sos bskul ngor lhag lha du ma'i sgrub thabs/ lha dang bla ma'i gsol 'debs/ zhal gdams bslab bya sogs tshig don phun sum tshogs pa'i legs bshad kyi bka' rtsom 115

ro / /gung bang bstan pa'ithon 'i gsung 'bum/yang mang du mdzad/ zhal nas kyang / kho bo gra sa na yod dus dge bshes rnams la 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khrid cig rje phur bu lcog pa'i gsung sgros ji bzhinabaskyar bar brten chos zhu mkhan rim gyis je mang du song nas nyin re bzhin chos bshad ma chad pa lta bu byung / de dus kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi khrod du chos 'brel ma thob pa med cing de dag las deng sang dga' ldan gser khri dang / shar byang dang rgyud stod smad sogs kyi mkhan khrir phebs pa dang grwa tshang so so'i slob dpon mdzad pa'ang mang du byung zhing tshe blos btangagis ri khrod 'grim pa'ang mang du byung 'dug / bdag rang ngos nas dge bshes de dag la chos 'chad par 'os pa'i yon tan ci yang med kyang rang gi bla ma rnams la dam tshig gi sel ma zhugs pa de'i byin rlabs kho na yin par 'dug gsung / mnga' ri sprul sku rin po che nas kyang chos bka' 'ga' zhig dgos tshul gsungs pa'i bzhed pa bskang / de skabs sgo mang dpon slob rin po ches rje 'di la smon lam gye gra skor dgos tshul gsung nan yang yang phebs pa rje phur bu spyog pa la rgyu mtshan zhus par/ chos phyogs nas bsam na khyed rang gis thos bsam gnad smin mdzad 'dug pas/ da de'i don nyams len zhig mdzad rgyu byung na de gas chog pa 'dug / 'jig rten gyi phyogs nas bsams kyang khyed rang mtshan dang go sa sogs mtshan btags byas pas che ru 'gro rgyu ci yang med/ skal ba bzang tsam byed zer na sngar gsang phu'i dka' bcu mdzad 'dug pas rje tsong kha pas kyang gsang phur mtshan btags mdzad pa yin pas de gas chog pa 'dug / lhag par lha sa'i gra skor mdzad rgyu 'di la cung zad 'tshub pa'i nyams shig kyang 'dug / des na mtshan btags rang ma mdzad kyang chog pa 'dra zhes phebs pas mtshan btags kyi dgongs pa zhus/ bra nyi dge bshes ngag dbang dge legs rang 116

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /yul du pheb rtsis kyis rje nyid la gsung brtag zhus par/ nged kyi rmi lam du lha sa'i smon lam gye tshogs su grwa sa'i bla ma rnams bzhugs 'dug pa'i gral du khyod rang yang 'dug pa gsal bar rmis pas re zhig rang yul du ma phebs par bzhugs na dgos pa zhig yod pa 'dra gsung / phyis su khong sgo mang mkhan po gnang skabs gro tshang mkhan po la gsung 'phros kyi tshe nged la rgyal ba yab sras dang thu'u bkwan rin po cher dad pa khyad med/ de'i rgyu mtshan khong gi zhabs pad nas chos bka' 'ga' zhig nyan pa la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma mngon che ba byung / der ma zad nged sgo mang bla ma byed rgyu 'di'ang khong gis lung bstan pa yin zhes gsung 'dug cing dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i bsnyen sgrub bya tshul ngag gi 'dod 'jo'ang khong gis zhus te ljags rtsom mdzad pa yin snang / shar rtse mkhan po mnga' ris pa blo bzang sbyin pas kyang rje 'di nyid las zab chos mang po gsan nas nyams su bzhes par byin rlabasakyi mtshan ma byung tshul gzhan du ma la gsungs/ yang rje phur bu lcog pa'i slob ma blo bzang bstan rgyal zer ba'i khams pa zhig phur bu lhog rin po ches rje 'di la bsngags brjod mdzad pa thos pa'i rkyen gyis nyid la zab chos 'ga' zhig nyan pas lhag par yang mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob ste/ sgrub pa gang dubyed pa'i gnas tshun chad 'phral phugs legs nyes kyi bya ba thams cad rje 'di rang la blo rtse gtad cing / dben par song ste thos don sgrub pas nyams su len tshul gyi zhal gdams shig kyang bka' drin skyong dgos zhes gsol ba btab par bslab bya mdzad pa ni/ gnas 'khor ba'i phun tshogs thams cad la/ / yid gting nas log pa'i skyo shas kyis/ / chos sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa yi/ / khyod blo gsal bstan pa rgyal mtshan gyis/ / 'dir bsnyen bkur lha rdzas bcas springs shing / / tshe 'di phyi'i 'dun ma sgrub tshul gyi/ /117

༄/ /yo thang ba naba'isgronatsho gsung bum/gtam tshigs su spel ba dgos so zhes/ / gzugs yi ger bris nas bskur ba 'byor/ / dus deng sang rab byung thams cad kyes/ / chos thos bsam sgom pa yal bor nas/ / tshong zhing las bun skyed la sogs pa/ / dman khyim pa'i bya ba nyams len dus/ / tshe 'di snang 'khri ba kun bcad nas/ / mchog thar pa sgrub la rtse gcig tu/ / thugs brtson pas gzhol ba khyed rnams la/ /bdag snying gi khong nas yi rangs so/ / lar da dung ji srid 'tsho yi bar/ /gyong lto gos gnyis la legs bskur nas/ / rten dal 'byor snying po len pa la/ / khyod snying rus skyed cig bstan rgyal ba/ / gzhi dam sdom rtsa ltar yal bor nas/ /lam bskyed rdzogs bsgoms kyang don med yin/ / don de phyir bsrung sdom dag pa la/ / gnad dam par zungs shig bstan rgyal pa/ / lam thun mong rim par ma sbyangs par/ / dpal gsang sngags 'jug pa'i gnas med pas/ / chos byang chub lam gyi rim pa la/ / rgyud sngon du sbyongs shig bstan rgyal ba/ / rgyud kun slong ngan pa'i dbang gyur na/ / chos gang byas ngan 'gro'i rgyu yin pas/ /khyod nyams len gang byed byang sems kyi/ / rtsis zin par mdzod cig bstan rgyal pa/ / dus nyin bzhin dge ba gang byas kun/ /dpal rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyur bsngos shing / / de dmigs med lta bas rgyas btab na/ / dge 'dzad med 'phel lo bstan rgyal ba/ / lo zla ba re re tsam bsgom pas/ / rgyud gar yang phyin par mi 'gyur bas/ / yun tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms pa 'di/ / don gtso bo yin no bstan rgyal ba/ /'dir cung zad bsags pa'i dge ba yis/ / khyod sgrub pa gegs med mthar phyin cing / / gnas 'og min chos kyi pho brang der/ / dus myur du zhal 'dzom 'gyur bar smon/ / zhes pa'o/ / de nas khong gis kyang ji ltar gdams pa'i don rnams yid la bcangs nas ri spugs su sgrub pa sha stag 118

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /mdzad pas/ phyis zhwa lu ri mthil pa thams cad kyi mgon du gyur te rje 'di nyid dag zhing du phebs pa'i lo zla de'i nang du rje nyid las nyin kha shas kyi rjes nasakhong yang ya mtshan pa'i ltas dang bcas te sku 'das/ zhwa lu pa rnams kyis ri spugs su sku gdung mchod rten dang sku brnyan bzhengs nas mchod pa'i yul du bzhugs su gsol ba gu thi ngag dbang bstan 'phel sogs kyis dngos su mthong zhing rgyu mtshan khungs dag thos 'dug pas/ gnas 'og min chos kyi pho brang der/ / dus myur du zhal 'dzom 'gyur/ gsungs pa ni smon pa tsam ma yin par don dngos gnas su zhal gyis bzhes pa yin par snang ngo / / rje phur bu spyog pa dang lcang skya rdo rje 'chang stag phu rin po che sogs bla ma dam pa thams cad rje 'di nyid la thugs shin tu mnyes shing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bsngags brjod yang yang mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis khong rnams kyi slob ma la rje 'di'i'ang slob mar ma gyur pa med pa lta bu dang / gang chos nyan pa'i rigs la byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma re'ang ma byung ba med pa lta bu yin zhes tshe dngasgrub ba stoms pa'i spong ba pa chen po rog shu'u bla ma ngag dbang dpal bzang sogs rgyus yod rnams gleng / de'i tshe rje phur bu lcog pa'i mdun nas rgyun par bka' chos nyan pa'i slob ma 'ga' zhig gis rang yul du 'gro khar rje 'di nyid la yab sras khyed rnams kyis rgyun du stsal pa'i gdams pa'i snying po tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa zhig thugs rjes gzigs dgos zhes yang yang gsol ba btab ste gnang ba ni/ pha dran pas gdung sel mi tri'i mtshan/ /skyabs zla med bla ma snying dbus bzhugs/ / khyed thag ring 'gro ba'i mched grogs la/ / ngas ya mtshan glu yi rdzong 'di 'bul/ / rten dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus thob/ / rje sangs rgyas bstan la rab tu byung / / yul dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing 'dir 'ongs/ / mgon sangs rgyas dngos dang khyad med 119

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'isgonar+sā gsung 'bum/pa'i/ / dpal jo shāka la sogs rten gsum dang / / rje dam pa gong mas byin brlabs pa'i/ / dgon gdan sa sgrub gnas mang po dang / / khong dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde rnams mjal/ / rje sangs rgyas dngos 'dra du ma las/ / dbang rjes lung zab khrid man ngag thob/ / tshul 'di rnams legs par soms shig dang / / las skal ba bzang ngo bsod nams can/ / lar mdo smad yul du slebs pa nas/ / rgyud sred pa'i grong chog kho na dang / /nor gsog 'jog bun skyed gtong ba sogs/ / dman khyim pa'i bya pas ma 'da' bar/ / pha bla ma rnams kyis yang dang yang / / chos sgrub pa dgos tshul gsungs pa rnams/ / dus yang yang sems pas rgyud bskul te/ / lam cha tshang sgrub la 'bad par mdzod/ / grogs bya btang chos mthun rnams dang 'grogs/ / gnas 'du 'dzi med pa'i dben pa bsten/ / gyong lto gos gtam gsum la bskur nas/ / rgyud chos bzhin 'dul la 'bad par zhu/ /gzhi dam sdom mig 'bras lta bur srungs/ / chos dge spyor bya ba gang byed kun/ /rgyud kun slong sems bskyed rtsis zin cing / / mthar dmigs med rgyas btab rdzogs byang sngos/ / lha thugs rje chen po sgrub thag nye/ / gzungs yi ge drug ma byin rlabs che/ / las snyung gnas dka' thub sdig sbyong mchog /khyod 'di la 'bad na gtan du legs/ / mi mang po'i ngag la ma nyan par/ / blo snying brang dkon mchog gsum la gtod/ / gros dam pa'i gsung rab rnams la dris/ / rang dbang thang dkyus gsum rang gis zungs/ / dus deng sang ji tsam tshe ring yang / / lo drug cu bdun cu brgal ba med/ / rang tshe stod phal cher don med thal/ / 'di soms la sgom sgrub rem la gyis/ / dpe rang re lhan cig 'grogs 'grogs nas/ / dus de ring so sor bral te song / / tshul 'dis kyang mi rtag chos shig bstan/ / 'di 120

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /soms la lha chos myur du sgrubs/ / 'og ma gir lcags khang btsan po na/ /me tsha mo 'ur 'ur 'bar ba yod/ / rang de nang mi 'gro'i nges med pas/ /las dkar nag blang dor 'bad par 'tshal/ / lar khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'dir/ / gnas gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gzhi/ / khyed sdug bsngal gtan nas mi 'dod na/ / gnas 'di nas 'bros pa'i thabs shig tshol/ / kho bdag 'dzin sdug bsngal byed po yin/ / chos gnas lugs rtogs na de nyid bzlog / don de phyir thar pa thob 'dod na/ / chos lta khrid bsgom pa gnad du zungs/ / dpal don gnyis yongs rdzogs sangs rgyas ni/ / rgyud snying rje'i rtsa ba las 'khrungs pas/ / gzhan gces 'dzin lhag bsam rnam dag gis/ / rgyud byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed 'tshal/ /ches gsang ba mthar thug rdo rje'i theg / da ring por mi thogs nub 'gyur bas/ / dus da lta cung zad gnas pa 'dir/ / rang bgo skal ma chad pa zhig mdzod/ / lo zla res gar yang mi phyin pas/ / yun tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms pa dang / / rgyud rtogs pa 'og ma brtan byas nas/ / lam gong ma rim gyis slob par mdzod/ / gtam 'di ni chos kyi snying po ste/ / pha bla ma'i zhal las ngas thos nas/ / dbyangs tshigs su bcad par nye bar sdebs/ /'dis rang gzhan kun la phan thogs shog / ces pa 'di'ang slob ma 'ga' zhig gis yul phyogs su 'gro khar nan tan chen pos bskul te btsun gzugs blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas dben gnas phur bu lcog nas gdams pa'o/ / zhes pa ste/ mdor na gang gsung thams cad rgyud la phan tshab shin tu che bas zhu ba so sor gang 'tsham gyi bslab bya rgyas bsdus mang du stsal snang ngo / / sog po'i grwa ba dge phrug gnyis gling khar song ste chab zhugs byas pa'i tshe dge rgan 'damagating ring po zhig tu byeng nas nub la nye ba na/ dge phrug gis ji 121

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithonama'i gsung 'bum/ltar byas kyang 'then ma thub/ rgyun par rje 'di la shin tu dad pa zhig yin pas thabs gzhan ma rnyed par thu'u bkwan rin po che mkhyen zhes 'o dod bos pas/ de ma thag gang nas 'ong cha med pa'i btsun chung zhig 'ongs te skyon med ngas grogs byed ces 'dam nang nas bton/ de nas btsun chung yang ga shed cig tu yud kyis song ste de phyin chad mthong rgyu ma byung bas bla ma'i thugs rje yin par nges pa rnyed/ gro tshang mkhan po'i dpon po 'jam dbyangasanor bu zer ba nad drag po zhig gis btab nas rim gro sman dpyad gang gis kyang ma phan par 'chi la khad byung ba na rje nyid la skyabs 'jug zhus pas/ gyon pa lus la bkab pa zhig khyer shog gsungs pa bzhin phul bar lus sbyin gyi spyan dmigs mdzad pa tsam nas je bder gyur te mi ring bar nad las grol/ de dag gis mtshon bod du bzhugs ring la zad pa med pa'i chos kyi sbyin pas skal ldan rnams smin grol la bkod pa dang / mi 'jigs pa skyabasakyi sbyin pas nyam thag dbugs dbyung ba sogs kyi lo rgyus ngo mtshar ba mang du yod tshod 'dug kyang sa bon mi rnyed pas zhib cha ma nges so/ / ston mjug mdo smad nas bsu ba 'byor te/ sum pa mkhan rin po ches gtsos bla ma dge 'dun rnams kyis rje nyid rang yul du cis kyang 'byon dgos pa'i zhu ba nan chen gye yi ge phul ba na rje phur bu spyog pa rin po cher de'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas rang yul du byon na legs pa'i bka' babs par brten chibs kha bsgyur bar thag bcad/ sku 'khor rnams kyis der nyer bsngogs gang dgos gra bsgrigs kyi zhabs 'degs hur skyed zhus/ dgung lo nyer lnga pa lcags sbrul gyi lo mdo smad du 'byon par nye ba na/ gzhung sa rin po cher thon phyag zhus pa'i tshe bstan pa'i gsal byed yer ti ni no mon han zhes pa'i cho lo dang /tham ga che chung / na bza' nyer spyad/ dung / rgya gling / rta dar 'bob 122

༄༅/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /lcag sogs chen por 'os pa'i gzengs bstod rmad du byung ba dang sku brnyan li ma mang po snam spos sogs kyi gnang sbyin rgya chen po stsal/ 'di dus gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog gi sprul pa'i sku nges 'drongs thag chod zin kyang po ta lar ma phebs par snye thang du bzhugs pa la mjal khar phebs/ rje nyid kyi 'bul ba'i khrod nas dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal zhig yod pa phyag tu bzhes te sku rtsed kyi rnam pa mang po mdzad cing spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i snang brnyan zhig phyag gis gnang bas rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs byung dgongs nas spro dga' tshad med pa 'khrungs/ phur bu spyog tu byon nas rje bla ma byams pa rin po che nyid ri khrod pa'i tshogs dbur spyan drangs te dngos 'byor gyi 'bul ba dang bcas zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa'i gsol 'debs dang tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su 'dzin pa dang / sku tshe 'dir yang dben pa'i gnas su tshe blos btang gi sgrub pa rnam dag cig mdzad nus pa'i skyabs 'jug bcas zhus par/ thugs shin tu dgyes pa'i bsngags brjod dang bcas da khyed a mdor byon nas ri khrod du 'byon thub na shin tu legs/ gal te rgya nag phyogs su 'byon dgos byung tshe skyabs mgon lcang skya rin po che dang dgongs bstun gyis 7gong ma bdag po chen por chos srid kyi zhabs 'degs gang spyogs mdzod dang bstan 'gro la phan thogs pa yong 'gro/ de gnyis gang mdzad kyang bar chad kyi dbang du mi 'gro ba'i ched du dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs pa dang chos skyong rnams la 'azin bcol sogs yang yang mdzad pa gal che/ gzhan yang nor rdzas rgya chen po rnyed pa dang mtshan dang go sa mthon por gyur tshe zhen chags ma che bar 'chi ba mi rtag pa yang yang dran par mdzad cing nor rdzas rnams dge phyogs la gtong gang thub mdzod/ces sogs bslab bya mang du grul/ zhal nas kyang / de dus byams mgon 123

༄/ /gung ca bstanapa'i name'i gsung 'bum/bla ma rin po che sku na smin zhing rang nyid kyang thag ring por 'gro dgos la/lhag par rgya phyogs su 'gro dgos pa'i nyams shig gsungs pa sogs kyis sems khral tshad med pa byung / de skabs bla ma rin po che nas bslab bya gnang ba rnams phyis su bsam tshe ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i lung bstan 'ba' zhig tu 'dug gsung / slar thon phyag zhus pa'i tshe rje rang nyid kyi dbu paṇa dang dbu skra/ sku brnyan/ chos gos/ snam spos sogs kyi rdzong ba mdzad cingasngar gyi bslab bya byas pa rnams thugs nas nam yang ma brjed pa mdzod ces gsungs te shin tu brtse ba'i rnam pa mdzad/ nyid kyang bla ma dang 'bral ma phod pas spyan chab rang dbang med par 'chor bzhin du gzim gshag nas phyir thon/ phyag 'tshal sgang du slebs te bla ma dran pa'i gdung shugs kyis gtan nas phebs ma thub par yun ring bzhugs dgos byung zhing de nas thugs smon nan tan mdzad/ nyid rang yul du 'byon rgyu'i stabs grwa pa bgres gzhon du ma bar ma chad pa lta bu 'ongs te mjal zhing skyabs 'jug zhus pa rnams la so so'i khams dang 'tsham par nyams len dang thos bsam byed tshul sogs kyi bslab bya bka' drin stsal te kun tu dga' bar mdzad do/ /smras pa/ mkhyen rab khruk+ṣa'i ljon pa la chags pa'i/ / rtog ge'i rigs lam mngar ba'i 'bras bu mchog / zab gsang chos kyi ma dros mtshor bying bas/ / thub bstan yang snying 'dzam bu'i gser du grub/ / mdo sngags lam rim zung gi gom gcig gis/ / rgyal bstan 'dzin ma'i khyon kun gzhal ba na/ / phyogs ris gzhung dang gdams ngag ri klung rnams/ / so sor bgrod pa'i ngal ba ci la dgos/ / rol ba'i rdo rje gnub ston la sogs nyams len byin rlabs brgyud pa'i bka'/ / byams pa'i mtshan can sbas don rgya che'i lam gyi rim pa'i man ngag dang / / 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i zab lam gzhung 124

༄7/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /sogs bshes gnyen gdams pa'i chu rub kyis/ / gcig car dbang bskur khyod nyid gcig pu de dag kun gyi gdung 'tshob lags/ / chu gter mtshungs med dbus 'gyur klung nas mdo rgyud man ngag bcud 'dren pa/ / chu ldan zab mo dri med rigs pa'i klog phreng stong gi dra ba can/ / chu lha'i phyogs kyi sa 'dzin spo las thugs rje rlung gis bskyod pa yis/ / chu mthongs snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'gengs bzhin mdo smad sman gyi ljongs su chas/ / smra ngan kurdo'i phreng ba zum byed cing / / blo gsal thar 'dod pad+ma kha 'byed pa/ /ṭ+wāṃrdo hrū bzade ༷ dī didī /༷ didh+ri~X ༷/sdi ༵'i ma/tsho'i/ ༵༷dī dī rdo/ sdi dīzloṭ+wāṃ bye bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum rmad du byung ba'i mdzad bzang 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal gyi cha tsam gtam du byas pa rtogs brjod pad+ma dkar bo las/dbus 'gyur chos kyi zhing du bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi gnad la gsan spyong mdzad pa'i tshul gyi 'dab ma ste drug pa'o/ /125

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ / 'dab ma bdun pa/ pe cin du phebs shing don gnyis sbun gyis grub pa'i tshul/ de nas gzhung sa rin po ches gnang ba'i mkhan chas rnams sprad de 'bras spungs nas thon skabs rtse shod kyi sku tshab dang bka' blon so so'i mi/grwa tshang gi las sne dang khang tshan mi tshan gyi dge gnyer/ gzhan yang slob mar gyur pa'i dge bshes dka' ram dge tshul slong sogs dad mos kyis skyel mi drag zhan shin tu mang ba byung / rim gyis stod lung yangs pa can du 'byor/garma zhwa dmar sprul skus yangs pa can dgon par 'byon dgos tshul gsungs pa bzhin der phebs nas mjal phrad mdzad/ rje nyid kyis phar 'bul ba 'ga' zhig dang / tshur yang dre'u kha shas dang lam chas sogs 'bul bar mdzad/ de nas rim gyis phebs te 'bri chu'i khar 'byor nyin phyogs thams cad du na bun 'thibs pas phan tshun gyi ras gur sogs kyang mi mthong ba zhig byung / phyi nyin snga bar 'bri chu brgal nas phebs 'grul pa rjes ma 'ga' zhig gisaphyir bltas pas/ zhag sa der jag pa mang po zhig 'gro ba mthong yang skyon ma byung / rjes su thos par a drag rdza dmar gyi mi sum brgya tsam khong dpon g.yog la glags lta ba'i phyir 'ongs te zhag gnyis gsum du bsgugs kyang / phebs nyin sprug pas bsgribs nas ma mthong ba yin 'dug pas bla ma dang chos skyong gi thugs rjer mngon/ ba yan ha rar zhag shas bzhugs te mgon po phyag drug pa'i gtor chen zhig gnang / dpa' bo dur khrod bdag po la gtor ma zhig byas te rdza gseb tu sba bar mdzad/ lam bar du nyin 126

༄༅/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bzhin bya rog gnyis rjes su 'brangs te mtsho sngon po'i bar du yopa'adug cing phyis su phan tshun la phebs dus kyang bya rog gnyis rgyun ldan du rjes su 'brangs pa zhig yod pa ni srung mas 'phrin las sbrub pa'i mtshan mar snang / mtsho sngon po'i ru sne nas dpon po phyag rdor pe'i zi'i bsu mi mang tsam 'byor/ khong gi ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ dadi / ༵༷ r+shang ༷su na ༷ ༷ ༷ ñtsha / ṭ+wāṃ/ ༵ ༷dh+ri ༷zab ṭ+wāṃX ṭ+wāṃX /pa ma/༵ chen phebs nas phan tshun thugs yid shin tu spro bas gsung 'phros mang du mdzad/ de nas dgon lung pas thab bsu rim pa mang du zhus shing ngur sprig 'chang ba'i dge 'dun nyis stong tsam gyis ser sbrengs dang bcas chos sde chen po dgon lung du phyag phebs/ dgon sgrub sde mang po'i mtshams zhus pa dang dge 'dun mang gis mjal phyag zhus/ lcang skya bla brang dang sum pa bla brang dgon pa spyi sogs la gdan drangs nas gsar ston zhus/ tshogs par mang jadang rten 'gyed spyi 'jog tu skyes rabs so bzhi pa'i thang ga ri mo gser tshon gong gsham sogs phun sum tshogs pa gras mtshungs bco lnga phul/ bod nas yong mkhan tshos nyin gsum gyi ring dam bca' 'jog pa'i phyag srol bzhin rje nyid kyang rdo bcal du dam bca' bzhag / sum pa mkhan chen gyis kyang shing rta'i srol 'byed las brtsams pa'i bgro gleng mdzad/ blo rtags la khas len re gnyis shor ba tsam las gzhan dbu phar gyi khas len la shor tshab dngaganod byed 'gro ba ci'ang ma byung bas dge 'dun rnams chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i mos gus lhag par 'phel/ sum pa mkhan chen gyis sngar bod du phebs dus gtad gnyer mdzad yod pa bzhin khyed rang bla ma byams pa'i sku mdun nas lta khrid legs par gsan yod mod/ da res nged la bod nas phebasapa'i skyes gzhan mi dgos chos kyi skyes su lta khrid zhib rgyas shig gnang 127

༄/ /gung bang bstanaja'izlanayo gsung 'bum/dgos gsung nas sngon mjug gi maṇ+ḍal dang bcas tshul bzhin zhu ba gnang bar/ nyid nas lta ba'i gnad 'gag phra mo rnams thang mar brdal ba'i bshad pa smin rgyas su 'bul bar mdzad pas thugs yid lhag par tshim pa'i rnam pa dang bsngags brjod ches cher mdzad/ de nas mgyogs par ri khrod cig tu phebs rtsis gnang yod skabs dgon lung khri pa sum pa mkhan chen gyis khri 'jog pa mdzad/ las sne rnams kyis rje 'di la khri pa gnang dgos tshul nan cher zhus kyang ma gsan/ de rjes dge 'dun mang byon nas gsol ba btab kyang zhal bzhes ma mdzad/ de nas sum pa mkhan chen dge 'dun tshang ma dang bcas byon nas mkhan chen gyis chos 'brel gyi dam tshig la bkar ba'i gsung nan gnang zhing / dge 'dun tshang mas phyag dang bcas u tshugs mthar skyel gyi zhu ba phul bas mdzad thabs ma rnyed par zla ba kha shas shig khri 'dzin bdag gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes mdzad/ de nas mgo zla ba'i gza' skar tshes grangs bzang por chos kyi khri la zhabs zung nye bar bkod/tshogs su mang ja dang ser skya thams cad la ston mo gya nom pas tshim par byas/sum pa mkhan chen gyi bston pa bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byon cing bstan pa dar ba dang gtad rabs bdun sogs rgya gar dang bod du bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad tshul/ khyad par du chos sde chen po de nyid ji ltar chags pa dang mkhan brgyud rim byon gyi lo rgyusadang bcas pa'i 'phror/ da ni rje btsun dam pa nyid rang gi skabs su babs pa yin pas 'chad nyan gyi gtsos pa'i bstan pa'i bya ba bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas rgya gang che mdzad dgos tshul sogs rgyas par gsungs te bca' yig chen mo phyag tu sprod par mdzad/ nyid nas kyang de dang bab mtshungs pa'i bka' lan nor bu'i phreng ba lta bu'i lhug par stsal pas dpon 128

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /slob thams cad kyang yid rangs par byed/ zhal nas/ nged kyi skye ba gong ma de yang dgung lo nyer lnga'i steng dgon lung gi khrir bzhugs 'dug cing /nged rang yang nyer lnga'i steng khrir 'khod pa ma bsgrigs rang 'grigs kyi rten 'brel bzang po 'grigs/ snga sor sum pa mkhan chen gyi thugs rmis shig la nged rang gis gos zla gam lta bu brtsegs ma bdun gyi 'og tu chos gos shig gyon 'dug pa mis/ de nas lo brgyad kyi mtshams su khyod kyis bstan pa'i bya ba zhig byed rgyu yong ba 'dra zhes gsung bar/ dus de nas brtsis pa'i lo brgyad pa de nged rang dgon lung gi khrir bsdad pa'i lo yin 'dug pas dgon pa'i khri bdag byed rgyu'i ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i gsung du gda' zhes gsungs/lo mjug tu bar skabs shig la sum pa mkhan rin po ches 'di lo nged kyi bla brang du 'tshub che ba zhig 'dug pas khyed kyis drag po'i sbyin sreg cig gnang dgos zhus par bla ma'i zhabs brtan du 'gyur na rang la gnod kyang bzod dgongs te mgon po phyag drug pa'i sbyin sreg gnad smin zhig mdzad/ de dus ligo dgug gzhug gi tshe phyogs du ma nas rlung 'tshub mang du 'ongs pa thag nyer sleb tshe rim gyis je chung du song nas 'brub khung du sib sib zhugs 'gro ba mthong bas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur/ mkhan rin po che'i sku gegs nye bar zhi ba'i mtshan ltas legs lam che ba byung yang drag las kyi lhong lta bus rje nyid kyi phyag mdzod ye shes don grub 'du phung ma bde bar yod pa de ma thag nad bab byu ru song ste ma 'tsho bas/ dang por thugs khral che tsam mdzad kyang da res 'di bla ma'i sku glud du song ba yin pas rang gar shi ba dang mi 'dra skal ba bzang gsungs te thugs gso bar mdzad pa ni dam pa'i khyad chos bla na med pa'o/ / gro tshang grag zhabs drung dpon g.yog mjal bar phebs/ khong gi bzhed mos lhar bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dang rjes gnang 'ga' zhig gnang 129

༄/ /gung ba bstan ba'izlanapo gsung 'bum/ste thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i gsung gleng 'phel/ zhal dkar yu ring legs pa shing thog gi ri mo can bcud bzang pos bkang ste phul ba rten 'brel gyi khyad du dgongs nas mgon khang phugs su 'jog pa mdzad/ byin rten 'gang che'i rigs dang spug ser po'i sgom zhwa legs pa gcig bcas gnang /dgung lo nyer drug pa chu rta'i gnam lo gsar tshes kyi tho rangs dgon pa'i 'grig lam 'char can bzhin 'du khang steng du dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i mchod gtor shin tu rgyas pa 'dod khams dbang mo 'jig rten du rgyu zhing gshegs pa'i dus tshes khyad par can dang bsgrigs pa'i tshes gtor ram gshegs gtor du grags pa phyag len ji lta ba bzhin du 'bul ba gnang /thub bstan spyi dang dgon pa'i 'chad nyan 'phel rgyas kyi don du 'azin las 'chol ba'i spyan dmigs nan tan mdzad/ de nas tshogs su phebs te lugs srol bzhin dge bskos gsar pa bsko bzhag dang tshig bkra legs pa'i tshogs gtam mdor bsdus shig stsal te tshogs mang la mjal kha gnang /tshes gsum nas smon lam tshugs pas nyin bzhin gsung chos la skyes rabs so bzhi pa'i bshad pa rgyal sras kyi spyod pa spyi'i khogs phubs shing de nyid gdul bya'i nyams len du khyer te lam rim dang sbyar bas blo 'khul ba/ sgra don gye rgyan gyi khyad par dang rig byed dang 'brel ba'i gtam rgyud sogs kyis zur phyin pa'i bshad pa rnam dpyod can rnams yid mchog tu mgu bar byed pa'i legs bshad kyi dga' ston stsal/ smon lam la bde smon dang bstan 'bar ma sogs phyag bzhes bzhin dang rgyal sras gong mas mdzad pa'i bca' yig chen mo klog ba'i steng nas chos khrims kyi tshogs gtam zhib rgyas rno zhing bajid chags pa 'grig lam nyam chag tu gyur pa'i rigs la dmigs phug pa'i gsung nan dang bcas stsal/ tshes brgyad kyi nyin byams sku bkram pa dang bcu 130

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bzhi'i nyin lcags mkhar chen mo brdebs pa dang / de dag gi skabs kyi 'cham sogs gang ci nas tshad ldan gra 'grigs pa byung bar thugs mnyes tshor mdzad/ smon lam grol nas chos grwa pa'i mtshan tho gsar du bsgrigs/ sku dngos kyis gzigs rtog zhib mo gnang ste gzhon pa gang yin chos grwar ming yig bris/ bar chos skabs nas bzung chos grwar thugs brtson chen pos ma chad pa byas te phebs/ brtsi bzhag snga sor dpe thog nas gnang gi yod kyang rje nyid kyis bca' yig bzhin thugs thog nas gtong ba gnang / zhal nas kyang / de dus las sne phal che bas 'grig lam sogs la ci yang mi sems par rang nyid mi rang bzhin bzang po yin zer ba'i ming tsam la zhig thob pa 'bad pa byed 'dug pa/ spyir na lhan pa ser po 'chang pa yan chad la dge 'dun dkon mchog dngos kyi 'du shes kyi dag snang dgos mod kyang /sems dge ba la nyes pa med gsungs pa ltar 'grig lam dang thos bsam rgyas pa'i ched du bsams te phyi'i rnam 'gyur gyis cung zad tsub mo byas pa nyes pa med dam snyam nas 'grig khrims dang 'gal ba byed pa tshor rtsad gcod dang tshul mthun byed pa rnams la gzengs bstod gang thub byas pa yin gsungs te/'di ni gnas skabs kyi bzang po'i grags pa tsam la mi ltos par/ skye dgu'i phan bde sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / de dge 'dun gyi sde/ de 'grig lam 'chad nyan sogs la rag las par gzigs te bstan pa kho na thugs la bcangs shing pha rol po de dag gis kyang gtan 'dun mi 'phyugs pa'i phyir rjes su brtse ba kho na'i dbang du gyur pa yin pas/ 'di ni chos 'dul ba las nan tur lnga dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa las tshar bcad pa'i rim pa gsum la sogs pa gsungs pa bzhin gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs mkhas kyi rnam par thar pa'o/ / snga sor 'chad nyan la bar chad shin tu che ba 131

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'i sgron 'i gsung 'bum/yong gin yod pas de zhi ba'i ched du rje nyid nas yungs gar gyi sbyin sreg khri tsho gcig / mgon po phyag drug pa'i drag po'i sbyin sreg rnams tshad ldan sgrub par mdzad/ de'i mthus rje nyid khri 'dzin bdag mdzad ring la chos grwa pa rnams la bar chad gtan nas ma byung zhing chos 'chad nyan sogs shin tu 'phel ba snga phyir de 'dra ma byung ba'i tshod lta bu yin par mngon te/ phyis su dgon sgrub sde rnams kyi bla mar thon pa'i dgon lung rang gi dge bshes rnams de dus rje nyid khrir bzhugs pa'i dus kyi gra thog kho na yin par 'dug ces rgyus yod rnams mthun par gleng / de nas chos thog thams cad la brtsi bzhag 'chag med dang gzhung gi dka' gnad so sor dogs slong / rang rang gi blo tshod dang 'tsham pa'i dpe 'dzin dang skyor sbyangs byed tshul tha na rtags gsal 'phen lugs tshun chad zhib tu bslabs te thugs khur tshad med pa'i sgo nas bskyangs pas rtsod gra shin tu dmar ba byung / don gnyer ba mang po la byang chub bde lam gyi dmar khrid zhag bco lnga'i bar du rje phur bu sbog pa'iphyag len dang gsung sgros ji lta ba bzhin gnang ste thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i chos kyi gan mdzod phye bas chos nyan mkhan rnams la sa lam gyi 'gang 'chun pa'i blo skyed che ba dang zhen log skyo shas kyi snang bas yid shin tu 'khul ba byung zhing / sems bskyed mchod pa dang bcas tshang mas smon sems dam bca' can 'dzin pa sogs skal pa shin tu bzang por gyur/gzhan yang lung khrid rjes gnang sogs gang 'dod kyi chos sbyin gnang / rje nyid 'khrungs yul gyi zhwa dmar dgon nas 'byon dgos tshul nan tan che ba bzhin phebs nas dgon par ser skya mang po la 'jigs byed kyi khrom dbang dang 'dod chos 'ga' zhig stsal cing dgon par spyi 'jog mang 'gyed sogs gzab rgyas gnang / 'brog sde so sos khyim du gdan drangs nas 'byor 132

༄/ /rje btsunazla bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /'khos kyi dngos 'bul zhus/ rgya yag dgon dang or tsho/ bod yul ri khrod/ dor zhi/ tā pan dgon pa rnams kyis gdan drangs te 'bul nod bstar/ phar yang mang 'gyed 'jog pa dang so sor 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ tshur lam mchod rten thang dgon par gdan drangs te skya ser gyisam chen por skyer sgang lugs kyi rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang stsal/sngar dge 'dun la lceb sri'i gnod tshab che ba la nus ldan du mas rim gro sogasaphyas pas ma phan kyang de nas bzung ste lhag med du zhi ba'i ngo mtshar ba'i gtam deng sang yang gleng / sman bla mched bdun gyi rjes gnang stsal pa'i gsung gi 'phros la phan yon gyi bshad pa rtsal 'don gnang bas mdo chog thugs dam gnang mkhan mang po byung / bla ma'i rnal 'byor dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i 'pho khrid gzab bshad gnang bas mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis zin bris bgyis/ tshur 'bul nod gzabs shing phar yang mang 'gyed 'jog pa gnang / sngar bod du bzhugs skabs beg tse'i cho 'phrul lta bu zhig yang yang yong gi 'dug pa mdo smad du phebs nas sum pa mkhan chen la zhus pas/ rgya yul gyi dgra lha bkwan lo'u ye zer ba de beg tse dang ngo bo gcig pas de'i 'phrulayin shas che nyid rang pe'i cing du phebs dgos pa'i ltas yin pa 'dra gsung ba dang / 'di res nyid kyi thugs rmis la khri zhig gi steng du bud med gzi bajid can zhig 'dug pa'i drung du rje nyid kyang bzhugs 'dug pa la bud med des khyod rgya nag tu 'gro dgos zer bar phebs mi thub pa'i rgyu mtshan gsung bas/ 'o na khyod kyis nged rang la bstan 'gro'i don byed rgyu'i don du de tsam bskul ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin bstan 'gro'i don dgos na cis kyang 'gro dgos pa yin zer/ rje nyid kyi thugs dgongs la zhabs drung bde ldan sgrol ma zer ba dbang che bar grags pas 'di de yin pa 'dra dgongs byung ba zhig 133

༄/ /gung ba napa'izlaname'ig4 'bum/rmis pa sogs gser gyi rgyal khab tu 'byon rgyu'i dus la babs pa'i ltas mang du byung / rje 'di sku na phra mo'i dus nas bzung ste gcig tu dben pa kho na la thugs gzhol ba'i dbang gis chen po'i stong 'ud/ dpal 'byor gyi yo lang sogs 'di snang chos brgyad kyi spros pa mtha' dag btsan chod du byas te gtad pa bzhi dang rdo rje gsum gyi sgo nas tshe blos btang gi ri khrod pa rnal ma zhig byed pa'i dgongs pa rgyun chags su yod pa'i stobs kyis snga sor lcang skya rdo rje 'chang la'ang rgya nag phyogs su 'byon mi dgos pa'i thabs kyi mgo 'dren dgos tshul gsol pa yang yang btab/ 'ga' zhig gis nyid sku tshe gong ma rgyal po'i mchodayul 'gran med du mdzad 'dug pas da res kyang rgya nag tu phebs na legs mod zhus pa la/ der song tshe ming dang go ba rnyed pa sogs 'jig rten phyogs nas shogs thon tsam yong shas che'ang gtan gyi 'dun ma sgrub pa rnam dag cig byed rgyu'i skal ba mi yong bas dgos pa med gsungs te de zlog thabs su lnga phyir rim gro phon che ba bsgrubs/ 'on kyang 'phrin las dus babs bzlog tu med pas 7'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po nas nyid pe'i cing du 'byon dgos tshul gyi gser yig gnang ba zi lang asta na la babs/ masta na dngos kyis dgon lung du 'ongs nas rgyu mtshan rnams mkhyen du bcug pas thugasayil shin tu che ba byung yang byed thabs dang bral bas 'byon rgyur thag bcad/ de'i tshe ri khrod du phebs rgyu'i thugs bzhed bzhin ma grub par gzhan dbang du shor ba la thugs ngal dang skyo shas chen po 'khrungs te 'gur du bzhes pa ni/ nam zla dbyar dus slebs pa 'di dga' yang / / myur du yal yol zad nas 'gro ba 'di skyo ba/ / mi tshe bde skyid myong ba'i dus tshod 'di dga' yang / / myur du yal yol zad nas 'gro ba 'di skyo ba/ / mdangs mdzes me tog gsar ba shar ba 'di dga' yang / / ser ba drag pos nam 134

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzabachos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /'joms cha med 'di skyo ba/ / nad med rgud med lang tsho dar ba 'di dga' yang / /rkyen ngan thog tu nam 'bab cha med 'di skyo ba/ / sbrang mas 'bad nas rtsi bcud bsags pa 'di dga' yang / / don med phyug dzigazhim zas byed pa 'di skyo ba/ / da lta ser snas nor rdzas bsags pa 'di dga' yang / /nyin gcig gzhan gyis hab thob byed pa 'di skyo ba/ / mgron po'i zhag mal khang bzang 'dzom pa 'di dga' yang / / sang nyin rang sar skyur nas 'gro dgos 'di skyo ba/ / tshe 'di'i bde skyid 'byor pa 'dzom pa 'di dga' yang / / 'chi nyin rang sar skyur nas 'gro ba 'di skyo ba/ / mi rigs sna tshogs khrom du zhal 'dzom 'di dga' yang / / myur du so sor gyes nas 'gro ba 'di skyo ba/ / nye 'brel mched grogs lhan cig 'dzom pa 'di dga' yang / / nyin gcig so sor gyes nas 'gro ba 'di skyo ba/ / ngang ba'i tshogs rnams 'phur lding rol pa 'di dga' yang / / ngang phrug gcig cig snyi yis zin pa 'di skyo ba/ / mched grogs phal cher ri khrod 'grim pa 'di dga' yang / / ban chung sna thag gzhan la sher pa 'di skyo ba/ / dro 'jam nyi ma dgung la shar ba 'di dga' yang / / nub ri'i phag tu bzhud la nye ba 'di skyo ba/ / sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa 'di dga' yang / / rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dus la nye ba 'di skyo ba/ / rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru dzing 'dzom pa 'di dga' yang / / mthun phyogs rgyu ba'i rlung dang bral ba 'di skyo ba/ /gzhung lugs dgongs 'grel thos bsam byed pa 'di dga' yang / / brtson 'grus drag pos mthar phyin med pa 'di skyo ba/ / ne tsos ma ṇi'i rjes zlos shes pa 'di dga' yang / / don gyi cha shas tsam yang mi shes pas skyo ba/ / kha nas skyo glu yang yang blangs pa 'di dga' yang / / rgyud la sbyor ba'i nyams len med pa 'di skyo ba/ / zhes so/ / phyis su zhal nas kyang nged rang bod na 135

/ /gungajang stan pa'isgron gsung bum/yod dus de ga'i ri khrod cig tu phyin te tshe blos gtong ba zhig cis kyang byed snyam nas dkon mchog lagasol 'debs dang chos skyong la 'phrin bcol de lugs kyis nan tan byed kyin yod pa la/ mi lam 'ga' zhig tu khye'u dkar po zhig gis/ shar gyi dar dkar yug ring de/ / brkyangs na dbus gtsang yongs la khyab/ / der ma zad rgyal khams yongs la khyab/ zer ba dang /chos skyong khog zhugs kyi rnam pa can zhig gis/ sprul gyi mjug ma rta yi lus/ / lug gi mgo la ma bsgrims na/ / lug bal brdal na long skabs med/ / zer ba sogs byung ba rnams skabs der dpyad ma shes kyang phyis su dpyad tshe 'dab chags ne tso smra ba mang ba'i rkyen gyis gzeb tu chud pa ltar/bdag gis kyang gra sa'i dge bshes rnams la chos 'ga' zhig bshad pa'i stong grags kyis dgon lung pa rnams nged rang ri khrod du 'gro bsam gang ltar dbus nas mar 'ong mi thub pa'i rkyen re 'ong dogs te/ sum pa mkhan rin po che'i gsung shog nan can dang bcas bsu mi rnams 'brug lo'i ston 'byor nas u tshugs mthar skyel byas pas bod kyi ri khrod du sdod dbang ma byung /'on kyang rang yul gyi ri khrod cig tu mi tshe skyel ba'i 'phen pa btang ste sbrul lo'i ston rang yul du 'byor ma thag nas de'i rtsol ba byas kyang dgon pa'i bla ma dge 'dun gyis chosakhrir sdod dgos tshul nan che bas rang dbang ma 'dus/rta'i lor 'chad nyan byed dgos pas ri khrod 'grim long ga la yod/ lug lo'i cho 'phrul smon lam grol ma thag tu khri khur spor nas/ tsham tshom med par rikhrod du 'gro rgyu zhe dam bcas yod kyang bar der 7gong ma'i bka' babs pasam de'i dpyid ka thabs med par rgya nag pho brang du 'gro dgos pa byung zhing / de phyin chad nas rang dbang 'du ba zhig gtan nas ma byung ba yin pas ci ltar byas kyang mi tshe 'dir snyan grags su ming btags pa'i stong 'ud 136
