༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /dang / 'phrin las su ming btags pa'i yo lang gis dus 'da' dgos pa 'di nyid lung bstan pa yin 'dug gsungs/ dgung lo nyer bdun pa chu lug gi lo gsar tshes gtor dang gsung chos smon lam sogs sngar rgyun bzhin mdzad de kun gyi rgyud la dad pa'i myu gu bsgrun cing bshad sgrub dbyar mtsho bzhin du 'phel ba'i thugs bskyed rlabs po che gnang / khrir bzhugs yun thung yang thugs rje dang byin rlabs thabs mkhas kyi rteng bskul sogs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis 'chad nyan me ltar 'bar ba byung ste rigs pa smra ba brgya phrag du ma thon/ rgya nag tu phebs dgos byung ba na blo gsal don gnyer can mtha' dag gis spyir bla ma'i 'phrin las kyi gting dpog dka' 'angakhrir yun ring bzhugs rgyu ma byung ba dgon par pham che zhes sems khral shin tu che ba byung / smon lam gye sengs bar la bkra shis chos gling du gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs te nyin gcig gi gsung chos smon lam gnang / de nas rgya nag tu phebs rgyu'i dbang gis dgon lung gi khri'i dgongs pa zhus sku 'gyed gzab rgyas dang ja khra legs pa brgya dang brgyad spyi 'jog tu gnang /bla ma gsar ba'i bsgo bzhag gi mtshams la 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po cher gsol ba btab na legs tshul bkod khyab gnang ba bzhin thams cad gros mthun gyi steng nas rgyud pa bla ma dang nyid kyi phyag mdzod sogs gdan 'dren du gtong bar mdzad/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che nas dgon lung gi khrir sngod thub mi thub gang ltar yang sprul pa'i sku sa thag ring bor phebs rgyu yin 'dug pas mjal phrad byed par cis kyang 'gro dgos gsungs te 'phral du phebs/ thams cad kyis zhu ba nan tan phul te khrir mnga'agasol ba'i khri 'don gyi nyin rje nyid nas sku gsung thugs rten sogs 'bul ba spam mtho ba btegs/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che'i drung 137

༄/ /gung bangabastanapa'izlanaḥ gsung 'bum/nas mgon po'i be'u bum gyi lung dang sman bla mched bdun rta mgrin shā na bzhi skor khro rgyal gtsug tor 'bar ba rnams kyi rjes gnang sogs chos bka' 'ga' zhig gsan/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma mchog nas kun mkhyen gong ma'i thugs dam rten bris sku'i man ngag ltar bzhengs pa'i mgon po'i thang sku byin can zhig gnang ste 'phrin bcol dang bka' bsgo nan tan mdzad cing smad phyogs su bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che gnang tshul gyi bslab bya nang sbyar zhib lhug tu stsal/ de'i tshe rje nyid kyi mnal lam du don grub dbang rgyal la 'brum pa yong pas rim gro 'di dang 'di gyis zer ba zhig byung ste phyi nyin kho la gsung nas rim gro rnams byed du bcug / ma 'gyang bar 'brum pa byung yang bde bar thar bas bla ma'i gsung la yid ches rnyed/ thag ring du 'byon rgyu'i stabs kyis nye 'khor na yod pa'i dgon sgrub sde mchod gzhis mtha' dag gis gdan drangs te 'bul nod bstar zhing phyag dbang 'dod chos sogs zhus pas thugs brel bar mtshams med pa lta bu byung / dgon lung spyi bla brang so sos kyang gdan drangs nas gsol ja dang phebs rdzong zhus/ de nas hor zla gnyis pa'i mjug tu dpon g.yog tshang ma dgon lung nas thon dge 'dun rnams kyis gling 'dabs su chibs skyel mdzad cing dar 'bod sogs myur du mjal ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ dge 'dun bgres gzhon med par rje nyid la thugs dad shin tu che bas 'bral mi phod par spyan chab 'chor ba sha stag byung / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che dang sum pa mkhan chen rnam gnyis kyis ja thab steng du phebs skyel mdzad cing bla slob phan tshun thugs 'phrang ba'i rnam pa mdzad/ dgon lung ma bu dgon gyi zhabs drung sku skye las sne dka' ram dang mchod gzhi'i mgo pa sogs ser skya mang po'i chibs skyel rim pa du ma dang bcas thog mar zi lang du phebs nas zhag kha shas bzhugs/138

༄༅/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /astan sogs dpon po che chung rnams dang phan tshun dngos phrad mdzad cing so so'i ya mon du gdan drangs nas phebs ston zhus/ rje nyid la phebs byams dang dpon g.yog tshang ma'i lam chas dang zhon khal thams cad mdzod nas byung / car go chi dpon po zhig dmag mi bcu gnyis dang bcas zhabs phyir 'brangs/ lam bar du tsha zhag gar babs su dpon po rnams kyis bsu skyel sogs bkur gzos chen po dang bcas zhag lnga bcus pho brang chen por 'byor te lha khang ser po bzhugs gnas su gnang ba bzhin der babs/ 'byor ba'i nyin de rang la skyabs mgon lcang skya thams cad mkhyen par gsang stabs kyis mjal kha zhus par thugs shin tu dgyes pas rje nyid kyi sku tshe gong ma rgyal po'i bla mchod mdzad pa'i lo rgyus dang / khyed kyis nga la sngar bod du pho brang chen por yong mi dgos pa'i mgo 'dren dgos tshul gsungs pa sems la༄ bzung ba min kyang da res thabs med lta bu byung / 'on kyang rje bla mas/bstan pa rin chen mchog gis ma khyab pa'am/ / khyab kyang nyams par gyur pa'i phyogs der ni/ / snying rje chen pos yid rab bskyod pa yis/ / phan bde'i gter de gsal bar byed par shog / ces thugs sgon mdzad pa bzhin gcig pur sgom sgrub byas pa las kyang sa mthar bstan pa'i khur bzung ba bsod nams che tshul sogs thugs kyi skyo ba sangs nus pa'i bka' pheb lhug par stsal/ mi ring bar 7gong ma chen po'i 'byor phyag la phebs pas pho brang nang ma nas dngos mjal mdzad bka' 'dri mang du phebs par 'brel chags shing dgongs par 'bab pa'i bka' lan thogs med du phul/ 7'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'ang thugs shin tu mnyes pa'i rnam pas bka' bzang po dang bu la ga'i ta hu mang phu'i na bza' ma nu'i rgyan phreng spus legs rnams rgyal po rang gis bzhes 'phro yin pa'i rgyu mtshan dang bcas gsol ras stsal 139

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/cing hu thog thu chen po'i lugs kyi mthong gzos bdag rkyen bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / 7gong ma chen po thog mar mjal skabs zhal ras 'od zer 'phro ba'irnam pa can du gzigs tshul phyis su 'ga' zhig la gsung 'dug pa rten 'brel dang dgos pa khyad par can zhig yin nam snyam/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang nas dang por mgron gnyer rab rgyas ngo g.yog nyin lam du chibs bsur gtong ba gnang ba dang / 7gong ma'i mtshams zhus grub rjes rdo rje 'chang sku dngos kyis lha khang ser por mjal phrad du byon te rje nyid la rgyal khab chen por phyag phebs pa'i thog ma'i rten 'byung du sku gdung thugs rten/bzhugs gdan bsnyel 'bol na bza' cha tshang dngul sogs dngos skyes shin tu gzab pa gnang ba sogs bkur gzos bdag rkyen bla na med pa mdzad/sngayo zhig nas rje rang gi nyams snang la khang bzang skyed tshal sogs kye bkod pa gzigs ma myong ba mang po yang yang 'char ba dang dri yid du 'ong ba zhig bro ba'i rnam pa yong gi yod pa 'di res pe'i cing du 'byor te gzigs pa na rgyal bo'i pho brang gi bkod pa'i rnam pa yin 'dug cing / dri bzang po de'ang rgya yul du shing thog dbang po'i lag pa'i dbyibs can zhig yod pa de'i dri yin pa 'dug gsung / rgyun par yang lo gnyis gsum tshun la yong rgyu'i bya bzhag 'ga' zhig snga mo nas nyams snang la yang yang 'char ba zhig yod pa de'i gnas tshul lcang skya rdo rje 'chang la zhus par sku tshe sngon ma rnams su mngon shes thob pa'i bag chags yin pa 'dra zhes gsung 'dug / de nas rtsa ba'i sbyin bdag 7gong ma'i nang blon chen po bsod nams kyi dpung pas sa chen po la rang phyan du spyod pa har chen wang rat+na sirnyis rang gi yab mes snga ma rnams kyi dus nas rje nyid kyi sku tshe gong ma dang mchod yon du gyur pa'i 'brel ba thugs la bcangs yod pa bzhin/ rje 'di pa 7gong ma'i bkas rgyal khab chen por 140

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /byon pa gsan ma thag tu dbyar rnga thos pa'i mdongs mtha' bzhin spro dga' tshad med pas zhal mjal bar brel nas thog mar mgyogs shad kyis mtshams zhus 'bul mi mngags pa 'byor te 'phral du mkho ba'i sku'i nyer spyad dang na bza' 'ga' zhig phul/ 7gong ma chen por rje 'di pa gdan 'dren gyi dgongs pa dang rje nyid la gdan 'dren rgya snyan gsan zhus/ mi ring bar mi drag 'ga' zhig zhon rta shing rta ul mi dang bcas gdan 'dren du 'byor pa bzhin zla ba lnga pa'i nyi shu lnga la pho brang nas thon/ zhe hor du mtshan sgrog mkhan chen blo bzang dar rgyas kyis gtso mdzad lha khang so so'i bla ma las sne rnams kyis chibs bsu dang mgron ston zhus shing bla grwa tshang ma dang jun gar pa rnams kyis mjal kha zhus/ de nas har chen ho sho'u 'ga' zhig gi bla dpon dngos dang tshab ci rigs kyi bsu ba dang wang gi ho sho'u nas blon 'bangs ser skya du ma rta thab kyi bsu ba snga phyi mang po dang bcas rim par phebs/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes bzhi'i nyin bsod nams 'bum phrag mngon par 'khyil ba wang chen mo phyi nang gi dgongs blon sogs rta pa stong phrag brgal ba'i 'khor dang bcas tā pa na sgang du chibs bsur 'byor/ mchod yon gser zhal lhan cig 'dzom pa'i legs dar rtse sprad cing wang yab sras kyis phyag dbang zhus/bzhugs gur dang ja thab gra bsgrigs bgyis sar gdan drangs te gsol ja dkar spro zhus thog gsung gleng cung zad gnang / de nas phyogs nye ring gi mjalab grangs med pa'i khrom tshogs bgrang gis mi lang ba sa'i dreg pa ltar sprug chil le ba'i gzhung gshags te mchod rdzas rnam pa mi 'dra ba du ma thogs pa'i dge 'dun brgya phrag mang po'i ser sbrengs kyis mdun bdar nas wang gi ya mon du babs/ pho brang dbus ma nas dpon g.yog tshang mar shangs len gyi dga' ston rgya chen po zhus/ thog ma'i rten 'byung gi brtan bzhugs phul 141

༄/ /yo ca ba na ba'i name'i gsung 'bum/te dngos 'bul spam mtho ba btegs/ re zhig gi bar du khyogs tha dad nas dad mos kyis mjal kha zhu mi drag zhan skya ser khri phrag mang po nyin ltar bar ma chad du byung ba la sger mjal zhu mkhan bla ma dang dpon blon mi drag du ma phyag dbang dang rang rang gi 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad mjal ba byings la khrom tshogs so sor phyag dbang gnang ba'i mjug tu sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang gzungs sngags zab mo rnams thos pa'i phan yon/ khyad par du spyan ras gzigs snying rje'i lha yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyes de'i gzungs ring dang ma ṇi sogs lhag par byin rlabs myur zhing phan yon che tshul sogs so so'i skabs dang 'brel ba'i bshad pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs dad pa 'dren nges re dang sbrags te dmigs brtse ma/ rigs gsum mgon pa'i snying po byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs ke ka ni durga te yig brgya sogs gzungs sngags khyad par can mang po dang / bde gshegs brgyad dang rin chen gtsug tor can sogs de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan byin rlabs can mang po rnams rna lam du sgog par mdzad/ yang mjal ba rang rang gi spyi bor spyan ras gzigs re bzhugs yod pa'i mos pa dang dad pa skyed du bcug ste bdud rtsi 'beb sbyang gi thugs dmigs dang bcas bla slob lhan cig tu ma ṇi 'phreng skor kha shas re 'ur chems kyis gsungs/ ma ṇi sogs dge ba khas len du bcug ste dge ba'i rtsa ba spyan ras gzigs la sgrub pa'i mchod par 'bul ba dang bla med byang chub kyi rgyur dmigs pa'i mos pa skyed du bcug pa dang bcas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i gter/ zhes sogs kyi 'dod gsol dang ji srid thub mchog ma sogs bsngo ba'i tshigs bcad rnams kyis mtha' brgyan par mdzad/ de nas bzung ste gang du phebs sar mjal ba khrom tshogs byung ba rnams la bka' chos de rnams thugs brel che chung dang bstun nas rgyas 142

༄7/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bsdus ci rigs 'chag med du gnang ngo / / de'ang byin gyis rlobs tshul la sku'i sgo nas byin gyis brlabs pa/ gsung gi sgo nas byin gyes brlabs pa/thugs bden pas byin gyis brlabs pa/ thugs thugs rjes byin gyis brlabs pa/ thugs ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs pa sogs mang du yod pa las/ dang po ni mdo sde sa bcu pa lta bu de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis rdo rje snying po'i dbu la phyag bzhag ste byin gyis brlabs nas gsungs pa la sku'i sgo nas byin gyes brlabs par bshad pa dang rnam pa mthun par phyag dbang du grags pa'i srol 'di byung / rje bla ma lta bu bdag nyid chen po rnams kyis phyag dbang dngos su stsol ba lta zhog / phyag zhabs kyis reg pa'i rdul tsam yang 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing sa bla na med pa dang 'phral yun du phan pa'i byin rlabs kyi gter chen por gyur pa ni phar phyin bsdus pa las/rkang pas bkra shis gyur pa'i rdul dag byung / / phyag 'tshal mgos gtugs thob pa kun tu 'khyer/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin mod kyang de tsam gyis chog shes mi mdzad par gzungs sngags zab mo rna bar sgrogs pa sogs phan pa'i thabs sgo du ma nas mdzad pa ni snying rje'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i khyad chos mtshungs pa med pa'o/ / tshul 'di lta bu bla ma'i go sar 'gying ba mtha' dag gisago dgos pa zhig ste/ mi shes gdol ba'i phru gu dar btums re la dam pa'i ming btags pa'am/ tshur mthong rang dga' ba'i sa nas lung rtogs kyi yon tan cung zad kyang nam 'phar bzhin du go sa rer phyin pa na pha rol pos byin rlabs yod du re zhing rang yang byin rlabs yod mdog gis lag pa'i 'deg 'jog kho na lhur byed pa ni ngal ba tsam zhig 'bras bur zad pas/phan nges pa'i thabs phran bu re cis kyang bya dgos pa'i tshul rje nyid kyis gnang ba'i chab shog las/ mgo bor lag pa bzhag la phyag dbang zhes/ / grags 143

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/kyang sdug bden gcig steng gcig brtsegs par/ / byin rlabs re ba chags ldan lus phra ma/ / ma ning dag las 'dod bde re dang mtshungs/ / de phyir dad pas 'dus pa de dag gi / rna ba'i yol go sangs rgyas byang sems kyi/ / mtshan dang gzungs sngags zab mo'i bdud rtsi yis/ / 'gengs par byed pa'i cho ga nyin bzhin bsgrubs/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ / der ma zad grub pa'i dbang phyug khri pa bsod nams grags pa'i drung du wang gi dpon mo mjal du 'ongs skabs dar phod dang phyag 'phreng sogs kyis mjal kha gnang ba la/ 'ga' zhig gis phyag gis dngos su gnang e dgos zhus par/ khong tsho'i mgo skam po de dang nga'i lag pa skam po gnyis thug pa la phan yon ci yod/ stabs nyes na reg pa'i lhag ma zhig skyid rgyu de yin mod gsungs te bka' bkyon mdzad pa bzhin byin rlabs phar gnang ba dang nyes pa tshur bskyed pa'i mtshams su zhib 'jug dgos pa'ang yod do/ / brel ba rim sel du song ba dang wang yab sras lha khang gi tā bla ma gnyis dang bcas dpon slob skya ser gyi tshogs pa shin tu mang por bka' chos kyi thog ma bla ma mchod pa'i khrid rgyas pa gnang / bco lnga'i nyin wang gi lha khang du byams skor dang smon lam la phebs/ tshur phebs te wang yab sras gtsos pa'i skya ser drag zhan stong phrag brgal bar snar thang brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang dang gdugs dkar zhal phyag yongs rdzogs kyi rjes gnang stsal/ wang gi lha khang gi mkhas mchog tā bla mas gshag tu gdan drangs nas sman bla mtho brtsegs dang rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi rjes gnang zhus/ gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyi yā mon du gdan drangs pa bzhin rta thab dang bcas phebs/ gung dpon pos gzhis len ston mo dang thog ma'i rten 'byung gi 'bul nod gzabs/ gung yum sras gtsos pa'iskya ser brgya phrag mang po la rdo rje sems dpa' dang spyan ras gzigs kyi 144

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /rjes gnang stsal/ tshur phebs te chos rje bla ma sogs don gnyer can nyung 'dus la 'jigs byed bskyed rim gyi khrid rgyas par gnang / zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gsum nas wang gi yā mon du dge 'dun stong phrag brgal bas nyin bdun gyi ring ma ṇi ril bu bsgrub pa'i tshogs dbu mdzad/ o'u han thu mur wangagi gdan 'dren pa 'byor te gsol ba nan cher btab pa bzhin chibs bskyod pa'i lam nas tha bu nang don grub kyis khyim du gdan drangs te gsol ston dang dngos 'bul bstar/ khā bstan 'gyur gyis spyan drangs pa'i thog ser skya stong phrag mang por sman bla'i rjes gnang stsal/ rim gyis dpon blon mang pos skya bsu dang thab bsu sogs bkur sti rgya chen po dang bcas thu mur wang gi ya mon du 'byor/ nyin kha shas bzhugs te wang 'khor bcas la 'jigs byed dang sgol ma'i rjes gnang sogs chos kyi dga' ston rgyas pa gnang / phyogs ris med nas 'dus pa'i mjal ba drag zhan mang po rnams phyag dbang dang 'dod chos sogs kyis tshim par mdzad/ wang gis gzhis len bkur ste zhabs tog phul du phyin pa bsgrubs shing dngos 'bul dngul srang brgya dang gos chen yug lnga/ rnga mong gsum rta lnga nor brgya tham pa bcas phul/ tshur lam ja lang sangs rgyas skyabs kyi khyim du zhag bab thog skyes pho mo'i khrom chen por gdugs dkar gyi rjes gnang stsal/ ja lang gis gzhis len 'bul nod gzabs/ zla ba brgyad pa'i bco lnga dang bstun wang gi mchod khang du gsar rnying gi rten rnams la rje nyid chog gra pa sum cu dang bcas rab gnas rgyas pa dge legs rgya mtsho'i char 'bebs kyi cho ga ltar zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg dang bcas nyin gnyis la gan nga / wang chen mos snga phyir brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel lan gsum bsgrigs pa'i dngos 'bul du dngul srang bzhi bcu'i maṇ+ḍal/ sku gsung thugs rten/ gos chen gyi bzhugs 145

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlanama'i gsung 'bum/gdan rgyab yol cha 'grig gsum/ mang nog gi bla bre gcig / gos chen dang bu la ga khe re me sogs la ched gnyer gyis bzos pa'i dbyar dgun gyi na bza' phu thung bubs nyer gcig / gos lhug khug ma phyag phyis dang bcas cha tshang / sham chas tshang ma tshar gnyis/ bu la ga'i dbu zhwa gcig / paṇa zhwa gcig / dbyang chas tshang ma tshar gnyis/ gos kyi zhabs lham 'bob bcas cha gsum/ dngul gyi bdun tshar mchod rkong bcas/ dngul bum bcud kyis bkang ba/ dngul gye rdo rje che ba dar tshon sna lnga'i sne 'dogs can/dngul gyi rdo dril/ dung dkar/ shel gye me long / dngul gyi chab ril gnyis/ zhal dkar yu ring stegs can gnyis/ zhib phor gnyis/bzed zhal gsum/ shel gyi mchod jan gcig / yu'u shi'i mchod jan gnyis/ shel lder gnyis/ sna dam legs pa gsum/ dri bzang gi thum po tsor can bcu/ bsil g.yab rgyu dang dbyibs mi 'dra ba bcu bzhi/ dngul srang stong phrag gcig dang dgu brgya/ bu la ga'i bags pa bco brgyad/mar nog dang gos chen mdog sna tshogs yug bcu bdun/ shing rta g.yog can dre'u dang bcas/ cibs rta sga 'khor can/ gzim gur gos chen tshos gnyis ma'i yol ba/ mthil gdan dkar dmar dang bcas cha tshang / ras gur khang ba'i dbyibs can che chung gnyis/ tsan dan dkar po'i don yod lcags gyu sogs mnang che la rnam grangs mang ba'i chod tshogs mtha' klas pa rdzogs ldan gyi sprin bzhin gtibs/ phyag g.yog sgrub mi grwa gzhon bcu tham pa'ang mgo 'bul zhus/ zhabs phyi pa nyi shu rtsa gcig la dbyar dgun gnyis kyi go lag tshang ma re/ dngul srang bdun re bcas gnang / srid na srid do dīX / ༷༈༵ madho dīrdos spri/na /du dzosta sdi dī rdong b.rashaṃ sna na di rdo dīdī rji ༷ /mtsho/ 146

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /'phyur ba bzhin/ / 'on kyang nam mkha' mdzod brnyes shing / / sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs pa/ / de la zang zing 'du 'god ni/ / rtswa rtse'i zil ba'i mtshonakhya nyid/ / sngar lo kha shas shig gi ring yā mon du btsun mo dang sras 'ga' zhig grong / sras 'ga' zhig na ba sogs 'tshub cha che ba byung 'dug par rje nyid la rim gro stobs chen zhig dgos tshul nan cher zhus pa bzhin drag po'i sbyin sreg cig gnang bas 'tshub lhong lta bus mchod g.yog pa ngag dbang bstan dar glo bur du grong yang de phyin chad nas wang gi yā mon du gegs chag gi rigs de thams cad lhag med du zhi bas legs lam shin tu che ba byung /ston mjug pe'i cing du chibs bskyod/ har chen nas chibs skyel du 'ongs pa'i mi drag zhan rnams la sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang stsal/ dgun gye ring pheb bzhud sogs kyi brel g.yeng chen po med pas thugs dam shin tu 'phel ba byung / de dus nyin re bzhin thugs dam gnang rgyu'i rim pa rang gis rang la bkas bcad lta bu gnang ba'i tho chung zhig 'dug pa ni 'di ltar/ tho rangs nam gyi sum cha lus ba na ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs/ gos bgo ba dang / khrus kyi rnal 'byor tshul bzhin byas rjes phyag gsum btsal/ nyin gcig gi rnal 'byor lam du 'gro ba'i phyir sher snying bdud bzlog dang bcas pa bya/ kun slong legs par bcos/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ ngag byin rlabs/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i bsags sbyangs dang lam khrid rgyas bsdus ci rigs bsgoms/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig dang khyad par du bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma 'pho ba dang bcas pa'i dmigs rnam rgyas par bskyangs/tshe lha gang rigs/ dmar po gnyis/ nag po gnyis/ khra bo gcig dang bcas pa'i bzlas bsgom legs par byas rjes brgya rtsa klu gtor chu sbyin sogs 147

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/gtong ba thun dang po'o/ / mjal kha gtong ba sogs la 'jug / de rjes long skabs dang bstun mdo rgyud gang rigs klog / sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang gzungs sngags zab mo dang bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems kyi bstod pa gang mos 'don pa thun gnyis pa'o/ / phyi dro phyag dang skor ba ci 'grub bya zhing 'jigs byed dpa' gcig dang mgon po snying zhugs kyi rnal 'byor/ yi dam chos skyong gi gtor 'bul za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg gcod kyi dmigs rnam bskyangs te bzang spyod sogs bsngo smon bkra shis byas gnyid kyi rnal 'byor sogs bskyang ba ni thun tha ma'o/ / yang thun drug tu yan lag bdun pa maṇ+ḍal sems bskyed thun drug gi rnal 'byor sgo drug pa'i gzungs ltung bshags dam tshig rdo rje dang rdo rje sems dpa'i bzlas bsgom la 'bad par bya'o/ / dus rgyun du dran shes bsten nas gtong len dang lam 'khyer dang lta ba rnams yang yang dran par byas la nyal ldang khrus kha zas kyi rnal 'byor tshad ldan bya'o/ / yar ngo mar ngo'i chos bcu la sgrub mchod bdag 'jug dang bcas pa dang / yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la lha mo dang rnam sras/bco lnga la mgon chos/ mar ngo'i tshes brgyad la zhal dang be+eg tse'i dus gtor chag med gtong ngo / zhes 'byung ba ltar la/ gzhan zla re bzhin marango'i bcu bzhi la dbyu gu drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor ma'ang chag med gnang gan yod ces rgyus yod rnams gleng / der ma zad bod du bzhugs skabs byang sems kyi bslab bya dang 'brel ba'i nyes pa 'gog pa'i chu lon gyi dam bca' zhes bya ba gzhan don ma gtogs rang don du drag las mi byed pa dang /bzang ngan gyi 'brel ba thogs pa'i sems can rnams byang chub ma thob kyi bar duyid kyis mi 'dor ba sogs dam bca' bcu lhag gnang ba'i brjed tho rje rang nyid kyi phyag bris gser dgon gyi rab 'byams pa ngag dbang blo bzang gi 148

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /lag tu byung ba de nas gzhan zhig tu 'khyar te ma rnyed kyang lo rgod gnyis kyis dam bca' bcu gsum dang bco lnga la sogs pa mdzad pa dang cha 'dra ba'i nyamasalen gyi sdoms dpag par dka' pa'i rnam thar du ma zhig yod tshod du snang / nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sku gser zangs las grub pa khru gsum can rgyan cha thams cad dngul las bsgrub pa zhig gsar du bzhengs te gzungs 'bul rab gams rje rang gis mdzad/ 'di ni sku tshe 'dir rten bzhengs che ba gnang ba'i mgo 'dzugs lta bu yin pas rten 'brel khyad par can zhig yod par sems/ de dang dus mtshungs su rang nyid kyis bkod pa gnang ste rgyu dngul srang chig stong sum brgya la maṇ+ḍal che ba ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla sogs kyi bkod pas mdzes pa zhig kyang gsar du bsgrubs/ dgung lo nyer brgyad pa shing sbre'u'i bgrang bya gsar tshes kyi dus ston mdzad cing lha khang ser po'isgon lam gye mgon du phebs te nyin bdun gyi ring gsung chos smon lam sogs rgyas par gnang / bcu bzhi dang bco lnga'i nyin yu'u mi yen la 7gong ma'i sku mdun du ston mor phebs/ nyin par khrang zhi'i rtsed mo dang mtshan mo me'i 'khrul 'khor gyi rtsed mo gzigs/ 7gong ma'i mtshams zhur 'ongs pa'i sog po'i dpon blon drag zhan mang pos mjal du 'ongs par phyag dbang dang bka' bsgo gsung brtag lung rjes gnang sogs gang zhus thams cad so so'i 'dod mos bzhin gnang ste re ba bskangs/ lo gsar gyi brel ba sangs pa dang sngar rgyun bzhin thugs dam zab mo'i nyams bzhes kyi rgyun bskyangs/de skabs su mnal lam du mkha' 'gro ma zhig gis/ phral ma phral mar tshags su gyis/ / ngang ba nub tu 'phur grab 'dug / 'phur kyang rang sa rang gis zungs/ / rdo rje dril bu ma dor zung / / shes rab yum chen mnyes par gyis/ / grogs po rig pa'i khye'u chung / / rnam rtog mtshon rtse ma 'grim 149

༄/ /gung thang bstanaba'izlan 'i gsung 'bum/par/ / bde chen thang la skyid nyal gyis/ / lo dgu lo bdun gnyid g.yur na/ / btsan rdzongs zin pa yong bar nges/ / rang don shor ba'i mdo med po/ / a re dga' la a re sdug / ming sring sdebs la glu cig len/ / zhes sogs gsungs 'dug pa bde stong gi rnal 'byor skyong tshul gnad che ba mang du yod snang yang zhib tu 'grel par ma spobs la/ nyams bzhes rtse gcig pa'i rgyun de lo bdun brgyad tsam skyong rgyu byung na btsan rdzong zin yod par gsungs pa go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /de'i tshe ring nas thugs la brnag pa bzhin dben pa'i ri sul du tshe blos btang gi sgrub pa gnang rgyur ma song ba dang / de'i steng du phyogs ris med kyi sbyin bdag so so'i dad gshin gyi dkor nor 'bul ba sogs ha cang tshan che bas skyugand can gyes zas mthong ba bzhin lhag par yang zhen log gis skyo shas drag po 'khrungs te nyams mgur dbyangs su bsdebs pa ni/ chos sde snod ngag tu 'chad la dbang / / byams snying rjes thugs rgyud yongs su gtams/ / drin sangs rgyas kun las ches lhag pa'i/ / pha bla ma snying dbus pad+mor bzhugs/ / rje khyod kyi drin las sprang btsun bdag / rgyud dad dang skyo bas nyer bskul te/ / tshe blos btang sgrub pa byed snyam du/ /snying rus pa'i gting nas dam bcas kyang / / rgyud dred du 'jug pa'i bdud las la/ / ming gzhan don btags pa'i bslu brid 'dis/ / dus da bar mgo bo 'khor 'khor nas/ / chos gdams ngag zab dgu dpe la lus/ / da 'chi bdag pho nya slebs la nye/ / tshe phyi mar phan thabs 'di byas zhes/ / blo gtad thub gdeng ni cang med pas/ / yid gzhu ltar bkug kyang mda' ltar shor/ / yul chos med mtha' 'khob 'di 'drar 'khyams/ / dbang sna thag btsan po'i lag tu shor/ / chos sgom sgrub phyogs la re thag chad/ / 'di 150

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bsam gyin snying la nad du thing / / khong sdon byon dam pa'i rnam thar dang / / grogs chos mthun bya btang mdzad spyod dang / / gnas g.ya' spangs dben pa'i yon tan rnams/ / dus lan re dran tshe 'chi ma 'chor/ /rje mi la lta bu'i snying rus kyis/ / khong sangs rgyas gral zhig bsnyegs 'dod kyang / / zob sna dgus dad ldan slu byed pa'i/ / kho chos 'tshong mkhan gyi gral zhig thob/ / rang ci yin gar 'gro mi shes kyang / / gzhan shi gson yar 'dren byed khul gyis/ / zas dad gshin dkor la spyad spyad nas/ / tshe phyi mar 'jal dgos bu lon blangs/ / rgyud nyin bzhin mi dge sdig pas gang / / tshe yud tsam res kyang 'chi la snyegs/ / gnas ngan song sdug bsngal bzod glag med/ / da ci drag ci drag nga re 'jigs/ / skyabs kun 'dus bla ma mai tri pa/ / sbrang skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang / / rje khyod min re sa gzhan med pas/ / tshe 'di phyi'i 'dun ma khyed rang mkhyen/ / lam nges 'byung byang sems lta ba dang / / dpal bskyed rdzogs rtogs pa mthar phyin nas/ / mchog sku gsum go 'phang mngon gyur te/ / ma 'gro kun 'dren pa'i dpal grub mdzod/ / dus nam zhig 'chi bas zin pa'i tshe/ / khyod thugs rje'i 'od zer lcags kyu yis/ / yid dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang der/ / dus myur ba nyid du drang du gsol/ / khyod nam zhig 'dzam gling 'dir byon nas/ / chos bdud rtsi'i dga' ston 'gyed pa'i tshe/ / bdag 'khor gyi dang por gyur nas su/ / mchog byang chub lung bstan thob par shog / ces pa 'di'angablo bzang chos kyi nyi mas rang gi gnas tshul la skyo nas rgyal khab pe'i cing du smras pa'o/ / zhes so/ / lo 'dir 7gong ma'i bkas bdag rkyen gnang ste rje nyid kyi bzhugs gnas bla brang gsar gsos byed rgyu dang dbyar gyi ring pho brang du tshab che ba bcas sbyin bdag wang rat+na sirnyi sa gdan 'dren pa 151

༄/ /gung thangabastanami'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/zhon rta shing rta dang bcas gtong ba gnang ste zla ba lnga pa'i tshes la har chin du phebs/ sbyin bdag wang dang bka' gros gnang nas bkra shis lung pa'i phugs su dben gnas ri khrod cig 'debs rgyu'i gnas gzigs mdzad de rgyudadon sngags rim chen mor bkral ba ltar gyi lto 'phye'i thig sogs rje rang nyid kyis gnang / shing cha dang shing bzo gyo bzo de dag gi cha rkyen thob thang gi yon sogs gang dgos rnams sbyin bdag wang nas mthun rkyen sbyar te gzim gshag 'bug rgyu'i mgo tshugs/ wang yab sras dang lha khang gi tā bla ma sogasabla dpon ser skya brgya phrag mang po la ba ri brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang stsal/zla ba drug pa'i bco lnga dang bstun wang gi lha khang rten dang brten par bcas pa la rab gnas rgyas pa zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg dang bcas gnang ste dge legs kyi snang bas khyab par byas/ mkhas mchog tā bla ma dang su la bla ma blo bzang dge 'dun gnyis kyis rang rang gi gshag tu gdan drangs te bsnyen bkur zhus par 'jam lugs tshe dpag lha lnga dang grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang gnang /bar skabs shig tu gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyi yā mon du gdan drangs te nyin kha shas bzhugs nas chos bka' 'ga' zhig zhus pa'i 'dun pa bskangs/khongagis kyang shangs len gzos sgo phul du phyin pa dang bdog pa gya nom pa'i yon 'bul bstar/ ston lcang skya rin po che mdo smad nas do lon no'ur brgyud de phebs par rje nyid yong nyod kyis mtshams su chibs bsu dang ston mo zhus pas thugs dgyes pa'i bka' mchid mang du 'phel/ sbyin bdag wang rat+na sirnyis snga phyi'i brtan bzhugs lan gsum gye 'bul bar dngul srang sum cu'i maṇ+ḍal/ sku gsung thugs rten/ bzang gos las bsgrubs pa'i bzhugs gdan rgyab yol tshar gnyis/ rten khebs che chung bco lnga/ dngul gyirdo rje che ba dar tshon sna lnga'i sne 'dogs can/ dngul srang sum cu las 152

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bsgrubs pa'i 'dod yon nas/ gser gyi gdu bu cha gcig / me long yu ba can gcig / dbyar dgun gyi na bza' bubs bcu bzhi/ dbul srang stong phrag gcig dang brkyang brgya/ sna dam legs pa bzhi/ shes kyi snod spyad 'ga' zhig / don yod lcags kyu bcas phul/ zhabs phyi ba rnams la go lag tshang ma re gnang / dbyar ston 'dir har chin du bzhugs ring la ho sho'u tha dad nas ched gtad kyis mjal mi bla dpon dag gzhan lo snga ma las mang du byung bar phyag dbang dang bka' chos sogs so so'i 'dod mos ltar stsal/ dgun pe'i cing du bzhugs thugs dam sngar rgyun ltar 'phel/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang dri med bla ma rgyal dbang gi 'khrungs rabs rgya mtsho bdun gyi 'dra sku khru gang re rnams tho'u sha las bsgrubs shing / sgrol dkar gyi sku khru gsum long ba gcig dang lam rim brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi sku tshun bdun re yod pa drug cu lhag rnams gser zangs las bsgrubs te gzungs 'bul dang rab gnas mdzad/ dgun zla tha chung gi nang du phyi log gi dpon po rnams gong ma'i mtshams zhur 'dzom pa'i skabs yin pas sbyin bdag har chin wang dang pā rin wang / e phu bde legs bzang po cang pe'i zi sogs phyogs tha dad kyi dpon chen mang du 'dus pa so so nas dngos 'bul phon che ba btegs shing tshe dbang sogs 'dod chos 'ga' zhig zhus pa dgyes bzhin du stsal/ har chin pe'i zi 'chi med rdo rje gzugs gzhi ma bde ba bab lce bar 7gong ma'i bkas rje 'di nyid gdan 'dren du 'ongs pa bzhin lo mjug tu pe'i zi de nyid ho sho'u la phebs/ pe'i zi'i a ke dang smon lam bla ma bkra shis dar rgyas/ thu sa lag chi/ ca khir chi sogs ho shu'u'i bla dpon blon po che phra mang po'i rta bsu thab bsu ser sprengs dang bcas pe'i zi'i ya mon du 'byor/ pe'i zi gdon nad kyis gzir bar mgon po'i drag po'i 153

༄/ /gung thangabastan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/sbyinasreg gnang bas dgun zla tha chung nang yin kyang ga nas 'ong cha med pas sbrul zhig thab khung du zhugs nas shi/ phyi nyin nas pe'i zi'i nad gzhi de nyid 'phral du dngas bas dga' bdes yid brtas par gyur/ 'on kyang 'di 'dra'i sku rim tshan che ba gnang res bzhin gnod byed gdon bgegs so so'i gnad la dbab ches pa'i stobs kyis sku 'khor rnams la cung 'tshub pa zhig yod pas 'di lan yang rta dpon dge slong zhig yod pa glo bur du 'das/ da lta phal cher sbyin bdag bde na rang gi byin rlabs dang / ma bde na de nyid kyi las su sgrogs pa tsam la blo phugs gtod pa tsam las 'tshub dang dngos grub kyi rnam pa ci'ang mngon rgyu med pa dang da mi 'dra bar/ rkyen sel re gnang ba la'ang zhi drag gi mtshan ma gang rigs nges can du 'byung ba ni grub pa'i 'brasatags yin te/ dam pa gong ma rnams kye lo rgyus su'ang 'di 'dra ba shin tu mang ngo / / phyogs nye ring du ma nas ched gtad kyis mjal du 'ongs mkhan grangs med pa lta bus sa sros kyi bar du de dag so so la phyag dbang 'dod chos sogs lhug par stsal te yid tshim par mdzad nas pe'i zi'i sku rim gnang dgos rnams mtshan mo la mthud blangs te mdzad dgos pa'ang lan mang du byung / dgung lo nyer dgur phebs pa shing bya'i lo gsar gye dga' ston pe'i zi'i yā mon nas mdzad cing dpon po'i nad gzhi lhag med du dngas pas blon 'bangs mtha' dag dad gus dang dga' spro 'gran pa bzhin du 'phel/ dga' ston rgya chen po ngang khyad nor ya mtshan pa du ma dngul srang stong phrag gcig sogs legs 'bul sbam mtho ba btegs/ yā zi a ke dang e bu dge legs bsam 'grub a she tsan+d+ra pā lam bu nang dbang bskur rdo rje ja lang skal bzang dang skal ldan sogs yā mon nye 'khor gyi dpon blon 'byor ldan mang pos rim gyis gdan drangs te 'ga' zhig tu zhag bzhugs dang la 154

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /las gung tshigs zhus thog bsnyen bkur 'bul nod gzabs/ lung dang rjes gnang sogs gang zhus thams cad la rang rang gi mos pa dang 'tsham pa'i chos kyi char phag ho sho'u thun mong gi don du bdun gcig bcad rgya mjug tu zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bcas gnang / pe'i zi yab sras kyis gtsos bla dpon ser skya dmangs dang bcas khrom khri phrag bzhi tsam 'dus pa la tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbangachen sta gon dang bcas gnang ste rgyud la thar pa'i sa bon bskrun par mdzad/ pe'i zi yab sras dang smon lam bla ma bkra shis dar rgyas ca khir chi tshebartan rgyal sogs skal ldan gyi slob ma nyung 'dus la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje btsun mo nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang dang gdams pa'i zab khrid sogs dgyes bzhin stsal te rjes su bzung pe'i zi'i mchod khang gi rten rnams la rab gnas mdzad/ thu med dang mong gol cin ja sag gung sogs kyi ho sho'u nas ched gtad kyis mjal kha dang bka' chos zhu bar 'ongs pa'i brag zhan mang po la'ang lung khrid rjes gnang sogs so so'i 'dod mos ltarasnal/ sbyin bdag har chin wang gi sras che ba don grub tshe brtan dang chos rje tā bla ma sogs drag zhan brgyad cu skor tsam mtshams zhur slebs/wang nas rten 'brel kyi rdzas 'ga' zhig 'bul rgyu bskur ba phul/ dbyed dbyar gyi ring ho sho'u 'di ga'i khrod du mi drag dang 'byor ldan gyi lha khang khyim tshang brgya phrag du mar rim pas gdan drangs nas spyi sger so sos che 'byor chung 'byor kyi 'dog pa'i dngos po yod 'bul lta bu zhus pa rnams gang la gang 'tsham gye mdzad pa'i sgo nas mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi sgo 'phar yongs su phyes/ phyogs mtha' dag nas mjal ba bgrang gis mi lang ba dbyar gyi char sprin bzhin du 'dus ba la phyag dbang sogs 'chom med du stsal pa'i mthar gzungs sngags zab mo du ma dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan byin rlabs 155

༄/ /gung ba bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/can mang po rna lam du bsgrags/ so so'i spyi bor spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam pa gsal 'debs su bcug ste bdud rtsi 'bebs spyang gi spyan dmigs dang bcasabla slob tshang mas yig drug nyung mtha' 'phreng skor re 'ur chems kyis gsungs/ ma ṇi sogs dge ba khas len du bcug dge pa'i rtsa ba spyan rasagazigs la sgrub pa'i mchod par 'bul ba dang bla med byang chub kyi rgyur dmigs pa'i 'dod gsol dang bsngo smon gyi mtshams spyor do gal chen pos nam yang ma chad pa gnang / dmigs bsal gyi bka' bsgo dang thugs brtags srung mdud ljags sngags sogs zhu ba bar ma chad lta bur byung yang skyo ngal gyi rnam pa mi mdzad par gang zhus mtha' dag dgyes bzhin stsal te mchog dman thams cad kyi yid tshim par mdzad/ slar yang pe'i zi'i yā mon du phebs dge bsnyen pha ma dang rab byung dge tshul brgya phrag mang po gnang /bsgrubaco sum brgya dang sum cu so gcig la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa phog ste bslab pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhi la bkod/ de nas tsha ba'i dus la thug pa dang mi mang po'i 'du long gis thugs sun pa bcas re zhig spros pa bcad nas sku ngal gso mdzad/ sbyin bdag wang rat+na sidhi dpon blon gyi 'khor brgya phrag dang bcas mjal du phebs/ nyin kha shas bzhugs par thugs bag phebs pa'i gsung 'phros shin tu dmar ba byung / sbyin bdag pe'i zi nas bzhugs ring la ston 'khor tshang mar gzhis len bsnyen bkur gzabs shing snga phyir dbyar dgun gyi na bza' dang sku'i nyer spyad gos dang dngul sogs kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin rgya cher spros/ 7gong ma chen po nas thu'u bkwan hu thog thu da lo ri dwags kyi sa char nged kyi zhabs phyir 'gro dgos pas zhe hor du shog ces bka' babs pa bzhin zla ba bdun pa'i nang du ne+e hor la phebs te 7gong ma chen por mtshams zhus phul bar thugs mnyes pa'i bka' 156

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bzang po phebs/ lha khang ser por bzhugs gnas mdzad/ zhe hor du7gong ma'i skyed tshal gyi mdun ngos kyi ri rtser ligi'i dbyibs can gyi brag dbang phyug chen po'i rten du grags pa'i mngon mtshan can zhig yod pa de'i thad gar7gong ma chen pos bde mchog gi lha tshogs sku tshad byis pa lo bco lnga can gyi bong tshod tsam bzhugs pa'i blos bslang shin tu che ba gtsug lag khang dang bcas gsar bzhengs mdzad skabs7gong ma chen po nas rje 'di nyid la bde mchog gi skor gyi chos tshan zhig bskur ba gnang nas dpe 'di bde mchog gi lha khang gi tog nang du bcug na 'grigs min dang / 'grigs tshe bka' 'gyur gyi po ti gang gi nang du yod pa btsal nas7gong du gzigs 'bul zhus shig ces bka' babs pa bzhin bka' 'gyur nang nas btsal te gong du spyan 'bebs dang tog gi nang du bcug na legs tshul zhus par thugs shin tu mnyes/ las byed pa tshan tā zhin mngags nas hu thog thu nyid kyis phyag bstar gyis dpe cha 'di tog nang du chug cig ces bka' phebs pa'i dgongs pa bzhin du bsgrubs/ mi ring bar lcang skya rdo rje 'chang zhe hor du chibs bsgyur gnang / 7gong ma'i bkas yab sras rnam gnyis gtso mdzad de cho ga grwa pa drug cu dang bcas pas lha khang de nyid du rab tu gnas pa tshad ldan bsgrubs shing7gong ma chen po nyid tshogs dbur bzhugs te 'khor lo bde mchogagi tshogs 'khor shin tu rgyas pa lhan du mdzad/ de nas yon mchod lhan rgyas i le'i su me'i zhabs brtan gyi tshogs dbur phebs te 'cham gyi rtsed mo gzigs pa gnang / 7gong nas nyin re bzhin sku mdun pa kha shas re mngags nas gsol ja dang sha dang shing tog gi gsol ras stsal pa sogs bdag rkyen tshad las 'das pa gnang / lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gi sku mdun nas a lag sha'i tho yon no mon han lhun grub dar rgyas gyis zhus pa'i rim lnga 157

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/gdan rdzogs kyi bshad lung khong dang lhan du gsan/ thugs brel gyi sengs bar du sbyin bdag wang rat+na sirnyis zhus ngor dpon chen mang po la 'jigs chung gi dug dbang / 'jam dbyangs nā ga rak+ka'i rjes gnang / gtor ma brgya rtsa dang gsol 'debs par do'i 'phrang sgrol gyi khrid gnang / de nas ri dwags kyi sa char 7gong ma'i zhabs phyi bsgrubs te dgun pe'i cing du phebs/thugs dam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa sngar bzhin mi g.yel ba'i ngos nas7rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum po ti bdun dang /rje gong ma'i gsung 'bum po ti gcig / rje nyid kyi gsung rtsom sngar yod rnams dpar du bkod de chos sbyin mi zad pa'i sgo 'phar phyes shing / rgyal dbang gi gsung 'bum zung cu zi dang / gzhan rnams arji min la 'jog par mdzad/ de skabs pe'i zi 'chi med rdo rje'i shog gi grong sde zhig la me 'jigs byung skabs rje 'di'i sbyin bdag cig khang steng du phyin te pe'i cing phyogs su kha bltas nas rje nyid kyi mtshan lan gsum bos nas gsol ba btab pas me de kho rang gi khang ba'i nye 'khor du slebs pa dang rang zhir song ste lhag par yang yid ches 'phel ba byung 'dug / dgung lo sum cu pa me khye'i gnam lo'i rang zhal gsar ngoms kyi dus ston dang lha khang ser po'i smon lam skabs kyi gsung chos smon lam7gong ma'i sku mdun gyi ston mo'i thog khrang zhi dang me'i rtsed mo gzigs pa sogs sngar rgyun ltar mdzad/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang dgung lo lnga bcur phebs pa'i 'khrungs skar gyi dga' ston skabs rje 'di pas sger du nyin gcig gi ring gsol ston sogs kyi bsnyen bkur zhus shing 'khor lo bde mchog dkar po'i bdag mdun gye cho ga sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje 'chang de nyid bkur ste chen pos gdan drangs te/ seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri gzhom gzhig dang bral bar bzhugs su gsol/ dpal 158

༄/ / rje btsunablo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /'khoramyo bde mchog tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bor mos nas phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgyasapar phul/ rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems srung ma rnams dpung gi ra mdar spyan drangs pa la bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa'i gsol 'debs gdung shugs drag pos mdzad de sku'i rten rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe dpag med rnam rgyal ma thub pa me ru shi ṣa bde mchog dkar po bcas kyi snang brnyan li ma/ gsung rten tshe mdo gser bris/ thugs rten rnam rgyal mchod rten rnams ched gnyer gyis bsgrubs pa dang na bza' paṇa chasadang phu thung ma'i skor cha tshang re/ dngul gyi spyi blugs bzed zhal zhal dkar stegs bcas tshem grub kyi bzhugs gdan rgyal yol gos chen dang snam bu yug mang tsam/ dngulosrang stong phrag gcig dang brgya bcas spyan lam du bstar zhing dngul srang lnga bcu las bsgrubs pa'i maṇ+ḍal tshem bu can phyag tu bsnamasanas bstan pa spyi dang khyad par khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa'i mgon gcig pur rgyal pa tshe mtha' yas pa'i rang bzhin du zhabs pad g.yo ba med par brtan par bzhugs dgos pa'i gsol 'debs bla ma'i thugs rje 'khul nges pa gdung shugs drag po'i sgo nas zhubar mdzad pas rdo rje 'chang chen po thugs shin tu mnyes pa'i zhal bzhes bzang po gnang / phyi dro dngul srang brgya phrag gis rgyu sbyar te bla ma te ru ka dam ldan gyi slob ma'i 'khor dang bcas pas tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor/bde dgyes thun mong pa'i bshad rgyud saspuṭa nas 'byung ba ltar ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor mchod pa rgyas pas tshim pa/ snying gar ye shes kyi lha bdud rtsi myang pas tshim pa/ phyi rol gyi 'byung po'i tshogs gtor mas tshim pa/ dam tshigadang ldan pa'i dpa' po dang rnal 'byor ma rnams nang gi sbyin sreg gis tshim pa/ phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro ma rnams glu gar gyis tshim pa/ lus kyi 159

/ /gung thangabastan ba'i name'igasung 'bum/dkyil 'khor lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyis tshim pa ste tshim pa drug ldan du rolabar mdzad pa na rje btsun dam pa nyid nas zab cing brling ba'i mgur dbyangasakyi mchod pa phul ba la/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang nas lan gyi tshul du bslab bya'i gsung mgur thol byung du gnang ba tshogs 'khor grol rjes rje nyid nas zhal spod mdzad de yi ger bkod pa ni 'di ltar/ rje dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid/ / skyabs bslu ba med pa'i bka' drin can/ / mgon blo bzang bskal bzang rgya mtsho de/ / mi bdag snying pad+mo'i ze'u 'brur bzhugs/ / sngon las smon bzang po'i 'brel ba yi/ / rje sprul pa'i sku mchog rnam gnyis sogs/ / khyed dad ldan slob ma'i tshogs rnams kun/ / mi kho bo'i glu la snyan gtod mdzod/ / rten dal 'byor mi lus thob dang gcig /mchog sangs rgyas bstan dang mjal dang gnyis/ / mgon dge ba'i bshes kyis zin dang gsum/ / don 'di gsum rnyed dka' sems par mdzod/ /tshe mi rtag ri gzar 'bab chu 'dra/ / gnas ngan song gsum po ya re nga / /dusad lta rang dbang yod dus 'dir/ / chos rnam dag sgrub la brtson par mdzod/ / srid 'khor ba'i phun tshogs snying po med/ / yid brtan tu med cing ngoms mi shes/ / las nyon mongs drag po'i gzhan dbang can/ / 'di bsam nas skyo ba skyed par mdzod/ / rigs drug gi 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /thog med nas bskyangs pa'i drin can ma/ / don de phyir byams brtse shugs dran gis/ / thabs byang chub sems la 'bad par mdzod/ / ston nam mkha'i chu 'dzin lang long de/ / dgung mkha' las byung zhing mkha' la thim/ / dpe de nyid rgyud la bskor byas nas/ / phyi gzung ba bden med dran par mdzod/ / mdang gnyid kyis non pa'i rmi lam du/ / skyid sdug gi snang ba gang myong de/ / dus da nang gar song cha med ltar/ / sems bden med sgyu 160

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /mar shes par mdzod/ / sems gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa de/ / chos 'khor 'das kun gyi byed po yin/ / thabs zab lam gnad du bsnun pa las/ /lam sku gsum rgyud la bskyed par mdzod/ / mi kho bo'i kha pho ma lags te/ /pha ngag dbang mchog ldan bka' drin gyis/ / sems skye med 'di la blo kha phyogs/ / dus de ring dga' bas glu ru blangs/ / khyed dad ldan slob ma'i tshogs rnams kun/ / tshe 'di snang 'khri ba rgyab tu bsgyur/ / snying thag pas lha chosasgrub pa yis/ / rten dal 'byor thob pa don ldan mdzod/ / dus deng nasakhyang chub snying po'i bar/ / khyed dam tshig gtsang ba'i bu slob dang / /pha nged rang 'bral med dam chos kyis/ / dpal byang chub bsgrub pa'i smon lam bgyid/ / ces pa 'di'ang bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon dam pa thu'u bkwan sprul pa'i sku blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas nged rang 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs nas tshogs 'khor gye bsnyen bkur mdzad skabs mgur mchod phul ba'i lan thol byung du smras pa'i byed pa po ni〉lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje lags so/ / zhes pa'o/ / de'i tshe rje rang nyid dgung lo sum cur phebs pa'i dga' ston chen po yin pas hal ha dang tsho chen zhe dgu'i wang / pe'i le pe'i zi gung tha'i ji tha bu nang sogs7gong ma'i mtshams zhur 'ongs pa'i dpon po che phra brgya phrag mang po spyi 'dus kyis rje 'di nyid la brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te rgya tig mkhan po dpon g.yog nyi shu skor la zhabs brtan gyi 'don pa gsung bcug pa dang chabs cig tu dngos 'bul spam mtho ba phul/ pha ra yang gsol ston rgyas pa gnang / sbyin bdag har chin wang rat+na sirnyi dang cang pe'i zi gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas ho'u pe'i zi'i a ke 'jigs byed skyabs rnams kyis rang rang gi bzhugs gnas su spyan drangs nas dga' ston zhus thog wang gis dngul srang lnga brgya/ pe'i zi dang gung gnyis kyis dngul 161

༄/ /gungajangabastanapa'izlaname'igasu las/ srang nyis brgya re/ a kes dngul srang brgya tham pas mtshon so sos dngos gtsang ba'i rten 'byung gi 'bul ba tshan grangs mang po bstar te zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba nan tan btab/ mdo smad nas rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i mi sna gsol dpon dge bshes bstan pa dar rgyas/ dgon lung spyi'i mi sna wang dka' bcu ngag dbang chos skyong bla brang gnyer ba ngo g.yog rnams lcang skya rdo rje 'chang dang rje 'di ba yab sras rnam gnyis kyi mtshams zhur 'ongs don bzhin rje nyid nas mtshams zhu'i 'byor lan du 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po cher gos chen jin don yug bco lnga/ dngul srang nyis brgya/dgon lung gi tshogs chen 'du khang gsar gsos kyi thebs su dngul srang stong phragagacig / nyid kyang lo snga ma nas sa chu'i skyon lta bus sku gzugs rgyun ldan du ma bde ba la/ dgon lung spyi la dngul srang sum brgya/ rgyud pa spyi la dngul srang brgya dang lnga bcus mtshon mdo smad kyi dgon sgrub sde 'ga' zhig tu zhabs brtan sgrub thebs phon che tsam 'bul rgyu bskur cing / mi sna gsol dponadage bshes la zab chos 'ga' zhig dang thams cad la so so'i go bab dang bstun pa'i zang zing gi gnang sbyin gyis tshim par mdzad/ nub cig mnal lam du rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa byon nas khyod kyi nad 'di gzhi che ba 'dug / 'on kyang rgyal ba thams cad kyi mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po yin pas khong la gsol ba btab na skyon med 'gro/lcang skya rin po che la mgon po'i srung 'khor zhig zhus nas 'chang na legs gsung ba zhig rmis te phyi nyin lcang skya rin po cher de'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas srung 'khor bri thabs rdo rje'i go cha'i nang bzhin gyi mgon po'i srung 'khor bri sgrub mdzad pa zhig bka' drin stsal/ yang nyin gcig lcang skya rdo rje 'chang nas gsung bris shig phebs par mdang nged kyi rmi lam du me tog sna tshogs kyis gang 162

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /pa'i thang yid du 'ong ba zhig na nged rang slebs 'dug / nged kyi mdun du khyed kyang chos gos gyon lag pa thal mo sbyar nas bzhugs 'dug pa la zur nas mizil che ba zhig gis thu'u bkwan tshang gi skye ba sngon ma rnams su yi dam rta mgrin yang gsang dang 'brel che'ang skye ba 'dir yi dam de rgyang bskyur byas pas chos srid gang la'ang bar chad che ba yin zhes zer ba zhig rmis byung zhes gnang 'dug pa dang / skabs der rje nyid la'ang mnal ltas sogs shin tu 'tshub cing sku khams mi bde ba sna tshogs shig byung bas lcang skya thams cad mkhyen par sku tshe'i tshad sogs 'phral phugs kun gyi don du thugs dam brtag pa gsal po zhig thugs rjes gzigs dgos tshul zhus par nyin 'ga'i rjes su phyag ris dam 'byar ma zhig gnang 'dug pa 'di ltar ro/ / lags nyi ma kha shas brtag pa byas khul la/ nyid kyi yin skad kyi mkha' spyod ma'i sku stod gsal la smad mi gsal ba zhig dang / yang gsar rtsom mi rtag pa'i skor tshigs bcad tshig rkang shin tu thung ba 'ga' bstan byung ba sku tshe'i rtags yin pa 'dra snyam pa byung / slar zlog thabs la dmigs nas brtag pa byas par mgon po skyabs e phu rta zhig la zhon nas dgon lung du yong bar lcag sne gnasade'i shar lhor bstan nas sgrub gnas der lo shas bya bral gyis sgrub pa byas na bsring thub bam zer/ e thub byas pas blos thong mi thong gi snying rus la rag las zer nas 'dzum pa zhig byung / spyir sngon las 'ga' zhig dang 'phral rkyen chos 'brel yin min the tshom za ba'i bla ma zhig gi sems dang 'gal bas de'i chos skyong drag po zhig nyid kyi'ang chos skyong gtso bor gyur pas thugs 'khrugs par brten skabs skabs su tshab tshub mang zhing 'jig rten dang chos kyi bya byed la gegs mang ba zhig yin pa 'dra/ yig brgya/ ltung bshags/byang chub sems sbyong / dkar 'gyed zang zing gi sbyin gtong / bla ma'i 163

༄/ /gung thang bstanami'i name'i gsung 'bum/rnal 'byor sogs la 'bad pa gal che zhing skabs bstun rim gro gzhan rnams thugs dang bstun/ smras pa/ slob ma dbang chen dad pa che/ / bla ma rdzun chen snying khams che/ / rnam rtog che la 'khrul snang che/ / zog chen kha yi rdzun chen 'dis/ / khyod thugs mnyes na mnyes pa des/ / khyod zhabs yun du brtan gyur cig / khyod thugs khros na khros pa des/ / nyon mongs rnam rtog dbyings su phags/ / the tshom za na zos pa des/ / sdeg 'bras 'grub par ma gyur cig / bden par sems na bden pa des/ / don dam chos dbyings rtogs gyur cig / sgyu ma'i mi yi 'khrul snang la/ / rdzun pa'i gtam gyi rnga chen sgra/ / srid gsum dri za'i grong du bsgrags/ / bden 'dzin tho yor 'gyel 'di rmad/ / lha rdzas dang bcas phul zhes pa ste/ bka' gnang bzhin gyi rim gro rnams gnad smin du mdzad pas 'tshub ltas rnams rim gyis zhi ba byung /de sngon tsam la rje nyid kyi mnal lam du'ang bud med dmar po zhig gis/ a yig dang po shar ba'i tshe/ / rgya nag 'khun pa'i sgos 'debs byed/ / gsal byed gnyis pa'i shar mtshams su/ / kha ba can gyi mun pa bsal/ / sde ba bcur 'khyud rgyan du bkod/ / 'khor lo bzhi pa'i rtags kyang 'char/ /yongs la gsang bar ma nus pa'i/ / dharma sur+ya'i ming gis gsal/ / da dung bajod kyang 'gyangs mi srid/ / bslab bya la chung mi za sgo/ / sku rim gyi rgyun 'khor khyad bsad na/ / tshe bdud kyi bar chad rtsom pa 'dra/ / go bar gyis la nyams su longs/ / zer ba zhig byung 'dug pa bla ma rnams kyi gsung brtag dang phyogs mtshungs pa'i 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan gnad can zhig yin par mngon/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang la rje nyid nas 'phreng ba'i dbang sogs chos bka' du ma'i gsol ba btab yod pa'i thog chu bzang rin po che'ang phebs nas gsol ba btab pas mtshams sbyar te zla ba gnyis pa'i nang du zhu ba 164

༄7/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /po rnam gnyis dang pe'i cing gi bla ma 'ga' zhig/ phyogs nas 'dus pa'i bla dpon drag zhan mang po dang bcas ser skya brgya phrag tsam la rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang sta gon dang bcas pa brgyud ldan bla ma dam pa'i phyag len mthong brgyud bzhin shin tu smin rgyas su stsal pa gsan/ 'khor lo bsgyur drug gi dbang gi skabs slob ma'i gtso bo dbang ste gsal 'god par gsungs pa bzhin du rje 'di nyid rus pa'i rgyan sogs rdo rje 'dzin pa'i chas dang bcas te dbang stegasal bzhugs su bcug / lcang skya rdo rje 'chang 'khor lo'i mgon por bzhengs pas dbang gi lha tshogs spyan drangs te gdugs dang rgyal mtshan sogasamachod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs dang bcas rnam rgyal chen po'i bum pa la sogs pa'i chu dbang bskur zhing shis pa brjod pas me tog gi char phab ste chos kyi rgyal srid du dbang bskur bar mdzad do/ / rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bka'/ / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yis bsdus pa'i bcud/ / rdo rje btsun mo'i thugs kyi sras khyod la/ / rdo rje slob dpon te ru ka yis gtad/ / de tshe mkha' dbyings til gyi gang bu ltar/ / yongs gar sras bcas rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ / shis pa brjod pa'i glu dang me tog char/ / sa gsum kunakhyab sgyu ma'i rol pa bzhin/ / de nas bde mchog dril bu lha lnga/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu/ bcu gcig zhal rnams kyi dbang dang / jo lugs sgrol ma nyer gcig / bde mchog sngags btu'i rjes gnang bcas gsan te mjug tu dpon g.yog tshang mas tshogs 'khor kyang lhan du mdzad/ rje nyid dang chu bzang rin po che mtshan sgog mkhan po rnam pa gsum la rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsang brgya can las 'byung ba'i dpal ldan dmag zor gyi rgyal mo las bzhi'i lha mos bskor ba'i rjes gnang dbang bzhi dang bcas pa thun mong ma yin pa spyan dmigs shugs drag po dang bcas gnang ba legs par gsan/165

༄/ /gung bang bstanaba'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/zla ba gsum pa'i nang du rje nyid la shar rtse no mon han ngag dbang tshul khrims kyis zhus ngor zhu ba po dang pho brang nang gi bla ma 'ga' zhig / yung hwa' gung dang lha khang ser po'i grwa pa mang tsam la sgrub thabs rin 'byung gi rjes gnang chosaskyong gi skor yan chad rjes gnang nyis brgya lhag cig stsal/ rab byung sgrub mi sum cu so lnga/ bsnyen rdzogs sgrub mi nyer gsum la sdom pa 'bogs par mdzad/ 7gong ma'i bkas rgyal sras lnga pa gnam du gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi 'don pa'i tshogs dbu mdzad par gos dang dngul gyi gsol ras rgya chen po stsal/ nub cig mnal lam du mi dmar po zhig gis khyodakyis nga la da bar du phrad par mi 'ong ba ci yin/ nga la phrad na khyod kyi don dag gal chen zhig nged kyis myur du sgrub rgyu yin pa la zer ba zhig byung /phyi nyin lcang skya rin po che la rgyu mtshan zhus par khran min gyi bkwan lo'u ye de mi lam du yong ba zhig yin pas de'i 'phrul yin pa 'dra/ kho mchod na 'phrin las kyang myur ba zhig yin gsung bas de'i lha khang du phebs te mchod pa dang snyan shal phul/ brtag sgril bskor nas mo 'debs spyad cig 'dug pa la mo btab nas mo bshad 'don bcug par/ don chen zhig 'grub rgyu smin mtshams kyi thad du slebs yod pas mi ring bar mig lam du mthong yong zer ba zhig babs/ de nas ring po ma lon par sa ga zla ba'i tshes gsum gyi nyin gnam kyi lha 7gong ma bdag po chen po nas rje nyid la jing zi'u chan zhi hu thog thu zhes bod skad du rnam dag bslab ldan bsam gtan gyi slob dpon 'phags pa chen po zhes pa'i mtshan gyi gzengs bstod dang / dngul gyi tham ga che ba bsngags brjod kyi gser yig dang bcas sku gong ma'i lung las ltar bka' drin la te rim gyis rka thi sogs gnang rgyu'i bka' bzang po phebs pas snga ma'i mnal ltas dang mo gnyis ka de la blta bar 'dug gsung / lugs srol 166

༄/ /rje btsunablo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /la ti thi rka thi chan thi gsum ni 'jam dbyangs 7gong ma rang gi slob dpon gyi gnas su bkur ba'i gzengs bstod bla na med pa yin pas tshul 'di ni kun gzigs lnga pa chen pos/ phal spyod skad ngan brgyal yang ri dwags gtsor/ / stobs 'byor ram gyi mdangs su bsgyur min pa'i/ / gong ma'i lung las cho rigs rtsal gsum kun/ / rdzogs pa'i gdong lnga pa de khyod du khums/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ la la khrims med kyis phugs rer rang gis rang gzengs bstod pa dang / pho brang du rjes re bzhag tsam nas gong ma'idabu bla zhes 'dod rgyal du sgrogs pa rnams dang mi 'dra bar rgyal khams yongs la ngoms chog pa'i che ba zhig go / bsod nams dpung bas 'dzin ma rnam gnon 'jam dbyangs mi yi rje bo'i bka' lung gis/ / jing zi'u chan zhi thu'u bkwan hu thog thu zhes rnam dag bslab ldan bsam gtan gye/ / slob dpon 'phags pa chen por bsngags pa'i dril chen phyogs kyi 'khor lor bsgrags pa na/ / de nyid ji bzhin don du gzigs pa'i rgyal ba ma lus mgrin gcig 'di skad ces/ / 'di ni shes rab mchog gi bsam gtan pa/ / tshul khrims dag pa'i mgo la 'dug pa po/ / rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob nges don rnyed pa zhes/ / bstod pa'i 'phreng bas yang yang bsngags par nges/ / yon tan dpal gyi che ba lha yi rnga/ / tshangs pa'i lung gi dbyu gus bskul ba'i dbyangs/ / 'dzam gling kun khyab grags pa'i sgra brgya yis/ / cher rlom 'ud kyi phreng ba gcig car bsnyal/ / 'on te 'dod khams bdag po'i mgo na gar gyis rol pa'i he ru ka / / ngur sprig gos gyon rnal 'byor ma mchog kha ṭ+wāṃ zol gyis 'chang byed pa'i/ / bde ba'i 'khor lor brtan g.yo mtha' dag spro zhing sdud pa'i byed po de/ / sus kyang 'degs dang smod par mi nus chos kun dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid/ / 'on kyang gdod nas mi 'gyur chos kyi dbyings/ /167

༄/ /gung bstanaba'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/kun rdzob cir yang 'char ba'i rgyu 'bras dang / / zung 'jug rten cing 'brel 'byung ri mo ni/ / srid zhi'i phun tshogs rol pa cir yang 'char bar 'dod gnyis skyes tshogs kyis phyag bya'i gnas/ / zhabs sen chu shel myu gu lus phra ma/ / sa dbang ral pa'i nags su rtsen pa bzhin/ / lha chen gtsug na zla ba'i cod paṇa mdzes/ / zhes bya ba'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /lnga pa'i tshes la har chin du phebs/ sbyin bdag wang nas ri khrod gsar ba'i gzim gshag gi skor legs par grub yod par ma zad wang rang gi pho brang du'ang rje nyid la ched dmigs kyis gzim khang nyams dga' ba zhig gsar bsgrun mdzad 'dug pas dbyar gyi ring bzhugs gnas de gnyis la res mos kyis bzhugs nas thugs dam shin tu 'phel ba byung / 'ja' klong 'khyilabar/ har chin wang gi rgyab ri'i sul gyi gnas dben pa zhig tu ri khrod cig bzung nas thog mar phyin skabs der slebs ma thag gsol ja zhus tshar phral nyams dang rmi lam 'dres pa zhig la gnas de'i gzhi bdag yin nam snyam pa'i ban+de gzhon pa zhig gis rin po che'i snod/ rin po che'i myu gu dang rgya'i skad du ling gri tsho'u zer ba'i bcud len gyi rdzas shig yod pas bkang ste 'bul ba dang / de na gzhi bdag klu mo zhig kyang yod nyams shar gsung ba'ang 'di skabs yin par snang / lcang skya rin po che la ri khrod kyi ming zhus par bde chen rab rgyas gling zhes thogs gsung ba de bzhin btags/ tshes bcu zhig dang bstun sbyin bdag wang la rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i siju ra'i byin rlabs stsal/ mchod yon lhan cig tu tshes bcu'i mchod pa tshar kha shas gnang zhor du phyag len rnams ston par mdzad pas de nas bzung ste wang gis kyang sku tshe hril por yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs ma chad par gnang 'dug / de nas zhu ba po so so'i ngor snga phyir wang 168

༄7/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i ga4 gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /gtsos pa'i don gnyer can mang nyung ci rigs la nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang / jo bo'i lugs kyi sgol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang / bde mchog dkar po/ tshe dpag med dkar po/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ so sor 'brang ma/ sher phyin ma/ seng gdong ma/ khyung nag / spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal rnams kyi rjes gnang dang rdo rje sems dpa'i bzlas sgom gyi khrid/ mkha' spyod zhal bzang lta ba'i smon lam dang smyung gnas cho ga / sgo drug pa'i gzungs sogs lung thor bu mang po bcas gnang / 'di lo char dkon pas khrus gsol dang klu gtor sogs mang du gtong rgyu'i zhal ta gnang ba bzhin bsgrubs par sprin 'dus kyang rlung drag pos gtor nas 'bebs su ma ster ba la rje nyid nas chu mig tu rgya nag chu 'khor bskor bas de ma thag drag char chen po babs/ gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyi skyes skar gyi nyin dga' ston du gdan drangs khrang zhi'i rtsed mo bstar te dga' ston rgyas pa byas/ gung dpon po la sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang de'i 'dra sku spos snagasogs rten 'byung gi skyes 'ga' zhig bcas gnang / dpon pos brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten gos chen gyi bzhugs gdan rgyab yol na bza' nyer spyad gos chen yug lnga dngul srang nyis brgya lnga bcu bcas phul/ gung gi rikhrod sogs su phebs te nyin kha shas bzhugs/ thu med pe'i zi'i ho sho'u nas ched gtad kyis 'ongs pa'i bsgrub bya lnga bcu skor la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa gnang / khā pa ri mad kyi khyim du gdan drangs nas 'bul nod gzabs/tshur lam tha bu nang don grub rdo rje'i khyim du gdan drangs te gsol ston bsnyen bkur dang dngul srang brgya tham pa shing rta g.yogs can gdan dkar dmar gos tshos gnyis ma'i bzhugs gdan bcas phul bar 'dod chos sogs kyis 169

༄/ /gung bstan pa'ithonapogasung 'bug tshim par mdzad/ wang dang gung gi lha khang gi tshogs su mar 'byed gya nom pa gnang ste sgo drug pa'i gzungs rgyun chags su btsugs/ bka' 'gyur dang spyo bskang sogs zhabs brnyan kyang mang po bsgrubs/ rje nyid nas sbyin bdag wang yab sras kyi sku'i rim gror zhi rgyas dbang gsum gyi sbyin sreg sogs rim gro 'ga' zhig bsgrub pa gnang / wang gi lha khang du tā bla ma blo bzang dge 'dun gyis sbyin bdag byas te ma ṇi ril bu sgrub rgyur bla ma dge 'dun tshangs dang thar gtsos pa'i dpon thon mang po bcas ser skya'i tshogs pa stong phragamang por spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang dang ma ṇi'i cho ga'i lung dang dmigs khrid gnang ste tshogs dbu mdzad/ har chin ja sag gung che che ga gi gdan 'dren pa 'ongs pa bzhin phebs/ gung dpon po dang e phu rnam rgyal/a ke tshe dbang / a ge dbang rgyal sogs ho sho'u'i dpon blon che phra brgya phrag mang po'i bsu ba rim pa du ma dang thab bsu ser sbrengs bcas ja sag gung gi yā mon du phyag phebs/ nyin kha shas bzhugs ring la skye pho mo khri phrag mang por phyag dbang dang mtshan dang gzungs sngags rna lam du sgrogs pa ma ṇi'i bzlas lung dang khas len bskor ba bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor bcas gnang zhing / dmigs bsal gyi chos bka' bsgo gsung brtag sogs so so'i 'dod pa bzhin du yid tshim nges pa bka' drin bskyangs/ dpon yum sras rnams la sgrol dkar 'od zer drug sgrags sogs rjes gnang 'ga' zhig gnang / spyi chos su gung dpon po sku mched gsum gtsos pa'i ho shu'i bla ma dang dpon dpon mo blon 'bangs bcas khri phrag brgal bar tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang sta gon dang bcas pa stsal/ sbyin bdag ja sag gung gis dbang yon du maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten/ gos chen tshem grub kye bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gos chen yug lnga dngul srang lnga brgya stag lbags 170

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /gcigabu la ga'i pags pa dgu/ rnga mong gcig rta pho rgod dgu tshan gsum nor dgu tshan gnyis lug dgu tshan bzhi bcas dang gzhan dpon blon drag zhan so so nas kyang dngos 'byor gyi mthul nod gzabs/ de nas tshur phebs te sbyin bdag wang gis gsar bzhengs sgrol ma nyer gcig gi sku brnyan la rab gnas mdzad/ wang chen mos snga phyi'i brtan bzhugs kyi 'dul bar dngul srang sum cu las bsgrubs pa'i maṇ+ḍal nang mdzod sku gsung thugs rten/bzang gos dras bsgrubs kyi bzhugs gdan rgyab yol tshar gsum dngul gyi rin po che sna bdun na bza' phu thung ma bubs gnyis paṇa chas tshang ma gos kyi zhabs lham 'bob bcas cha bzhi sku'i nyer spyad tshang ma/ dkar yol dang shel snod mdog dang dbyibs mi 'dra ba du ma gser zangs kyi spos phor gos chen yug bcu gnyis dngul srang stong phrag gcig don yod zhags pa bcas phul/ wang gi lha khang du rab byung nyer gcig bsgrub bya brgya dang nyer bdun la dge tshul dang brgya dang nyer brgyad la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa phog ste tshangs spyod kyi dpal la bkod/ ston zhe hor du phebs te7gong ma chen por mtshams zhus phul/ 7gong nas nyin re bzhin sku mdun pa mngags pas gsol ras sogs gzigs pa cher gnang / nyin gcig rdo rje 'chang dang rnam gnyis7gong ma'i mdun du 'bod pa gnang ste skyed tshal gyi gzim khang chung ngu zhig tu rgyal po dbus dang lcang skya rdo rje 'chang g.yon du bzhugs rje 'di g.yas su bzhugs te thugs bag phebs pa'i gsung gleng mang du gnang /mdun du rgyal po dang thag nye zhing rgyab na shel gyi pad sdong chen po zhig 'dug pa dang thag nye bas gang gis bsnyen dka' ba gnyis kyi bar du chud de de nyin las khegs pa ma byung gsung / de'i nye 'khor nas gcig gis rgya skad du rdul chen po 'dug chag chag mi 'debs pa ci yin zhes skad log chen po rgyag gin 171

༄/ /gung tha bstanapa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/'dug par/ 'di nas 'di ltar byed thub pa zhig yod ma thang ba la dgongs pa byung / phyir phebs te lcang skya rin po cher zhus pas de 'dra'i dbang chen zhig yod gsung nas bzhad mo gnang zhing de na bya 'dra mi 'dug gam ces bka' 'dri phebs par/ bya dkar po lug tsam zhig 'dug zhus pas de o ru su'i bya zhig yin skad log rgyag mkhan kho red gsung / skyed tshal nang ma rnams su blon po che ba rnams kyang rang dgar song mi chog na lugs srol shes mkhan zhig la 'di'ang dpe med pa'i bdag rkyen yin par snang / mtshan sgrog mkhan chen blo bzang dar rgyas kyi zhal snga las lcang skya ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan gyi gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung gsan/ 7gong ma'i zhabs phyir ri dwags la 'gro mi dpon blon drag zhan mang po la 'dod chos dang bka' bsgo sogs kyi sgo nas 'dun pa yongs su bskangs/ 'di res khu khe su me la bzhugs pa yin pas pad dkar 'dzin pa'i phyag dpar mang po yod pa la nyid kyi phyag bstar gyis sku 'dra mang po dpar 'debs par mdzad/ ri dwags kyi sa char7gong ma'i zhabs phyi bsgrubs par gnam gshis sogs sgo gang thad nas rten 'brel legs tshogs kyis brgyan par gyur/ slar pe'i cing du phebs pa na snga sor rgyal sras lnga pa gnam du gshegs pa'i rkyen gyis7gong ma chen pos bka' tham bdag rkyen gnang ba'i dga' ston phral du sgrub stabs ma 'grigs par lus yod stabs/ bcu pa'i yar tshes la 7gong ma'i bkas mdzodanas ston mo'i gsol ras khrang zhi'i rtsed mo pa dang bcas gnang thog bsngags brjod kyi gser yig gsar ba mong gol cur gan gyi dpon po 'ga' zhig la skyel du bcug pas bka' drin bdag rkyen blo yul du mi chud pa lta bu stsal/ dga' ston chen po de nyid dang rje nyid dgung lo sum cur phebs pa'i dga' ston chen po gnyis chabs cig tu mgo tshugs te thog mar lcang skya rdo rje 172

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /'chang nas maṇ+ḍal nang mdzod sku brnyan bzhugs gdan rgyab yol nor bu don yod zhags pa gos chen dang dngul gyi legs skyes gya nom pa dang bcas brtan bzhugs 'bul du bcug pa gnang / de rjes rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyi sku tsha 'dan ma sprul sku sogs zur stu zi'i zhabs phyi ba rnams dang yung ha' gung gi mkhan po shar rtse no mon han dang rgya tig mkhan po sogs gra tshang so so'i bla ma las sne grwa pa rnams dang / lha khang ser po g.yas g.yon gyi tā bla ma dang las sne grwa mang bcas gzhan yang pho brang phyi nang gi lha khang so so'i bla ma che chung las sne grwa ba mang po dang cang pe'i zi'i e phu bde legs bzang po gzhan 'brel ba yod pa'i rgya dang man ju'i mi drag du ma rnams mu mthud nas dngos gtsang ba'i rten 'byung gi legs 'bul rgya chen po dang bcas mjal kha zhus/ mchod rten dkar po'i cha gan zhabs drung gis sger du mjal nas bka' 'gyur mtshal dpar po ti brgya dang drug tshang bar phul ston mo gang rgyas btang /7gong nas gzengs bstod tshad med gnang ba'i gtam snyan lha'i rnga bo che phyogs kun tu grags pas chen po hor gyi yul gru nas sbyin bdag tu gyur pa'i wang pe'i li pe'i zi gung tha'i ji tha bu nang thu sa lag chi ca khir chi sogs dang /slob mar gyur pa'i bla ma dang zhabs drung sku skye dge bshes dka' ram gu thi sogs ser skya drag zhan ris med dngos dang tshab ci rigs bgrang las 'das pa dgun dus hril por nyin ltar chu'i gnyer ma bzhin gcig rjes gcig non gyi tshul du 'ongs te rten 'byung gi legs skyes spel ba'i dga' ston chen po bar ma chad pa byung / dga' ston chen po dang chabs cig par tsardon jo bo mchod rten dkar po sogs rten 'gang che ba rnams la mchod 'bul rgya gang che/yung dgon dang lha khang ser po sogs pho brang phyi nang gi lha khang so so'i dge 'dun la mang 'gyed gyi bsnyen bkur gya nom pa dang nyin kha shas re'i mtshams 173

/ /gung ca bstanapa'i nami'i gsung 'bum/nas ngan slong stong phrag mang po la bza' btung gi sbyin pa chad med du gnang ba sogs yar mchod mar sbyin gyi dge tshogs kyang rgya cher spel/ dga' ston gyi mjal ba'i zhar la lung rjes gnang khrid sogs zhu mkhan mang du byung ba thams cad so so'i blo dang 'tsham pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis yid kyi bum bzang yongs su gtams par byas/ thag ring bo'i yel chi rnams zang zing gi gnang sbyin gyis tshim par mdzad/ 7gong ma chen po'i sku'i gcen ye re thu wang gis yā mon du gdan drangs nas dga' ston dang legs 'bul zhu ba gnang / wang chen mo yab sras kyi zhabs brtan du zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sogs sku rim 'ga' zhig sgrub par mdzad/ mtsho sngon phyogs su gtam gleng chen po byung ba rim gyis gong ma'i snyan du son par brten nyes can nyes med mang po dngakhyad par rje nyid kyi sbyin bdag gal chen zhig la skyon 'byung nyen che bar sbyin bdag nas ci drag gang drag la thug ste gsang stabs kyis 'phrin pa btang nas rje nyid la mkhyen du bcug par/ nyid nas thugs khral chen po'i ngos bla ma dkon mchog la ched dmigs kyi gsol 'debs nan tan mdzad kyin yod pa la mi ring par 7gong nas rje nyid kye sbyin bdag cang pe'i zi la gtam gleng de nyid thag gcod par 'gro dgos tshul gyi bka' babs pas rje nyid nas pe'i zil lam chos su seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi rjes gnang dang gtam gleng de'i skor la zhal bkod zhib rgyas dang khyad par sbyin bdag de nyid gtad gnyer legs par mdzad/ cang pe'i zis kyang sde nyid kyi bka' spyi bor babs te bya ba de nyid bkra shis lugs legs su thag bcad cing nyid kyi thugs rjes sbyin bdag de la skyon cung zad kyang ma byung / lo 'dir ri dwags kyi sa cha nas sbyin bdag cig stabs nyes kyis 7gong ma'i dgongs phog byung ste khrims byu mo gcod grab byas par/ mtshan mo btson 'don sgrol ma'i cho ga tshar gcig 174

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /gnang bas phyi nyin nyes skyon ci'ang ma byung bar dgongs phog las grol 'dug / phyis su zi lang astan du bsdad pa'i khus zan ye chung dus su kho dang na tshod mnyam pa'i dpon phrug thams cad la 7gong ma'i bdag rkyen mang du byung na'ang kho la spyan bskyang gang yang ma byung bar thabs gzhan ma rnyed nas rje nyid la nan tan zhus par bka' bsgo zhig gnang / de'i phyi nyin kho la gong nas tog cig gnang ba sogs 'bad rtsol chen po la ma ltos par spyan dmigs re tsam gyis skye bo mi 'dod pa thog tu babs pa rnams dbugs 'byin pa dang 'dod pa btsal bas ma rnyed pa rnams kyi re ba skong bar mdzad pa'i rnam thar ches mang bas so sor brjod kyis mi lang ngo / / de'ang gzhan gyis grogs bya ba dang thabs la rmongs pa sel ba sogs don bya ba bcu gcig gis sems can gyi don sgrub pa rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa yin la/ dgos pa'i grogs su 'gro mi byed/ / ces sogs las ldog pa'i bslab bya gal che ba zhig kyang yin no/ / der ma zad 'jig rten ya rabs kyi lugs srol la'ang rang la re ltos 'cha' ba de nyid yal bar mi 'dor ba zhig nges par dgos te/ dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ rgud tshe snying la re ba dag / rnam par bkod nas grogs thob pa'i/ / grogs po 'bras med nyid gyur te/ / gang zhig 'tsho ba de yis ci/ / grogs la phan pa'i dpal dang ni/ / yongs la phan pa'i nor dag dang / / 'jigs la phan pa'i srog gang yin/ / de dag 'tsho ba legs pa yin/ / zhes 'phags skyes po'i yal 'dab las 'byung ba bzhin no/ / lo 'dir sgrol dkar gsum thugs rje chen po gcig sgol ljang gtso 'khor gsum rnams sku tshad che tsam dang / de las chung ba'i sangs rgyas so lnga bde gshegs brgyad sogs sku brnyan lnga bcu skor gser zangs las bsgrubs te nyid kyis gzungs 'bul dang rab gnas mdzad/ yang chi'i kun dga' rwa ba shel sgo 175

/ /gung thang bstanapa'i name'i gsung 'bum/dang bcas ched gnyer bsgrubs pa'i nang du bzhugs su gsol/ dgung lo so gcig pa me phag gi lo gsar sogs sngar 'khyud bzhin byas/ 7gong ma'i bkas tsajan jo bo'i smon lam gyi tshogs dbu mdzad nyin bdun gyi ring gsung chos smon lam gnang ste 'jug tu gtor rgyag mdzad/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gi 'khrungs skar gye nyin brtan bzhugs phul te zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol 'debs dang dgung grags sel phyir tshe dpag med kyi rjes gnang yang zhus/yus mi yon la gong ma'i sku mdun gyi ston mor phebs te khrang zhi dang me'i rtsed mo gzigs/ zla ba gnyis pa'i nang du ri bo rtse lnga la phebs phu tsha ting du ja sag bla ma'i khang par bzhugs/ phu tsha ting dang lo'u ho zi sogs grwa pa'i dgon pa che chung bcu gnyis la dngul srang stong phrag gcig dang / hwa shang gi dgon pa che ba bcu dang chung ba sum cu so lnga la dngul srang lnga brgya bcas dngulasrang chig stong lnga brgyas mang 'gyed dang de dag la yod pa'i rten byin can rnams la dngul srang brgya lhag gis mchod pa dang / yang dngul srang brgya lhag gis kun spangs ri khrod pa rnams la cha rkyen dang ngan slong brgya phrag mang po la sbyin gtong sogs gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin rgya cher bsgrubs/zla ba phyed gnyis kyi ring bzhugs nas gnas dang rten rnams la dkar chag ltar zhib mjal mdzad de bstan 'gro spyi dang khyad par 'brel thogs kun gyi don du thugs smon nan tan mdzad/ gsum pa'i nang du lcang skya rdo rje 'chang yang der chibs bsgyur gnang bas yang yang sku mdun du phebs nas chos kyi bka' mchid zab cing rgya che ba mang du gnang / skabs skabs su phan tshun nyams 'char gye gleng mos thugs kyi skyo ba sangs par mdzad/ lo snga ma zhig nas rje 'di nyid sku cung zad ltom ba byung ste yun ring song zhing lcang skya rdo rje 'chang nas sman bcos dang lhag par me btsa' sogs kyi dpyad sku dngos kyis 176

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /mdzad pa dang / phral phral du rim gro gang dgos rnams bka' lung brtse bas bskyangs bzhin pa yin kyang bskung gzhi gting dag tu ma song bas rdo rje 'chang la 'di'i rkyen gyis sku tshe'i bar chad du 'gyur ba'i dogs pa sogs yod med brtag pa nan zhus byas pa la lcang skya rdo rje 'chang nas nged kyi rmi lam du dpon po chen po zhig gis thu'u bkwan tshang gis nga la rta dmar po zhig ster dgos zer ba zhig rmis byung bas rgyal po'am jo bo rgyal mtshan ba gang rigs kyi rnam pa yin pa 'dra de la rta zhig btang na legs pa 'dug / yang mi lcags kyi rkang ba can zhig gis thu'u bkwan sprul skus red ar la gtang zer ba zhig byung bas khyod kyis klu zhig la drag las bgyis yod pa 'dra/ klu dang 'gras pa gtananas mi legs gang ltar yang a mdo ba'i phyogs kyi chos skyong ngam gzhi bdag 'ga' zhig gi sems 'grang ba dang re 'khang yong ba'i nyams dang /klu gnyan zhig la phog thug byung yod pa lta bu'i nyams shig 'dug pa ma gtogs sku tshe la skyon yod pa zhig gtan nas ma shar/ 'on kyang lo 'dir nyid kyi bdun zur gyi dgung gegs yin pas rang gi dgongs pa bar chad de zhabs brtan mang tsam sgrub zhor du dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur byas na legs tshul bka'aganang ba bzhin/ slar yang ri bo rtse lnga'i phu tsha ting dang lo'u ho zi sogs grwa ba'i dgon pa bcu gnyis la mang 'gyed gnang ste zhabs brtan mang po bsgrubs/ de'i mu mthud nas zhabs brtan sgrub thebs dngul srang stong phragasted dang gsum bgo bsha' byas nas pho brang phyi nang gi dgon pa rnams dang zhe hor gyi dgon pa rnams dang har chin ho sha'u 'ga' zhig gi dgon pa che chung mang po dang / mdo smad du dgon lung dang chos bzang ri khrod sogs dgon sgrub sde 'ga' zhig bcas la rim gyes bskur te zhabs brtan rgya chen po bsgrubs/ ri bo rtse lngar rdo sgo'i mdun ngos kyi ri la ring bsrel gye mchod rten 177

༄/ /gung thang ba napa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/zhig yod pa dngul srang brgya lhag gis gsar gsos mdzad/ gzhan yang sats+tsha 'bum grangs bsags pa dang srog blu grangs bsags pa sogs dngul srang lnga stong tsam gyis zhabs brtan phon che bar bsgrubs/ yul gyi lha srung la rta kham pa zhig tshe thar du btang zhing klu zhig la phog thug 'dug gsungs pa snga sor har chin du char dkon pa'i skabs klu la ar gtad byas pas de ma thag drag char 'jigs su rung ba dang thog kha shas kyang 'bab pa byung bas klu des khon du bzung ba yin par dgongs te klu gtor sogs kyi bcos pa'ang mang du bsgrubs/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gi sku mdun nas bde mchog dkar po'i rjes gnang gsan cing yab sras lhan du tshogs 'khor kyang mdzad/ gnas mjal skabs dkar chag la zhib tu gzigs pas rtse lnga ba dpal ldan grags pas mdzad pa zhig 'dug pa cung zad bsdus shing / rgya'i yig tshang nas bsgyur ba zhig snang ba sgyur nyes pas go dka' ba bcas dgongs par ma son pas lcang skya rdo rje 'chang la de'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkar chag rgyas pa zhig kyang snyan bskul zhus/ rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyi zhal bkod ltar bcad rgya'i ngos bde mchog dkar po'i tshe sgrub mdzad/ de dus yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs sogs 'di 'dra byung zhes gsal bar gsungs pa mi snang yang gzigasasnang ya mtshan can mang po byung yod par gdon mi za ste/ phyis su zhal slob 'ga' zhig la nged rang ri bo rtse lnga la 'gro skabs dad pa u tshugs kyis phyag skor la 'bad pas sdig pa dag pa'i mtshan ma mang du byung ba dang /gnas 'brel byas nas bdun mtshams shig la bsdad par rig pa dwangs pa'i tshod kyis lha'i spyan dkar nag dang rgyan cha'i khyad par yan chad dngos su mig gis mthong ba lta bu'i gsal snang thon byung pa dang / mtshan mo zhig phu tsha tingagi skor bar song skabs rdo skas chen po'i steng du ngal gsos bsdad par 178

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /mchod rten chen po'i za ra tsag gi thad nas 'od dkar po glog 'khyug pa ltar rgyangs kyis thon te rten gyi gtso bo 'jam dbyangs lha khang la thim pa dang /de nas rgyangs kyis thon te mchod rten dkar po la thim pa sogs 'od dkar po phan tshun du yar 'khyug mar 'khyug byed pa'i mthong snang byung ba dang /skabs gzhan du mdza' 'ong phan tshun rtse ba lta bu'i mthong snang 'ga' zhig byung pa yin pas de rnams gnas kyi byin rlabs yin pa 'dug gsungs pas kyang shes par snang ngo / / byang chub sems dpa'i spo nas gnas kyi bstod pa 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba'i gsung mgur zhig kyang thol byung du ljags rtsom mdzad/ 'de res hwa shang gi lha khang gog po zhig tu thub pa'i sku rgya gar li ma g.ya' dang rdul chags pad gdan dang zhabs bkag med pa'i khong stong zhig sus kyang snang rung ma byas par phyag dar khrod du 'phangs yod pa gzigs te hwa shang la sku de'i lo rgyus dris par snga ma lha khang 'dir me 'jig cig byung dus ma tshags bar lus pa zhig red zer yang / rtsis med byed pa thugs kyis ma bzod par blu yon yid mgu ba gnang ste gdan drangs bad gdan gsar bsgrubs dang gser chab gsol zhing gzungs 'bul rab gnas mdzad de thugs dam rten gral du bzhag pa phyis su rab byung dge tshul slong gi sdom pa nam gnang dus sku 'dra de kho na bshams nas de'i mdun nas sdom pa 'bog pa sogs thugs gtsigs che ba gnang / 'di'ang rgya 'dul 'dzin pa'i rten rnams rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan pa'i phyag tu 'byor ba dang cha 'dra ba'i rten 'brel dang dgongs gzhi can zhig yin par mngon/ phu tsha ting dang lo'u ho zi sogs dgon pa so so'i bla gra spyi 'dus kyis chos 'brel dang ri khrod pa rnams sger du rang rang gi 'dod chos zhus pa so so'i re ba bskangs/ja sag bla ma sogs lha khang so so'i bla ma dang las sne rnams dang phu tsha ting gi 179

༄/ /yong bstanaba'isgronaḥ gsung 'bum/dem chi gnyer ba sogs sku mdun du bcar sdod kyis phyag g.yog sgrub mi drag zhan rnams go bab dang bstun pa'i gnang sbyin gyi tshim par mdzad/ zla ba bzhi pa'i nad du ri bo rtse lnga nas phyir 'khor te pho brang brgyud nas har chin ho'upe'i zi'i ho she'u'i chu tshan la phebs pa'i lam du 'grog cang gi nang du cung zad 'thum 'phras lta bu zhig gnang skabs/ mi dmar po rta dmar po zhon pa lag na ru mtshon ba dan dmar po lhab lhub g.yo ba thogs mkhan zhig rje nyid kyi sku mdun du 'ong nas glog 'khyug pa bzhin yal song bas sprin ring rgyal po'i rnam pa yin dgongs te de la gsol mchod kyi cho ga zhig kyang ljags rtsom gnang / chu tshan khar nyin nyer gcig gi ring bzhugs te chab tshan gyi 'phrod brten mdzad smon lam bla ma bkra shis dar rgyas dang e phu dge legs bsam 'grub sogs slob ma sbyin bdag nang ma 'ga' zhig sku mdun du bcar sdod kyis zhabs phyi bsgrubs/ smon lam bla mas zhus ngor ser skya'i tshogs pa la bla ma mchod pa'i khrid gnang / mjug tu smon lam bla mas brtan bzhugs phul te dngos 'bul gya nom pa btegs/ zla ba lnga pa'i nang du pe'i zi 'chi med rdo rje'i yā mon du gdan drangs pe'i zi'i a ke 'jigs byed skyabs gtsos pa'i dpon blon mang po la dzasta la dkar po'i rjes gnang stsal/ dpon blon rnams kyis dngos 'bul spam mtho ba spyan lam du bstar te smon lam bla ma btsos pa'i grwa pa sum cu skor gyis bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga gsung ba dang sbrags nas brtan bzhugs rgyas pa phul/ shi ni su me la gdan drangs nas dpon chen mkhan po'i gdung rten la rab gnas zhus/ de ga'i grwa pa sum cu skor la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang gnang ste dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi phyag len dang rta dbyangs thams cad rje rang nyid kyis khrid par mdzad/ thog mar rje nyid kyis dbu mdzad de bla slob lhan du sgrub mchod tshar gcig gnang / de 180

༄7/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /nas thebs 'jog pa gnang ste yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu'i dus su sgrub mchod gtong rgyu'i srol btsugs/ de ga'i dgon chung du mar mang 'gyed gnang ste sgo drug pa'i gzungs rgyun chags su 'don rgyu'i bkod khyab stsal/ tshur lam un 'dur ho'u gung dang ja sag gung rnams kyis rang rang gi yā mon du gdan drangs nas bsu skyel 'bul nod sogs bsnyen bkur yang dag bsgrubs/phan tshun phebs lam du mi drug dang 'byor ldan du mas bsnyen bkur bar byin rlabs 'dod chos sogs kyi sgo nas rjes su bzung / phyogs 'dus kyi mjal ba grangs las 'das par phyag dbang chos 'brel sogs sngar rgyun bzhin gnang ste thar pa'i sa bon bskrun/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes mgor sbyin bdag wang ran+ta sarnyi'i yā mon du phebs wang gis gsar bzhengs kyi rten 'ga' zhig la rab gnas mdzad/ zhu ba bo so so'i ngor wang gtsos pa'i don gnyer can mang po la bde mchog dkar po tshe dpag med dkar po dang dmar po tshe ring mched lnga sogs lha du ma'i rjes gnang dang ljags lung thor bu mang po gnang /wang gi zhabs brtan du rim gro 'ga' zhig kyang bsgrubs/ bdun pa'i tshes gsum nas wang yum sras bcas dang lha khang gi tā bla ma gnyis gtsos pa'i ser skya drag zhan shin tu mang po la lam rim bde lam gyi khrid nyin bdun gyi ring gnang / de nas ri khrod gsar par phebs te zla ba gcig gi ring bcad rgya dam po gnang nas thugs dam la shin tu gzhol bar mdzad/ mtshams grol rjes wang gtsos pa'i skal ldan gyi slob ma nyung 'dus la rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma gser chos 'phob dang bcas pa'i khrid nyin gsum gyi ring stsal te zab lam bdud rtsis smin par byas/ mjug tu mchod yon rnam gnyis dang cho ga grwa pa nyi shu bcas kyis dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod bdag 'jug lag mchod tshogs 'khor dang 181
