༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/bcas rgyas par phyag len du bstar/ bshol zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu drug la ri khrod nas tshur phebs wang chen mos snga phyi'i brtan bzhugs kyi 'bul bar maṇ+ḍalakha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyal yol dngul las bsgrubs pa'i bkra shis rtags brgyad lhung bzed na bza' bub gsum shel sogs kye cha byad mang po/ gos chen bcu dngul srang stong yid bzhin 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bcas phul/ brgyad pa'i tshes la zhe hor du phebs sum pa mkhan chen dang dgon lung spyi'i mi sna lo dkar nang so dang btsan sa rab 'byams pa ngo g.yog 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che'i mi sna rab 'byams pa blo bzang 'byung gnas rnams 'byor te/ 7gong mas bka' tham gnang ba'i dga' ston du bskur ba gnang ba'i legs 'bul gyi dngos po rnams brtan bzhugs lugs su phul/ so so'i 'byor lan du gos dang dngul gyi skyes mang tsam dang el chi rnams gnang sbyin gyis tshim par mdzad/'dis mtshon pa'i snga phyir mdo smad dang mtsho sngon phyogs nas bla dpon sbyin bdag gra rigs drag zhan du ma'i legs 'bul gyi zhu yig dngos skyes bcas bar ma chad pa lta bu byung / gu run wang dang mtsho sngon chin wang sogs so sos kyang sger du brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te legs 'bul gya nom pa zhus/ be'i zi 'chi med rdo rje 7gong ma'i bkas hal ha'i cang jun du 'gro rgyur lam chos su rjes gnang dang bka' bsgo srung ba sogs gnang /7gong ma'i zhabs phyir ri dwags kyi sa char 'gro mi drag zhan mang po la rjes gnang dang bka' bsgo sogs rang rang gi 'dod mos ltar stsal/ dgun pe'i cing du bzhugs te thugs dam sngar rgyun bzhin bskyangs/ de skabs mnal lam du rang phyogs kyi gzhi bdag yin pa 'dra snyam pa'i 'brog pa rta zhon mang po zhig gis mda' dar g.yab cing yar la mchod zer nas gdangs ring 182

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /por gyer ba'i gzims rmis shig byung ste da ni mi ring bar rang yul du 'gro thub pa 'dra gsung / rje rang gi 'khrungs skar gyi dga' ston nyin lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gi sku mdun nas sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang gsan/ sbyin bdag wang rat+na sirnyi pā rin wang cang pe'i zi e phu bde legs bzang po dge legs bsam 'grub sogs dpon chen bcu skor la rig byed ma'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang stsal/ mkha' 'gro mar grags pa ong nyod gzungs skyid dpon mos nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs dang khrid zhus pa'i 'dun pa bskangs/ lo 'dir sman bla dang mi 'khrugs pa seng ge'i nga ro mi tshad lhag tsam re/ rje'i sku khru gang ba sgrol ma khru gang ba sogs yi dam lha'i sku brnyan che chung sum cu so gsum dang mchod rten khru gang ba gcig bcas 'di rnams gser zangs las bsgrubs shing / sku 'dra che ba gsum la shing gi seng khri rgyab yol gser tshon dang bcas spus gtsang bsgrubs pa dang / rje'i rnam thar sogs zhal thang yang mang po bzhengs/ hwa' khrang zi nas sngon gyi li ma dus gsum sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa byams pa rnams khrud re yod pa/ bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad khru gang re yod pa rnams gang 'dod kyi yon phul te gdan drangs/ gzhung gi mkhan nang gdong du rgyal dbang thams cad gzigs pa chen po nas 7gong mas bka' tham gnang ba'i dga' ston du nang mdzod gcig sku brnyan byin can gnyis paṇa chen rin po che'i 'khrungs rabs kyi zhal thang bcu gsum rgyal dbang gi gsung 'bum po ti bdun/ gzim spos chun po nyer lnga gzhung spos chun po nyer lnga sprugs bzang po yug bcu ther ma legs pa yug gsum/ zhwa ser lnga chos gos sogs kyi gsol ras sbam mtho ba dang / sngar bod nas gnang ba'i gzengs bstod la gdugs bsnan pa'i lung las dang bsngags brjod shin tu che ba'i bka' 183

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'i sgron 'a gsung 'bum/tham sogs gzigs pa shin tu che bar gnang / de mtshungs paṇa chen rin po che nas kyang bka'i glegs bu gnang rten gya nom pa bcas dang / rgyal sras rin po che/ sems dpa' rin po che/ mnga' ris sprul sku/ rgyal tshab bde mo sprul sku/ mnga' ris gung / bka' bzhi gung sogs bka' blon rnams dang / yongs 'dzin khri rin po che/ a khu lags/ sku bcar dge 'dun/ sku mdun mkhan po sogs gzhung gi mi drag du ma dang / sgo mang sogs grwa tshang ris med kyi bla ma dge bshes drag zhan mang pos sku 'dra spos snam sogs rten 'byung gi dngos skyes tshar du dngar ba dang bcas pa'i legs so'i zhu yig mang du 'byor/ de skabs chos srid kyi 'phrin las grags snyan sogs gang thad nas dbyar mtsho ltar nyin re bzhin je rgyas su song yang sku khams mi bde ba de mjug ma dngas par ma zad yun gyis bab je mthug tu song bas nyid kyi thugs dgongs la'ang 7gong mas bka' drin bdag rkyen gnang ba la bsam na da dung dgongs pa zhu rgyu snga song ba lta bu bab mi mtshungs kyang / pho brang gi sa chu mi 'phrod pa dang sku gzugs rgyun du ma bde ba la bsams na sran btsugs nas bzhugs te bcos su med pa'i mtshams shig la gtugs na don med pas/ de bas da lta nas 7gong ma chen por rang gi gnas tshul mkhyen du bcug ste dgongs pa zhus nas rang yul du phebs pa rang dga' 'o snyam du dgongs te thog mar lcang skya rdo rje 'chang la dgongs bstun zhus/ rdo rje 'chang gis kyang rgyu mtshan sngar nas mkhyen bzhin pa yin pas mdzad thabs dang bral te yab sras gnyis bka' gros kyi steng nas gnang ba zhu rgyur thugs thag bcad/ rim pas thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas gnas tshul rnams 7gong ma'i snyan du gsol te dgongs pa zhus par gong nas rib tsam phebachog pa'i dgongs pa khrol te slar bskung gzhi lhag med du dngas pa dang 184

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bstun phyir yongs dgos tshul gyi bka' phebs pas thugs shin tu mnyes pa byung / rje nyid kyi sbyin bdag tu gyur ba'i sog po'i dpon po mang po dang khyad par du rtsa ba'i sbyin bdag wang rat+na sirnyi'i thugs shin tu 'khang bar gyur kyang sku gzugs kyi don du song stabs gnang thabs dang bral ba byung /skabs der sku khams mi bde ba sna tshogs byung ba'i 'phral rkyen ni rje nyid chos srid kun la mkhyen pa nam mkha'i mtha' ltar rgyas shing mdzad pa 'grin las dbyar gyi chu mtsho bzhin du dar drag pa dang / khyad par 'jam pa'i dbyangs 7gong ma chen po nas tshad med pa'i spyan bskyangs gnang ba'i grags pa mtha' dbus kun tu mched pa na re dogs kyi rgyar chud pa 'ga' zhig gis rang rang la sos mi bde ba'i rtsa rkyen ci 'dra yong snyam don med pa'i rnam rtog mched de mngon du mdzes lam gyi dngos skyes sogs gang legs zam ma chad pa lta bur byung yang / lkog nas rnying ma'i ngan sngags mkhan de 'dra'i las sbyor kho na la gcig tu 'bad pas sngags nus thon pa mang po bsags te mthu dang ngan sngags kyi sbyor ba kho na la brtson ba shugs drag po rang gis khas blangs pa'i dam sdom las kyang lhag par ji srid mtsho'i bar du rgyun chad med par byas 'dug pa'i rkyen gyis yin snang ste/ sku khams ltems pa nam byung res bzhin pha rol po de'i gnas gzhi yin nam snyam pa'i khang pa zhig tu zhugs nas phyir thon mi thub pa'i thugs mis yang yang byung / 'on kyang de 'dra nam byung res kyi skabs 'ga' zhig tu rgya dpon brjed bag can zhig dang / skabs 'gar btsun pa zhig dang / skabs phal cher rje bla ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa dngos phebs nas skar khung la skas 'dzegs te rje 'di pa'i phyag nas khrid de skarakhung nas 'don par mdzad pa yang yang mis/ yang lan cig de nas mngags sam snyam pa'i dmag dpung chen po zhig glo bur du slebs te nyid kyang 185

༄/ /gung thang bstanami'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/ci drag la thug par/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po ches nyid rang rta zhig la bskyon/ rje de nyid kyang rta dkar po zhig bcibs nas nged kyi rjes la shogagasungs khong rang sngon la phebs/ rje 'di pa rjes la zhugs phyin pas sus kyang mi thar pa'i brag g.yang chen po zhig la thon nas spangs ljongs nyams dga' pa zhig tu sleb pa'i thugs mis byung / pha rol po de dag nas bsam sbyor ngan pa shin tu shugs drag la rgyun chags pa gang byung gis bzlog tu med pa'i tshod de lta bu byas na'ang nyid la sku khams cung zad ltems pa re'am/mnal lam cung zad 'tshub pa re lta bu ma gtogs de dag gis yid la brnag pa ltar sku tshe dang mdzad pa 'azin las kyi gegs su 'gro ba ma byung bas rje nyid kyi zhal nas kyang / de tsho'i bsam sbyor gyi tshod yin na nga rang ming tsam yang rjes shul med par 'gro dgos pa'i tshod yin te/ las 'bras kyi stobs dang bla ma dam pa'i skyabs 'og nas nga rang da dung yang bde bar 'tsho ba 'di bzhina'i khong tsho ang yig pa sangs ma rgyas nye gnas sangs rgyas pa'i dper song ba 'dra zhes gsungs/ dgung lo so gnyis pa sa pho byi ba'i lo gsar dga' ston sogs rgyas par mdzad/ rang yul du pheb rgyur thag bcad pa'i stabs kyis lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gi 'khrungs skar nyin dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol/ gos dang dngul sogs kyi dngos 'bul spam mtho ba spyan lam du bstar te zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba nan tan 'debs par mdzad/ thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod kyi zur bka'i dbang chen sogs chos bka' 'ga' zhig gsan/ lo gsar gyi brel ba sangs pa dang 7gong ma chen por thon phyag gi mtshams zhus phul bar bka' bzangapo phebs te gos chen sogs kyi gsol ras gya nom pa bka' drin stsal/phu yan bla ma dpal 'byor hu thog thu dang yung dgon mkhan po shar rtse no mon 186

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /han sogs bla chen 'ga' zhig dang / gu dun e pā rin e phu bde legs bzang po dang cang pe'i zi sogs dpon chen 'ga' zhig gis rang rang gi bzhugs gnas su gdan drangs nas gsol ston zhus te/ bla ma rnams kyis pheb rdzong gzabs shing dpon po rnams kyis dngos 'bul rgya chen po brtan bzhugs lugs su phul te zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol 'debs dang /khyad par du rang yul la phebs nas ma 'gyang bar pho brang phyogs su chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur ba'i gsol ba nan tan btab/ de mtshungs gong ma'i mtshams zhur 'ongs pa'i phyi log gi dpon blon brgya phrag mang po spyi 'dus kyis bla grwa rnams la zhabs brtan gyi bden tshig gsung bcug pa dang sprags nas bdog pa'i dngos po spam mtho ba btegs te gsol ba sngar bzhin btab/ sger mjal zhu mkhan phyi log gi dpon blon mang po dang pho brang nang gi bla dpon ser skya du mas nyin mang po'i bar du mu mthud bar phyag dbang dang bka' chos bka' bsgo skyabs 'jug sogs zhus pa mtha' dag gi 'dun pa skong par mdzad/ thugs brel gyi sengs bar du rgyal dbang yab sras kyis gtsos pa'i bod kyi bla chen mi chen drag zhan mang po'i yig lan 'char can dang 'phar ma rnams bsgrigs nas mkhan nang la sprad/ pho brang phyi nang gi lha khang so so nas mang 'gyed thog lam gyi rim gro mang po bsgrubs tsan dan jo bo dang mchod rten dkar po sogs rten rnams la mchod mjal dang thugs smon rgya cher mdzad do/ / smras pa/ rgyal phran bye bas phyag 'tshal gyis bslang ba'i/ / rdul dmar chu mthongs 'gog pa rgyal po'i khab/ sum rtsen lta na sdug gi grong khyer la/ / 'phya ba gsal byed gser gyi pho brang cher/ / mos pa tha dad mchog dman 'gro ba'i rigs/ / bgrang yas til gye gang bu phye ba bzhin/ / khams kyi rjes 'gro spyong tshul sna tshogs kyang / / mog po rta yi spu bzhin brjod las 187

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'izlanayo gsung 'bum/'das/ /'on kyang tshon brgya gsal pa'i me long bzhin/ / chos srid zhi drag thabs kyi rol ba 'bum/ / rang rang blo dang 'tsham par 'jug pa las/ /lhag pa kun tu bzang po'i spyod de gang / / mi yi tshangs pa dgyes pa'i kurdo 'dzum/ / skal bzang bsod nams dad pa'i chu gter spel/ / rnam gsum 'khorama'i cha shas yongs gang zla/ / legs byas shar ri'i rtse nas dal gyis 'phags/ / legs ldan zur phud nor bu'i cod paṇa gyis/ / bsten bya bsod nams 'khor los mtshan pa'i zhabs/ / mngon par bskyod pas srid na dge legs kyi/ / gser bzang pad+ma'i dga' tshal spro ba bzhin/ / gzung 'dzin 'ching ba'i rgya las rnam grol cing / / kun rtog spros ba zad pa gdod ma'i gshis/ / gnyug ma 'od gsal sems kyi rang bzhin la/ / bde chen rgyan du shar ba'i dpa' bo gang / / 'khor ba'i pha mtha' zhig pa'i mthas gtugs par/ / rdzogs min gsang gsum rol ba sgyu ma'i gar/ / mkha' khyab gdul bya'i mos pa bzhin bsgyur yang / / 'bad dang rtsol ba mi mnga' lhun gyis grub/ / ces rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum rmad du byung ba'i mdzad bzang 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal gyi cha tsam gtam du byas pa rtogs brjod pad+ma dkar po las gser gyi rgyal khab chen por phebs shing don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul gyi 'dab ma ste bdun po'o/ /188

༄༅/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /༄7/ / 'dab ma brgyad pa/ rten bzhengs sogs bya ba las kyi 'khor lo mdzad pa'i tshul/de nas phebs chas kyi gra bsgrig tshags su tshud pa dang bstun bla ma gnyis pa'i nyer bzhi'i nyin pho brang nas bla dpon drag zhan mang po'i chibs skyel dang bcas thon/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang thang shan du bzhugs yod par thon phyag la phebs lam chos dang bka' bsgo skyabs mjug sogs zhus/ rdo rje 'chang nas bslab ston zhib rgyas dang dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal kha btags/ thugs dam rten bde mchog dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku brnyan lo rgyus can/ / spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal dang phyag bzhi pa/ thub pa'i sku brnyan rnams khru gang re yod pa/ gser bris ma'i tshe mdo dang rdo rje gcod pa/ bka' gdams mchod rten/ mgon chos sogs chos skyong gi zhal thang lnga rnams kyis sna drangs te gser dngul gos chen sogs kyi phebs rdzong rgya chen po gnang /zhe hor du mtshan sgog mkhan rin po ches gtsos pa'i lha khang so so'i bla ma las sne rnams kyis bsu skyel dang ston mo gzabs shing spyi sger so so nas phebs rdzong dang bcas mjal kha zhus/ lha khang so sor mang 'gyed gnang ste zhabs brtan bsgrubs/ de nas rim gyis har chin du sbyin bdag wang rat+na sirnyi'i yu mon du 'byor nyin nyi shu tsam bzhugs/ wang yum sras sogs dpon blon che phra du mar sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang dang bde mchog dkar po'i tshe dbangasnal/ dge bsnyen bcu gcig rab byung nyi shu dge tshul bzhi bcu lhag bsnyen rdzogs nga gsum bcas bsgrubs te thar ba'i sa bon bsgrun/ rang 189

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/yul du chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur ba'i gtam thos te ho sho'u so so nas brtan bzhugs dang phebs rdzong 'bul mi bla ma dang dpon blon 'byor ldan gyi sbyin bdag dngos dang tshab ci rigs mang po dang / mjal kha dang bka' chos bka' bsgo gsung brtag srung ba sogs zhu mi dad ldan gyi ser skya khri phrag du ma har chin nas thon rag tshun la nam langs nas mun sros kyi bar nyin 'khyongs sugatong dgos pa byung / mi dag dang 'byor ldan rnams kyis dngos 'bul rnams brtan bzhugs lugs su phul nas zhabs pad brtan pa dang slar yang shar phyogs tsi na'i yul 'dir myur du chibs kha bsgyur pa'i gsol ba nan tan btab bar bka' lan bzang pos tshim par mdzad/ sbyin bdag wang rat+na sirnyis phebs ston rgyas pa zhus shing brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga dang sbrags nas dngul srang lnga bcu'i maṇ+ḍal nang mdzod/ sku gsung thugs rten/ bzhugs gdan rgyab yol/ na bza' bubs brgyad/ gsar bzos dngul gyi 'khor lo dang rdo rje/ 'dod yon sna lnga/ zhal dkar stegs bcas/ bzed zhal spyi blugs nas sis rgyal pos gnang ba'i tsardon las bsgrubs pa'i mar me'i 'od khang cha/ bse ru'i rwa shel dkar sngon tsardon ka bed dkar yol sogs kyi spyad pa ya mtshan can sum cu skor/ dngul srang chig stong lnga brgya gos chen bzang ba yug dgu bu la ga'i pags pa dgu nor bu don yod zhags pa dang bcasaspyan lam du bstar te/ zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa'i gsol 'debs dang / / khyad par du rje nyid rang yul du rib tsam phebs nas ma 'gyang bar myur du chibs kha bsgyur ba'i gsol ba nan tan btab par bab bstun gyi bka' lan dang zhal bzhes bzang po gnang / de nas zla ba gsum pa'i nyi shu gnyis kye nyin sbyin bdag wang rat+na sirnyi/ ja sag gung che chig /gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas sogs phyogs tha dad kyi bla ma dang dpon blon drag 190

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /zhan rta pa stong phrag brgal ba dang lhan du dpon g.yog tshang ma har chin wang gis mon nas thon/ wang gi lha khang gi dge 'dun pa dang bcas ser skya'i tshogs pa stong phrag mang pos myur du chib4kha bsgyur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/phebs lam du wang dang gung a ke don 'grub rdo rje rnams kyis rim pas thab skyel zhus/ gung bstana'adzin dar rgyas kyis yumon du gdan drangs nas zhag gnyis bzhugs gung yum sras bcas la sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang stsal/dpon pos brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te dngul srang nyi shu'i maṇ+ḍal bar mdzod spyan ras gzigs tshem grub/ bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dngul srang lnga brgya dang lnga bcu gos chen yug dgu/ shel snod 'ga' zhig sna dam legs pa drug gos khug nyer gcig don yod lcags kyu bcas phul te zhabs pad brtan pa dang myur du chibs kha bsgyur ba'i gsol ba btab/gung gi gcud rtag brtan a ges kyang sger 'bul gzabs/ e me gen tā thon gyis gdan drangs nas phebs ston dang brtan bzhugs phul te thon sras yum bcas la sgol ljang gi rjes gnang stsal/ ja sag gung che chig gis phebs lam nas ja thab zhus te gung 'khor bcas dang nyo sho'u tha dad kyis chibs skyel zhu mi drag zhan brgya phrag mang po'ang de nas phyir log / sbyin bdag wang rat+na sirnyi dang gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas sogs ngo g.yog gis 'bral mi phod pa'i ngang nas nyin gsum gye lam du zhabs phyir 'brangs par rje nyid nas slar nged rang yong dus thag ring du bsu pas chog / da res 'di nas phyir phebs rogs mdzod ces gsungs ba bzhin song nyod kyi sa cha zhig nas gsol ja dkar spro zhus te sems 'phrang bzhin du phyir log / ong nyod wang dpon blon gyi 'khor brgya phrag dang bcas chibs bsur byon te ba yan ho sho'u'i lha khang du gdan drangs nas phebs ston zhus shing dngul srang brgya tham pa gos 191

༄/ /gungajangangastanaba'ithoname'i gsungababum/chen yug lnga rta sga 'khor can bcas rta dgu phul/ dpal ldan po'i zi sogs drag zhan so so nas kyang 'bul nod gzabs/ yong nyod gzungs skyid dpon me sras po'i li dang bcas lam nas gsol ston dang phebs rdzong zhus/denas rim gyis do lon no'ur du phyag phebs/ lcang skya bla brang du bzhugs gnas mdzad de zhag mang du bzhugs lha khang shar nub so sor gdan drangs nasatwa bla ma dang dge 'dun rnams kyis phyag dbang dang gsol ston 'bul nod zhus/ lha khang gnyis kyi dge 'dun rnams dang phyogs nas 'dus pa'i drag zhan gyi khrom chen po la spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang dang sgyung gnas kyi cho ga'i lung / don gnyer can bla gra mang po la nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang gcod gdan thog gcig ma'i khrid dang lung bcas gnang / sgyung gnas dkar po phyogs brgyad la bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun nyis brgya drug cu re lnga'i 'tsho ba sbyor rgyu'i zebs gnang / bu lig thu no mon han dang mjal phrad gnang zhing khong gi bla brang dang shi re thu'i bla brang so so nas gsol ston phebs rdzong sogs rgyas par zhus/ a ba ga co rig thu wang gnas brtan wang bkra shis mi 'gyur pe'i li ho'u chid yer ti ni wang dang bkra shis rdo rje wang / u cu mu chin wang dang bo'i li khi shig then ja sag tshe dpag nyang tshang hu thog thu ko'u kya zhabs drung sogs thag nye ring gi bla dpon drag zhan dngos dang tshab ci rigs mu mthud nas 'ongs te mtshams zhus dang phebs rdzong bstar/ u cu mu chen wang gis sras gung ma hā su kha mngags nas dngul srang brgya dang rnga rta sogs dngos 'bul btegs pa'i thog mkhar sngon par du skyel mi dang rta yul gyi mthun rkyen bsgrubs/ phyag mdzod ngag dbang tshul khrims lo snga ma nas gzugs gzhi ma bde ba 'di res do lon no'ur nas ma 'tsham par lha khang shar nub sogs su dge ba bsgrubs shing u cu mu chin lha ram pa la sbyin sreg byed 192

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bcug ste rus bu la rang nyid kyis spyang chog mdzad nas sats+tsha 'deb tu bcug / lcang skya rin po che sogs skyes bu dam pa rnams la bsngo zhus dang /rje rang nyid kyis zhag zhe dgu'i bar du nyin re bzhin mkha' spyod ma'i sbyang chog ma chad par gnang / har chin nas chibs skyel du 'ongs pa'i a ke gnyis gtsos pa'i ser skya drag zhan nyis brgya skor la tshe dpag med kyi rjes gnang stsal/drag zhan so sor go bab dang bstun pa'i rta dang dngul gyi gnang sbyin gya nom pa gnang / de nas do lon no'ur nas tā bla ma dang dem chi dge bskos sogs kyis chibs skyel ja thab dang bcas thon/ har chin a ke gnyis sogs chibs skyel pa byings rnams ja thab steng nas rje nyid shar phyogs su myur du chibs kha bsgyur ba'i gsol 'debs ljags rtsom zhus yod pa de'i lung dang bka' bsgo zhus nas phyir log / ku lu khu lo'i zhabs drung blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis do yon no'ur du bzhugs ring la sku mdun du bcar sdod kyis phyag g.yog bsgrubs shing 'di'i dgung mo khong dang u kur hā bstan 'dzin gnyis kyis sgar thog tu gsol ston drangs te stobs can du ma shed 'gran du bcug pa sogs kyi rtsed 'jo bgyis/ lam zhor du cha har tsho ba so so'i ka li tā dang u kur tā sogs mi drag dang 'byor ldan du mas rim pas gdan drangs nas dkar spro dang dmar spro'i gsol ston thog chi ge drangs te glu dang rol mo'i mchod pas mchod cing dngos 'bul phangs med du btegs pa sogs bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs ba zhus/ byin rlabs 'dod chos sogs yid tshim par gnang bas mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob/ ku lu sha ri'i yo ga tsa ri bla mas lam thog tu bzhugs gur gra bsgrigs bgyis par gdan drangs nas gsol ston dang bdog pa'i tshan grangs bstar/ de dag gis rta ul sogs kyi skyel ma dang mkhar sngon shi re thu'i bla brang nas bsu mar mngags pa'i rta yul bcas 193

༄/ /gung ba bstanapa'i name'i gsung 'bum/kyi steng nas mkhar sngon du phebs/ shi re zhabs drung jo bo che chung gi tā bla ma dngalas sne chos skyabs ti yun chi'i zhabs drung bcas rta pa mang po'i chibs bsu dang dge 'dun gyi ser sprengs dang bcas thog mar yi be jo mo'i lha khang du babs/ khu re bdun gyi bla gra rnams der 'dus nas phyag dbang chos 'brel zhus shing gsol ston dang 'bul nod phul/ de rjes shi re thu'i bla brang dugadan drangs pa bzhin phebs nas der bzhugs/ ja lang brgyad gtsos pa'i mi drag mang po mjal du 'ongs par phyag dbang bka' bsgo sogs 'dod mos bzhin gnang / phyi nyin zhabs drung la bzhed chos 'ga' zhig gnang nas bcag mal mdzad/ skye pho mo'i khrom chen po la phyag dbang chos 'brel dang gson gshin gyi bsngo ba gnang / shi re thu zhabs drung gis gzhis len bsnyen bkur dang 'bul nod gzabs/ sbyin bdag har chin wang gi skyel mi ja lang no mon tshang dang khā rab brtan sogs tog can 'ga' zhig ul mi u'ig gi shing rta dang bcas mkhar sngon nas phyir ldog rgyur bka' bsgo dang byinaten srung mdud sogs stsal/ / or du su'i yu lā gra bsgrigs thog nas phebs chos skyabs ti yān chi'i dgon par gdan drangs bsru skyel yon 'bul gzabs shing 'dod chos zhus pa'i re ba bskangs/ or du su cun gar pe'i zi rnam rgyal rdo rje drag zhan gyi 'khor du ma dang bcas rma chu'i 'gram du chibs bsur 'byor te ja thab gra bsgrig bgyis bar gdan drangs nas gsol ja dkar spro zhus/ de nas pe'i zi rnam rgyal rdo rje dang ha lad pe'i zi bstan pa dar rgyas wang tshe ring rdo rje u shing tu pe'i zi bkra shis tshe ring rnams kyis rang rang gi ho sho'u la gdan drangs pa bzhin rim pas phebs par dpon chen rnams rang rang gi sa tshigs su tsha zhag gi gra bsgrig dang rang rang gi bla ma dang dpon blon 'bangs mi'i 'khor mang po dang bcas pas bsu skyel ja thab rim 194

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /pa du ma dang / dge 'dun gyi ser sprengs kyis mdun bsu ba dang bcas bkur ste chen pos brgyud mar gdan drangs/ ho sho'u sosor nyin kha shas re bzhugs rang rang gis bka' chos dang gsung brtag sogs gang zhus 'tshem med du gnang ste 'dun pa rdzogs par mdzad/ cun gar pe'i zis mtsho 'gram zhig tu gur phub par ston chen zhus thog glu dang rol mo rtsal 'gran rta rgyug sogs rtsed sna du ma bstar/ khong gis zhus pa bzhin mtsho la rab gnas mdzad pas rten 'brel legs pa byung / u shing pe'i zi'i ho sho'u'i spyi chos su gdugs dkar gyi khrom dbang gnang / ta lad no yon bla ma blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang wang gi paṇ+ḍi ta bla ma blo bzang lhun grub sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos rje gu thi du ma dang / dpon chen so so'i sku'i nye rigs the'i ji tha bu nang rnams dang thu sa lag chi ca khir chi sogs blon po che phra 'byor ldan gyi skye bo mang dang bcas pa mtha' dag gis gus 'dud lhur blangs te bdog pa'i dngos po yod 'bul lta bu zhus bka' chos sogs kyi gsol ba btab pa rnams la chos sbyin lhug par gnang zhing mjal ba dkyus ma'i tshogs la'ang phyag dbang gi mjug tu sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang gzungs sngags zab mo rnams rna lam du sgogs pa ma ṇi'i bzlas lung dang khas len bskor ba dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub kyi rgyur bsngo ba sogs rgyas bsdus ci rigs ma chad par mdzad de phan pa'i lam la sbyar/ gson gshin gyi bsngo ba dang bka' bsgo skyabs 'jug sogs zhu mkhan rnams la so so'i 'dod mos bzhin stsal/ dpon chen so sos gzhis len bsnyen bkur gzabs shing rang rang gi ngos nas brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te dngos 'bul du pe'i zi rnam rgyal rdo rjes dngulasrang drug brgya rnga rta zhe bzhi/ pe'i zi bstan pa dar rgyas kyis dngul srang brgya nyi shu rnga rta bco brgyad/ wang tshe ring rdo rjes dngul srang brgya rnga rta 195

༄/ /gung thang bstanaba'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/bcu dgu/ tā pe'i zi bkra shis tshe ring gis sku gsung thugs rten na bza' cha tshang dngul srang lnga brgya/ gos chen gsum rnga rta sum cu skor bcas phul/dh+ri~X ༵/nad ༷༷sa /nga rjeX rdordo ༵ ༵ṭ+wāṃ sa late ga/ṭ+wāṃl dradhi/ ༵༵ ༵ rdo //༷ dīdī hang kin tā pe'i li dang ja sag dbang rgyal tshe brtan rdo rje rnam gnyis rang rang gi blon 'khor dang bcas phebs te lam thog tu bzhugs gur gra bsgrig bgyis par gdan drangs nas gsol ston dang 'bul nod phul ba la phyag dbang 'dod chos sogs dgongs bzhed ltar gnang / or du su'i dpon pornams snga ma nas pho brang du 7gong ma'i mtshams zhur phebs thengs rer rje 'di nyid la chos bka' dang skyabs 'jug yang dang yang du zhus thog dngos 'bul nga mang du 'degs bzhin pa yin pas thams cad 'brel che ba'i sbyin bdag yin pa dang / khyad par du o thog wang don grub rgya mtshos lo ltar sku dngos dang yel chi ci rigs kyis brtan bzhugs re ma chad par phul zhing bka' chos kyang mang du gsan pas chos dang zang zing gi 'brel ba gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i sbyin bdag dwangs ma yin pas snga ma pho brang du bzhugs dus gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan yang yang phul kyang sa khang ring stabs7gong mar dgongs pa ma zhus par phebs mi thub la/ dgongs pa zhu stabs 'phral du ma 'grigs par lus pa 'di lan rten 'brel rang 'grig tu song gshis u shing tā pe'i zi'i thog nas o thog wang don grub rgyu mtshos gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs/ wang nas rta bsu rim pa mang du mngags pa'i mthar wang rang nyid bla ma dang dpon blon gyi 'khor brgya phrag mang po dang bcas chibs bsur 'byor te bzhugs gur dang ja thab gra bsgrig bgyis par gdan drangs nas gsol ja dang dkar spro zhus/ de nas ul ju'u thu dgon 196

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /pa bkra shis dpal dar gling du mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa'i dge 'dun mang po'i seng sprengs dang bcas phyag phebs/ rje nyid kyi bzhugs gnas su ched gnyer gyis bsgrubs pa'i bla brang gsar par gdan drangs te ston chen zhus thog mi drag rnams kyis legs dar dang bcas phyag dbang zhus/dgos pa'i gtso bo ho sho'u'i mi che phra thams cad kyis 'brel ba 'jog pa'i ched yin pas rgyun ring por bzhugs dgos zhes gsol ba nan cher btab pa bzhin nyin mang du bzhugs te nyin re bzhin dad ldan gyi skye pho mo khri phrag brgal ba re 'dus par snga dro phyi dro mjal kha thang gnyis re gnang / phyag dbang gi mjug tu so so'i phan yon gyi bshad pa mos gus dbang med du 'dren pa re dang bcas bde gshegs brgyad sogs de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan mang po/ byams pas dam bca' sogs kyi gzungs sna tshogs rna lam du sgogs pa dang spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam thar ma ṇi'i phan yon bcas gsungs te/ spyi bor thugs rje chen po bsgom du bcug nas bdud rtsi 'beb sbyang gi spyan dmigs dang sbrags te tshang mas lhan du yig drug brgya phrag du ma 'ur chems chems 'don pa sogs sgo mtha' dag nas phan pa'i thabs su gang 'gyur gyi mdzad pa bzang pos ngan song gi sgo ni bcad pa bzhin du byas/mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo ni yongs su phyes pa bzhin du mdzad do/ / chos kyi bdud rtsi don du gnyer ba du ma la skal ba dang 'tsham par gdams pa'i bdud rtsi char du bsnyil/ so so nas kyang srid 'byor la snying bo blang ba'i phyir gces nor yod dgu phangs med du phul/ bka' chos mjal kha sogs zam ma chad pa nyin du mar sprel te cung zad brel pa sangs pa na sbyin bdag wang gis gsar du bzhengs pa'i lha khang rten dang brten par bcas pa la spyan dbye'i cho ga rgyas par mdzad de dge legs kyi snang bas khyab par byas/ wang 'khor 197

༄/ /gung ba na ba'ithonaḥ g.yo 'bum/bcas la yid bzhin 'khor lo bka' bab bdun ldan gyi rjes gnang stsal/wangadang cha gan bla ma dge legs chos 'phel sngags ram pa bla ma blo bzang ngag dbang sogs snod ldan gyi slob ma nyub 'dus la rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i siju ra'i byin rlabs dang / bskyed rimarnal 'byor bcu gcig /rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma/ gnyis bral chad dus kye zhal shes gsum/ gser chos 'pho ba dang bcas pa'i khrid sogs zab cing gsang ba'i man ngag gi nying khu du ma bka' drin bskyangs/ mjug tu sbyin bdag wang gis dngul srang brgya dang lnga bcus rgyu sbyar te mchod yon lhan cig tu tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen pos chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dgyes par byas/ wang gcig pu la ku ru kul+le thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang dmigs rim gyi khrid dang bcas mnog chos su gnang / snga phyir rab yon dang chos yon gzabs shing dpon 'bangs thams cad kyi 'dod pa'i re ba skong bar mdzad pa'i rjes su 'du khang chen mor tshogs dbur gdan drangs nas bla ma dge 'dun gyis gnas brtan phyag mchod sogs zhabs pad brtan pa'i bden tshig gsungs pa dang chabs gcig tu wang chen mo nas dngul srang lnga bcu'i maṇ+ḍal nang mdzod/sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol na bza' nyer spyad cha tshang /gos chen yug bdun dngul srang stong phrag gcig dang lnga brgya rta dgu rnga mong hom shir teg can bzhi bcu zhe gcig bzhugs gnas bla brang dang bcas phul te zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol 'debs dang / wang rang nyid kyis bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs su 'gro ba'i bya ba bzang po yid smon ltar 'grub pa'i skyabs 'jug nan tan zhus pa'i lan du snyan cing 'brel pa'i bka' lan nor bu'i 'phreng ba spyi bor phebs pas slar yang gtang rag gi tshul du dngul srang sum cu'i maṇ+ḍal/ gos chen dkar po yug chen srid du ring ba zhig brkyangs 198

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum ༅ dkar rmad byung /te phul/ gzhan yang wang gi ma yum bkra shis mtsho sring mo tho yon gnyi4dang gcung tshe dbang rdo rje sogs tha'i ji tha bu nang dpon blon mi drag du mas mu mthudanas gos dang dngul rnga rta sogs kyi 'bul ba dpag tu med pa bstar/wang 'di'i yab mes kyi dus nas rje yab sras gsum gyi lha khang gcig ma gtogs gzhan med na'ang wang rang nyid kyis gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa mang du bzhengs te lo ltar dge 'dun stong phrag brgal bas cho 'phrul smon lam/ drug pa'i smon lam ma ṇi ril sgrub rje'i dus mchod rnams nyin bdun re/ sa ga'i dus chen dang bstun nas ser skya mang pos sgyung gnas dkar po phyogs brgyad srung rgyu sogs kyi srol btsugs yod la/gzhan gang gnang rgyu cha ma chod pa'i mtshams yin pas 'di res rje nyid la dgon pa 'dir bstan pa'i gsos bu che ba'i bya ba gang byas na phugs su bzang tshul dgongs bstun zhus pa la/ rje nyid nas bstan pa'i gzhi ma tshul khrims yin pas thog mar gzhi gsum gyi phyag len rnam par dag pa btsugs te de nas rim gyis mdo sngags kyi 'chad nyan 'dzug thub na legs lam che tshul gsungs shing mchod gnas bla ma rnams la'ang de lugs kyi zhal ta gnang / de'i phyir lo 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che chibs bsgyur gnang skabs zhus pa la'angade ltar gsungs nas grwa ba rnams la gzhi gsum cho ga'i lung yang sul bas yab sras rnam pa gnyis ga'i dgongs pa mthun byung ba la yid ches skyes te/lode nas dgon gnas de nyid la sgo mang dge bshes dge legs chos 'phel gyis mdo 'don pa po dang / rgyud smad sngags ram pa blo bzang ngag dbang gis dbyar bdag mdzad de gzhi gsum gyi phyag bzhes rnam par dag pa'i srol tshugs/ rje nyid phebs khar gos bor bzhengs 'phro zhig bla brang du bzhag ste byin rlabs dang rten 'brel gye sgo bsgrig par mdzad/ de nas pa ga ho ro la 199

/ /gung jastananga'isgranalo ga ngabum//didi ṭ+wāṃX rdo ༷ /ṭ+wāṃ /ṭ+wāṃni ༵༵ lhan mdi dīdīs snyirji dī/ ṭā ṭ+wāṃ ༵ ༵ snenaX dgos tshul nan che ba bzhin khong dang wang rnam gnyis la skog chos su stsal/maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gyis sna drangs te/ gos dang dngul snam bu tshag gdan rnga rta sogs kyi 'bul ba spam mthob phul/ thu sa lag chi dpal 'byor dang dpal 'byor lhun grub a ke atho sirnyi sogs du mas dngos 'bul gyi mchod sprin bstar/ de nas rim gyis phebs par wang 'khor bcas kyis rma chu thon rag la chibs skyel mdzad cing hor sho'u'i ru sne thon bar du tsha zhag gi gra bsgrigs dang / a lag sha'i yā mon bar du mi bzang kha shas kyis thog drangs te skyel mi mang po khal rnga zhon rta tshang ma bcas bton te mthun rkyen zhus/ o thog 'byung gnas mi rin gyis lam thog tu bzhugs gur phul par gdan drangs nas gsol ston dang 'bulanod gya nom pa btegs/ a lag sha'i chin wang blo bzang rdo rjes yā mon du gdan drangs chos 'brel zhus te dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal kha btags gos chen yug dgu rnga mong dgu rta dgu bcas dgu tshan gsum gyi dngos 'bul dang gzhis len gsol ston sogs mi zhel ba bsgrubs/ dgon lung bar du skyel mi ngo g.yog bdun yu la'i rnga mong mi nyung tsam gyis zhabs 'degs zhus/mdo smad kyi sa sne zin pa nas bzung ste pho rod dang dpa' ri stong shag sogs kyidagon sgrub sde ris med kyi bsu ba bla ma las sne ci rigs dang / dgon lungasnyi dang sger gyi bsu ba zhabs drung sku skye las sne dka' ram dge tshul slong mngapo dang ma bu dgon gyi mchod gzhi'i sbyin bdag drag zhan mang po bcas chibs bsu thab bsu rim pa du ma nyin ltar mu mthud pa'i spros pa chen po dang bcas phebs/ tsong chu'i kha'i shang thang du sum pa mkhan chen byon te bsu 200

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /ston rgyas pa dang bcas mjal 'dzom gnang / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che sku 'bum gyi mkhan khrir ba bzhugs pa'i skabs yin pas mar tshang du bsu ba gnang ba dang mjal nas nyin gcig lhan du bzhugs te gsung gleng shin tu smin par byung / slar dgon lung du rten bzhengs gsar ba rnams rab gnas la phebs dgos pa'i snyan gsan phul/ rje de nyid dang lhan du sku 'bum gyi bla spyi che chung sgar ba khag gi chibs bsu drag zhan mang du 'ongs pa rnams kyis mjal phyag dang ston mo zhus/ astan gyi mtshams zhus pa thung zi'ang der glebs/ dgon lung khri thog pa chu bzang rin po che pa yan gyi ja thab steng du byon pa dang mjal phrad mdzad/ de nas zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu gnyis kyi nyin dgon lung du gling 'dabs nas dge 'dun nyis stong brgal ba'i ser springs kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs shing 'bud dkrol sogs kyi rol mo'i bye brag mang po dang /dri zhim po'i spos 'dren bcas kyis mdun bsus dad 'dus kyi mjal ba khri phrag tsam 'dus pa'i gzhung gshags te gdan sa chen por phyag phabs/ bla brang nas rje nyid dang gzhi byes kyi mi drag du mar gsol ja dkar spro zhus/spyi bla brang so sos dem ja dang bcas phyag dbang zhus shing dge 'dun sger mjal zhu mkhan dang dad 'dus kyi mjal ba mang po la phyag dbang stsal/gser khog dang chu bzang sogs phyi log nang log gi dgon che chung nas mtshams zhus ba mang po dang / lung khog sde lnga'i mjal ba'ang mu mthud nas 'ongs pas nyin mang por mtshams mi phyed pa byung / de nas dgon pa'i tshogs dbur gdan drangs nas bla spyi thun mong nas brtan bzhugs dang dge 'dun mang gis phyag dbang zhus/ dgon lung spyi so dang lcang skya bla brang sum pabla brang sogs spyi bla brang so sos gdan drangs nas 'byor ston zhus/ rje 201

/ /gung bangabastanaba'i nayo༄nga 'bum/nyid nas tshogs chen du mang ja lnga zhus thog rgyal sras rin po che dang khri ba chu bzang rin po che sogs 'bul ba thob bzhin pa rnams la dngos 'bul ngos gtsang zhing gya nom pa dang / dge 'dun gyi sder dngul zho lnga re'i sku 'gyed spyi 'jog la tshogs su chab 'dren pa'i dngul gyi spyi blugs che legs gnyis/bzang gos gser 'brug ma'i ka 'phan 'dom drug re yod ba brgyad/ lha mo'i rten sga dngul gyi srin po'i thong sga dang mi lpags g.yang bzhi srab rmed sogs mngon rtogs bzhin bsgrubs pa'i khyad mtshar bcas phul/ de mtshungs dgon lung ri khrod dang mang 'dus ri khrod chos bzang ri khrod gsum la mang 'gyed gzabs shing / gser dgon dang chu bzang dgon 'dul ba dgon nom chi dgon tha yan chi lung dkar ri khrod rgyal sras ri khrod/ bum pa chos lung shing lung ri khrod/ sems nyid dgon pa kun chen dgon mchod rten thang bkra shis chos gling rgyud ba sgar 'brug lung dgon bsam gtan rtse/tshang skya sku 'bum mā yang ri khrod lo dkar ri khrod a kya ri khrod srog mkhar ri khrod/ ser lung dgon pa tas thung dgon chen chu lung dgon yar klung dgon rab rgyas dgon stag lung dgon pa 'bri gung dgon pa bā ju'i dgon thang ring dgon pa len hwa thas dgon pa gro tshang dgon pa rnams la mang ja dang 'gyed dngul zho phyed do re gnang / gzhan yang chu bzang rin po che dang sum pa mkhan chen rnam gnyis la rgya nas phebayopa'i skyos ma gzab rgyas 'bul ba gnang zhing / dgon lung gi zhabs drung sku skye slob ma gra rigs mang po dngalung khog lnga'i sbyin bdag drag zhan du ma dang phyogs tha dad nas 'ongs pa'i bla sprul dka' ram dngos dang tshab ci rigs rnams bdog pa'i skyes kyis tshim par mdzad/ 7gong ma chen por nyid kyi bka' drin spyan bskyangs la brten nas rang yul du bde bar 'byor pa'i rgyu mtshan snyan sgron dang mtshams 202

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /zhus 'bul rgyu'i don la zi ling du phebs astan dang mjal phrad thog nas gong du yi ge phul/ sku 'bum du 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che la gdan 'dren pa btang ba bzhin chibs bsgyur gnang bar chibs bsu thab bsu rim pa du ma dang dge 'dun mang gi ser sbrengs kyis mdun bsus te dgon lung du gdan drangs/ thog mar tshe dbang dang chos rgyal dug ri'i rjes gnang sogs chos bka' 'ga' zhig gsan/ de nas rje rang nyid wang zhabs drung sogs chog gra pa dang bcas pas bde mchog dkar po'i brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga bsgrubs te rje bla ma de nyid bkur ste chen pos seng ge'i khri la bzhugs su gsol/ mchod 'bul gsol 'debs maṇ+ḍal dang sprags nas dngos 'bul la dngul gyi rdo rje gser tshos can che ba mdzod btags sna lngas brgyan pa/dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal che legs dar tshon sna lnga'i sne 'dogs can nang mdzod dang bcas pa/ tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan dgu/ tshe mdo goser bris/ rnam rgyal mchod rten khru gang ba/ dngul gyi chab ril/ bzed zhal/ zhal dkar stegs bcas/ bla gos/ mthang gos/ snam sbyar/ sku gzan/stod 'gag / ban sked/ bzhugs 'ding / sne ring / gogaber/'gan sbyar/ khe re men gyi na bza' phu thung bka' zi ring ba dang bcas/gtsug tor rigs lnga/ stod g.yogs smad g.yogs/ dngul gyi rdo dril/dngul gyis g.yogs pa'i ṭa ma ru/ thod pa kha khebs stegs rnams dngul las bsgrubs pa rin po che'i phra can/ chu shel dang byu ru dang spos shel gye phyag 'phreng gsum/ shel spyad sna tshogs/ 7gong mas gnang ba'i phyag shan khyad chos dgu ldan/ dngul las bsgrubs pa'i bkra shis rtags brgyad/rgyalasrid sna bdun/ 'khor lo rdo rje rgya gram/ rgyan bzhi mang nog sangs rgyas sku sha ma pad+ma gser mig ma kha thi sogs gos chen legs pa nyi shu/203

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/gser srang lnga/ dngul srang lnga brgya/ mdzod btags sna lnga/ ling yug sna lnga/ dar chen khra bo yug lnga/ nor bu don yod zhags pa bcas bstar te maṇ+ḍal gyi zhu 'bul rje rang nyid kyis kha mdzad par rje bla ma de nyid nas phyir phebs kyi bka' lan dang zhal bzhes bzang po gnang / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che nyid chog gra pa dang bcas pas pho brang nas gdan drangs pa'i gsar bzhengs kyi sku gsung thugs rten rnams la rab gnas mdzad/rab yon kyang gzab rgyas phul/ rab ston gyi skabs yab sras rnam gnyis gtso bor bzhugs te dgon pa'i zhabs drung sku skye chos rje las sne sogs dang /gser khog gi mā zhabs drung mtsho sngon phyag rdor pe'i zi sogs phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i mi drag du ma dang bcas ston 'khor brgya phrag brgal ba'i bzhugs gralal snga dro'i dus rgya'i lugs kye ston mo gzab rgyas/ phyi dros khod yangs par lding gur phub par 'tshogs te sgyu ma mkhan gyi rtsed mo dang sgyu rtsal ya mtshan pa sna tshogs kyi gzigs mo dang / bi wang gling bu sogs rol cha sna tshogs brdebs pa'i sgra snyan dang / nyi ma nub rjes me'i 'khrul 'khor gyi rtsed mo sna tshogs spyan lam du bstar nas yab sras rnam gnyis kyis gzigs zhor du ltad mor 'dus pa'i ser skya'i tshogs pa khri phrag tsam la ston du bcug ste/rtsed mo ba rnams dang phyogs nas ston mgron du bos pa'i mi drag du ma dang rab ston la mthun rkyen sbyar ba'i sbyin bdag mang po rnams gzhi len gnang sbyin gzab rgyas kyis mgu bar mdzad/ ltad mor 'dus pa'i skye bo thams cad la'ang bza' btung sogs tshim nges gnang / de nas rten rnying gang yod dang gsar bzhengs kyi rten gsum dpag tu med pa rnams bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po bla brang dang sbrags pa zhig bzhengs pa'i thugs dgongasasnga ma nas yod pa bzhin bla brang gi las byed rnams la de lugs kyi 204

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /zhal bkod gnang ste lo 'di nas shing cha sogs gra bsgrigs kyi mgo tshug bya ba las kyi 'khor lo gegs med du 'grub phyir bla brang du spyi bskang gang 'grub dang rta mgrin gyi bsnyen pa mgon po'i gtor sgrub dang gtor chen sogs sgrub pa khag 'ga' sbyin sreg bcas dang / tshogs chen du mang ja lnga bcu'i thog gdugs sher seng gdong ma'i bzlog bsgyur sgrol ma 'gro gang che chos skyong gi gsolamachod sogs rim gro phon che ba dgon dang sgrub sde mang po nas gtan chags su bsgrubs/ sbyin bdag har chin wang rar+sha sirnyis zhabs phyir mngags pa'i mi sna khā sa'i jir hu sogs drag zhan nyi shu skor phyir ldog rgyur so so'i go bab dang bstun pa'i rta dang snam bu dngul sogs kyi gnang sbyin gzabs shing lam chos dang bka' bsgo byin rten stsal/ zi ling astan kyang mjal phrad du phebs te nyin gcig bzhugs par gzhis len gsol ston zhus shing lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i gsung gleng 'phel/ sngar pho brang nas bla brang gi las byed sogs la chos bzang ri khrod du rje gong ma'i sangs rgyas so lnga dang gnas brtan bcu drug zhal gzigs pa'i gzim khang rnying skyon che ba gsar gso byed dgos pa'i gsung shog gnang ba bzhin gzim khang de nyid gsar gsos legs par grub zin 'dug par dgun gyi ring chos bzang ri khrod kyi gzim gshag der bzhugs nas thugs dam bskyangs/ de'ang rje 'di nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod la thugs mos pa brtan po thob cing dus gsum mkhyen pa'i skyes chen dam pa du mas kyang sku tshe'i phreng bar 'brel ba'i lhag pa'i lhar lung bstan pa dang rten 'brel gyi sgo du ma zhig kyang rang 'grig tu byung bas/ dbus gtsang mdo khams rgya sog gi yul gru kun tu lha 'di nyid kyi 'phrin las rgya cher spel bar mdzad cing / lhag par mdo smad kyi sgrub sde gang rung zhig tu siskyo ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod cig 'dzug rgyu'i 205

༄/ /gung thangabamaba'izlaname'i ga4 'bum/thugs 'dun yod thog dgun 'dir rje nyid drung 'khor ba dang bcas pas yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu'i dus su sgrub mchod rta dbyangs phyag rgya dang bcas yid 'khul ba zhig gnang bar brten/ chos bzang ri khrod kyi dad brtson can mang pos rang rang gi dadapas kun nas bslangs te sgrub mchod 'dzug par snyan bskul yang yang nan tan zhus pas/ rje nyid kyang thugs shin tu dgyes pa'i sgo nas bzang shu'u zhabs drung dang btsan tsha chos rje snu zogs sgom pa sogs bsam gtan pa nyung 'dus shig la si ra'i byin rlabs zab mo gnang / de nas bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ mar gyi ngo yi tshes bcu dang / /zla ba yar ngo gang rung la/ / myung du 'bad pas mchod par bya/ / zhes sgrub pa'i dus la sdig pa sbyong ba dang bsod nams gsog par rim pa bzhin phyogs gnyis kyi tshes bcu bsngags shing de'i nang nas kyang khyad par du 'phags pa dgun zla 'bring po la sogs kyi/ / bcu pa la ni gus bas mchod/ / ces bshad rgyud kun spyod las dmigs kyis bkar ba'i dus phun sum tshogs pa dgun zla 'bring po'i tshes bcu'i nyin grub pa'i bste gnas chen po de nyid du rje btsun bla ma dam pa nyid kyis gtso mdzad/ rgyun pa'i sku 'khor rnams kyi steng dugasar slob kyi spong ba pa rnams bsnan te dpon slob sum cu so gnyis kyis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang / tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs rgyas par mdzad de yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu'i sgrub mchod 'chag med du gtong ba'i srol btsugs/ de'ang o rgyan gyi mdzad pa grags che ba phal cher tshes bcu re dang sprel gyi lo zlar bstan pa mang bas rat+na'i gter kha sogs su/ 'byung cog zla ba'i tshes bcu la/ / nga nyid 'byon par dbu snyung bzhes/ / zhes pa dang / nor bu'i bang mdzod las/ yar ngo'i tshes bcu nam shar tshe/ / o rgyan pad+ma'i sprul pa 'byung / / zhes sogs de 206

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /phyogs su grags che ba rnams la 'khrul nas tshes bcu zhes pa rnying ma'i lugs kho na zhig tu go ba ni ma rgyud kyi phyogs ma mthong pa'i rang gi de nyid ston par zad do/ / zhwa dmar nas rje nyid kyi khu bo bra ste zhabs drung sku tshe ma zin pa'i 'phrin byung bar dngul srang brgya dang gos chen kha shas kha btags che chung lnga brgya sogs rnam dkar gye thebs stsal cing / rje rang nyid kyis nyin mang po'i bar dudagongs pa rdzogs pa'i thugs dam spyan dmigs rgya cher gnang / dgung lo so gsum pa sa glang lo'i bgrang bya gsar tshes kyi nyin chos bzang ri khrod du lha mo'i tshes gtor gyi tshogs dbu mdzad/ mtsho sngon kun bzang tshe ring ja sag mjal du 'ongs par phyag dbang dang 'dod chos kyis mgu bar mdzad/smon lam grol nas ri khrod pa rnams dang dgon lung gi wang zhabs drung sogs dang / mdung nag mā tsha zhabs drung dang gcur zhabs drung sogs phyogs nas 'dus pa'i don gnyer can mang po bcas la bla ma mchod pa'i khrid zla phyed lhag tsam la zhib bshad dang lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung / rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar dang gsung mgur gyi lung sogs zhu ba po so so'i ngor lam rim dang blo sbyong skor gyi khrid dang lung mang du gnang / yang gong gsal gyi zhabs drung rnams dang ri khrod pa kha shas bcas nyung 'dus la nā ro mkha' sbyod ma'i dbang dang de'i bskyed rdzogs sogs kyi khrid rjes gnang 'ga' zhig mu mthud pabacas zla ba gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i bar bka' chos kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad/ de nas sku 'bum gyi gser sdong chen mo la mjal du phebs par dgon pa'i bla spyi che chung dang sgar ba khag gi chibs bsu/ spyi'i ja thab/dge 'dun gyi ser sbrengs dang bcas 'byor/ lha khang chen mor mchod sprin rgya mtsho spros te yan lag bdun pa maṇ+ḍal gsol 'debs dang bcas sems bskyed cho gas 'dzin pa gnang ste bzang spyod sogs kyis thugs smon rgya chen po 207

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/mdzad/ lha khang gzhan rnams la'ang mchod mjal zhib bar gnang /ṭ+wāṃ/dī dī~X sdi ṭ+wāṃrnyi/ nidīr r+shadin rlordo r+sha ༵༵ ༷༵/ zlo dh+ri rdo bye rdo/༷ stonasnal/ bla spyi khag so so nas zhabs brtan phul te dge 'dun mang gis phyag dbang zhus/ dge 'dun la mang ja'i thog kha btags dang dung tshe sum brgya re'i sku 'gyed dang / khri rin po che dang spyi ba sogs la 'bul ba dang 'jog pa gzabs/ chos skyong chen mo sku pheb zhus te 'azin bcol gnyer gtad mdzad/ 'du khang chen mo gsar bzo'i shing rtsi'i thebs su dngul srang sum brgya gnang / tshur lam zi ling a na gyis yā mon du gdan drangs nas khrang zhi'i rtsed mo bstar ba dang bcas gsol ston zhus/ de nas dgon lung du bla brang gi las byed pa rnams kyis gtsug lag khang gi shing cha dang so phag sogs kyi gra bsgrig bzo bo so so la gtam rgyu sogs nyer bsdoms gang dgosale thogs med par tshags su tshud pa na snga ma'i gzim khang de nyid rgya chung la ha cang rnying skyon ches pas ar chog byas te bskyod/ nye 'khor gyi grwa gshag mi nyung tsam yang ji ltar 'dod pa'i rin gyis nyos te thams cad kyi shul sa khod snyoms par bzos/ lha khang 'bub sar sgang bcag pa'i nyin sdom pa zhu mi mang tsam byung ba rten 'brel gyi khyad du dgongs nas sgang bcag zin pa dang bstun gnas gzhi der rje nyid kyis mkhan po dang / wang zhabs drung sogs dgon lung gi gnas brtan 'ga' zhig gis las gral mdzad de rab byung dge tshul mang tsam dang / bsgrub bya nyi shu rtsa dgu bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/dus tshigs brjod pa'i skabs su rje nyid nas bla brang gsar pa la bkra shis 'od 'bar zhes don mthun gyi ming 'dogs par mdzad/ har chin nas sbyin bdag wang rargo sirnyi'i yel chi mi drag ngo g.yog skabs 'dir 'byor te wang 208

ro༅/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /zhabs drung gtsos pa'i chog grwa pa bcus brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga gsung thog / wang nas bskur ba'i na bza' dang gos dang dngul shel dang yang ṭi'i ca lag sogs kyi 'bul ba spam mtho ba mtshams zhu'i glegs pu bcas dang /gzhan yang tā gung sogs dpon blon che phra'i mtshams zhus kyi yi ge dngos skyes mang po dang bcas phul/ dgon lung gi tshogs chen 'du khang rje nyid nas sgrub thebs sbyar te bkod pa sogs sum pa mkhan chen la gtad gnyer zhus pa bzhinaskya bzo grub yod par/ slar yang cha rkyen gnang ste phyi nang gi shing rtsi dang sgo 'phyor gyi sdeb ris rnams dbyar thog 'dir grub par byas/ grub ston du dge 'dun rnams la'ang ja thug sogs kyis bsnyen bkur zhus/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che rgya nag tu chibs bsgyur gnang rgyur mar tshang du zhag bab sogasathu gra bsgrig gnang ba'i thog tu gdan drangs te rgya lugs kyi dbyar dgun gyi na bza' cha tshang / chibs drel spos snam sogs phebs rdzong gtos che ba phul/ yab sras rnam gnyis zhag gnyis lhan du bzhugs nas gsung gleng dmar bar mdzad cing / phebs dus sa tshigs gsum gyi bar du chibs skyel zhu ba gnang / ston ga phyi logs su sum pa mkhan chen sku ltem nas 'o brgyal ba'i tshul bstan yod pa rje nyid la sus kyang zhus mi 'dug na'ang thugs rmis 'ga' byung ste glo bur du chas nas lung dkar ri khrod du phebs/ mkhan chen gyis thugs dgyes pa'i rnam pas nged rang bro 'tshal ba khyed la sus zhus pa yin zhes dri ba gnang bar/ rmi lam 'ga' zhig byung ste nyid la mjal bar 'ongs pa yin zhes thugs mis byung tshul zhus pas dgyes tshor dang ngo mtshar che bar mdzad/ mkhan chen gyi dgongs bzhed ltar mgon po bar chad kun sel gyi rjes gnang 'bul bar mdzad cing gnad dmigs can gyi zhabs brtan 'ga' zhig bsgrubs pas bsnyun gzhi phral du 209

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/dwangs nyams shar/ phyir 'khor dus rje nyid nas mkhan rin po che la maṇ+ḍal kha btags dang bcas zhabs pad yun ring du brtan pa'i gsol ba btab pa'i lan du/ mkhan chen nas/ nged rang gis nyid kyi sku tshe gong ma rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang chos rgyam pa'i sku gdung rin po che la sri zhu bgyis skabs bzhugs mal du zhun thig mthe bong tsam zhig phebs 'dug pa mthong ma thag tu blangs te khar myang bas de'i byin rlabs dang rten 'brel gyis deng sang tshe ring zhing 'byer ba che ba 'di byung / da res nged rang bro nang drag pos zin nas sman bcos rim gro gang gis kyang ma phan pa la/ nyid kyang snyan bskul ma ltos par sku dngos kyis phebs te ring 'tshe'i rten 'brel 'ga' bsgrigs tsam gyis tsher ma bton pa ltar nad gzhi dwangs song ba yin pas/ dkon mchog gi byinarlabs dang 'u cag dam tshig gi 'brel ba gtsang ba'i mthus nged rang tshe ring po yong ba gzhir bcas sogs zhal len bzang po dang thugs mnyes pa'i gsung mang du phebs/ mkhan chen gyis khong rang gi rnam thar sa bon bsgrigs pa'i nang na'ang rje 'di pa la bden tshig grub pa'i bsngags brjod gnang 'dug zer/ de nas mchod rten thang dang bkra shis chos gling sogs nas gdan 'dren gye snyan gsan phul yod pa bzhin phebs skabs/ 'brug lung dgon dang bsam gtan rtse'i ri khrod rnams su gdan drangs nas dgon mchod gzhis rnams kyis phyag dbang chos 'brel zhus te 'bul nod bstabs pa la phar yang so sor mang 'gyed gnang / bkra shis chos gling du ja thab ser sbrengs dang bcas phyag phebs/ 'du khang du gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun lnga brgya lhag tsam dang dad ldan sbyin bdag gi tshogs sum stong brgal ba la bla ma'i rnal 'byor dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid gzab bshad kyis brgyan pa stsal/dge bshes gnyis kyis tshogs gleng dang bcas ston chen zhus shing zhabs 210

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung / brtan gyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te maṇ+ḍal nang mdzod sku gsung thugs rten/dung tshe dang rta nor ra lug sogs rnam grangs lnga brgya tsam gyi dngos 'bul spyan lam du bstar ba'i thog dpa' 'bum lha ram pa blo bzang rin chen gyis maṇ+ḍal bshad pa 'brel chags pa zhig zhus par thugs dgyes pa'i bka' lan bzang po gnang / tshogs par mang 'gyed 'jog ba gzab rgyas zhus/ rgyud pa sgar du gdan drangs te mchod yon tshang mas phyag dbang dang 'dod chos zhus pa'i re ba skong bar mdzad/ tshur 'bul nod dang phar mang 'gyed gnang /de nas rim gyis zab lung rgya tig gi 'brog sde'i khrod du gdan drangs nas spyi sger so sos bsnyen bkur 'bul nod gzabs par phyag dbang dang 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ rdo spungs sum mdor rgya tig spyi 'dus kyi ja thab thog mchod rten thang gi bde rgu 'dul 'dzin dar rgyas rgya tsho dang rgya tig zhabs drung sogs rta bsu mang po 'byor/ rim gyis rdo dkar ri khrod du gdan drangs yon mchod rnams kyis gsol ston 'bul ba gzabs mang 'gyed kyang gnang / phyogs 'dus kyi ser skya nyis stong nye ba la tshe dpag med dkar po'i rjesaganang stsal par dam tshig gi bshad pa las 'phros te tshe sgrub thun mong ma yin pa ni rang gis srog gcod spong ba dang / gzhan gyi srog skyob pa rnams yin tshul gtam rgyud dpe dang sbyar nas gsungs par srog gcod spong par khas len mkhan mang po byung ste phan pa'i lam la spyor ba'i thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pa ngo mtshar can no/ / grags pa 'od zer bya ba 'bam nad kyis gdungs te lo mang por sman bcos kyis ma thub pa la phyag sman thun 'ga' tsam gnang bas nad gzhi lhag med du dwangs song bar thams cad ngo mtshar skyes/de nas khri zur sngo kho ngag dbang bstan 'dzin bzang po sogs dgon pa'i bla ma las sne dka' ram mang po dang / sngo kho mda' phu bcu drug gi mgo pa rnams 211

༄/ /gung thangabastanapa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/dang bcas rta thab rim pa du ma dang / dge 'dun chig stong nye ba'i ser sbrengs dang bcas mchod rten thang dgon par 'byor te bde rgu bla brang du bzhugs/ rje nyid nas dgongs pas bcad de ri dgon thams cad la gang phan pa'i bka' chos shig bka' drin gnang dgos tshul zhus pa bzhin 'du khang chen mor dge 'dun tshang ma dang tsho ba'i mi drag mang po bcas la gnas brtan bcu drug gi rjes gnang gnas brtan chu 'byon gyi lo rgyus dang bcas gnang bar rgan rabs rnams kyis rje gong ma sems dpa' chen po ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtshos sde 'di'i 'du khang rab gnas mdzad skabs/ ri dgon thams cad kyi chos 'byor zung 'jug tu 'phel pa'i rim gro gang phan pa zhig brtag zhus byas pas/ phyir phebs lan du gnas brtan phyag mchod rgyas pa gtan chags su btsugs na legs tshul thugs mis ya mtshan byung ba'i lo rgyus dang bcas bka' gnang ste/ rje rang nyid kyis zang nga dpon slob sogs skad grwa pa rnams la rta dbyangs phyag len dang bcas bslabs shing / gnas brtan sbyin bdag bka' srung dang bcas pa'i gser sku tshun lnga ba nyer gnyis dang / gos chen gyi phyi 'phur cha gcig tshugs ston mang 'gyed dang bcas gnang nas btsugs par mdzad pa'i mthus ri dgon gnyis char chos dang 'byor ba phan tshun 'gran bzhin 'phel ba 'di byung / da res kyang gnas brtan rjes gnang mdzad pa 'di 'byung 'gyur legs tshogs kyi snga ltas su mngon zhes gleng / de nas chos grwa chen por ser skya'i tshogs pa lnga stong tsam la dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid rgyas pa gnang skabs spyan 'dren gyi tshigs bcad bshad pa'i gzhir drangs pa dang dus mtshungs su mkha' la sprin dkar po lang long 'khrigs pa'i klong nas char zim bu babs byung bar thams cad kyis rten 'brel ma bsgrig rang 'grigs su go nas dad gus 'phel/212

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bzhugs gral ston mo'i thog 'bul chen brtan bzhugs lugs su phul te 'dul 'dzin dar rgyas rgya mtshos maṇ+ḍal gyi zhu 'bul byas par bab bstun gyi bka' lan bzang po gnang / sngo kho khri zur ngag dbang bstan 'dzin bzang po'i bla brang du dgon pa'i bla gra phal cher 'dus pa la bla mchod bde stong dbyer med ma'i khrid snyan brgyud man ngag gis brkyan te gzab bshad gnang bar bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi thugs yid tshim ste bsngags brjod sgrogs bas brel/ rje nyid kyi sku'i nye rigs su gtogs pa mā chi zhabs drung khu dpon sku chas ha cang bkren pa la rgyal chen ngal gso'i rjes gnang stsal te rten gtor thab khung du bzhu ba'i zhal ta mdzad pa bzhin byas pas phyis su zhabs drung yul ba dang bcas par longs spyod 'bad med lhun grub tu byung /byams khang chen mo 'dul 'dzin dar rgyam pas zhig gsos mdzad par rab gnas zhus pa bzhin gnang ste mjug tu byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs dang byams smon bstan 'bar ma dang bcas pas mtha' brgyan par mdzad/de dus byams khang du stong 'khor pa mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i sku brnyan zhig yod pa la snyan shal phul te/ phan tshun gcig gis gcig la rku zhing 'khon/ /thams cad bsdongs nas khyod las ci thob rku/ / rkun ma kun gyi dbus na lhang nge ba/ / mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / zhes gsungs shing / khyed tshos gsol 'debs 'di 'don gin ye yod ces bka' 'dri gnang bar thams cad bzhad gad theg ge ba byung / de las 'phros te dad rdzas sus khyer 'dis khyer med pa'i ku yangs des nye gnas ngan lang la btang nas sdig pa bsog tu 'jug pa las yon mchod su la'ang mi phan/ de bas zhib tshag byas te yon mchod kyi ched du dmigs pa'i rten bzhengs sam/yar mchod mar sbyin gyi tshogs bsags rgya gang cher btang na dad rdzas chud ma 213

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithonaḥ gsung 'a ma/gzan bya ba yin/ nye gnas la phugs su gnod pa'i ku yangs de byams pa go log yin pas de las phung tshab che ba med gsung / 'dul 'jig pas rab ston dang rab yon gzabs/ 'dul 'dzin par rang gi gzim gshag jo 'grom sogs kyi legs ris can gsar bskrun la bzhugs gnas gnang 'dug pa bzhin phyin gyis brlabs te phun tshogs mngon dga' khang zhes pa'i ming 'dogs par mdzad/ der bzhugs ring la thugs brel gyi sengs bar rnams su 'dul 'dzin dar rgyam pa dang chos kyi 'bel gtam mang du 'phel zhing khong la bzhed chos 'ga' yang gnang / dgon par mang 'gyed 'bul ba dang 'jog pa'ang gzabs/ tshur lam rang stag gi 'brog sde rnams kyis bsnyen bkur zhus pa bdag gir bzhes te phyag dbang chos 'brel sogs kyis tshim par mdzad/ dgun gyi ring chos bzang ri khrod du bzhugs te thugs dam sngar rgyun bzhin 'phel/ dgung lo so bzhi pa lcags stag gi lo gsar dga' ston mdzad/ dpyid byams pa 'bum gling phyogs su rten mjal la mngon tshan chung ngus phebs rtsis kyis dpon g.yog lnga tsam byas te zhabs phyi rnams rkang thang dang / nyid kyang na bza' rnying ba zhig mnabs te gsang stabs kyis phebs/ thog mar len hwa thas dgon par rib tsam mjal bas 'ga' zhig gis shes nas thams cad brdab shog langs te mjal du 'ongs pas bros stabs kyis phebs dgos pa byung / rje nyid nas gzhan la gsang dgos tshul nan tan che ba bzhin zhabs byi pa rnams kyis gsang khul byas kyang / cha rgyus med pa'i sa char yang rgya dang hor thams cad langs nas phyag 'tshal zhing gus 'dud byed pa sogs bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid dang bsod nams kyi stobs kyis gsang ma tshugs par rim gyis tshang mas shes pa byung / skabs shigacoms pa 'bum gling gi g.yung bla ma chibs bsur 'byor te khong gis lam 214

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /pa mdzad/ mdzo mo mkhar nang gi lha khang na yod pa'i byams chen chos rje'i sku gdung mchod rten dang / de'i phyi nang gi rten mang por zhib mjal gnang /'dzin bdag byed mkhan blu yon gyes mgu par mdzad nas byams chen chos rje'i thugs dam rten lo rgyus can 'ga' zhig gdan drangs/ de nas lo'u kyā tun gyi dgon par phebs/ rgyab kyi brag khung la bzhugs pa'i bde mchog yab yum gyi sku la dbang chas tshang ma dang snyan shal sogs phul te byin rlabs zhus/ mdun du mchod pa gya nom pa bshams te bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod bdag 'jug dang bcas gnad smin thugs nyams su bstar/mchod rten dkar po'i mchod mjal du phebs te rim gyis byams pa 'bum gling du 'byor/ byams sku chen po'i lha khang dang / stod kyi sgrol ma lha khang rnams su mchod mjal dang thugs smon mdzad/ brag la brkos pa'i lha sku mang po dang / gnas kyi brag ri'i ngos la yod ba'i lha sku dang yi ge rang byon rnams la snga ma nas rgyus yod pa lta bu de dang de yin gyi ngos 'dzin gnang nas zhib mjal mdzad pas yul mi thams cad ngo mtshar ba byung 'dug / 'bum gling dang sgol ma lha khang so so'i bla ma dge 'dun rnams kyis phyag dbang chos 'brel zhus/ yung bla ma'i bla brang du bzhugs gnas mdzad par khong gis gzhis len bsnyen bkur gzabs/ de nas pā ju'u dgon pa dang thang ring dgon pa/ gro tshang dgon pa rnams su rim pas gdan drangs pa bzhin chen po'i lugs kyi rta bsu thab bsu ser sbrengs dang bcas phebs te so sor 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ gro tshang rdo rje 'chang gi lha khang go tam sde la phyi nang gi rten rnams su zhib mjal mdzad de dgon lung du byon/ dbyar 'dir char dkon po byung bar rgya bod hor gsum gyi char 'bebs pa rnams rang rang gi yul du char 'bebs byas shing / nyid kyang char 'bebs la 215

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/bzhugs te thun mtshams shig tu rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas char 'bebs byed tshul ljags rtsom gnang zhing / sbyar byang la slebs pa dang char 'beb pa dus mtshungs su gyur pas slar 'dis gzhan la phan thogs pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs song gsung / deng dus kyi bla sngags rnam pa srab ba zhig yin na brtan g.yo thams cad la dbang bsgyur ba'i 'bras rtags yin pa lta bu'i 'ur sgrogs pa'i tshod yin kyang / rje bla ma 'di lta bu'i mdzad pa'i cha shas phra mo zhig tu snang ngo / / lo snga mar bla brang bkra shis 'od 'bar gyi gtsug lag khang chen po de nyid 7gnam skyong gong ma bdag po chen po dgung lo drug cur phebs pa'i dga' ston dang zhabs brtan gyi ched du dmigs nas bsgrubs pa'i rgyu mtshan astan brgyud nas7gong ma chen po'i snyan du gsol ba bzhin 7gong nas thugs dgyes pa chen pos mkhyen yangs gling zhes pa'i zi ben gye gsol rasabaka' drin stsal ba 'byor par dgon pa'i bla ma dge 'dun gyes bsu ba ser sbrengs kyis mdun bsus te bkur ste chen pos gdan drangs nas gtsug lagakhang chen mo'i sgo mo che'i steng thad phyi khyams su btegs/ 7gong nas dgyes gzigs kyi legs 'bul dang mtshams zhus la nang so bstan pa rgya mtsho ngo g.yog rdzong brda' gnang / de'ang bla brang bkra shis 'od 'bar zhes mig dang yid la kun dga'i snang ba ci yang spro ba'i gtsug lag khang chen po 'di nyid kyi rten dang brten pa'i bkod pa rags pa tsam brjod na/ dri gtsang khang rim pa du ma khyams skor phyi nang mang po yod kyang gtso bo mkhyen yangs gling dang gzim chung rnyog bral bste gnas/ mo ṭi ya na/ bde chen phugs/'chi med dga' tshal/ byin rlabs gter mdzod/ gtum drag rol pa/mgonakhang bsil ba tshal/ kun rig khang / grub thob khang rnams yin la/de dag tu sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhugs pa'i rim pa'ang / dbus kyi 216

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /gtsugalag khang chen po mkhyen yangs gling du dbus su rgyal ba seng ge'i nga ro/g.yas su mi 'khrugs pa dang 'od dpag med gtso 'khor gsum pa/ g.yon du sman bla dang shākya thub pa gtso 'khor gsum pa rnams mi tshad lhag tsam dang /yang mi 'khrugs pa byis pa lo brgyad kyi bong tshod tsam gnyis bcas 'di rnams rgyu gser zangs las grub pa bzhugs khri rgyab yol rgya bzo 'phrul ma khyad mtshar rnams dkar chag zur gsal ltar sa gsum na rnyed par dka' ba'i byin rten ring bsrel rnam bzhis byur bur gtams pa dang / g.yas g.yon gye kun dga' ra ba'i nang du tsardon dmar po las grub pa'i bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad/ dus 'khor dang rnam rgyal mchod rten rnams khru gsum re'i tshad dang / bka' bstan 'gyur mtshal dpar tshar re/ gzhan yang ri bo rtse lnga nasagadan drangs pa'i rgya gar li ma thub pa me rdug ma dang / gong ma yung lo'i thugs dam kye rten dor mda' gang ma/ bde mchog / phyag rdor 'khor chen rnams kyi gser sku khru tshad long ba/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku khru gang pa sogs yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems kyi 'bur sku du ma dang / lam rim tshogs zhing gsum thang dang / gnas bcu bdun thang sogs bris sku du ma bcas bzhugs/ ngos gcig tu rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho/ lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje/ stong 'khor bsod nams rgya mtsho/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhadapa/ rje 'di ba dang bcas pas zhabs sen nye bar bkod de chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor ba'i bzhugs khri byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba bzang gos dras grub kyi bzhugs 'bol lnga brtsegs rgyab yol dang bcas pa/steng gi gtsang khang dbus ma'i dkyil du shel gur nang du 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i blos bsrang chen po mig gi bdud rtsi spungs pa lta bu lo rgyus can/de'i mdun ngos la dbus su rgyal ba tsong kha ba'i sku brnyan gzhan phan ma/217

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/g.yas g.yon dang mdun du lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje dang / bla ma byams pa'i mtshan can/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang bo rnams kyi sku brnyan mthong ba don ldan/ de dag gi g.yas g.yon du tshe dpag med gnyis dang sgol dkar rnam snang mngon byang rnams kyi gser sku 'di rnams sku tshad khru gang lhag tsam/ mtha' skor du brnyo la dra mig shel sgo can srus legs du ma'i nang du byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i rgya chen spyod pa dang zab mo lta pa'i rgyud pa'i bla brgyud tshang ma/ rje yab sras/ rgyal ba sku na rim/paṇa chen sku snga phyi/ lcang skya sku snga phyi/ rgyal sras sku snga phyi sogs dge ldan gyi bla ma du ma/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum/ dus 'khor/ 'khor chen/spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ ku ru kul+le/ mkha' spyod skor gsum/seng gdong ma/ bde mchog dkar po/ rta mgrin/ rnam rgyal ma/ sgol ma dkar ljang / gdugs dkar sogs rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs du ma dang /sangs rgyas so lnga tshar gnyis/ nye sras brgyad sogs sangs rgyas byang sems sku mang po/ chos skyong du ma/ bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten rnam brgyad tshar lnga sogs sku rgyu gser dngul dang shel sogs rin po che'i rigs du ma dang / gser zangs las grub pa'i sku brnyan brgya phrag mang du bzhugs la/'khri shing dang rgyal dbang paṇa chen gnyis kyi 'khrungs rabs sogs bris thang mang po/ phyag dpe pota brgya phrag du ma kun dga' ra ba bcas bzhugs/mchod rdzas kyang dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal che legs dpangs su khru gang zhang du khru gsum pa rgyu mtshungs kyi tshom bu can/ gser zangs kyi maṇ+ḍal che legs tshad dang bkod pa dngul mkha de dang cha 'grigs pa/ dngul maṇa dpangs ru mkhyud gang zheng du khru phyed dang do ba dus 'khor lugs kyi tshom bu can/ tshad de las che ba'i tsardon gye maṇ+ḍal tshom bu can cha/ me long sgor mo che legs stegs 218

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /can cha gnyis kyis mtshon steng 'og tu gser dngul yang ṭi ma na ho man shel sogs rin po che sna tshogs pa dang / gu gu sha sogs kyi mchod pa'i yo byad dbyibs dang kha dog mi 'dra ba mtha' yas pa/ bzang gos las bsgrubs pa'i gnam rgyan bla bre phye 'phur ka 'phan bzo bkod phun sum tshogs pas yongs su gang ba lha'i gzhal med khang lta bur bsgrubs/ g.yas kyi gtsang khang byin rlabs gter mdzod du nang rten lo rgyus can gyi skor la/ klu 'dzin las grub pa'i thub dbang mtha' 'khor du mdzad bcu'i bkod pa can/ klu 'jim gyi spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal/ rnye khyim las grub pa'i thub dbang gi sku/ rto khyim las grub pa'i 'od dpag med/ thub ba'i dngul sku gsung 'byon ma/ rje btsun mi la'i sku khyad 'phags/ rje'i gser sku glang chibs dang gle'u chung ma gnyis/ bla chen 'brog mi'i gser sku/ 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon po'i gser sku/ phag mo gru pa'i snang brnyan mthong grol ma/tā ra nā tha'i snang brnyan ting 'dzin ma/ thang stong rgyal po'i sku brnyan/spyan snga bcu gnyis pa'i sku brnyan/ gong ma lnga pa chen po'i sku brnyan/bsil ba tshal gyi rdo nag las grub pa'i te ru ka / bde mchog rgya gar li ma/'jigs byed dmar po mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'i gser sku/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na/ spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi ba/ sgol dkar/ sgrol lngang gnyis/ ku ru kul+le/ mgon po phyag drug pa rnams kyi li sku/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku brnyan rgya gar li ma dang bod li gnyis rnams re re bzhin rten gtsor 'os pa'i lo rgyus ya mtshan can kho na yin la/ rnam pa de lta bu'i bris thang yang a ti sha'i rnam thar ras bris ma/ 'od dpag med kyi zhing bkod pa la bris ma/ 'jam dbyangs kyi zhal thang gnyis/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zhal thang gnyis/ 'jigs byed dmar po mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'i zhal 219

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/thang / rta mgrin yang gsang gi zhal thang / kyi rdor/ pu ṭa/ dur bdag gsum gyi zhal thang / ku ru kul+le'i gsang thang / mkha' spyod ma'i gsang thang / gsung ngag slob bshad kyi glegs bam/ thod pa lha sku can/tsardon gyi phur bu steng 'phur ma che chung nyer brgyad/ rar+sha gling pa'i gter byonaganam lcags kyi rdo rje/ lho brag phyag rdor pa'i mgul phur dang bcas bzhugs pa so so'i lo rgyus dkar chag tu gsal ba ltar ro/ / gzhan yang kun dga' ra ba shel sgo can du ma'i nang du mkha' spyod ma'i dngul sku che ba dang /rta mgrin yang gsang gi sku che ba/ tsan dan las grub pa'i thub dbang nye sras brgyad dang bcas pa/ pad+ma'i sdong po la bzhugs pa'i rgya'i lugs kyi lha sku che tsam gnyis sogs gser zangs dang tsan+dan las grub pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku brnyan rgya bzo bod bzo du ma dang / skyes chen dam pa du ma'i na bza' dang nyer spyad sogs byin rlabs kyi rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa so sor kha byang dang bcas bzhugs/ g.yon phyogs kyi mthog khang gtum nag rol pa'i pho brang gi phugs su gzhan mgon stobs 'phrog nag po'i gsang thang tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gi shangs mtshal gyis bzhengs pa gcig / bla ma dam par bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi shangs mtshal las grub pa gcig / rje ngag dbang chos rgyamapa sku snga phyis bzhengs pa gnyis bcas 'di rnams shin tu gnyan pa'i lo rgyus can/ de dag gi gong gnon du bzhengs pa'i mkha' spyod ma nag mo'i zhal thang / kha'u brag rdzong gi dpal mgon thim pa'i sa byin rlabs can las grub pa'i bram gzugs/ rje 'di pas tshad ldan bzhengs pa'i bram gzhugs mi tshad tsam yum chen bzhi dang bcas pa/ dar gur nang du rdo nag zur gsum pa'i ngos gsum la zhal sgrub dus kyi mgon po/ gdong gnyan can/dkarapo tshe 'phel dang bcas rang byon du phebs pa/ grub chen zhig gi rdo 220

༄7/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /nag maṇ+ḍal/ gsang rten gri snying / gzhan yang phyag mtshan rnams man ngag bzhig bkod pa dang / mgon khang phyi mar sku tshe na rim gyis bsten pa'i srung ma dmag dpon chen po jo bo rgyal mtshan pa dang / dam can rdo rje legs pa'i bris 'bur gyi sku phyi nang gsang ba'i rten spyan gzigs dang bcas pa/dgra lha dang 'go ba'i lha lnga'i bris sku rten rdzas dkor nor dang bcas bzhugs/grub thob khang du dra mig nang la tsardon dkar po las grub pa'i nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig / g.yas g.yon du grub thob brgyad cu gya brgyad kyi 'bur sku/ thub pa'i dbang po'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis dang cho 'phrul chen po'i bkod pa ras bris/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gi 'khrungs rabs thang ga rnams bzhugs/ mgon khang bsil ba tshal gyi sbug tu ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu/ gsang yum lha mo phyag bzhi ma gnod sbyin bzhi dang bcas pa/ dam can chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum/dpal ldan lha mo gdong can gnyis dang bcas pa/ rnam sras ser chen rta bdag brgyad dang bcas pa/ dkar po tshe 'dzin/ yang gsang mdung dmar/ bog tse lcam dral las mkhan dang bcas pa/ rgyal bo sku lnga bcas 'di rnams kyi 'bag sku'i mi tshad tsam pa gzungs 'jug sogs rje rang nyid kyis phyag len dang man ngag bzhin shin tu rung bar mdzad pa/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes man ngag ltar bzhengs par mdzad pa'i mgon po 'khor bcas kyi gsang thang / paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes pa'i shangs mtshal gyi mgon chos gnyis/ rgyal sras blo bzang bstan 'dzin pa'i shangs mtshal gyi 'jigs byed dang mgon dkar nag las gshin/ lha mo/rnam sras dmar ser gnyis/ beg tse/ rje gong ma de nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i chos skyong de rnams kyi gsang thang rnams dang / chos skyong de dag pad+ma'i 221

༄/ /gung bang bstan ba'isgron 'i gsung 'bum/tshal la bung ba bzhin du 'du zhing lus dang grib ma ltar 'go bar byed pa'i rang rang gi phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rnams kyang man ngag mnga' ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes bzhin tshad ldan bsgrubs shing / lha mo'i nang rten nal bu'i gsob dang snying lta bus mtshon rnyed dka' ba rnams kyang rtsol sgrub gnang ste ma tshang ba med par legs par bsgrubs/ mgon khang phyi mar tsan dan dkar po las grub pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs yab yum gyi sku brnyan dang / dra mig shel sgo can gyi nang du/ mgon po dkar nag gnyis/ gur mgon/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa dang bram gzugs/chos rgyal/ lha mo/ rnam sras dmar ser gnyis beg tse rnams kyi gser sku bzhugs/ gzhan yang phyag mtshan sna tshogs dang go mtshon sna tshogs kyis gang yod/ kun rig lha khang du/ ngan song yongs su sbyong ba kun rig rnam par snang mdzad lha sum cu so bdun gyi 'bur sku rnams khru gang lhag tsam/ rje tsong kha pa'i rnam thar dang rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar gyi bkod pa ras bris rnams bzhugs/ gzim khang rnyog bral bste gnas su kun dga' ra ba shel sgo can che legs kyi nang du rnam rgyal ma'i dngul sku khru gang ba sogs sangs rgyasabyang sems kyi gser sku du ma g.yas g.yon du gong ma yung los bzhengs pa'i dus gsum sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang / byams pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyi gser sku rnams khru do re'i tshad/ yo ṭi ya nar sprul sku chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i phyag bzo paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi gsang ba'i rnam thar khyad du 'phags pa dang / dngul gar blugs kyi sku brnyan du ma/ gong gsal gyi gzim chung de dag dang / bde chen phugs dang / 'chi med dga' tshal sogs gzim chung gzhan rnams la'ang tsan+dan dang nan mo 'phrul ma'i gur khang shel sgo can spus gtsang dbyibs mi 'dra ba du ma'i nang du gser 222

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /dang dngul chu shel ba so tsardon dkar dmar/ gser zangs sogs las grub pa'i 'bur sku dang mchod rten/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam thar dang lhag lha du ma'i zhal thang / rgya'i lugs kyi sangs rgyas byang sems dang hwa shang grub thob mang po'i bris 'bur gyi snang brnyan sogs sku gsung thugs kyi rten bsam las 'das pa nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bur bzhugs pas zhib tsobrir ga la lang / dmigs bsal gyi skabs so sor bkram rgyu'i mchod rdzas kyang lo gsar dus ston sogs la gtsang khang chen mor 'grem rgyu'i phye 'phur bla bre ka 'phan sogs grangs mtshungs rgyu bzo khyad du 'phags pa/ shel dang tsardon sogs las bsgrubs pa'i mar me'i 'od khang du ma/ bla ma dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i bzhugs gral gyi gdan cha snod spyad tshun chod zhe mtshungs 'gang che ba gsar bsgrigs dang / rnam rgyal stong mchod la ched gnyer gyis bsgrubs pa'i mchod rdzas gos chen gyi yol ba dang bla bre gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan phye 'phur dang dngul gyi rnam bum chen po/ stong mchod kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i mchod rkong bdun tshar/ de dag dang 'grig pa'i mchod khri tshon rtsi can du ma/ mtha' skor du bsham rgyu'i bzang gos tshem grub kyi 'phan chung chig stong nyis brgya lhag tsam gos dar gyi gsham bu lda ldi dang bcas cha tshang /sgrub mchod bdag 'jug dang rab gnas rgyas pa las gzhi so so'i sbyin sreg dang gtor sgrub gtor chen sogs gang dang gang gi dgos chas de dang de rnams lhag dang bcas pa dang / dus gtor chen mo sogs la mkho ba'i mchod cha tshangs dbyangs dpal 'bar sogs spub dang sil snyan spus legs cha sum cu lhag dang / gser rnga lnga bcu lhag dang / ḍa dril bcu phrag du ma dang / dung dkar gser zangs kyi gshog pa can dang / dung chen rgya gling /rkang gling so so nas cha du mas mtshon bskang rdzas dang spyan gzigs cha tshang ba/223

/ /yo bstanapa'i name gsung 'bum/gzim chung so sor yang gsham dar dang mtha' dkyil du mchod pa'i lha mo dang mchod rdzas pa ṭa la ñtsa ci rigs bkod pa'i bzang gos gras drub dang tshag drub tshem drub kyi bla bre dang 'phan spus legs du ma dang / dwangs shel dang sengs gos kyi mar me'i 'od khang gos skud kyi phon tshar can sna tshogs dang shel gyi me long du mas brgyan pas gzugs re re ba'ang brgya phrag shar nas ngo mtshar skyed pa/ ji ltar be+eḍūr sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ / lha dbang lus kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba zhes pa'i dper 'os pa lta bu/ gnam rgyan dang logs rgyan du rgya nag dang rgya ser gyi ri mo mkhan mkhas pa'i lag bzo dge mtshan dang ldan pa'i yul ljongs sna tshogs kyi bkod pa ngo mtshar ba dang tshe g.yang bsod nams mnga' thang ci rigs kyi rten 'byung mtshon pa'i gzugs ris khyad mtshar dang /snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad du mas dge legs kyi dpal mtshon pa/ rang grub dang rgya'i bzo bo mkhas pas sgyu 'phrul lta bur bsgrubs pa'i bzhugs khri lan gan can ngo mtshar ba du ma/ 7gong ma'i mdzod nas byung ba'i g.yang ḍi dang chu shel/ man shel/ ma na ho/ g.yu dngabyi ru/ ku ku sha sogs ca lag snod spyad sna tshogs mdog dang dbyibs yid du 'ong zhing bzo bkod phun sum tshogs pa rgya gar nag bal bod rgya ser sogs yul gru tha dad nas thon pa'i khyad mtshar rin thang che ba du mas phyur phur gtams/ steng du gser zangs kyi gasder che legs bzhi/ chos kyi 'khoram ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa sogs yul dus la dpag na paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos rgyan gyi rnam thar du lha khang so so'i tho gnang ba la 'gran bzod pa lta bur yod cing / 'chi med dga' tshal dang nye bar skyed tshal chung ngu ri dang sngon shing me tog sogs kyi bkod pa khyad 'phags shin tu nyams spro ba dang / skyed tshal yid dga' chos 'phel du khang bzang mi 224

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /'dra ba'i bkod pa sna tshogs pa/ dwangs bsil gyi mtsho ri bo bcos ma sna tshogs/ ljon shing gi phreng ba dang me tog gi tshal la sogs pa'i ngo mtshar blo'i rwa ba las 'das pa rnams kyi paṇa chen rnam thar du klu ldings gnyis bsgrub tshul gsungs pa dag las kyang ches khyad du 'phags par yod do/ / rten bzhengs 'ga' zhig dang las mjug phran tshegs phyis su bsgrubs pa yod kyang 'dir phyogs sdoms su bkod pa yin no/ / de ltar 'jam dbyangs7gong ma'i lung gis mkhyen yangs gling du bsngags pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po bkra shis 'od 'bar rten dang brten par bcas ba gsar bskrun mdzad pa la rgyu 'gro gang song gzhung khra'i steng nas dngul thog tu phab par srang khri phrag lnga tsam song snang ngo / / de nas gza' skar 'phrod sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin gtsug lag khang gi phyi nang kun tu dkon mchog gi mchod pa dpag tu med pa bshams nas/rje rang nyid kyis rdo rje slob dpon mdzad de dgon lung gi rgyud pa'i bla ma dge 'dun yongs rdzogs dang bcas pas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas rab gnasakyi cho ga dge legs rgya mtsho'i char 'bebs ltar sbyor ba dngos gzhi zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg chos skyong bsgo ba sogs dang bcas nyin gsum gye ring rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rgyas par mdzad de bkra shis dang dge mtshan gyi dpal chen pos phyogs dus kun tu khyab par byas/ rgyud pa'i bla ma dge 'dun rnams la rab yon gya nom pa bstar/ dgon lung tshogs chen gyi dge 'dun mang yang gtsug lag khang gi ra skor du tshogs par nyin 'khyong gi ja thug dang 'gyed kyi bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas zhus/ khri chen ngag dbang dpal bzang gi sprul sku lang gru'u phyogs su sku 'khrungs pa skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ngos 'dzin mdzad pa bzhin rje nyid kyis bdag gnang ste rten 'brel gang legs kyis gdan drangs pa mtshams 'dir byon/ rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang chen po rten 225

/ /gungajang bstan pa'ithon 'ir+yāngajabum/dang brten pa spyan dbye'i cho ga dang bcas grub pa'i dga' ston dang sprul sku'i gsar ston chabs cig sbrags nas nyin gsum gyi ring khrang zhi dang sgyu ma mkhan gyi rtsed mo spel mar bstar ba dang bcas ston chen byas par/ dgon lung ma bu dgon mchod gzhis bcas dang / gser dgon sogs phan tshun gyi dgonasgrub sde ris med nas 'brel che ba'i slob ma sbyin bdag ston mgron du 'os pa'i mi ser skya drag zhan stong phrag phyed dang gnyis tsam pos te/ bla brang du rje rang nyid kyis gral dbu mdzad nas zhabs drung sku skye bla ma dka' ram chos rje nang so sogs mi drag brgya skor tsam gyi bzhugs gral du za ma'i bye brag sna tshogs sbyar ba'i gsol ston gzab rgyas dang / gos sbrug ther ma sogs bdog pa'i skyes kyis mgu bar mdzad/ 'grul pa byings rnams la chos grwa nas ston mo gnang ste bab 'os bzhin zam ras kha btags sogs gnang sbyin gyis tshim par byas/ rang ngos nas ltad mor 'dus pa'i skye pho mo shin tu mang bo dag la'ang ja thug sogs 'tshem med du gnang ste mchog dman thams cad dga' mgu rangs pa'i dpal la bkod do/ / de nas gtsug lag khang 'di nyid du lo re bzhin 'char can gyi dus mchod sogs sgrub tshul bkas bcad gnang ba'i rim pa'ang / hor zla dang po'i yar tshes la gza' skar bzang po zhig dang dus bsgrigs te rje nyid kyes dbu mdzad nas dpal mgon gyi dam tshig bskang gso nyin gcig / hor zla gnyis pa'i yar tshes la zhabs brtan du dge 'dun bcu res bde mchog dang sgrol ma tshe dpag med kyi tshe sgrub gsum nyin bdun re/ de dang dus mtshungs su tshogs chen du mang ja'i thog rnam rgyal gzungs ring dang tshe gzungs ring po 'bum ther re/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi sngags bye bsnyen dang de'i sgo nas 'chi blu dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs/ dge 'dun brgya phrag brgal bas bka' 'gyur dag 'don/ sa 226
