༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /ga zla ba'i bco lnga'i dus chen la dge 'dun bco lngas rnam rgyal stong mchod/zlab lnga par stabs 'grig dus kyi nyin rma chen dang brtan ma'i gsol mchod rgyas pa/ bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen dang lha bab dus chen/ rje rang gi 'khrungs skar gyi dga' ston nyin rnams su brgya mchod rgyas pa dang 'brel ba'i dkon mchog spyi mchod/ rje'i lnga mchod dang sku gong ma'i dus mchod sogs skyes bu dam pa mang po'i dus mchod gling me rnams dkyus ltar/ hor zla bcu pa'i yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la dge 'dun brgya phrag brgal bas chos skyong spyi'i dus gtor chen po nyin zhag phrugs gcig / dgun gyi nyi ldog dang bstun rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi gtor zlog dang lcam sring gi mdos/gsod la thug pa'i sems can lus po nga dang rin thang che ba'i srog blu nyung mtha'adagung grangs/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la dgra lha dang 'go ba'i lha lnga'i gsol mchod/ mar ngo'i tshes brgyad la tshes skyong spyi'i dus gtor gtong ba rnams chag med du lag len la 'debs rgyu sogs chos spyod rnam bcu'i srol bzang du ma rim gyis 'dzug par mdzad/ chos bzang ri khrod kyang rje gong ma ngag dbang chos rgyam pa'i dus su tshe blos btang gi bsam gtan pa bdun bzhugs pa'i sgrub sde btsugs pa rje nyid kyi ring la dge 'dun 'phel rgyas su gyur par brten bla brang gi sa las mgo rtsom pa dang dus mnyamache chos bzang ri khrod kyi 'du khang yang rje nyid kyis 'bub thebs dang bkod pa gnang ste sngar gyi 'du khang las mtho zhing yangs pa steng 'og tu mchod khang dang mgon khang bka' 'gyur khang sogs dri gtsang khang mang du yod pa'i bkod pa khyad du thon pa/ shing rtsi ldeb ris sogs kyang dngos gtsang ba/steng du gasdir che legs can ja khang chos ra dang bcas gsar bsgrun mdzad/bris 'bur gyi lha rten dang gos dar gser zangs sogs las bsgrubs pa'i 227

༄/ /gung bang bstanaba'isgronarme'i gsung 'bum/mchod rdzas rnam grangs mi nyung ba dang / tshogs gdan tshogs zangs ja khra sogs dge 'dun gyi gnas mal yo byad/ ja tshul gyi thebs rgya mi chung ba dang bcas 'jog pa gnang / rje rang nyid kyis rab gnas gnang ste/ ri khrod la bde chen chos gling zhes ming 'dogs par mdzad/ smon lam/ dbyar gnas/ lnga mchod/ dgu gtor/ gshegs gtor/ dus mchod/phyag mchod skabs kyi tshogs 'don chos spyod cho ga bskang gso sogs zhal 'don gyi rim pa dang / mchod gtor bsham lugs/ dbyangs dang 'dur rta/ rol mo brdung lugs sogs kyis mtshon pa'i phyag len gang yod rnams dag ther zhib par mdzad/ khyad par du ri khrod rang gi dge 'dun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dbang thob mkhan sum cu so gnyis yod 'dug par/ cho ga pa rnams la bdag mdun gyi cho ga cha lag dang bcas pa blo 'dzin byed du bcug ste rta dbyangs dang phyag rgya/ mchod gar ba rnams la gar 'gros/ rol mo ba rnams la dung chen dang rgya gling 'bud tshul/ rnga spub rdung lugs/mchod g.yog pa rnams la mchod gtor bsham lugs tshogs rdzas 'grem lugs yan chad phyag len phra rags thams cad rje rang nyi da sku dngos kyis bslabs/dkyil 'khor gyi bcas shom dang / gos dang gser dngul sogs las sgrubs pa'i mchod rdzas rnam grangs mang po dang / ḍā dril dbang chas sogs rnal 'byor pa'i yo byad/ mchod 'phreng pa'i 'cham gos dang rus rgyan sogs dgos chas shin tu spus legs shing rin thang che ba dang tshad dang ldan pa sogs gang ci nas phun sum tshogs par bsgrubs te/ bstan pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du zla re bzhin sgrub mchod lan gnyis re gtong rgyu'i thebs dang bcas sbyor 'jags mdzad/ dus bzhi'i sgrub mchod chen mo/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nyi shu lnga dang / zla ba dang po dang / bzhi ba dang / bdun pa 228

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /rnams kyi yar ngo'i tshes bcu rnams la btang ste mchod phreng la slebs pa na mchod gar pa rnams kyis 'cham gos dang rus rgyan sogs tshul mthun gyis gyon cing / skabs gang yin gyi mchod rdzas rnams thogs te rol mo dang bcas gar 'gros kyis 'ongs nas dkyil 'khor la g.yon skor byas te mdun phyogs su 'greng zhing / cho ga pa rnams kyis skabs gang yin gyi mchod pa tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas 'bul ba dang gtor 'bul rdzogs rjes rig ma bcu drug gi 'cham dang bcas rdo rje'i glu sogs 'degs 'jog 'gyur khug phra sbom drug ldan gyi gdangs snyan pos mgrin gcig tu len pa sogs 'di skor dam pa gong ma rnams kyi phyag len khungs thub gang yod cha tshang ba 'dzugs par mdzad/ 'dir gnang ba'i dpyid glu'i gdangs 'di deng sang gi rgyud stong smad kyi gdangs dang cung zad mi 'dra'ang rdo rje 'chang lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i sku na rim gyis rgyud du mdzad bzhin pa'i tshad ldan yin pa dang / zhal bzang lta ba'i smon lam gyi gdangs 'di nyid rje 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos mkha' 'gros glu len pa dngos su gsan nas de dang rnam pa mthun par mdzad pa'i byin rlabs can yin pas 'di dag la rang lugs kyi gdangs thun mong ma yin pa 'di nyid byed pa las bsgyur bkod kyi slad cung zad kyang zhugs mi chog pa'i bkas bcad nan cher gnang / de'ang pe'i cing nas chibs bsgyur gnang ste lo gsum gyi ring phal cher chos bzang ri khrod du bzhugs nas thugs dam spyi dang khyad par du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam gyi nyams len la thugs 'grus par mdzad/ de skabs mnal lam du hor mo zhig gis lag ris bstan pas/ rdo rje gri gug dang pad+ma mthong / zur nas cig gis/badz+ra kirte ka pad+ma matā mu dra/ dpe gsum gyis don gsum mtshon/ 'big byed gcod byed rten byed pa/ / go bar gyes la dang du longs/ / the tshom 229

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'isgronaḥ gsung 'bum/bdud kyi bar chad yin/ zer ba dang / bud med mdzes ma zhig gis/chos 'byung zhig bstan nas/ 'di zho 'thung ba'i snod yin/ rnam thar sgo gsum mtshon/ snga nub kyi don de gsal bar 'dis mtshon zer/ yang bu moyo bcu drug lon pa zhig gis 'o byed cing / 'brug gi mjug ma sbrul gyi mgo / 'u cag gnyis kyis thab cig 'dzin/ / lung gsum mdo ru sgyed bu tshugs/ /spud pa mi dgos rlung cig gtong / / me tsha rang drag pas zla ba tshos/ / zla ba bzhus pa klung du 'dren/ / 'thung mi dgos tshim pa'i btung ba yin/ / nga'i pha ma gnyis kyang zas 'di g.yos/ / bu mo nga yang zas 'di g.yo/ /bu khyed la g.yos skol byed par btang / / zer ba sogs rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas rjes su bzung ba'i mtshan ma shin tu gsal ba mang du byung 'dug / thun mtshams rnams su rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa pad+ma rā ga'i them skas/ sgrub thabs shin tu bsdus pa mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i them skas/ snying po dang rkang brgyad kyi phan yon skal bzang dga' skyed/bsnyen yig pad+ma rā ga'i phreng mdzes/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg / bskyed rdzogs kyi dmigs rim shin tu zab pa bde chen lam gyi snying po/ lam gyi rim pa'i stong thun gnad don kun gsal bcas mkha' spyod ma'i chos tshan kyang mang po ljags rtsom dang gzhan yang dzam dkar 'brug zhon nor sgrub rgyas pa dang 'go ba'i lha lnga'i gsol mchod sogs bka' rtsom mang du spel/ mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs lngags rtsom gnang skabs dgun yin kyang gzim gshag la 'ja' yang yang zug pa mang po zhig gis mthong / dus min gyi 'ja' de ji 'dra yin zhes rnam rtog ngan pa byed mkhan kyang 'ga' zhig byung yang / rje bdag nyid chen pos sbas don kun gsal mdzad skabs gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'dus pa'i lo rgyus bzhin rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i man ngag khyad 230

༄/ /rje btsun blobazang chosakyi nyi ma'i gsangagasum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /par can mdzad pa'i stobs kyis pad+ma'i tshal la bung ba bzhin du ḍa kyi ma nye bar 'dus pa'i mtshan ma zhig tu nges so/ / ma rgyud 'od gsal nam mkha'i dbyings/ / grub pa zla ba'i thig le yis/ / bzung tshe mkha' 'gro'i phreng ba bzhin/ / rig 'dzin bye ba'i kurdo rgod/ / phun tshogs dge mtshan kun tu snang ba'i dpyid/ /mi 'gyur bde chen dpal gyi be'u yis/ / thugs gsang mdzes par sba ba de yi bka'/ / sa gsum kun la shis pa'i rol mor che/ /rnal 'byor gsar mtha'i dga' tshal dar ba na/ / gnas gsum ḍa kyi bye ba'i bh+ra ma ra/ / rab dgyes nyams kyis rdo rje'i glu dang bcas/ / dngos grub sbrang rtsi'i dog pa sbyin pas brel/ / zhes kyang ched du brjod par bya'o/ / de'i sengs par rnams su gzhi byes kyi don gnyer can rnams la chos bka' 'ang mang du gnang / skabs shig dpon slob bcu skor gyis be ga tse'i gtor zlog nyinagang ba zhig gnang ste gtor ma 'phen par byon skabs 'ga' zhig gis rgyang ring po nas bltas par/ nyid kyi mtha' skor du khro zhal can mang po zhig gis bskor yod pa'i snang ba byung ste chos skyong gis 'azin las dngos su byas pa'i mtshan mar mngon/ rje nyid kyi 'khrungs yul zhwa dmar bra ti dgon du gdan drangs pa bzhin rib tsam phebs te dgon mchod gzhi'i ser skya thams cad mjal kha dang 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ dgon par mang 'gyed dang 'jog pa'ang gzabs/ dgon pa'i 'du khang zhig ral gyi skyon che bar rje nyid nas gsar gsos gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes mdzad de dgon lung nas shing bzo gyo bzo sa las pa las mgo byed mi bcas gtong ba dang chabs gcig tu rgyu chas dang bkod pa sogs kyang gnang / dgon lung khri thog pa ser lding zhabs drung lo mjug la gtad nas sku gshegs par dge 'dun mang gis rje nyid la khri byin gyis brlabs pa'i ched du mtshams 'dir khrir bzhugs 231

/ /gungaja ba napa'izlanas gsu 'asgegadagos tshul gyi zhu ba nan tan phul ba bzhin zhal bzhes gnang / dgung lo so lnga pa lcags yos lo gsar gyi dga' ba dang po'i nyin 'du khang steng du lha mo'i tshes gtor gyi gral dbu mdzad de tshogs chen du lo gsar gyi tshogs dbur phebs/ dge 'dun la tshogs gtam snyan 'bul dang dge bskos gsar ba bsko bzhag gnang / cho 'phrul smon lam gyi skabs nyin re bzhin gsung chos smon lam lachad med du phebs te gsung chos la skyes rabs kyi bshad pa dang /smon lam la 'brel ba thogs pa rnams kyi ming nas smos pa'i bsngo smon gyi spyan dmigs bstan 'bar ma bde sgon rnams dkyus ltar gnang zhing / tshes brgyad dang bcu bzhi'i lcags mkhar gyi 'cham la gzigs rtog mdzad/ rje gong ma ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho'i rnam thar tshig gi spros pa ha cang mi che'ang don gyi rang bzhin gsal bar mtshon nus pa skal ldan dad pa'i pad+mo rang dbang du 'byed pa'i legs bshad 'di nyid bka' rtsom gye mjug rdzogs par gnang / bar chos dang daphyid chos la chos grwar chad med du phebs te rtsi bzhagadang khyad par du gsung chos la thog ma'i blo sbyong gi bshad pa shin tu gzab rgyas bshad yam tsam ma yin par bka' gdams gong ma'i gsung sgos dang brgyud ldan bla ma'i zhal lung gis brgyan te rgyud thog tu bkal nas sems 'dul ba'i rim pa rtsal du bton pa'i legs bshad kyi dga' ston nyin mang po'i bar du spel bar mdzad/ de dus gsung bshad go bde zhing yid 'khul ba byung bar dge 'dun bgres gzhon bar ma thams cad kyi thugs yid lhag par tshim ste/ bgres pa rnams kyis thugs dam dge sbyor dang gzhon pa rnamasakyis slob gnyer la brtson pa yar skyed gsar tshos kyi zla ba'i 'phel ba bzhin du gyur to/ / smras pa/ ka lā pa yi nor bu'i ba gam bzhin/ / kha pad mngon mtho mchog gsum garto la/ / ga bur tsardon bsung zhim 'thul 232

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /ba'i nang / / nga ro snyan pa'i gdangs dbyangs rol mo 'khrol/ / ci 'dod mchog stsol byin rlabs dri yi ngad/ / chi le spro ba dkon mchog gsum gyi rten/ / ji snyed tshar du dngar ba'i dge mtshan ni/ / nyi ma stong phrag 'bar ba'i gdengs ka bzhin/ / ta thā ga ta'i zhal skyin sku yi tshogs/ / tha dad yul dang phyogs su bzhugs pa kun/ / da lta ma tshang med par 'dir 'dus te/ / na bun bzhin du go mtshams med par gtibs/ / pu ti ka dang snang brnyan rang byon sogs/ / phu mda' byin rlabs rten gyis yongs gang zhing / / bu bzhin skyong mdzad dam can srung ma'i tshogs/ / mu mtha' yas pas khor yug ri bzhin bskor/ / tsa tur mu kha'i gzi byin bskal pa'i me/ /tsha ba'i shugs kyis dgra sde kun 'joms shing / / dza lang rgyas pa'i rgyal blon drogs ldan kun/ / wa ler thogs med 'di yis dbang du sdud/ / zho dang ku mud ltar dkar khang bzang dang / / zo mdog bde ba skyed pa'i yo byad sogs/ / 'o cag mi yi longs spyod las 'das pa'i/ / yo lang sum rtsen bdag po'i dpal 'byor bzhin/ / ra ba khang bzang rim pa mtha' yas kun/ /la lung mkho dgu'i 'byor pas gang ba yang / / sha thang 'bad pas sgrub la stos min par/ / sa gsum phun tshogs mtha' dag ngang gis 'du/ /te ru ka dpal dgyes dgur rol pa'i gnas/ / e baṃ bde ba chen po'i pho brang 'di/ / he te 'jig rten thal gyis 'grub min te/ / e ma tshogs gnyis bzo bo'i 'phrul las byung / / gzhan yang mtha' bral lta bas rgyas btab yang dag bsam gtan lam la gnas/ / dad ldan rnams la gang la gang 'tsham zab rgyas man ngag mtha' yas stsal/ / khyad par las dang skal bar ldan rnams gsang sngags zab lam gnad la sbyar/ / bstan la phan pa mtha' dag tshang bas rnam dkar mdzad bzang bsam las 'das/ / zhes rigs dang 233

༄/ /gung bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum rmad du byung ba'i mdzad bzang 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal gyi cha tsam gtam du byas pa rtogs brjod pad+ma dkar po las rten bzhengs mtha' glas pa sogs bya ba las kyi 'khor lo gtso bor gyur pa'i 'dab ma ste brgyad pa'o/ /234

༄༅/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /༄7/ / 'dab ma dgu pa/ pe cin du lan gnyis pa phebs zhing bstan 'gro'i don mdzad pa'i tshul/de'ang snga sor 'jam dbyangs 7gong ma chen por gnang ba zhus skabs rang yul du rib tsam phebs te ma 'gyang bar phyir 'byon dgos pa'i bka' phebs yod pa bzhin lo 'dir yang pho brang du phebs dgos pa'i gser yig babs par 7gong ma'i bka' bzlog tu med pa'i stobs kyis rngo ba zhabs drung dgon lung khrir bskos te nyid nas rgya nag tu phebs rgyu'i gra bsgrig mdzad/'on kyang 7gong ma chen por dgongs pa gtsang zhus kyis mgyogs par rang yul du phyir ldog rgyu'i 'phen pa kho na thugs la brnag pa'i dbang gis de'i don la ched dmigs kyi rim gror wang zhabs wang rin po che chog gra pa dang bcas par mgon po'i zhi rgyas dbang gsum gyi gtor sgrub sbyin sreg gsum dang bcasasnyub rgyu'i ljags bkod dang / gzhan yang dgongs bzhed kyi don de la gtso bor dmigs nas bla brang du chos skyong spyi dang khyad par dpal mgon gyi bskang ba gnad smin/ dgon lung tshogs chen dang rgyud pa gzhan dgon dang sgrub sde ris med rnams su'ang rim gro ji ltar sgrub dgos mtha' dag las byed rnams la bkod pas khyab par mdzad/ dgon pa'i bla ma dge 'dun thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu gdan sar chibs kyi kha lo myur du bsgyur ba'i gsol ba nan tan btab par 'gyur med rdo rje'i gsung gis zhal bzhes gnang / zhabs brtan gsol 'debs bsod nams ye shes ma'ang de dus dge 'dun mang gis bskul nas mdzad/ thag nye ring gi slob ma sbyin bdag 235

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron 'i gsung 'bum/mjal kha dang phebs rdzong zhu mkhan dgon pa nas thon rag la nyin bzhin zam ma chad du byung bar thugs brel che chung dang bstun nas phyag dbang dang bka' bsgo gsung brtag sogs zhus par so so'i 'dod mos ltar stsal/ dgon sgrub sde ris med kyi zhabs drung sku skye bla ma las sne ci rigs chibs skyel du 'dus/ de nas zla ba lnga pa'i tshes lnga'i nyin dgon pa nas chibs bsgyur gnang bar dge 'dun mang gis rang yul du myur du chibs kha bsgyur ba'i rten 'brel sgo du ma nas phun sum tshogs pa bsgrig par mdzad/ dgon lung ma bu dgon gyi drag zhan du ma'i chibs skyel ja thab tshan du ma dang bcas rim par glang chan dal 'gros kyis byon/ thang ring dgon pa dga' ldan bshad sgrub glingagi bla ma dge 'dun rnams kyis khrir bzhugs rgyu'i snyan gsan nan cher zhus yod na mdo smad du myur du chibabasgyur ba'i rten 'brel la dgongs nas lam zhor du thang ring dgon par phebs te khri 'don gyi rten 'brel bsgrig par mdzad/ dgon pa'i bla spyi dang rgyud pa bla spyi ba ju'u dgon bla spyi sogs gzhi byes kyi drag zhan mang pos khri 'bul btegs/ dge 'dun la lam rim chen mo dbu btsugs te mchod brjod nas tshigs bcad gcig gi bshad pa gnang /de nas rim gyis phebs par a lag sha dang or du su ho sho'u so so'i sa tshigs rnams su dpon chen mang po blon 'bangs dang bcas pas bsu skyel bkur ste phun sum tshogs pa'i ngos tsha zhag dang u la'i gra bsgrig gsol ston dang 'bul nod sogs kyi bsnyen bkur bla na med pa zhus par chos bka' sogs gang la gang 'tsham gyes re 'bras smin par mdzad/ tsha zhag gar babs su dad pas 'dus pa'i mjal ba drag zhan mang po la phyag dbang dang sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang gzungs sngags zab mo mang po dang / ma ṇi'i bzlas lung khas len bskor ba bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor dang bcas star chags su gnang / or 236

༄7/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /du su'i o thog wang sogs kyis gdan 'dren nan che na'ang 7gong ma'i bka' ne+e hor nas mtshams zhus 'bul dgos tshul phebs 'dug par mtshams zhu'i nyi skar thag nye bas lam zhor du cun gang pe'i zi'i dgon pa gsar bar bcag malagacig gnang ba tsam las phyogs gzhan du pheb long ma byung ba la thams cad du phyir lam 'byon rgyu'i zhal bzhes bzang pos mgu bar mdzad/ thu med kyi mi drag ser skya du mas chibs bsu dang bcas mkhar sngon du slebs/sbyin bdag wang rat+na sidhi'i yel chi ja lang no mon tshang dang khā rab brtan ha ban no mon tshang sogs drag zhan drug cu skor u lha'i zhon rta bzhi bcu/ shing rta sum cu dang bcas 'byor te wang gi mtshams zhu'i yi ge dang sengs gos kyi na bza' phu thung ma'i skor dang nyer spyad 'ga' zhig phul/ chos skyabs ti yān chi'i dgon pa dang mkhar sngon pa ga rdza/ bas astan dang cang ga tā sogs kyis khyim rnams su rim pas gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus pa so sor dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston spel/ lam zhor du cha har tsho ba so so'i lha khang dang mi drag 'byor ldan rnams kyis khyim du gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus pa bdag gir mdzad de lung rjes gnang sogs kyis re ba bskangs/do lon no'ur dang nye ba'i sa'i cha bā shing thu gol zer bar sbyin bdag har chenawang rat+na sirnyi yab sras blon 'khor dang bcas rta ba brgya phrag brgal ba chibs bsur 'byor/ mchod yon rnam gnyis zhag gcig lhan du bzhugs te gsung gleng dmar bar mdzad/ phyir nyin wang 'khor bcas zhi hor du theg / do lon no'u'i gyi dgon pa g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi dom chi gnyer ba'i ja thab thog har chin pe'i zi 'chi med rdo rje 'khor bcas dang lcang skya rdo rje 'changagis gtong ba gnang ba'i chos rje ngo g.yog sogs drag zhan gyi bsu ba mang po 'byor/ do lon no'ur du dgon lung pa do lon mkhan po'i khang bar 237

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'izlaname'igasung 'bum/bzhugs gnas mdzad de nyin kha shas bzhugs/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang dang hal ha rje btsun dam pa rnam gnyis do lon no'ur du zhal 'dzom nas bzhugs 'dug par nyin re bzhin lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gi sku mdun du phebs nas ja sbyor gnyis gsum re'i ring lugs gnyis kyi gsung gleng mang du mdzad/lca skya rdo rje 'chang la maṇ+ḍal kha btags dngul srang bzhi brgya phul te rje rang nyid la re zhing ltos pa'i gra slob sbyin bdag thams cad gnas skabs mi mthun pa'i nyer 'tshe mtha' dag dang bral nas tshe bsod dpal 'byor rnam dkar gyi bya ba thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang / mthar thug bla na med pa'ibyung chub chen po myur ba nyid du 'thob pa'i ched du bsngo smon gyi mtshams spyor dang skyabs 'jug yang dag zhus/ hal ha rje btsun dam pa rin po che'i sgar thog tu'ang phebs nas mjal phrad mdzad/ rje btsun dam pa'i zhabs phyi che gras rnams kyis kyang gus 'dud dang bcas phyag dbang dang bsu skyel sogs zhus/ sbyin bdag har chin wang gi btsun mo ma ṇi dha ra 'khor bcas mjal du 'ongs par phyag dbang stsal/ lcang skya rin po che dang rje btsun dam pa rnam gnyis la mjal khar 'dus pa'i bla dpon drag zhan thams cad kyis rje 'di'i mjal khar yang mu mthud nas gshar bar phyag dbang sogs kyis tshim par mdzad/ do lon no'ur nas thon skabs lcang skya rin po che'i mgron gnyer dang / dgon pa gnyis kyi las sne sogs drag zhan mang pos chibs skyel ja thab zhus/ ku lu khu khe'i zhabs drung gis lam thog tu bzhugs gur gra bsgrig bgyis par gdan drangs nas gsol tshigs sogs kyi bsnyen bkur zhus/hang chin gyi dpon blon mi drag phal che ba 7gong ma'i zhabs phyir ri dwags la 'gro rgyur zhe hor du 'dus pa'i skabs yin pas e phu yul 'khor skyong sogs gzhis sdod kyi dpon blon 'ga' zhig dang / wang gi lha khang gi tā bla ma 238

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /gnyisalas sne sogs dang bcas ong nyod kyi sa'i cha zhig tu chibs bsu dang thab bsu zhus/ de nas rim gyis rta thab rim pa du ma dang mjal ba mang po'i 'du long dang bcas zla ba bdun pa'i tshes nyer gcig la sbyin bdag har chinawang rat+na sirnyi'i ya mon du 'byor nyin bkra shis lung ba'i mdar wang gi sras gsum pa sogs a ke dang ke ke rnams kyis thab bsu dang / yā mon gyi sgo drung du lha khang gi tā bla ma dge 'dun rnams kyi seng sprengs dang bcas phyag phebs/ 'byor ston zhus thog wang gi btsun mo sras mo blon po rnams kyis legs dar dang bcas phyag dbang zhus/ sngar gyi gzim gshag tu bzhugs gnas mdzad cing ho sho'u tha dad nas 'byor mjal la 'ongs pa'i drag zhan mang por phyag dbang sogs gnang / zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gcig la sbyin bdag wang gis lngags bkod gnang ba bzhin rje nyid mdo smad nas gsar du byon pa'i thog ma'i dga' ston du btsun mo dang sras sras mo blon po rnams kyis dngos 'bul spyan lam du bstar te lha khang gi bla ma dge 'dun rnams kyis bde mchog dkar po'i brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga bsgrubs pa dang sbrags nas dngul srang nyi shu las grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal nang mdzod sku gsung thugs rten/ bzhugs gdan rgyab yol na bza' cha tshang / dngul srang stong phrag gcig gos chen yug lnga shel dang dkar yol gyi snod spyad 'ga' zhig / yid bzhin 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bcas phul te zhabs pad yun ring du brtan pa dang 7gong ma'i dgongs bzhed ltar pho brang chen por gtan chags bzhugs rgyu'i gsol ba nan tan btab par bka' lan bzang bos tshim par mdzad/ de nas zhe hor du phebs te 7gong ma chen por dngos mjal gyis mtshams zhus phul par 7gong nas khyed rang a mdor song nas lo kha shas kyi ring 'dir nged kyi zhabs brtan la dmigs nas gtsug lag khang rten gsum bzhengs pa dang grwa pa 239

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/rnams la chos slob tu bcug pa thos nas dga' ba yin/ nad gzhi sangs drag tu song yod 'gro sogs bka' 'dri mang du phebs par/ so sor bka' lanadang nad gzhi da dung gting drag tu ma song ba'i rgyu mtshan pus btsugs nas zhus/ lcang skya hu thog thu dang rje btsun dam pa rnam gnyis dang lhan du po ta la'i rab gnas dang smon lam gyi gral dbur sdod ces bka' babs pa bzhin lcang skya rdo rje 'chang dang rje btsun dam pa/ rje 'di pa yab sras gsum gyisapo ta la'i rab gnas dang dge 'dun stong lhag 'dus pa'i smon lam gyi tshogs dbu mdzad pa la/ 7gong ma chen po'ang smon lam gyi tshogs la lhan du bzhugs te yab sras rnam pa gsum la gos dang dngul sogs kyi 'bul ba spam mtho ba dang / dge 'dun la sku 'gyed gya nom pa gsol ras stsal/ 7gong ma'i sku mdun gyi ston gral du'ang yab sras rnam pa lhan du bzhugs/ sbyin bdag har chin wang rat+na sirnyi pā rin wang ba thu e phu bde legs bzang po pe'i zi 'chi med rdo rje/ cang pe'i zi ja sag gung che chog / o'u han wang bkra shis rab brtan pa'i zi chos rgyal gung blo bzang shes rab gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas sogs 7gong ma'i mtshams zhur 'dus pa'i phyi log gi ho sho'u mngawa'i wang pe'i li pe'i zi gung tha'i ji tha bu nang thu sa lag chin khir chi sogs dpon blon mi drag brgya phrag du ma spyi 'dus kyis rje nyid la brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te zhabs pad brtan pa dang / lhag par du rgya nag dang hor gyi yul gru chen po'i bstan pa dang sems can gyi don thugs la dgongs nas 7gong ma'i dgongs bzhed dang bstun pa gnang ste rgyal khab chen por yun ring bzhugs pa'i gsol ba nan tan btab par bka' lan bzang pos mgu bar mdzad/ dpon blon de rnams g.yog 'khor dang bcas par ri dwags la 'gro rgyu'i lam chos seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi rjes gnang stsal/240

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /mtshan sgrog mkhan chen sogs zhe hor gyi bla ma che chung rnams dang khyad par du lcang skya rdo rje 'chang nas 7gong ma'i dgongs bzhed dang bstun pa gal che tshul bka' nan mdzad yod kyang rje nyid nas gong mar dngos mjal lan drug tsam zhus pa'i tshe bka' 'dri mang du phebs pa la bzhugs rgyu'i snyan sgon gyi phyogs tsam yang ma zhus par bskung gzhi 'phar ldang che tshul dang pho brang gi sa chu mi 'phrod pa'i bab rgyun kho na zhus/ nyid la thugs 'dris can nang blon rnams la brgyud nas kyang de lugs kyi zhu ba kho na thabs kyis phul thar 7gong ma chen po'ang mi dgyes pa'i rnam pa med par de lta yin na phyir rang yul la phebs chog ces dgyes bzhin du dgongs pa khrol bas thugs la dga' bdes khyab par gyur/ 7gong ma ri dwags la phebs rgyu'i sngar nyin gsol ja'i kho khor ser po dang gsol dkar ser po gsol 'phro bcas dang shel dang g.yang ṭi'i ca lag 'ga' zhig / gos chen sogs kyi gsol ras phon chen po bdag rkyen stsal/ phyi nyin ri dwags la 'byon pa'i zhabs skyel zhus shing lam thog nas kha btags btegs te mtshams zhus phul bar dgyes pa'i bka' stsal bzang po dang bcas kha btags gnang / lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gi mdun du gsang chos 'ga' zhig zhus pa bzhed pa bzhin gnang zhing bslab ston zhib rgyas dang dngos po gya nom pa'i skyes kyang phon cher stsal/ mtshan sgrog mkhan chen sogs dgon sde phan tshun gyi bla ma rnams nas gsol tshigs sogs kyi bsnyen bkur zhus/ dge 'dun pa dang jun gar gyi mi skya pho mo drag zhan du ma mjal du 'ongs pa la phyag dbang 'dod chos sogs rang rang gi mos pa bzhin stsal/ dgon sde so sor mang 'gyed kyi bsnyen bkur thog zhabs brtan kyang mang bo bsgrubs/ de nam har chin du sbyin bdag wang gi sā mon la phebs/doman no'ur nas khrid 'ongs pa'i lha bzo mkhas pa 'ga' la chos bzang ri 241

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron 'i gsung 'bum/khrod kyi sgrub mchod dang tshes gtor la bkram rgyu'i mkha' spyod ma'i sku thog tshad bla brgyud dang bcas pa lha mo'i sku thang thog tshad 'khor tshogs cha tshang can/lha mo'i bskar rdzas kyi bkod pa sogs yi dam chos skyong gi zhal thang dang spyan gzigs mang po rje rang nyid kyis ljags bkod gnang ste bzhengs su bcug / lha bab dus chen dang bstun nas rab byung dge tshul mang po dang bsnyen rdzogs bsgrub bya brgya dang lnga bcas la tshigs snga phyi'i sdom pa phog ste nges legs kyi sa bon smin par mdzad/ sbyin bdag wang yab sras kyang ri dwags kyi sa cha nas tshur phebs/ wang gi bzhed mos bzhin khong yum sras dang bla ma gra rigs nyung 'dus la chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum dang dpal mgon zhal bzhi ba'i rjes gnang go cha'i dpa' bo drug dang dpa' mo drug gi rjes gnang sogs zab chos yid bzhin nor bus thugs kyi yong go yongs su gtams/gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyis yāmon du rta thab ser sprengs dang bcas bkur ste chen pos gdan drangs sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang sogs 'dod chos ci rigs stsal/ gung dpon pos maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten/ tshag grub kyi bzhugs gdan rgyab yol/ dngul srang nyis brgya/gos chen yug lnga/ shel dang dkar yol gyi snod spyad sogs dngos 'bul gya nom pa brtan bzhugs lugs su phul/ gung gi lha khang gi hu bi la gan gnyis dang e me gen ha thon lha skyabs gung sogs ho ro de ma'i dpon blon drag zhan mang pos rang rang gi gshag tu gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus par lung rjes gnang sogs chos bka' du ma gnang / tshur lam a ki don grub rdo rjes gdan drangs nas 'dod chos zhus shing bsnyen bkur 'bul nod gzabs/zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bdun rje nyid kyi 'khrungs skar nyin sbyin bdag wang rat+na sirnyi btsun mo sras sras mo dang gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas btsun mo sras 242

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /sras mo dang bcas pa/ ho ro yas mas dang ho sho'u'i nang gi dpon dpon mo blon po che phra bla ma grwa rigs/ gzhan yang ja sag gung che che ga sku mched gsum dpon blon gyi 'khor dang bcas pas mtshon har chin dang o'u han sogs ho sho'u tha dad kyi bla ma dang dpon blon sogs 'khrungs skar gyi dga' ston du dad mos kyis 'dus pa'i 'byor ldan gyi ser skya gtso 'khor stong phrag mngapos khra spung de tshogs te/ wang gi lha khang gi bla ma dge 'dun rnams kyis bde mchog dkar po'i cho ga bsgrubs nas rje nyid mchod rdzas dang spos rol gyis mdun bsus te bkur ste chen pos seng ge'i khri la zhabs pad bkod bla ma yi dam dbyer med pa la phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa phul cing / sku tshe brtan pa'i gsol ba btab ste maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa dang chabs gcig tu sbyin bdag wang gis dngul srang nyi shu rtsa lnga'i maṇ+ḍal dar tshon sna lnga'i sne 'dogs can sku gsung thugs rten/ bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dbyar dgun gyin bza' phu thung ma dang ban chas skor/ gos kye mchod rdzas 'ga' zhig dngul dang dwangs shel dkar yol sogs kyi mchod cha dang sbyad pa mang po/dngulasrang lnga brgya gos chen dang bu la ga dgu re/ nor bu don yod zhags pa bcas dang / btsun mos sgrol dkar gye sku tshag grub khyad mtshar sras sras mo so sos rten 'byung gi 'bul ba mang po/ ja sag gung che cheg gis maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten/ bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dngul srang nyis brgya dang lnga bcu/ gos chen kha shas dang pags rigs sogs/ gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyis maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten/ bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dngul srang brgya dang lnga bcu gos chen 'ga' zhig / nyer spyad sna tshogs/ gung gi btsun mo dang sras mo rtag brtan a ke btsun mo sras bcas sogs dga' ston la ched gtad kyis 'ongs pa'i sgob ma sbyin bdag 243

༄/ /gung bangabastanaba'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/drag zhan gang yod mu mthud nas gshar te rang rang gi 'byor tshod kyis 'dog pa'i dngos 'bul gzab rgyas phul zhing dpon chen rnams kyis zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol 'debs dang skyabs 'jug nan tan zhus par bab bstun gyi bka' lan bzang po gnang / wang chen mo nas zhabs phyi pa rnams la go bab dang bstun pa'i dgun gyi go lag cha tshang re gsol ras stsal/ 'khrungs skar gyi ston mo sbyin bdag wang gi gzhung nas thon pa gnang ste mchod yon rnamasagatsos pa'i gzhi byes kyi mi drag gang yod la mdun cog re rer dkar yol mang po bsgrigs pa'i rgya'i lugs kyi ston mo rgya gar na mgron khyad par can la rje'u tsho'i sum brgya'i kha zas sbyin par rin phreng las gsungs pa dang cha 'dra ba'i zas sna brgya phrag gi gsol ston gzab rgyas zhus shing / wang chen mo dang ja sag gung gnyis rang rang gi mnga' 'og gi shed chen rnams stobs rtsal 'gran du 'jug pa dang / rol mo sna tshogs brdebs pa'i sgra snyan dang sprags nas glu len du 'jug pa dang / skar mda' phan tshun 'phang ba lta bu'i me'i 'phrul 'khor gyi rtsed mo sogs nyin mtshan spel mar kun tu dga' ba'i rol gar gyi rtsed 'jo ya mtshan pa spyan lam du bstar/ rje nyid nas dad ldan gyi slob ma sbyin bdag de rnams la so so'i go bab dang bstun nas lha rten dang spos snam byin rten srung mdud ci rigs kyi gnang skyes 'tshem med du stsal/rgas shing 'khog pas nyam thag pa dang dbul phongs tshun chad la kha btags dong tshe sogs zang zing gi sbyin pa dang mtshan dang gzungs sngags zab mo rna lam du sgogs pa sogs chos kyi sbyin pas tshim par mdzad cing / byis pa chung ngu rnams kyang shing thog sogs bza' btung gis dga' bar byas/ sbyin bdag wang 'khor bcas pho brang du phebs rgyur lam chos su bde mchog dkar po'i tshe dbang stsal/ bstan 'dzin me'i rin sogs wang gi ho re'i blon chen 244

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /mang pos rang rang gi khyim du gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus par rkyen sel gyi rim gro dang chos sbyin gang 'dod gnang / bstan 'dzin me'i rin gyis dngul srang lnga brgya dang gzhan rnams kyang 'byor tshod dang bstun pas bdog pa yod 'bul lta bu zhus/ dgun gyi nyi ldog skabs dang lo mjug tu wangagi zhabs brtan la dmigs pa'i rim gro 'ga' zhig bsgrubs/ dgung lo so drug pa chu 'brug gi gnam lo gsar ba'i rang zhal gsar du ngoms pa'i tshesa'i wang gi wamon du lha mo'i tshes gtor gyi tshogs dbu mdzad/ gzhis sdod kyi sras sras mo dang blon po rnams kyis lo gsar gyi mjal kha dang dga' ston zhus/ gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas sogs ho ro yas mas kyi mi drag so sos gdan drangs nas lo gsar gyi ston mo zhus shing rtsed mo sna tshogs kyi gzigs mo bstar ba gzigs/ bco lnga'i nyin lha khang gi smon lam dang byams skor la phebs der tshogs pa'i skye pho mo'i khrom chen po la phyag dbang gnang / tā bla ma gnyis kyis rang rang gi gshag tu gdan drangs nas 'dod chos 'ga' zhig zhus shing gsol ston dang dngos 'bul rgya chen po btegs/dgun dang dpyid kyi ring 'dir wang gi yā mon gyi gzim gshag dang dben gnas bde chen rab rgyas gling gnyis su res mos kyis bzhugs nas thugs dam shin tu 'phel bar nub gcig rmi lam ya mtshan ba byung tshul yi ger bkod pa 'di lta sta/ rje btsun bla ma thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ / byang chub bar du rjes su bzung du gsol/ kho bo dharma badz+ra rang lo so drug pa chu pho 'brug gi lo'i mchu zla ba'i nyi shu brgyad kyi mtshan mo rmi lam du rdo rje 'chang lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa dang mjal nas gsung 'phros mang po zhig gnang ba'i mthar/ nged kyis mgur ma zhig 'then pa la rje bla ma mchog nasalan gyi tshul dugadangs snyan po dang bcas gsung mgur zhig gnang ba mnal sad pa na 245

mi/ /gung bstanapa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/tshig phal cher blo la ma brjed par 'dug pa yi ger bkod pa ni 'di ltar ro/ / rje mi bskyod ngo bo bka' drin can/ / zhing bye ba phrag brgyar sprul pa spro/ / thugs rjes sems can yongs la khyab/ / 'bangs bdag gi spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ / khyed nyon dang dad pa brtan pa'i bu/ / glu 'di la nyon la don la soms/ / spyir 'du byas chos rnams mi rtag cing / / sgos sgyu lus chu bur bas kyang g.yo/ / don med kyi bya ba 'di rang blo 'brid pa'i thabs/ /'di snang gi phun tshogs 'byor na yang / / 'phral phan phan 'dra yang phugs su bslu/ / nam yang mi bslu ba lung rtogs kyi bstan pa yin/ /da thos don nyams su mi len nam/ / byang chub kye sems dang stong nyid lta/ /'di mdo sngags gnyis kyi lam gyi srog / phyi nang gi thabs kyi g.yo byed kun/ /lam po cher btsud na mi legs sam/ / a cang nged kyis ku re yin/ / shes na 'khor ba spangs ba dka' rgyu med/ / ma shes na chos kyang 'khor ba'i rgyu/ / phyis 'byung 'di yang sems la zhog / bar 'di nas tshig 'gag brjed 'dug / mjug tu/ sa ltar byang chub sems kyi gzhi zin shog / ri ltar ting 'dzin brtan par shog / 'phrin las nyi zla bzhin du shog / sku tshe ri dbang ltar brtan shog / ces pa'o/ / 'di'ang har chen wang gi gzim khang du brjed thor bris pa'o/ / zhes pa 'di nyid yin la/tshul 'di lta bu ni sad rmi mnyam par rtogs pa klong du gyur pa'i stobs kyis sad mi mnyam pa nyid du song ba'i bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi khyad chos phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags bla na med pa mkhas pa rnam dpyod can rnams chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i ngo mtshar dang mos gus lhag par skye ba'i 'os su gyur ba zhig go /snga phyir har chin ho sho'u lnga dang o'u han yong nyod ba rin ne'i man sogs ho sho'u tha dad nas bla dpon sbyin bdag gra rigs sogs bgrang las 246

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /'das pa mjal du 'ongs pa rnams drag zhan la ma ltos par thun mtshams su mjal kha sogs 'dod pa bzhin gnang / lung khrid rjes gnang sogs 'dod chos dang tshigs snga phyi'i sdom pa bka' bsgo gsung brtag phyag sman srung ba sogs gang zhus thams cad kyang 'dod dgur stsal te re ba'i shing rta yongs su 'gongs par mdzad/ khyad par du smon lam bla ma bkra shis dar rgyas sogs snod ldan gyi slob ma 'ga' zhig la zab chos bka' rgya can yang mang du gnang / de nas be'i zi'i ho sho 'chi ba tshan la phebs te nyin bdun bzhugs/mong gol cin cha gān ti yun chi'i zhabs drung mjal du phebs par phyag dbang chos 'brel bzhed mos ltar gnang / khong gis dngul srang brgya dang lnga bcu sogs 'bul nod gya gom pa phul/ be'i zi 'chi med rdo rje dang e phu dge legs bsam 'grub sogs dpon blon mang po 'ongs nas gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul te phebs skabs smon lam bla ma bkra shis dar rgyas kyis dgon par gdan drangs/ spyi sger nas 'dod chos zhus pa'i reb bskong bar mdzad/ smon lam bla mas snga phyir dngul srang bzhi brgya dang chibs rta chibs drel sogs 'bul ba rnam grangs mang po phul/ be'i zi'i yā mon du dbon blon brgya phrag du mas lta bsu thab bsu dang dge 'dun stong lhag gis ser sbrengs dge ba'i sa bon gyis yongs su bskul ba'i dad 'dus kyi mjal ba'i khrom nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu dang bcas phyag phebs/ zla phyed tsam bzhugs 'di la ho sho'u rang dang thu med mong gol cin sogs nas rkang tshugs kyis 'ongs pa'i dad ldan khri phrag du ma byin rlabs dang gsung gi bdud rtsis yid tshim par mdzad/ dpon po yum sras dang bcas par tshe lha gsum dang drag po gsum dril sogs lha du ma'i rjes gnang dang rkyen sel gyi rim gro sogs bzhed mos ltar gnang zhing spyi chos su spyan ras gzigs kyi khrom dbang stsal/247

༄ / /gung bang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/sbyin bdag bo'i zis gzhis len bsnyen bkur phul du phyin pa'i thog dngul srang stong dang brgya dre'u bcu tham pa sogs 'bul ba spam mtho ba phul/ man ju nas nas dang e phu dge legs bsam 'grub sogs ho ro'i mi bzang rnams kyis rang rang gi khyim du gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur 'bul nod gzab par so sor 'dod chos dang bka' bsgo gsung brtag sogs kyis mgu bar mdzad/ de nas phyir 'khor te sbyin bdag wang gi yā mon du byon/ phan tshun zla ba gnyis kyi bar lam zhor du wang dang pe'i zi ja sag gung gsum gyi ho sho'u'i mi drag dang 'byor ldan du mas lha khang dang rang rang gi khyim gzhis sogs su gdan drangs te bkur ste zhabs tog gces nor yod dgu'i 'bul nod sogs nus pa rtsal sprugs kyis mchod sprin bar ma chad du spros/ de thams cad la'ang mos pa dang 'tsham pa'i chos kyi dga' ston lhug par stsal te dgyes bzhin rjes su bzung / wang yum sras dang lha khang gi tā bla ma sogs mi drag rnams la mtshan brjod kyi 'jam dpal dang rnam sras ser chen phag dkar shes rab gsal byed sogs lha 'ga' zhig gi rjes gnang stsal/gzhan yang thag nye ring nas ched gtad kyis mjal mi drag zhan har chen nas thon rag la nyin bzhin zam ma chad du byung bar 'dod mos dang bstun pa'i lung rjes gnang rab byung dge tshul slong gi sdom pa sogs spel mar mdzad/wang chen mos bde mchog dkar po'i brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga dang sbrags nas dngul srang sum cu'i maṇ+ḍal sne 'dogs can/ nang mdzod/ sku gsung thugs rten/ tshag grub kyi bzhugs gdan rgyab yol/ sengs gos kyi na bza' cha tshang / dngul bum dang dngul thod sogs mchod rdzas dang /sku'i nyer spyad mang bo/ dngul srang stong phrag gnyis dang brgya dang lnga bcu/gos chen legs pa yug dgu / bu la ga dgu / rnga mong gnyis/ rta drel 248

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /gnyis/ don yod lcags kyu bcas phul te zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa dang shar phyogs kyi gdul bya'i zhing du yang yang chibs kha bsgyur ba'i gsol ba btab par bka' lan bzang pos mnyes par mdzad/ wang chen mo la khyed rang gi sras tho yon mthu stobs nyi ma 'di grwa sa gcig tu bzhag na legs zhes bskul ma gnang ba bzhin rje nyid la gtad gnyer zhus te zhabs phyir mngags/ zla ba lnga pa'i nyi shu gnyis la wang gtsos pa'i gzhi byes kyi chibs skyel pa drag zhan stong phrag tsam dang lhan du har tshan wang gi yā mon nas thon/ake don grub rdo rjes khyim du gdan drangs nas gsol ston dang dngul srang brgya tham pa sogs 'bul ba gzabs shing / che phra thams cad kyis phyag dbang bka' bsgo zhus/ gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyis yā mon du gdan drangs par zhag gsum bzhugs te wang dang gung yum sras sogs mi drag du ma la bde mchog dkar po'i tshe dbang dang / ser skya'i tshogs pa stong phrag brgal bar spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang dang sgyung gnas cho ga'i lung gnang / gung dpon pos maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten/bzhugs gdan rgyab yol/ dngul srang brgya/ gos chen yug lnga sogs 'bul ba mang po phul/ sbyin bdag ja sag gung che cheg sku mched rnams dang /yun 'dur ho'u gung / e phu rnam rgyal sogs dpon blon mang po chibs skyel du slebs/ tha bu nang tshul khrims kyis gzhi gsar par ras gur nang du gdan drangs nas gsol ston dang 'bul nod phul/ khang ba 'bub rgyu'i gnas gzigs dang byin rlabs mdzad/ e me gen ha thon gyes gdan drangs nas der bzhugs/ tshogs pa mang po la sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang stsal/ dpon mos gzhis len ston mo dang 'bul nod gzabs/ ja sag gung gis bzhugs gur gra bsgrig bgyis par gdan drangs nas phebs ston 249

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/gzab rgyas dang gzim gur khang pa'i dbyibs can/ dngul srang lnga brgya dbang chas tshang ma tsardon gyi ḍa ma ru sogs bdog pa'i tshan grangs bstar/un 'dur ho'u gung dang e phu rnam rgyal so so nas kyang dngos 'bul gzabs/ja sag gung 'khor bcas dang ho sho'u gzhan gyi chibs skyel pa byings rnams phyag dbang bka' bsgo zhus te phyir log / ong nyod kyi sa sner yo'u han wang bkra shis rab brtan yab sras/ nu bo tho yon sogs 'khor mang po dang bcas chibs skyel du 'byor/ sgar thog tu gsol ston rgyas pa dang dngul srang nyis brgya gos chen yug gsum bcas phul te bka' bsgo skyabs 'jug zhus/ su por ga'i gol du ong nyod pe'i li'i nu bo dbang chen tho yon ngo g.yog 'byor nas ma gzungs skyid dang phu bo be'i li tho yon rang gi 'bul ba rnams so sor phul te phyag dbang dang gsung brtag sogs zhus/ sbyin bdag wang yum bcas dang gung che chung gnyis wang dang gung gi lha khang gi tā bla ma rnams dang bcas dpon blon ser skya brgya phrag du ma nyin lnga'i lam du zhabs phyir 'brangs te lam thog nas phebs ston rgyas pa dang phyag dbang bka' bsgo zhus nas 'bral mi phod pa'i rnam pas phyir log / sod nyod wang gi a ke e phu tshe brtan ngo g.yog lam nas gsol ja dang 'bul nor btegs te phyag dbang zhus/ yod nyod pa'i zi dus las 'das par dpon mo dang a ke sogs kyis sgar thog tu mjal nas bsngo rten gzab rgyas phul bar ljags bsngo spyan dmigs bka' drin bskyangs/ de nas rim gyis do lon no'ur du slebs nye ba na sha ra su me'i hal ha tā bla ma dem chi dang bcas/ khu khu su ma'i dem chi gnyis/ do lon mkhan po/ lcang skya bla brang gi gnyer ba/ ra kho hu thog thu'i mgron gnyer sogs chibs bsur 'byor te dgon pa gnyis kyi spyi'i ja thab zhus/ de nas do lon no'ur du phebs te nyin gsum bzhugs/250

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /dgon pa gnyis kyi dge 'dun dang phyi log gi ho sho'u ris med kyi mi drag zhan du ma mjal du 'ongs pa phyag dbang dang 'dod chos sogs so so'i mos pa dang bstun nas gnang / rta tshag rje drung sprul pa'i sku der bzhugs pa dang phan tshun mjal phrad gnang zhing bka' mchid 'phel ba byung / dgon pa gnyis kye tā bla ma dem chi gnyer pa sogs dang bla brang so so'i mi drag rnams sgar thog nas mjal kha zhus te rang rang gi ngos nas gsol ja zhabs tog dang chi ga drangs/ sbyin bdag wang gi sras che ba don grub tshe brtan sogs har chin nas chibs skyel du 'ongs pa'i ser skya drag zhan brgya skor la ston mo dang byin rtenasbang mdud sogs gnang / wang gi ljags bkod ltar 'khor tshos kyang nyin dpon g.yog la ston chen zhus/ do lon no'ur nas phebs dus lam zhor du dgon pa so sor mchod mjal mdzad par so so'i dge 'dun rnams kyis ser sbrengs kyis mdun bsus te bkur ste chen pos gdan drangs nas gsol ja dang phyag dbang zhus/ rje drung sprul sku rin po che'i sku tshab ngo g.yog gis sha bar thu nas ja thab zhus par/ de'i steng nas wang gi sras e phu don grub tshe brtan gtsos pa'i har chen gyi chibs skyel pa byings rnams phyag dbang dang bka' bsgo zhus te phyir log / hal ha tā bla ma sogs dgon pa gnyis kyi dem chi gnyer ba dang bla brang so so'i sku tshab rnams kyis hu su thu la dgon pa spyi'i ja thab gra bsgrig bgyes par gdan drangs nas gsol ja dka' spro zhus te phyir log ku lu kho khu'i zhabs drung dang do lon mkhan po ngo g.yog gis zhag bab bar du chibs skyel zhus te/ khong gnyis dang u ger tā bstan 'dzin ka le tā tshe dbang yel gi tā tshe ring sogs 'byor ldan mang po'i sgar thog tu gsol ston dang dngos 'bul gang rgyas thog sog lugs bzhin rta rgyug shed 'gran glu dang rol mo sna tshogs sbrags pa'i dbyangs snyan sogs kyi rtsed 'jo du 251

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/ma spyan lam du bstar/ de nas bzung ste mkhar sngon bar du cha har tsho ba so so'i 'byor ldan gyi ser skya du ma dad mos kyis bsu skyel zhus pa dang / gung zhig gi sa char thab shing dang mar 'o skyel ba dang / rang rang gi khyim dang lha khang so sor gdan drangs nas gsol ston chi ga drangs thog glu len sogs kyi dga' rtsed spel zhing / bshul ring gi lam du phan thogs nges kyi rnga rta'i 'bulab 'degs pa sogs bkur ste bla na med pa zhus/ rje nyid nas kyang lung khrid rjes gnang sogs 'dod chos dang rkyen sel rim gro bka' bsgo skyabs 'jug sogs rang rang gi mos pa dang bstun nas yid tshim par stsal/lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gis cha har ku lu o lan gye ja lang skal bzang brgyud nas gsung shog cig gnang ba la/ os rong wang dang lha btsun no mon han gnyis kyi bar du sel zhugs yod 'dug pas de phan tshun 'dum thabs shig gyis gsung 'dug par/ yi ge 'byor rgyu'i snga dgung rje nyid kyi mnal lam la bud med cig gis/ rdo rje rdo rje sa bcom zer yang / / 'joms byed rdo rje sa 'og song / / rdo rje ma bcom slar yang rnyed/ / zer ba zhig byung ba skabs deragasal ba zhig ma byung yang phyis su dpyad tshe khong yon mchod gnyis ga'i mtshan zur la rdo rje re yod pas bcom bya 'joms byed gnyis ga'i phyis 'byung gi lung bstan du shes sla zhing / rdo rje ma bcom slar yang rnyed/ / ces pa phyis su lha btsun pa'i skye brgyud rim par 'ongs pa de la lta bar 'dug gsung /mkharalngon du shi re thu hu thog thus gtsos pa'i khu re bdun gyi bla ma las sne rnams dang / chos skyabs ti yun chi'i zhabs drung / cang ka tā sogs drag zhan mang po'i chibs bsu dang / dge 'dun brgya phrag du ma'i ser sbrengs dang bcas shi re thu'i bla brang du babs/ zhag gsum bzhugs ring la khu re so so'i bla ma dge 'dun dang thu med kyi grong sde so so'i mi skya pho mo drag zhan du ma 252

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /mu mthud nas mjal du 'ongs par byin rlabs dang chos bka' gson gshin gyi bsngo ba sogs so so'i 'dod mos bzhin gnang / ho tho'i asnan gyis gdan drangs nas gsol tshig zhus shing mol mchid 'phel/ shi re thu hu thog thudang chos skyabs ti yān chi'i zhabs drung sogs bla ma rnams la bzhed chos 'ga' zhig gnang zhing sengs bar du thugs bag phebs pa'i gsung gleng yang mang du 'phel/ shi re thu hu thog thus gzhis len bsnyen bkur bzang po bsgrubs/ or du su cun gar pe'i zi'i mi sna mkha'i che dpal ldan ngo g.yog u lā dang bcas 'byor te mtshams zhus dang gdan 'dren gye snyan gsan phul/sbyin bdag har chin wang gi skyel mi ja lang thu su khu/ khā bo long sogs tog can 'ga' zhig ul mi u lag gi shing rta dang bcas phyir ldog par go bab kyi gnang sbyin dang byin rten srung mdud phyag dbang bka' bsgo bcas gnang /mkharajon nas thon dus shi re thu hu theg thu sogs khu re so so'i bla ma las sne rnams phebs skyel du 'ongs te shi re thu bla brang gi ja thab gra bsgrig thog tu gdan drangs nas gsol ja dkar spro zhus/ chos skyabs ti yān chi'i dgon par gdan drangs nas der bzhugs/ phyi nyin zhabs drung sogs dgon pa'i dge 'dun rnams la dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid gnang / gsol ston dang 'bulanod kyang gzabs/ or du su cun gar pe'i zi rnam rgyal rdo rje drag zhan gyi 'khor mang po dang bcas thu med kyi sa cha zhig tu chibs bsur 'byor te lhan du rma chu'i 'gram du babs/ pe'i zi dpon pos bsu ston zhus/ rma chur grus brgal te cun gar pe'i zi'i dgon pa gsar ba la dge 'dun gyi ser sbrengs dang bcas phyag phebs/ zhag gsum bzhugs nas pe'i zi la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang sogs rjes gnang 'ga' zhig dang rim gror 'jigs byed kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gnang / dpon pos gsol ston bsnyen bkur gya 253

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/nom pa'i thog dngos 'bul dngul srang nyis brgya lnga bcu/ rnga mong gnyis/rta bco lnga bcas phul/ pe'i zi'i nu bo du rāl thus lag chi gza' mi rnams tshur 'ongs te dngos 'bul btegs nas seng ldang nags sgol gyi rjes gnang zhus pa'i 'dun pa bskang / phyogs 'dus kyi mjal ba drag zhan shin tu mang po la phyag dbang dang mtshan dang gzungs sngags rna lam du sgrogs pa dang ma ṇi'i bzlas lung khas len bskor ba/ bsngo smon gyis mtshams spyor ba rnams rgyas par mdzad/ mar lam dgon pa der bzhugs skabs mnal lam du btsun ma lwa ba dmar po gyon pa gdod dmar hur re ba brjid bag can zhig 'dug pa la/ mi gzhan zhig gi 'di tshar chen gyi garma mu dra yin zer bas/nyid kyi thugs la tshar chen yang phyag rgya ma bzhes pa yin rgyu red dgongs pa rmis/ phyi nyin mnal lam du byung ba de ji lta ba bzhin zhig byung nas 'jigs byedakyi rjes gnang zhig zhus par thugs brel shin tu che bas long skabs med dus shig yin kyang dgos pa dang rten 'brel khyad par can zhig yod par gzigs te rjes su gnang ba smin rgyas su stsal kyang / 'dir res sngar gyi btsun ma de gar yod gzhan la dris pa na de phyogs su rgyus yod mkhan gcig kyang ma byung la/ zhi hor du de'i rgyu mtshan lcang skya rdo rje 'chang la zhus skabs tshar chen gyi rig ma yin zer ba rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin zer rgyu yin 'dug / de rnal 'byor ma yin 'dug pa la khyod kyis ci byas gsung /'jigs byed kyi rjes gnang dgos zer 'dug pa bgyes pa yin gzhan ci byed zhus pas/ g.yon du bskor ba dang / rkang brgyad kyis bstod pa dang /khyod ma bdag ni zhes sogs kyis gsol 'debs mngon mtshan chung ngus byas yod na legs pa 'dug ste gsung / 'di ni dngos grub myur du 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu tha mal gzugs can garma mu dra zhes gsungs pa dang don mthun zhing /254

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba gong ma rnams kyi lo rgyus dang phyogs mtshungs param zad zhib tu brtags na gsang sngags kyi gdams pa zhus pa sogs ni dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po nyid du nges pa'i mtshan ma'o/ / o thog wang don grub rgya mtsho 'khor bcas 7gong ma'i ri dwags kyi zhabs phyir phebs rgyur chas nas 'ongs pa rje nyid byon pa dang mjal nas lo snga mar gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul yod pa bzhin zhe hor du rkyen zhig gis yong ma thub pa'i rgyu mtshan 'bul mi btang ste rang yul du phyir log / wang tshe ring rdo rje dang gung mgon skyabs rdo rje sku mchod gnyis kyi gdan 'dren pa 'byor te phebs skabs da lang ge'izi blon 'khor dang bcas pas lam thog tu mjal nas gsol ston dang 'bul nod phul/ wang dang gung gtsos pa'i drag zhan brgya phrag du mas rta bsu thab bsu dge 'dun gyi ser sprengs dang bcas gung mgon skyabs rdo rje'i lha khang du phyag phebs/ wang sku mched gsum gtsos pa'i ser skya'i tshogs pa chen por spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gye dbang gnang / ma ṇi ril bu sgrub pa'i tshogs dbu mdzad/ gzhis len gsol ston gzabs shing wang dang gung so sos dngul dang rnga rta sogs kyi 'phul ba spam mtho ba btegs/ ho sho'u ris med kyi mjal ba bar ma chad du gshar bar phyag dbang dang chos 'brel sngar rgyun ltar gnang / de nas o thog wang gi gdan 'dren pa 'ongs pa bzhin phebs/ u'u shing tā pe'i zi dang ja sag dpon po rnams rang rang gi blon 'khor dang bcas pas lam nas gsol ston dang 'bul ba phul te mjal kha zhus par so sor chos bka' sogs bzhed mos ltar gnang / wang don grub rgya mtsho yab sras dang a ke tshe dbang rdo rje dang dkon mchog rdo rje sogs wang gi sku'i nye rigs tha'i ji rnams dang / cha gān bla ma dge legs chos 'phel dang dge bshes bla ma blo bzang bkra shis thu sa lag chi dpal 'byor 255

༄/ /gung cabastan ba'izlanaḥ g.yo tshom/dnganam rgyal sogs mda' tshan brgyad cu gya gsum gyi mi drag tog can stong phrag tsam gyis rta bsu thab bsu/ dge 'dun stong phrag phyed dang gnyis kyis ser sbrengs skye pho mo'i khrom chen po spug shig ge ba dang bcas dpal dar gling dgon par babs te rje rang gi bla brang du bzhugs gnas mdzad/ wang gis gtsos dgon pa'i bla gra blon po che chung sogs drag zhan gyi tshogs pa ches mang bar nyin lnga'i ring byang chub bde lam gyi dmar khrid lung rigs man ngag gis brgyan pa gnang ste skyes bu gsum gyi lam la bag chags kyi nus pa yongs su brtas par mdzad/ wang dang bla ma rnams la nyid kyi lngags rtsom mkha' sbyod ma'i chos skor gyi lung sogs chos bka' mang po gnang / btsan khang gsar bar rab gnas gnang ste rgyal po sku lnga'i 'bag sku dang rten mdos spyan gzigs sogs la zhib gzigs mdzad wang gis chos yon dang rab yon kyang gzabs/ wang gi gcung tshe dbang rdo rje gza' mi rnams kyis bla brang du gsol ston 'bul nod zhus par 'dod mos bzhin drag po gsum dril gyi rjes gnangasnal/ 'dir nyin bcu lhag tsam bzhugs ring la ho sho'u'i mi che phra thams cad hrugs te 'dus par nyin re bzhin nangs dgung gnyis su skye pho mo'i khrom chen la byin rlabs gnang ba'i mjug tu mtshan dang gzungs sngags rna lam du sgogs pa dang yig drug gi bzlas lung dge ba khas len du bcug ste bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs pa rnams chad med du gnang / mi drag 'byor ldan du mas sger mjal gyis 'dod chos mang po zhus pa'ang mos pa bzhin du stsal/sbyin bdag wang gis tshogs dbus su gdan drangs nas dge 'dun chig stong lnga brgyas zhabs brtan gyi bden tshig brjod pa dang chabs gcig tu dngul srang sum cu'i maṇ+ḍal sne 'dogs can/ nang mdzod/ sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol/ na bza' nyer spyad/ dngul srang stong phrag 256

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /gcig dang sum brgya/ rnga mong hom shir tig can drug cu/ gos chen yug dgu sogs 'bul ba rgya chen po dang / ma yum dang sring mo sras sras mo sku'i nye rigs tha'i ji sogs 'byor ldan gyi mi drag zhan du ma mu mthud nas che 'byor chung 'byor gyi 'bul ba mtha' yas pa dbyar gyi char sprin bzhin du bstar/ maṇ+ḍal gyi bshad pa cha gan bla ma dge legs chos 'phel gyis 'brel chags pa zhig zhus par thugs dgyes pa'i bka' lan bzang po gnang / snga ma rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa dang rje 'di pa yab sras gnyis kyis lngags bkod stsal pa bzhin dgon de nyid du dbyar gnas tshugs pa'i lo rjes mar tā bla ma blo bzang ngag dbang gis rgyud pa'i dpon slob dang / cha gan bla mas bla ma dbu mdzad byas te rgyud smad pa'i phyag bzhes ji lta ba'i sngags grwa legs pa zhig btsugs/ de nas yang cha gan bla mas 'chad nyan gyi thugs khur dang se ra bye'i dge bshes blo bzang bkra shis kyis gzhung las pa/ ho sho'u'i nang gidage bshes dka' ram bcu lhag gis dge rgan byas te blo gsar rnams la rtags gsal 'khrid pa sogs mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa gsar du tshugs rgyu'i nyer bsdogs la 'bad bzhin pa'i skabs yin 'dug pas/ rje nyid nas phyogs mthar bstan pa'i bya ba yar rgyas su spel ba la thugs shin tu dgyes pas legs so'i gsung gis dbugs dbyung zhing spro ba bskyed/ mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi spyi 'jog tu dngul srang sum brgya'i gsol ras dang gzhan dag gis kyang 'chad nyan 'dzugs pa la mthun rkyen sbyar na phan yon che tshul gyi bslab ston dang rnying bskul gyi bka' tham bcas bka' drin gnang bas de ma thag gra tshang gsar ba la rkyen sbyor mkhan mang po byung zhing / slad nas kyang dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur zhu mkhan gyi mig ltos la phan thogs shin tu che ba byung bar brten da lta'i bar du bstan pa'i bya ba dang 'byor ldan rnams kyi bsnyen 257

༄/ /gung bang brtenapa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/bkur phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin gong 'phel du gyur/ de nas wang 'khor bcas kyis nyin lam du chibs skyel dang hor sho'u'i sa sne thon gyi ring la tsha zhag gi gra bsgrig a lag shā'i yā mon bar du u la'i rnga mong dang zhon rta cha tshang sogasakyis bkur ste rim gro bla na med pa bsgrubs/ a lag shā wang phyogs gzhan la dgos don zhig tu phebs nas yul du bzhugs med kyang / khong rang gi bkod pa bzhin mi bzang rnams kyis bsu skyel lam ston 'bul nod gzabs shing ho she'u'i sa sne thon par du u lā sogs kyi mthun rkyen gang drag zhus te bde bar phebs/ sog po'i sa sne thon pa dang dgon lung ma bu dgon gyi bsu ba rim gyis 'byor cing tas thung gi chu kha nas dgon lung gi rgyud pa bla ma ngo g.yog dang / ping ku'i la rtsar wang zhabs drung rin po che gtsos pa'i rta ba brgya skor dang / mar tshang du dgon pa'i khri brto ba zhabs drung rin po chesagatso mdzad de rta pa brgya phrag du ma 'byor ba bcas chibs bsu thab bsu rim pa du ma dang / gling 'dabs su dge 'dun mang gis ser sbrengs kyi bkodapa phun sum tshogs pas mdun bsu ba dang bcas zla ba dgu pa'i yar tshes la chos sde chen po dgon lung byams pa gling du phyag phebs te gra dpon slob thams cad zhal 'dzom pa'i dga' ston mchog tu 'phel lo/ / smras pa/snying rje'i rlan chags rgyal ba'i khams kyi sa bon grung po smin pa las/ / rin chen sems kyi myu gus bsod nams ye shes yal ga 'bum du bres/ / de yi gsang gsum me tog phreng bzhin lpu ba rab dkrigs chu gter gyis/ / sked bcings 'dzin ma'i khor yug mnyam par 'phrin las bzang po'i bsil ba 'bebs/ / rgyal kun thugs rje'i 'dzum dkar zla gzhon ni/ / 'dzam gling skye dgu'i bsod nams bai ḍūr+ya'i/ / me long gtsang mar 'phos pa'i dge mtshan gye/ / rol rtsed snying gi kurdo dga' ba'i dpyid/ / nor 'dzin skyong ba 258

༄༅/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /sa yi dbang phyug gi / ral pa'i cod paṇa mdzes pa'i rgyan gyur kyang / /skal bzang gling bzhi'i mkha' la 'dod dgu ru/ / bgrod pa mi bshol thugs rje'i mthu de rmad/ / zhabs sen dmar ba'i 'od chags siskyo ras/ / skye dgu'i dpral par bkod pa'i thig le ni/ / phan bde'i dngos kun dbang byed byin rlabs kyi/ / dge mtshan gsal ba'i ri mo yongs su smin/ / thugs bskyed sa srung steng 'gying dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i spyan stong bgrad/ / byin rlabs rtse brgya gdengs bas 'gro 'di'i nyer 'tshe ri bo'i 'phreng ba 'joms/ / man ngag gtsug nor reg pas bde chen lhag pa'i lha mchog skur byed pa/ / bshes gnyen grags pa'i mu khyud zhabs bsten 'gro 'di e ma skal ba bzang / / zhes rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum rmad du byung ba'i mdzad bzang 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal gye cha tsam gtam du byas pa rtogs brjod pad+ma dkar po las/ slar yang gong ma'i bkas gser gyi rgyal khab tu lan gnyis pa phebs shing bstan 'gro'i don ches cher mdzad tshul gyi 'dab ma ste dgu pa'o/ /259

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/༄༅/ / 'dab ma bzu pa/ bka' rtsom spel ba sogs bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad pa'i tshul/de nas rje nyid rgya nag nas myur du chibs bsgyur gnang ste bla slob thams cad zhal 'dzom pa'i legs 'bul du spyi bla brang sogs nas 'byor ston dang tshogs dbus su brtan bzhugs dang / thag nye ring gi slob ma spyin bdag drag zhan du ma rim pas 'ongs nas 'byor mjal dang rten 'byung gi zhabs tog zhu ba sogs dga' ston nyin mang po'i bar du 'phel/ lo gnyis kyi ring 'dir phan tshun gyi dgon sgrub sde mang po dang khyad par du dgon lung gi dge 'dun tshang mas sku tshag la ma 'dzem par rje nyid kyi zhabs brtan la rgyun ldan 'bad 'dug pas nyid nas kyang dgon par skyes kyi tshul du mang 'gyed phon che ba gnang / gzhan ris med kye dgon sgrub sde sum cu lhag la mang 'gyed thebs 'bul rgyu bskur ba dang / khyad par bkra shis chos gling gi spyi 'jog tu rdo rje 'chang gi gser sku rin po che'i phra rgyan can mi tshad tsam pa dngul srang brgya tham pa dang bcas bskur ba gnang / grwa slob sbyin bdag rnams kyang so so'i go bab dang bstun pa'i gnang skyes kyis ngoms par mdzad/ sbyin bdag har chin wang gi skyel mi khā pa ri mad sogs drag zhan nyi shu skor phyir ldog rgyur ji ltar 'tsham pa'i dngos po'i gnang sbyin dang lam chos bka' bsgo srungab sogs stsal/ skyel mi rnams phyir lam rma chu brgal dus chu dkyil du slebs pa na srub bkag gi shing gcig lhung nas gru nang du chu shor 'ongs par thams cad kyis ci drag gang drag la thug / ba ri mad kyis rje nyid kyi mtshan 260

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /nas smos te gsol ba shugs drag btab par rgya mi zhig gis 'dis khogs zer nas lhan pa zhig byin pa des bkag pas chu yong 'phro rbad kyis chad de nyes skyon med par thon/ chu 'gram nas mi de la drin gzo zhig byed dgos snyam ste btsal bsam rnyed la gru nang du'ang kho rang ma gtogs gzhan sus kyang ma mthong 'dug pas bla ma'i thugs rje kho nar nges te mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob/rje nyid yar phebs khar sbyin bdag har chin wang rat+na sirnyis rje rang gi sku tshab pher ba'i mchod gnas bla ma zhig gtong ba gnang dgos tshul zhus yod pa bzhinadagon lung gi wang zhabs drung rin po che sku na gzhon dus nas rje nyid las chos dang zang zing gi bka' drin mang du mnos shing phyag g.yog tshul mthun gyis thugs zin pa'i slob sras yin gshis khong la paṇ+ḍi ta'i cho lo'i gzengs bstod dang dgos chas kyi mthun rkyen sbyor ba gnang ste sku tshab tu mngags/ sbyin bdag wang la'ang gsung shog gi lam nas khong gi 'phrin las kyi zhabs 'degs tshul bzhin sgrub rgyu'i gtad gnyer nan tan mdzad pa bzhin 7gong ma chen po mug ten du phebs dus wang rang gi sa tshigs kye zhag bab cig tu ser sbrengs kyi mgo nas 7gong ma chen por bla ma 'di nged kyi mchod gnas hu thog thu zhig yin zhes snyan sgron phul te mtshams zhus byed 'jug pa gnang bar 7gong nas kyang de lugs kyi bdag rkyen gsol ras bka' drin stsal/ de nas bzung khong la hu thog thu'i mtshan chags nas 'azin las dar rgyas su song / dgun chos bzang ri khrod nas phal cher bcad rgya'i ngang du bzhugs pas zab mo'i thugs dam shin tu 'phel ba byung /yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu'i sgrub mchod kyi tshogs dbu sngar rgyun ltar mdzad/chos rgyal gyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rnam gzhag 'phrin las bzhi'i bang mdzod bka' rgya can yang skabs 'dir bka' rtsom gnang / dgung lo so 261

༄/ /gung thang bstanaba'i sgronayo gsung 'bum/bdun gyi dgung gegs sel phyir zhabs brtan sgrub thebs dngul srang stong phrag gnyis tsam bton te ris med kyi dgon sgrub sde rnams su rim gyis btsugs te zhabs brtan gtos che ba rgyun chags su bsgrubs/ dgung lo so bdun pa chu sprul gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dga' ba dang po'i nyin chos bzang ri khrod du gsar bzhengs kyi lha mo'i sku thang thog chad ma spyan gzegs dang bcas bshams te gshegs gtor gyi tshogs dbu mdzad/ chos sde chen po dgon lung du cho 'phrul dus chen gyi smon lam rje nyid nas rgyu yon sbyor te btang bar lcang skya rin po che'i thugs dam rten jo bo dang zhi bar 'od dpag med bra ste'i nang rten sogs gdan drangs/ dgon pa'i nang rten dang bcas rten 'gang can du ma la nyin bco lnga'i ring mchod sprin rgya mtsho spros pa dang chabs cig tu dge 'dun nyis stong brgal bar mang ja drug cu nyung ja lnga bcu nga gnyis bzhes thug bdun zhus thog sku 'gyed 'dzug ston du kha btags chos 'don re/gzhung ston du dngul zho lnga re/ grub ston du bcu tshan rer ja bag re/ bar mtshams rnams su dung tshe dang khab skud phreng ser nas phog bcas 'gyed lan bdun/ dgon pa'i thugs dam rten du ched gnyer gyis bsgrubs pa'i thub pa'i gser sku mi tshad lhag pa ring bsrel rnam bzhi'i gzungs 'jug dang rab gnas rje rang nyid kyis tshad ldan gnang ba bzhugs khri rgyab yol dang bcas/sde dge'i bstan 'gyur tshang ma/ spyi 'jog tu gser zangs kyi spos phor cha nyi shu/ gser rnga nyi shu bcas phul nas/ rje rang nyid la re zhing ltos pa'i slob ma sbyin bdag rnams kyi 'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'phel ba'i skyabs 'jug dge 'dun la nan tan zhur bcug cing / sku dngos kyis kyang tshes brgyad dang bcolnga'i gsung chos smon lam du phebs te 'brel ba thogs pa rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub kyi rgyur bsngo ba'i thugs dam spyan dmigs mdzad/ dus 262

ro༅/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /chen dang bstun nas sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga'ang ljags rtsom gnang /dbyid dang dbyar gyi ring za zi'i spros pa bcad nas zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la gcig tu gzhol bar mdzad cing thun mtshams su don gnyer can la lar chos bka' 'ga' zhig dang / chos rgyal gsang sgrub dang lcam sring gi gtor chog sogs gsung rtsom yang mang tsam gnang / dgon lung gi rgyud grwa 'di lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa gong ma dang kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho yab sras gsum ga bka' bgros kyi steng nas 'chad nyan sogs kyi mgo 'dzugs gtso bor kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas gnang ste btab pa yin kyang de'i tshe rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho la rgyud grwa 'di da lan nged rnams kyis btab kyang slar nyams chag tu song dus khyed rang gis 'debs dgos zhes lung bstan pa ltar/ mtsho sngon dus zing la brten nas dgon pa gnas ma thub pa slar chags pa'i tshe rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtshos bla ma'i gsung bzhin yang bskyar gyis btab pa sogs sku phreng gong ma gnyis kyi phyag rjes su gyur pa la dgongs te lo 'dir yang rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che dang rje 'di pa yab sras gnyis kyis 'bub thebs dang bkod pa sogs kyi thugs khur bzhes te rgyud khang gsar gso mdzad par/shing cha sogs gang ci'i gra bsgrig bla brang gi las byed rnams nas khur blangs kyis legs par bsgrubs/ grub ston du rje nyid nas rgyud pa'i dge 'dun la ja thug gi bsnyen bkur dang / spyi 'jog tu ḍa ma ru mdzod gos tshem grub kyi cod paṇa can thum bcas bdun cu don brgyad/ rgyud pa dpon slob kyis man brgyud dbang chas spus legs cha tshang bcas phul/ skabs snga phyir rje nyid kyang rgyud pa'i tshogs dbur phebs rig pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun rnams dang lhan du 'khor lo bde mchog gi bdag 'jug lan mang du bzhes/ ston 263

༄/ /gung ba bstanapa'ithoname' gsung 'bum/ga dben gnas byang chub gling du ri khrod kyi bla ma dge 'dun tshang ma'i thog gra 4byams pa gling gi sprul sku zhabs drung sku skye dka' ram sogs dang / 'dul dgon gyi rong bo zhabs drung ngo g.yog sogs gzhi byes kyi chos nyan pa sum brgya skor la bla ma mchod pa bde stong dbyer med ma'i zab khrid snyan brgyud man ngag gis brgyan nas nyin bdun dang / gzhan yang spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal dang sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi rjes gnang sogs chos bka' du ma gnang / dgon pa spyi'i mi sna gdan 'dren du btang ba bzhin stong skor sprul pa'i sku rin po che dgon lung du phebs par chibs bsu thab bsu/ ser sbrengs/ spyi sger gye gsol ston sogs gzhis len gzab rgyas zhus/ rje nyid nas lngags bkod gnang ba bzhin stong skor sprul sku rin po che dgon pa'i tshogasadabus su gdan drangs te spyi bla brang khag so so nas zhabs brtan phul zhing chos 'brel zhig zhus par sprul sku rin po che nas tshogs yongs la bla ma'i rnal 'byor dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid stsal te mang 'gyed kyang gya nom pa gnang / stong 'khor sprul pa'i sku nas zhus pa bzhin khong dpon g.yog sogasatshos nyan pa hrag bsdus la rje bla ma'i gsung gi yang snying bstan bcos legs par bshad pa'i snying po'i bshad lung dri ma med pa'i lung rigs kyi dgag bzhag dang bcas pa sogs chos bka' mang tsam gnang ba gro tshang mkhan bo bod nas byon te 'byor mjal la phebs par gzhis len gsol ston dngabakur gzos bla na med pa mdzad cing gnas tshul gyi gsung gleng shin tu 'phel/ dgun rje 'jam dbyangs bshad pa rin po che nas bkod khyab gnangab bzhin bkra shis 'khyil nas spyi so'i sde pa ngo g.yog gdan 'dren du 'ongs te chibs bsgyur gnang skabs dgon pa'i khri gdan zur dang grwa tshang so so'i bla ma las sne sogs kyis phebs bsu ring thung / thab bsu rim pa du ma 264

༄7/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /dang / ngur smrig 'chang pa'i dge 'dun nyis stong lnga brgya lhag gi ser sbrengs kyis gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan spos phor sogs mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs shing / 'bud dkrol gyi rol mo'i bye brag du ma dang / dri zhim po'i sbos 'dren gyes mdun nas bsu ba sogs rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar yangs por phye ba dang bcas gdan sar phyag phebs/ tshogs chen du chos khrir spyan drangs nas dge 'dun mang gis zhabs brtan gyi bden tshig gsungs pa dang chabs cig tu maṇ+ḍal dar tshon can sku gsung thugs rten/ na bza' nyer spyad/dngulasang lnga brgya/ gos che chung / zam ras/ gcan gzan gyi pags pa du ma/ chibs chen legs pa sogs dngos 'bul gya nom pa btegs te zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba btab par dgyes pa'i zhal bzhes bzang po gnang / tshogs yongs la rten 'brel bstod pa'i bshad lung gnang dgos kyi gsol ba btab pa bzhin chos grwa'i khri khar phebs te 'jam mgon tsong kha ba chen pos thun mong snang tshod dang mthun par mtha' bral dbu ma'i lta ba gsar du rnyed pa na ston pa thub pa'i dbang po la stong pa dang rten 'byung gi de nyid gsungs pa'i tshul las brtsams te bstod pa legs bshad snying po chung ba'am/rten 'brel bstod par grags pa'i bshad lung nges pa'i don gyi mdo sde rnams dang rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum sogs klu sgrub yab sras kyi gzhung che chung thams cad khog bsgrigs nas thal rang gi lta ba'i khyad par phra zhing phra ba'i gsang tshig thams cad rjen cher du phyung ste/ zab mo'i gnad 'di dag thams cad 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha ba chen po gcig pus sa 'og gi gter bzhin du gsalabar byas tshul sogs gsung bshad shin tu zab cing brling la rgya che ba/dka' ba'i gnad re re'i steng du'ang mdo bstan bcos kyi shes byed mang po thogs pa med par drangs te rno zhing 'dril ba'i rigs pa mtha' yas pa'i sgo 265

༄/ /gung thang bstanaba'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/nas bsgrub pa sogs rmad du byung ba'i legs bshad nor bu'i dga' ston lhug parasnal te/ dran dbang mtha' dag gi rnam par dpyod pa'i yol go phyur bur gtams pas mos gus dang dga' spro 'gran pa bzhin du 'phel bar gyur to/ / snang bzhin stong la stong bzhin snang / / nges par rdzun pa rdzun par nges/ / snang stong bden med bden stong snang / / mkhas pas rtogs dka' rtogs pas mkhas/ / snang ba 'khrul phyir btags tsam brda tsam yod/ /yod tsam brda tsam btags phyir 'khrul ba snang / / zhi ba spros bral dmigs dka' ches zab lam/ / lam zab ches dka' dmigs bral spros pa zhi/ /stongadang rten 'byung rigs pa 'gal me yi/ / tshul gyis rtag chad spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang / / bral ba'i lam ston thub pa'i gdung 'tshob ste/ /gtam 'di nyon mongs med pa'i chos kyi mchog / ma rig gnyid slong chos dung lnga pa'i dbyangs/ / dpal gyi mgur nas gsang mthor bsgrags pa yis/ / 'khor ba'i rims nad gdung ba phrogasas pa na/ / chos la rton pa'i thar 'dod ngang gis 'dud/ / ces bya ba'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ / rjes sor nyid kyi zhal nas kyang zhal slob 'ga' zhig la/ nged rang bkra shis 'khyil du dang po phyin skabs sang nyin chos bshad rgyu'i snga dgung spyi nas rten 'brel bstod pa'i bshad lung dgos tshul byung ba khas blangs nas phyi nyin chos grwar 'gro dus grwa mang gis nged la de tsam gus nyams mi byed cing /'dis ci zhig bshad 'jog ang snyam pa lta bu dang / nged rang gis kyang rgyus yod kyi dge bshes 'ga' ma gtogs gzhan rnams zob che ba tsam las yon tan rang ga 'dra yin snyam pa yod kyang chos bshad tshar nas phyir yong dus grwa mngagis rigs pa'i rjes 'brang gi dad pas zhwa mo gdan du bting ba sogs gus 'dud dpe med byas shing / nged kyis kyang bkra shis 'khyil du yon tan 266

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /can mang po yod pa gzod go byung / rje bla ma de nyid kyang bar thog cig nas snyan gtad de gsan yod pas sgrub pa'i mchod pas thugs yid shin tu tshim pa'i rnam pa mdzad byung bar rang gis kyang skal ba bzang po byung 'dug snyam du semasadaga' ba yin zhes gsungs snang / rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che tshogs dbus su spyan drangs te brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs nas dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal che legs/ nang mdzod/ sku gsung thugs rten/ bzhugs gdan rgyab yol/ na bza' nyer spyad/ gos chen yug bdun/ dngul srang sum brgya dang lnga bcu/ zam ras/ dar yugachos 'don/ skya chen sogs 'bul ba rnam grangs mang po spyan lam du bstar zhing zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba nan tan btab par thugs dgyes pa chen pos zhal bzhes gnang / tshogs par mang ja gsum dang sku 'gyed zho gsum re phyag mdzod mdo phugs/ rgyud pa dus 'khor spyi sogs la'ang 'jog pa gzabs/ a mchog dgon dang / bkra shis dge 'phel/ yid dga' chos 'dzin so sor yang mang 'gyed bskur ba gnang / gser gdung chen mo sogs mchod khang thams cad la gtsang zhing gya nom pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho spros te zhib mjal mdzad/ de gong rje nyid kyi bsnyun gzhi rnying ba de nyid rgyun ldan du 'phar zhing thugs rmis su byad ltas ngan pa yang yang byung bas de la ched dmigs kyis 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che las gdugs dkar gyi dbang zhig gsan par byad grol tshar ma thag sku gzugs bde cham gyis song ba'i nyams shar ba nas bzung ste byad lhongs dang bsnyun gzhi 'phar ldang gi shugs chad song gsung ba zhal nas dngos su thos/ 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongasardzogs yum bcas kyi rjes gnang gi rgyun shin tu nyag phra bar song snang yang / der bla ma gnyis tsam la rgyun bzhugs pas gang las gsan na legs 267

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgro me'i gsung 'bum/zhes 'jam dbyangs bla ma rin po cher dgongs bstun zhus te bla ma da lta ba tshang gi drung nas rjes gnang de nyid gsan te rgyun spel bar mdzad/ dgon pa'i sprul sku/ zhabs drung / bla ma/ dka' ram sogs dad mos kyis phyag rten 'bul nod dang bcas mjal kha zhu mkhan che phra mang por 'dod mos dang bstun pa'i chos bka' dang zang zing gi gnang skyes ci rigs kyis mgu bar mdzad/ dgon lung gi dge bshes dpa' rin dka' bcu ngag dbang bsam 'grub dang ra zhi dka' bcu ngag dbang brtson 'grus gnyis dam bca' gtong bcug cing / dgon lung tshogs chen dbu mdzad sogs la gshin rje'i ngar dbyangs slob 'jug pa gnang / bzhugs ring la yab sras rnam pa gnyis ka bka' mchid shin tu 'phel/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che nas gzhis len ston mo dang gnang skyes gzabs shing / sku dngos kyis sgo mo che'i phyi rol tu bsu skyel mdzad pa sogs bkur gzos bla na med pa gnang / phyir phebs dus rgan gya'i brag dkar du grub khang bla mtsho yod sar byon nas bde mchog gi tshogs 'khor rgyas pa gnang ste thugs nyams spro ba'i rnam pa mdzad/ de ga'i dgon pa dang ri khrod kyi bla ma dge 'dun dang /mkha' 'gro ma sku skye sogs kyis phyag dbang chos 'brel zhus shing 'bul nod phul/ so sor mang 'gyed dang gnang skyes sogs stsal/ phan tshun phebs lam du 'brog sde'i khrod na gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhu mkhan mang bar 'dod chos dang khrus dbang bka' bsgo skyabs 'jug so so'i mos pa bzhin gnang / dgung lo so brgyad pa shing pho rta'i lo gsar gyi dga' ston dgon lung nas mdzad/ dgon pa'i chos rgyal gyi gtor sgrub pa rnams la gshin rje'i ngar dbyangs slob bcug ste gtan chags su btsugs/ nyid kyi bkod khyab ltar cho 'phrul smon lam rgya tig tsho ba brgyad kyis sbyin bdag byas nas 268

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /legs par bsgrubs/ nyid nas kyang gsung choyosmon lam lan 'ga' gnang / dpyid don gnyer ba 'ga' zhig gis zhus ngor gzhi byes kyi nyan mkhanapa brgya phrag du ma la spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang chen gnang / rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che sku 'bum du phebs pa spyan drangs nas tshe dpag med 'chi med rnga sgra'i dbang 'chi blu dang bcas pa/rgyal thang ba'i gcod kyi dbang khrid sogs chos bka' mang tsam nyid rang gis gsan zhor du dgon pa'i bla grwa che gras skor la mnyan du 'jug par mdzad/bla brang gsar ba'i khang ba thams cad du phyag nas dang chos bzang ri khrod kyi 'du khang du rab gnas zhus/ sum pa mkhan rin po che'ang gdan drangs nas mgon khang du rab gnas zhus par mkhan chen nyid kyi mnal lam du chos skyong gi sku brnyan du ma gar byed pa rmis pa sogs dge ba'i mtshan ltas du ma byung / dbyar gro tshang dgon pa nas gdan 'dren pa 'ongs te phebs par gro tshang mkhan rin po che dpon yog du ma mar tshang nas chibs bsu thab bsu zhus shing / rim gyis grong sde'i ja thab mjal ba mang po dang dge 'dun brgya phrag du mas ser sbrengs dang bcas gro tshang bla brang du babs/ zhag kha shas bzhugs shing chos grwa ljon shing spang ljongs sogs nyams spro ba zhig yod pa der khri bshams nas tshogs yongs dang mchod gzhis bcas ser skya'i tshogs pa chen por byang chub lam gyi rim pa bde lam gyi khrid gnang / gsung chos tshugs dus sprin dkar lang long 'khrigs pa las char rgyun zim pu babs shing grub dus nyi 'od gsar zhing 'ja' sprin ya mtshan can mang du shar ba sogs gnam gshis legs pa byung 'dug / tshogs dbur spyan drangs te/ zhabs bad brtan pa'i rten 'brel du dngul mkha kha btags/ sku gsung thugs rten sogs 'bul ba spam mtho ba dang bcas mkhan po nyid kyis gsol ba rtse 269

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'izlanama'igasung 'bum/gcig tu btab par zhal bzhes bzang po gnang / dge bshes gnyis kyis tshogs gleng dang hwa shang 'bag gyon pa gtso 'khor gyis rtsed sna bcas ston mo rgyas pa zhus/ de bzhin du gro bla brang nas gsol ston dang ga ring sgar ba gong ba sgar ba so sor spyan drangs nas gsol tshigs zhus shing / gong ba bla ma dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gcig tu phebs pa la gna' dus kyi lo rgyus dri gtugs mang du mdzad/ dgon par mang 'gyed kyang gya nom pa gnang /de nas rdo rje 'chang gi lha khang go tam sder phebs te bla brang du nyin kha shas bzhugs/ mkhan rin po cher bzhed chos dang gsung gleng 'phel zhor du blo skyed kyi skyes mang du stsal/ lha khang rnams su brgya mchod snyan shal dang bcas rten mjal zhib tu gnang skabs sku brnyan rnams la spyan ras kyis btsa' bar mdzad de/ grub chen bla ma bsam blo pa'i sku gdung 'dra sku la 'di su'i sku yin dris par mkhan pos grub chen gling dkar par grags pa'i sku yin tshul zhus/ thugs mar phyag gis reg nas 'di'i thugs ka na drod yod pa'i lo rgyus e yod gsung bar med tshul zhus/ 'o na khyed kyis ltos gsungs nas mkhanapo thugs gar phyag gi4reg par drod chil le ba zhig 'dug pas khong yang shin tu ya mtshan par byung / tshur phebs dus rdo rje 'chang gi sku mdun du thugs smon yun mi thung ba tsam gnang ste snyan shal 'phang ba thugs gar rdo dril bsnol thabs su 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis kyi steng du cha mnyam par babs pas thugs shin tu mnyes/ 'di 'dra ba dgon lung du drug pa'i smon lam thog rje'i gos sku la snyan shal 'phang ba phyag mdzub la 'byar nas gos sku dril gyi bar du shing sogs kyis kyang ma lon pas dge 'dun thams cad ya mtshan du gyur pa sogs mdor na dus nam gyi tshe'ang mas brnyan gyi rigs la snyan shal rgyang ring po nas 'phangs kyang phyag gi thad du nges par 'bab pa zhig yod pa 270

༄7/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /ni tshur mthong dang dga' bas ltas na stabs 'phrod pa lta bur snang yang / sa la gnas pa'i bdag nyid chen po rnams la rgyal ba'i sku brnyan mtha' dag gis chos ston pa sogs kyi mdzad pa sangs rgyas dngos dang khyad med du byed par gsungs pas snyan shal phul ba'ang so so nas phyag gis bzhes pa yin nam snyam mo/ / tho'u bkwan du rje gong mas bzhengs pa'i dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi lha khang rten brten par bcas pa zhig ral du song ba lo 'dir lha khang shing rtsi logs ris bcas gsar bskrun dang / sku brnyan rnying ba rnams la bzo bcos dang gser tshon/ khru gsum re yod pa'i bde gshegs mchod rten brgyadagasar du bzhengs nas tshon rtsi gzungs 'jug rab gnas dang bcas legs par bsgrubs/ de dang 'dab chags par ljon shing me tog gi ldum ra gzim gshag dang bcas rim gyis bsgrub par mdzad/ de dang dus mnyam du 'dul ba dgon gyi 'du khang rje nyid nas rgyu mthud dang bkod pa'i thugs khurabazhes te do dam pa dang las ka byed mi rnams btang nas gsar bsgrub mdzad/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rnam gzhag dang dragapo gsum dril gyi bsnyen pa bya tshul sbyin sreg dang bcas pa sogs gsung rtsom 'ga' zhig gnang / sngar sems nyid dgon gyi nye 'dabs su hus hu'i sde chags pa khong tshos thabs gang gis kyang 'ded ma thub pa la rje nyid nas mastan la bkod khyab gnang ste mi sna mngags nas dbang shed kyis ded pa yin pas ston 'dir de'i rgyab gnon du sems nyid dgon mched gzhis dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ dgon du bla ma mchod pa'i khrid dang gcod dbang khri'i lung dang bcas gnang zhing / 'brog sde'i khrod du zla lhag gi ring bsnyen bkur zhus par phyag dbang dang lung rjes gnang dbang bskur sogs kyis tshim par mdzad/ tshur phebs te sgrub sde byang chub gling du phyogs 'dus gzhi 271

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/'dug dang bcas nyan mkhan brgya phrag kha shas la blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid shin tu rgyas pa nyin mang po dang mu mthud nas chos bka' gzhan yang mang du gnang / bar skabs nas bkra shis chos gling du gdan drangs par 'dod mos kyi chos bka' dang / nyid kyi ljags rtsom jo bo rgyal mtshan pa'i gsol mchod btsan rgod rol mtsho'i lung gnang ste mang 'gyed dang bcas tshogs su 'dzugs par mdzad cing / dad ldan bzhi stong tsam 'dus par phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang / dgon pa bkra shis 'khyil nas grub pa'i dbang phyug bla ma bsod nams grags pa gdan drangs nas gcod kyi skor sogs chos bka' mang tsam gsan cing phar yang bzhed chos 'ga' zhig 'bul bar mdzad/khyad par du zhabs brtan la sku mdun rang nas lus sbyin gyi spyan dmigs mang du gnang bcug par/ nyid kyi gzigs snang du mdun gyi bar snang nas khyi phag gi mgo brnyan can 'ga' zhig mig ras kyis btsa' ba zhig gi nyams shar zhing de phyin chad nas 'tshub stong je 'jam du song ba yin gsung / dgung lo so dgu pa shing mo lug gi dus bzhi thog ma'i dga' ston chen po'i nyin sbyin bdag har chen wang rardo sirnyi'i mi sna khā sho'u mar ngo g.yog gis wang gi ljags bkod bzhin gos chen dang dngul sogs kyi 'bul ba spam mtho ba brtan bzhugs lugs su phul te zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba btab/ dgon lung gi smon lam nyid nas sbyin bdag bstan 'dzin mi rin la gtad pa bzhin mai rin rang gi bu khā sho'u mar gyes thebs dngul srang stong phrag gcig khyer 'ongs pa bla brang nas khur blangs bgyis te smon lam gzab rgyas btang /sbyin bdag gis gdan drangs pa bzhin smon lam du phebs te spyan dmigs gnang / dngul srang bzhi brgya sogs dngos 'bul gya nom pa btegs/wang la mtshams zhu'i lan dang smon lam yon bdag la chos bka' dang gzhis 272
