༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /len gnang rten gzabs/ de nas dbon gnas bde chen chos gling dang sa khad ha cang mi ring ba na sngon garma pa rol pa'i rdo rjes yun ring bzhugs nas byin gyis brlabs shing / g.yas g.yon gyi brag ngos la ma hā shā ri dang ma hā u ma gnyis kyi mtshan ma dngos su dod pa sogs rgyud sde rnams las rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i gnas su bsngags pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig tu sngar gzhis ka don kun 'grub kyi gzhi bting yod pa der gzim khang yo rgyan gling rwa skor dang bcas phubs shing / de dang 'dab chags par skyed tshal yid dga' chos 'phel gyi gnas gzhi bting ste mtha' skor du ljon shing gi rwa ba dang / de'i nang du spangs ljongs dang ri phran spel mas yongs su bskor cing dbus su dwangs bsil gye chu mtsho chen po bskyil ba/ mtsho 'gram dang thang dang ri sul rnams su yul phyogs tha dad pa du ma nas 'ongs pa'i shing rigs mi gcig pa dang me tog sna tshogs pa'i tshal rim pa mang po kha dog rnam par bkra zhing dri zhim gyi ngad phyogs kun tu 'thul ba/ bar bar du dbyibs bkod mi 'dra ba'i khang bzang rtseg ma can dang thog re re ba shel gyi ba gam lta bu du ma dang /rang byung gi lo ma'i spyil bu sogs ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i bkod pa sna tshogs pa mtho ris kyi dga' tshal la 'gran pa'i skyed mos tshal gyi bste gnas nyams dga' ba zhig gsar bsgrun mdzad cing / pho brang theg chen chos kyi ba gam sogs gzim chung dang khang skor rim pa du ma'ang rim char du bsgrubs/gzim khang o rgyan gling grub zin pa dang bstun rgyu mtshan 'ga' zhig labarten nas tshe ring mched lnga'i gsol mchod kyi cho ga 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang ljags rtsom gnang bar mgo tshugs dus bu mo gzhon nu ma lngas bza' btung 'bul ba dang / mjug rdzogs skabs gos dar dang mu tig 'bul mkhan byung ba sogs ma bsgrigs rang 'grigs kyi rten 'brel rmad du byung ba 'grigs pa ni 273

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/bstan srung chen mo rnams dgyes pa'i mtshan mar mngon/ bde chen chos gling du rje gong mas bde gshegs so lnga zhal gzigs pa'i gzim khang du gyang logs la mi 'khrugs pa'i 'bur sku stong / bar mtshams kyi yul sngongs la spyan ras gzigs kyis rigs drug 'dren tshul sogs rnam thar mang po'i bkod pa mchod khri gshar mtshon rtsi can gsar bzos la sangs rgyas so lnga'i sman sku byis pa lo brgyad kyi bong tshod tsam pa dang / mgon khang du dpal mgonabram gzugs kyi sku mi tshad long ba yum bzhi dang bcas pa 'di rnams gser tshon gzungs 'jug rab gnas bcas tshad ldan bsgrub par mdzad/dbyar 'dul ba dgon du gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs te rong po bla brang du bzhugs/ thang ring bla zur bra tsha zhabs drung dang lang gru'i su chos rje sogs phyogs nas 'ongs pa dang bcas tshogs yongs la lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi khrid gnang / rong po zhabs drung bod du slob gnyer la chas par lam chos dang zhal bkod zhib par stsal/ har go'i chab tshan gyi 'phrod brten la phebs par bzhugs ring la phyag rdor pe'i zi dang kun bzang ja sag sogs kyesabasnyen bkur zhus shing sa skya bla ma sogs don gnyer can rnams la chos bka' mang bo gnang / ston dben gnas byang chub gling du dgon sgrub sde gnyisakyi dge 'dun hrag bsdus pa lam rim bde lam gyi khrid shin tu gza' rgyasakyis mtshon zhu mkhan so so'i ngor chos kye dga' ston nyin mang por spel bar mdzad/ sngar 'dul ba dgon gyi khrir bzhugs dgos kyi gsol ba nan tan btab par zhal bzhes gnang ba bzhin zla ba bcu pa'i nang du chibs bsgyur gnang skabs 'dul dgon sogs phyi log gi dgon mchod gzhis so so'i chibs bsu pa rang thung tshan mang po dang / mo'u bā shing gi mkhar gyi rgya dpon dang tsong ye sogs kyis bsus shing ja thab du ma dang mchod rdzas thogs 274

ro༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /pa'i dge 'dun brgya phrag gsum gyi ser sbrengs dang bcas dgon par phyag phebs te khri 'don mdzad/ 'dul dgon rang dang dgon lung spyi bla brang lung dkar nom chi tha yan chi rgyal sras ri khrod kyi mi rnams dang mchod gzhis kyisbyin bdag rnams kyis khri 'bul rgya che ba bstar/ khri 'don gyi ston mo'i steng du dka' ram gnyis kyis tshogs gleng byas te lung rigs kyi dga' ston spel/ de ga'i tshogs pa rnams la mang 'gyed gya nom pa dang gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun sogs chos nyan pa stong phrag du mar dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid phyag dbang dang bcas stsal/ sngar gyi 'grig lam ma nyams pa'i steng gling gseb tu phu thung mi gyon zhing rta mi zhon pa sogs khrims su bca' pa'i tshogs gtam mdzad/ der bzhugs skabs mnal lam du grwa pa rgan po zhig rdzu 'phrul ston khul gyis 'phur tshul byas shing / gzhan zhig gis rje nyid la 'phur rgyu'i snyan bskul zhus par lus gnang bcos te rlung bzung bas kho las mtho sar 'phur ba la/ khos gus 'dud kyis phyag btsal pa zhig rmis pa de ga'i mi min zhig gi 'phrul yin par dgongs nas gzhi bdag gi bsang mchod kyang ljags rtsom gnang / yul gyi rgya mi drag zhan gyis sngar bla ma ser mo la rtsi 'jog gang yang med kyang de nas bzang rtsi bkur sogs la phan pa chen po byung ste bstan pa'i dbu 'phangs mthon por btegs/ phyir dgon lung du phebs nas lcang skya rdo rje 'chang dgung lo drug cur phebs pa'i 'khrungs skar gyi dga' ston du dgon lung spyi nas rgyud pa bla ma ngag dbang bsam 'grub gtong ba dang lhan du rje nyid nas mar tshang nang so blo bzang bsod nams mngags te dngul srang sum brgyas zhabs brtan 'bul rgyu bskur ba gnang / skabs shig sku khams cung zad mi dwangs pa byung ste sman bcos sogs ci byas kyang phan skyed ma byung ba la mnal lam du bla ma zhig gis khyod kyi rim gror bog tse'i gtor mdos 275

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/shig sgrub dgos zer/ gtor ma mda' 'phang sogs kyis spras pa mang po zhig bshams/ rnga rol dang bcas mdos chog cig 'don kin yod pa'i gzims rmis byung ste phyi nyin beg tse'i be'u bum gzigs par bca' thabs 'don cha sogs mnal lam du byung ba de ji lta ba'i yig rnying zhig 'dug pa la nyid nas snon 'bri cung zad dgos pa rnams bcos te chog sgrig gnang ba'i steng nas bsgrubs pas bsnyun gzhi'ang lhag med du myur bar dwangs pa byung /bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa'i rim gror dmigs nas dgon lung spyi la lo ltar mgon po'i gtor chen chag med kyi srol 'dzugs par dgongs te gtor chen gyi ngag 'don dang bsgral chog bca' sgrig sogs gsar rtsom mdzad/ mgon po gtso 'khor gyi 'cham sogs zur du bsgrigs/ sgrub pa po dang don gnyer can mang po la mgon po bar chad kun sel gyi rjes gnang dang stag phu rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i gtor chen gye cho ga dang nyid kyi gsar rtsom ngag 'don sogs kyi lung stsal te phyag len rnams bca' sgrig rdo rje'i re kha ltar lo mjug 'dir 'dzug par mdzad/ gtor chen 'dzugs bzhed kyi skabs der lan gcig mnal lam du lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa khri mthon po zhig gi khar bzhugs phyag tu dpe cha zhig bsnams 'dug pa 'di mgon po'i gtor chen gyi cho ga yin/ ngas khyod la klag lung ster gsungs/ nyid nas gser gyi maṇ+ḍal la rin po che'i tshom bu bkod de phul cing / de nas sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum rjes zlos byas pa'i rjes su lung gnang byung bar thugs gtad nas gsan pa na rdo rje 'chang stag khu rin po ches mdzad pa'i mgon po'i gtor chen gyi chog sgrig ji lta ba la bar skabs su bskul ba'i tshigs bcad mang po yod pa mjug tu la byā ta badz+ra gyis sbyar ba'o/ / zhes pa zhig 'dug cing klag lung grub rjes dge ba bsngo ba dang gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal sogs 276

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /kyang 'bul ba zhig rmis gsungs pa ni rmi lam gyi snang ba tsam ma yin par sa chen gyes gdams ngag bsnyel pa rnams zhang dgon pa ba'i drung nas rmi lam la yang bskyar gyes gsan pa lta bu rmi lam gyi lus la brten nas nyan bshad mtshan nyid par gnang ba shin tu ya mtshan che ba'i gnas so/ / dgung lo bzhi bcu pa me pho spre'u'i lo gsar dga' ston sogs dkyus bzhin dang / de nas chos rgyal gye gtor sgrub pa rnams la 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs yum bcas dang chos rgyal phyi nang gi rjes gnang stsal/ dgon pa'i cho 'phrul smon lam rje nyid nas rgya tig mkhan po la gtad gnyer gnang ba bzhin pho nya'i lam nas sgrub thebs bskur ba bla brang nas khur blangs kyis smon lam legs par bsgrubs/ or du su o thog wang gi btsun mo dkon mchog tshe ring sras mo gnyis sogs mi drag du ma'i 'khor dang bcas mjal du 'ongs ba la 'dod mos bzhin grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang sogs rjes gnang 'ga' zhig dang nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang / nyid kyi gsar rtsom mkha' spyod ma'i chos skor gyi lung rnams bka' drin stsal/ dpon mos maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol rten khebs sogs mchod rdzas 'ga' zhig /dngul srang bdun brgya gos yug lnga khe pi su'i mthil gdan che legs bzhi bcas phul cing dgon par yang mang 'gyed gzab rgyas zhus/ de dus rje nyid kyi mnal lam du keng rus 'ga' zhig gis rgyal dbang lnga pa'i rgyal gsol bsam 'phel dbang rgyal gyi tshogs zhing gi tshigs bcad steng nas dbyangs shig rnga spub dang bsdebs te gdangs snyan pos 'then pa yang yang byung ba bzhin dbyangs de nyid skad gra pa kha shas bslab kyin yod thog / o thog dpon mo dang lhan du de skor gyi 'don phyag bzhes sogs la shin tu mkhas pa'i dbu mdzad cig ltar dbyangs sgor skyel gyi tshul du 'ongs pa chos skyong gi 'azin 277

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/las su dgongs nas skad gra pa rnams la rgyal gsol rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs kyi dbyangs 'ga' zhig slob bcug ste bla brang du rgyal gsol 'dzugs par mdzad/rje nyid kyis yab yum rnams la sman pa'i don du dgongs te kha lung gzhis gar yab yum bzhugs pa'i khang shul du lha khang tshon rtsi can gsar bzhengs kyi nang du mi 'khrugs pa dang sman bla mched bdun gye sman sku mi tshad tsam pa gser tshon gzungs 'jug rab gnas bcas legs par bsgrub par mdzad/ lha mo'isados 'grin gyi lag len cho ga'i lhan thabs rgyas pa dang mdos chog gi ngag 'don khrigs chags su bkod pa bam skong gi cho ga dang bcas lngags rtsom gnang / dgon lung khri ba rdo ba zhabs drung brjes mtshams la lcang skya rin po cherakhri ba gsar pa dgongs bstun gyi zhu shog phul ba'i phyir phebs su mchod rten thang gi bde rgu 'dul 'dzin dar rgyas rgya mtsho bsngags brjod dang bcas khri bar 'os pa'i bka' babs pa bzhin khong dgon lung gi khrir mnga' gsol/khongadang gser khri sprul sku lha btsun mthu stobs nyi ma sogs don gnyer can mang bo la lhag pa'i lha du ma'i rjes gnang dang lung sogs nyin kha shas la stsal/sgrub sde byang chub gling du dgon ri khrod gnyis kyi dge 'dun brgya phrag kha shas la thog ma'i blo spyong gi bshad pa nyin bdun dang / gzhan yod chos bka' mang po mu mthud nas gnang / skabs shig phyis su rong phyogs kyi grwa tshang so so'i bla ma mdzad mkhan dge bshes dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang 'jam dbyangs/dge 'dun rab rgyas dge 'dun te dka' ram phul du phyin pa bzhi gra skor du 'ongs par mkha' spyod ma'i be'u bum gyi lung sogs 'dod chos 'ga' zhig stsal/ sngar lo dgon lung gi bde rgu zhabs drung bod du thog dus dge 'phel sgom pa ngag dbang rab brtan ba la gdan 'dren snyan bskul gyi phyag bris bskur ba dang zhabs drung la gtad gnyer mdzad pa bzhin kho 'dir zhabs 278

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /drungaskyel mi dang lhan du phebs nas phan tshun chos bka' mang po gsan res mdzad cing dam pa'i chos kyi gsung bgros mang du 'phel/ de nas bzung ste khong ji srid bzhugs kyi bar du bzhugs gnas dang na bza' nyer spyad nar ma'igasol chas rnams bla brang nas mthun rkyen phul du phyin pa ltar chags su bsgrubs/ 'khrungs skar dang bstun nas rje nyid dgung lo bzhi bcur phebs pa'i dga' ston chen po mdzad pa la rje bla ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che spyan drangs/ 'khrungs skar gyi nyin thog mar rje bla ma de nyid nas grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang rgyas pa gnang ba dang rten 'byung gi dngos chas gya nom pa bstar te zhabs brtan 'bul du bcug pa bcas zhabs pad brtan pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar brgya gras su phye bar mdzad/ de rjes dgon lung gi bla brang dngagazhan dgon sgrub sde ris med kyi bla ma las sne ci rigs mu mthud pas brtan bzhugs dang / sbyin bdag har chen wang rat+na sirnyi'i el chi khā a dhi ya ngo g.yog gis sger du brtan bzhugs phul te wang nas bskur ba'i dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal che legs sne 'dogags can nang mdzod sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol na bza' nyer spyad rnams ched gnyer gyis bsgrubs pa'i srus legs/ dngul srang stong phrag gcig dang brgya tham pa gos chen yug dgu bu la ga dgu don yod lcags kyu sogs dngos 'bul spam mtho ba dang / cang pe'izi dang gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas sogs har chen ho sho'u ris med kyi dpon blon sbyin bdag rnams kyis bskur ba'i dngos gtsang ba'i 'bul ba rgya chen po spyan lam du bstar nas zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba btab par zhal bzhes bzang po gnang / yab sras rnam gnyis gtso bor bzhugs pa'i gzhi byes kyi mgron shin tu mang po la bla brang nas khrang zhi'i rtsed mo bstar ba dang bcas gsol ston gzab rgyas zhus/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin 279

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/po cher dngos 'bul gzabs shing phyogs 'dus kyi mgron rnams go bab dang bstun pa'i gnang sbyin gyis mgu bar mdzad/ sbyin bdag wang gi mi sna dang lhan du lha btsun mthu stobs nyi ma rang yul du thon rgyur 'dod mos bzhin mkha' spyod ma'i dbang sogs chos bka' 'ga' zhig gnang / wang chen mos gtsos pa'i sbyin bdag che phra thams cad la so sor byin rten snam ther sogs 'os 'gab kyi rten chas 'tshem med du stsal/ snga sor sum pa chos rje sogs kyis rje nyid la mkhan chen gyi rnam thar zhig lngags rtsom zhus bar/nyidakyang thugs shin tu dgyes te rnam thar rgyas pa zhig rtsom bzhed yod kyang par skabs su dgon lung gi gdan rabs bka' rtsom gnang kyin yod pa'i grangs la 'jug rgyu'i nyung bsdus shig bris pa mkhan chen gyis gzigs te de dkar chag gi grangs yin pa ma mkhyen par/ de tsam zhig gis rnam thar dngos gzhi'i go chod pa byed rgyur 'dug dgongs te thugs ma mnyes par sa bon shog bu sum cu shog bu lngar bsdus pa de 'dra yin na don mi 'dug gsungs nas thugs rtogs mched pa'i gsung skyon bcug pa mang po dang bcas mkhan chen rang gi rnam thar rang nyid kyis brtsams shing / rjes ma'i sa bon yang ma byung bas rje nyid kyis mkhan chen rnam thar rgyas pa slar rtsom rgyu'i thugs bzhed yod pa'ang thog tu ma khel/ rkyen de dag gi thog yul gyi skye bo'i bsod nams kyis ma 'chun pa dang 'byung po'i pho nya lta bu du mas dbyen sna tshogs bskyal te rnam pa gnyis ka cung zad thugs bskang zhugs yod pa'i don skar rnams rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che nas zhib bkrol gnang zhing / lhag par rje nyid la bden rdzun sher rgyus song na khyed rang bden mod kyang de la ma ltos par chos 'brel la bsam nas mkhan pos mi 'os pa ci zhig gnang yang khyed kyis 'khur dgos zhes gsung las mi 'da' ba rgyu mtshan du 280

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /byas pa'i 'gro 'tsham lta bu gnang ste thugs nang dag par mdzad/ nyid kyi bkod khyab ltar dgon lung spyi nas tshe dpag med dang rgyud pas bde mchog lca yi ba'i dbang zhus te bde mchog gi dbang bla brang du gnang bcug ste nyid kyis kyang gsan par mdzad/ dgung lo zhe gcig pa me bya'i gnam lo gsar du tshes pa'i dga' ston la o thog wang gi btsun mo dkon mchog tshe ring gi mi sna khān yan tha'i ngo g.yog gis btsun mo yum sras kyis bskur ba'i dngul srang stong phrag gcig gis mtshon 'bul ba spam mtho pa brtan bzhugs lugs su phul te gsol brtse gcig tu btab/ dgon lung gi smon lam chen mo rje nyid nasayo thog wang gi btsun mo la bskul ma mdzad pa bzhin mi sna'i gdong du thebs dngul srang stong phrag gcig bskur byung bar bla brabanas gra bsgrigs kyis dkon mchog gi mchod pa dge 'dug gyi bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas smon lam legs par bsgrubs/ sbyin bdag gi 'dod mos bzhin nyid nas tshes brgyad dang bco lnga'i nyin gsung chos smon lam du phebs te dge 'dun gyi sde dang lhan du rnam dkar rlabs po che bsgrubs pa'i dge ba rnams nam yang mi zad pa byang chub mchog gi rgyur bsngo ba'i spyan dmigs kyis rgyas 'debs par mdzad/ dpon mo yum sras la 'byor lan gyi bka' shog sku 'dra spos snam gyi rten chas dang el chi la 'dod chos dang gnang sbyin gya nom pa stsal/ 7gong ma'i ma yum thas hu chen mo gnam du gshegs pa'i dgongasardzogs kyi chos 'don dgos kyi bka' babs byung ba dgongs bzhed ltar bsgrubs te gdung mchod du nang so bstan 'gyur can mngags/ rnam rgyal stong mchod dang ltung bshags kyi cho ga / dmigs brtse ma'i char 'bebs sogs gsung rtsom mang du spel/ 'dul pa dgon gyi 'du khang gi shing rtsi rje nyid nas rgyu chas dang do dam ba gtong ba gnang ste legs par 281

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/bsgrubs yod par dbyar 'dul dgon la phebs nas rten brten pa sogs la rab gnas mdzad de shis pa'i me tog char du bsnyil/ 'du khang grub ston du dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur dang spyi 'jog tu dung dkar gcig phul/tshogs yongs la lam rim bde lam gye khrid nyin bdun gnang skabs spyor ba'i chos drug zhib bshad stsal bar brten phyag skor mchod 'bul sogs bsag sbyang la 'bad pa'i mig ltos ches dar bas bsod nams kyi 'jug ngogs yangs por phyes/ dgon pa'i tshogs 'don gyi 'dur rta dbyangs dang 'cham dang rol mo 'bud dkrol sogs la dag ther gnang ba'i thog sngar mnal lam du keng rus kyis gar 'khrab tshul bstan pa de ltar gyi 'cham tshan pa gcig gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ sku dngos kyis mgon khang du gsung grogs dang bcas rgyal gsol rgyas pa zhig btang / phyir 'khor te sngar zhwa dmar bra ste dgon gyi 'du khang shing rtsi ldeb ris dang bcas nyid nas phyag rdzas dang bkod pa gnang ste gsar bskrun mdzad pa'i rab gnas su gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan lan mang du byung na'ang thugs brel gyis lo 'gyangs bar sku'i nye rigs rnams kyis sems 'khang che bas ston 'dir chibs bskyod gnang / lam zhor du mchod rten thang dgon pa dang dor zhi dgon yon mchod kyis bsnyen bkur zhus par so sor 'dod chos dang dgon par mang 'gyed stsal/ bra ste dgon du khri gdan zur zhabs drung rnams dang ching hu sogs ser skya rim pa du mas chibs bsu thab bsu ser sbrengs gang rgyas dang bcas phyag phebs/'du khang rab gnas dang spyi sger gyi 'dod chos rab byung dge tshul slong gi sdom pa sogs gang zhus thams cad yid tshim bar stsal/ ri dgon spyi 'dus kyis bsnyen bkur 'bul nod gzabs par mang 'gyed 'bul ba'ang gya nom pa gnang / 'brog sde'i khrod du gdan drangs nas che phra thams cad kyis mjal 282

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /kha dang bsnyen bkur zhus pas byin rlabs dbang bskur sogs kyis tshim par mdzad/ rgya yag dgon gye gdan 'dren pa byung ste phebs lam du or tsho dang bod yul ri khrod pa rnams chos dang zang zing gis mgu bar mdzad cing grub chen bla mas gtsos pa'i rta ba brgya phrag du mas chibs bsu thab bsu ser sbrengs dang bcas rgya yag dgon du babs/ spyi chos su bla ma'i rnal 'byor dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid dang spyan ras gzigs mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang bcas pa'i rigs gtad sogs chos kyi bdud rtsi'i dga' ston spel/ bsgrub bya lnga bcu brgal bar bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa phog ste bslab pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhi la bkod/ grwa ba 'ga' zhig gi 'dod mos bzhin gza' mchog gi rigs gtad kyang gnang / grub chen bla ma sogs spyi sger gyis gsol ston dang 'bul ba rgyas pa zhus dgon par mang 'byed kyang gzabs/ hor dgon pa sogs kyi gdan 'dren pa 'ongs par phebs zhor du lha chen byams pa la mchod mjal dang 'byor ldan sgang bsgyud nas 'brog sde'i mi rnams byin rlabs dang gsung gi bdud rtsis ngoms par byas te hor dgon par 'bab/ ser skya'i tshogs pa la rdo rje sems dpa'i rjes gnang sogs chos bka' 'ga' zhig stsal/so so nas bkur ste zhabs tog mi zhel ba bsgrubs shing tshogs par mang 'gyed gnang / de bzhin du nags yangs dgon gong 'og dang rgyang ring dgon gong 'og yong khrang dgon yon mchod rnams kyis gdan drangs pa bzhin rim pas phebs te bsnyen bkur bdag gir bzhes nas phyag dbang chos bka' sogs gang zhus kyi re ba gong par mdzad/ de dus nad drag pos btab nas grong la thug pa'i bla rgan zhig mjal khar khur 'ongs pa la mtshan dang gzungs sngags rna lam du bsgrags/ ngo la spyan 'bur tshugs kyis gzigs te en tsamaspyan dmigs gnang nas zhal phu btang cing nged rang su yin ngo e shes 283

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/gsung bar/ khos khyed rang rnal 'byor ma dmar mo red zhus pas zhal 'dzum pa mdzad cing da khyer gsung / phyi nyin bla rgan lnga pa'i lam du song 'dug/ sngon rje btsun rtse ba chen po'ang 'ga' zhig gis thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa dang la las bcu gcig zhal gye rnam par mthong ba de nyid 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i rnam 'phrul du sgrub pa'i shes byed gtso bo zhig tu dam pa gong ma mang pos gsungs pa ltar na/ 'dis kyang rje btsun rnal 'byor ma dang ngo bo dbyer med du bsgrub nus sam snyam mo/ / tshur lam lang gru'u sde bzhi'i gnas dang rten rnams la zhib mjal mdzad de thugs smon rgya cher gnang / phyogs de'i ri dgon thams cad kyi sa cha dang nags rnams rgya mi dang hus hus rnams kyis bdag byas nas dmag rta gso rgyu sogs la bsnyad de 'grul bkag nas bod kyis tha na zog gso sa dang me shing len sa med par nyam thag pa'i steng du rang rang gis sgo'i rgya dpon chung ba dang dmag mi rnams kyis kyang khral log 'gel ba sogs kyis sgo du ma nas gtses te sdug bsngal bar yod pa'i don du rje nyid la skyabs btsal ba bzhin/ nyid nas lang gru'u grin tha'iye la rgyu mtshan zhib mol gnang ste phyin chad dkyus khral ma gtogs pas sgo'i dpon chung dang dmag mi tshos rang 'dod kyis khral log bkal mi chog pa'i yi ge phral du bkram zhing / rim gyis dpon chen gzhan rnams la bkod khyab nas bod kyis rang gi sa cha dang nags la ci bder longs spyad chog pa'i yi ge blangs pa sogs gzhal bar dka' ba'i bka' drin gyis dbugs dbyung bar mdzad/ dgun tho'u bkwan gye gzims gshag tu bcad rgya'i ngos thugs dam nyams bzhes la brtson pa chig dril du gnang / de'i tshe gcod kyi nyams bzhes la brten nas mtha' bral lta ba'i mtshon rnon gyis dngos 'dzin 'ching brgya'i dra ba gcod pa don dam pa'i gcod yul gyi rtogs pa khyad par can 284

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /thugasal 'khrungs te/ zhal nas kyang / tho'u bkwan gyi gzhis gar mtshan mo gcod btang bar 'khor gsum bden med du bsam skabs nga rang mi 'dug pa snyam pa byung / mig phyis nas rang gi gzugs phung e 'dug lta dgos pa byung / gzugs phung yang gzhan zhig gi yin pa lta bus lag pas reg nas lta dgos pa byung / chos thams cad mi 'dug las bsog pa po dang rnam smin myong ba po dang sdug bsngal sogs gtan nas mi 'dug pas dmyal bar skye dogs kyis 'jigs pa mi dgos pa 'dug snyam pa byung / 'di lta bu'i nyams myong yod pa 'ga' zhig la dris pas la las chad ltar song 'dug zer/'ga' zhig gis da lta'i snang tshul 'di ltar du grub pa mi 'dug snyam du shar ba yin 'dug pas chad ltar mi 'gro zer/ phyis su paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen par zhus pas khyod kyis mnyam bzhag gi ngor ma shar pa ma gtogs chos thams cad med par thag 'chad pa mi 'dug pas chad ltar mi 'gro/ 'on kyang tha snyad du 'char tshul cung zad shugs skyed na legs zhes gsung tshul dang bcas bka'astsal pa 'di ni rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang mngon du gyur pa'i rnam thar bla na med pa zhig ste/ sngon rje btsun shes rab seng gas kyang lta ba gsar du rnyed skabs nges ngor rang nyid kyang ye med du song ba lta bu'i nyams shar nas phyag gis na bza'i gong ba la 'chang ste yod med blta dgos pa byung ba rje bla mas mkhyen nas snar thang bas kun rdzob gong ba la bzhag pa red ces mchog tu dgyes pa'i gsung gnang ba bzhin no/ / dgung lo zhe gnyis la phebs pa sa pho khyi'i lo gsar gyi dga' ston nyin sbyin bdag har chin wang gi mi sna ngo g.yog gis wang nas bskur ba'i lha rten na bza' gos dang dngul sogs dngos 'bul rnam grangs mang po brtan bzhugs lugs su phul te zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba btab/ dgon pa'i smon lam chen mo nyid 285

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/nas har chin wang la snyan bskul gnang ba bzhin mi sna'i gdong du dngul srang stong lhag bskur ba bla brang nas khur blangs kyis rten gsum la stong mchod dang /dge 'dun la ja thug 'gyed kyi bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas kyis smon lam legs par bsgrubs/ nyid kyang smon lam gyi tshogs dbur phebs te bsngo smon gyi spyan dmigs yang dag gnang / dus chen dang bstun nas sgol dkar tshe sgrub kyi yig cha'ang ljags rtsom mdzad/ rgyal yag dgon pa'i grub chen bla ma sku tshe ma zin pa'i sngas mgor sbyin bdag phyag rdor phe'i zi nas bzod pa khā gdan 'dren du btang ba bzhin phebs/ gan chen dgon pa dang 'bri gu dgon pa yon mchod kyis lam nas bsu skyel ja thab rgyas pa dang gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan zhus par phyir lam 'byon rgyu'i zhal len gnang / rgyal yag dgon par grub chen bla ma'i bur sbyangs sogs kyi cho ga bsgrubs shing ri dgon thams cad kyis dgon pa 'dzin bdag gnang dgos kyi gsol ba nan tan btab par zhal bdag mdzad de 'dan ma bla ma sku tshab tu bsko bzhag gnang /'dan ma grub chen gyi sprul sku de ga'i 'brog khrod du 'khrungs pa thag bcad nas gdan 'dren byed grab kye skabs yin pas phyag mdzod kyis sprul sku'i 'khrungs yul du gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs te sprul sku'i gtsug phud bzhes/ tshur lam 'bri gu dgon pa yon mchod kyis bkur ste chen pos dgon par spyan drangs nas spyi sger gyis mjal kha dang gsol ston 'bul nod gzab rgyas zhus par ser skya mang la lam gtso'i khrid dang tshogs par mang 'gyed stsal/ de nas gan chen dgon par ja thab ser sprengs dang bcas 'byor/ lam nas sku grib la brten pa'i bsnyung gzhi byung ba bab lci ru song bar zhag kha shas bzhugs te gsol sman gye 'phrod brten dang dgon par mang 'gyed 'bul ba gya nom pa'i thog zhabs brtan mang po bsgrubs pas cung zad bde nyams shar/286

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /ldan ma grub chen gyi zhal gzigs ltar gyi mgon po zhal gyis cham gzigs bzhed kyis mgon khang du grwa pa nyi shu lhag la bskang gso rgyas pa zhal gyi tshes gtor bcas gtong bcug pa dang sku dngos kyis mgon khang nang mar phebs nas 'phrin bcol gnyer gtad zil che ba gnang zhing chos grwa nas zhal gyi 'cham bstar ba gzigs te thugs shin tu mnyes pa'i rnam pa mdzad/ rjes sor gsung 'phros kyi skab4samagonakhang der chos skyong gnyan pa'i stabs yin nams skya'i mgon khang gi nyams shar cing gnyer gtad byed dus dang zhal gyi 'cham blta dus sems g.yeng nas nad kyi zug gzer brjed 'dug cing / rjes nas nad gzhi yang rang shugs kyis dwangs song gsung tshul la dpag na der gzigs snang khyad par can zhig byung yod pa'i tshod du snang /'du khang du spyan drangs te bskun gzhi dwangs pa'i dga' ston dang zhabs pad brtan pa'i rten 'brel du dngos 'bul spam mtho ba btegs te gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab par dgye4pa'i bka' lan du tshogs yongs la spyor ba'i chos drug dang 'brel bar yon tan gzhir byung ma'i khrid stsal/ de nas dgon mchod gzhis kyi chibs skyel ja thab dang bcas thon te rim gyes gdan sar babs/ gan chen nas bsnyen song phyag len sogs nges pa'i grwa pa kha shas bos te dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i glo bur las bcol 'dan ma grub chen gyi phyag len bzhin bsgrub skabs chos rje blo bzang bstan dar gyi rmi lam du'ang sego la'i gleng nas 'ongs zer ba'i a tsa ra dpon g.yog lngas dngul gyi ka ṭo ra chen po zhos bkang ba zhig gi phyogs bzhir dngul thag btags 'dug pa g.yog bzhi pos 'then nas 'di sku zhabs su 'bul rgyu yin zer gzim khang 'gag tu sgug sdod byas yod pa zhig rmis 'dug pa bstan srung chen po dgyes shing 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsol ba'i dan rtags su gsal la/ /287

༄/ /gung ngab ngo'i name'i gsunga'abum/stong 'khor sprul ba'i sku 'di lo bod du 'byon rgyu yin stabs nyid kyi mdun du mjal phrad la phebs par 'jigs chung gi dug dbang dang zhang blon gyi rjes gnang sogs bzhed mos bzhin gyi chos bka' dang phebs rdzong sbam mtho ba gnab/ dbyar phyag mdzod dar har dpon po don grub dbang rgyal ngo g.yog bod du rnam dkar dge sgrub dang gser khri sprul sku dang lha btsun mthu stobs nyi ma gnyis grwa sar skyel ba chabs gcig tu gtong ba gnang skabs bla brang nas dus thog der dad gshijagyi rdzas phyag tu gang byung rtsal sbrug lta bu gnang ste/ gser rkyang srang brgya dngul rkyang srang chig khri brgal ba gser dngul dang bzang gos las bsgrubs pa'i mchod rdzas du ma/ g.yu dang byi ru sbos shel man shel g.yang ṭi sogs rin po che'i rig kyi rgyan phreng dang sgod spyad spus gtsang rin thang che ba du ma/ gos chen rgyu mdog gang legs grangs mang bas mtshon ha sag wa nag bu lag gos btags zam ras sogs ngos gtsang ba'i dngos po sna tshogs dngul srang chig khri brgal pa'i thob thang bcas bton nas phyag mdzod la mchod sbyin byed lugs dang lha rten gsar rnying phyag dpe sgrub rgyu'i ljags bkod/ sprul sku dang lha btsun gnyis la slob gnyer byed lugs sogs kyi zhal ta zhib par gnang / khyad par du lha btsun mthu stobs nyi mas zhus pa bzhin tshul khrims rnam par dag pa gzhir byas kyi steng nas thos bsam sgom gsum ya ma bral bar nyams su len tshul gyi bslab bya mu tig phreng ba zhes bya ba go bde la don gyi gnad 'gag 'dril ba zhig stsal te/ mjug tu'ang / je skad bshad pa'i don rnams nyams blangs na/ / tshe dang chos la bar chad mi 'byung zhing / / thos bsam mthar phyin rang gzhan kun 'tsheng ba'i/ / dga' ston bzang po nyams su myong bar nges/ / gsungs pa bzhin khong gis kyang bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bka' ji lta bar lag len du bstar 288

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bas mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob ste dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mang gi chos khri mdzad pa sogs bstan pa'i gsos su che bar gyur to/ / dbyar thog shas cher skyed tshal yid dga' chos 'phel du zab mo'i rnal 'byor gtsor 'don ngos thun mtshams su dpal mgon gyi gtor chog 'phrin las myur mgyogs kyi pho nya dang phyag drug pa'i gtor chog dgos 'dod kun 'byung sogs gsung rtsom 'ga' zhig kyang mdzad/ / ston bkra shis chos gling gi khrir phebs dgos kyi gsol ba btab pa bzhin phebs dpa' ris stong shag gi dgon mchod gzhis kyi rta bsu thab bsu rim pa du ma dge 'dun gyi ser sbrengs bcas rten 'brel gang legs kyis dgon par babs te khri 'don mdzad/ dgon pa rang dang dgon lung spyibla brang 'brug lung bsam gtan rtse rgyud pa sgar mā yang lo dkar ri khrod sogs kyis khri 'bul btegs shing de dag la tshogs gleng dang bcas ston mo rgyas pa'i thog lha ram pa don 'grub rgya mtshos khri bshad byas/ tshogs par mang 'gyed dang dad 'dus kyi mjal ba stong phrag du ma la phyag dbang gnang sgrig lam bca' yig nang ltar bsdams shing tshogs gtam byas pa dang 'chad nyan mdzad/ rtsa lhung rnam bshad sogs khrid lung gi skor mang bo gnang lha ram pa don grub rgya mtsho slob chung la bskos te phyir phebs/ 'dul ba dgon gyi rong bo zhabs drung bod nas gsar du skebs te 'byor mjal zhus par thugs mnyes pa'i gsung gleng 'phel/ mchod rten thang dgon par 'dom bzhi re yod pa'i phye 'phur gsum dang der cha mtshungs kyi ka 'phan bdun 'jog pa gnang zhing / de'i gos kyi lhag ma kha snon dang bcas gnang ste dbang rgya tig zhabs drung gis khur blangs kyis 'phan yol legs par bsgrubs/ de skabs rje nyid gar bzhugs kyi phyogs su bcol rgyug pa dang mnalamal me dang dud sprin 'dres ma'i dpung chen po blta bar mi bzod pa 289

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/zhig 'ongs te mdun du babs pa na rang nyid rta mchog rol ba'i nga rgyal gyes de la dbyug pa zhig bsnun pas mi shi ba'i shul du so phag gi zor chung ngu zhig yod pa sogs dngos dang mnal lam du 'tshub ltas chen po yang yang byung bar sengagadong ma gtso 'khor gsum dang / chag lugs gtsug tor 'bar ba'i phyir slog gi gdams pa ljags rtsom gnang ste dgun gyi ring 'dir dgon sde khag che chung la gtong sgo rgya chen po btang thog sku rim mang po dang / khyad par bla brang du sgrub pa khag 'ga' btsugs nas phyir bzlog gi bsgom bzlas dang byang chu bo la bsgyur ba sogs gnad smin gyi zhabs brtan stobs chen mang du bsgrubs/ rje nyid kyis kyang thugs dam spyan dmigs rgyun chags su mdzad pas 'tshub lhong mtha' dag sprin nag rlung gis gtor ba bzhin rim gyis rang yal du song / dam sris rgyud brlams pa'i ser skya 'ga' zhig gis kham chu sna tshogs shig bslangs nas ya ba mi byed thabs med byung skabs dam can dmag dpung bskul ba'i rnga sgra drag po bya ba'i bskul de gsar du brtsams nas mgon khang du tshar gcig tsam btang / de rjes bla brang gi mi rnams dang de dag khrims sar zhu gtugs kyis sher rgyag skabs dgra bo'i dwangs ma bdud layag zer bas gyod gtam gyi mgor sdang zhugs drag po'i sgo nas rje 'di'i mtshan smos ma thag kho rang glo bur du lpu ba zhig bskyugs te sher dpon gyi mdun du 'gyel/ de nas bzung lo gcig gi ring spyos te phyogs thams cad du 'khyams pa'i mthar 'jig rten pha rol tu song / yang mtshams shig mnal lam du mi byad dmar hur re ba gos dmar po gyon cing dar thod dmar po bcings pa zhig gis mi snying phyed tshal zhig thogs nas gri snying yin zer/tshang ma byung na gsang rten zhig bca' chog pa la dgongs te 'di'i phyed ka ci byas gsung bar nged rang gis zos pa yin zer/ su'i snying yin byas pas 290

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nye ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /dgra phyogs su mdzub ston byed pa rmis shing de dang dus mtshungs su dgra bo de dag gi nang nas gtso bor gyur ba g.yung ri zer ba de kha sna bshang gci sogs sgo thams cad nas khrag rul zag ste shi 'dug pas/ drag bskur du/ snying la lcags kyi spar mos thob/ / khobakhrag dron mo skyug tu chugs/ / klad pa dkar po zho ltar dkrugs/ / don snying nang khrol thang la grom/ / zhes ji ltar dmod bcol ba bzhin du bstan pa'i dgra bo de dag dam can chos srung rnams kyis mngon sum nyid du bsgral bar gor ma chag go / bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho khros pa'i zhal/ / khrag zhag lbu ba 'khrigs pa rgya mtsho'i klong / /bstan dgra sde dang bcas pa'i bla tshe srog / bstab pa khyur gyes mid cing skanaspa gtog / sdig can srog gis skyo ba yi/ / skye bo yid 'byung ldan pa rnams/ / rnal 'byor dbang phyug dgrar bzung na/ / zhi ba'i go 'phang myur du 'thob/ / ces kyang go bar byas te bag yod par gyis shig / dgung lo zhe gsum pa sa phag gi lo gsar sogs dkyus bzhin byas/ de'i lo dgon pa'i cho 'phrul smon lam nyid nas sbyin bdag dam pa phyag rdor pa'i zil bskul ma mdzad pa bzhin khong gis rgyu yon sbyar te smon lam rgyas par bsgrubs/dpyid dbyar gyi ring brel ba gzhan med par thugs dam shin tu 'phel zhing thun mtshams su skal ldan rnams la chos bka' dang mgon dkar gyi nor sgrub bka' rgya can dang de'i gtor chog / rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi gtor chog dang de'i 'phrin bcol gyi tshigs bcas btson 'don sgrol ma'i cho ga rgyas pa lo gyon ma'i bum chog sogs ljags rtsom mang du spel/ dbyar gnas kyi skabs bkra shis chos gling du phebs nas 'chad nyan mdzad/ 'dzin gra thams cad kyi brtsi bzhag dang 'gro gleng gi rgyug blangs par so sos rgyug 'phrod nges su phul bas thugs mnyes pa'i bsngags brjod dang phyin chad kyang brtson 291

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronas gsung 'bum/pa lhur len rgyun chags pa dgos tshul gyi zhal ta gnang / 'brog sde'i khrod du gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus skabs da lta'i thar pa gling gi gnas 'dis dpyad legs pa'i gnas phun sum tshogs par gzigs nas dben dgon zhig 'dzin rgyu byung na snyam pa'i thugs dgongs byung ste sa'i bdag por 'brog pa rnams la gnas gzhi de 'tshong 'dod yod med dris par btsong chog pa'i khas len bgyis pas thugs shin tu mnyes/ mā yang dgon pa dang rgyud pasgar sogs su gdan drangs te 'dod chos zhus pa'i re ba skong bar mdzad nas tshur dgon lung du phebs/ phyag mdzod dar han dbon po don grub dbang rgyal ngo g.yog gis bod chos kyi zhing du slebs nas rje nyid kyi zhal bkod ji lta ba bzhin/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho dang / paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes/saskya bdag chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros/ rgyal tshab no mon han rnams la rnam grangs mang nyung gis phye ba'i 'bul chen dang gzhan mchog dman du mar bab bstun gye 'bul sbyin gzab rgyas/ jo bo shākya rnam gnyis dang lo ke shā ra sogs lha rten byin can mang po dang rje yab sras rgyal dbangadang paṇa chen sku na rim sogs dam pa khyad par can mang po'i gdung rten dang 'bum pa sogs rten 'gang can rnams la stong mchod brgya mchod ci rigs dang gser chab snyan shal gyis mtshon mchod pa rgya chen po/ lha ldan smon lam dang se 'bras dge gsum/ rgyud stod smad dang srad rgyud/ bkra shis lhun po/ sa skya dgon chen/ zhwa lu dgon pa/ dpal 'khor chos sde/rong byams chen/ yer ba dang rwa sgreng dgon sogs dbus gtsang phyogs gi dgon sgrub sde mang por mang 'gyed gya nom pa bcas gtong ba'i sgo 'phar yangasapor phyes te rnam dkar bsod nams kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 292

༄༅/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bsgrubs/ rgyalasrayorin po che la rje nyid nas sog yul gyi sbyin bdag rnams la dge bskral mdzad pas dngul srang stong phrag gnyis dang / dgon pa spyi nas mchod gzhis la 'bul sdud byas pas dngul srang stong phrag gcig ste dngul srang stong phrag gsum bla brang sgos kyi'ang 'bul ba gzab rgyas dang bcas phul bas/ khong gis kyang de la gzhis byas te dzing phyi'i byams khang steng du gser gyi rgya phib gsar bsgrubs gnang ste dge tshogs gong 'phel gyi bsod nams mi zad pa'i gter du gyur to/ / rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho zhal bzhugs skabs sku brnyan mang po bzhengs rgyur rgya bal sogs nas blangs pa'i tsan dan gyi sdong dum las ma song ba la rgyal ba rang nyid kyis sku rgyu'i byin rlabs sogs mdzad pa gzhung sa nas zhus te bal bo'i bzo mkhas pa kha shas la jo bo shākya mu ne/ lo ke shā ra/ byams 'jam dbyangs kyi sku khru gang re bzhugs khri rgyab yol can bzhengs bcug pas mtshon tsan dan dang dngul sogs kyis gsar du bzhengs pa'i sku brnyan nyi shu skor la nang 'jug tu chos sku'i ring bsrel tshad ldan dang sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi 'phel gdung dang / rgya gar gyi paṇa grub mang po/ bod kyi skyes chen dam pa du ma'i dbu lo na bza' gdung rus sku mtshal zhun thigs sogs byen rten grangs stong phrag brgal ba phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i rten ril gyis sna drangs te yungs 'bru dang sku gdung dang skyabal gyi ring bsrel skor sna du ma rtsol bsgrubs kyis phyur bur gtams nas rgyal dbang yab sras la me tog 'thor 'bul zhus shing / gzhung sa dang bkras lhun sa skya sogs nas zhus te rten rnying lo rgyus can tsardon dang gser zangs sogs kyi 'bur sku sum cu lhag dang zhal thang bcu bzhi/ gzhan yang klu 'jim dang bur tshwa sogs kyi sku brnyan dam pa du ma'i na bza' bubs dang tshal bu ci rigs bcas rten byin rlabs 293

༄/ /gung ca ba pa'isgroname'i g.yo 'bum/can mang po dang / phyag dpe rgyun dkon pa'i rigs gang rnyed rnamasalegs par baspubs te ston 'dir rang yul du bde bar 'byor bas thugs dgyes tshor chen po mdzad cing / rten gsar rnying rnams bla brang gi li ma khang byin rlabasagater mdzod du bzhugs su gsol/ dgon pa'i spyi 'jog tu 'cham bsagon rgyu'i grwa lham cha bzhibacu zhe gnyis khyer 'ongs pa de bzhin 'jog pa gnang / kun spangs skal bzang zla ba bod nas mdzod pa dang lhan du phebs paraganas tshul gyi gsung gleng dang nyams myong la dri gtugs mang du mdzad cing de phyin chad nas khong gi chos kyi cha rkyen bla brang nas sbyor rgyu byas pa khong rang zhal bzhugs bar du zhus pa'o/ / 'dis mtshon pa'i thag nye ring gi chos byed mkhan rnams la drag zhan dang rgyus yod med la ma ltos par rgyud tshod dang bstun pa'i chos bka' gang 'dod du stsal cing / chos bzang ri khrod sogs su lo zla ji tsam sdod rag la cha rkyen sbyar ba sogs dge sbyor ba rnamayol thugs gtsigs lhag par che ba zhig yod pa ni mdo sde rgyan las/ brtan pa ji skad brtan pa sgrub pa des/ / de yi sems ni yang dag mgu bar byed/ / ces dang / de chos bgo skal la spyod yon tan ldan/ bshes gnyen rab tu sten byed zang zing min/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar mchod pa kun las sgrub pa'i mchod pa la par dgyes pa theg pa mchog gi bshes gnyen gyi rnam par thar pa'o/ / lo 'dir srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes rgya nag tu gdan drangs pa bzhin chibs bsgyur gnang ba la 'bri chu'i khar phebs bsu zhu mi rdzong brda' dang / dgon lung dgon ma lag dang bcas par chibs bsu ji ltar bya ba'i ljags bkod gnang ste nyid dpon g.yog zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du chibs bsur chas nas 'dul ba dgon du 'byor nyin bod nas byams chen mkhan po ngag dbang nor bus dbu 294

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'igasangagasum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /paṇa sne ring / na bza' chog gos phul ba phyag tu son pas rten 'brel legs par dgongs nas thugs mnyes par mdzad/ de nas rim gyis phebs lam du chu 'gag nas kun bzang ja sag 'khor bcas kyis bsnyen bkur zhus shing /sa stong zhig tu sgar btab nyin thams cad kyis nye 'khor na ru sde med tshul gleng mo byas par/ nyid nagazhal rtsed kyi tshul du nged rang gisas stong 'dir thams cad la 'thung rgyu'i zho dar cig 'gugs gsung ba dang de ma thag tu sog po tshan gcig gis chi ge dang zho mang po bkal nas slebs byung ste sngon ston pa rin po che rnal 'byor rnam bzhi dang bcas rwa sgreng du bzhugs skabs/ nyin gcig tshang gsol nas dro la bzhes rgyu ma lus pa'i tshe dgon pa bas nga ni bus sna gdong na 'ongs pa de za gsungs pas/ zhag gcig na de nas sbyin bdag cig 'ongs te dge 'dun la dro drangs pa dang / mus pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan phebs bzhud cig gi tshe chibs rta mus nas len rtsis byas par nga'i rta shi 'dug ste po po'i rta zhon chog gsungs pa na/ nges par chibs snga ma de shi 'dug cing ma 'gyang bar dol nas po po stag la zer bas rta zhig phul byung bar chibs byas pa'i lo rgyus sogs dang dpe mtshungs par snang ngo / / dge 'dun gung gis ur ge la gdan drangs nas gsol ston 'bul nod zhus par 'pho khrid sogs chos bka' 'ga' zhig gnang / gung gi dgon pa bkra shis chos 'byor gling gi bla gra rnams kyis gdan drangs nas der phebs sgug mdzad de zla ba phyed gnyis tsam bzhugs par tā bla ma blobazang don grub sogs der 'khod kun gyis bsnyen bkur phu dud yang dag pa bsgrubs/ dgon sde ris med kyi chibs bsu ba mang po der 'dus nas lhan du sgugs sdod byas shing nyid la chibs bsu sogs ji ltar byed lugs kyi dgongs bstun zhus pa bzhin zhal bkod zhib par stsal/ bzhugs ring la de ga'i bla gra tshang ma dang yul mi mang 295

༄/ /yo bangab ba'ithoname'i ga4 'bum/po/ phyogs gnas 'dus pa gro tshang mkhan po dang ka ring zhabs drung sems nyid zhabs drung rong po zhabs drung 'dan ma zhabs drung dor zhi zhabs drung pā dru bla ma sogs snga phyir gzhi byes kye drag zhan mang nyung ci rigs la sgrol dkar 'od zer drug sprags dang lha mo shra ma ṇa sogs lha du ma'i rjes gnang dang /bla ma'i rnal 'byor lam rim blo spyong sko ra gyi khrid lung / lcang skya gsung 'bum nang gi le tshan mang po dang yi ge bzhi pa'i srung zlog tshe sgrub kyi rim pa mang po'i lung sogs nyin ltar chos bka' du ma dang bka' bsgo byin rlabs sman sbyin sogs 'gro ba'i don du gang 'gyur gyi mdzad pa don yod pa 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' ba byung / lhag par mdo sngags rig gnas kyi gzhung don dang rang rang gi nyams myong sogs kyi dri ba zhu mkhan thams cad kyang rmongs pa'i dra ba bcad de legs bshad skyes kyis ngoms pa'i kun tu dga' ba la sbyar/nyin gcig mtsho mchod du phebs par snga go nga kha char babs nas na bun thubs yod na'ang mtsho 'gram du bsang mchod dang klu gtor rgyas par mdzad pas na bun gye zhal khebs phyes te mtsho mdangs baiḍūbo ltar dwangs byung bar/dbus kyi mahā de ba'i ri la zhal bltas te thugs gting nas g.yos pa'i rnam pas 'du 'dzi la skyo zhing dben pa'i yon tan dran tshul gyi mgur dbyangs mang du bzhes te rgyun ring por bzhugs pa ni sngon bra sga mo chos kyi rdo rje'i dus na ri de nyid du sgrub pa gnang ste dbon pa las skyes pa'i bsam gtan gyi dga' ba mchogal gzhol ba'i ngang tshularjes su dran pa yin par sems so/ / dgon lung khri ba 'dul 'dzin dar rgyam pa dang khri zur rdo ba zhabs drung sogs ma bu dgon gye chibs bsu pa sum brgya skor la o lon bu lag nas chibs bsu zhu rgyu'i bkod pa gnang ste sngon la btang / nyid rang gis shar ngos rdo'i nyi zla g.yas ri gser chen mthon po g.yon ri smon lam mthon po mdun du g.yu mtsho 296

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /mer ba/ sa cha dngos kyi ming cha kān tho lo gos zhes ming bkra legs pas de nas chibs bsu byed gsung ba bzhin zla ba bcu ba'i bcu gcig gi nyin rje nyid dbu mdzad de/ gro tshang mkhan po dang ka ring zhabs drung hor grub chen zhwa dmar dgon dang rgyal yag dgon/ sems nyid dgon 'dul ba dgon bkra shis chos gling / bsam gtan rtse rgyud pa sgar lo gar ri khrod pā ju dgon len hwa thas sogs dgon sde du ma'i sprul sku zhabs drung bla ma las sne rta ba sum brgyaranye ba nyid kyi zhabs phyir 'brang nas cha gān tho lo go'u nas/ 7paṇa chen mchog gi zhal mjal te 'byor phyag zhus pas thugs dgyes pa'i bka' 'dri mi nyung tsam phebs shing / a sha gan gyi zhag bab la sku mdun du bzhugs khri rgyab yol sogs bkur gzos zhes dang bcas ja gral thog bka' mchid mang du 'phel/ nyid nas zas sna mi 'dra ba lder sum brgya tsam gyi gsol ston bsgrigs thog dngul maṇa nang mdzod/ sngar thugs mis byung ba dang dbyibs mthun par gos chen sangs rgyas sku sha ma'i gdugs dung dkar dngul gshog can cha/ gos chen sna tshogs chibs chen dkar po phrum dar can sogs thog ma'i rten 'byung gi dngos 'bul btegs te/ sngon jur ching rgyal po dge ldan ba dang 'brel mdzad pa paṇa chen chos rgyan gyi bka' drin yin tshul dang da lan rje bla ma nyid rgya nag tu chibs bsgyur gnang ba'ang rang cag dge ldan pa'i bstan pa gong nas gong du dar zhing rgyas pa'i rten 'brel gyi gnad yin tshul las brtsams te 'brel chags pa'i zhu 'bul mdor bsdus tsam phul bar/ mthu chen gyes bden pa bdar ba ltar 'grub yong gsung dgyes tshor chen po mdzad/ nged dang lhan du sku 'bum la phebs shig gsung bar zhabs phyi zhu rgyu yin tshul zhus/ de nas bzung ste phyir lo rgya nag tu 'byon rag tshun la sku 'bum du bzhugs nas nyin bzhin sku mdun du bcar te 297

༄/ /gung bstan ba'izlaname'i༄nga 'bum/skabs su gang babs kyi zhabs 'degs tshul bzhin zhus shing / paṇa chen mchog nas 7gong ma chen por mjal phrad zhu tshul dang / 7gong ma'i blon chen sogs rgya'i mi drag rnams la chabasred chen po'i lugs kyi gzos sgo rim pa ltar gnang lugs sogs kyi bka' 'dri stsal pa dang / astan sogs rgya dpon che rigs kyis paṇa chen mchog la mjal phyag gis mtshon chos lugs kyi bsnyen bkur byed tshul sogs zhu gtug byas pa rnams la mdzes lam du ma gyur pa'i snyan sgron dang bslab ston 'bul gnang mdzad de phan tshun gye mtshams spyor rje nyid kyis mdzad pas bstan pa'i la rgyar phan pa'i phyag rjes bka' drin shin tu che ba byung / gan lang shus gsum pho rod dpa' ris stong shag gi'i dgon phal che bas bsu skyel ston mo'i bkod pa dang phyag dbang bka' chos bsnyen rdzogs sogs kyi mgo 'dren rje nyid la blo rtse gtad pa bzhin thugs khur bzhes te bsgrubs par gzhan gyi mi drag tshe sgob can rnams nyin zhag 'gyangs nas sgug sdod byed dgos kyang / nyid kyis sku tshab btang nas zhu sna mdzad pa'i grwa rkyang mi rkyang yan chad dka' tshegs la ma ltos par gang bsam thams cad phral phral du grub nas thon thub pa byung bas/ 7paṇa chen mchog gis thugasagatsigs che ba dang rgya bod kyi mi drag so sos rtsi bkur yang gzhan las lhag pas lugs gnyis kyi rnam dbye shes mkhan rnams ha las pa lta bur gyur/dgon sde de rnams la 7paṇa chen mchog gi mdzod nas mang 'gyed kyi gsol ras kyang gya nom bstsal/ thugs 'gol ba'i tshe gzim chung spug nas gsol ja lhan du gnang ba sogs nang lugs kyis bag phab nas rgyun ring por gzhung chen mo'i 'phros pa dang bstan srid kyi bka' mchid zhib rgyas gnang /skabs la lar brtse gzigs kyis ku re lta bu'ang mang du phebs te nyin gcig kha sangakhyed tsho la mdo'i paṇ+ḍi ta zhig gis bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi skabs su 298

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /ra'ang gis chos 'brel mnos pa'i bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skyed pabazhin du/ rang gi slob mas kyang rang la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skyed pas na rang nyid sangs rgyas min pas ji ltar byed ces dris byung / khyed tsho a mdo pas slob mas bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bskyed pas mchog par bla ma rang gis rang la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skyed dgos pa de thugs khur chen po 'dug yang gsungs pa'i lan du/ slob ma byin gyis brlabs pa'i ched du rang yang sangs rgyas yin khul byed dgos pas sems khur cung zad yod lags zhus pa dang / yang rang nyid skad cig grong bskyed kyis bde mchog gi skur lam gyis bzhengs te nga bde mchog yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal brtan po la gnas pa de bde mchog e yin zhes dris byung / a mdo pas gsal snang 'don pa sogs kyi ngal pa rang mi dgos par shā mo spang rdol gyi lha skur dmigs nas nga rgyal u tshugs kyis yi dam bsgrubs pa'i bskyed rim 'di las sla ba zhig 'dug ang gsungs pa'i lan du/ snang bas mi 'ching zhen pas 'ching gsungs pa yin pas gnas skabs der lha de dang de yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal gtso bo kyin yod lags zhus pa dang skyabs mgon mchog nas dri ba 'di dag la bka' lan ji ltar gnang ba yin zhus par/ nga la don byed nus stong gi dris lan bre phul gyis 'jal rgyu mi 'dug pas khyed rang yin na lan ji ltar 'debs gsungs pa'i lan du/ nga rang yin na don byed nus stong gi khyab 'grigs 'ga' 'phangs yod zhus pa dang / chos nyan zhig gi thog ma'i maṇ+ḍal skabs dbu mdzad cig gis mi 'da' ba'i gsol 'debs bton pa la/'di khyed tsho a mdo pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag srol red yang gsungs pa'i lan du/ chos 'khor bskor ba la zhabs pad brtan pa gal che bas yin lags zhus pa sogs thugs spro ba'i ched du bzhad slong ba'i nyams 'char du ma 299

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/mchod pa'i tshul du zhus pas shin tu dgyes pa byung snang la/ zhu 'bul rjes ma 'di dgongs gzhi can zhig kyang yin nam snyam/ nyin gcig rje nyid nas bla ma sgom pa ngag dbang rab brtan sogs la paṇa chen mchog gis me tog bzhes med cing sku sha dar yod pas rgya nag tu byon nas ci 'dra yong zhes thugs 'tsher gyi gsung gleng mdzad pa la/ phyi nyin mjal khar phebs dus paṇa chen mchog nas nged rang thor ba mthar pa dang gzugs phung dar yod pa la 'ga' zhigagis rgya nag tu song nas ci 'dra yong zhes thugs 'tsher mdzad kyin yod tshod 'dug ste skyon gang yang med ces gsung bar/ nyid cung zad thugs 'jigs zhum me ba dang dga' ba khyad par can zhig kyang 'khrungs te/ phran bus kyang de bzhin dogs pa byas nas sems 'tsher byed kyin yod mod kyang da chaskyabs mgon rin po che nas skyon med ces 'gyur med rdo rje'i gsung gis zhalabazhes mdzad pas yid tshim pa byung zhes zhus/ paṇa chen rin po che rgya nag nas dag zhing du dgongs pa gtad rgyu nyid kyis mkhyen nas thugs 'tsher mdzad pa dang / de'i tshul paṇa chen mchog gis mkhyen te thugs gso mdzad pani yab sras nang phan tshun du mkhyen pa'i me long gi gsal cha 'gran pa'i rnam thar rmad du byung ba'o/ / rje nyid nas mdo sngags kyi dka' gnad mang po la brdar sha chod tshul smos mi dgos la/ gzigs snang dang rtogs pa 'khrungs tshul rnams dag mi dag gi dogs gcod kyang zhib tu zhus shing /paṇa chen mchog nas kyang rang nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam thar shin tu gsang ba gzhan la ma gsungs pa du ma dang / rje 'di ba'i sku tshe snga phyi mang po'i gnas tshul 'byung 'gyur gye gsang lung mang po sogs cung zad kyang ma sbas par bka' drin lhug par stsal snang bas/ tshul 'di ni mdo sde rgyan las/blon po chen po lta bur pha rol phyin la 'jug bya'i phyir/ / byang chub chen po'i 300

༄༅/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /phyogs mthun brdal la rtag tu spyan byed phyir/ / gsang ba'i gnas ni rnam gsum rtag tu yang dag 'dzin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungasapa ltar thugs yid gcig 'dresakyi slob ma'i thu botshas kyi gsang mdzod mtha' dag la sbyan du gyur pa rgyal po'i nang blon ltabar gyur ba'i rnam thar gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos bla na med pa'o/ /der ma zad nyid kyi 4phyag phul skabs 7paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa nyid nas phyag thal mo spyor pa sogs bkur gzos dpe bral lta bu gnang bas zhabs phyi khengs dregayocan thams cad kyis kyang zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs te gus pas btud/ lan gcig 7paṇa chen mchog nas 'di ba la mthu chen gangs pa shākya 'bum gyi skye ba yin tshul phebs snang ste/ nyid kyi zhal nas kyang / snga mo bod du skabs rje phur bu lcog pas yi dam chos skyong sna tshogs kyi bris thang brgyad tsam gnang byung ba'i khrod na rnying ma'i 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi thang ga zhig 'dug pa de dus rtog dpyod ma zhugs bar bla ma nyid la phyir 'bul bgyis pa phyis su bsam na rten 'brel cung zad 'phyugs pa 'dra/ da res paṇa chen rin po ches gsungs tshul dang chung dus kyi bag chags/ rje phur bu lcog pas thang ga gnang lugs sogs la dpag na rnying lugs kyi gshed skor la yi dam byed pa'i sngags pa rak+ka'i phreng kog mnyis mnyis pa zhig tu byes med pa'i nges pa mi 'dug snyam pa shar zhes gsungs snang / phyag mdzod don grub dbang rgyal bod nas gzugs phung ma bde bar 'ong ba skabs 'dir 'das song par 7paṇa chen mchog la bsngo rten rgya che ba phul te rjes 'dzin skyabs 'jug nan tan zhus/'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che gdan drangs nas yab sras gnyis lhan du dgon lung la phebs te sbyangs chog sogs gnad smin dang / dgon sgrub sde du mar bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas zhus te dge tshogs rlabs po che bsgrubs/301

༄/ /gung ba pa'i nas ga4 'bum/ denas phyir sku 'bum du phebs te rong po zhabs drung ngag dbang nam mkhas zhus ngor dge 'phel sgomapa sems nyid sgom pa 'phyor sang sgom pa/ sku 'bum rang gi rab 'byams pa dpal ldan chos grags sogs dge bshes dka' ramadu ma dang bcasadon gnyer can brgya skor la gcod nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang / stan thog gcig ma'i khrid/ smon lam mtha' yas rgya mtsho'i gcod khrid/ skal ldan 'jug ngogs che chung / phul byung gser phreng / rgyal thang pa bsam gtan 'od zer gyi gcod gzhung yongs rdzogs sogs kyi lung bcas gnang / gcod dbang gi skabs har tshin pa tho yon cigagis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsar bzhengs byon legs shig phul bar rten 'brel bzang zhes thugs mnyes mdzad/ mā thi dgon gyi lha ram pa ngag dbang shes rab sogs phyogs de'i mi drag zhan du mas phyag rdor gtum chung gi rjes gnang sogs 'dod chos 'ga' zhig nyan cing gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan kyang zhus/ phyag rdor be'i zi'i btsun mo nor 'dzin dbang mos zhus te rong phyogs kyi stag gi zhabs drung ngag dbang dge 'dun bstan 'dzin/ dpon slob blo bzang rgya mtsho sog4dge bshes 'ga' zhig dang bca4 par nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang dang sgrub thabs kyi lung / bla ma de dag dang rgyal sprul sku dge 'dun bstan pa'i nyi ma sogs la zab chos 'ga' zhig kyang gnang /denayorje nyid nas paṇa chen mchog la phyag chen khrid kyi gsol ba btab pa bzhin nyid lnga'i ring zhib rgyas bka' drin stsal pa gsan zhing rgyal khab tu phebs rgyu'i lam zhor du dgon lung la gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul bar phyir lam 'byon rgyu'i zhal bzhes mdzad/ 'bul ba dngos gzhi phyir lam dgon lung nas 'bul rtsis yin pas 'di lan rten 'brel mtshon byed tsam gye dbang du byas te nyid dgung lo zhe bzhir phebs pa lcags byi'i gnam lo gsar 302

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /tshes kyi dga' ba dang po'i dus ston dang bsgrigs nas snang ba mtha' yas paṇa chen thams cad gzigs pa chen por zhabs brtan gyi cho ga sogs legs byas rten 'byung gi sgo brgya mngon par phye ba'i thog / 'bul ba'i mtshon byed tsam du dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal/ kha btags nang mdzod/ sku gsung thugs rten/tshem grub kyi bzhugs gdan rgyab yol/ na bza' nyer spyad/ rgya dngul rta rmig ma bco lnga/ gos chen yug dgu/ bu lag dgu/ shel gyi spyad pa sogs dngos gtsang ba'i 'bul ba rgya mi chung tsam bstar te nyid dngos kyis gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab par dgyes pa'i bka' lan stsal/ de dus zhu 'bulagyi tshig zur du kla klo'i rigs gyur thams cad nyid kyi 'dul skal yin pas na dang / lta ba ngan pa'i ming tsam sang mi grags par zhes sogs thon pa la rnam dpyod can rnams kyis phyi lor za lar 'khrugs rgyu'i ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i gsung du go 'dug / a rig rtsang sku skye blo bzang bstan pa rgya mtshos zhus ngor khong dang sems nyid sgom pa blo bzang yon tan rgyar tshang sgom pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan khur lugs pa dka' bcu bkra shis dar rgyas rnams la mkha' spyod ma'i dbang dang bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid gser chos dang bcas dkyus gcig la gnang ste/ zhal nas/ 'di'i gser chos la da snga slob ma gsum las lhag ma myong / da lan bzhi byung gsung nas shin tu bka' dog pa'i thugs 'tsher nyams lta bu gnang / har chin pa srad rgyud mkhan zur blo bzang shes rab sogs gzhi byes kyi don gnyer can du ma la chos bka' thor bu rgyun ldan lta bu gnang / de dus phyogs tha dad kyi mchog dman mtha' dag 7paṇa chen mchog gi mjal khar 'dus nas rang rang gi 'dod chos zhus pa'i skabs yin pas sku 'bum du bzhugs ring la paṇa chen mchog las lam rim dmar khrid sems bskyed cho gas 'dzin pa dang bcas pas mtshon bka' chos 303

༄/ /gung bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/gang gnang ba phal cher gsan cing dogs pa mang du chod pa dang sengs bar du gzhan la'ang chos bka' lhug par stsal pa bcas 'chad nyan spel mas dus 'da' bar mdzad/ skabs der mdo smad kyi ljongs 'di na gnas pa'i che dgu dang mkhas dgu yod do cog lhan cig tu gdan 'dzom pa lta bu yin pas/paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen po nas so sor mdo sngags kyi dka' gnad du ma las brtsams pa'i dri rmed gnang ba la rje 'dis lan gang phul rnams gzhanalas lhag par sa chod che la don dang 'byor bas dgongs par shin tu 'bab pa byung / mkhas pa'i skye bo nang phan tshun chos kyi bgro ba byas pa'i tshe na'ang rje 'dis gang gsungs thams cad tshig re res kyang nges pa ster phul shin tu che ba zhig yod pas blo ldan gzu bor gnas pa mtha' dag gis legs bshad mi zad pa'i gter du mthong ste/ ji skad du mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi mas/gang gi mgrin pa legs bshad kyis/ / gang bde la blang ngor gnas/ / 'dri bde yang blo gros kyi/ / dbang po mchog tu gsal bar khums/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin rje 'di'i drung du rgyun chad med par btud nas gzhung che chung du ma'i dka' gnad/ rang gi nyams myong sogs kyi dri ba zhu rgyu gang yod zhu ba rnams la phral dang phral du go bde la gnad 'dus pa'i gsung lan re res blo bde 'bol gyis btang bas thams cad mchog tu dga' mgu rangs shing ngo mtshar rmad du gyur te/ spyir mdo sngags rig gnas thams cad tha na sngon byung gi lo rgyus tshun chad dang / khyad par sngags phyogs kyi dka' gnad la thu'u bkwan tshang lta bu chags thogs med par the tshom gyi mdud pa gcod mkhan dkon pa 'dug ces bsngags pa brjod pa'i rgyun deng sang bar du sgrogs bzhin pa'o/ / srid kyi lugs la chan zhi go sa che stabs rgya'i dbon chen rnams kyis kyang lugs srol ded nas rje nyid la gus 'dud lhag par byas shing /304

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /7rgyal po'i mdzod nas rtswa chas dang thab shing gi phog nam 'dod du skyel pa sogs mthun rkyen legs par bsgrubs/ zla ba gsum pa'i nang du paṇa chen mchog rgya nag tu chibs bskyod pa'i phebs skyel du 'byon zhor la mar tshang nas dgon lung ma bu dgon gyi ser sprengs gsol ston dang dge 'dun mang gis phyag dbang zhus pa'i mgo 'dren mdzad/ nem pa'i mkhar du bzhugs zhag gnang skabs 7paṇa chen mchog nas gsung 'phros shig la nyid nas dgon sde gsar ba zhig bzung na legs po yong zhes phebs par/ tsā che'i zer ba'i gnas la brtag pa zhus pas shin tu legs pa'i bka' phebs/ dgon sde'i ming zhus par theg chen thar ba gling zhes thogs gsung / de nas srong lang bar du phebs skyel zhus paṇa chen mchog nas snga phyir lha rten lo rgyus can dang byin rten dam rdzas 'gang chen gyes mtshon gsol ras kyang sbam mtho bstsal/seralung dgon pa'i don skor du sum pa mkhan chen dang klu skyabs dpon po gnyis ma 'cham ste mkhan chen gyis lo kha shes kyi ring gnang cha dang mdzad khyab 'jam po sna tshogs kyis 'bad kyang brnyas stabs kyis dgon pa gtor grab byas pa la/ mdzad thabs gzhan bral te paṇa chen mchog la zhus na'ang thugasabrel gyis dngos su bkod khyab gnang ma thub par rje 'di pa la gtad gnyer mdzad pa bzhin/ phyir la mched gtad kyis klu skyabs dpon po'i yā monadu phebs te dpon po la thabs mkhas kyi zhu skyor gnang bas dpon pos kyang 'khon 'dzin dang bral te gtam gleng ngan pa rang zhir song nas dgon pa deng sang bar du bde 'jags su gnas pa 'di byung / tas thung dgon thos bsam dar rgyas gling du gdan drangs pa bzhin bsu ba ser sbrengs dang bcas phebs/ 'du khang du bla ma khri ba grags pa chos 'dzin gyis gtsos dge 'dun tshang mar bla ma'i rnal 'byor dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid zhib rgyas stsal/ spyi 305

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/sger gyis gsol ston 'bul nod gzabs shing tshogs par mang 'gyed gnang /de nas dgon lung du byon te 7gong ma chen po dgung lo bdun cur phebs pa'i dga' ston chen po'i mtshams zhur nang so bstan 'gyur mngags zhor du lcang skya rdo rje 'chang la mtshams zhus dang / sbyin bdag har chin wang sogs la mtshams 'dri bskur ba gnang / tsā tsha'i sa bdag 'brog sde rnams la mi btang nas gnas gzhi nyo'i tshang gi gros byas par phur tsha pad+ma rgyal dang dpa' 'bum sogs che rgan bco lnga skor 'ongs nas sa cha phul bas khong tsho la ston mo dang gnang sbyin gzab rgyas gnang / re zhig thugs dam 'phel zhing thun mtshams su rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi bzlas pa byed tshul spu gri dar 'dogs dang bsnyen sgrub gdon bgegs sel ba'i man ngag bdud dpung 'joms pa'i mtshon cha sogs ljags rtsom 'ga' zhig mdzad/ de nas kun gzigs paṇa chen mchog nas lang gru'u sde bzhir bzhugs pa'i sngon gyi lha rten rnams dang /garma pag shi'i gdung rten sogs rten rnying byin can mtha' dag khyad par du gan gru'i sgrol ma rang byon/ shus gru'i 'jam dbyangs rang byon rnams la mchod pa 'bul rgyu nyid la gtad gnyer mdzad pa ltar sku tsha tha'i ji nor bu lang gru'u la btang na sa mchod pa 'bul du 'jug pa gnang zhing / rje rang nyid gan shus gru'i bod dang yus gur bas sngar nas gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul yod bas stabs gcig par zla ba drug pa'i yar tshes la dgon lung nas phyag btegs/ lam zhor du sems nyid dgon pas gdan drangs par zhabs drung la rta mgrin gsang sgrub dang khro rgyal gtsug tor 'bar ba'i rjes gnangaspri chos su rten 'brel bstod pa'i bshad lung bcas gnang / de nas nags yangs ri dgon so so'i bsnyen bkur dang du bzhes nas gang zhus kyi re ba skong bar mdzad/ rdza dmar maṇ+ḍal du zhag bzhugs gnang skabs mi 306

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /dmar rta dmar zhon pa mang bo'i 'du yong gis sa gzhi yom yom byed pa lta bu dzub pa'i nyams shar zhing rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi bdag skyed rgyas pa rta mchog rol ba'i zhal lung yang 'di res ljags rtsom gnang / yong khrang dgon gyi khri gdan zur sku skye chos rje ching hu sogs kyis rta bsu thab bsu ser sprengs dang bcas dgon par 'byor/ khrir bzhugs dgos kyi gsol ba btab pa bzhin khri 'don gnang ste khyung tsha bla ma slob chung du bskos/ spyi chos su bla ma'i rnal 'byor dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid dang gzhan yang lung rjes gnang sogs sger chos mang po dang mjal ba khrom tshogs la dmigs brtse ma/ rig sa gsum mgon po'i snying po byams pas dam bca' sogs gzungs sngags zab mo rnams dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan mang po rna lam du bsgrags shing ma ṇi'i bzlas lung dang khas len bskor ba dge ba bsngo ba sogs chag med du gnang / spyi sger gyis bsnyen bkur 'bul ba gzabs shing nyid nas mang 'gyed kyang stsal/ de nas gan gru'u'i mā thi dgon dga' ldan dam chos gling gi khri pa 'bring shos dka' bcu bkra shis dpal ldan rgyud pa'i 'khri ba khyung nag zhabs drung ngag dbang tshul khrims/ 'bring shos lha ram pa ngag dbang shes rab 'bras ram pa dkon mchog sogs las sne dka' ram dge tshul slong dang /ra chi'i tā thu mu ngag dbang dpal 'byor gyis gtsos ra 'khyung tsho ba bcu bzhi'i dpon chen bzhi dang dpon chung bcu sogs tsho ba so so'i rgan po rnams dang bcas skya ser gyi rta bsu rim pa du ma dang / lam zhor du tsho ba so sos bsnyen bkur gzabs shing chos kyi dga' ston spel ba bcas rim gyis dgon du 'byor nyin mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa'i dge 'dun brgya phrag du mas ser sbrengs kyis mdun bsus te bkur ste chen pos spyan drangs/ sgol ma rang byon la paṇa chen rin po che nas mchod 'bul gyi thebs stsal ba'i steng du rje 307

༄/ /gung ca bstanapa'isgoname'i gsung 'bum/nyid kyis rgyu tshogs phon chen sbyar te mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam las 'das pa phul cing / phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan yang snying dge ldan ring lugs dri ma med pa dang rje btsun bla ma'i 'phrin las chabs gcig pas 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon thams cad dkar 'jam yug gcig tu khyab pa'i thugs smon gsol 'debs gang drag rgyun ring du mdzad/ skya ser kyi tshogs pa chen por sbyor ba'i chos drug dang 'brel bar yon tan gzhi gyur ma'i khrid gsung bshad 'byam klas pa chos thun shin tu ring po gcig byas te gnang / de'i tshe nyid kyi thugs ngor bshad nyan sogs kyi snang ba 'gags te mdun gyi nam mkhar thub pa'i dbang po g.yas su spyan ras gzigs g.yon du shā ri'i bu bcas bzhugs 'dug pas/ spyan ras gzigs dang shā ri'i bu gnyis kyis stong nyid zab mo bzhi ldan la dris lan mang du mdzad pa'i mthar ston pas legs so mdzad pa zhig gi nyams snang byung ste de'i ngang la thugs 'byams nas gsung bshad sogs ci mdzad pa yin mi mkhyen pa zhig byung yang / chos nyan pa rnams kyis bltas tshe gsung bshad sogs dus rgyun dang 'dra bar zab cing rgya che la nor ba cung zad kyang med pas der thugs gtad yod pa 'dra ba zhig byung 'dug pa ni gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i khyad chos tshur mthong gi blos dpog parami nus pa zhig ste/ mngon pa mdzod las/ ston min sprul pa po dang bcas/ / chos gsum rig pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa chen po dag gis kyang de 'dra mi nus par gsungs so/ / gzhan yang zhu mkhan so so'i ngor dbang dang rjes gnang lung khrid sogs chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor/ tshigs snga phyi'i sdom pa'i bka' drin zhu mkhan byung ba rnams kyang bslab pa'i gzhi so so la bkod de thar pa'i grong khyer mchog tu gzhol bar mdzad/ ri dgon thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu gsol ba btab pa bzhin dgon pa'i khrir bzhugs 308

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /te khyung nag zhabs drung ngag dbang tshul khrims sku tshab tu bsko bzhag mdzad/spyi nas gsol ston dang 'bul ba sbam mtho ba btegs tshogs par mang 'gyed 'bul ba'ang gzab rgyas gnang / tsho ba thams cad du gdan 'dren zhus kyang lam zhor ma gtogs gzhan la phebs long ma byung bar che phra tshang mas dgon du mjal kha zhus pa la dkyus dang zur bka'i chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad/ rgya dgon du'ang bla grwa rnams kyis phyag dbang chos 'brel dang gsol ja 'bul nod zhus/ gan shus gru'u'i mnga' 'og gi bod dang hor yus gur ba rnams sngar lang gru'u'i mnga' 'og gi bod rnams rgya'i khral log dang snyad gtser sogs kyis ji ltar mnar ba de bzhin mnar yod tshul rje nyid la zhus nas skyabs btsal bas/ gan gru'u mkhar du the'i du'u zhin tā zhin la mjal phrad thog rgyu mtshan zhib mol gnang rtsis byas par dpon chung mang po mtshams zhur 'ongs pa dang thug nas gsung stabs gtan nas ma 'grigs par 'gor ba la thugs cung zad 'tshub nas da 'gro dgos pa 'dra dgongs te chas pas srung mas rgyus bskul ba lta bus tā zhen gyes hu thog thu skyed tshal du skyo sangs la mi 'byon nam zer bar/ nyid nas cis kyang 'gro gsung tā zhen dang mnyam por skyed tshal du phebs dpon chung rnams kyang zhabs phyir 'ongs na 'ang mtsho zhig yod pa'i 'gram du glebs pa dang khong rnams der bsdad/nyid dang zhen rnam gnyis shing grur zhugs te mtsho nang du ri 'bur zhig yod pa la skor ba brgyab nas phyir 'khor gyi ring la 'gol zhing bar skabs der nyid nas gsung rgyu'i rim pa gcig kyang ma lus par zhib mol gnang tshar ba byung /de ma thag tā zhen gyis rtsar gcod drag pos dpon chung dang dmag mi rnams ci drag gang drag la gtad cing mi ring bar lan co'u mkhar du don skor zhig la 'gro dus tsong do'u dang gros mthun gyis khral 'jal rgyu sogs lugs srol ltar 309

sa / /gung bang bstan ba'izlanas gsung 'bum/sa mtshams bcad nas phyin chad nges 'jog med pa'i khral log sogs kyis snyad gtser gtan nas byas mi chog pa'i yi ge btsan brjid can tsong do'u'i tham ga brgyab pa zhig gan lang shus gsum gyi sa sgo so so'i dpon po dang dmag mi rnams la dril bsgrags shing / de bzhin yig gdan la'ang bzhag pas de nas bzung ste gan lang shus gsum gyi bod hor rnams rang dbang 'dus pa'i bde skyid la ci dgar longs spyad du yod pa 'di byung ba ni/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ni/ / 'gro don thugs la dgongs 'grub shog / ces pa ltar ring nas sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa rnams dbugs dbyung ba'i phyir smon lam yang yang mdzad pa'i lag rjes lhun gyis grub par snang / de nas hor yus gur gyi gdan 'dren pa 'byor te phebs skabs bzang rin zhabs drung sogs dgon pa so so'i zhabs drung sku skye bla ma dka' ram dang tsho ba so so'i tā thu mu dang cin thu mu phu thu mu sogs dpon po che chung skya ser drag zhan rnams kyis rang rang gi sa tshigs su rta bsu thab bsu mu mthud cing / tsho ba so so'i mi drag dang 'byor ldan gyi khyim du spyi sger gyis bsnyen bkur 'bul nod gzabs nas mjal kha zhus par rang rang gi 'dod chos sogs gang zhus thams cad mos pa bzhin dang bka' chos dkyus ma'i skor rnams ma chad par mdzad kyin thog mar rta mgo dgon du 'byor/ser skya'i tshogs par rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rjes gnang sogs chos bka' 'ga' zhig dang mang 'gyed gnang / de nas lung ser ri khrod du spyan drangs te bsnyen bkur zhus par rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang dang mang 'gyed stsal/ mdung nag 'jam dbyangs mgon gyi bla ma khri ba bshes gnyen dpon slob dang so nyid zhabs drung ngag dbang don grub/ chos 'khor gling gi mā tsha chos rje dang las sne 'ga' zhig sogs dgon gnyis kyi chibs bsu pa sum cu 310

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /skor 'byor/ sman chu dgon du spyan drangs par sgol ma dkar ljang sogs lha 'ga' zhig gi rjes gnang dang lung khrid du ma gnang / bzang rin zhabs drung gtsos pa'i ser skya thams cad kyis gsol ston dang 'bul nod sbam mtho ba btegs phar yang mang 'gyed stsal/ 'dir 'jam dbyangs dgon gye 'gu bla ma rgan pa dang 'gug 'bul dpon po gtsos pa'i ser skya brgya skor tsam 'byor nas thab bsu zhus/ bor na dgon du phebs lam nas bzang rin zhabs drung la mdang nged kyi rmi lam du mā thi phyogs kyi brag khung zhig nas chu srin zhig thon 'ongs te khyed tsho'i mi gcig zos song ba rmis gsung bas/zhabs drung gis rang thog tu blangs nas sems ma bde ba la de ma thag pa yod zla ba'i pha rgad pos mjal kha zhus par chu srin gyis zos pa'i mi de 'di yin pa 'dug gsungs pa bzhin mi ring bar rgad po lnga pa'i lam du song 'dug /per na dgon du phyag rdor gtum khyung gi rjes gnang sogs chos bka' kha yar dang mang 'gyed stsal/ spyi sger gyes zhabs tog 'bul nod gzabs/ rim gyis has zi ri khrod pa yon mchod kyi 'dod pa'i re ba skong bar mjed de 'jam dbyangs dgon gyi mchod gzhis sne blo bzang lha khang du bcarge mal thog dpon po ched hu gnyis sogs drag zhan spyi sger gyis 'byor 'khos dang bstun pa'i bsnyen bkur zhus te gsol ba btab par gang la gang 'dod kyi chos bka' mang du gnang / mā yang gan du chos 'khor gling gi yer khu bla ma gcurabla ma go kyā zhabs drung 'phur tsha dpon po sogs rta pa lnga bcu 'byor nas ja thab zhus/ ngam kha ba'i dpon po sogs sbyin bdag rnams kyi don mdzad/ chos lung mi dar bkra shis lha khang du bcag mal thog mdung nag dpon pos gtsos drag zhan tshang mar spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang dang smyung gnas cho ga'i lung sogs bka' chos dkyus ma dang 311

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'a4/bcas gnang gsol ston 'bul nod gzabs/ bshes gnyen lha khung du bcag mal thog dmigs bsal gyi zhabs brtan zhig bsgrubs shing dpon po gsar rnying sogs sbyin bdag rnams kyi 'dod pa skong bar mdzad/ sa skya paṇa chen kyi zhabs rjes yod pa'i lha khang gi gsham na sar lngags dpon slob rin po che gtsos pa'i chos 'khor gling gi dge 'dun mang gis bsus te mchod rdzas sna tshogs tshar du dngar zhing rol mo 'bud dkrol dang bcas phebs lam zhor du zhabs rjes mjal nas yer khu lha khang du babs/ chos 'khor gling pas gsol ston dkar spro zhus phyi nyin dgon par 'phyor te zhag kha shis bzhugs/ tshogs par rnam rgyal lha dgu'i rjes gnang dang / ri khrod pa dka' bcu tshul khrims dar rgyas dang 'jam dbyangs grags pa gnyis kyis zhus ngor bla ma dka' ram nyung 'dus la mkha' spyod ma'i dbang dang ri khrod pa gnyis la rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi khrid/ gzhan yang zhu mkhan so so'i ngor thun drus rnal 'byor dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor dben sa lugs dang srad rgyud lugs dga' ldan lha brgya ma rnams kyi khrid bla ma lnga bcu pa dang nang gi khong skran 'don ba'i skyug sman/ sdom gsum phyir bcos drag po gsum dril gyi bsnyen sgrub sbyin sreg dang bcas pa'i lung sogs dam pa'i chos kyi char phab/spyi sger gyes gsol ston dang 'bul ba rnams grangs brgya phrag du ma btegs phar yang dge 'dun rnams la mang 'gyed gya nom pa gnang / de nas 'jam dbyangs dgon du phebs lam la 'phur tsha dpon po'i lha khang du bzhugs drag zhan tshang mar spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang sogs chos bka' ci rigs gnang / rim gyes tsho ba drug g.yas ru gnyis kyi dpon po dang dgon pa'i las sne sogs kyi rta bsu mchod rdzas du ma thogs pa'i dge 'dun gyi ser sbrengs dang bcas dgon par babs/ lha babs dus chen 312

༄7/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /dang bstun nas 'jam dbyangs rang byon la paṇa chen mchog nas 'bul ba gnang ba dang nyid rang gi mchod pa rnams phul te spyan 'dren khrus gsol yan lag bdun pa maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa gsol 'debs smon lam du ma dang bcas gsungs te bstan pa spyi sger gyi don du thugs smon rgya gang che'i mtshams sbyor shugs drag po mdzad/ spyi tshogs dang don gnyer can so sos zhus ngor mgon po bar chad kun sel dang sgrol dkar drag po gsum dril rta mgrin sogs lha du ma'i rjes gnang dang / nyid kyis mdzad pa'i mgon po'i gtor chenagyi skor dang btson 'don sgrol ma dang maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga sogs chos tshan mang po'i lung / gcod stan thog gcig ma'i khrid spin rgyas sogs gsung gi bdud rtsi'i dga' ston rgya cher spros/ gcod khrid kyi skabs chos thun ha cang ring song bar bshes gnyen dpon slob sogs kyis zhus nas mjug bsdu bar mdzad dgos pa byung la/ de'i tshe yang gan gru'u na4bka' chos gnang skabs bzhin nam mkha' nas zab mo stong nyid kyi sgra lhang lhang sgrogs pa'i snang ba bka' chos rdzogs kyi bar byung ba de la thugs 'phyan pas zhal nas gang gsung nyid la mi 'char yang gsung bshad ji bzhin par thon pa byung / rjes sor sum pa mkhan rin po cher nged la de 'dra zhig byung bas de srog rlung gi stobs dang bdud las 'dra min nam zhes zhus par/ khyed la de 'dra zhig gi re ba yod pa la rta brgya phrag gcig byin pa las gtam 'di la dga'/ da stong nyid kyi lta ba la 'bad na ring po mi lon par don chen po 'grub par 'dug skyabs su mchi gsung nas tshad med pa'i mnyes tshor dang gus nyams mdzad pa ni chos kyi gnad mkhyen pa'i khyad chos su snang la/ de'i ngang nas gsung bshad stsal pa ya mtshan che tshul gong smos ltar gyi thog tu nam mkha' stong sangs las zab mo'i gdams ngag gsan pa ni dag pa'i sa la 313

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/gnas pa phan chad kyi khyad chos su gsungs te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ lung dang rtogs dang dbang 'byor las/ / kha dang gzugs ni thams cad dang / / nam mkha' las kyang byung ba yin/ / zhes phyi ma dbang 'byor pa'i skabs la gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / der ma zad gan gru'u shus gru'u'i rten gtso 'di gnyis la mchod 'bul tshogs bsags rgya chen po gnang ba'i mtshams nas 'di 'dra re byung ba ni de nyid rtogs pa'i bogs 'byin khyad par can du song bar mngon la/ 7paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas kyang dgos pa bla na med pa 'di nyid mngon sum du gzigs te de dag tu mchod pa 'bul rgyu rje nyid la ched du gtang par gdon mi za'o/ / yon mchod tshang mas dgon pa'i khrir bzhugs dgos kyi gsol ba btab par dgon pa thams cad kyi bla ma brje mtshams la paṇa chen rin po ches nged rang mchod 'bul du gtong ba gnang ba dgongs gzhi yod pa 'dra gsung zhal gyis bzhes te khri 'don mdzad sku tshab tu ra ljags dpon slob dge bskos gsar ba dang bcas bsko bzhag gnang /spyi nas brtan bzhugs kye rten 'brel bsgrigs thog rnam grangs stong du nye ba'i 'bul chen btegs dge 'dun la mang 'gyed kyi bsnyen bkur kyang gzabs/shus gru'u'i mkhar gyi tsong ye dang jin pā tsong sogs 'jal du 'ongs par gnang sbyin gyis ma gu bar mdzad/ phebs dus dge 'dun rnams kyis yang yang chibs kha bsgyur ba'i rten 'byung gi sgo 'phar yangs por phyes shing /gam pa mdo nas bshes gnyen dpon po ngag dbang rab brtan gyis dung dkar che legs shig phul te rten 'brel gang legs bsgrigs bshes gnyen dpon po rnying bas dgon par gzhi 'dzin thebs su gzhi sa khang ba btsugs sdong sum brgya dang bcas phul dpon po nyid la nang so'i cho lo gnang lho ba dpon pos kyang zhabs tog gang legs zhus/ rim gyis lung skya ri khrod pa 314

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /yon mchod sogs so so'i 'dod pa rim par bskang ste pad sdong du babs/yusagur gyi mi drag dang 'byor ldan rnams kyis khyim du gdan drangs nas spyi sger gyis bsnyen bkur 'bul nod zhus par rang rang gi 'dod chos dang bka' chos dkyus ma rnams kyis tshim par mdzad/ yus gur gyi dkor bdag de gdug pa shin tu che bas thams cad kyis zon byed pa zhig yin 'dug kyang rje 'di la phyag dang bsnyen bkur sogs gus pa'i rnam pa kho na lhur byed pa zhig mnal lam du byung snang / mdung nag tho'u le lung pa'i sbyin bdag rnamasakyis ra lngags dpon slob kyi skar thog tu gdan drangs te nyin kha shas bzhugs/ dpon slob rin po ches gtsos pa'i dgon pa gnyis kyi zhabs drung sku skye dka' ram sogs ser skya'i tshogs pa chen po la bla ma mchod pa bde stong dbyer med ma'i khrid zhib bshad dang gdugs dkar zhal phyag yongs rdzogs spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal sgrol dkar drag po gsum dril seng gdong ma rnams kyi rjes gnang / rgyan 'jug dang lam rim bsdus don dzam dkar gyi nor sgrub drag po gsum dril gyi bsnyen sgrub sbyin sreg dang bcas pa sogs chos tshan du ma'i lung sogs 'dod chos gang zhus kyi re 'bras yongs su smin par mdzad/ phan tshun so so nas mjal ba che phra bgrang gis mi lang ba lta bu 'dus pa thams cad kyang phyag dbang dang dkyus ma'i sgom lung sogs byin rlabs mi zad pa'i dga' ston gyis yongs su smin par byas/ dpon po rnams kyis gtsos sbyin bdag drag zhan thun mong nas gser dngul rta mdzo rnam grangs stong phrag brgal ba'i 'bul chen btegs/ bcu pa'i nyer gsum la dus gtor dang nyer lnga la dus mchod kyi zhal 'don sgar nas mdzad/chos nyan pa byings la 'jam lugs tshe dbang bcu gcig zhal dang rnam sras ser chen gye rjes gnang dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid sogs bka' chos thor bu 315

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/mang tsam gnang zhing / yer khu rab 'byams pa 'jam dbyangs bstan dar a yi tshe ring sogs sger du 'pho lung zhu mi 'ga' zhig byung ba'i re ba bskangs/yus gur brgyad po'i gdan 'dren pa 'byor te der phebs par bsu skyel yon 'bul sogs bkur ste rim gro yang dag bgyis par phyag dbang chos 'brel sogs kyi sgo nas re ba bskangs/ der phebs skabs lam nas rje nyid dpon g.yog thang zhig tu 'byon gyen yod pa'i tshe pha tshad kyi ri zhig la gzigs nas thugs 'tshab pa'i rnam pa lta bus 'di'i rgyab na rang re'i grwa pa sbyin pa bla rgan sogs slebs yod pa 'dra zer ba zhig zhal nas thon song ba dang / ma 'gyangs par dgon lung nas 'ongs pa'i sbyin pa nang so ngo g.yog rnams de nas tshur thon byung bas der 'khod mtha' dag ya mtshan du gyur/ grwa ba de dag gis am bhan nas 7paṇa chen rin po che dag zhing du gshegs pa'i rgyu mtshan sku zhabs la mgyogs par mkhyen du 'jug dgos tshul byung ba bzhin zhu par 'ongs pa yin zhes rim gyis snyan du phul bas thugs ngal chen po mdzad/spyir paṇa chen mchog nas mdzad pa de ltar ston rgyu de rje nyid kyis thog ma nas mkhyen yod pa gong du bshad pa bzhin snyan zhus 'bul lugs kyis kyang shes la/'ja' 'khyil du'ang paṇa chen rin po che sku 'bum du bzhugs skabs nub cig nga rang skyid shod kye lcang thang sgang du 'dug pa la bkra shis lhun po'i nang zan lta bu 'bog zhwa chen po can mang po ci drag gang drag lta bus phar rgyug tshur rgyug byed kyin 'dug pa la nged kyis ci byung dris pas/ paṇa chen rin po che rgya nag tu phebs rgyu'i lam bar du phyogs gzhan zhig tu phebs song ba gar phebs mi shes pas rtsar gcod pa yin zer/ nged kyi sems la 'bras spungs su spas pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs yod pa 'dra snyam pa rmis/ rgya nag tu phebs grub nas zla ba lnga pa'i nang du tshe ring mched lnga'i bskang ba nyin kha shas btang skabs rmi 316

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /lam du paṇa chen rin po che pe'i cing nas phyir phebs kyin 'dug pa nged rang phebs bsur phyin pa lta bu la 'do li chung ngu zhig mi mang pos btegs nas byung / dbu gdugs mi 'dug pas nga rang gi gdugs shig yod pa 'bul bsams gdugs rtsibs 'degs par brtsams pas yu ba chag song ba rmis zhes gsungs pa sogs kyis kyang shes par snang ngo / / mnal lam la paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa 'bras spungs su sbas pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs yod par gzigs pa ni 'bras spungs thun mong ma yin par rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rtsa ba'i gdan sa yin la/ paṇa chen mchog gi yang srid kyang rgyal dbang rin po che'i sku'i nye rtsar 'khrungs par 'gyur ba 'di nyid kyi ltas su mngon no/ / de nas phan tshun du gdan 'dren zhu mkhan shin tu mang yang ma phebs par mgyogs shas kyis byon/ zi ling du7gong ma chen por paṇa chen mchog gi dgongs rdzogs kyi zhal 'don gsung rgyu'i gnas tshul dang thugs gso'i zhu 'bul am bhan brgyud nas phul te gdan sar babs/ de ma thag nas bcad rgya gnang ste dgun mjug gi ring paṇa chen thams cad gzigs pa chen po de nyid kyi thugs zag pa med pa'i dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs shing slad kyang bstan 'gro yongs kyi phan 'de'i dpung gnyen gcig pur mchog sprul 'khrul med myur du 'byon pa'i gsol 'debs dang thugs smon rgya gang che'i sgo nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad du byas te dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs la gcig tu brtson par mdzad/dgung lo zhe lnga pa lcags mo glang gi lo'i cho 'phrul smon lam skabs sbyin bdag gi 'dun pa bzhin tshes brgyad dang bcu bzhi bco lnga rnams la gsung chos smon lam gnang zhing 'cham la gzigs par mdzad/ dgon pa gsar rgyag gi gegs sel du dgon sgrub sde mang po la gdugs sher seng gdong ma dang sgol ma 317
