༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/'grogang che dang bla brang du'ang sgrub pa khag 'gas mtshon rim gro stobs chen rgyun ldan sgrub rgyu'i bkod pa gnang / chos bzang ri khrod du phebs te 'bri gung zhabs drung dang 'dul ba'i rong bo zhabs drung rnam gnyis kyis gsol ba btab pa bzhin sgrub mchod kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang / de'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid nyin bdun gyi ring la zhib bshad/de'i be'u bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang /zhabs drung rnam gnyis la mkha' spyod 'grub pa'i gser chos/ khong gnyis sogs nyung 'dus la mgon chen bcu gsum gyi rjes gnang mgon po'i be'u bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung dben sa bka' 'bum nang ltar gyi mgon po gsang sgrub bka' rgya can snying zhugs sogs kyi khrid/ gtsug tor 'bar ba'i rjes gnang nyid kyi bka' rtsom gnang zin thams cad kyi lung / ri khrod pa spyi mang dang bcas pa la thog ma'i blo spyong gi bshad lung bla mchod kyi khrid dang gcod khrid rgyas pa sogs chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor te snod ldan gdul bya'i yid kyi gru gzings lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag yid bzhin gyi nor bus yongs su 'gengs par mdzad/ zla ba gnyis pa'i mjug tu tsā che'i la phebs te dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi gnas der nyid dngos kyis sa bcos dang lto 'phye'i brtag pa sogs mdzad nas bum gter bcug / a na mtsho bas nyid la dkar spro'i ston ma dang khong tsho mi brgya sgor la nyid nas ja gral sogs kyi rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa bsgrigs/ chos rje blo bzang bstan 'dzin sogs sa bdag rnams dang bcas pas g.yas phyogs la btse g.yon phyogs bkra shis lung pa gnyis la sa mtshams kye rtags brgyab/ yan ma bkra 'bo'u dang a po brtan sogs der gtogs rnams kyis mdun ri dang g.yas kyi mchod rten lung pa dang g.yon gyi lha lung rnams su skyes pa'i nags tshal gang 318

༄7/ /rje bam blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /yod nyid la gtsang 'bul zhus/ chos rje blo bstan dang nang so sbyin pa sogs bsdad nas dgon pa'i gnas gzhi bting / nyid bkra shis chos gling du byon te 'chad nyan mdzad skabs rgyud pa sgar ba'i gra rgan rnams mjal khar 'ongs nasakhong tsho'i mdun ri nas shing sum brgya lhag tsam zhal 'debs su phul te sgar gyi grwa pa rnams kyang gnas gzhi gsar par spo rgyu byung na legs tshul zhus/de nas tshur phebs te yid dga' chos 'phel du sngar sprul ba'i sgo skyel du khyer 'ongs pa'i mkha' spyod ma'i gsang thang bshams nas zla ba phyed dang gnyis kyi ring bcad rgya'i ngos thugs dam 'phel zhing tshogs 'khor rgyas pa'ang lan mang du mdzad/ de skabs nang mchod kyi bdud rtsi khol ba bzhin du rlangs pa sngo phyi ru ru thon pa byung bas bcad rgya grol ma thag nang mchod la bdud rtsi ril bu bsgril ba gnang / gsang thang gi zhal khebs rang gi phyag bstar gyes btsems nas da lan a mas bzang gsung thugs nyams shin tu spro ba'i rnam pa mdzad/ de'i rgyu mtshan zhib cha gsungs pa mi snang yang mdzad tshul la dpag na rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i lam gyi rtogs pa khyad par du gyur pa'i ltas ya mtshan pa du ma zhig byung ba'i tshod du 'dug ces rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams gleng / thun mtshams su mkha' spyod ma'i spyi don chen mo gsang chen sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde mig kyang ljags rtsom gyi dbu btsugs gros 'debs snying gi thig le'ang 'di res ljags rtsom mdzad/ der ma zad 'ja' klong 'khyil bar/yid dga' 'chos 'phel du mtshams kyi bcad rgya yun ring tsam byas skabs dge sbyor gnad smin byung zhing nub gcig rmi lam du lcang skya rin po che'i sku drung du nged kyang 'dug pa la lcang skya rin po ches nga rang la sum pa mkhan rin po ches dgongs tshom 'dug pa ma legs tshul mang po zhig gsung gin 'dug pa la/ lcang skya rin po che'i steng gi nam mkha' na thub pa'i dbang po thugs gar 319

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'i sgronama'igasung 'bum/spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa zhig bzhugs 'dug pa nga rang gis lcang skya rin po cher khyed kyi sku'i steng phyogs na thub dbang thugs gar spyan ras gzigs dang bcas 'dug tshul zhus par/ dbu g.yas su kyog nas gzigs tsam zhig mdzad de degaci byed rang re sngar gyi gtam 'phro gleng ba yin gsung nas yang sngar gyi gsung 'phros de ga rang bldab nas gsungs pa zhig rmis/mnal sad nas rmi lam de la dpyad pas bla ma dang dam tshig nyams na shākya thub pa dang spyan ras gzigs dngos su byon kyang byin rlabs mi 'jug gsung rgyu red snyam pa byung / sum pa mkhan rin po ches thugs dgongs phyogs cung zadasad pa la sngar nas 'gyod pa yod pa'i steng du rmi lam gyi brda' 'dis 'gyod pa shugs drag tu song / dgongs tshom sel thabs ci drag na snyam pa nyin bzhin byung slar skabs shig nged rang mkhan rin po che'i bzhugs gnas su ched gtad kyis phyin nas shad sbyang kha zhe med pa zhus shing 'gyod tshang phul bas dgongs tshom bsal te spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang zhig kyang thugs rjes gzigs byung bas rdo rje'i dmyal ba'i 'gram kha nas phyir log byung snyam du dga' spro tshad las 'das pa byung / 'dun mnyes la khad pa la bcos rgyag mkhan lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa yin 'dug pas bka' drin 'dis cig pu'ang 'khor thabs ma mchis zhes gsungs pa'ang 'di skabs yin 'dug cing / rje 'di nyid bla ma bsten tshul mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa ji lta ba bzhin thugs nyams su bstar ba las deng sang gi chen po'i lugs srol gtan nas mi mdzad pas/ slar de'i rgyu mtshan lcang skya thams cad mkhyen par zhu shog phul ba'i phyir phebs kye lan du'ang / sngar bsags spyong zhing phyi ma sdom byed pa'i/ / mkhas pa rnams kyi sdig pa lce rung yang / / las dang 'bras bur yid ches med pa'am/ / khyad du gsod pa'i mkhas rlom la ni 320

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /lce/ / zer pa yin mod/ sdig ltung la sdig ltung du shes pa'ang bla ma dkon mchogagi byin rlabs yin bla ma dkon mchog gi skyabs 'og tu tshud pa'ang de 'dra la zer/ nyid rang gi ngos nas zhe gtsang phyin mkhan pos thub chod byas pa tsam gyes nyid sdig can du ga la 'gyur zhes sogs bla na med pa'i gdams ngag yid gso'i sman yod dam par 'gyur ba sogs thugs gso'i bdud rtsir gyur pa'i zhal ta bcas bka' drin gnang 'dug / de'ang sum pa mkhan rin po che dang rje nyid rnam gnyis thugs nang shin tu dag pa zhig byung na chos sde chen po dgon lung 'di nyid chos srid mtha' dag gi cha nas phun sum tshogs pas bstan pa'i gsos sman chen por 'gyur ba de me tog mda' can gyi snying la zug rngur gyur nas slob ma dang sbyin bdag sogs kyi rnam par 'phrul ba ci rigs bas yang yang bar du dbyen bcug pa yin snang la/ de'ang spyir rnam pa gnyis ka phan tshun bla slob tu gyur cing khyad par nyid nas zab chos mang du gsan pa'i 'brel ba thugs la bcangs te snga phyir 'gyur ldog gis bsnyen dka' bar byung yang dgongs tshom yang yang bsal nas thugs dang bstun thabs kho na gnang / mnal lam gyi byung tshul 'di'ang gzhan zhig yin na mi sgogs pa'am don gzhan du 'grel pa las 'os ma mchis mod kyang / rje nyid nigasang bor smra ba la goms pa dang gzhan la brtse ba'i lhag bsam kho na'i dbang du gyur pa'i stobs kyis don ngo bo la thugs 'gal zhugs pa med na'ang 'phral snang cung zad stabs mi bde ba re byung ba de'ang bden kha thams cad bla ma la phul te/ nyes pa mtha' dag rang steng du blangs nas dam tshig gi srung mtshams 'di la shin tu bag zon bya dgos zhes go bar bya ba'i phyir du gsungs pa yin snang / rnam pa gcig tu ni sngon paṇa chen ye shes rtse mos thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshor mi mnyes pa'i rnam pa kho na mdzad kyang de nyid 321

༄/ /gung ca bstanaba'ithonas gsung 'bum/kye 'phrin las rgyas pa'i grogs kho nar song ste phyis yab sras gnyis thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pas snga ma'i snang tshul de nyid dgos dbang gis yin par gsungs pa lta bu zhig yin kyang srid do/ / gang ltar yang skyes bu dam pa gnyis re cung zad thugs ma mthun pa'i tshe/ gcig shos dam pā yin na gcig shos dam pa ma yin par 'gro dgos pa lta bu'i rnam gcad yongs gcod kyi tshul du blta ba ni blo gros chung ba'i skyon yin te/ dam pa rnams don gyi dgongs pa gcig pa bzhin snang tshod la'ang dgongs pa gcig kho nar gnas na gcig la mi dad pa de thams cad la mi dad par 'gro bas de nyid 'dren pa'i thabs med la/ snang tshul dgongs pa mi mthun pa dang grub mtha' mi mthun pa lta bur yod na khams dang mos pa mi 'dra ba'i gdul bya so so'i don du 'gyur ba'i phyir gzhan don gyi dgongs pa'i mtha' dpog par mi nus pas bdag legs su 'dod pa rnams 'di 'dra gzhan dang gzhan gyi tshul la'ang ri bong cal gyi rjes su ma rgyug par dag snang nor bu'i 'od kyis kun tu khyab par byas na legs so/ / da ni dkyus la 'jug par bya ste sgrub sde byang chub gling gi 'du khang rje nyid nas 'bub zebs dang bkod pa gnang ste phyi nang gi shing rtsi khyams kyi ldeb ris dang bcas gsar bskrun mdzad cing dge 'dun la grub ston gyi bsnyen bkur zhus/ sbyin bdag wang rat+na sirnyi'i mi sna ngo g.yog 'byor te wang nas bskur pa gnang ba'i lha rten na bza' gos dngul sogs 'bul ba rgya chen po brtan bzhugs lugs su phul/ rdo ba zhabs drung bang 'dul 'dzin dar rgyam pa rnam gnyis dgon lung gi khrir bzhugs ring dgon pa'i chos srid kyi don mtha' dag rje nyid la blo phugs gtad de ljags bkod gang gnang bzhin bsgrubs pas chos khrims dam zhing 'chad nyan shin tu 'phel ba dang gong smos bzhin rje nyid nas gtso bor thugs khur mdzad de/322

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /cho 'phrul smon lam gtong mkhan sogs kyang sbyin bdag gang bzang rim par byung bas chos srid gnyis ga'i cha nas gzhan la 'gram chu ldang ba mi dgos pa zhig byung ste de dag gi rtsa ba'ang rje nyid kyi bka' drin las byung bar snang /'di res 'dul 'dzin dar rgyam pas khri'i dgongs pa zhus te rang dgon du phebs rgyu'i thon phyag zhus par spyi sger nas gsol ston legs 'bul dang chibs skyel sogs bkur gzes shin tu che bar byas/ dgon pa gsar pa'i lha khang dang gzim khang shar nub dang mdun gyi khang ba ra skor dang bcas bsgrubs yod pa la ston tshes grangs bzang po'i nyin der phebs te bkra shis chos gling dang rgyud pa sgar sogs phyogs de'i dgon pa drug gi las sne dang /mchod gzhis sga phur sogs tsho ba dgu'i mgo pa sogs khyim grangs kyi mi tshang ma bsdus nas grub ston rgyas par mdzad/ a na mtsho ba spyi dang khyad par sa bdag ngo ma la bab bstun gyis dngul dkar dang rta bzang gos chen bcas kyi gsol ras rgya chen po stsal/ 7paṇa chen rin po che nas dgon pa'i ming la thar pa gling zhes btags yod pa'i gnas tshul thams cad la dril bsgrags/dgun 'khrungs skar gyi dga' ston nyin rgyud pa sgar gyi khri ba sum pa chos rje gtsos pa'i grwa rgan rnam 'ongs nas rgyud pa sgar gyi grwa pa rnams lo rjes ma'i nang thar pa gling du spo rgyur thag bcad tshul zhus/ snga ma rgya nag tu bzhugs skabs lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gi thugs rmis su byung tshul dang rje gong ma ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dus na'ang byung tshul de nyid kyi mthar brda' tshig ma las/ pad+ma dbang gis byin gyis rlabs/ / dbang 'od ngur gsal dga' bdes tshim/ / zhes sogs ltar rta mgrin gsang sgrub 'di rje nyid kyi sku tshe'i phreng bar 'brel ba'i yi dam yin pa dang rgyal gdon dang dam sri bdo ba'i dus snyigs 'dir gnyen po'i lha mchog tu gyur pa yin pas na de'i be'u bum zhig 323

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/bsgrig bzhed yod pa bzhin lo 'di nas mgo brtsams te dam pa gong mas mdzad pa'i de'i chos skor rnams phyogs gcig tu dpar la bkod cing /nyid rang gis kyang 'di'i chos tshan 'ga' zhig sngar nas gnang yod pa'i steng duyo 'dir de'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel bar dal 'byor la snying po len tshul/ de'i sgo nas rab gnas bya tshul zhi rgyas dbang gsum gye sbyin sreg sri mnan byed tshul/ gzhan yang dam can gyi gtor chog rgyas pa dang bskul tshig phyir zlog 'khor lo 'bar ba'i gdams pa bde chen chos gling gi bca' yig sogs gsung rtsom mang du spel bar mdzad/de'i tshe mnal lam du 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang phyug yin zer ba'i bla ma zhal ras dmar srug can zhig gis gshed dmar gyi dbang bskur ba gsan pa dang / yang tshar chen yin zer ba zhig gis rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang gi yig cha ji lta ba bzhin cha tshang ba sngon mjug gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba yan chad go rim ma 'khrugs par gnang ba'i thugs rmis shig kyang byung / yang de'i tshe lan gcig mnal lam du lho brag grub chen las kyi rdo rje yin zer ba'i bla ma zhig gi mdun du chos po ti mang po bsgrigs 'dug pa la khyod kyi rta mgrin gyi chos tshan du 'di'i nang nas kha bskang ste bsgrigs na gzhan la phan thogs che ba zhig g.yong gsung chos 'di gang yin zhus pas gsang ma'i chos skor yin gsungs pa zhig byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis de'i man ngag 'ga' zhig kyang tshur blangs nas 'di la spyor bar mdzad pa yin tshul nyid kyi zhal nas 'ga' zhig la gsung snang / 'di lo nas brtsams te rim bzhin rta mgrin gyi chos skor yig rnying pod gcig dang gsar rtsom pod gnyis cha tshang bar bsgrigs te gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ la la gsang sngags sgrub don gnyer/ 'di na dkyil 'khor 'jug par byed/ / bsod 324

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /nam4'dod pas de las gzhan/ / zhes pa lta bu'i gdul bya phal pa nad rims gdon bgegs sad ser thon pa sogs kyi nyer 'tsho zhi zhing 'di dang phyi ma'i mngon mtho'i bde 'byor 'dod pa rnams la de'i thabs kyi rim pa ma lus pa dang / gzhan dag 'jig rten gzhan don gnyer/ / zhes pa ltar gyi gdul bya blo mchog tu gyur pa rnams la sman byed dang grol byed kyi lam cha tshang ba dang khyad par du da lta chos rnam dag sgrub par 'dod pa rnams kyang gdon gsum gyi 'tshe bas 'dod don gyi steng du khel dka' ba rnams la lha mchog 'di nyid zung 'jug nor bu'i gling du 'khrid pa'i ded dpon mchog tu bzung ste nyer 'tshe gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa srung ba khor yug gi ri bo bzhin du bsten pa'i tshul sogs mdor na rang don gzhan don/ mchog thun mong zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las rab 'byams gang zhig bsgrub par 'dod kyang de'i thabs kyi rnam pa ma tshang ba med pa nor bu'i gter kha phye ba bzhin du mdzad pas deng dus shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i mtha'i bar gyi bla sngags grub mtha' ris su ma chad pa mtha' dag gi spyi nor mtshungs zla med par gyur pa ni bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha gnyi ga'i 'phrin las dus bab kyi ngo mtshar phul du phyin par snang ngo / / e ma ho/ khams gsum zil gnon rta mchog ting 'dzin gyis/ / srid gsum me dpung gcig tu 'bar ba'i klong / / thang gsum bzhad pa'i gad rgyangs bsgrags pa na/ / gdon gsum sde dang bcas pa'i snying rtsa 'dar/ / chos kyi lag len ji snyed mchis so cog / chos skor gcig gi lus su 'dril ba 'di/ / chos mig rdul dang bral ba'i mkhyen rab kyis/ / chos kun mngon par chub pa'i gtan tshigs yin/ / byams dang snying rje'i khyung sngon skyes kyis drangs/ / mtha' bral lta ba'i tsha zer gyis 'khyud pa/ / nges don sngags kyi las sbyor 'od stong gis/ / srid zhi'i rgud mun gcig car sel byed kyang / /325

༄/ /gung thang na ba'i sgronaḥgasung 'bum/ ral pa'i khur chen bzhin du rmongs pas non/ / rak+ka'i phreng kog bzhin du shes rgyud tsub/ / gdon chen bzhin du rdzas la rngam pa yi/ / sngags rgan ru dra gnyis pa'i spyod yul min/ / rta gdong me chen rgya mtshos sbar ba bzhin/ /drag sngags nus pa snying rjes 'byin bya yi/ / sdang sems tsam gyis rig sngags bsgrub pa ni/ / tsan dan sol bar byed pa'i blo gros yin/ / zhes kyang smra'o/ / rab 'byams pa chos bzang bkra shis kyis zhus ngor dgon pa'i zhabs drung sku skye sogs don gnyer can rnams la nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang dang gcod stan thog gcig ma'i khrid/ gtor ma brgya rtsa dang za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg gi khrid lung sogs gnang / dgung lo zhe drug pa chu stag gi lo'i gsar tshes kyi dga' ston sngar rgyun ltar 'phel/ rgya tig zhabs drung dang sems nyid zhabs drung sogs la mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang stsal/ dbyud kyi ring thugs brel gzhan med par bde chen chos gling dang yid dga' chos 'phel sogs su res mos kyis bzhugs nas thugs dam dang dpe gzigs gsungs rtsom spel mar gnang / zla ba gnyis pa'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i nyin khros nag lha lnga'i mdun skyed kyi cho ga mkha' 'gro mnyes byed rtsom par bzhed nas thog ma'i/ skal bzang mos pa'i dzing bu ji snyed par/ / zhes pa'i tshig phyag bris gnang ba dang dus mtshungs su grwa pa zhig gis gcod kyi dpe cha po ti gnyis khyer byung ba phyag tu blangs pa'i de ma thag lo de'i thog ma'i 'brug skad grags shing kha char 'dres ma zhig gis ri klung thams cad dkar 'jam yug gcig tu song bas chos 'dis gzhan la phan thogs pa'i rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa 'grigs song gsung thugs mnyes mdzad/zla ba gsum pa'i yar tshes la mar tshang chos rje mngags nas rgyud pa sgar gyi grwa parnams kyis gzhi 'dzin rgyu'i sa cha bgos te grwa gshag rnams rim gyis sbos/326

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzangacas kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /sa ga zla ba'i bco lnga'i nyin sgar gye dge 'dun tshang ma bla brang du tshogs pa la mang ja zho ston bsashis kha btags kyi 'gyed dung dkar dar yug bcas phul/rab rgyus zhabs drung ngag dbang chos 'phel rgya mtshos gsol ba btab pa bzhin khong dang gzhi byes kyi zhabs drung sku skye dka' ram ri khrod pa rnams la klu dbang rgyal po dang rnam rgyal lha dgu gtsug tor 'bar ba drag po sum dril dzam lha dkar nag ser gsum lo ma gyon ma tshe ring mched lnga sogs lha du ma'i rjes gnang / 'jigs byed dmar po'i dug dbang dben sa bka' 'bum lho brag bka' 'bum rta pota tshang ma rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi chos skor nyid kyis bsgrigs zin gang yod/ rin 'byung gi lha'i sgrub thabs tshang ma sogs chos tshan mang po'i lung / rab rgyas zhabs drung sogs nyung 'dus la na ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang dang de'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid smin rgyas/ bkra shis 'khyil nas 'ongs pa'i dge bshes 'ga' zhig la mkha' spyod ma'i chos skor gye lung sogs zab chos 'ga' zhig / bde chen chos gling gi bsam gtan pa rnams la blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid zhib rgyas dang gnas brtan phyag mchod rgyas pa'ilung sogs chos sbyin mi zad pa'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes te dbyar gyi ring phal cher bka' chos kyis dus 'da' ba byung / zla ba bdun pa'i yar tshes la thar ba gling du dgon mchod gzhis thab bsu dge 'dun gyis ser sbrengs sogs legs byas rten 'brel gye bkod pa rgya gang che'i sgo nas phebs te khri 'don dang / byang chub lam rim gyi dbu nas bka' chos thun gcig dgon pa'i 'grig lam sogs ji ltar byed dgos kyi bkod khyab bcas stsal/mar tshang chos rje blo bzang bstan 'dzin bla 'tshab dang dka' bcu 'jigs med rgyal mtshan chos khrims par bskos mang 'gyed dang sku brnyan mthong ba don ldan dge 'dun gyi thugs dam rten du phul/ phyir 'khor nas rgyal yag 327

༄/ /gung thang ba na pa'izlanaza' gsung la / dgon pa'i slob chung brje mtshams la thug par ma ra tshang chos rje blo bzang bsod nams sku tshab tu gtong ba gnang / de nas 'dul pa dgon du gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs phyogs de'i dgon mchod gzhi'i ser skya du ma dang bcasagazhi byes kyi dad ldan stong phrag brgal bar tshe dpag 'chi med 'dod 'jo'i dbang sta gon bcas dang / thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gye dbang ma ṇi'i ril sgrub dang sgyung gnas cho ga'i lung sogs chos bka' du ma bka' drin stsal/ spyi nas gsol ston 'bul nod gzabs shing nyid nas mang 'gyed gnang / thams cad kyis dgon par bla brang rgyag dgos kye zhu ba dang shing cha phul ba bzhin gnas gzhi gzigs rtog dang gra bsgrigs sogs kyi ljags bkod gnang ste dgon lung du phebs/ brag rtsa'i mkha' spyod rtse'i lha khang zhig gsos dang de dang 'dabs chags par gzim chung mkha' spyod yang rtser skor dang bcas gsar bskrun mdzad/ lha khang nang du dngul dkar srang stong phrag las bsgrubs pa'i mchod rten thog tshad ma nang 'jug tu rje gong ma ngag dbang chos rgyam pa'i thugs dang gdung rus yi ge rang byon dang 'bral spangagi thub dbang lo rgyus can gyes gtsos byin rlabs kyi rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs pa la sum pa mkhan chen gdan drangs nas rab gnas bskyar ma zhus/ sbyin bdag har chin wang gi mi sna khā nor rgyal ngo g.yog 'byor nas brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te wang nas bskur ba'i 'dog pa'i dngos po btegs/ lo 'dir rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang gaṅgā'i chu rgyun rta mgrin bka' sdod dang bcas pa'i bskang bshags gtor zlog rdo rje'i 'phrul sgogs zlog chog bdud dpur pham pa'i rgyal rnga bod gtong zlog thabs drag po'i sbyin sreg bya bas khrus dug dbyung glud chog sogs rta mgrin chos skor gye yan lag mang po zhig ljags rtsom gnang / bstan 'dzin bzang po bya ba 328

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /'brum bas ma bde skabs rje nyid nas glud rdzong zhig gnang bas de nub kho rang gi nyams snang la kho'i mtha' skor du sprang po dang byis pa chung du mang po zhig gis bskor nas 'dug pa la/ rje 'dis paṇa zhwa zhig mnabs nas sngags shig gdangs mthon pos gsungs bzhin kho'i rtsar phebs te sprang po 'di tsho da dung mi 'gro ba ci yin zhes thugs 'ur ba'i rnam pas de thams cad dbyug pas brdungs te ring du bskrad pa'i snang ba byung / der ma zad kho rang sdod sa bzhugs gnas dang thag shin tu ring yang zhal 'don gang gsung gi rim pa sogs kyang go rim ji lta ba bzhin ma 'phyugs par nyams snang du 'char ba byung la/ de'i phyi nyin nas nad kyang rim dwangs su song bas bla ma dang lha sngags kyi nus pa la yid ches lhag par rnyed pa byung / skabs der sum pa mkhan rin po che nas mdos glud sogs khungs med du sgrub pa'i yig cha ke ta ka zer ba zhig mdzad de rtsal bshad gnang zhing rje nyid la'ang ke ta gar 'thad mi 'thad 'dug na brgal brtag byed dgos tshul lan 'ga' gsungs kyang dgos pa las dgag bya che bar gzigs nas btang snyoms su bzhag pas yang bskyar mar tshang nang so blo bzang bsod nams la kha btags chos 'don gye skyes dang bcas sngar nas lan 'ga' zhus yod kyang brnyas stabs kyis ris su por ba yinanam lan ma byung zhes gsung lce mos dbang med du bskul ma gnang bar brten/ mkhan chen rang gi dgongs bzhed sgrub pa'i ched dang gnad ma rtogs pa 'ga' zhig gsung de la brten nas chos spong gi las gsog pa'ang byung 'dug pas nyes spyod rgyun 'gag pa'i phyir mdzes lam du ma song ba'i dogs dpyod kyi bstan bcos ke ta ga'i byi dor bya ba zhig mdzad nas phul/mkhan chen rang gis bskul ma gnang tshul de'i nang du gsal bar bris yod cing skabs der ci yang ma gsung 'dug / rjes sor yang lan mkhan chen 329

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/gyis mdzad pa yin zer ba zhig na bskul ma ma byas tshul sogs bris 'dug pa ni mkhan chen la kha g.yar ba'i rdzun mar rtog dpyod can rnams kyis shes sla la/des mtshon te dgag sgrub kyi nus pa ci yang ma thon par tshig dan gye phreng ba kho na spel 'dug pas kyang mkhan chen rang gi gsung min par go nus so/ /dgun zla tha chung gi nang du dgon lung du khros nag lha lnga'i bsnyen pa mdzad skabs tho rangs shig bya 'dab 'og tu byi'u zhig gis sirnyi pha la zer ba'i skad bsgrags pa gsan 'dug pa ni dngos grub 'grub pa'i mtshan ma khyad par can du mngon/ lo mjug tu mgon po'i gtor chen pa sogs don gnyer can mang po la mgon po bar chad kun sel gyi rjes gnang de'i gtor chen gyi cho ga stag phu rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa dang nyid kyi gsar rtsom skor tshang ma'i lung bcas gnang / dgung lo zhe bdun pa chu yos gnam lo gsar pa'i dus ston bstar/ chos rgyal gyi gtor sgrub pa rnams la 'jigs byed sngags btu'i rjes gnang dang chos rgyal phyi nang gnyis kyi rjes gnang stsal/ zla ba gnyis pa'i yar tshes la mchod rten thang bkra shis dar rgyas gling gi khri pa zang nga zhabs drung spyi gnyer grwa rgan bcas 'ongs nas mgon pa'i 'du khang gsar gsos kyi mgo 'dren gnang dgos tshul zhus pa bzhin zhal bzhes gnang ste shing bzo rtsig bzo lha bzo las dpon rnams la tshad dbyibs sogs kyi ljags bkod dang / las ka ngos dag ru nga ba dgos tshul gyi bka' khyab nan tan gnang nas rim par btang bas legs par bsgrubs/ do lon mkhan pos zhus ngor khong dang bde rgu mkhan po sems nyid zhabs drung zang nga zhabs drung sogs gzhi byes kyi don gnyer can du ma la khros nag lha lnga'i dbang smin rgyas dang / gong gsal nang gi che gras nyung 'dus la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang de'i skyed rdzogs kyi khrid zhib rgyas/ yang rgyud pa bla zur dpa' rin chos rjes 330

༄7/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /zhus ngor zhabs drung sku skye dka' ram sogs ser skya mang po la lam rim bde lam gyi khrid nyin mang po'i bar zhib bshad dang / zhwa dmar dgon gyi khri pa chos snyan grags kyis zhus ngor mgon po'i rjes gnang dang bla mchod smon lam rnam lnga gdugs dkar mchog grub ma'i ljags lung sogs zhu mkhan so so'i ngor chos bka' rnam grangs mang po gnang / sprung gnas cho ga dang khros nag gi gtor bzlog de'i zlog pa'i chog gcod lugs kyi glud chog rta mgrin chos skor gyi yan lag tu bka' bsgo chu gtor klu gtor bum gter 'chi blu bla blu rgyal rdzong lo skor bcu gnyis kyi bcos byis glung gtong tshul/ rbad bdun ma la brten pa'i gdon 'dul bya tshul bsang chog bkra shis dbyangs snyan 'dod gsol kha bsgyur dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga dge legs rgya mtsho'i char 'bebs rnams ljags rtsom mdzad/ ston 'dul ba dgon du phebs te bla brang gsar pa'i sa las grub 'dug par spyi bla brang nas dga' ston legs 'bul zhus shing nyid nas kyang khang ston rgyas par gnang / 'di res dgon pa'i khri 'jog pa mdzadade rong po zhabs drung rin po cher mgul dar dang bcas khri bar bsko bzhag dang dgon pa 'dzin skyong gi bslab ston zhal ta mdzad/ tshogs dbur gdan drangs nas gnas brtan phyag mchod dang 'brel ba'i zhabs brtan rgyas ba phul/ tshogs par sgo drug pa'i gzungs kyi bshad lung dang mang ja 'bul ba gzab rgyas dang spyi 'jog tu sgrol ma khri sku'i thang ga bcu gos rdo rje gsang lam ma'i bla bre zangs gling cha rnams stsal/ dge 'dun la sgo drug pa'i gzungs gyi dpe cha re dang lha bab dus chen dang bstun nas tshogs su 'dzug rgyu'i mang 'gyed thebs bcas gnang / dgon gsar thar pa gling du 'du khang dbus 'phug gyan sum cu so lnga rgya mthong gyan dgu 'khyam gyan lnga steng du mchod khang dang mgon khang sogs yod pa spen pad dang gyo thog can/331

sa / /gung thangabastan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/chos ra sgo khang rung khang dang bcas phun sum tshogs pa bsgrubs te rje'i lnga mchod kyi nyin dge 'dun rnams 'du khang gsar bar tshogs pa la mang ja phreng 'gyed gdugs gcig ba dan dang rgyal mtshan cha re 'du khang phugs su gyan lnga 'gengs pa'i sgrol yol 'jog pa mdzad/ rim gyis 'du khang steng du gser zangs kyi gasdir mi tshad lhag pa steng 'og dang phyi nang gi shing rtsi shod kyi gyan bcugasum la logs ris sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis dang rje bla ma'i rnam thar rgyas pa bcas ras gzhi la bris pa rgya mthong gyan bcu gcig la bla ༵t+t+waṃdī ṭ+wāṃ dī~X /bye ༷༵ ༵ dībheX rnyi diṭ+wāṃrje ṭ+wāṃnartsi /soXs bal stodī dhidhi ༷rnyi|༷ pa'i bar stong rnams su yul ljongs me tog khang bzang sogs kyi ri mo tshon gyis bris pa'i dngos gtsang / 'du khang phugs su nyid kyis bzhugs khri bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gos be+er dang bcas pa'i g.yas g.yon du mchod khri gyan re 'gengs pa bcu tshon rtsi can gye steng du lam rim bla brgyud kyi sku brnyan byis pa lo brgyad gyi bong tshod tsam lnga bcu nga dgu/ gzungs gzhug tshad ldan dang gser tshon shin tu dngos dag gis mtshon bris 'bur gyi sku brnyan du ma bzang gos las bsgrubs pa'i ka 'phan ring ba brgyad dang phye phur bzhi sogs mchod rdzas sna tshogs dang bcas bzhugs/ steng shod la g.yas kyi mchod khang du gong du smos zin pa ltar phyag mdzod don grub dbang rgyal gyis bod nas bzhengs pa'i dkar chag skor tshad zur gsal ltar gyi jo bo'i sku brnyan mthong ba don ldan gyes gtsos pa'i bris 'bur gyi sku du ma mchod rdzas sna tshogs dang bcas pa/ g.yon gyi mgon khang du chos 'khor rgyal gyi lha mo'i bla mtsho'i chu dngaphye ma rde'u sogs rgya bod kyi gnas chen rnams dang mgon khang dang dur khrod mang po'i mdo/ dam pa mang po'i dbu lo na bza' gdung rus gdung 332

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /thal rnams phyogs gcig tu 'gros pas sku rgyu byas shing thugs gar srog 'khor bris sgrub rab gnas gnad smin bgyis pas mtshon dbu zhabs ked gsum gyi gzungs 'jug tshad ldan can gyi dmag zor rgyal mo'i sku brnyan mtho bcu tsam pa de'i sku thang kha byang yod pa'i byen can/ rgyal sras rin po ches gnang ba'i tsan dan gyi be con thod pa bdud rtsi ril bu dang rin po che 'bru sman gyis bkang ba go mtshon sogs spyan gzigs sna tshogs tshar du dngar ba dang /dge slong ngag dbang dga' blos dad pas bzhengs pa'i lha khang rgya 'bug gyo thog can shing rtsi logs ris dngos dag bsgrubs pa'i nang du bka' 'gyur ro cog gi chos kyi 'khor lo/ btsan khang gyan dgu gyo thog can gyi sdeb ris la keng chen sde bzhi bstan ma bcu gnyis/ dregs pa sde brgyad gzhan yang 'gro ba'i lha lnga las mkhan 'ga' zhig bcas bkod cing / pho brang nang mar dam canagasang sgrub dang nor sgrub mgar nag gsum gyi sku brnyan mtho bdun re tsam pa thugs ka rnams su srog 'khor bla rdo sogs bris sgrub rab gnas tshad ldan bgyis pas mtshon stod smad par gsum gyi gzungs gzhug spyi bye brag spel tshig dang bcas gzungs 'jug spyi 'gro tsam gyis zhwa dpe lham 'gebs lta bu ma yin par sgos kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag bzhin du rung bar mdzad pa bzhugs shing / pho brang phyi mar bzang gos sna tshogs kyis bsgrigs pa'i nor bu'i dra ba dra phyed phye phur cha gcig me mda' dang mda' gzhu stag dong gzig shubs can spus gtsang tshar bzhi re sogs spyan gzigs mang du bstar gzhan yang smon lam skabs 'grem rgyu'i mi 'khrugs pa'i gos sku lha mgron du bde gshegs brgyad chos skyong 'ga' zhig bcas bzhugs shing bzo bkod phun sum tshogs pa srid du 'dom brgyad dang zheng du 'dom phyed dang lnga pa zhal khebs can/ khrus chas su snam sbyar rten khebs kun bzang 'khor lo ma gcig dang 333

༄/ /gung thang bstanaba'izlanama'i gsung 'bum/gzhan gcig bum pa gser rtsi ma me long che legs spos phor mchod rkong mchod 'dzin pas gyon rgyu'i rtse zhwa legs pa drug gos chen pad+ma gser mig can gyi phrag khebs gos skud sna tshogs kyi kha tshar can/ mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub mchod kyi dgos chas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor stegs yol ba bla bre bcas dang rnam bum dung rdor gser rtsi can tshems grub kyi bkra shis rtags brgyad dang rgyal srid sna bdun ting phor mar me'i rkong bu sogs dang / cho ga'i dpe cha tshar bcu bzhi chas 'jug tshar bcu gsum rdor dril gdan bcas bcu gsum/ beg tse gtso 'khor gsum gri thogs bshan pa brgyad dam can rdo rje legs pa keng rus gnyis a tsa ra gnyis dang bcayopa'i 'cham bkra shis lhun po'i phyag len ltar gsar du btsugs shing / de dag gi dgos chas su zhal 'bag bcu drug rgyan bzhi sogs gos chen gyi 'cham lwa bcu drug bod kyi grwa lham cha bcu drug dang ras lham dmar po cha bcu drug / so so'i phyag mtshan tshang ma spub cha gcig gseraja drug dang tshon can bzhi 'phyar dar drug rtse rgyan phod dang bcas pa thams cad gsar bsgrigs/ spyi sor thog khang gyan lnga bcas khang ba mi nyung tsam gyi shing cha 'bub thebs thab 'dzin thebs bcas kyi gsol ras stsal zhing /dge 'dun la khe bi su'i tshogs gdan legs pa phying ba'i nang sha sru rug gi kha dkris can bcu gnyis/ ja khra legs pa drug tshogs su chab 'dren pa'i chab ril rgyan drug ma dge bskos kyiyo'adzin rgyu'i khrims dbyug cha/ ja tshul dang dbyang gnas kyi thebs sogs la dngul srang phyed dang bzhi brgya bcas kyi 'jog pa mdzad/ bla brang gi ra skor yang rgya cher bskyed nas dbus dang shar nub tu thog khang gyan lnga res mtshon phyi nang gi ra skor rim pa du ma dang g.yas zur du gzim khang gyan bcu drug gru bzhir bskor ba 'di rnams shing rtsi dang bcas legs par grub pa'i dbus kyi lha khang nang du dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi 334

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /gser sku che ba yung lo'i thugs dam mar grags pa'i byin can bzhugs khri rgyab yoladang bcas pa/ paṇa chen rin po che'i tsan dan gyi 'dra sku khru gang ba bkras lhun gyi nang rten nas byung ba'i byin can bzhugs khri rgyab yol bcas tsan dan dmar po las bsgrubs pa'i bde gshegs brgyad kyi sku brnyan tsan dan dmar po'i lha bab mchod rten che ba rje'i sku gling 'phur ma sogs tsan dan dang gser zangs kyi sku brnyan du ma dang / ston pa'i rnam thar a ti sha'i rnam thar tsong kha ba'i rnam thar rgyal dbang gi rnam thar lam rim tshogs zhing sogs ras bris kyi sku thang mang po bcas bzhugs/ steng shod du bka' 'gyur dbus dbar cha tshang phyag dpe po ti brgya phrag brgal ba/ sgyung gnas pa'i thugs dam rten du ched dmigs kyis bzhengs pa'i 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal gyi sku brnyan che ba sogs bris 'bur gye sku du ma/ mgon khang du dpal mgon zhal gyi rten thang bskang rdzas spyan gzigs dang bcas bzhugs/gzim khang rnams su byams pa rin po che sogs rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams dang gsang bde 'jigs gsum nā ro mkha' spyod rta mgrin gsang sgrub sogs thugs dam rten gyi sku brnyan bris 'bur dum bzhugs shing / mchod rdzas kyi skor yol ba dngabla bre 'phan sogs bzang gos las bsgrubs pa dang / maṇ+ḍal dang bum pa bkra shis rtags brgyad dang rgyal srid sna bdun ting phor rkong bu sogs gser zangs dang dngul dkar li dkar sogs las bsgrubs pa so so nas tshar du ma dang / gzhan yang khang rgyan du shel dang dkar yol sogs kyi snod spyad dang ca lag dngos gtsang du mas mtshon mkho ba'i yo byad kyi skor ma tshang pa med pa'i gra bsgrig dang / bla brang gi mdun ngos kyi klu ldings su rigs mi 'dra ba'i sa bon du mas bskyed pa'i rtsi shing dang me tog dang pad+ma sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i skyed mos tshal yid du 'ong ba zhig kyang bskrun par mdzad/ de 335

sa / /gung thang bstan pa'izlan 'i gsung 'bum/ltar dgon gsar thar pa gling rten dang brten par bcas pa gsar bsgrun dang sa cha dang nags nyos pa sogs kyi rgyu 'gror dngul srang chig khri lhag tsam song / dgon gsar 'di nyid snang ba mtha' yas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes dbang pos gnas dang ming bcas lung bstan pa ltar grub cing / lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa rol pa'i rdo rjes thugasadam gyi lta dang 'das ma 'das kyi srung ma rnams lung bstan pa bzhin tshogs pa'i zhal 'don du mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga gtan chags btsugs shing /lha mo dam can rnam gnyis kyi pho brang dang phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rgyun gtor dīdī ༵rdo~X ༷rdo hā/rdo ni~X smyoṭ+wāṃ d+dhāX sdungh+ru / rje ༵ dī ༷ ga~X rdogo/ na // ༵ ṭ+wāṃr+sha nyid du rim par gdan drangs nas gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa la rab tu gnas pa'i chog lan kha yar dang zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor bas snod bcud thams cad la ye shes kyi byin chen po phab pa dang bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma spel bar mdzad/ rje nyid nas sde 'dir thog mar 'jug pa'i tshul dang zhugs nas blang dor ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa tshar bcad pa'i las la nan tur bya ba'i tshul gsum gyis bsdus pa'i bca' khrims spyi dang / khyad par du gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa bca' khrims kyi gtso bor bsdams ngos yi ge 'bri klog dang tshogs 'don gyi rigs blor 'dzin dang mdo dbus gang rung du rang gi thob khungs kyi chos sder phyin nas pu ti lnga'i slob gnyer dang rgyud grwa 'grim nas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung la thos bsam mthar phyin byed mkhan rnams de bzhin dang / de tsam mi thub pa rnams gnas kyi bla ma dang dge rgan tshad ldan brten nas sdom pa gsum gye bslab bya lam rim blo sbyong sngags kyi skyed rdzogs sogs la rang rang gi blo'i nus 336

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /pa dang bstun pa'i thos bsam byed pa gal che zhing / de'i steng du tha snyad rig gnas la mos pa yod mkhan gyis sman rtsis snyan ngag sogs slob pa la'ang dgag bya med pa dang ha cang thos rgya chen por mi tshe btang nas nyams su len rgyu ma byung gi dogs pas 'jigs pa rnams kyis spros pa mang po dor nas bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i drung nas byang chub lam gyi rim pa dang / yi dam gang la mos pa zhig gi dbang dang gdams ngag sogs mdor na sgrub pa nyams len la med mi rung gi chos la sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i thos bsam gyi snying po bsdus pa re bgyis pas kyang rung ba dang / de ltar thos bsam bgyis pa de'ang dad brtson dang dran shes bag yod bsten pa'i sgo nas rang rgyud la spyor ba'i nyams len byed dgos shing blo rab kyis nyin bzhin thun dang thun mtshamasakyi rim pas mdo sngags kyi lam gyi rim pa'i dmigs rnam sbyong pa la 'bad pas tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms pa dang / blo 'bring gis lhag pa'i lha gang yang rung ba re'i bsgom bzlas la gtso bo 'bad cing de'i steng du rgyal ba ma pham pas/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang / nyan dang klog dang 'dzin pa dang / / 'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang / / de sems pa dang bsgom pa'o/ / spyod pa 'di bcu'i bdag nyid ni/ / bsod nams phung po dpag tu med/ / ce4gsungs pa ltar chos spyod bcu'i nyams len dang bsam sgom sogs mi yong ba'i gang zag phal bas kyang lus kyis phyag dang skor ba byed cing mchod pa 'bul ba la brtson pa dang ngag gis sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang gzungs sngags zab mo bgrang ba dang yid kyis de dag gi phan yon bsam nas dad pa bsgom pa sogs sgo gsum don ldan du 'gyur pa'i thabs la brtson pa bya tshul dang / dmigs bsal gzhi gsum gyi phyag len dang chos thog gi rim pa rnams bye brag tu phye ste lo gcig la dus 'brel gyi gso spyong bco lnga pa bco 337

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/brgyad dang bcu bzhi pa drug rnams yul lugs kyi rgya rtsis dang bstun nas nyin zhagagi grangs rtsi tshul ma nor zhing ma chad pa dgos pa dang / bkra shis kyi gso sbyong sogs nam dgos dus su byed pa dang dbyar khas len la dbyar snga ma zhal bzhes mdzad pa'i srol bzhin dbyar zla 'bring po'i bco lnga la gso sbyong dang dbyar khas len gyi sta gon rnams dang / bcu drug gi nang bar dngos gzhi byed cing byin rlabs ma byas par mtshams kyi phyi rol tu mi 'gro ba dang nag tho tshun chad du bud med kyi rigs mi gtong ba dang nang du 'khrugs long mi skyed pa sogs dbyar gyi khrims rnams tshad ldan dang / dgag dbye bcu bzhi'i mtshan mo chos bshad nyan byed par gsungs pa bzhin 'grub na bya zhing bco lnga'i nyin dgag dbye dang bcu drug gam de nyin dgag bya yod tshe bcu bdunagyi nyin ma mtha' rgyang grags gcig tshun chad du ljongs rgyu bar 'gro ba dang / tshogs 'tshogs nus ba dang bzhugs dus grol dus rnams su zhi dul gyispyod lam bag dang ldan pas mtshon 'grig lam zhib tu bsdams pa'i ngos nas lo gcig la chos thog smon lam gnyis/ dbyar gnas lnga mchod skyung gnas sgrub mchod tshes gtor rnams las cho 'phrul smon lam zla ba dang po'i tshes gnyis la gral 'dzin dang / tshes gsum nas dngos gzhi bya zhing nyin re la mang ja lnga re'i thog kun rig bdag mdun gtsos pa'i zhal 'don gyi rim pa tshad ldan dang snga dro bla mas gsung chos dang phyi dro smon lam gyi phyag len skabs bstun/ tshes brgyad la gos sku 'grem zhing khrus gsol mchod 'bul byas rjes 'cham rgyag pa dang / bcu bzhi la bskang gso 'don zhing phyi rol tu zor 'phen pa dang tshes bco lnga'i nyin byams pa'i sku brnyan skor bar gdan 'dren zhing phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma dang cha gsum gtong ba dang phyi dro dus bzang chos spyod 'don pa sogs phyag len ltar byed pa dang / drug pa'i smon lam tshes 338

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /gcig nas bcu tham pa'i bar nyin rer mang ja lnga re dang tshes brgyad la mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga 'don zhing gos sku 'grem pa dang 'cham rgyag pa las gzhan zhal 'don sogs cho 'phrul smon lam dang dpe 'dra byed pa dang / dbyar gnas la nyin rer mang ja gsum re'i thog mi 'khrugs pa dang kun rig tshe dpag rnams kyi cho ga chos skyong rnams kyi bskang gso bcas nyin grangs cha bgos te so sor gtong zhing mjug tu gtor rgyag dang / chos thog gi stod kyi tshogs par rnams su chos spyod bskang gso sogs kye dbyangs sbyangs pa dang smad kyi tshogs par rnams su 'cham gsar slob dang rnying ba rnams 'cham chags byed cing / bla ma dge bskos kyis do dam tshag 'dzin zhib nges byed dgos pa dang rje'i lnga mchod la nyin rer mang ja lnga re'i thog kun rig gi bdag 'dun dang nyi shu lnga'i mtshan mo so so'i gshag tu gling me dang 'du khang du mchod pa gzab rgyas bshams te mchod rol sogs gtong zhing / dge 'dun tshang ma 'tshogs nas mang ja gnyis kyi thog bla ma mchod pa dang chos spyod smon lam sogs 'don pa dang nyi shu dgu la bskang gso gtor ma drug cu pa bcas dang phyi rol tu gtor ma 'phen pa rnams dkyus ltar/ bzhi pa'i tshes bco lnga dus chen sum 'dzom dang dgu pa'i nyer gnyis lha babs kyi dus chen dang sgo bstun nas sgyung gnas srung mkhan grwa pa dang mi skye pho mo gang yod lhan cig tu rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i cho ga'i steng nas smyung gnas sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshad ldan srung ba dang / lo gsar gyi tshes gcig la 'du khang gi yang thog tu bla grwa rags bsdus kyis lha mo'i tshes gtor cho ga phyag len 'khrul med gzab rgyas gtong ba dang / slar rim gyis chos thog zur ba tshugs thub pa byung tshe zhal 'don sogs skabs bstun byed pa dang / zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes brgyad dang bco lnga la mang ja gsum re'i thog mi 'khrugs 339

༄/ /gungathang bstan ba'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/pa lha dgu'i cho ga bdag mdun dbang chog bcas lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i cho ga bsgrigs kyi steng nas gtong ba dang / btsan khang du zla dus su dam can gyi dus gtor gtong ba dang bla brang du lo dus su dpal mgon gyi dus gtor rgyas pa gtong pa rnams kyi srol btsugs shing / gzhan yang dge 'dun gyi rgyun gyi spyod lam dang las sne rnams kyi blang dor gyi rim pa sogs so sor 'dul ba'i bca' khrims dam po mdzad dgun gyi nyi ldog skabs bcad rgya gnang ste gcod kyi dmigs pa nan tan mdzad pas mnal lam du bye'u rigs mang pos mtha' bskor nas skad sna tshogs sgrogs shing nyid kyis de rnams la zan byin nas tshim par mdzad pa dang / yang bla chen 'khor g.yog mang po can zhig gis chos zhu ba sogs kyi mi ltas byung ba ni rgyal po shing bya can gyi 'phrul la brten pa'i lhong dang tshar tshad cig yin pa 'dra gsung / yang mnal lam la sa skya bdag chen ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros phebs te thugs dgyes pa'i rnam pas khyed khams bzang bar bzhugs shig nged tsa ri'i cig shed du 'gro ba yin no gsung nas bar snang la phar yud kyis byon pa mis shing rjes sor dris tshe bdag chen zhi bar gshegs pa'i lo tshigs dang 'grig par snang ba ni bla ma te ru ka nyid dag pa mkha' spyod du gshegs khar byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ltas 'khrul ba med par mngon no/ / dgung lo zhe brgyad pa shing pho 'brug gi lo gsar sngar rgyun bzhin gnang / dpyid kyi ring kun spangs chen po blo bzang yon tan sogs zhu mkhan so so'i ngor khong dang bde rgu mkhan po do lon mkhan po sems nyid zhabs drung mdung nag su nyid zhabs drung sogs dgon pa'i sku skye dka' ram rags bsdus la rdo rje sems dpa' bla med lugs dang 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs phyag rdor gtum chung bde mchog dkar po dang sgrol dkar lo gyon ma gtso 'khor gsum dang seng 340

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /gdong ma gtso 'khor gsum lha mo dmag zor ma dang tha maṇa sogs lha du ma'i rjes gnang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor don gnyis lhun grub ma'i dmigs khrid zhib rgyas bla ma mchod pa'i khrid yig rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i 'jigs byed kyi skyed rdzogs gnyis sbyin sreg dngos grub rgya mtsho dang shel dkar me long nyid kyi gsung 'bum dpar bkod gang yod bcas kyi ljags lung / gong gsal nang gi che gras nyung shas la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang khrid yig bai zur+ya zhun ma'i them skas kyi steng nas rim gnyis kyi khrid smin rgyas yig cha de dang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i spyi don gsang chen sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde mig sogs bka' rgya'i skor 'ga' zhig gi lung dang 'pho khrid tshe khrid sogs zab chos mang po bka' drin stsal/ nag zla'i nya la dge tshul du bsgrub bya kha shas dang sems nyid zhabs drung blo bzang mchog grub nyi ma sogs bsnyen rdzogs bsgrub bya bzhi bcu lhag bcas par tshigs snga phyi'i sdom pa phog / sems nyid zhabs drung rang yul du 'degs rgyu'i thon phyag zhus par bde mchog gi rjes gnang gnang skyes dang thos don rgyud la sbyar te lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i nyams len byed lugs kyi bslab ston zhib rgyas bcas stsal cing khyad par du gzhan la bstan mi chog pa'i bka' rgya dam po dang bcas gsang chen bcud thigs lngags rtsom gyi dpe phyag bdar nas gtod pa gnang / sems dpa' chen po bla ma ngag dbang rab brtan bas zhus ngor khong dang dgon lung gi bla ma dge 'dun hag bsdus la thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang chen sta gon dang bcas pa bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang sgyung gnas cho ga mkhas grub chig brgyud dang ba so chig brgyud kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi lung rnams dang / su nyid zhabs drung blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma la seng ldeng nags sgol dang rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang rta mgrin gyi byabs khrus bcas gnang / rta 341

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronami'i gsung 'bum/mgrin chos skor gyi yan lag tu 'chi blu dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs 'bul tshul slob dpon la tshes bcu'i mchod pa 'bul tshul char 'bebs rgyas pa ser srung gi gdams pa 'phro can rnams ljags rtsom mdzad/ de dus 'dul dgon gyi rong bo zhabs drung gis zhwa po khog gi phyogs der lo snga ma rnams su lo tog la ser ba'i gnod pa chen po byung ba la srung thabs zhus par nyid kye ljags rtsom ser srung man ngag gi lung dang bka' bkod gnang ba ji lta ba bzhinabasgrubs pa nas bzung ste deng sang bar du ser pa'i gnod pa cher ma byung 'dug la/ phyogs gzhan dang gzhan du'ang ser srung gi rten dang byin rlabasaganang ba nas bzung lo grangs mang po'i bar du ser ba'i gnod pa ma byung tshul gyi lo rgyus khungs dag shin tu mang bar snang ba ni srin bu'i rjes la yi ge'i rnam pa byung ba ltar lan re tsam stabs legs kyis phan thogs pa la grub pa'i dbang po zer ba lta bu ma yin par lhun gyis grub pa'i byin rlabs kye 'jug pa zad mi shes pa'i rang rtags su gsal lo/ / sa ga zla ba'i nang rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che bod du phebs rgyu'i gtam gsan nas jo'u gya'i gzhis gar phebs nas mjal phrad dang zhag gnyis lhan du gsung gling mdzad bkra shis 'khyil gyi khri pa gnang dgos kyi bka' nan phebs par dgongs pa zhus/ bod nas sku don dgongs bzhed ltar grub ste myur du chibs kha bsgyur pa'i bden tshig gsol 'debase zhus pa bzhin rje bla ma de nyid kyis zhal bkod gnang ste nyid kyis phyag bris mdzad lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa pe'i cing du bzhugs rje nyid bod du phebs kho bo ni gung ru rgyan bzang gis/blo bzang grags pa dga' ldan gnas su gshegs/ / byams chen chos rje mi dbang gtsug na mdzes/ / rgyal mtshan bzang po gangs ri'i khrod 'dir lus/ / zhes skyo tshig gsungs pa lta bu yong 'dug ces thugs phreng ba'i rnam pa 342

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /mdzad pa la bla ma mchog nas/ nyid kyang gzhan zhig tu phebs dgos dgos yodasrid gsungs pa mi ring bar/ gong ma'i bkas rgya nag tu 'byon rgyu'i lung bstan du mngon/ dngul rta rmig ma gsum/ gos chen yug lnga/ gong ma'i na bza'i khrod kyi 'brug rtsag gsar ba spus gtsang bcas kyi phebs rdzong dang / gro tshang mkhan po dang / ka ring zhabs drung sogs zhabs phyi drag zhan dang bcas pa yan thang bar du phebs skyel zhus/ phyir lam gro tshang brgyudade thar pa gling du phebs/ mang ja dang dong tshe nyis brgya re'i 'gyed gnang / gnas gzhi'i 'dabs su sa gnon kyi 'bum khang rgyag rgyu'i bkod pa mdzad de/ slar dgon lung byams pa gling du pheb bo/ / smras pa/ bde gshegs 'phrin las byed po lhag pa'i lha/ / theg gsum thar pa'i sa mkhan 'gro ba'i mig / yon tan tshogs kyi bla mar gyur pa yi/ / chos kyi rgyal po bshad sgrub bstan pa'i bdag / lung dang rtogs pa'i dpal gyis mngon mtho bas/ / bsnyengs bral 'jigs pa med pa gdong lnga'i khri/ / lha dang drang srong grub rigs mkhas pa'i tshogs/ / kun gyis mngon par btud pa'i spo na 'gying / / snang ba mtha' yas dgyes bzhad lha lam ngos/ / yid 'ong kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin lung gtibs/ / don ldan zhu ba snyan pa'i dbyangs sgogs shing / / bkur ste glog phran 'gyu pa'i gar yang rtsen/ / gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin sprang rtsi'i ros/ / bgrang yas 'dus pa'i rkang drug tshim byed cing / / dad ldan dad pa'i rdzas kyi dzasbu'i 'bras/ / byang chub snying po gser sbyang khams su bsgrubs/ / gang gi zhabs sen 'od kyis reg pa yis/ /phyogs dang mtshams su dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde/ / bgrang yas mya ngan med pa'i tshal chen po/ / bslab gsum sprang rtsi'i gter gyur ci yang bzhad/ /res 'ga' 'chad dang rtsom pa'i dga' ston spel/ / skabs 'gar yang dag 343

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/'jog la gcig tu gzhol/ / gzhan tshe dge 'dun sde dang gtsug lag khang / / gsar du bskrun cing spel ba dbyar mtsho bzhin/ / mdor na rgyal dbang grags bstan gdugs dkar po/ / gyen du 'degs pa'i rmad byung 'phrin las kyi/ / cha shas rtsibs stong yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ / grib bsil nor 'dzin dkyil 'khor kun tu khyab/ / ces rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum rmad du byung ba'i mdzad bzang 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal gyi cha tsam gtam du byas pa rtogs brjod pad+ma dkar po las/ dgon sde du ma phyag 'deb/ rlabs po che'i tshogs bsags/ paṇa chen mchog gi zhabs 'degs/ bka' rtsom mang po spel ba sogs ris med pa'i bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad tshul gyi 'dab ma ste bcu pa'o/ /344

༄༅/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /༄7/ / 'dab ma bcu gcig pa/ pe cin du lan gsum par phebs shing 'gro don mdzad pa'i tshul/deyang hor zla bzhi pa'i gnam gang gi snga dro 7gnam bsgos mi'i rje bo 'jam dbyangs 7gong ma chen po'i bka' las/ thu'u bkwan hu thog thu hor zla brgyad pa tshun la tsha byol pho brang du sleb pa gyis zhes phebs pa/ mong gol cur kwan nas de ma thag rta zam thog nas yi ge btang ba zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bdun gyi nyin zi ling astan la 'byor/ tshes brgyad la gser yig skyel mi astan gyi mi sna dgon lung du 'byor nas rgyu mtshan snyan du phul par/ thugs ngal shin tu che ba byung yang 7gong ma'i bka' zlog tu med cing / mjal rgyu'i dus tshod kyi bka' gnang ba yang dus nye ba'i dbang gis zhag bcu skor gye ring la lam chos rta khal sogs gang dgos gra sgrig tshags su tshud par byas/ tshes bcu gsum gza' skar 'phrod sbyor bzang po'i nyin chu mgo dkar dris zer bar sga 'bogs gnang / de nas tshur phebs skabs dge 'dun stong lhag gis ser sbrengs dang / bla brang steng nas dar 'phyar dung 'bud sogs rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa bsgrigs/ bla brang nas tshogs su zhabs brtan gyi mang ja zhus pa'i thog rje nyid tshogs mjal du phebs skabs/ ljongs 'dir mi nub ring du gsal gyur cig / ces pa'i tshig mtshams dang 'grigs pas slar myur du gdan sar phebs thub pa'i rten 'brel dud dgongs te dgyes tshorabla na med pa mdzad/ lung pa'i phu'i sgrub sde byang chub gling bas gdan drangs pa la mgyogs par rang yul du 'khor nas dben pa'i gnas su tshe dang 345

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/sgrub pa stoms pa'i rten 'brel yin gsungs te/ de nyin rang la byon nas ri khrod pa rnams la lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung gi dbu btsugs nas gnang zhing / tshur phebs skabs bzhugs gdan rgyab yol kyang der 'jog par mdzad/ ri khrod pa kha shas kyis rang rang gi spyil bor gdan drangs te bsnyen bkur zhus shing / bgres gzhon mtha' dag nas 'bral ma phod par mchi ma dbang med du 'tshor ba byung / bco lnga'i nyin dgon lung spyi nas tshogs dbur gdan drangs te/ dge 'dun tshang mas mjal kha zhus/ tshogs nas phyir phebs skabs sgo 'gram nas zhal phyir bsgyur ba dang tshogs pa'i zhal 'don/ 'jig rten kun las khyad par 'phags par shog / gsung ba khrig ge 'phrod pas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur/ nyin der chos bzang ri khrod du phebs par gsol ston dang phebs rdzong gang gzab zhus rgya tig tsho ba brgyad dang / ra za/ sngo skor/ tshang kyā sogs grong 'brog mang pos spyi sger gyi mjal kha dang phebs rdzong zhu mi mang du byung / phyi nyin ri khrod pa rnams kyis gling 'dab su chibs bsgyur dang bstun dung 'bud dar 'bod mdzad pas phan tshun thams cad sems skyo ba tshad las 'das pa byung / don grub gzhis ka nas thon skabs gzhi bdag seng mtho'i 'phrul yin nam snyam pa'i nyams snang 'ga' zhig byung gsung / kun spangs dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po dge 'phel dpon slob dang / bya bral ba blo bzang zla ba gnyis dgon lung du phebs nas zhag kha shas kyi bar lhan du bzhugs te/ skabs 'ga' zhig tu chos kyi 'bel gtam dang / nyams mtshar gyi gsung gleng sna tshogs kyis bzhad gad theg ge ba dang / skabs la lar phan tshun so sor gyes tshun so sor gyes te rje nyid thag ring por chibs bskyod dgos pa'i gnas tshul gleng ba'i rkyen gyis skyo shas shugs drag pos mchi ma 'khrugs pa sogs dga' skyo'i 346

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /snang ba spel mer byung / btsan po dgon dang chu bzang 'dul ba nom chi tha yān chi rgyal sras ri khrod sems nyid dgon mchod rten thang sogs kyi bla ma 'ga' zhig dang las sne ci rigs sleb ste phebs rdzong bstar/ dgon lung gi lcang skya bla brang khri ba sum pa bla brang bde rgu bla brang wang bla brang li kyā bla brang rnams su gdan drangs shing ston mo dang rdzong ba gzabs/ grwa rkyang phal che bas kyang dngos 'dul 'deg rgyu cher med na'ang dad zhon ha cang che ba'i stabs kyis so sos gshag tu gdan drangs nas 'byor 'khos dang bstun pa'i bsnyen bkur zhus/ grong sde rnams nas gdan 'dren pa mang du byung yang 'byon bzhud kyi dus gtugs pas phebs ma thub par nyin re bzhin tshur bla brang du bsnyen bkur dang phebs rdzong zhu mkhan zam ma chad par byung /phyogs ris med nas skya ser gyi mjal ba khrom chen po'ang bar ma chad par 'ongs te so so'i 'dod mos ltar gyi chos zhu ba bka' bsgo zhu ba gsung brtag zhu ba skyabs 'jug zhu ba sman zhu pa srung mdud byin rten zhu ba phyag dbang zhu ba sogs nam langs nas mun sros kyi bar rgyun ma chad pa lta bu byung bas zhabs sdod rnams zhe sun cing mi lcogs pa lta bu byung na'ang rje nyid nas snying rje'i gzhanadabang du gyur pa'i stobs kyis cung zad tsam yang ngal ba'i rnam pa mi mdzad par de thams cad kyi re ba tshim nges su mdzad/ bkra shis 'khyil nas kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i bang chen dgon pa spyi'i mi sna bcas 'byor te rje bla ma mchog gi gsung shog dang phebs rdzong gi dngos po sbam mtho ba rnams spyan lam du bstar/ nyi shu gnyis kyi nyin gling 'dabs kyi gres thang du sgar btab ste zhabs phyi mang der bsdad/ sgo me ting skya dpon slob 'byor te gsung gleng smar zhing rdzong ba zhus/ nyi shu gsum gyi nyin gser gyi rgyal khab chen por chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur ba na ser skya'i khrom dmar nag nam mkha'i skar 347

༄/ /gung ca bstanapa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/tshogs lta bu 'dus shing gling 'dabs nas chibs kha lan gsum phyir bsgyur ba dang bstun dge 'dun rnams kyis thal skad dang sbrags pa'i dar 'bod mdzad/ dge 'dun rnams 'bral mi phod pas rgyang ring por phyi bzhin du 'brangs shing tha na lo brgyad dgu tsam las ma lon pa'i btsun chung mang pos kyang rjes bsnyegs nas 'ongs te phyag dang skor ba byed kyin 'dug pas grwa slob thams cad thugs skyo shas kyis 'khol ba byung / drag zhan gyi skyel mi shin tu mang bas byings rnams bzang skor du dgon pa spyi'i ja thab kyis nas phyir slog bzang skor zhing pa dpa' rin pa yan gong ma lcang skya'i grong sde rnams kyis gsol ja zhus zhag bab bar gyi rgya grong thams cad kyis kyang rang rang gi srang bar du rgya'i lugs kyi mchod pa'i yo byad dang bcas phyag 'tshal bar byed do/ / hor dum grong bas ja zhus mar tshang ru ba gong mar gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus de nub bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyi snang brnyan bzhugs pa'i lha khang gi 'dabs su mar tshang dpon tshang gi gzhir bzhugs khong tshang mas shangs len dang dngos 'bul gya nom pa zhus/ bla chen po'i sku gdung gi mdun du yan lag bdun pa maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa lam rim gsol 'debs dang bzang spyod smon lam sogs gsungs te thugs smon rgya gang che mdzad/ chos sde chen po bya khyung nas rje nyid dgon pa'i mkhan khrir phebs dgos tshul gyi zhu yig dang bla brang phyag mdzod dge bskos grwa rgan kha shas bcas de gar 'byor da res 7gong ma'i bkas rgyal khab tu 'gro dgos dang thug pas mkhan khrir yong stabs ma 'grog na'ang slad nas thugs 'dun bzhin sgrub pa'i 'dun pa byed ces bka' lan gnang / zhabs phyi dang skyel mi rnams la'ang nged rang lam du zhugs pa'i thog ma'i nyin rang la bstan pa'i me ro gso mdzadabla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyi mdun sar mdo smad kyi dgon sde'i 348

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /thog ma bya khyung chos sde'i mkhan khrir gdan 'dren zhu ba dang 'grigs ba ma bsgrigs rang 'grigs kyi rten 'brel rmad du byung bar snang / snga phyi'i rten 'brel rnams la dpags na nges par rang yul du myur du slebs nas bstan pa la bya ba byed rgyu yong ba 'dra gsung ste thugs shin tu dgyes pa'i rnam pa mdzad/phyi nyin mar tshang nas thon skabs bya khyung bas chibs skyel zhus shing dgon lung gi chibs skyel ba bde rgu mkhan po rgyud pa bla zur dpa' rin chos rje tshing kyā chos rje do lon mkhan po ri khrod bla ma kes shu'u zhabs drung tshogs chen dge bskos spyi gnyer dbu mdzad grwa rgan rnams phyir slog / de nub nem pe'i mkhar du zhag bzhugs gnang ba'i thog bkra shis chos gling gi bla ma las sne grwa mngadang bcas ba khra rdzong bra ste zhabs drung ngo g.yog 'brug lung sems nyid zhabs drung ngo g.yog rnams kyis gsol ston dang phebs rdzong gzab rgyas/gro tshang mkhan po ka ring zhabs drung thang ring cha gan bla ma bcas kyis mjal phyag dang rdzong ba phul/ nem pe'i shen gyis mjal phrad dang phebs skyel bsnyen bkur zhus stong shag gi a 'gon ma gtogs pa'i tsho ba tshang mas so sos bsnyen bkur dang 'bul ba phul cing sngar sa dpon gyi khral rigs shin tu lci ba rje nyid kyis bka' phebs te yang du bcug pa la bka' drin che tshul gyi legs so phul/ de nas btags te a kyā sgar ba'i nang du zhag bab gnang ba'i thog len hwa' thes kyi dge 'dun rnams phebs nas brtan bzhugs phul phyi nyin bcag mal mdzad cing dgon gsar thar pa gling ba mchod gzhis a nam zhi'i che a thar bcas kyis gsol ston dang phebs rdzong phul mā yang ri khrod a kyu ri khrodaganyis kyis kyang phebs rdzong btegs nyer drug la chos bzang ri khrod kyi dpon po 'jam dbyangs sku tsha bsod nams nor bu sogs skyel mi rnams phyir slob/ / bing ku'u zer bar tsha bab thog lo dkar ri khrod bas gsol ston dang 349

༄/ /gung thangabastan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/phebs rdzong phul 'brog pa mang tsam gyis mjal kha zhus/ nem be'i shen gyis gsol ja zhus shing mo'u tha la'i lha khang du zhag bab kye steng nas ser lung gi bla ma dang dge 'dun mang tsam gyis gzhis len dang dngos 'bul zhus par bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi lung stsal/ klu skyabs dpon po chung bas bsu skyel sogs bkur ste yang dag zhus phyi nyin 'ju lag gi gru kha nas thar pa gling bla ma cha gān bla ma ser lung bla ma rnams phyir slog ste zhin gran zer bar babs/ nyi shu brgyadal grung lang mkhar gye nye 'dabs kyi rgya'i lha khang zhig hu bzhugs par or du su dharma sirnyi wang gi mi sna 'ga' zhig gis mjal kha dang dngos 'bul zhus/ de'i phyi nyin phing tshong bo'u zer bar zhag bab thog stag lung dgon pa'i gnyer ba nang so bsu bar slebs te dgon par phebs dgos tshul gyi snyan gsan zhus rab rgyas sgar gyi bra ste zhabs drung ngo g.yog sleb nas rdzong ba zhus/zhwa dmar dgon pa'i dor zhi zhabs drung rgya tig chos rje sngags grwa'i grwa ba kha shas bcas la gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud dang bdag mdun cho ga'i bklag lung gnang / drug pa'i tshes gcig la zung shan thang nas zhwa dmar dgon gyi rtse thang mkhan zur bla ma khri ba bra ste zhabs drung se chen zhabs drung sku rten chos rje sogs ser skya nyis brgya lhag tsam gyes thab bsu stag lung zhabs drung ngo g.yog gis chibs bsu 'bri gung nang so bcas pa'i ser skya brgya lhag tsam gyes chibs bsu dang thab bsu ston mo gzab rgyas byas or thu zer ba'i sa char sgar babs/tshes gnyis kye nyin sgar thog tu zhwa dmar dgon mchod gzhis zhog kha drug bcas kyis gsol ston dang rta brgyad sogs phebs rdzong bstar skya ser gyi khrom la sbyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang dang bklag lung 'ga' zhig gnang / de nyin stag lung dgon du chibs bskyod bar bla zur gyis gtsos pa'i ser skya mang pos chibs bsu dang bla ma khri bas thog drangs dge 350

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /'dun gyis ser sbrengs bsgrigs ston mo dang phebs rdzong phul/ chos rwa nas zhabs drung dang khri gdan zur gtsos pa'i ser skya stong phrag tsam la dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid dang ljags lung thor bu 'ga' zhig stsal te mjug tu mjal ba thams cad la phyag dbang bka' drin bskyangs/ dgung mo sgar thog tu babs rjes zhwa dmar chos skyong sku phebs zhus nas 'byung 'gyur gyi don skor 'ga' zhig dri rmed mdzad par lo gsum gyi thog rang gi gdan sar phebs thub yong zhus 'dug pa ji bzhin thog tu khel ba byung snang / tshes gsum la 'bri gung dgon par gdan drangs te bsu ba ser sbrengs ston mo phebs rdzong sogs gang gzab zhus nang sos zhus ngor rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang stsal/a phyi'i mgon khang du 'phrin bcol nyer gtad gnad smin mdzad de sgar thog tu babs rgya yag dgon nas 'ongs pa'i dge gnyer sogs kyis phebs rdzong phul/ tshes bzhi lnga la 'brog sde 'ga' zhig gis gdan 'dren zhus shing sgar thog tu ser skya mang po la mjal kha phyag dbang 'dod chos sna tshogs kyis tshim par mdzad/ der bzhugs ring la 'bri gung pas thab shing 'o ma sogs bskyal ba dang 'bri stag gnyis gas mtshan mo rta drel gyi mel tshe zhabs tog gang drag hur skyed zhus shing stag lung bla brang nas rta drel rnga mong sogs kyis ngo'i thams cad zan yan ching bar du bskyal/ tshes drug la sgar btegs stag lung nang so dang chen hu 'bri gung nang so bcas kyis skyel thung zhus gan ku'u mda' ru gung ba pa dang pos te shwa'u zer bar zhag bab gnang / phyi nyin zan yan ching du 'byor par dmag dpon cong yes bkur gzos dang mtshan mor dmag mis mel tshe byas/ a lag shā nas thus lag cha tshang bar rdo rjes u lā rnga mong bzhi bcu zhe dgu dang bsu mi tha'i ji dharma pā la ngo g.yog rnams 'byor/ tshes brgyad la cho'u lon song go cho dang / dgur shor gol ci zer 351

༄/ /gung ca bstanaba'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/bar zhag bab byas/ tshes bcu'i nyin bye thang skya bo brgal te thung ge'i thus lag chis gur dang thab shing sogs gra bsgrigs kyi steng du babs/ bye gzhung 'di mgron po thams cad tsha gdung gis ngal dub dang zhon khal rnams chad lus sha stag 'ongs pa'i mya ngam thang skad grags can zhig yin pas rje nyid dpon g.yog rnams la'ang 'o brgyal che tsam e yong bsam yod kyang sngar dgung nub phyogs nas rlung chen pos sna drangs te sprin sar rim gyis 'khrigs shing char cung zad babs/ phyi nyin bye ri thon gyi bar sprin 'khrigs shing rlung bser bu ldang ba la bye gzhung thon phral sprin rnams slar yang zhal khebs bsal ba bzhin nub phyogs su dwangs song ba rang phyogs kyi yul lha zhig gis grogs byas pa'am skabs der rgyal gsol zhig gtong dgos pa 'dug gsung nas dpon g.yog kha shas kyis rgyal gsol bsam 'phel dbang rgyal zhig btang 'dug pa la dpag na sprul pa'i chos rgyal rnams kyis sdongs grogs bgyis pa'i mtshan ma gang rung du mngon/ phyi nyin bcag mal gyi thog thu sa lag chi'i nu bo dang bu sogs dmag la song ba'i rim gro dgos tshul gsol ba btab pa bzhin rta mgrin gyi bzlog pa bdud dbung pham pa'i rgyal rnga spyan dmigs nan tan dang bcas te bsgrubs/ 'di lo lan gru'u phyogs kyi hu'u hu'u sde 'ga' zhigango log pa la 7gong ma chen pos dpung 'jug mdzad pa'i dus zir dang thug pas sog sde'i sne zin gyi bar la lam bgrod dka' tsam yod na'ang rje nyid sku 'khor rta khal dang bcas pa nye zho cung zad kyang med par bde bar thon/thus lag chis bdog pa'i tshan grangs bstar zhing u lā rnga mong lnga bcu nga gcig na chen ja lang gis bdun tshe bo sman pa'i rnga rta brgyad bcas kyis yā mon bar du bskyal/ bcu gnyis la shi rig do lon dang bcu gsum la dwags po kun grol no mon han gyi bsu mi slebs shing ba yan hu dog la zhag / rim gyis 352

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /cab sar o su dar bag ge bum pa thu rnams su zhag mal gnang zhing nyin der 'jigs byed thu sa lag chi dang dwags po tshang gi phyag mdzod sogs kyis skya bsu dngakun grol no mon han rang nyid kyis gtses pa'i grwa tshang gi4ser sbrengs rol cha dang bcas khong gi sgar du gdan drangs/ dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal kha btags gos gnyis sa gdan kha shayorta dang rnga mong sogs 'bul skyes gya nom pa btegs/ bcu bdun la wang gi yā mon dang sa khad nye bar gzim gur me shing sogs kyi gra bsgrig zhus pa'i thog tu lha khang gi grwa ba rnams kyis ser sbrengs dang bcas te phebs/ wang gi sras gnyis dang thu sa lag chi gnyis blon po rnams dang dgon pa'i chos rje nang so las sne rnams dang dad 'dus kyi ser skya mang tsam la mjal kha gnang / bco brgyad la chin wang dbang chen dpal 'bar nu bo gnyis dang bcas dmag la song ba'i rim gror lha mo'i gtor zlog gam zlog mdos gang rigs shig sgrub dgos tshul nan cher zhus pa bzhin du bsgrubs pas mi mthun pa'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyi dga' ston mngon du gyur/ wang gi yā mon nas thab gsos dang gos yug bzhi rta bzhi rnga mong lnga sogs kyi 'bul nod dang gsol ston rgya gang che rta khal gyi mel tshe sogs bkur ste rim gro yang dag zhus/ bcu dgu'i zhog ka ser skya kha shas la gang blo ma'i bstod sgrub kyi byin rlabs dgu phrugs phog /wang gi ho shu'u nas rnga mong bdun cu zhon rta gang dgos bcas kyi u lngas rma chu'i gru kha bar du bskyal/ bcu dgu la yā mon steng nas btegs te a rig ces par 'byor cing nyi shu la yu che the'i dang nyer gcig la chi lon song go cho nyer gnyis la rma chu'i 'gram rnams su rim par babs/ rgya yul gyi 'khrugs pa zhi ba'i gtam gsan pas dgyes tshor che bar byung / or du su'i dpon po rnams hul su thes zer bar chol gan bgyis yod par legs so 'bul mi nang 353

༄/ /gung cabastan pa'ithon 'i gsung 'bum/so bstan 'gyur ched mngags gnang / rma chu'i 'gram du o thog pe'i li'i mtshams zhus pa car go chi sogs 'byor cing 'byung gnas mi rin gza' mi sogs phyag dbang zhu mi mang du 'dus pa rnams kyi re ba bskangs/ a lag shā dang or du su'i mi mang pos phyag g.yog zhus te shing gru bdun tsam gyis rma chu bde bar brgal/ nyer gsum la a lag sha'i skyel mi nu so hes tha'i ji ngo g.yoga.u lā dang bcas pa phyir slog / yo thog pe li'i rnga mong drug cu rta lnga bcu tsam gyi u wa steng nas phebs pas nyin der ca tā ge thu dang phyi nyin khu shus zer bar zhag / de'i phyi nyin yi khe u sor tsha bab kyi thog cha gan bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dpon g.yog 'byor cing dgung mo u lān cher ga zer bar babs/ 'di nas bzung tsha zhag gar babs su dad 'dus kyi ser skya pho mo'i khrom shin tu che ba byung ba la phyag dbang dang ljagasabasngo bka' bsgo sogs gang 'dod bka' drin lhug par stsal cing dmigs brtse ma dang rigs gsum mgon po'i snying po khyad par du byams pas dam bca'i gzungs 'di su'i rna lam du thos kyang rgyal ba byams pa 'jig rten du 'byon dus mjal te byang chub tu lung ston par byams mgon rang nyid kyis dam bca' mdzad pas phan yon shin tu che bar dgongs te phyogs 'dus kyi mjal ba tshogs che ba byung res kyes gsung gdangs mthon po'i sgo nas kun gyi rna lam du bsgrags shing bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor gnad smin thugs khur che bzhes mdzad/ brel ba gzhan med dus khrom pa'i steng gi nam mkhar spyan ras gzigs gsal btab ste bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyang gi spyan dmigs dang bcas bla slob tshang mas lhan du yig drug brgya phrag kha shas re 'ur 'don dang mjug tu ma ṇi khas len bskor ba dge rtsa de dag kyang bla med byang chub kyi rgyur thugs kyi 'dun pa drag pos kha bsgyur ba sogs mthong thos dran reg don ldan du 'gyur ba'i thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pa 354

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bzang po sgo du ma nas phyag bzhes su bstar/ zhal nas kyang 'brel ba thogs tshad la gnas skabs dang mthar thug dge ba'i smon lam yang yang 'debs pa sogs rang 'khos dang dpag pa'i lhag bsam rgya gang che byed khul bgyis pa snyigs dus kyi bla chen spyi'i phyag srol las cung zad 'phags pa'i rnam thar 'buradod cig tu rlom par mchis gsung ba ni skye bo blo gros can zhig gis brtags na shin tu thugs mad par ma zad dam pa'i go sar bzhugs pa mtha' dag gis gsan cing mkhyen par bya dgos pa'i gnas ngo gal shin tu che ba zhig tu sems so/ / nyi shu drug la o thog pe li'i ul ju'u thu lha khang gi mkhan po tā bla ma nā bhena'i chos rje rgyud pa'i bla ma dbu mdzad sogs kyis mdun bsus te jo so'i po ro tho lo ge zhes par babs pe li'i ma gnyis dang dpon mo sras sras mo sogs ser skya shin tu mang bar mjal kha dang spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang stsal/ pe lis rta rnga mong dgu dang ma gnyis dang dpon mo bla ma rnams so sos 'bul ba gzabs shing pe li'i sring mo bkra shis lha mos dngul gye sga srab rin po che'i rgyan ldan rta dang bcas pa phul/ byin rten 'gang che ba zhig dgos zhus par mkha' spyod ma'i li sku zhig gnang / har chin nas sbyin bdag chin wang rat+na sidhis chibs bsur mngags pa'i khā ā nan+ta nye ba skal ldan ngo g.yog 'byor nas wang gis phul ba'i yi ge dang lam bar du mkho ba'i nyer spyad sna tshogs 'bul rgyu bskur ba rnams spyan lam du bstar/ wang gi yi ge 'bul skabs sgar thog gi zhabs phyi ba rnams tshogs nas zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'don gyen yod pa dang 'grigs pas zhabs brtan phul ba lta bu'irten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa byung / nyi shu bdun la o thog gi u lā phyir slog ste u'u shing pe zi dang ja sag dbang rgyal tshe brtan rdo rje gnyis kyi rta yul stong nas byon/ har u so zer bar mor gon a te tshe dbang rdo rjes tsha 355

༄/ /gung bstan pa'isgronaḥ gsung 'bum/bab kyi gsol ja zhus shing rnga mong dgu phul rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang dang phyir zlog 'khor lo 'bar ba'i bklag lung stsal zhag mal tsha gan chir zer bar bzhugs/ phyir nyin chi gī ci rim du babs shing zhag mal snga phyi'i nye 'dabs su mtsho kha shas yod pa nas sprin langs te sgar thog tu char zim bu yang yang 'bab pa byung ba klu dga' ba'i ltas su mngon/ nyi shu dgu la mar gen a tes sogs skyel mi rnams dang u lā rnams phyir slog hang gin pe zis sa rim phul/ tha'i ji ngo g.yog bsu mir 'byor rta gnyis dang rnga mong gcig phularwa rag tu zhag bab bgyis ta lad pe'i zi'i tho yon sogs la bklag lung 'ga' zhig gnang / gnam gang gi nyin dgon lung khri ba bde rgu dpon slob ri bo rtse lngar gnas mjal la phebs nas phyir 'khor te mjal du byung bar gsung gleng dmar bar mdzad/ khong dpon g.yog ku su lu'i chas su zhugs nas phebs pas 'o brgyal 'dug par rta gnyis gnang mur gu chig gi su me zer ba'i lha khang gi mdun sar sgar phab/ dharma sidhi wang gi dpon mo sogs kyis mjal kha zhus shing rta bzhi dang rnga mong gcig phul/ skabs 'dir bkas mngags pa'i tā zhin sto de phyir log pa dang mkhar sngon gyi jang jun sung kung nyang shā mkhar du 'gro ba bcas u lā rgyug dgos stobs chen lhan du 'dzom pas sa rim sogs thon dka' tsam yod kyang or du su 'di stobs 'byor che ba dang lhag par bla ma dkon mchog la dad gus mi 'dra zhing khyad par du rje nyid la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes lta bu'i moyogus tshad med pa'i stobs kyis nus pa rtsal sprug byas te tshe zhag gi gra bsgrig rta yul sogs cung zad kyang le thogs med pa byung ja sag tha'i ji'i sku skye zhig gis phral du bsnyen rdzogs dgos zer bar bsnyen rdzogs kyi cho ga rta thog ma zhig 'dul bar ma bshad gsung nas ma gnang ba ni sbyin bdag gi ngor bltas te lag len ris su 'bor ba dag gi 356

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /spyod tshul las rgyab kyis phyogs pa bstan pa kho na gces par dgongs pa'i rnam tharadu mngon/ bdun pa'i tshes gcig la jer ge zhes par che bab kyi steng nas wang gi skyel mi chos rje sogs phyir slog ste de nub e khi na dīn du bzhugs/tshes gnyis la cu 'un gar pe zi'i bsu mi dge bskos dang cang gi zhig da lang pe zi'i thus lag chi tā bla ma tha'i ji gcig rnams 'byor hol thu ni gol zhes par tsha bab thog hang gin pe zi'i skyel mi u lā bcas slog / da lad pe zi'i rta dang rnga mong shing rta sna tshogs byung ba'i steng nas phebs te shar o sun ni er ki zhes par babs/ da lan pe zi'i dngul srang lnga bcu rta lnga wang dharma sirnyis dngul srang brgya bcas phul/ da lad kyi dpon po rgya nyams che bas 'bangs rnams kyang gtso bo'i rjes su 'brang pas 'bangs kyang rgya nyams che zhing bsngo ba zhu mkhan ches maṇ+ḍal brtan bzhugs smon lam bkra shis dang bcas pa 'don pa sogs kyi srol cha mi mtshungs pa yong 'dug pa ni/ legs bshad tshol gyi yal 'dab las/ gang dag sa bdag byed pa de de mtha' dag skye bo byed par 'gyur/ / gsung ba'i don du snang / tshes gsum la o'u shing pe zi'i mi sna chos rje cang gi zhig 'byor/ cha ma hag gi e kher cu bun gar pe zi tho yon mkhan po dang dge legs chos rje'i sku skye dge bskos sogs mang tsam bsrubar slebs shing shi ne jo bo'i su me dge 'phel gling du chibs bsgyur gyi snyan gsan zhus/ cha ma hag tu tsha bab kyi tshe ja sag drug gi dpon po rnams bkasamangags pa'i am bhan po ti dang lhan du dmag la song ba phyir 'khor nas je go su phu thu'o lha khang du chos gan la 'tshogs yod pa dang 'grigs bas da lad tā pe zi o thog tā pe li hang gin pe zi cu kun gar pe zi ja sag tha'i ji so so'i thu sa lag chi ja khi rog chi mi rin sogs ngo g.yog mang tsam mjal khar slebs/ lam bar du am bhan gye mtshams zhu ba slebs shing je ge su thu su 357

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'izlaname'i ga4 'bum/mer am bhan dang ngos phrad gnang / rgyal mtshan lha khang dpal 'bar gling du grwa pa rnams kyis spos rol dang bcas gdan drangs wang gi tā bla ma dang ta lad pe zi'i skyel mi u lā bcas phyir slog / tshes bzhi la cu'un gar pe zis u lā phul lam bar du dge 'phel gling gi bla ma chos rje dge bskos sogs kyis bsu ba bgyis/ dge 'dun rnams kyis ser sbrengs dang mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs 'bud dkrol gye rol mo sna tshogs dang bcas jo bo'i lha khang gsar bar gdan drangs mkhan po'i bla brang du paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa bzhugs zhag mdzad pa'i khang ba zhig 'dug pa der phyag phab/ snga mo rje nyid der zhag bzhugs gnang skabs dgon gnas 'di mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas shig yin pa 'dra ba'i mtshan ltas 'ga' zhig byung bas da lan mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub mchod cig e thub dgongs pa yod kyang brel ba che stabs kyis ma grub/lam bgrod kyi rim gror rgyal gsol gzab rgyus shig btang cu'un gar pe zi 'di kho rang gi pha'i dus nas sku zhabs nyid kyi yon bdag dwangs ma zhig yin zhing bar skabs sun tsha shi chad sogs rkyen ngan du ma zhig byung ba dang pe zi 'di'ang skabs skabs su dran pa mi zin pa sogs bgegs 'tshub shin tu che ba 'dug pas da lan sri gnon zhig dgos tshul gsol ba nan cher btab kyang 'di res 7gong ma'i mtshams zhu'i nyi skar thag nye bas sgrub long mi 'dug cing phyir 'khor skabs 'dod bstun byas chog pa'i zhal bzhes stsal/ tshes lnga'i nyin pe zi'i rim gror rta mgrin gsang sgrub kye bdag mdun dang 'brel ba'i zlog pa rnam rgyal stobs kyi mtshon cha rgyal rdzong rgyas pa bcas btang zhing mjug tu dpon g.yog tshang ma la bkra shis dang dge mtshan spel ba'i chog dge legs rgya mtsho'i char 'bebs gang rgyas gnang / rgyal rdzong skabs sog po rta pa mang po zhig ku dir dang bcas rgyal gzugs la zhugs 'gro ba'i gzigs snang byung 358

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /zhingade mtshungs pe'i zi kho rang gis kyang phyi rol nas mi mang pos skad ring gtongab lta bu thos 'dug pa gnod byed mngon sum du bskrad pa'i mtshan ma mthun snang du grub pe'i zis legs 'bul rta bzhi dang rnga mong gcig dngul gos dar sogs dang tho yon mkhan pos rta gnyis bsam 'grub 'thus lag chis rta drug dre'u bzhi dngul sring lnga bcu de'i nu bo tsha dbang rdo rjes dngul srang lnga bcu dang rta gcig yar 'phel thu sa lag chis rta gsum dngul srang lnga bcugazhan yang che phra du mas 'bul ba gzab rgyas phul/ nyin snga phyir ser skya'i khrom shin tu che ba la mjal kha phyag dbang btang / mkhar sngon po'i tham ga bla ma chos skyabs ti yān che'i dgon pa'i tā bla ma dang chos rje dge bskos rnams bsu bar slebs/ skyabs mgon lcang skya rdo rje 'chang ri bo rtse lngar bzhug sa pa la mtshams zhu dang 7gong mar mjal phrad kyi skor la bslab ston zhu mi nang so bstan 'dzin drung yig mā nan+ta bcas rta shad kyis mngags/ tshes drug la rma chu'i 'gram du tsha bab gnang ste thu med kyi mo'u das zer ba'i shing grus rma chu brgal nas ba yan cha gan zer bar zhag / bdun la hor ha tshar tsha bab thog mkhar sngon tham ga bla ma chos skyabs zhabs drung dpon g.yog gis phebs bsu dang gsol ja zhus thu med kyi ser skya mang po zhig la phyag dbang stsal de nub ne ne yo'u la zhes pa'i ri 'dabs sa lus zhes par bzhugs zhag mdzad/ brgyad la ngag dbang ye shes tā bla ma dang ja sag bla ma cha har zhabs drung sogs bsu bar slebs pi chig chi'i su mer tham ga bla ma dang kho rang gi dgon pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis gsol ston zhus shing nang mdzod dngul maṇa bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gos chen rgyan bzhi gcig rta gcig bcas brtan bzhugs lugs su phul/ har chen nas khal rta sogs khyer yong mi no mon tshang ja lan hu bi thu khā bstan 'gyur khā jang gi gcig khun tu 359

༄/ /gung bstanapa'isgronasa'agasu 'bum/gsumadang gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas dang a ke pu rna pā las chibs bsur mngags pa'i ming gan ha wang shu lug thu kha sogs 'byor/ mkhar sngon phu yen bla ma dang khu re bdun gyi ja sag bla ma rnams bsu bar 'byor zhing de'i hā mong zer ba'i grong ba'i nang du thab bsu'i gsol ston drangs dge rgan pā shing du bzhugs zhag gnang / tshes dgu'i nyin yi khi jo bo'i lha khang du khu re bdun gyi spyi nas gsol ston dang brtan bzhugs lugs su maṇ+ḍal kha btags bzhugs gdan rgyab yol bcas phul de nyin tham ga bla ma'i gshag tu bzhugs/thu med kye kā le tā rnams dang mjal kha zhu mi ser skya shin tu mang po 'dus par phyag dbang sogs kyes re ba bskangs/ chos skyabs zhabs drung 'di snga mo dbus gtsang du yod skabs rje nyid las dbang lung man ngag mang po nyan nas dad zhen shin tu che stabs nyid mdo smad du phebs skabs cha rkyen gzab rgyas phul cing rje bla ma mchogasnga sor shar phyogs rgyal khab chen por lan gnyis chibs bsgyur ba'i tshe 'bul nod khal rta'i mthun rkyen sogs gang gzab dang da lan kyang 'khos dpags kyi bkur ste rim gro phul du phyin pa zhus 'dug na'ang zhabs drung 'di pa sngar sgrub pa nyams len zhig gi 'dun pa che bar yod pa las phyis su bla chen lugs kyi 'phrin las rgyas pas de'i steng du ma khel 'dug par thugs ma mnyes nas nged rang bla slob gnyis ga'i byed spyod 'di 'phral yin mdog kha bo 'dug ste phugs mdzo sprel g.yang bskyur lta bu min nam gsung nas bka' bkyon gyi rnam pa'ang mdzad 'dug pa ni rang la dga' zhing phan pa tsam rgyu mtshan du byas te dgyes 'dzum lhug par ston pa'i rigs ma yin paraslob ma'i phugs kyi khe nyen kho na la dgongs pa bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i rnam thar du snang ngo / / tshes bcu'i nyin cu'un gar pe'i zi'i skyel mi mkhan po dang thus lag chi bsam grub ngo g.yog rnams phyir slog / tham ga 360

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chosakyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bla ma phu yan bla ma ja sag tā bla ma rnam4kyis phebs skyel dang tham ga bla mas rnga mong dang dre'u ci rigs kyi u lā bcas yi khe cha gān khu rer zhag bab mdzad/bcu gcig la thu med kyi sa mtshams ha rol khar tsha bab steng nas tham ga bla ma'i skyel mi tā bla ma ngo g.yog phyir slog ste rje nyigal sgang zhig tu skyo bsangs la phebs pas shar lho'i mtshams su sprul pa'i gnas mchog ri bo rtse lnga yod tshul 'ga' zhig mol bar brten pha bla ma bka' drin can de da lta gnas der sku gzibyin lham mer bzhugs yod snyam du sku'i rnamapa thugs ngor bkra lam me shar cing spyir bstan 'gro yongs la bka' drin che ba dang / sgos su nyid la chosasred gnyis char nas bka' drin tshang ma mchis tshul rnams dran nas dad pa dang skyo ba 'dres ma zhig gis thugs gting nas g.yos te mgur dbyangs thol byung du mdzad pa ni 'di ltar/ dpal rigs brgya rigs lnga rigs gsum kun/ / don gcig tu 'dus pa rdo rje 'chang / / pha bla ma dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag / khyed snying nas dran no brtse bas skyong / / sngon rgyal po gser gyi mtshan can gyis/ / lha spyan ras gzigs dbang mi yi gar/ / bod gangs can mgon po thams cad mkhyen/ / rje bsod nams rgya mtsho spyan drangs shing / / de'i sprul sku yon tan rgya mtsho nyid/ / sku 'khrungs shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ / dus da lta mkhar sngon zhes grags pa'i/ /gnas 'di yi shar lho'i mtshams kyi ngos/ / lha 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa'i gnas/ / ri dwags bsil lhun po rtse lnga zhes/ / dpal shākya'i rgyal pos lung bstan pa'i/ / gnas ngo mtshar khyad du 'phags pa yod/ / de'i dbus ri'i 'dab kyi gtsug lag khang / / mtshan byang chub sems dpa'i spo zhes pa'i/ / phyogs shar ngos rgyang grags tsam gyi sar/ / sngon slob dpon burnya pā li tas/ / gzungs gtsug tor rnam rgyal spyan drangs pa'i/ / gnas rdo rje'i 361

༄/ /gung ba balhan ba'ithonaḥ gsungangabum /phugs pa zhes bya bar/ / sprang bdag gi 'dren mchog thams cad mkhyen/ /mtshan rol pa'i rdo rjer grags pa bzhugs/ / nang bde stong lha yi rnal 'byor las/ / dus nam yang g.yo ba mi mnga' yang / / phyi 'dul ba'i kun spyod gtso bor mdzad/ / pha khyed kyi rnam thar bsam zhing dad/ / sku bag yod zhi dul spyod lam can/ / rgyang ring bor tshul khrims dri ngad 'thul/ / mthong tsam gyis snang ba 'gyur ba de/ / dus da lta nyid du mjal snying 'dod/ /gsung mtho dman 'tsham zhing rna bar snyan/ / blo rab 'bring tha ma'i gdul bya la/ / chos zab rgyas gang 'tsham 'dom pa de/ / dus de ring thos na dga' bal/ / thugs bde chen ngang las g.yo med kyang / / byams brtse bas 'gro don 'ba' zhig dgongs/ / spangs rtogs pa'i yon tan gter chen de/ /dus da lta thob na ci ma rung / / dus snyigs ma'i dmu rgod brlang spyod la/ /thugs skyo med bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i khur/ / rang gcig pus bzhes pa'i snying stobs de/ / pha khyed las gzhan la yod re skan/ / dus da lta'i cher rlom phal mo ches/ / rang gcig pu'i rnyed bkur 'ba' zhig sems/ / khyed rang don dor nas bstan 'gror dgongs/ / 'di bsam gyin khyed nyid kho nar dad/ / khong chen po rnams kyis bkur na yang / / thugs khengs dregs mi mdzad nyam chung la/ / ches lhag par brtse ba'i ngang tshul de/ / bdag bsam gyin dad pa'i spu long g.yo/ / dus deng sang mtha' dbus gang du yang / /rje thub bstan cung zad gnas pa 'di/ / pha khyed rang gcig pu'i drin du nges/ / 'di bsam gyin dad pa gting nas skyes/ / khong shar phyogs mi yi dbang phyug de/ / rgyud dad pas bstan la gus mchod pa/ / pha khyed kyi thugs rje 'ba' zhig mthu/ / tshul 'dis kyang khyed la snying nas dad/ / sgos btsun gzugs dharma badz+ra bdag / khong mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs bsten 362
