༄༅/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /kyang / / chos mdo sngags lam gyi snying po can/ / rje khyod kyi bka' drin kho na4rnyed/ / dus da lta'i rang mnyam bstan 'dzin khrod/ / chos gdams pa'i nor gyis bdag rang phyug / 'di pha rgan khyed kyi bka' drin yin/ / drin 'khor thabs ma mchis bla ma rje/ / khyed dgyes pa'i thabs gzhan bdag la med/ / gnas yid 'od dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ / tshe sgrub pa snyoms pa'idam bca' bgyid/ / 'di gegs med 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /dusakhyang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ / khyed thugs rje'i lcags kyus nyam chung bdag / dus skad cig tsam yang ma gtong bar/ / mchog sangs rgyas sa la 'god du gsol/ / gtam 'di las byung ba'i dge ba'i mthus/ / pha bla ma'i zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan/ / 'bangs bdag kyang gzhon nu nor bzang bzhin/ / mgon bshes gnyen bsten la zla bral shog / ces pa'o/ / de nas btegs te teb tshig ces par zhag / bcu gnyis la tsha bab chin ta ma ni zer bar gnang zhing snga ma 'byon skabs shig tu ri 'di'i shing nags sogs ma bcad na legs 'dug gsung ba cha gar ba rnams kyis dang blangs bgyis pas ri ngos 'khri shing sna tshogs kyis gtams pas byin chags pa zhig byung zhing de mthun yul phyogs su'ang lo chu sogs 'phan dar ba byung tshul zhus snang / phyi nyin yal than pu se'i lha khang mdun gyi thang shar cul ger zhag skabs lha khang gi dge 'dun rnams kyis gsol ja sogs kyi bsnyen bkur zhus shing phyogs so so'i mjal ba mang du 'dus pa'i re ba bskangs/ bcu bzhi la gu lu u lan gyi cho ge zer ba dang gu lu sha ra'i gu shri su ma'i tā bla ma blo bzang ye shes gnyis kyi nang du gdan drangs bsnyen bkur 'bul ba gzabs pa yan tho lo go'i zer bar ul cu'u thu cang gis khyim du gdan drangs bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas zhus shing / dngul srang bcu dang rnga rta gsum sogs phul 363

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung babum/bu gcong nad can zhig 'dug par khyung nag gi rjes gnang dgos tshul ltar rjes gnang dang sman sogs stsal er gi nag tu sgar phab/ bco lnga la con tā bsodanams tshe ring gi khyim du bsnyen bkur zhus cha gan er gi zhes par hu bi thu khā zer pas gsol ja zhus shing ser skya mang tsam la phyag dbang gnang /har chin nas sbyin bdag chen wang gi sras gsum pa lha rgyal rdo rje dang sras lnga pa bsod nams dpal ldan mi rin tig cor sogs bsu bar 'byor wang gis bskur ba'i yi ge shing thog sogs bza' bca' sna tshogs dang gzhan drag zhan mang pos mtshams zhu bskur ba rnams phul cing thog ma'i mjal phrad kyi rten 'brel du sras che bas nor bu don yod zhags pa dang chung bas cha spyad sna tshogs yod pa'i sgam chung khyad mtshar zhig phul nyid nas kyang so so la rta bzang re'i gnang sbyin mdzad ho tho zer ba'i sa char sgar phab/ bcu drug la sras lnga pa 7gong ma'i phyag g.yog la sleb dgos pa'i rings khyad kyis snga 'gros su rta shad kyis thon zhing sras gsum pa sogs zhabs phyir 'brangs skal ldan tshe ring tā dang dge bskos dge 'dun spun gyis khyim du bsnyen bkur zhus/ 7gong ma'i su rug chi grom phan tā zhig gis khyim du bsnyen bkur zhus shing sngar byi ba'i lo khong tshang gis gdan 'dren zhus skabs rigs rgyud med pas de'i ched du rim gro gang phan zhus par sku zhabs nyid nas tshe ring mched lnga mchod na bu lnga yod gsung ba bzhin bsgrub pa'i thugs rjes da cha bu lnga yod tshul zhus te tshad med pa'i gus zhen byed cing bsnyen bkur yang dag bsgrubs/ tha la bu lag tu zhag pa'i thog dar rgyas dge slong zer bas sgar thog tu bsnyen bkur drangs te sngo ba zhus zla 'dzin byung bar ro rkyang gi rgyu ba rtu tīr tshud pa'i rten 'brel gyis 'gyur che bar dgongs te zla ba gza' las grol gyi bar zhal 'don nan tan mdzad/ bcu bdun la pa yan cha gān du nor bu rin chan tā dang 364

sa༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nye ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /tshe ring bkra shis ka li tā gnyis kyi khyim du gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur bstabs/ snga phyir gdan 'dren zhu mkhan tsho'i khyim du chi ge 'dren skabs mi khyim gang 'tshogs pa'i dbus su ban gzhon rnams mgrin pa bsdebs nas glu len cing gzhan rnams kyis de'i mthun 'gyur lta bu byed pa sogs yul lugs kyi dga' ston gang rgyas zhus/ zhal nas kyang 'di 'dra'i rigs rnams gnas skabs skyid mdog kha bo 'dug rung chos 'dul ba dang 'gal ba'i nyes dmigs 'byung nyen shin tu che bas dran shes gang drag rgyun du bsten cing bde stong gi rnam rol tu blta ba'i khul bgyis pa yin/ nor lug bsad pa'i sha'i 'tsho ba byung skabs bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te bla ma yi dam la phul zhing sems can de'i ched du gsol 'debs bsngo smon nan tan dang sdig sgrib spyong ba'i gzungs sngags bzlas te rus bu la 'debs pa sogs bgyis pa yin gsungs pa ni bstan pa'i gnad shes pa zhig gis brtags na bsngags pa'i 'os su gyur ba'i che ba rmad du byung ba zhig ste zas gos gnas mal sogs la longs spyod pa'i 'tshe 'du shes bcos tshul long ba gzhir gtogs kyi skabs dang sman gzhi sogs 'dul ba las rgya cher gsungs la/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las kyang med du mi rung bar de thams cad gzhan don gyi bsam pasazin dgos pa dang rdo rje theg pa'i skabs su de thams cad bde stong gi rol par blta zhing zas rnams nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul du spyod pa bza' ba'i dam tshig tu gsungs pas de gcig pu'i steng du'ang bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi nyams len tshang ba rgyal ba dgyes pa'i rnam thar bla na ma mchis pa'o/ / tshu ru thur zhag bab kyi steng du nom chi su me'i bla ma byams pa rab 'byams pa zer bas bsnyen bkur gzabs khong snga ma bod du song ba'i grwa rnying zhig yin 'dug pas 'dus pa'i skor las brtsams pa'i chos kyi gsung gleng dmar pa gnang /365

༄/ /gung thang bstanaba'isgroname'i ga4 'a ma/bco brgyad la a to'u tā rab brtan rdo rjes sgar thog tu bsnyen bkur phul btsun ma ngag dbang byang chub kyis khyim du bsnyen bkur 'bul nod bstabs cha khur thu zhes par zhag bab gnang / bcu dgur ku lu cha gān gyi ho sho'u su mer tsha bab steng mjal kha zhu mi mang tsam zhig la phyag dbang sogs gang 'dod stsal phur ga so thur zhag mal gyi steng du mtshan sgog mkhan chen gyi bla brang nas mngagasapa'i mi sna 'byor nas dkar spro zhus/ nyi shu la do lon no'ur nas lcangs rin po che'i dem chi bstan 'dzin bkra shis smin grol no mon han gyi gnyerab shes rab ra kho hu thog thu'i mi sna bcas bsu bar 'byor cing thab bsu'i ston mo sogs bgyis pā shing thur sgar babs/ phyi nyin rtsa ba'i sbyin bdag har chin wang gi sras lha btsun sang gha shri 'jam dpal nor bu wang gi su me'i tā bla ma ku thi bsam 'grub ba yan cha gān zhabs drung rnams dang gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyi bu dpal 'byor a ke a ke bu r+ṇa pā la lha skyabs gung gi bu ma hā dharma don grub rdo rje'i tha'i ji har chin pe zi 'chi med rdo rje'i sras 'jigs byed skyabs kyi mi sna pe zi bstan pa dar rgyas kyi mi sna/ e phu dge legs bsam 'grub tsan+d+ra pa la smon lam rab 'byams pa tho yon bkra shis dar rgyasayo'u han wang 'chi med grub pa bcas kyi mi sna rnams rim pas bsu bar 'byor/ ha tho bu lag zer bar do lon no'ur gyi dgon pa gnyis ga'i gnyer pa sogs grwa ba mang tsam 'byor cing thab bsu'i dga' ston zhus do lon no'ur du dgon pa dang ha cang thag mi ring ba'i sar sgar babs/ dgon pa gnyis dngadaga' ldan gser khri tham ga bla ma bi chag thu no mon han ra kho hu thog thu bka' 'gyur pa no mon han a kyā hu thog thu rnams kyi bla brang so sos dang ku lu khu kho'i hu pil gan bla ma bcas kyis dkar spro zhus/ sbyin bdag wang gi lha btsunaganyis kyis gsol ja dang bzhes spro zhus thog wang gi mi sna phas than tā 366

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /la ba thu gsar du 'byor cing wang yab yum sogs kyis bskur ba'i mtshams zhu'i yi ge sogs phul pa rang babs su stabs 'grigs pa mchod yon dam tshig gtsang ba'i rten 'brel du dgongs te dgyes tshor mdzad/ dga' ldan shi re ge thu'i ja sag sum gnyis kyi tā bla ma rnams mjal bar slebs pas gsung 'phros mdzad dgon pa gnyis kyi dge 'dun rnams dang dpon che phra sogs drag zhan gyi mjal ba shin tu mang ba nyin snga phyir bar mtshams med pa lta bu byung / nyi shu gnyis la bcag mal gnang thog pe zi bstan pa dar rgyas kyi mi snas dngul srang lnga bcas brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs/ smon lam bla ma e phu dge legs bsam 'grub tsan+d+ra pā la 'jigs byed skyabs rnams kyis thab bsu'i gsol ja zhus lha khang ser por mchod mjal zhib tu gnang /lcabaskya rin po che'i zhabs phyi rnying ba dem chi bstan pa steng grib kyis thebs 'dug par phan thabs shig bka' drin che dgos tshul zhus par dug dbyung sogs gza' bcos nan bskyed cig byas na phan thogs yong tshod 'dug kyang long skabs mi 'dug tsher ma 'don pa bzhin phral du sel rgyu dka' 'ang pha bla ma'i zhabs phyi rnying ba yin pas gal chen zhig byed dgos gsungs te gsang bdagamag tri pā la'i drag sngags drang srong gi dmod pa dang bcas pa'i spyan dmigs nan cher gnang / nyer gsum la lha khang so so'i las sne rnams kyis skyel thung bgyis shing de nub yi cwa mthar bar babs u kher tā ol cu pas zer bas zhabs tog zhus/ ku lu khu khu'i zhabs drung chibs skyel du 'ongs pas mjal kha gsol ston zhus shing khong gi lha bzo bas sgrol dkar gyi thang ga byon legs shig phul/ nyi shu bzhi la do lon hu su zhes par bzhugs zhag gi thog her han gyi gzhi bdag la gsol mchod dgos pa'i mtshan ma rmang lam du byungab bzhin bsang dang gtor ma sogs btang char 'bab tu nye ba la char 367

༄/ /gung bang bstanami'izlaname'igasung 'bum/'gog gi dar spyog g.yob tu bcug pas 'gog thub pa byung ste der 'khod rnamasaya mtshan du gyur/ nyi shu lngar har chin do mang du ho shu'u'i ja sag gung mahā ba la'i bsu mi dang sbyin bdag wang gi ha thon bsu bar yong gi yod tshul gyi snga 'gros su btang ba'i mi sna ca khi rog chi shi re mi ngo g.yog wang gi bla ma paṇ+ḍi ta hu thog thu'i grwa ba pā ri na wang pa thu dang de'i jo jo a sa ha am bhan e phu bde legs bzang po gnyis kyi mi sna rnams rim par 'byor/ yu lan po thong du tsha bab skabs bsam 'phel ā ke'i kai kai gnyis kyi mi sna 'byor no'u chid bzhes par sgar phab/ tha bu nang bsam grub ngo g.yog 'byor nyin snga phyi'i lam bar rnams su spang ljongs dang ljon shing sna tshogs 'khrigs shing me tog du ma 'khrungs 'dug par gzigs te rang yul gyi sa cha'i nyams shig 'dug gsung spro ba'i rnam pa mdzad/ nyi shu drug la si han mo do zhes par tsha bab thog sbyin bdag wang gi btsun mo ma ṇi dha rā ke ke nor 'dzin ma ho sho'u ke ke bsod nams blo lam ke ke o yon ta les ke ke ku mu da a ke bde chen rab rgyas rnams bsu bar slebs/ btsun mos sgrol dkar gyi thang ga tshem grub sogs thog ma'i mjal phyag gi rten 'brel du phul cing ke ke gzhan tshos kyang rten 'brel gyi rdzas ci rigs phul gsol ja dang shing thog sna tshogs kyi bsnyen bkur bstabs/ bsam grub a kes gsol ja zhus cir ga lang thu zhes par sgar babs/ nyi shu bdun la 'jam dbyangs 7gong ma chen po nas rje 'di ba zhe hor du nam gleb yong zhes bka' 'dri gnang tshul har chin wang gi yi ge dang bcas mi sna 'byor/ thu sa lag chi tshul khrims tha bo nang har chin chaphu rnam rgyal gyi bu dzā na gi ti ja sag gung ma hā pā la'i nu bo ma hā yan yong nyod dbang chen tho yon rnams bsu bar slebs char zim bu babs shing 'ja' 'od kyigur khyim rim pa gnyis yod pa zhig shar/ dgon lung nas thon te 'di 368

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /yan 'ja' tshon ya mtshan pa lan dgu'i bar du shar ba stabs 'grigs tsam ma yin pa'i ltas khyad par ba zhig yin par sems/ yong nyod nang so mkhas grub kyis gsol ja sogs kyi bsnyen bkur gzabs yin ji tha bon ger zhes par zhag bab gnang / nyi shu brgyad kyi nyin ong nyod wang gi mi sna rnam sras a ke'i lha khang dang bka' 'gyur su me bcas kyi bsu mi tha bo nang rdo rje lha btsun zhabs drung bsod nams nor bu ong nyod wang gi su me'i tā bla ma ngo g.yog phe than tā ong nyod a ke marga la dang har chin gung gi mi sna ja lang tel gerarnams 'byor/ khu ri thu zhes par ong nyod tha'i ji mgo las dkar spro zhus har chin gung lha skyabs 'byor cing thab bsu'i gsol ston zhus ong nyod wang gi ho ro'i nye 'dabs su sgar btab nyin snga phyir lam bar du gsol ja zhu mi dang tsha zhag gi sa dang lam bar ci rigs par mjal phyag zhu mi tshan che ba bar ma chad pa byung / nyi shu dgu la ong nyod wang gis gsol ja dkar spro zhus shing ha thon tha'i ji sogs mang tsam la mjal kha bka' bsgo sogs mos pa bzhin gnang / gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyi a ke de ba rā dza sogs ngo g.yog tha bo nang mon khu u la ju'u wang gi ja lang eng khe rnams bsu bar 'byor mjal kha zhus che phra stong rwa can tsam byung bar byin rlabs kyi dga' ston stsal/ gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas ke ke bcas bsu bar 'byor cing thab bsu'igasol ston drangs/ nes man ya mā zer bar zhag thog ne+e hu'u nas sbyin bdag wang gis shing thog gsar ba sna tshogs 'bul mi ha ban o mon thu 'byor 'di nas bzung wang gi yā mun la phyag phebs kyi bar char chen 'bab la khang pa lo ka tri pā la'i sngags tshar kha shas re ljags bzlas mdzad pas bsrung thub pa byung / gnam gang la ā ke pu r+ṇa pā la dang har chen tā gung gis gsol ston zhus shing hor chin 'chi med rdo rje wang gi thus lag chi sogs 'byor/369

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgronamatha gsung 'bumamed gi da ba'i la rtser paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas ngos 'dzin mdzad pa'i byang chub shing gi yal ga 'bul mi byung zhing yul lha gzhi bdag dgyes pa'i bsang mchod phul/ la rtsar tsha bab thog snga sor mkhar sngon po nas ri bo rtse lngar lcang skya thams cad mkhyen par mtshams zhu byed par mngags pa'i nang so bstan 'dzin slebs/ lcang skya rin po ches gsung shog gnang 'dug par gang ci'i bslab ston zhi brgyas dang khyad par 7gong ma chen por mjal phrad bgyid skabs pe'i cing du sdod dgos pa'i bka' 'dra phebs pa shar tshe dgongs pa zhu lugs sogs nang sbyar gyi bka' gsol gnang 'dug par thugs la dga' bde tshad las 'das pa 'khrungs/ wang zhabs drung er te ni paṇ+ḍi ta dpon g.yog wang gi su me'i chos rje bla ma'i sku skye ngo g.yog tha po nang stobs chen yi la hu tshan legs ldan phyag rdor don grub a ke'i bu che ba bcas ser skya brgya lhag tsam bsu bar 'byor/ ul ju'u thu lung pa'i mngar sbyin bdag wang gis thab bsu'i gsol ston gang rgyas zhus shing sras che ba'i dpon mo ke ke sogs dpon mo mang po mjal bar slebs lung pa 'di'i phugs na snga mo nyid kyes btab pa'i dben gnas bde chen rab rgyas gling gi rgyab kyi brag sogasagazigs pa na lam skabs su drag zhan bar ma'i skye bo nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu dang zang zing gi yo lang dbyar gyi char sprin bzhin 'dus pas skyug nad can gyis zas mthong ba bzhin thugs sun yod pa'i stobs kyis phral rang la der phebs na snyam pa'i thugs bzhed shugs drag po byung / da lta sangs rgyas su khas 'che ba mang po rnyed pa phra mo re byung bas kyang gting nas myos tshod mi rig pa la dpag na srid 'byor mtha' dag gcig tu spungs pa lta bu'i rnyed pas kyang lhag par zhen log skyed pa ni ma 'dres pa'i chos su bgrang chog pa zhig go / de nas btegs pa'i lam bar du wang gi rwa khi rog chi sogs 370

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /gzhiraldod kyi blon po thams cad dang lha khang gi chos rje bsam 'phel sogs ser skya brgya phrag tsam bsu bar glebs shing dkar spro'i dga' ston zhus/lam bar gyi grong ba so so nas gsol ja dang dkar zas 'dren mkhan yang mang la mjal phyag zhu mi zam chad pa lta bu byung / gsol ja re zhus sar char ba thar thor re babs shing lhag par wang gi pho brang du slebs par nye ba na sprin gseb nas 'ja' tshon mi tshad tsam pa zhig rim gyis mar babs te pho brang gi mdunagyi ri 'dabs su thim song ba ltas mtshan zhig tu mngon/ wang gi lha khang gi mdun du grwa pa rnams kyis ser sbrengs dang wang gi pho brang gi sgor gdugs rgyal mtshan pa dan thogs pa du ma 'bud dkrol gyi rol mo'i bye brag mang po skya ser gyi khrom shin tu che bas gus 'dud dang bcas 'do li la btegs te lha lcam dang sras gsum pa paṇ+ḍi ta hu thog thu tā bla ma sogs kyis spos sna dang bcas pho brang dbus kyi khang bzang zhig tu gdan drangs dpon g.yog tshang ma la dkar spro'i dga' ston gya nom pa zhus/ de nas sku zhabs nyid rgyun bzhugs kyi gnas su ched du dmigs pa'i khang ba bkod pa legs shing mal stan nyer mkho'i yo byad rnam grangs du ma dang rgyan gyi bye brag mi 'dra ba sna tshogs tshar du dang ra ba dang khor yug tu me tog sna tshogs dang 'khri shing sna tshogs 'khrungs pa spro zhing bag phebs pa zhig sta gon bgyis 'dug pa der gzhi phab nas bzhugs/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gcig la chibs gyi kha lo mngon par bsgyur ba'i thog ma'i rten 'byung gi sgo 'phar bsgrig ched du wang gi gzim khang du gdan drangs/ paṇ+ḍita hu thog thus gtso mdzad tā bla ma bsam 'grub sogs dge 'dun bcu lhag gis 'khor lo bde mchog dkar po'i sgo nasabartan bzhugs 'bul ba'i cho ga dang 'brel bar lha lcam ma ṇi dhār sras gsum pa lha rgyal rdo rje de'i bu bde chen rab rgyas dhi rma badz+ra tho yon sang snya thi 371

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'isgroname'i ga4 'bum/'jam dpal nor bu ke ke gsum dang bcas gzhi sdod rnams kyis sku gsung thugs rten dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal che legs bzhugs gdan rgyab yol/ paṇa chas cha tshang gyon pa phu thung ma cha tshang tshar gsum ska rags khug ma bcas rten khebs che chung cod paṇa sogs dgu tshar dri bzang gi thum bu dang khug ma sna tshogs chu shel sogs rin po che'i spyad pa sna tshogs gos chen yug dgu dngul srang lnga brgya dngul gyi rgyal srid sna bdun bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs 'bul ba spam mtho ba dang bcas brtan bzhugs rgyas par phul/ tshes gnyis la wang zhabs drung paṇ+ḍi ta hu thog thu'i gshag tu gdan drangs bsnyen bkur gzabs shing dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal che ba sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dngul srang brgya sogs phul/ har chin pe zi'i ho sho'u smon lam rab 'byams pa bkra shis dar rgyas ngo g.yog mjal bar slebs gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas dang don grub a ke gnyis nye 'khor du sgar phab 'dug pas so sos sgar thog tu phebs par dkar spro sogs kyi bsnyen bkur zhus/ phyi bro wang yab yum gye gzim gshag tu rgya nag lho phyogs kyi yul gru nas thon pa'i 7gong ma'i gsol zas kyi shing thog rigs mi 'dra ba mang po zhig drangs ras chen ya mtshan pa 'ga' zhig dang gos chen spyan pa 'ga' zhig phul/ a ke so so'i khang bar yang ki ki rnams kyis gsol ja zhus te spyan pa khyad mtshar ci rigs phul/ mas gsum la gong mar mtshams zhu'i ched zhe hor du phebs rgyur wang gi pho brang nas btegs bstan 'dzin mi rin gyis nang du gdan drangs te gsol tshigs rgyas pa zhus dngul srang lnga bcu'i maṇ+ḍal dngul rta mig ma gcig kyo'u tsi dre'u gnyis dang bcas pa phul/ wang gi lha khang du mchod mjal gnang zhing zhabs pad brtan pa'i rten 'brel du bsam ste tshe lha gsum gyi lha khang du gsol ja zhus/ gzhir bzhugs kyi dpon po rnams dang blon po kha 372

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /shasakyis skyel thung zhus lam bar du wang gi rta'i su rug dang mi rin bstan 'dzin dang deb gyur gyi rta rnams la bgegs bskrad dang shis brjod mdzad/a bar ga zer ba'i sa char wang gi gzim khang gsar ba zhig brgyab 'dug pa der zhag a ke gsum pas chibs skyel dang ston mo zhus/ tshes bzhi la yang zhu'u gu zer bar tsha bab thog sbyin bdag wang gi mi sna ha wang ja ha na jo'u slebs/ o'u han pe zi sangs rgyas rgyal pe zi bde ba'i rdo rje'i mi sna 'byor/do lon ger du bzhugs/ lnga pa la po ta la'i mkhan po mdung nag zhabs drung gi grwa ba chos rje bstan 'dzin lhun grub mtshan sgrog mkhan rin po che'i gnyer bsul bla ma blo bzang rgyal mtshan bcas bsu bar 'byor cu'un gar du zhag bab thog wang gi sras che ba e phu don grub tshe brtan ngo g.yog 'byor/ tshes drugagi tsha bab thog zhe hor gyi lha khang dgu'i dem chi gnyer ba rnams 'byor cingagasol ja zhus har chin ye phu dge legs bsam 'grub bsu bar glebs/lo'u phung dud zer ba'i brag phugs chen po'i nang du lha khang yod pa zhig gi nye 'dabs su pā rin chin wang pa thu'u a ke che ba pā rin e phu bde legs bzang po ne'i man wang ja sag gung ma hā pā la e phu chos dpal 'bar sogs kyi mi sna 'byor zhing dpon po rnams 7gong ma'i sku mdun du bzhugs dgos pa'i stabs kyis sku dngos bsu bar thag ring por glebs ma thub tshul zhus/7gongama'i blon chen he a li ha tā'i mi sna khag bcas 'byor/ zhe hor gye dgon pa dgu dang pho brang nang gi yung hā gung gi spyi bla paṇ+ḍi tā mkhan po sangs rgyas 'od zer bkra shis lhun po'i mkhan po rtsang ba dka' chen po ta la'i mkhan po mdung nag zhabs drung lha khang gzhan thams cad kyi tā bla ma mal ken bla ma su la bla ma rnams dang bcas ngo g.yog brgya tsam chibs bsur 'byor shud hāng zi zhes par tsha bab thog dad stobs kyis mngon par mtho ba'i sbyin bdag har 373

༄/ /gung cabastan ba'isgonaḥ gsung 'bum/chin chen wang rar+sha sarnyi dpon g.yog phebs/ wang gis mjal ma thag dad pa'i shugs kyis mchi ma lhug par btab bas nyid kyang thugs skyo nyams che ba byung / wang nas rgyal pos gnang ba'i nor bu don yod zhags pa bkra shis rtags kyis spras pa'i lha rdzas bcas phul cing dkar spro'i dga' ston rgya chen bstabs ja sbyor gcig gi ring la gang ci'i gsung gleng 'phel zhing phan tshun dga' spro tshad las 'das pa byung / har chen dge bshes skal bzang snyan grags 'byor zhe hor du 'byor par nye ba na char ba che tsam babs shing dbang gzhu'i gur khang rim pa gnyis yod pa zhig shar/ ku zas am bhan pe zi bde legs rgya mtsho pā rin wang na'i man wang thu med po zi mong gol ci na pe li ja sag gung o'u han wang 'chi med grub ba o'u han pe zi sangs rgyas rgyal ong nyodawang pe li 'jigs byed skyabs har chin gung gi sras ho sho'u e phu yul 'khoraskyong e phu don yod rdo rje 'jam dbyangs stobs ldan sogs dpon po mang po zhig gis phebs bsu byas/ mtshan sgrog mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang blo bzang dar rgyas zhal snga nas kyi gzim gshag smon rgyas gling zer bar babs/7gong ma chen po'i sku tshab grong chin wang hud wang mer gen wang sogs 7gong ma'i sku nye dpon po rnams kyi mtshams zhu ba/ sog po'i wang pe li pe zi gung tha'i ji sogs phal che ba rnams mjal bar slebs/ tshes bdun la 7gong ma chen po bkra shis lhun po'i lha khang du mchod mjal la phebs skabs lha khang sgo'i rdo zam gyi sner 7gong ma'i gser zhal mjal/ nyid nas pus mo btsugs te bzhugs pa gzigs phral du long gsung zhing kha btags sku 'dra bcas phul ba bzhes te tshur yang kha btags gnang / 7bka' las gzugs po bde po ye byung khyed rang a mdor song nas lo mang tsam song de'i bar la thugs dam dge sbyor dang dpe ltos mang po byed rgyu e byung / snga ma lang tsho shin tu rgyas pa zhig 374

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /yin pa la da cha cung zad nyams 'dug pa na tsha lta bu byung ba min nam zhes bka' 'dri phebs pa so so la/ 7gong ma'i thugs rjes/ gzugs po bde bo byung rang yul du song nas lo bcu gsum song 'dug7gong ma'i zhabs brtan la dmigs nas dge spyor phran tshegs dang dpe cha yang dga' rab lta rgyu byung / sngar gyi nad gzhi rnying ba gting drag la ma song bas gzugs po cung zad nyams 'dug ces bka' lan zhus/ nad gzhi rnying pa da dung sang drag la ma song ngam phebs pa la sang drag min tshul zhus/ khyed rang po ta la'i tshogs dbur sdod la zhabs brtan gyi chos thon gsung ba bzhin de phral du po ta la'i tshogs dbur phebs nas bzhugs/ 7gong ma bkra shis lhun po'i mchod mjal zin nas po tā lar phebs rten la spos phul zhing phyag mdzad phyag thal mo sbyar nas thugs smon yun ring tsam dang khong dpon slob rnams kyis chos gsung ba la gzigs rtog zhib tu mdzad cing dgyes nyams chen po gnang /de rjes 7gong ma'i bka' phebs pa bzhin thor god kyi mi sna wang pe li pe zi gung mang po zhig 'ongs nas rje nyid la phyag dbang zhus/ 7gong ma'i nang blon kha shas dang ngo phrad gnang zhal 'don grol nas po ta la'i mchod khang rnams la zhib tu mjal/ mkhan po mdung nag zhabs drung gis gshag tu gdan drangs te gsol tshigs zhus phyir bzhugs gnang su phebs pa na sbyin bdag rnams dang rang gi sku 'khor rnams kyis 7gong ma'i mjal phrad sogs leg lam che ba byung ba'i legs so'i kha dar phul/ bkwan dung shi re thu dang dpon po mang po mjal bar 'ongs pa la so so'i blo dang 'tsham pa'i gsung 'phros gnang / 7gong ma chen por sku brnyan li ma bco brgyad bzang spos phyags pa nyi shu rtsa bdun snam bu bco brgyad gro ma dang shug pa thum po dgu re bcas phul ba dgyes bzhin du bzhes/ tshes brgyad la sbyin bdag har chin 375

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung ཿma/wang gi khang bar phebs/ wang yab yum dang sras rnams la mdo smad nas byon pa'i sku skyes su sku brnyan thang ga snam spos ther ma dar sle nam mthing ka ras sogs rnam grangs mang tsam gnang / blon chen phu'u gung gi tsha bo zha'u gung ye nang blon khrang tā zhin hor chin jo rig thu wang u cu mu chin tā pe li ong nyod har chen gung ong nyod pe li har chin pe zi bstan pa dar rgyas ja sag gung hor chen pe li'i a ke ar chid khi shig then ja sag o'u han tshe brtan tha'i ji sogs mjal bar byung / pā rin e phus hor gos yug chen dor dung yug phye ma phur ma rgam chung gang shing thog sna tshogs phul/ zhe hor gyi tā pho zi po ta la bkra shis lhun po sgol ma lha khang lha khang ser po lha khang sngon po rnams kyi spyi ba so so nas gsol tshigs zhus/ tshes dgu la 7gong nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa gdan drangs skabs bzhugs gnas su bzhengs pa'i dgon gsar bkra shis lhun po la mjal bar phebs/ 'du khang chen po shar nub kye dngul gdung lha khang gser gyi rgya phib gnyis dang bcas pa/ bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po sbyil bu mang po dang bcab bkra shis lhun po dang dbyibs 'dra zhing paṇa chen gyi gzim khang ya mtshan pa che chung du ma dang / de rnams su sku gsung thugs rten bsam gyis mi khyab pas phyur phur gtams shing mchod pa'i yokhyad dpag tu med pa'i bkod bshams sogs blo yul las 'das pa lta bu rnams zhib tu gzigs pas 7gong ma bdag po chen po 'di nyid nges par bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i thugs bskyed rlabs po che grub pa'i chos rgyal gzhan dang mi 'dra ba mdo sde rgyan sogs su/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ni/ / khyim pa 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur/ / gsungs pa lta bu'i gang zag khyad par can zhig tu the tshom mi 'dug snyam pa'i thugs nges chen po 'khrungs/de dang 'dabs chags bar 7gong ma rang gi gzim khang 'ga' zhig 'dug pa 376

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /la'ang zhib tu mjal/ de nas 7gong ma chen pos bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang la dpe byas nas bzhengs pa'i lha khang tā pho zi zhes pa dbus kyi lha khang du spyan ras gzigs nam mkha' rgyal po thog so lnga'i tshad tsam gyi shin tu che ba dang gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla bcas kyi lha khang so sor sku gsung thugs rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs pa rnams la mjal bar phebs/ lha khang na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis rol mo 'bud dkrol sna tshogs dang bcas gdan drangs/ smin grol no mon han lha khang der bzhugs 'dug pa phyi sgor phebs te bsu ba mdzad par mjal dar rtse sprod gnang / lha khang so so'i mchod mjal grub rjes spyi sos gsol ja dang grwa mang gis mjal kha zhus smin grol no mon han bzhugs sar phebs te gang ci'i gsung gleng shin tu 'phel/ phyir gzim khang du phebs rjes yā mon gyi dpon po 'ga' zhig dang lha khang so so'i bla ma grwa rigs sog po'i dpon po mang po 'jal bar byung ba la blo dang mthun pa'i bka' mchid stsal/ tshes bcu la 7gong ma'i pho brang nang gi mchod rten chen po'i 'khris su ched dmigs kyis sog gur chen po mi stong tsam chud pa zhig phub nas der dbus su khri chen po zhig la 7gong ma rang nyid bzhugs/ de'i g.yas phyogs su khri chung zhig la rje 'di ba bzhugs su bcug ste thor god kyi mi sna dang rgya nag lho phyogs a nan rka zer ba rgya gar dang thag nye ba'i yul gru zhig gi me sna bcas gzhi byas la ston mo'i gsol ras rgya cher stsal cing rtsed mo'i rnam grangs 'ga' zhig kyang ston pa mdzad/ nyid la nor bu chu shel gyi phreng ba rgya ser gye gos chen gnyis sogs gos chen yug bcu gnang sbyin mdzad/ ston mo grol te phyir phebs pa na snga nyin nas dpon po rnams kyis sku zhabs nyid la brtan bzhugs 'bul rgyu'i snyan gsan phab yod pa bzhin har chen wang rat+na sirnyi sras che ba don grub tshe brtan sras lnga ba bsod nams dpal 377

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/ldanawang gi tsha bo e phu maci badz+ra thu med pe zi phun tshogs mong gol cin pe li bsod nams dpal 'byor de'i a ke dge 'dun skyabs dang dkon mchog dpal bzang gnyis/ pe zi bstan pa dar rgyas e phu dge legs bsam 'grub ja sag gung ma hā pā la ho sho'u e phu chos dpal 'bar wang gi shog lha skyabs gung a ke ma hā dharma e phu pur+ṇa pā la e phu yul 'khor skyong e phu 'jam dbyangs stobs ldan e phu don yod rdo rje e ke mun khu yul ju'u sogs har chen ho sho'u lnga'i dpon po rnams dang / pā rin e phu pe zi bde legs bzang po a ke sas shing nga pā rin chin wang pa thu pe zi rdo rje rab brtan a ke al than sang pe zi tshe 'phel rdo rje tha'i ji bsod nams sogs ba rin gyi dpon po rnams dang / o'u han wang 'chi med grub pa pe zi sangs rgyas rgyal de'i a ke 'jigs byed skyabs pe zi bde pa'i rdo rje tha'i ji tshe brtan rdo rje dpal 'byor rab brtan tha'i ji ba yan pā thur tha'i ji yi la hu san e phu rgyal ba tha'i ji 'jigs byed skyabs tha'i ji lha dbang e phu dpal ldan sogs o'u han gyi dpon po rnams dang / yong nyod wang dbang phyug pe li 'jigs byed skyabs pe zi thu mu ba yan gung de ba thi tha'i ji ba yan pa thur tha'i ji sangs rgyas skyabs tha'i ji ha sa pā thur tha'i ji rta mgrin skyabs bcas ong nyod dpon khag / hor chin jo rig thu tā wang kun dga' rab brtan ded tā dar han wang dbang rgyal rdo rje wang bkra shis skal ldan dpal 'byor pe zi de'i bu shi ti pe li mgon po skyabs pe zi mi 'gyur rdo rje/ gung dzachu ka ma la gung chos 'phel rgya mtsho gung lha dbang gung gu ru skyabs tha'i ji rin chen rdo rje e phu yar 'phel ca lad pe li a mo go lang sogs hor chen gyi dpon po rnams dang /hal ha thu shi thu hā na tshe brtan rdo rje che chen hān tshe brtan skyabs er ti ni chin wang dkon mchog dung ge chi wang bsam 'phel rdo rje bcang hal ha'i dpon po 378

༄༅/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /rnams dang / ni' man wang lha dbang rab brtan de'i a ke dpal mchog a ro hor chin pe li'i bu at+pa sirnyi a pa ka pe zi rtag brtan phun tshogs or du su ta lad pe zi u rad gung 'jigs byed rdo rje khi shig then ja sag dge 'dun dar rgyas ca rod gung phun tshogs/ de'i a ke yang khi rdo rje ca rod tshes gung u cu mu chen pe li bkra shis mgon po sogs tshol gan drug gi dpon po zhe hor du gang yod pa thams cad dang / 7gong ma'i sku nye grong chin wang dang bcas pas dngos cha bsdus te 'bul ba'i dngos po spam mtho ba dang bcas brtan bzhugs phul/ u cu mu chin pe li bkra shis mgon po dang / o'u han sangs rgyal pe zi gnyis kyis zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol 'debs dang lhag par shar phyogs kyi gdul bya rnams la thugs brtse ba'i sgo nas phyogs 'dir yun ring du bzhugs dgos tshul nan tan chen pos zhu ba mdzad/ rje nyid nas dkon mchog gi thugs rjes yon mchod rnams kyi bsam don 'grub pa dang sbyin bdag thams cad la gnas skabs mthar thug kun tu bkra shis kyi dge mtshan rgyun mi 'chad du byung ba'i smon pa yang dag bgyid tshul sog skad kyis brda 'byor nges su bka' drin bskyangs te thams cad dga' mgu rangs bar mdzad dpon po rnams la dkar spro zhus shing byin rten srung mdud sogs 'tshem med du stsal/ bcu gcig gi nyin gong ma chen po shu'u shing zi zer ba'i lha khang du phebs par ser sbrengs kyi dbur bzhugs te phebs bsu zhus/sbyin bdag wang gis mamon du gdan 'dren zhus shing / gung tshigs kyi gsol ba drangs bde mchog dkar po'i rjes gnang stsal cing dngos 'bul gya nom pa btegs/ bcu gnyis la bkra shis lhun por 7gong ma'i pa yar gyi 'don pa'i tshogs dbur bzhugs/ bcu gsum la yang bkra shis lhun por zhabs brtan du tshe chog 'don pa'i dbu mdzad cing der 7gong ma'i sku tshab tu 379

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/rgyal sras brgyad pa spos 'bul du byon pa la mtshams zhu gnang / gong ma chen por 'khrungs skar gyi pa yar du tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan lha rdzas bcas phul/bcu bzhi la bkras lhun du smon lam tshogs dbu dang gnas brten lnga brgya'i lha khang sogs la zhib mjal mdzad/ bco lnga la 7gong ma'i ri dwags zhabs phyir 'gro ba'i dpon po khag che chung thams cad byon pa la so so'i 'dod bston gyi bka' bsgo byin rlabs sogs stsal te 'dun pa bskangs/ sbyin bdag thams cad dang bla ma grwa ba'i rigs phal che bas da res rgyal khab chen por gtan bzhugs dgos tshul yang nas yang du zhus/ nang gi blon chen 'ga' zhigagis kyang 7gong ma chen po'i thugs dgongs da skabs pe cing du bla chen mang po med pas khyed rang bsdad na legs 'dug kyang 'dod pa gtan nas med na btsan thabs kyis sdod byas tshe sems la gnod rgyu red dgongs 'dug pas ci nas kyang 7gong ma'i dgongs pa dang bstun te sdod rgyu'i phyogs zhus na legs tshul nang lugs kyis zhus pa la/ nged rang lo'ang rgan gral du tshud pe cing gis chu'ang 'phrod dka'/ rang nyid chos srid gang la'ang shes yong yang zhan pas 7gong ma'i phyag g.yog tshad ldan yong dka' gsungs te ma gsan/ grwa slob nang ma 'ga' zhig gis kyang nan bskyed nas zhus par rgyal po 'di mnyes pa'ang gal che mod de las kyang rgyal po gcig shos de dbang che bas kho'i bsu ma ma sleb gong la phyi ma'i lam rgyag cung zad tshags su tshud na legs pa 'dug pas da lam rang yul du phyir log nas dben gnas shin tu dge sbyor rnam dag byed rgyu byung na de gal che gsung / gsung 'di'ang bzhi brgya par/ gang la 'jig rten gsum mnga' bdag / ces sogs dang /spyod 'jug tu/ rgyal po lta zhig mnyes na yang / zhes sogs dang don mthun pa dpyod shes pa gcig gis bltas na bslab bya'i snying po 'gang che ba 380

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /zhig tu snang ngo / / rgyal po'i thugs dgongs la yod tshul gzhan gyis zhus pa tsam du ma zad bka' phebs kyi dbyibs la'ang phyag g.yog tu sdong rgyu yin zhes zhudagos tshod 'dug kyang ma mkhyen pa'i tshul mdzad de de 'dra'i snyan sgron gyi phyogs tsam yang ma zhus/ bcu drug la 7gong ma ri dwags kyi sa char 'byon rgyur phebs skyel zhus shing zhung hā zi nas kha btags phul te mtshams zhus bgyis par tshur yang kha btags gnang zhing khyed rang da res phyir log rgyu yin nam zhes bka' phebs par yin tshul zhus/ pe cing du phebs rgyu'i khal rta ma sleb pas bcu bdun gyi nyin sgug sdod gnang bar zhe hor du yod pa'i mkhan po rnams dang grwa ba mang po mjal bar yong ba la chos kyi bka' mchid dang po ta la'i mkhan po mdung nag zhabs drung sogs 'ga' zhig la 'dod chos sna tshogasakyi bklag lung stsal/ bco brgyad la zhe hor nas btegs har ho tho chang zhi lu'u sag shi yang zi khrog tu grang zla shin zung he rnams su rim par bzhag ste nyi shu bzhi la pe cing du 'byor nas sbyin bdag wang gi ya mon du bzhugs/ nyi shu lnga la tsan dan jo bo'i lha khang sogs su mchod mjal zhib rgyas dang thugs smon gyi mtshams sbyor rgya gang che gnang / rgya tig mkhan po dang mchod rten dkar po'i zhabs drung sogs mjal bar slebs te lugs gnyis kyi bka' mchid 'phel/ nyer drug nas zhag kha shas kyi ring la pe cing gi ja sag bla ma tā bla ma yil gen bla ma su la bla ma gang yod dang lha khang so so'i dge 'dun mang po mjal bar slebs shing / chen mun dang ho ko zi/ lung pho zi rnams su tshong 'dus chen po'i ltad mor gzigs/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gcig la lcang skya rdo rje 'chang ri bo rtse lnga nas gsar du phebs par mjal phyag zhus pas thugs dgyes pa chen po dang bkur gzos bla na med pa mdzad gzim khang du yun ring po'i bar gsung 'phros mang du gnang / tshes gnyis la yung 381

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/hwa gung du rgya tig mkhan po'i gshag tu gdan drangs bar phebs pa'i tshe de ga'i bla ma rnams dang dge 'dun thams cad kyis bsu ba dang bsnyen bkur bgyis shing mjal phyag sogs gang 'dod du gnang ste de nub mkhan po'i gshag tu bzhugs/ gsum la ja sag bla ma dge legs nam mkhas gsol tshigs zhus shing tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan zhu'u yi chu shel gyi phreng ba khug ma sna tshogs bcas phul/ tshes bzhi nas bcu gcig gi bar zung gru zir bzhugs te lcang skyardo rje 'chang gi drung nas dge ldan bka' rgyud phyag rgya chen po'i nyams khrid thun mong du ma grags pa'i snyan brgyud zhal shes dang bcas pa/ nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad zab mo kun la ma grags pa du ma dang rje nyid kyi gsung 'bum gras sngar lung ma gsan pa kha shas sogs nyin re bzhin snga dro chos thun rgyas pa re gsan cing gsol tshigs lhan du gnang / phyi dro mdo sngags kyi dka' gnad du mar dogs gcod sogs chos kyi 'phros pa dang bstan srid spyi sgos kyi bka' mchid sogs don dang ldan pa'i gsung gleng 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar mdzad/ bka' chos grub pa'i gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dngul srang lnga brgya bcas phul zhing zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa'i gsol 'debs phur tshugs su zhus pas zhal bzhes bzang po gnang / na bza'i khrod kyi rtser son shin tu mnad che ba zhig phul te 'di phyi bar do thams cad du rjes 'dzin gyi skyabs 'jug nan tan zhus pa la ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin du 'grub pa'i zhal bzhes lhug par stsal pas dgyes pa rab kyi rtser son par gyur/ rdo rje 'chang chen po nas ri bo rtse lngar sgrub pa gnang ba'i bdud rtsi ril bu phon che ba gnang da res sku rdzong sogs 'bul rgyu min rten 'brel khyad par can zhig yod pas 'di khyer gsung lhung bzed cig phyag gis gnang ba ni las kyi cho gar/ 'di 382

༄/ /rje btsun blobazang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /zas kyis 'gengs pa bzhin du rang rgyud yon tan gyis 'gengs 'di'i nang nas zas la longs spyod pabazhin du chos la longs spyod gsungs pa lta bu'i dgongs gzhi chen po zhig yin par mngon/ bcu gcig la mchod rten dkar po ma hā kā li'i lha khang lha khang ser po nub ma'i paṇa chen rin po che'i bzhugs gnas mchod rten dang bcas pa mjal zhing / lha khang ser po shar mar snga mo rje nyid bzhugs pa'i bla brang du phebs lha khang spyi ba dang smin grol no min han gyi zhabs phyi pa rnams kyis gsol ja zhus/ nub kyi mchod rten dkar por mjal zhing zhabs drung tā bla ma'i gshag tu gsol tshigs dang rin po che las grub pa'i thub pa grong khyer ma'i sku shel spyad 'ga' zhig gos chen yugaganyis sogs phul/ bcu gnyis la mjal kha zhu mi che phra mang tsam byung zhing rgya tig mkhan pos sku gsung thugs rten dngul srang brgya yo byad 'ga' zhig bcas phul/ bcu gsum la pe cing nas btegs te nyer gnyis lha las babs pa'i dus chen gye nyin har chin du wang zhabs drung er ti ni paṇ+ḍi ta sbyin bdag wang dang ha thun a ke rnams dang bcas pas chibs bsu dge 'dun rnams kyis ser sbrengs dang bcas wang gi pho brang du 'byor te gzhi byes thams cad zhal 'dzom pa'i dga' ston rgya cher byas/ de nas nyi ma kha shas kyi ringagung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas lha skyabs gung e phu pur+ṇa pā la ha thun ning ner thu sa lag chi tshul khrims a ke mun khu yul jis a ke don grub mi rin bstan 'dzin wang gi lha khang gi tā bla ma gu thi bsam 'grub nyi ma rnams kyis gdan drangs nas dga' ston rgya chen dang rten 'byung gi dngos 'bul btegs/ dpon po rnams dang sbyin bdag grwa rigs so sor mdo smad nas phebs pa'i sku skyos su lha rten snam ther spos sogs bab bstun gyi gnang cha mdzad/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gcig nas nyin gsum gyi ring sbyin bdag wang 383

༄/ /gungangongang naba'i naza'agayo 'phag — gi rim gror dge 'dun nyis brgya lngabacus bka' 'argyur gsungs pa'i tshogs dbu mdzad/ 'di skabs nye 'khor gyi grong sde rnams su tshad rims kyi nad mched pa zhi phyir du nyin gnyis kyi ring bka' 'gyur gyi glegs bam grong skor du gdan drangs par/ ston 'khor tshang mas gang ser ma 'ur chems kyis gsungs te bkra shis kyi me tog char du bsnyil ba dang sprin 'thibs nas kha char zim bu babs pa dus mtshungs kyi rten 'brel 'grigs pa bzhin ma 'gyang par nad rims rgyun chad de yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i rnam thar mngon du bstan/ wang paṇ+ḍi ta zhabs drung la dgon lung khri ba'i res babs te rang yul du thon nye bar bzhed mos bzhin khong dang sbyin bdag wang yab sras tā gung e phu pur+ṇa pā la o'u han dge bshes ngag dbang blo bzang lha khang gi grwa ba che gras rnams dang bcas don gnyer can skya ser sum cu skor la rje nyid kyi gsung 'bum par du 'khod zin gang yod kyi ljag lung gnang / bcu gnyis kyi nyin zhabs drung dpon g.yog thon par rje nyid ri khrod bde chen rab rgyas gling du phebs zhor la bkra shis lung pa'i mda' bar du skyel ma'i tshul mdzad nas phebs de nas ri khrod du byon te nyin skor la phyir phebs bcu gsum gyi nyin ja sag gung mahā pā la ye phu dbang rgyal e phu rnam rgyal e phu chos dpal 'bar sogs dpon blon mang po mjal du 'ongs par phyag dbang gnang /lha khang gi hu bil gan bla mas gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur 'dod chos zhus/bcukhrug la mi rin bstan 'dzin gyis khyim du gdan drangs mai rin steng grib kyis na bar sku mtshams la bzhugs te lho brag snyan brgyud nas 'byung ba'i gza' bcos kyi man ngag bzhin sngags chu za yig sman rnams gnang ba dang nyin re bzhin du gang byung sogs bka' drin bskyangs pas ma 'gyang bar phan skyed che ba byung / nyer gcig gi nyin sku mtshams grol te gza' mi tshang mar 384

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /tshe dpag med kyi rjes gnang stsal mai rin gyis rim gro'i yon du dngul srang lnga brgya phul/ nyer gnyis kyi nyin tā gung gi a ke rnams dang lha khang gi zhabs drung gnyis bcas gdan 'dren du 'ongs pa bzhin phebs te zhag gsum bzhugs gung yab sras sogs la rta mgrin gsang sgrub dang rnam sras ser chen gyi rjes gnang stsal/ gung dpon po 'bul ba gya nom pa brtan bzhugs lugs su phul/ nyer drug la gung gi ri khrod gsar bar gdan drangs der tshogs pa rnams la skyes rabs so bzhi pa dang bzang spyod kyi lung gnang / de nyin tshul khrims thus lag chis khyim du gdan drangs nas zhag mal mdzad gsol ston 'bul ba gzabs shing gza' mi rnams la phyag rdor gtum chung gi rjesaganang stsal/ nyer bdun la a ke pu r+ṇa pā las gdan drangs nas zhag gsum bzhugs mgon po bar chad kun sel dang sgrol ma'i rjes gnang mkhan spyod ma'i sirdu ra'i byin rlabs rnams stsal te gzhis len bsnyen bkur kyang gzabs/ bar skabs su tha bo nang bsam 'grub kyis gdan drangs nas zhabs tog dang spyan ras gzigs kyi bzlas bsgom gyi lung zhus/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig la a ke don grub kyis khyim du gdan drangs nas zhag gnyis bzhugs dpon po grib skyon gyis na ba la rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi rjes gnang dang bcos ka 'ga' zhig mdzad pas phan skyed che ba byung 'byor 'khos kyi 'bul ba gzabs/ tshes gsum la phyir 'khor tshes lnga dang drug la rim pas sbyin bdag wang dang btsun mo gnyis kyi skyes skar gye dga' ston byas par/rje nyid nas wang dang btsun mo gnyis la tshe dpag med kyi li sku dgu re dang spos zhing khyab dgu tshan res thog drangs te rten 'brel gyi skyes sna tshogs dgu tshan re ri bo ma la ya nas thon pa'i tsan dan dmar po 'dom phyed dang tsan dan dkar po dum bu che ba tshe spel ba'i shis brjod kyi snyan tshig bod sog gi yi 385

༄/ /gung 4 bstanaba'i name'i gsung 'bum/ge shan sbyar bcas stsal/ tshes bdun la rje nyid kyi 'khrungs skar gyi dga' stonacos par nyid dpon g.yog kha shas kyis 'go ba'i lha lnga'i gsol mchod btang wang gis pho brang dbus mar bkur ste chen pos gdan drangs te sbyin bdag wang btsun mo sras sras mo blon 'khor thams cad dang wang dang gung gi lha khang gi bla grwa che gras skor/ gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas yum sras dang a ke pur+ṇa pā la sogs phyogs nas 'dus pa'i dpon blon drag zhan mang po bcas skya ser gyi tshogs pa stong phrag brgal bas bde mchog dkar po'i sgo nas brtan bzhugs 'bul tshul gyi cho ga dang sbrags te zhabs brtan rgyas pa phul bar wang gis kha btags nang mdzod dngul srang lnga bcu'i maṇ+ḍal sne 'dogs can tshe dpag med kyi li sku tshun lnga pa dgu dang bris thang dgu tshem grub kyi sgrol dkar gsung dang thugs kyi rten dngul gyi rdo rje dang bkra shis rtags brgyad bzang gos tshem grub kye bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dbyar dgun gyi na bza' cha tshang gsol dkar dngul gyi stegs can sogs dngul las bsgrubs pa'i nyer spyad 'ga' zhig g.yang ṭi dang shel gye snod spyad khyad mtshar can mang po/ gos chen legs pa dgu dngul srang lnga brgya rta sga 'khor tshang ma bcas rta dgu yu'u shi dang dkar yol gyi yid bzhin 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu gnyis sras sras mo kai ke rnams dang tā gung yum sras sogs phyogs nas 'dus pa'i dpon dpon mo blon po rnams kyang so so nas dngos gtsang ba'i rten 'byung gi 'bul ba mang po btegs/ wang chen pos zhabs gras rnams la dgun zhwa dang pags rtsag re gnang zhing ji srid har chin du bzhugs ring la dpon g.yog tshang ma'i nar ma'i gsol chas gang gzab byed dgos tshul blon po rnams la bka' bkod gnang ba sogs bkur sti rim glo dpe zla med pa mdzad/ nyin gsum gyi ring gzhi byes kyi mi drag mang po la gsol ston gye rim pa rnams wang gi gzhung nas 386

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kye nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /thon pa gnang / de nas dgun gye nyi ldog dang bstun nyi ma mang po la sbyin bdagawang gi rim gror rje nyid chog grogs pa bcu skor bcas kyis rta mgrin gtor zlog sgrol ma g.yul zlog lha mo'i zlog mdos rnams rim gyis bsgrub par mdzad/ lha mo'i zlog mdos btang skabs sngar ma grags pa'i rlung nag gnam sa g.yo ba lta bu byung bas mdos brdeb long med par 'gyel 'phyar dar 'ga' zhig kyang chag rje nyid kyi nyams snang la'ang bud med khres po khur ba zhig gting nas mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur byed pa sogs 'tshub ltas mang du byung song ba ni rjes sor wang gi khyim der gegs chag mang du byung 'dug pa de'i ltas su mngon/ g.yang skar zhig dang bstun wang gi pho brang du dge mtshan spelaba'i cho ga gnang sbyin bdag wang btsun mo sras bcas la mgon po bar chad kun sel gye rjes gnang bde mchog dkar po'i tshe dbang / nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sin ju ra'i byin rlabs bcas stsal/ bcu dgu nas mi rin deb cor dang tha bo nang il go tshan gnyis kyis rim pas gdan drangs par zhag re bzhugs shing mai rin la rim gro 'ga' zhig dang tha po nang gza' mi rnams la rnam sras ser chen gye rjes gnang stsal/ nyer gnyis kyi nyin sbyin bdag wang yabasras pe cing du phebs rgyur sgrol ma'i bka' bsgo mdzad de nyin nas dbu btsugs te nyi ma kha shas kyi ring bcad rgya mdzad nas mjug tu wang yab sras kyi rim gror lha mo ku ru ku l+le'i sbyin sreg gnang / de nas wang gi gzhis sdod kyi a ke rnams dang lha khang gi bla grwa 'ga' zhig gi 'dod mos ltar chos tshan thor bu mang po zhig gi lngags lung dang ong nyod pe li'i nu bo ba yan pā thur ha sa pā thur ca rod zhabs drung sogs phyogs nas mjal du 'ongs pa mang po la phyag dbang dang bka' bsgo sogs 'dod mos bzhin stsal/ mi rin kun dar gyis gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus shing mai rin la dge bsnyen gyi 387

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/sdom pa gnang / tā gung gi ho ro la gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs nas nyin kha shas kyi ring gung yab sras sogs don gnyer can nyung 'dus la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid gser chos 'pho ba dang bcas bka' drin stsal/de nas tshur phebs sbyin bdag wang pe cing du 'byor phral wang gi tsha bo malca badz+ral 7gong ma'i tsha mo ke ke bdag rkyen gnang rgyu'i bka' babs par wang nas rje nyid la rgyu mtshan 'bul mi btang ba'ang 'byor/ wang gi lha khang gi dge bskos rab 'byor dge slong rigs ldan nang so dpal bzang khā pa ri mad rnams kyis rim pas gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs grwa ba rnams la rang rang gi 'dod mos ltar bklag lung thor bu mang po dang khā pa ri mad gza' mi rnams la mi 'khrugs pa'i rjes gnang stsal so sos zhabs tog 'bul nod gzabs/lo 'jug dang bstun sbyin bdag wang gi rim gror rje nyid dbu mdzad nas dge 'dun drug cu tham pas spyi bskang nyi ma bdun gsungs shing mjug tu chos rgyal gyi gtor rgyag mdzad/ zor 'phen skabs gzigs snang la rje rang gi mtha' skor du dregs pa pho mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa dpung gi tshul du bskor nas bzhugs shing hom gyi me 'bar ba'i nang du byad ma zhig yin snyam pa nyam thag ngo hrang nge ba mig khra hrig hrig pa zhig 'dug pa'i snang ba shar te lha'i nga rgyal brtanapos tsham tshom cung zad kyang med par zor phyag tu thogs te me dpung 'bar ba'i dkyil der phebs pa na sku lus thams cad me lces 'khyud pa bzhin du gyur/ g.yas g.yon dang rgyab ngos su yod pa 'ga' zhig gi smin ma sogs tshig pa byung 'dug kyang / rje rang gi sku dang na bza' sogs la skyon cung zad kyang med par ma zad tsha ba'i nyams tsam yang ma byung ba ni lha'i rnal 'byor brtan pos gzhan snang zil gyis gnon nus pa'i rnam thar du mngon/dgun 'dir ho sho'u so so nas bla dpon sbyin bdag grwa rigs dngos dang tsha ba 388

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /ci rigs zam ma chad papabyung zhing de dag la chos bka' dang gsung rtags sogs rang rang gi 'dod mos ltar stsal/ dpe gzigs dang ljags rtsom zhal 'don gyi rim pa rnams kyang spel mar gnang / dgung lo zhe dgu pa shing sbrul lo gsar mas kyi dga' ba dang po'i nyin wang gi pho brang dbus mar gdan drangs lo gsar gyi dga' ston rgyas par bstabs/ sras sras mo rnams dang blon po che chung thams cad lha khang gi bla ma las sne gzhan yang dpon po che chung sogs mi drag du mas mjal kha zhus/ tshes gnyis la wang gi lha khang du mchod mjal la phebs phyir lam mi rin bstan 'dzin gyis khyim du gsol ba dkar spro zhu ba/ tshes bzhi gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas dang a ke pu r+ṇa ba la don grub rdo rje rnams kyis khyim du lo gsar gyi dga' ston du gdan drangs pa rnams la rim bzhin phebs/ bdun la rje nyid sgrub grogs dang bcas pas dpal mgon zhal gyi dam tshig bskang gso btang / tshes brgyad la shi rim ca khi rog chis khyim du gdan drangs rim gror rgyal gsol zhig btang 'bul ba zhabs tog bzabs shing der zhag mal mdzad/ dgu la gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyis gdan drangs par byon te zhag lnga bzhugs dge ldan bka' rgyud phyag rgya chen po'i khrid sogs chos bka' 'ga' zhig gnang 'bul ba zhabs tog phun sum tshogs pa dang / bcu gnyis dang bcu gsum gyi mtshan mo me'i rtsed mo rnam grangs mang po'i gzigs mo phul/ bar skabs su zhabs drung bsod nams nor bus gdan drangs zhabs tog legs par bsgrubs shing klu dbang rgyal po'i rjes gnang stsal/ bcu bzhi la phyir phebs bco lnga'i nyin wang gi lha khang du smon lam gyi tshogs dbur byon 'cham gyi gzigs mo dang byams sku dang lhan du skor bar gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs/ dka' bcu dkon mchog nyi ma yun ring na bar sman bcos rim gro sogs nan tan bgyis kyang dus 389

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'izlanamo ga4 'bum/slebs lta bus phan skyed ma byung bar bco lnga'i mtshan mo tshes dus byas par 'da'akha'i tshe byin rten 'gang che ba du ma stsal cing rna lam du gzungs sngags zab mo dang sangs rgyas kyi mtshan sgrog tu bcug dge rtsa gang 'grub dang rus bu rnams nyid nas rus chog gnang ste satsā btab ba ri bo rtse lngar bskyal/ snga phyir lcang skya rdo rje 'chang la bsngo zhus rus bu la cho ga sogs zhus pas rnam shes srid pa'i du kha las sgrol ba'i thabs ma tshang ba med par bka' drin bskyangs/bcubadun gyi nyin ma ṇi nang so ngag dbang rgya mtshos gshag tu gdan drangs bsnyen bkur 'bul nod bstabs de nas mai rin bstan 'dzin gyes khyim du gdan drangs zhag lnga bzhugs te rta mgrin gsang sgrub phyag rdor khyung lnga sor 'brang bcas kyi rjes gnang kha 'bar ma dkar mo'i 'chi blu gnad smin gnang dngos 'bul yang rgya che ba zhus/ nyer gnyis la dza lang rig 'dzin gyis khyim du gdan drangs zhag gsum bzhugs rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang dang gshin 'dre'i gnod pa che bar dmigs gcod kyi lus sbyin dang sri can spubs bshig gi cho ga kha yar dang khyim pa srog rlung gis spyos par bka' bsgo sogs bka' drin bskyangs/ nyer gsum gyi nyin wang gi sras lnga pa'i skyes skar gyi dga' stonal gdan drangs tshe dbang stsal/ sngar lcang skya rin po che'i lo gsar gyi mtshams zhur btang ba'i nang so bstan 'gyur slebs lcang skya rin po ches jo zhwa gnang ba phul/ phyi nyin dge bskos ngag dbang dpal 'byor gyis gdan drangs gsol tshigs dang 'bul nod zhus/ nyer lnga la tha bo nang don grub rdo rjes khyim du gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs lam du dzam bha la ca khir chis gdan drangs nas gsol tshigs dang 'bul nod bstabs/ don grub rdo rje'i nang du zhag drug gi ring bcad rgya'i khong nas dpon po'i nad gzhi la phan ched rta mgrin gyi sgo nas gza' gtsos pa'i sde brgyad kyi dug dbyung lan kha yar dang kha 390

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /'bar ma'i 'chi blu bsgrubs shing lho brag bka' 'bum nas 'byung ba'i man ngag bzhin gza' bcos kyi za yig sngags chu srung 'khor sogs gnang bas phan skyed phral du thon pa byung / zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la a ke pur+ṇa pā li'a.a ma ke ke rang lo lnga bcur slebs pa'i dga' ston la gdan drangs pa bzhinakhong gi yā mon du phebs/ a pa ka nas nyang tshang zhabs drung dang a ro hor chin tā bla ma dpal bzang thu med rab 'byams pa ngag dbang rdo rje rnams 'dod chos 'ga' zhig zhu bar slebs brel ba che skabs dang thug pas 'dod chos thams cad gnang ma thub kyang / tshes gnyis nas mgon po'i be'u bum dang rta mgrin chos skor gsar bsgrigs kyi bklag lung stsal/ tshes bzhi nas nyin gsum la bka' 'gyur 'don pa'i tshogs dbur phebs/ tshes drug ke ge'i skyes skar gye nyin tshe dpag med kyi sku 'dra dgu spos phyags dgu sogs rten 'brel gyi rdzas 'ga' zhig gnang zhing sgrol dkar gye rjes gnang stsal/ rje nyid la bde mchog dkar po'i sgo nas brtan bzhugs dang sbrags pa'i maṇ+ḍal sku gsung thugs rten na bza' cha tshang bzhugs gdan rgyab yol mchod rdzas dang spyad pa sna tshogs gos yug kha shas/ dngul srang brgya sogs 'bul ba gya nom pa btegs/ bka' 'gyur klog 'don grub par rje nyid la gos ber legs pa sogs kyi dngos 'bul dang dge 'dun brgya lhag la zla gam phor ba phreng ba bcas grangs mtshungs re dang dung tshe lnga brgya re phul/ bdun la phyir 'khor ba'i lam du sbyin bdag wang btsun mo dang bcas pa pe cing nas 'khor nas bsu bar phebs pa dang mjal phrad gnang ste lhan du be+e mon la phebs pe cing nas phebs pa'i skyes ma shel spyad sogs rnam grangs 'ga' zhig phul/ brgyad la thu med sogs phyogs du ma nas bslab tshigs don du gnyer ba'ibasgrub bya mang po dka' spyad kyis 'ongs pa la rab byung dge tshul bsnyen 391

༄/ /gung bangabastanaba'isgronasag4 'bum/ rdzogs ci rigs kyi sdom pa phog / zhag shas kye bar du nyang tshang zhabs drung hor chen tā bla ma sogs don gnyer can mang po la drag po gsum dril dang zag tse'i rjes gnang bklag lung thor bu 'ga' zhig bcas dang zhabs drung dang sbyin bdag wang gnyis la snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang stsal sengs bar du bla ma rnams dang chos kyi 'bel gtam mang du mdzad/ ri dwags kyi sa char gcan gzan gyi 'tshe ba che bar brten 7gong ma'i bkas gcan gzan gsod par 'gro mkhan rnams 'jigs skyob kyi don du sgrol ma'i rjes gnang zhus pa'i re ba bskang / nyang tshang zhabs drung gis gtso byas te rje nyid kyi zhabs brtan du dmigs nas 'chi blu dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs bgyis/ snga sor pe zi'i ho shu'u nas paṇ+ḍi ta zhabs drung gzugs gzhi ma bde ba la rim gro sogs kyi ched du spyan 'dren gye snyan gsan phul skabs khal rta sogs skabs 'di tsam la gleb na phebs rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang yod par zhabs drung zla ba snga ma'i nyer lngar ma 'tsho 'dug rung ho sho'u de ga'i che phra thams cad sku zhabs nyid la dad 'dun shin tu che bas tshang mas mjal 'dod kyis yang bskyar gdan 'dren zhu mi lan kha yar 'byor cing tshes bcu'i nyin tshe 'phel a ke dang pe zi 'chi med rdo rje'i tsha bo rar+sha ki rte ja lang bzang po sogs mi drag kha shas dem chi sbyin pa sogs lha khang gnyis kyi grwa ba bco lnga bcas khyon mi bzhi bcu tsam dang zhon rta shing rta bcas 'byor/ bcu gnyis kyi nyin thon rtsis mdzad kyang kha ba che zhing lam bgrod dka' bas bcu bzhi'i nyin wang gi yā mon nas thon/ wang chen pos sras lnga pa bsod nams dpal ldan lha btsun sasgo thi gu thi tā bla ma khā a nan ta bcas mi sum cu tsam zhabs phyir gtong ba gnang / don grub a kes khyim du gsol ja zhus shing zhag bab gung dpon po'i nang du mdzad gung nas gzhi byes drag zhan thams cad la bsnyen bkur dang khal rta brgya phrag lhag tsam 392

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /gyi gzan chas sogs shangs len yang dag bgyes/ gung gis lo re bzhin mdzod dngul gyi phud srang lnga bcu re 'bul gyin yod pa bzhin 'di res mdzod dngul gyi phud kyang phul/ 'dis mtshon pa'i har chin dang mar du su sogs kyi sbyin bdag dpon 'bangs rnams nas lo ltar 'chag med 'bul rgyu khas blangs shing rang rang so so'i 'byor tshod kyis sen mo dkar nag gi mtshams nas bcad de gces nor yod dgu phangs sred med par phul ba la sbyin pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i dngos po mtha' dag nam yang mi zad pa byang chub mchog gi rgyur bsngo ba'i spyan dmigs kyang nan tan rgyun chags su mdzad/ phyi nyin a ke rnams kyis skyel thung zhus te mo cang gong zer bar tsha bab dang wang gi zhing 'debs mkhan do'u zer ba'i rgya tshang zhig tu zhag bab gnang / pe zi'i ho sho'ul phebs rgyu der phyogs de'i yul 'dre dam sri 'ga' zhig mi dga' ba'i ltas yin nam snyam pa'i mnal ltas 'ga' zhig byung ba bzhin 'di nyin kha ba bu yug 'tshub pas lam bgrod shin tu dka' tsam byung bar zhag mal gyi sar dkar phyogs kyi lha klu 'byung po rnams la gtor ma bsngos te grogs bcol zhing gsang bdag lo ka tri'i sngags dmigs kyis ma rungs pa rnams bcun pas phyi nyinanas 'jam du song / bcu drug gi nyin pi chig thu'i la snang du yul lha gzhi bdag gi gzengs bstod cing lha rgyal gyi dar dkar lab tse zhig 'dug par btags de nub o lhan da pa'i rgya tshang zhig dang phyi nyin je rin pu lag gi grong bar dkon mchog khun tus gdan drangs par zhag bzhugs gnang /lam bar du mjal kha zhu mkhan mang zhing zhag sar mi nyis stong tsam la phyag dbang dang byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs dang ma ṇi'i phan yon brda 'phrod nges su gsungs shing gzungs rna lam du bsgrags pa dang khrom tshogs kyi steng du spyan ras gzigs gsal btab nas bdud rtsi 'beb sbyang gi dmigs 393

༄/ /gung bang bstanaba'izlanaḥ gsung 'bum/pa dang sbrags te ma ṇi 'dren bcug pa dang yig drug sogs dge ba khas len bskor ba sogs snying rje'i gzhan dbang du gyur pas gang la gang phan gyi thabs sna tshogs pa mjug tu bsngo smon dang bcas thugs la btags/ mgon po'i rjesaganang dgos zer bar mi ha cang mang pas slob ma lhar skyed sogs med par gtor ma'i byin rlabs dbang bzhi tsam gnang la/ tshul 'di ni dgag bya chung zhing dgos pa che ba zhig 'dug pas blo gros can rnams kyis dgongs par mdzad na legs sam snyam/ bla mchod dang bzang spyod sogs kyi lung 'ga' zhig kyang gnang e phu rnam rgyal gyi mtshams zhu 'bul mi dang e phu'i nu bo gnyis mjal bar byung ba la dgyes pa'i bka' stsal phebs/ dkon mchog khun btus 'bul ba gya nom pa brtan bzhugs lugs su phul/ bco brgyad kyi nyin e pa the la tshe dbang jang gi'i khyim du gdan drangs zhabs tog 'bulab gzabs mjal kha zhu mi stong lhag tsam byung bar phyag dbang dang ma ṇi'i bzlas lung sogs snga nyin ltar du gnang / smon lam bla ma'i gnyer ba tā'i thung zhabs drung tho yon dge legs rab rgyas pa yan cha gan zhabs drung bcas bsu bar 'byor/ tho go thu la sha ka sha pad kyis khyim du gdan drangs dbang rgyal tha bo nang bsu bar slebs lo'u hu'i chu brgal nas tha bin ger la thog thol gyi khyim du zhag bab gnang / yang tsis zer bas khyim du gdan drangs nas gsol ja zhus/ 'di nyin yang lam bar du mjal ba stong phrag gsum tsam 'dus par gzungs sngags bsgrags pa sogs sngar nyin ltar le shor med pa mdzad/ bcu dgu'i nyin grong pa de ga'i nye 'dabs kyi lha khang du gdan drangs de na yod pa'i grwa pa tshos gsol ja dang 'bul ba phul rten gsum la rab gnas rta thog ma zhig gnang mjal kha zhu mkhan lnga brgya tsam byung /hu lo so thas kyi grong pas gsol ja dang 'bul nod bgyis/ de nas thugs rje 394

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /chen po'i lha khang du gdan drangs nas de ga'i grwa pa rnams kyis gsol ja dang 'bul nod bstabs a bi ta'i lha khang du gdan drangs/ pa yan cha gan zhabs drung grwa ba bcas dang lha khang de ga'i grwa pa rnams kyis gsol tshigs rgyas pa zhus shing bdog pa'i tshan grangs bstar skya ser gyi khrom sum stong tsam la phyag dbang dang bla mas smon gyi lung stsal lha khang dang rgyab kyi mchod rten la me tog 'thor 'bul mdzad/ sbyin bdag wang sogs dpon po rnams kyi pha mes kye dur yod sar phebs te gzungs sngags zab mo bzlas pa'i 'thor 'bru gtor zhing brab sngags dang yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i shis bajod sogs 'dodams bzhin du gnang / ge gon grong sde spyi mang dang thu su khe ja lang gis gsol ja 'bul nod bstabs mi stong lhag tsam la phyag dbang chos 'brel sogs kyis re ba bskangs/ 'di nyin mjal kha zhu mkhan stong phrag brgyad lhag tsam la phyag dbang dang byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs bsgrags pa ma ṇi bgrang ba khas len bskor ba dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba sogs mthong thos dran reg don ldan du 'gyur ba'i thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pa bzang po'i bka' drin gyis khyab par byas/ nad pa mang po ljags sngags bka' bsgo sogs zhu bar byung ba la 'dun pa bzhin du brtse bas bskyangs mun rub tsam la u lung thes grong par khā yum chung gi khyim du 'byor/ nyi shu la yum chung gza' mi tshang mar sgol ljang gi rjes gnang stsal shangs len dang 'bul ba dngos gtsang ba zhus/ pe zi'i shog gi srad rgyud mkhan po bsu bar 'byor mjal kha zhu mi stong tsam la phyag dbang gnang lam bar du a ke tsan+d+ra pā la dang rdo rje snying po lha ram pa sogs dka' ram 'ga' zhig bsu bar 'byor/ u kher chi lo la pā thur khun tu'i khyim du tsha bab gnang zhing khun tus bdog pa slel/ bstan 'dzin mkhan po sogs dka' ram mang tsam dang mjal kha zhu 395

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/mkhan stong lhag tsam la phyag dbang dang bsngo smon sogs gang zhus kyi 'dun pa bskangs/ phebs lam du po ti no yon lo brgyad cu gya gcig lon pa ngo g.yog dang o lan go'i tā bla ma lha ram pa zhabs drung bstan 'phel tā bla ma mkhas mchog nu rul hu'i tā bla ma pe zi'i ho ro'i dka' ram dge bskos dem chi sogs grwa ba lnga bcu skor rim gyis 'byor te chu tshan gyi la sgang du gsol ja zhus/der ja sag gung gi shog on ngur hu gung pha bu thu med thus lag chi the gu su chog thu pe zi'i ho sho'i e phu dge legs bsam grub tha po nang 'bum pa skyabs sogs dpon blon mang pos chibs bsu zhus/ chu tshan khar skya ser stong phrag tsamal phyag dbang bsngo smon sogs mdzad btsun ma lo dgu bcu lhag lon pa zhig gis gson bsngo zhus de ga'i lha khang du zhag bab gnang smon lam bla mas gsol ja dang ho sho'u nas gsol ja gsol tshigs zhus/ chos bzang chos rje dang rnam dag tha po nang 'ongs nas phyir lam gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phab chu tshan der 'jug pa gnang zhing des phyin chad gzhan la phan thogs chen po 'byung ba'i smon lam dang sman bla'i gzungs mang du bzlas nas byin gyis brlabs/ nyer gcig la a bi ta'i ho ro la ta'i thung zhabs drung gis ja zhus thog tha po nang u ru shel sogs mi drag dga' dang mjal kha zhu mi sum brgya lhag byung po ti tha po nang gi khyim du tsha bab mdzad mjal mi nyis stong lhag 'dus pa la phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang / de nas pur han thu dgon par mchod rdzas thegs pa'i dge 'dun gyi ser sbrengs dang bcas 'byor te zhag lnga'i ring bzhugs/ smon lam bla ma sku khams ma bde ba'i don la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi gtor zlog dang 'chi blu grib sel byabs khrus sogs rim gro 'ga' zhig bsgrubs shing tshe dbang gnang / 'on kyang smon lam bla ma bsnyung bab ha cang lci bas slar 'tsho mi thub par shes nas khong rang gis gsar du 396

༄7/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /btab pa'i dgon pa gnyis yod pa dang yang srid kyi skor rnams rje nyid la blo gtad pa'i bcol dam zhus/ nyid nas kyang mgo 'dren gyi zhal bzhes dang thugs dam gsal 'debs kyi bslab ston rgyas par stsal/ bzhugs ring la nyin rer ser skya'i khrom mang por mjal kha dang gzungs sngags bsgrags pa ma ṇi'i bzlas lung gnang ba sogs sngar rgyun ltar mdzad/ thu med dang pe zi'i ho sho'u nas mi drag mang po'ang mjal bar 'ongs/ nyi shu bdun gyi nyin tshogs dbur gdan drangs nas dge 'dun mang pos zhabs brtan gsol 'debs dang sprags te dngul ma sne 'degs can sku gsung thugs rten na bza' gsar ba'i skor cha tshang gos chen gyi bzhugs gdan rgyab yol rta sga 'khor can dngul srang nyis brgya lnga bcu bcas phul/ mkhan po bkra shis bstan 'dzin gyes maṇ+ḍal gyi zhu 'bul byas par bab bstun gyi bka' lan bzang po gnang dge 'dun la phyag dbang dang sgo drug pa'i gzungs kyi lung sogs chos 'brel stsal/ de nyin pur han thu nas chibs bsgyur gnang hāl ga thu grong pa dang shī re'i lha khang du rim pas gsol ja dang ser skya spyi mang gis phyag dbang chos 'brel zhus/ da kwan tho hos la cang gi chos rgya mtsho'i khyim du shis brjod gnang ste pa ron ho ro'i lha khang du zhag bab mdzad grwa pa rnams la gdugs dkar gye lung dang skye pho mo'i khrom lnga stong brgal bar phyag dbang dang gzungs sngags ma ṇi'i bzlas lung khas len bskor ba sogs rgyas par gnang /nyer brgyad la a ke bsod nams stobs rgyas kyi khyim du gsol ston 'bul nod gzabs shing gza' mi tshang mar khyung khra'i rjes gnang stsal mjal mi nyis stong tsam byung / pa cha gān thes la tha po nang bsam 'phel sogs spyi mang gis gsol ja zhus thog mjal mi chig stong lhag byung / ar pan ger gyi lha khang du nang so bzod pas gtsos spyi mang gis zhabs tog zhus thog sbyin bdag 397

༄/ /gung bangab naba'izlanami'i gsung 'bum/'jigs byed skyabs dpon po ngo g.yog chibs bsur 'byor mjal ba stong phrag tsam 'dus nang so yi dam skyabs kyi lha khang du bzhugs/ der yang mjal mi nyis stong tsam byung ste nyin gcig pu der yang mjal pa drug stong brgal ba byung na'ang thugs sun pa dang ngal ba'i rnam pa gtan mi mdzad par de thams cad la phyag dbang 'tshem med dang sngags kyi bzlas lung sogs cung zad kyang sla chos su ma song ba brtse gzigs gnang / nyi shu dgu la tha po nang 'od zer skyabs dang tha po nang dharma skyabs gnyis kyis rang rang gi khyim du bsnyen bkur dang 'dod chos zhus mjal kha zhu mkhan yang sum stong lhag byung o lān go'i 'du khang du bzhugs zhag mdzad/ 'dir mjal kha zhu mi stong phrag bdun lhag 'dus shing snga phyir mjal mi khri phrag brgal ba la phyag dbang dang rnam rgyal ma'i gzungs ring byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs sogs gzungs zab mo rnams dang ma ṇi 'dren bcug pa dang khas len bskor ba bsngo smin gyis mtshams sbyar ba sogs rgyas par stsal/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gcig la de ga'i bla ma dge 'dun la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sngags btu'i rjes gnang stsal gzhis len 'bul ba'ang gzabs/ thu pid dge bskos dang zhabs drung dem chi che chung so sos gdan drangs nas rten la phyag nas zhus/de nas 'jigs byed skyabs dpon po'i yā mon gyi nye 'dabs su skye pho mo'i khrom chen pos yig drug gdangs snyan pos 'don cing phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa'i dge 'dun gyis ser sbrengs kyis mdun bsus te thog mar dpon po'i khang par gdan drangs dpon po yum sras rnams kyis mjal phyag dang gsol ja dkar spro zhus/ de nas bzhugs gnas su phebs te ser skya'i khrom lnga stong brgal bar phyag dbang dang chos 'brel dkyus ltar gnang / tshes gnyis la sen ye zi ye so so'i yā mon dang lha khang jo bo'i lha 398

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /khang rnams su gsol jar gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs nas phyir 'khor mjal kha zhu mi mang po la phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang / tshes gsum la smon lam bla ma bkra shis dar rgyas sku tshe ma zin par tha po nang bsod nams stobs rgyas dang gu thi legs grub rnams 'ongs nas yang bskyar gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul/ nyi ma kha shas kyi ring bla dpon sbyin bdag grwa rigs ser skya stong phrag nye bar spyan ras gzigs tshem bu dmar khrid blo dman rab 'bring so so'i rgyud tshod dang bstun pa'i gzab bshad rgyas par stsal pas thams cad dga' ba dang dad gus 'phel/ sangs bar du gnyer ba gdugs dkar skyabs sogs paṇ+ḍi ta zhabs drung gi grwa pa rnams kyis lha khang du gdan drangs zhabs drung gi gdung la khrus chog dang zhugs 'bul rus bu sbyangs chog sogs gnad du 'gro nges pa gnang grwa rigs rnams nas kyang dge sgrub kyi dngos 'bul rgya che ba bstar grwa pa rnams la thun drug gi rnal 'byor gyi khrid stsal/ nas nas lha khang du dem chi sbyin pa sogs grwa pa rnams kyis zhabs tog gzabs shing yon tan gzhir gyur ma'i khrid zhus gu thi ting 'dzin gyes gshag tu ja zhus thog don gnyer can mang po la chos tshan thor bu 'ga' zhig gi lung gnang / tshes bdun gyi nyin smon lam bla ma'i dgon par phebs lam du dge slong shag sha pad kyi lha khang du rab gnas rta thog ma mdzad dgon par nyin lnga bzhugs pa'i nyin gsum la nyid chog grogs dang bcas pas 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod bdag 'jug dang 'brel ba'i lho sgo gnang nyin gcig la bla ma'i yang srid myur gsal dang dgon gnyis kyi 'chad nyan 'phel ba'i rim gror spyi bskang btang nas 'phrin bcol gnyer gtad gnad smin mdzad yang srid myur 'byon gyi bden tshig gsar rtsom gyi lngags lung gnang / sngar smon lam bla ma rang nyid kyis gtad gnyer zhus pa bzhin grwa rigs rnams kyis kyang chos srid 399

༄/ /gung tha bstanapa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/gang cir rje nyid las re sa gzhan na med tshul nan gyes zhus shing nyid nas kyangadagon pa gnyis kye bla grwa rgan pa rnams 'dzom thog tu spyi sger gye bslab ston zhib par gnang / dgongs rdzogs grub yon du bla ma rang gi na bza' srus gtsang gi skor cha tshang chu tshod 'khor lo dngul srang nyis brgya chibs rta sga srab can phebs byams dre'u gnyis dang bcas phul/ smon lam bla ma 'di nyid rje 'di la mi phyed pa'i dad pa can gyi slob ma'i gtso bo zhig yin pas khong gi tshe tshad sogs kyang rje nyid kyis sngon zhig nas ye shes kyi spyan gyis gzigs pa bzhin sbed gsang med par gsung snang ste/ 'ja' klong 'khyil bar snga mo zhig dge ba'i bshes gnyen har chin smon lam bla ma bkra shis dar rgyas kyi khong rang gi tshe tshad la brtag pa dgos tshul nan tan byung bar/ ban+de thal ba sbrul gyi dug / gsum gsum dgu ru rang sgra sgogs/ / zer ba zhig byung ba de dus ji bzhin dpyod ma shes/ 'di lo smon lam bla ma sku gshegs par gsum gsum zhes pa sum cu nyis brtsegs drug cu'i brda dang dgu ni rang lo re brgyad thog yin kyang bshol zla brtsis na re dgu yin 'dug pas de'i bar du rang sgra sgrogs pa 'tsho ba'i don dang / bsde ni smon lam bla ma nyid dang thal ba ni 'das pa'i dus dang sbrul gyi dug ni shing sbrul 'o 'dir tsub pa'i brda yin par 'dug ces gsungs so/ / bcu gcig gi nyin de nas phyir 'khor tha po nang mgon po skyabs dang jang gi ki rti gnyis kyi khyim du rim pas bsnyen bkur zhus shing ki rti'i khyim du skye pho mo'i khrom la spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang stsal tha po nang bsod nams stobs rgyas kyi khyim du bzhugs phyi nyin bkwan tho hos kyi lha khang du bla ma dge 'dun la bzang spyod kyi lung gnang lha khang la ming zhus par kun phan gling zhes btags/ tha po nang dge 'dun skyabs kyi khyim du shis brjodaganang ste dpon po'i yā mon du 'byor a ke tsardo pā la'i nang du gdan /khru

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /drangs te gsol ston 'bul ba gzabs gza' mi tshang ma dang tshogs pa stong phrag brgal bar rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang stsal/ phyi nyin phyir 'khor te dpon po'i skyed tshal du snga ma shing bya lor rje nyid ho sho'u 'di gar phebs dus tshe dpag med lha dgu'i khrom dbang gnang skabs rnam bum gyi kha rgyanaphyas pa'i 'bras bu can gyi shing gi yal ga skyed tshal du btsugs pa shing sdong chen por gyur pa gzigs 'bul zhus par bla slob dam tshig gtsang ba'i stobs kyis tshe dang bsod nams sogs 'phan dar ba'i rten 'brel legs gsungs te dar dkar btags shing shis brjod mdzad/ bcu bzhi la e phu dge legs bsam 'grub kyis khyim du gdan drangs te zhabs tog 'bul nod gzabs gza' mi rnams la mgon po bar chad kun sel gyi rjes gnang stsal/bco lnga'i nyin phyir 'khor sbyin bdag dpon po'i khang chen du dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga gnang de nyin nas dbu btsugs te nyin kha shas kyi ring ser skya drag zhan brgya phrag mang po la bla ma mchod pa'i khrid rgyas pa chos tshan thor bu mang po zhig gi ljags lung spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal dang mgon po'i rjes gnang 'jigs byed sngags btu'i rjes gnang sogs dam pa'i chos kyi char phab/ sbyin bdag dpon po 'jigs byed skyabs sngar ho sho'u'i ja sag yin pa rkyen zhig la brten nas ja sag shor bar phyis kyi brgyud pa rnams kyi mnga' thang rgyas ched du dmigs nas lha mo gu ru sle'i sbyin sreg sogs gnad dmigs can gyi rim gro 'ga' zhig gnang / a ke kun bzang dpon mo 'bum skyid ja lang chog thu jang gi tshang thu rnams kyis khyim du rim pas gdan drangs nas zhag re mchod/ 'bum skyid kyi khyim du ser skya'i khrom chen por spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang tshang thu'i khyim du don gnyer ba nyung 'dus la mkha' spyod ma'i siskyo ra'i byin rlabs tshang thu gza' mi rnams la sgol ma'i rjes 401

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/gnad kun bzang dang cho ga thu'i khyim so sor dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga gnang / ca khir chi bo yan thu dang mgon po sogs sbyin bdag grwa rigs 'ga' zhig gis gzim gshag nas gsol tshigs dang 'bul nod btegs shing rang rang gi 'dod don 'ga' zhig zhus par yid tshim pa'i bka' stsal phebs/ja sag gung gi mi sna ca khir chi sangs rgyas skyabs nes man wang gi mi sna khā gdugs dkar skyabs rnams 'byor nas so so'i ho sho'u la gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul/ sngar sen ji'i phyogs kyi sbyin bdag grwa rigs kyis gdan 'dren zhus par 'byor rgyu'i zhal len gnang ba bzhin tha po nang tshe 'phel rdo rje spun gsum gdan 'dren du slebs/ nyer gsum gyi nyin dpon po'i yā mon nas thon tshe 'phel rdo rje spun gsum tshab dpal ldan rdo rje'i khyim du 'dus nas gzhas len 'bul nod gzabs shing der bzhugs/ mjal kha zhu mi sum stong brgal bar phyag dbang dang gzungs sngags zab mo bsgrags pa ma ṇi'i bzlas lung khas len bskor ba sogs rgyas par stsal/ nyi shu bzhi la sbyin bdag spun gsum gtsos skya ser gyi khrom la lha mo 'od zer can ma'i rjes gnang stsal de ga'i lha khang dang cho 'phel rdo rje mun gun tu shi so so'i khyim du gsol ja dang shis brjod zhus/ nes man ho tho'i lha khang du spyi mang gis gsol ja dang chos 'brel zhus ta la'i ho ro la tha bo nang gi rel tshang gi khyim dang de ga'i lha khang du rim pas zhabs tog 'bul ba zhus shing lha khang der ser skya'i khrom chen por spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang stsal/ nang so rin chen gyi gzhi la bzhugs khu dpon gyis 'dod don ci rigs pa'i gsol ba btab cing yon 'bul rgya che ba bstar/ pā rin wang gi mi sna tā bla ma ja khir chi phas than tā rnams 'byor nas de ga'i ho sho'u la gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul/ nyer lnga'i nyin tha po nang bsod nams don grub kyis khyim du bsnyen bkur gzabs 402

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /shingagaza' mi tshang mar sgrol ma'i rjes gnang stsal/ dge slong sbyin pa bkra shis kyi lha khang du phyag nas gtor bar mdzad gor pan ger du khun du shes rab kyis zhabs tog zhus thog ser skya mang por mgon po'i rjes gnang stsal de ga'i lha khang la ming zhus par phun tshogs rtag brtan gling zhes btags/ tha bon ger gyi lha khang du ja lang rdo rje sogs spyi mang gis bsnyen bkur zhus shing seraskya'i khrom chen por spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang stsal/ tha po nang ming ga thu'i khyim du shis brjod mdzad de sen ji'i lha khang du kā dā gu shis gtsos dge 'dun gyi ser sbrengs dang bcas phyag babs 'di nyid snga phyir mjal kha zhu mi stong phrag drug tsam byung bar phyag dbang dang gzungs sngags zab mo'i bzlas lung sogs rgyun gyi phyag bzhes ltar gnang / phyi nyin lha khang de ga'i bla grwa dang sbyin bdag dpon 'bangs bcas ser skya'i khrom shin tu mang poraspyan ras gzigs snying po don gsum gyi khrid gzab bshad stsal khong tshos kyang 'bul ba gya nom pa btegs/ de nas phyir 'khor te tha po nang a yu shi tshe ring dpal rnam thos sras rnams kyi khyim dang rab 'byams pa rin chen gyi lha khang rnams su rim pas bsnyen bkur dang 'dod chos zhus/ nes man ho tho'i dge bskos bde legs sogs ja zhus 'ga' zhig gi don mdzad de dpon po'i mon du 'byor/ nyer bdun la e phu dge legs bsam 'grub kyi lha khang du rab 'byams pa blo gros sogs grwa mang gis gsol tshigs zhus tshogs pa la rnam rgyal ma'i gzungs ring dang bstod pa'i lung gnang / tha po nang ci rag lang gis khyim du zhabs tog dang phyag gnas zhus/ de nas ho shu'i sbyin bdag thun mong gi rim gror nyin gsum gyi ring bcad rgya mdzad nas mjug tu mgon po'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gnang / 'di dag gi snga phyir mi ma yin gdug pa can gyis mtho brtsams pa dang lha sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi nus pa bsam gyis 403

༄/ /gung bang bstan ba'isgoname'i gsung 'bum/mikhyab pa'i sgo nas gdug can thal bar brlag pa'i ltas ya mtshan pa mang du byung snang ste/ 'ja' klong 'khyil bar har chin pe zi'i ho sho'ur 'gro skabs nged kyi rmi lam du zeng po zer ba'i pe zi'i g.yog po zhig snga sor gshis ngan du shi ba des mi mang po zhig btang nas nged kyi lam dgog pa 'dug zer/ nged kyis bltas pas nged 'gro ba'i lam na ri chen po zhig la mi mang pos me gtong gan 'dug nged kyis sngags bzlas pa'i mchil ma zhig btab pas me thams cad rang shir song ba rmis pe zi'i ho sho'u la slebs nas sen ji zer ba'i ri'i 'dabs su ri de dang mnyam pa'i 'ug pa'i gdong ba can spu rwa gdengs pa shin tu yid du mi 'ong ba zhig gis phyogs thams cad lta nyul byed pa la zur nas mi gzhan zhig gis 'di nyid dam sri ma rungs pa zhig yin/ sngar thu med pe zi'i ho sho'u la song nas der bkra mi shis pa sna tshogs bskyed pa yin/ de nas 'di gar 'ongs pas lo snga ma rnams su 'khrugs long sogs mi bde ba mang po byung ba de yin da 'di nas mi ring bar hang chin wang gi ho sho'u la 'gro ba yin no zer ba zhig byung / de ltar byung tshul sbyin bdag wang la labs kyang de byung na nged rnams phung la gtong rgyu yin 'dug zer ba tsam las rim gro sogs kyi rtsol ba byas ma song bas phyis su nges par de bzhin byung 'dug / zeng po zer ba gdon 'drer skyes yong dogs 'dug pas de la dmigs nas las sbyor zhig byas par nged rang dngos la rtags mtshan ci yang ma byung / phun tshogs bstan pa'i rmi lam du nged dpon g.yog lam zhig tu 'gro gan 'dug pa la rgya dpon lta bu kha shas kyis lam khar bsgug 'dug / nged kyis de mthong ma thag khros te dam nyams zeng po 'di gar bsdad 'dug pa thams cad rgyug la kho 'khor bcas ma shor bar zungs shig zer bzhin phyag g.yog pa rnams dang gzhanayang las mkhan lta bu khro gtum can mang po zhig gis rgya dpon g.yog 404

༄za/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bcas bzung nas mgo gcod pa snying 'don pa sogs kyis ma lus par bsad nged nas gnas 'di ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod yin no zer ba zhig rmis 'dug gsung pa rnams kyis shes par snang ngo / / bzhi pa'i mas gcig dang gnyis la dgebasnyen pha ma dang rab byung dge tshul sgrub mkhan drug brgya lhag tsam dang bsnyen rdzogs bsgrub bya brgya dang nyi shu rnams yid kyi bum bzang tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i bdud rtsis bkang ste thar ba'i grong khyer mchog tu 'dzud par mdzad/ tshes gsum la sbyin bdag dpon blon rnams la phyag rdor gtumazung dang seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi rjes gnang ho sho'u'i spyi chos su ser skya'i khrom khri phrag brgal par spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang bka' drin stsal/ sbyin bdag dpon po 'jigs byed skyabs yab sras kyis brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal che legs gos chen gyi bzhugs gdan rgyab yol ched gnyer gyis bsgrubs pa'i na bza'i skor tshang ma bzang gos las bsgrubs pa'i mchod rdzas du ma bu lag bcu go gser gnyis/dngul srang nyis brgya yu'u phing zer ba nan mu dang yu'u shi shel rnams kyis spel mar bsgrubs pa'i rgyab yol rin thang can bcas phul/ cing ho sho'u spyi 'dus kyi 'bul ba'ang gzabs/ 'dir bzhugs ring la nyin rer snga dro phyi dro gnyis la mjal kha zhu mi shin tu mang po zam ma chad du byung bar phyag dbang dngagazungs sngags zab mo bsgrags pa ma ṇi bgrang ba dang khas len skor ba sogs chag med du gnang zhing 'dod chos dang bka' bsgo gsung brtag gson gshin gyi bsngo ba phyag sman sogs gang 'dod du stsal/ chos bzhi'i nyin ho sho'u de nas phyir 'khor bar do lon pe'i shing dang sha bar tha'i grong ba spyi mang gis rim gyis zhabs tog dang mjal kha zhus/ 'jigs byed skyabs dpon po a ke tsardon pā la sogs chibs skyel pa byings rnams phyir slog nang so 405

༄/ /gung bang bstanapa'i nayo gsung 'bum/chos skyabs dang khun tu nyi ma rdo rje khun tu nes ma ta'i rnams kyis bsnyen bkur dang 'dod chos zhus shing nas ma tras kyi khyim du bzhugs/ snga phyi'i mjal ba mang po la phyag dbang chos 'brel sngar rgyun ltar gnang / tshes lnga la lam du ja zhus dgu la babs te so sos 'dod pa'i re ba skong bar mdzad/zhes man jang gi'i grong sde'i lha khang du gu thi bstan 'dzin dang jang ri bo yan thu sogs spyi mang gis zhabs tog gzabs shing ser skya brgya phrag mang por yon tan gzhir gyur ma'i khrid gnang / ja lang sin cang thus gdan drangs nas gzhis len 'bul nod gzabs shing gza' mi rnams la gdugs dkar gyi lung dang snga phyir mjal mi sum stong lhag tsam byung bar phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang / tshes drug la srad rgyud mkhan zur blo bzang shes rab kyis ri khrod du gdan drangs te zhabs tog 'bul ba zhus rten gsum la rab gnas rta thog ma dang tshogs pa rnams la mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gdams pa'i nying khu lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi khrid stsal/ yong god g.yon ru'i lha khang du smon ram pa dge 'phel sogs ser skya spyi mang gis bsnyen bkur zhus shing rten gsum la rab gnas mdor bsdus dang mjal pa'i khrom chen por zab lam bla ma'i rnam 'byor dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid gnang / o ma pi chi'i lha khang du ser skya spyi mang gis gsol ja dang chos 'brel zhus/ wang gi ho sho'u'i tha po nang dar dung dang tshe brtan tā bla ma bkra shis don grub rnams gdan 'dren du 'byor cho lo chid la dpa' bo skyabs kyi khyim du bzhugs/ snga phyi'i mjal ba nyis stong lnga brgya tsam la phyag dbang dang / rgyun pa'i phyag bzhes kyi chos 'brel sogs gnang / tshes bdun la/ de ga'i grong sde gnyis kyis mjal kha chos 'brel dang / sha par thu'i lha khang du ser skya spyi mang gis gsol ja dang / skyabs 'gro'i lung zhus/ ping thu nang so dang tā bla ma bkra shis don 406
