༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /grub so so'i lha khang du gdan drangs te bsnyen bkur bstabs/ ser skya'i khrom sum stong brgal bar spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gye rjes gnang stsal/ ni rul hu'i tho yon nang so nor bu dang skal ldan/ ye bu shu'i tā bla ma gdugs dkar skyabs rnams gdan 'dren du 'byor/ thur gen a ma'i lhakhang du bzhugs/ snga phyi'i mjal pa khri tsho nye bar phyag dbang dang bka' chos dkyus ma'i skor rgyas par gnang / chos rje kun dga' dang / go no yon sogs ser skya spyi mang nas gzhis len 'bul ba gzabs/ tshes brgyad la/ de ga'i ser skya mang por khyung nag gi rjes gnang stsal/ e phu dge legs bsam 'grub sogs pe zi'i ho sho'u'i mi drag 'ga' zhig phyir log /dge slong rab brtan gyi lha khang du gsol ja dang shis brjod zhus/ tha po nang puṇ+ḍi dang phun tshogs sogs ja zhus pa 'ga' zhig gi don mdzad/ pe la cher su me'i zhabs drung ngo g.yog gdan 'dren tu 'byor/ no rul hu ri tha po nang chos sbyin pa dang rab brtan gnyis kyis khyim du rim gyis phyag nas zhus gung gi ho ro'i lha khang du zhag bab gnang snga phyi'i mjal ba mang po la phyag dbang chos 'brel sngar rgyun ltar mdzad/ tshes dgu'i nyin de ga'i bla dpon rnams dang ser skya'i khrom stong phrag brgal bar spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang la/ chos bzang chos rje dang tha po nang rnam dag sogs yon mchod rnams nas shangs len gzabs shing mchod sprin spros/ tha po nang tshe brtan dang rnam dag gi khyim du rim pas shis brjod zhus/ ha sa dag gi tā bla ma dang tha po nang no mong skyabs sogs mjal bar byung po long a ke'i hor la tha po nang a la than tshang gi khyim du tshogs pa stong phrag brgal bar bla ma mchod pa'i ljags lung stsal/ ho ro de ga'i lha khang du tā bla ma gdugs dkar skyabs tha po nang a yu shi dar dung sogs ser skya spyi mang gis bsnyen bkur zhus shing 407

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung babum/skye pho mo'i khrom la sman chog bsdus pa'i ljags lung gnang / tha po nang a yu shi dang dar dung thu sa lag chi'i ho ro'i tha po nang a la ma su dang dar ma rnams kyis rim pas bsnyen bkur dang 'dod don zhus pa'i re ba skong par mdzad tha bo nang rdor skyabs kyi khyim du zhag bzhugs zhus shing 'bul nod gzabs/sbyin bdag har chin wang gi mi sna 'byor nas mtshams zhu dang bka' 'gyur su me la gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul/ snga phyi'i mjal ba lnga stong tsam la phyag dbang dang bka' chos kyi rim pa dkyus ltar gnang / tshes bcu'i zhog ka tha bonang rdor skyabs la mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs stsal/ tha po nang seng ge stobs rgyas dang tā bla ma nor bu sogs spyi sger nas zhabs tog 'bul ba gzabs shing de ga'i lha khang du ser skya'i khrom chen por spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang dang sgo drug pa'i gzungs kyi lung sogs gnang ni chu gun gyi zhabs drung tā bla ma ngo g.yog mjal du 'byor/ ni rul hu'i khu na du smon lam sogs sbyin bdag mang gi gsol ja chos 'brel dang phal cher gyi lha khang du zhabs drung dam chos rgyal mtshan sogs ser skya spyi mang gis zhabs tog dang bzang spyod kyi lung zhus dge slong no mon tshang gi gzhi la bzhugs/ gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas dang a ke pur+ṇa pā la don grub rdo rje sogs dpon po mang po'i mtshams zhu 'bul mi rim par 'byor/ sbyin bdag wang gi gsung bkod bzhin pe zi'i ho sho'u'i rta ul skyel mi dang bcas 'di nas phyir slog ste wang gi ho sho'u'i rim steng nas phebs/ snga phyi'i mjal ba sum stong brgal bar mjal kha chos 'brel dkyus ltar gnang / bcu gcig gi zhog ka dge slong no mon tshang la phyag rdor gyi rjes gnang stsal cing 'bul nod gzabs mjal mi drug brgya tsam byung / thu bod dge slong gi lha khang du de ga'i grong sde gnyis kyis bsnyen bkur zhus am pa jang gi'i grong sde spyi sger nas zhabs rtog 408

ro༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /dang chos 'brel zhus/ a min dha re'i ho tho la jang gi tshe 'phel gyi ja zhus thogabaka' 'gyur su me'i zhabs drung ngo g.yog dang gung gi sras a ke dpal 'byor a ke pu r+ṇa pā la sogs mi drag mang po chibs bsur 'byor/ shi ne ho tho'irdo rje'i khyim du shis pa spel te de ga'i lha khang du bzhugs/ bcu gnyis la ser skya stong phrag brgal bar sgo drug pa'i gzungs dang bka' chos dkyus ma'i skor rnams phyag dbang dang bcas gnang / no mon chog thu bla ma sogs spyi mang gis gzhis len 'bul ba gzabs/ i khe ho tho la ja lang thu su khe'i khyim dang dge slong ngag dbang sbyin pa'i lha khang rnams su rim par phebs te so so'i re ba bskangs lha khang la ming zhus par bkra shis 'phel rgyas gling zhes btags ja lang dbang ldan rdo rje'i khyim du shis brjod gnang / tsha gan ho thu'i jang gi a tsa la'i khyim du zhabs tog zhus thog mjal pa stong phrag tsam 'dus pa la so sor 'brang ma'i lung sogs chos 'brel phyag dbang gnang /dur bul ji'i lha khang du em chi tshe 'phel sogs ser skya spyi mang gis phyag dbang chos 'brel zhus/ e ba'i lung ba'i mdor tha ben gyi khyim tshang rnams kyis mjal kha dang zhabs tog zhus tshogs pa stong phrag nye bar skyabs 'gro'i lung sogs chos 'brel phyag dbang gnang / de nas bka' 'gyur su me'i nye 'dabs su gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun brgya phrag mang pos ser sbrengs dang bcas phyag phebs lha khang 'og ma'i zhabs drung gi gshag tu bzhugs gnas mdzad/sbyin bdag wang chibs bsur phebs pa'i snga 'azin du ja khir chi shi rim btang ba 'byor nas rgyu mtshan phul/ bcu gsum gyi nyin snga dro mjal kha zhu mi stong phrag lnga tsam la phyag dbang dang bka' chos dkyus ma bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor bcas rgyas par gnang / phyi dro zhabs drung dpon g.yog tshang mar bde mchog gi rjes gnang stsal zhabs drung gis bkur ste zhabs tog phul du phyin pa 409

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgoname'i gsung 'bum/bsgrubs/ sbyin bdag chen wang rat+na sirnyi yab sras blon 'khor dang bcas 'byor te lha khang gong mar gdan drangs nas gsol ja dkar spro zhus lha khang gi grwa mang dang wang yab sras blon 'khor sogs ser skya'i khrom la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rjes gnang stsal lha khang sbyi nas gsol ston dang 'bul nod gzabs/mtshan mo lha khang gi nye 'dabs su sbyin bdag wang gis me'i rtsed 'jo ya mtshan pa gzigs mor phul/ bcu bzhi'i nyin wang gis lha khang gong ma'i tshogs dbur gdan drangs rje nyid la 'bul ba dang dge 'dun la mang 'gyed kye bsnyen bkur zhus thog gnas brtan phyag mchod dang bsngo smon bstan 'bar ma bcas gsungs/ mchod mjal du phebs nas rten gsum la rab gnas rta thog ma mdzad/ rab 'byams pa blo bzang dga' bas gshag tu bsnyen bkur dang phyag nas zhus cur ga ta'i nang so'i sku skye sogs spyi sger nas 'bul nod dang bcas bka' bsgo skyabs 'jug zhu mkhan mang du byung / wang yab sras dang lhan du bka' 'gyur su me nas thon phebs lam du thu sa lag chi tshul khrims lha skyabs gung gi a ke sogs chibs bsu ba 'ga' zhig 'byor u lān tā pa'i rgya tshang du zhag bab gnang / o'u hun thul ga'i su me'i tā bla ma na dem chi dge bskos rnams slebs nas gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul/ ong nyod e phu dpal 'byor ngo g.yog 'byor nas mjal kha zhus/ sa ga'i bco lnga la do'u zer ba'i rgya mi zhig gi khang bar zhag mal mdzad/ sku don rgya che bas ha cang thugs 'gol ba ma byung yang dus chen sum 'dzom gyis 'gyur shin tu che bar dgongs te rten gyi drung du gtsang zhing gya nom pa'i mchod pa phun sum tshogs pa phul nas spyan dmigs nan tan dang bcas 'dus pa'i rgyu rgyud le'u bcu gsum pa'i mtshams sbyor bar ljags klog dang bsngo smon rgya cher gnang /wang yab sras sogs la thun drug rnal 'byor dam tshig rdo rje'i bzlas sgom 410

༄ / / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /sogs kyi lung stsal/ bcu drug gi nyin mo cang gong zer bar wang gi yā mon rnyingaba'i shul du wang 'khrungs sar lha khang zhig 'dug par tsha bab dang shis brjod mdzad/ rgyal chen lha khang du bkra shis kyi me tog 'thor lam bar du gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas yab sras gtsos pa'i dpon po mang tsam bsu bar glebs gung gis yu mod du gdan drangs nas gsol ja dang dpon mo rnams kyis mjal kha zhus/ wang gi lha khang gi zhabs drung tho yon chos rje nang so so'i sogs bsu ba mang po lam nas 'byor/ klu'i lha khang zhig yod sar wang gi thab bsu dang a ge lha rgyal rdo rje ke ke blon po rnams mang tsam bsu bar slebs nas mjal kha zhus/ wang gi be+e mon gyi sgo drung du lha khang gi dge 'dun rnams kyis ser stengs rol cha du ma dang bcas gdan drangs/ bā kun yod pa'i rgya dpon car go chi dgos ched cig tu yā mon la yong yod pa sgo'i phyi rol tu 'ongs nas bsus te mjal 'phrad zhus/ khang ba dbus mar bzhes spro gsol ja zhus te mi drag rnams kyis mjal kha zhus/ de nas sngar gye bzhugs gnas su phebs te gzhi phab nas bzhugs char dkon par chu mig cig tu char rdzas ril bu bskyal bas de nub cung zad babs/ bcu bdun la pā rin wang gi gdan 'dren zhu mi tho yon zhabs drung blo bzang bstan 'dzin thu sa lag chi ho shang da mai rin thu mur sogs blon po kha shas bcas ngo g.yog brgyad cu skor zhon rta rnga mong dang bcas 'byor nas phyag dbang zhus/ u cu mu chin e rte ni paṇ+ḍi ta gu shri'i sku skye ong nyid e phu dpal 'byor la skyes yod pa ched gtad 'byor par rab byung gi tshul khrims thog cing blo bzang bshad sgrub nyi ma zhes ming stsal/ gzhan yang bsgrub bya mang tsam byung ba rab byung dang dge tshul sogs su bsgrubs/ pe zi 'chi med rdo rje'i che bo rat+na ki rte sogs pe zi'i ho sho'u nas phyag phyir brdzangs pa'i mi drag ngo g.yog phyir slog par phyag 411

༄/ /gung ca bstanapa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/dbang bka' bsgo gnang / bco brgyad la ka chen dgon pa'i spyi 'jog byams pa'i gos sku'i ma dpe'i skya ris kyi mgo btsugs me rin bstan 'dzin rab byung bsgrubs/ nā e phu'i mi sna 'byor nas mtshams zhu phul nye 'khor gyi grong ba'i bu chung 'brum pa 'debs rgyu mang por bka' bsgo shis brjod sogs gnang / sbyin bdag wang 7gong ma ri dwags la phebs pa'i sa cha sogs kyi gzigs rtog la phebs rgyur bka' bsgo byin rlabs mdzad/ bcu dgu'i nyin pā rin phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur bla dpon thams cad kyis phebs skyel zhus shing wang gi lha khang gi gu thi tā ma bsam 'grub nyi ma gung gi lha khang gi zhabs drung tā bla ma/ wang gi tho yon gnyis dang sras gsum pa lha rgyal rdo rje gung gi a keng pas 'byor blon po kha zhabs bcas zhabs phyir 'brangs/ a ke don grub rdo rjes khyim du gsol ja zhus gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyis khyim du dkar spro zhus shing gung dang a ke rnams kyis zhag bab bar du skyel ma bgyis mo cing gong du zhag sgar phab/ nyi shu'i nyin u lān ha da'i tshad du wang gi gzhung nas gung tshigs drangs yong nyod wang gis cha sha ra ga zhes par zhag bab gnang / 'di nyin rlung 'tshub shin tu che bas lam bgrod dka' se pa zhig byung bar de la dmigs nas dam can rdo rje legs pa la gsur bsngos byed bcug pas phyi nyin cung zad 'jam pa byung / nyi shu gcig gi tsha zhag khu thul bu lag dang per khe gnyis kyi tsha zhag ther ge thu dang chin ngog / gsum gye tsha zhag sa ran tha'i dang o lā su'i ho dog rnams su mdzad/ phyir lam ong nyod po li'i ho sho'u la phebs rgyu'i snyan gsan 'bul bar dbang chen tho yon 'byor te gsol ba btab pa bzhin zhal gyes bzhes/ pa rin wang gi mtshams zhu pa khā tshas cing hu 'byor/ nyi shu bzhi la ha shā thu hu dog la tsha bab le zi'i tha bin la zhag mal mdzad/ chu thag ring bas nye 'khor gyi sde pa tshos chu 'dren pa la 412

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /—dka' spyad che tsam bgyis/ tha bin gyi khyim tshang 'ga' sgar thog tu gsob ja dkar spro zhus/ bā rin wang gi lha khang gi mkhan po sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin gtsos las sne grwa ba bsu bar 'byor/ nyi shu lnga la shar mu run du tsha bab gnang / chu 'gram du wang gi a ke bsod nams rdo rje tshas shing da tha'i ji bsodanams tha'i ji sbyin ba bkra shis tha'i ji dge legs sogs dpon po ngo g.yog mang tsam dang lha khang gi khri ba bla ma don grub rgya mtsho tā bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtsho gel bar gyi tā bla ma blo bzang chos 'phel bde mchog tho yon bcas gla ba che chung brgya skor bsu bar 'byor/ mjal kha zhu mi nyis stong tsam la phyag dbangadang gzungs sngags zab mo rna bar sgogs pa rang rang gi blo nus dang bstun ba'i rnam dkar la 'bad rgyu'i dam bca' bskul ba sogs sgo du ma nas phan pa'i lam la sbyar pa yan mo ngur zhag sgar phab mi brgya phrag mang por phyag dbang sogs gnang / nyi shu drug la ho dod no'ur zhes bar tsha bab mdzad pa'i thog der mtshe'u zhig 'dug par klu gtor btang zhing char rdzas ril bu sbas pa na de ma thag 'brug sgra dang bcas char cung zad babs pas thams cad ya mtshan du gyur/ cha gan mu run gyi 'gram du sbyin bdag chin wang pa thu tha'i ji rnams dang blon po mang po bcas ngo g.yog brgya skor dang lha khang so so'i bla ma las sne ngo g.yog lnga bcu tsam bsu bar 'byor/ wang gis ras gur shin tu che ba zhig phubs 'dug par gdan drangs nas gsol ja zhus/mjal kha zhu mi stong phrag lnga tsam la phyag dbang sogs rgyun gyi phyag bzhes bzhin du mdzad/ de nas rim gyis wang gi lha khang thams cad kyi thog ma rdzogs ldan gling zhes par gdan drangs bla grwa rnams la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bla brgyud gsol 'debs smon lam shis brjod kyi lung gnang phyag dbang bklag lung sogs kyis mgu bar mdzad/ wang gi yā mon gyi sgor dge 'dun mang pos 413

༄/ /gung bangabastan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/mchod rdzas rol cha thogs nas ser sprengs dang skya ser gyi khrom chen po 'tshogs pa dang bcas nang du gdan drangs dkar spro gsol tshigs sogs rgya cher zhus/rwa skor du phyir gur phubs par bzhugs gnas mdzad/ bu mo zhig nad tshab drag pos zin 'dug par bka' bsgo zhig gnang bas de ma thag tsher ma bton pa bzhin du nad sangs kyis drag ste thams cad dad pa'i sa la bkod/ nyi shu bdun la pā rin ja sag pe zi tshe 'phel rdo rje pe zi rdo rje rab brtan dpon blon mang po dang bcas mjal bar 'byor/ skya ser gyi khrom khri phrag long bar phyag dbang dang gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma'i gzungs ring byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs bsgrags/ ma ṇi'i bzlas lung khas len bskor ba bsngo smon sogs sngar rgyun bzhin du mdzad de de dag thams cad 'khor ba mtha' can du byas/ wang gi sdod gnas rnams su shis brjod kyi me tog 'thor/ mi zhig nyes spyod tshan che bas srog gi chad par thug yod pa wang la ngo chen gnang ste mi 'jigasabaskyabs kyi sbyin pa stsal/ ong nyod pe li'i mi sna slebs shing u lā sogs tshes gnyis tsam la sleb par thag bcad/ nyi shu brgyad la chos bsgrags gling gi bla ma dge 'dun tshang mas mjal kha dang 'bul nod phul dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid yon tan gzhir gyur ma dang bstan 'bar ma'i lngags lung stsal/ skya ser lnga stong tsam la mjal kha dkyus bzhin btang /de nas lha khang kun mkhyen gling du gdan drangs bla ma dge 'dun gyis gsol ja dad 'bul nod phul bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi lung stsal/ tha'i ji bstan 'gyur gyis khyim du gdan drangs nas gdugs dkar gyi rjes gnang zhus te gsol ston dang dngos 'bul spam mtho ba btegs/ thu sa lag chi ting sha tha'i ji co khi yol tha'i ji byams pa bkra shis tha'i ji chog thu rnams so sos khyim du gdan drangs nas gsol ja dang 'bul nod bstabs phyag dbang chos 'brel bka' 414

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bsgo sogs so so'i 'dod mos ltar gnang / nyi shu dgu la sbyin bdag wang btsun mo sras sras mo bcas kyis gtsos pa'i ho sho'u de ga'i dpon blon mang po dang pā rin pe zi rnam gnyis blon 'khor bcas dang lha khang so so'i bla ma khri ba tā ma sogs phyogs tha dad nas 'dus pa'i ser skya lnga stong tsam la rdo rje 'jigasakhyed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang gi sta gon dang lnga pa'i tshes gcig la dbangadangos gzhi smin rgyas su stsal te sku bzhi'i go 'phang 'grub pa'i sa bon grung po thebs par mdzad/ wang gis gtsos pa'i ho sho'u thun mong gis gos bzang bsgrigs pa'i bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gos chen kha shas dngul srang stong phrag gsum sogs 'bul nod rgya chen po btegs/ har chen tā gung gi mtshams zhu pa khā no mon tshang 'byor/ tshes gnyis la wang sras sras mo bcas la lo gyon ma dang rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang stsal/ mi bdun cu tsam rab byung dang dge tshul bsgrubs/ ci ling pe li'i tha'i ji de la ger chog thu thu sa lag chi pa dar hu ngo g.yog mjal du 'ongs par phyag dbang bka' bsgo sogs gnang / ong nyod nas dbang chen tho yon thu sa lag chi ho' shing sogs mi drag zhan mang po u lā dang bcas gdan 'dren du 'byor/ tshes gsum la bsgrub bya bdun cu rtsa drug la rje bla ma nyid nas mkhan po dang blo bzang rab brtan gyis las slob byas te bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa phog / phyi dro chagān mu dun gyi chu 'gram du ras gur phub par gdan drangs chi ge drangs shing stobs rtsal 'gran pa dang rta rgyug byed pa dang wang gtsos pa'i dpon blon rnams kyis mda' 'phen pa sogs yul lugs kyi dga' ston gang rgyas spyan lam du bstar/ rta rgyug gi thog mar rta dkar po zhig thon pa rje nyid la phul/char zim bu babs nas 'ja' tshon sna tshogs kyi gur khyim lan gnyis shar bar thams cad kyis rten 'brel bzang zhes dga' ba 'phel/ phyir 'khor nas 415

༄/ /gung ba bstanaba'izlanalo gsung 'bum/wangagi khang ba nang ma zhig tu wang dpon g.yog gsum tsam la 'pho khrid zab mo man ngag gis brgyan pa dang mtshan mo bla ma khri pa sogs grwa pa bgres pa 'ga' zhig la 'jigs byed rdzogs rim gyi khrid shin tu gsang ba'i gnad du ma dang bcas pa mnog chos su stsal/ 'di nyin nes man dang o'u han nas rang rang gi ho sho'u la nam phebs rgyu'i ang nyan du btang ba'i mi sna rnams kyang 'byor/ tshes bzhi'i zhog ka bla dpon tshang mar pa ri lugs kyi tshe dpag med kyi rjes gnang mdzad/ wang gi yā mon nas thon te a ke tshas shing da'i khang ba gsar par bkra shis kyi me tog 'thor/ bla dpon tshang mas skye lam bgyis te cha gan mu dun gyi chu thon nas wang gtsos pa'i bla dpon skyel mi byings rnams phyir slog / thus lag chi ting sha sogs mi drag 'ga' zhig yong nyod bar du phebs skyel zhus/ ho dod no'ur la dge legs tha'i jis khyim du gdan drangs gsol tshigs dang 'bul nod bstabs/ ba yan mo dur zhag bab steng nas zhabs drung blo bzang bstan 'dzin la dam can gyi rjes gnang stsal/ har chen nas sbyin bdag chin wang gi mtshams zhu ba thu gu su po yan thu dang e phu bu pā la'i mi sna su'i khe thu bcas 'byor/ khug ma dri bzang bsil yab sogs nyer spyad 'ga' zhig 'bul rgyu 'dug pa spyan lam du bstar/tshes lnga la shar mu run gyi tham sner ong nyod pe le'i lha khang gi tā bla ma blo bzang bshadasgrub dge bshes bla ma ye shes dar rgyas mkhan po tho yon sogs grwa pa brgya lhag bsu bar 'byor/ ho yor o su la gung bab thog yu cu mu chin tā pe lis sku zhabs nyid pā rin du phebs yod pa thos nas gdan 'dren gyi gsol ba 'debs par btang ba'i mi sna khā po yan thu ngo g.yog 'byor/ phyi log gi dpon po rnams kyis pā rin du bzhugs thog der rang rang gi ho sho'u la gdan 'dren zhu rgyu'i snyan gsan 'bul rtsis byas te yang nyan byed kyin yod 'dug 416

༄za/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /kyang / pā rin nas nyi ma kha shagalas ma bzhugs par chibs kha phyir bsgyur zin pa'i stabs kyis u cu mu chin nas 'ongs pa'i gdan 'dren pa sogs la zhal bzhes ma gnang / de nas thon par ong nyod pe li 'jigs byed skyabs tha'i ji pa yan pā thur dang ha sa pā thur thu sa lag chi sangs rgyas sogs dpon blon ngo g.yog brgya lhag bsu bar 'byor sin yo su la zhag sgar phab/ snga phyir dad 'dus kyi mjal ba mang po la phyag dbang chos 'brel sngar rgyun ltar gnang /tshesajug la phebs lam du pe li'i lha khang gi bla ma las sne grwa pa lnga bcu skor chibs bsur 'byor/ ca lā thu la pe li'i ja thab thog mjal pa stong phrag tsam la phyag dbang gnang / de nas pe li'i yā mon du dge 'dun gye ser sbrengs dang bcas phyag phebs nyin gsum bzhugs te sbyin bdag dpon po yab sras rnams la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang dang khyim du dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga gnang / pe li gtsos pa'i ho sho'u thun mong nas maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dngul srang brgyad brgya gos chen yug bcu gcig rnga mong gsum rta pho rgod nyi shu rtsa bdun bcas phul/ nyin re bzhinaskye pho mo'i khrom chen por mjal kha dang bka' chos phyag srol bzhin du gnang / tshes dgu la de nas thon khā ba thu mung khu'i khyim du shis brjod mdzad cing tha'i ji ba yan pā thur gyikhyim du bzhugs te dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga dang so sor 'brang ma'i rjes gnang stsal/ tshes bcu la tha'i ji ha sa pā thur gyi khyim du g.yang 'gug mdzad cing der bzhugs/ bcu gcig gi nyin ong nyod pe lo'i dgon par 'byor te nyin gsum bzhugs bla dpon rnams kyisagatsos ser sku stong phrag gsum lhag la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang chen zab mo sta gon dang bcas pa mjug tu dam sdom srung tshul gyi bslab bya nan tan dang bcas gnang / dgon pa'i bla grwa sbyin bdag rnams kyis dbang 417

༄/ /gung bang ba napa'i mogasung 'bum/lon du maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dngul srang lnga brgya dang lnga bcu rnga rta lnga bcu tham pa nor brgyad cu bcas phul/bla ma rnams kyis gtsos don gnyer can mi nyung tsam la nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang dang rje nyid kyi gsar rtsom gcod kyi chos skor gyi lung bcas stsal/rab byung dge tshul bsgrub bya sum cu dang bsnyen rdzogs bsgrub bya bco lnga la sdom pa gnang / nyin ltar phyogs so so nas dad 'dus kyi mjal pa'i khrom chen po la phyag dbang chos 'brel sngar rgyun bzhin mdzad/ bcu bzhi'i nyin dgon panas thon ca khir chi rnying ba'i bu rdo rjes gdan drangs nas pha'i dge rtsar dmigs pa'i 'bul nod btegs par bsngo smon gyi mtshams spyor yang dag gnang / tho yon mkhan po dang tā bla ma sogs lha khang gi las sne grwa pa du ma dang sbyin bdag pe li srun gsum thu sa lag chi sogs dpon blon mang pos nyin lam du chibs skyel zhus/ er ge ni ga thu la zhag bab thog mjal mi stong phrag tsam la phyag dbang sogs gnang / bco lnga'i nyin mo'u pu lag tu gung bab thog de phyogs su spur nag zer ba'i srin bu mang po yod pa gzigs pas rkyen byas 'du 'dzi'i yo lang gis thugs gting nas sun pas skyo mgur dbyangs su bzhes pa ni/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho yi gtso bo rol pa'i rdo rje/ /byams pa mgon po dang dbyer med mi tri'i mtshan can/ / bka' drin 'khor mtha'adang bral ba bzhad pa rdo rje/ / mtshungs med bla ma gsum bdag snying pad+mor bzhugs shig / chos med snying rul gyi dharma badz+ra ming can/ / rgyal khamasaphyogs med du nyul tshe rang gi 'dun ma/ / blun rmongs dud 'gro dang khyad par med tshul mthong nas/ gros 'debs tshig gsum 'di kha nas dbang med thal lo/ / bye thang skya bo na tshogs pa'i srin bu spur nag / lce ba'i phung bo la hab thob byed pa'i mu la/ / 'gron po'i rta rmig gis badzis 418

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /nas rmeg med byas tshe/ / bsags pa'i lud phung gis phan pa ci yang med pas/ / mi gtsang kha zas su rlom pa'i zhen chags dor te/ / yid 'ong dga' tshal du me tog gtsang ma'i bcud la/ / ci bder spyod bzhin du dar dir rgyang glu len pa'i/ / bung ba gzhon nu yi dga' ston tshogs gral snyogs shig /rgyalakhams chu bzhin du nyul ba'i dharma badz+ra/ / dad gshin dkor zas la shi spar 'tham pa'i mu la/ / glo bur 'chi bdag gi pho nyas zin par gyur tshe/ /nor rdzas longs spyod kyis phan pa cung zad med pas/ / dug la bdud rtsi ru rlom pa'i zhen chags dor te/ / dben pa'i sman ljongs su rtse gcig ting 'dzin rol/ / ci dgar spyod bzhin du lhang lhang mgur dbyangs len pa'i/ / mang thos spong ba pa'i dga' ston tshogs gral snyogs shig / grong yulasrang bar na 'khyams pa'i phag pa nag po/ / mi gtsang kha zas kyis rang lus 'bad nas gsos kyang / / sdig can shan pa khos lus srog phral ba'i tshe na/ / gzugs gzhi tshon po des phan pa ci yang med pas/ / lto phyir phyogs kun tu nyul ba'i dka' spyad dor te/ / gnod 'tshe 'jigs pa dang bral ba'i ri sul yangs par/ / sngo ljang rtsa myug gis 'tsho zhing bde bar rgyu ba'i/ /bag phebs ri dwags kyi dga' bde'i rtse gral stogs shig / dad ldan sbyin bdag gi khyim du nyul ba'i bla gzugs/ / ma mdag sha khrag gi zas kyis rang lus gsos kyang / / brtse med gshin rje yis lus srog phral ba'i tshe na/ /gzugs gzhi dar ba des phan pa ci yang med pas/ / lto phyir phyogs kun tu 'khyams pa'i dka' spyad dor te/ / 'du 'dzi g.yengs pa dang bral ba'i ri sul stong par/ / sdig med kha zas kyis 'tsho zhing chos la spyod pa'i/ / sgrub brgyud bstan 'dzin gyi gral du da lta snyogs shig / 'brog gnas phyugs lhas na rgyu ba'i g.yag rgod rog po/ / 'dris pa'i phyugs dzi la sna snom byed pa'i mu 419

zhu/ /gung thangabastan pa'i sgronayo khrung 'bum/la/ / sna thag gzhan lag tu chud nas khal chen bkal tshe/ / ri sul nyamasadaga' de dran kyang 'gro thabs mi 'dug / g.yo can phyugs dzi yis mgo bskor bden par ma sems/ / byang stod mi med kyi thang du ci bder rgyu zhing / /nyin mtshan khor yug tu rtsa bcud gang 'dod spyod pa'i/ / sna yan 'brongagayag gi gral du da lta snyogs shig / rgyal khab chen po ru slebs pa'i ban chung klad med/ / sbyin bdag grwa rigs kyi 'dun sgos sna tshogs nyan nas/ / sna thag mi lag tu shor gnas gzhan dbang gyur tshe/ / dben pa'i yon tan kun dran kyang gleb pa dka' bas/ / g.yo can mdza' bshes kyi bslu brid bden par ma 'dzin/ / mi med dben gnas su dgag sgrub spang blang dor te/ / nyin mtshan khor yug tu yang dag 'jog la gzhol pa'i/ / yan pa blo bde yi kun sbangs gral du snyogs shig / ce4pa 'di yang shing sbrul lo chen po hor gyi yul gru du ma nyul skabs spur nag dang phag pa sogs kyi kun spyod mthong nas rang gi 'dun ma yang de dang 'dra ba 'dug snyam pa dang / grwa rigs sbyin bdag du mas nged rang rgyal bo'i bla mchod bgyis na legs tshul mol ba yang blor ma shom bar brten/ dharma badz+ra gyis ong nyod kyi sa'i cha zhig tu tsha babs skabs phral mar sug bris bgyis pa'o/ / zhes pa'o/ / bcu drug gi nyin gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas yab sras rnams dang a ke pu r+ṇa pā la thu sa lag chi tshul khrims sogs dpon blon mang po'i chibs bsu dang bcas thus lag chi tshul khrims kyi khyim du bzhugs/ bcu bdun gyi nyin sbyin bdag chin wang a ke blon po bcas kyis rta thab ser sbrengs bcas sngar gyi bzhugs gnas su phyag phab/ ong nyod pe li'i chibs skyel pa dge bshes bla ma dang tha'i ji gdugs dkar skyabs ngo g.yog phyir log / phyi nyin nas dben gnas bde chen rab rgyas gling du phebs te nyi ma kha shas sku ngal gso mdzad cing snga dro phyi 420

༄༅/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /dro'i thun la thugs dam dang dpe gzigs spel mar gnang / drug pa'i tshes gcigagi nyin wang gi lha khang du drug pa'i smon lam gyi tshogs dbur phebs snga dro tshogs thebs gcig la bla mchod gsol 'debs kyi rim pa dang phyi dro tshogs thebs gcig la smon lam bstan 'bar ma bcas gsungs/ na'i man gyi gdan 'dren pa dka' bcu dang tha'i ji mi 'gyur rtag brtan ja lang gnyis khā gnyis bcas ngo g.yog brgya lhag u la'i zhon rta rnga mong bcas 'byor/ tshes gnyis la na'i man du phebs rgyur wang gi sras che ba don grub tshe brtan gtsos ser skya drag zhan nyi shu tsam zhabs phyir 'brangs wang gung sogs ho ro yas mas kyi dpon blon mang po'i bsu skyel dang bcas e phu pur+ṇa pā la'i khyim du bzhugs/rim gyis yong nyod tha'i ji ci yā thu'i khyim du gdan drangs thog ser skya'i khrom la bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid lung gnang / yo'u han tha'i ji bsam grub cho'u thu'itshos rje sog ser skya drag zhan sum cu skor chibs bsur 'byor khā bstan 'gyur gyi khyim du zhag bzhugs thog mjal ba chig stong lnga brgya tsam la phyag dbang dang byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs ma ṇi'i bzlas lung gang lcogs kyi dge ba khas len du 'jug pa sogs kyi mthar bsngo smon rgyas par gnang / ti yān chi bstan dar dang su'i khe thu zer ba gnyis kyis snyung gnas stong phrag re srung rgyu khas blangs par thugs dgyes tshor chen por mdzad khong tsho'i lha khang du ming zhus par dpal 'bar gling zhes btags/ tshes drug gi nyin yo'u han gyis sner ja sag wang bde chen wang 'chi med grub pa thu shi gung rnam rgyal rdo rje sogs dpon blon mang po chibs bsur 'byor te ja thab zhus phebs lam du ja zhu dang mjal kha zhu mi tshan mang po byung bar phyag dbang dang bka' chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ tha'i ji yar 'phel gyi khyim du gdan drangs thog ser skya brgya phrag brgal bar rta mgrin sgrub thabs kyi lung gnang /421

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgranas gsung 'bum/lam zhor du o'u han ja sag wang gi khang ba 'bub rgyu'i gzhi gsar la gnas gzigs dang byin rlabs mdzad/ khā thu sa lag chi bde legs nor bu'i khyim du 'dod don zhus shing gzhis len 'bul nod gzab/ tshes bdun gyi zhog mja sag wang gis khang bar gdan drangs te gsol ja dkar spro dang 'bul nod phul ser skya stong phrag brgal bar phyag dbang bka' chos gnang / e phu thus lag chi mi bskyod rdo rje dang khā sa'i cir hu rnams kyis rim pas gdan drangs pa'i 'dun pa bskang ste/ ba yan go zer bar zhag bzhugs mdzad/brgyad la e phu tshe brtan rdo rjes bsu ba ser sprengs dang bcas lha khang du gdan drangs te zhabs togami zhel ba bsgrubs bla dpon ser skya stong phrag long bar spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang stsal/ na'i man wang gi a ke ngo g.yog chibs bsur 'byor du mal tha'i ji rin chen gyes khyim du gdan drangs nas 'dod don zhus na'i man wang gi sa sner thu sa lag chi a nan+ta sogs rta pa brgya skor chibs bsur 'byor nas ja thab zhus shing der bzhugs/ tshes dgu'i zhogaka na'i man wang dbon blon gyi 'khor brgya phrag du ma dang bcas chibs bsur 'byor gzungs bsdus skyangs kyi khyim du mjal mi lnga brgya tsam dang phebasa'im du mjal ba khrom tshogs tshan mang po byung ba rnams la phyag dbang bka' chos chag med du gnang / po ti'i su me sogs lha khang so so'i bla ma las sne dge tshul slong nyis brgya lhag chibs bsur 'byor tha'i ji kun bzang gis khyim du gdan drangs thog dad 'dus kyi ser skya sum stong brgal bar phyag dbang dang gzungs sngags zab mo rnams dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs bsgrags shing / maṇi'i bzlas lung dang khas len bskor ba sogs rgyas par stsal cing lam thog tu mjal ba khrom tshogs tshan mang po byung ba la yang de bzhin mdzad pas shin tu 'gyangs te po ti'i su 422

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /me la mtshan mo spebs/ tshes bcu la po ti'i lha khang chos 'byor gling gi khri pa bla ma dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gtsos grwa pa rnams kyis 'du khang du gsol ston dang 'bul nod phul ser skya'i khrom sum stong brgal bar bla ma mchod pa'i lung dang phyag dbang sogs gnang / phebs lam du mjal kha zhu mi tshan mang po byung bar phyag dbang bka' chos sngar nyin ltar gnang zhing na'i man wang gi yā mon du mchod rdzas dang rol cha thogs pa'i dge 'dun gyi ser sbrengs dang bcas 'byor dad 'dus kyi skye pho mo'i khrom chen por phyag dbang dang bka' chos rgyas par gnang / 'dir nyin bcu skor bzhugs bla dpon tshang mas gtsos ser skya brgya phrag mang por brgyad stong pa'i ljags lung spyi chos su rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang gi snyan gsan phul ba bzhin phyogs tha dad nas 'dus pa'ibla dpon ser skya stong phrag gsum la dbang stsal te skal ldan gdul bya'i rgyud la rgyu 'bras theg pa'i lam gye bag chags brtas par mdzad/ dge tshul bsgrub bya bzhi bcu zhe brgyad dang bsnyen rdzogs bsgrub bya lnga bcu nga drug la tshigs snga phyi'i sdom pa phog ste thar pa'i sa bon bskrun/ bkwan dung shi re thu ngo g.yog ched gtad kyis mjal du 'ongs shing khong gis zhus ngor ser skya stong phrag gnyis tsam la bla ma mchod pa'i khrid mdor bsdus tsam gnang / cho hor hal ha pe li'i gdan 'dren pa thu sa lag chi ngo g.yog u lā dang bcas 'byor te phebs zhor la tā chen gyi lha khang du gdan drangs pa'i don mdzad cing /ha shā thu la ang bi ci hus zhabs tog zhus thog skye pho mo'i khrom mang po phyag dbang bka' chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ pe li'i ya mon du zhag gcig bzhugs pe li gzugs gzhi ma bde ba la bka' bsgo srung ba sogs gnang zhing bkwan dung shi re thu zhabs phyir 'brangs nas 'ongs par 'od dpag med kyi 'pho khrid stsal/ phyi nyin pe li gza' mi tshang mar khyung khra'i rjes gnang mdzad 423

/ /gungango ngastan ba'i naḥ gsung 'bum/pe lis kyang bkur ste rim gro phul du phyin pa zhus phyir lam khā tshe dbang gis bsnyen bkur zhus pa'i don mdzad/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs sogs sbyin bdag 'ga' zhig gis gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs te ca khir chi bsod nams kyi khyim du 'dod chos 'ga' zhig dang dge slong 'jam dbyangs kyi gshag tu dad 'dus kyi skye pho mo stong phrag bzhi tsam la phyag dbang bka' chos dkyus ma'i skor rgyas par gnang / dge slong 'jam dbyangs kyis gsol ba btab pa bzhin mjal ba thams cad la yang sna tshogs yum gyi rjes gnang dang gdugs dkar dang sgol ma'i lung bcas stsal/ shangs len phu dung gang rgyas dang dngul srang sum brgya sogs 'bul ba gya nom pa phul/ / phyir 'khor lam du ha ba na phing shing dang khā el beg tshad so so'i khyim du rim par babs te 'dod pa'i re ba skong bar mdzad/ wang yum sras dang bcas par rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid gnang /wang gi yu nom du bzhugs ring la nyin rer skye pho mo'i khrom stong phrag kha shas re la phyag dbang dang bka' chos dkyus ma rnams chag med dang gson gshin gyi bsngo ba dang 'dod chos bka' bsgo sogs 'tshem med du stsal/ bcu dgu'i zhog ka sbyin bdag wang gtsos pa'i ho sho'u thun mong nas brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyal yol na bza' bubs gsum gos chen yug dgu dngul srang stong phrag gnyis dang lnga brgya sogs mchod pa'i dngos po rdzogs ldan gyi sprin bzhin gtibs/ o'u han nas tā mal tha'i ji pad dkar skyabs sogs mi drag 'ga' zhig yul mi u lwa dang bcas gdan 'dren du 'byor ba bzhin chibs bsgyur gnang / wang gi nu bo thu sa lag chi lha dbang nor bu dang tha'i ji ba thu rab brtan so so'i khyim du skyabs 'gro'i khrid lung re gnang / po ti'i lha khang 424

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /du rten gsum la rab gnas mdor bsdus dang ser skya'i khrom la phyag dbang bka' chos gnang / tā bla ma blo bzang skal ldan gyi gshag tu shis brjod mdzad sbyin bdag wang blon 'khor bcas chibs skyel ba byings rnams phyir slog thu sa lag chi ku ru sel gyes khyim du gdan drangs pa'i don mdzad col chang ho la zhag sgar btab/ nyi shu'i zhog ka mjal mi stong phrag tsam la phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang na'i man wang gi a ke dang thu sa lag chi gu ru sel sogs mi drag 'ga' zhig phyir slog / sha ra ha la o'u han pas gung bab gra bsgrigasabargyas par babs na'i man gyi thu sa lag chi ā nan+ta gza' mi rnams kyis phyag dbang chos 'brel dang zhabs tog zhus/ o'u han gyi e phu rgyal ba tha'i ji dkon mchog yar 'phel thul ga'i su me'i las sne 'ga' zhig bcas drag zhan mang po chibs bsur 'byor sha ra ha'i thang du sgar btab mjal mi stong phrag brgal bar phyag dbang bka' chos rgyas par gnang / grwa ba zhig gis sgyung gnas stong phrag gcig srung rgyu khas blangs par dgyes pa'i gsung gis dbugs dbyung mdzad/ nyer gcig la yong kon du thul ga'i su me'i khri ba mer gon chos rje dge bshes ngag dbang blo bzang tā bla ma chos grags po'u rol su me'i zhabs drung tā bla ma sogs su mi 'ga' zhig gi tā bla ma las sne bcas grwa pa lnga bcu tsam dang / khā tshe dpag skyabs kyi khyim du gung tshigs zhus thog o'u han ja sag wang thu sa lag chi wang pe zi thu shri gung rnams kyis gtsos dpon blon ngo g.yog brgya phrag du ma chibs bsur 'byor thul ga'i su me brtseb rgyas byed gling gi nye 'debs su dpon 'bangs stong phrag mang po'i skya 'phreng dang / dge 'dun stong lhag gis ser sbrangs kyis mdun bsus te rol cha sna tshogs dang dri zhim po'i spos 'dren bcas bkur ste chen pos gdan drangs/ 'du khang du bla dpon rnams kyis gsol ja dkar spro zhus dad 425

༄/ /gung bang bayoba'izla 'igasung 'bum/'dus kyi mjal pa lnga stong brgal bar phyag dbang dang mtshan dang gzungs sngagasabasgrugs pa ma ṇi'i bzlas lung dang dge ba khas len du bcug pa bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor bcas rgyas par stsal/ spyi chos su spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang zhus pa bzhin bla dpon tshang mas gtsos ser skya pho mo khri phrag brgal bar spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang sta gon dang bcas pa bya rgyud rang gzhungagi lag len ji lta ba bzhin gnang ste mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi lam bzanga'agrub pa'i skal ba can du byas/ chos nyan pa de dag la phyag dbang bka' chos dkyus ma'i skor rnams kyang sngar nyin ltar mdzad/ de ga'i bla ma dge 'dun dang dpon blon bcas nyan mkhan brgya phrag kha shas la rdo rje sems dpa'i rjes gnang 'jigs byed kyi sngags bcu'i rjes gnang mdo sdud pa'i lung sogs 'dod chos du ma gnang / dge bsnyen pha ma dang rab byung dge tshulabasgrub bya brgya dang sum cu bsnyen rdzogs bsgrub bya brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe brgyada'i bstan pa'i gzhi ma so thar gyi sdom pa'i bdud rtsi dgyes bzhin stsal/dgon pa'i mdun ngos kyi thad du dpon blon rnams kyis ras gur phub par gdan drangs chi ka drangs shing stobs rtsal 'gran pa dang mda' 'phen pa sogs dga' ston 'phel/ de nas thul ga'i lab rtse yod sar gdan drangs te bsang dang dbang bstod sogs mdzad rta brgya bang 'gran pa'i gzigs mo phul/ chos rje tshul khrims dang dge 'dun nyi ma yo ro'i su me'i chos rje tu mal tha'i ji a chi thu sogs sger du bsnyen bkur zhu mkhan 'ga' zhig la 'dod chos sogs yid tshim par stsal/ dgon pa'i tshogs dbur gdan drangs nas dge 'dun brgya phrag mang pos zhabs brtan gyi bden tshig gsungs pa dang lhan du bla dpon sbyin bdag grwa rigs ho sho'u thun mong nas maṇ+ḍal kha btags skugasung thugs rten gser zangs kyi 'khor lo dang sna tshogs rdo rje rnam bum 426

༄༅/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /dung dkar rnga mong dkar po gcig dang rta dkar po brgyad kyis sna drangs te rta nor brgya dang lnga bcu srang stong phrag gcig dang nyis brgya'i dong tshe bcas dngos 'bul ngoms che ba phul cing dgon pa spyi nas kyang sger 'bul gzabs/nyi shu drug la thu ga'i su me nas thon khā er khe skyabs dang cang ke po yan thu so sos bsnyen bkur zhus pa'i don mdzad/ wang 'chi med grub pa dang gung rnam rgyal rdo rje dpon g.yog lnga bcu skor chibs bsur 'byor nas ja thab zhus wang gis khang ba spo rgyu'i gzhi gsar ba la gnas gzigs dang byin rlabs mdzad mjal kha zhu mi lnga brgya tsam la phyag dbang sogs gnang / de nas wang 'chi med grub pa'i yā mon du dge 'dun gyi ser sbrengs dang bcas phyag phebs/nyi shu bdun gyi zhog ka wang dang gung gtsos pa'i dpon 'bangs drug brgya skor la rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i rjes gnang dang bde mchog dkar po'i tshe dbang gnang / tha'i ji dkon mchog yar 'phel gyis gdan drangs pa bzhin phebasa'im du tha'i ji marga la'i khyim du babs te 'dod pa bskong bar mdzad/dkon mchog yar 'phel gyi lha khang du tā bla ma dge 'dun bzang po sogs grwa pa rnams kyis bsnyen bkur dang rten gsum la shis brjod zhus/ dkon mchog yar 'phel gyi khyim du gza' mi rnams kyis phyag dbang dang 'dod don zhus shing gsol ston 'bul nod gzabs skye pho mo'i khrom brgya phrag mang po la phyagadabang dang bka' chos rgyas par gnang ste phyir wang gi yu mon du phebs/nyi shu brgyad kyi zhog ka wang gis brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te maṇ+ḍal kha btags bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gos chen yug lnga pu la gan lnga shel spyad kha shas dngul srang sum brgya dang brgyad cu bcas dngos 'bul gyi mchod sprin spros/ de nas thon te khā yum skyabs kyis khyim du zhabs tog dang shis brjod zhus thu shi gung rnam rgyal rdo rje'i yā mon du dge 'dun gyi ser sbrengs 427

sa / /gung thang bstanapa'izlanama'i gsung 'bum/ dang bcas phyag babs snga phyir mjal kha zhu mi stong phrag gsum tsam la phyag dbang bka' chos dkyus ltar gnang / sung ma pu rnams kyis gtsos pa'i mi drag rnams༄ 'jal dpal nag po'i rjes gnang mngon rtogs kyi lung bcas stsal/ gung dpon pos zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol 'debs dang sbrags nas yid bzhin 'gugs pa'i lcags kyus sna drangs gos chen gsum pu la gan gsum dngul srang lnga brgya bcas bdog pa rgya che ba bstar/ nyi shu dgu la po rol su me'i bla ma las snes chibs bsu dge 'dun gyis ser sbrengs dang bcas phyag phebs snga phyi'i mjal ba stong phrag bzhi tsam la phyag dbang bka' chos sngar rgyun ltar gnang / gnam gang la 'du khang du rten brten par bcas la rab gnas bsdus pa gnang bla grwa rnams kyis rab yon gzabs/ wang 'chi med grub pa dang gung rnam rgyal rdo rje sogs dpon blon mang po phyir slog bla ma'i pe shar du zan pe zi'i a ke sogs chibs bsu pa 'ga' zhig 'byor ko cod zer ba'i khyim tshang gi mi bdun shā 'od kyis khyer ba la bsngo smon mdzad/ sa ra na ha da'i ri khrod du gdan drangs dge bshes ngag dbang blo bzang gis gsol ston thog maṇ+ḍal kha btags bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dngul las bsgrubs pa'i rnam bum dang rgyal srid sna bdun bkra shis rtags brgyad dang rdzas brgyad thod pa dngul gyi nang sha can thod ṭar rdor dril dngul gyi me tog cha shel dang dkar yol gyi snod spyang kha shas gos gzan gcig gos yug kha shas pu la gan dgu dngul srang brgya rtsa brgyad bcas phul te zhabs pad brtan par gsol ba nan tan btab par bka' lan bzang po stsal/ ser skya stong phrag tsam la phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang ri khrod kyi gnas la gzigs rtog dang rten la shis brjod mdzad/ pe zi sangs rgyas rgyal dang pe zi bde ba'i rdo rje gtsos pa'i dpon blon mang po chibs bsur 'byor shar khu'i lha khang dang khu khu chel gyi 428

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /lha khang so sor bla ga rnams kyis phyag dbang chos 'brel zhus snga phyi'i mjal ba sum stong brgal bar phyag dbang bka' chos ma chad par gnang / de nas ja sag pe zi sangs rgyas rgyal gyi be+e mon du dge 'dun gyi ser sgrengs dang bcas phyag phebs/ bdun pa'i tshes gcig la pe zi bde ba'i rdo rjes yā mon du gdan drangs te gsol ston dang 'bul ba gzabs shing sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang stsal/ ye phu dge 'dun rgyal gyi khyim du che phra tshang mar lo ma gyon ma'i rjes gnang skur bar mdzad cing bsnyen bkur gya nom pa zhus/ lha khang rnam rgyal gling du bla grwa rnams kyis mjal kha chos 'brel zhus/ mi rin po yan skyabs kyi khyim du shis brjod gnang ste ja sag pe'i zi'i yā mon du phebs 'di nyin phyogs tha dad nas 'dus pa'i mjal ba khri phrag nye bar phyag dbang sogs rgyas par gnang / dge ba rlabs po che khas len mkhan mang po byung bar de ring legs po byung gsung ste shin tu dgyes tshor che ba mdzad/ phyi nyin ja sag pe zis zhabs brtan gyi bden tshig dang sbrags nas dngul maṇa sne 'dogs can bzhugs gdan rgyab yol shel gyi me long sogs shel dang dngul gyi spyad pa mang po gos yug lnga dngul srang brgya tham pa bcas phul/ de nas thon te khā pa yan hu thog gis gdan drangs pa'i don mdzad/ pe zi sangs rgyas rgyal dang bde ba'i rdo rje sogs dpon blon mang po phyir log ma ni han gyi lha khang dang tha'i ji dpal 'byor gyi khyem du rim par babs te 'dod pa skong bar mdzad/ de nas rim gyis tsha zhag gi sa cha dang lam bar du dad ldan gyi skye bo mang po phyag dbang chos 'brel gyis tshim bar mdzad de sbyin bdag chin wang yabasras dang tā gung yab sras so so'i chibs bsu thab bsu dang bcas tshes lnga'i nyin har chin wang gi yā mon du phyag phebs o'u han gyi chibs skyel ba bla dpon ngo g.yog phyir slog tshes drug nas har chin wang rardo sidhis sbyin bdag 429

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlanayo gsung ཿma/byas te/ 7'jam dbyangs gong ma'i zhabs brtan la rje nyid kyis tshogs dbu mdzad nas dge 'dun sum stong lnga brgya bdun cu lhag gis ma ṇi'i ril bu nyinabadun sgrub pa gnang bar sgrub khang gi phyi nang dang skor lam sogs nas dad ldan rnams kyis ril bu mang po rnyed pa dang / mtshams mtshams su char zim bu babs shing 'ja' tshon sna tshogs yang yang shar ba sogs rten 'brel gyi ltas khyad par can mang du byung bas thams cad dga' spro 'phel zhing bla ma dang chos la mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan po thob/ bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du sbyin bdag wang gis rje nyid la dngul srang nyi shu'i maṇ+ḍal sne 'dogs can dngulasang stong phrag gcig bcas phul zhing dge 'dun rnams la'ang bsnyen bkur 'bul ba gzab rgyas zhus/ sbyin bdag wang gis zhus ngor wang yum sras kyis gtsos ser skya stong phrag brgal bar spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhalagyi dbang chen sta gon dang bcas smin rgyas su stsal te byin rlabs bdud rtsis yid kyi bum bzab 'gengs par mdzad/ sbyin bdag wang yab sras ne+e hor du 7gong ma'i ri dwags kyi zhabs phyir phebs rgyur lam chos la bde mchog dkar po'i tshe dbang gnang / wang dang lhan du nang so bstan 'gyur can 7gong ma'i mtshams zhur btang bar wang gis mgo 'dren gnang ste mtshams zhu legs par bsgrubs shing / wang rang gis 7gong mar ma ṇi ril bu'i phung phul te zhabs brtan du ma ṇi bsgrubs pa'i rgyu mtshan snyan du gsol bar thu'u bkwan ho thog thus sgrub pa bgyes pa'i ma ṇi'i ril bu zhes zhal du myang zhing thugs la btags pa'i bka' bzang po mang du phebs/ phyogs nye ring sna tshogs nas sdom pa'i bka' drin zhu pa'i phyir du 'ongs pa'i bsgrub bya brgyad cu gya drug la rab byung nyis brgya bcu gsum la dge tshul nyis brgya skor la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa gnang ste bstan pa'i rmang gzhi tshugs par mdzad/ snga phyir 430

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /ri dwags kyi sa char 7gong ma'i zhabs phyir 'gro mkhan dpon blon mang po mjal du 'ongs par rjes gnang dang bka' bsgo srung ba sogs gang 'dod du stsal/ wang gi sras lha rgyal rdo rjes zhal gdams zhus par bslab bya lha'i rnga bo che dang rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga rnal 'byor rol pa'i dga' ston be+eg tse'i gtor chog bstan srung dgyes pa'i rol mo dam can gyi gtor chog dam can rol mtsho rnams lngags rtsom mdzad/ de nas dben pa'i bste gnas bde chen rab rgyas gling du phebs te bcad rgya'i khongs nas dpe gzigs dang thugs dam zab mo spel mar gnang / 'di dus wang gi tho yon gnyis la zhal gdams mgur ma zhig gnang ba ni/ / pad dkar gzhon nu khyod bkrag mdangs mtshar yang / / mi ring lo 'dab kun 'brul bar nges pas/ / dbyibs legs mdangs bzang dang ldan pa'i dus 'dir/ / dkon mchog mchod gral du snyegs na legs so/ / lha btsun gzhon nu gnyis lang tsho dar yang / / mi ring rgas khog tu 'gyur bar nges pas/ / nang med rgud med du 'tsho ba'i dus 'dir/ / dam pa'i lha chos la 'bad na legs so/ /bung ba gzhon nu khyod 'phur lding rtse yang / / nyin gcig grang reg gis 'gum par 'gyur bas/ / me tog gang bzang rnams shar ba'i dus 'dir/ / rtsi bcudangoms med du spyad na legs so/ / lha sras gzhon nu gnyis rtse dgas rol yang / / nyin gcig 'chi bdag gis nges par 'joms pas/ / dam chos gang zab dang 'phrad pa'i dus 'dir/ / nyams len ngoms med du bgyisan legs so/ / sprin dkar gzhon nu khyod lang tsho gsar yang / / mi ring nam mkha' la rang yal 'gro bas/ / da lta lang long du 'khrigs pa'i dus 'dir/ / char rgyun lhug pa ru phab na legs so/ / ser snas nor rdzas kun ci tsam bsags kyang / / nyin gcig don med kyi mi yis 'khyer bas/ / da 431

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/lta rang dbang dang ldan pa'i dus 'dir/ / rnam dkar dge phyogs su btang na legs so/ / bya bye'u sna tshogs rnams phyogs gcig tshogs kyang / / mi ring so so yi gnas su gyes pas/ / dbyar dus yun thung tsam lhan du gnas ring / / tshang dang kha zas la rtsod pas ci bya/ / spun dang nye du kun lhan cig skyes kyang / / mi ring so so ru 'bral bar nges pas/ / tshe thung yud tsam la lhan du 'dug ring / / dpal 'byor mnga' thang la rtsod pas ci bya/ / yid bzhin nor bu la phyogs lhung med kyang / / gsol ba ma btab par dngos grub mi 'byung / / rgyal mtshan rtse mo ru bkod de mchod na/ / gang 'dod re 'bras kun 'bad med 'byung ngo / / bla ma dkon mchog la nye ring med kyang / / log lta dad med la byin rlabs mi 'byung / / snying nas blo gtad kyis skyabs su song na/ / 'di phyi'i legs tshogs kun 'bad med 'byung ngo / / 'du 'dzin sna tshogs kyis sun pa'i mi rgan/ / dben pa'i nags khrod du ngal bso bgyid skabs/ / dpe don 'di 'dra zhig sems la shar nas/ /lha btsun rnam gnyis la gdams pa dge'o/ / zhes pa 'di yang btsun gzugs 〉dharma badz+ra gyis chen po hor gyi yul gru mang po nyul te 'du 'dzi sna tshogs kyis yid sun skabs dben pa'i nags khrod bde chen rab rgyas gling du zhag kha shas ngal bso ba'i tshe/ nyin gcig 'di 'dra zhig sems la shar nas lha'ibatsun pa sa shrī dang 'jam dpal nor bu gnyis la smras pa dge legs 'phel/ / zhes pa'o/ / nub re bzhin gcan gzan 'ongs nas gzim khang rwa skor la skor ba byas nas song ba'i rjes mthong ste thams cad skrag nas mtshan mophyi rol tu 'don dka' bar byungab na ri khrod kyi phyogs bzhir thag ring zhig tu rgyal chen bzhi'i tho btsugs nas skyed chog mdzad pas/ de phyin chad gcanagazan gyis tho'i phyi rol nas skor ba byas te nang du gtan nas ma 'ong 432

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /'dug pa ni rgyal po chen po rnams kyis bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i mtshan mar gsal la/ rnam pa gcig tu na yul gyi gzhi bdag 'ga' zhig gis phyag dang skor ba sogs bkur sti bgyis pa'i lo rgyus grub chen gong ma 'ga' zhig gi rnam thar du 'byung ba dang phyogs mthun pa zhig yin nam sems so/ / a ke pur+ṇa pā la ri khrod du mjal khar 'ongs pa la thugs bag phebs pa'i gsung gleng 'phel/ de skabs gsung 'phros kyi lhongs la slar sbyin bdag wang gi khyim du skyid sdug 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan mang po gnang ba khong gis ma brjed par semasal bzung bas/ phyis de kho na bzhin du byung ba na ches ngo mtshar du gyur te rje nyid la lung bstan thog tu khel pa'i gnas tshul gyi zhu shog phul bar/zhal nas nged rang gis mngon shes bshad pa min mod kyang brtags nas bshad pa thams cad thig song ba yin 'dug ces khengs bskyung gi rnam pas zhal bzhes ma mdzad snang / pā rin pe zi bde legs bzang po mjal du 'ongs par khong rang rje nyid la dad 'dun che zhing chos 'jig rten gyi shes sgo bzang bas gsung gleng mang du 'phel/ pe zi nyid dar tā gung sogs la sdug bsngal sel ba'i sgrol ma'i rjes gnang mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs kyi lung tā gung dang tho yon brtan pa'i 'khor lo sogs la dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang thu sa lag chi tshul khrims dang grwa pa 'ga' zhig la mkha' spyod ma'i dbang dang dmigs rim gyi khrid nang so yi dam skyabs la mgon po tshe dpag med kyi rjes gnang ke ke bsod nams sgrol ma la tshe dbang sogs don gnyer ba so so'i ngor zab rgyas gdams pa'i dga' ston rgya cher stsal/ su nyid g.yon ru'i wang dpal 'byor yar 'phel gyi mi sna sngags ram pa shes rab bzang po dang ja lang sa'i snying po or du su cun gar pe zi'i mi sna ja lang phun tshogs bkra shis or du su ja sag gi mi sna zhabs drung ye shes rgyal mtshan mong gol cin pe li'i 433

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/mi sna tha bo nang sa khi ya thu med pe zi'i mi sna tha'i ji don grub rnams rim pas 'byor te so so'i ho sho'u la gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul/ thu med pe zi'i mi snas pe zi tshe brtan bkra shis sngar grwa pa'i dus su rje nyid la a mdo nas mjal skabs rje nyid sog yul du lan gnyis phebs nas nyo sho'u gzhan rnams su gdan 'dren zhus kyang nged tsho'i ho sho'u la gdan 'dren ma zhus pa skal ba chad 'dug ces zhus par nyid nas zhal rtsed kyi tshul du khyed rang pe zi byed dus 'ong chog ces gsungs pa da lan thog tu babs pa'i gnas tshul zhus pas/zhal nas nged rang gis rtsed mo bshad pa mo ston phag mgo'i dper song 'dug ces bzhad mo mdzad/ or du su ja sag gi zhabs drung dpon g.yog la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa dang gcod stan thog gcig ma'i khrid lung gnang /a ke legs ldan dang mi rin deb cor ja lang chang khe lha khang gi tho yon nang so rnams kyis rang rang gi nang du gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus par rkyen sel gyi rim gro dang 'dod chos sogs so so'i mos pa bzhin stsal/ skabs shig gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyis khyim du gdan drangs te nyin kha shas bzhugasagung dpon po la lha mo rig byed ma'i rjes gnang dang sgrub thabs kyi lungadapon po yum sras kyis gtsos ser skya lnga bcu skor la bde mchog dkar po'i tshe dbang gnang phyir phebs te wang gi sras mo o yon tan las hor chin duskyel nye bar sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang rten 'brel gye skyes 'ga' zhig gnang / de nas wang gi zhabs brtan la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi gtor zlog sogs rim gro 'ga' zhig bsgrubs shing mjug tu dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga gnang / lha babs dus chen gyi nyin wang gi pho brang dbus mar rje nyid dbu mdzad nas cho ga pa bcu gnyis kyis rnam rgyal stong mchod phul/ sbyin bdag wangagis byis ston dang rgan ston gnang bar der 'dus pa'i skye bo stong phrag 434

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /phyed dang gnyis la nyid nas kyang dong tshe dang shing thog gi gsol ras phyag dbang bcas gnang ste gzungs sngags dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rna lam du bsgrags shing dge ba rdzogs byang du sngo bar mdzad/ wang yum sras la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bsnyen yig gi khrid lung tshogs 'khor dang lag mchod gnyisakyi khrid sbyin sreg gi lung thun drug rnal 'byor gyi khrid sogs zab chos gang zhus kyi re ba yongs su bskangs lo dkar dka' bcu sogs zhabs phyi pa rnams la gtsug tor 'bar ba'i rjes gnang stsal/ ja sag gung gi ho sho'u nas gung gi phu bo tho yon 'jigs med nyi ma nu bo a ke ma hā yā na sogs mi drag tog can bco lnga gung dang nā e phu'i lha khang so so'i dge bskos dem chi 'ga' zhig zhon rta shing rta ul mi dang bcas gdan 'dren du 'byor/ zla ba dgu pa'i nyer drug gi nyin har chin wang gi yāmon nas thon sbyin bdag wang gisasras gsum pa lha rgyal rdo rje dang tho yon gnyis sogs skya ser drag zhan sum cu skor zhabs phyir btang tā gung gi yā mon du bzhugs a ke pur+ṇa pā la dang zhabs drung tā bla ma sogs zhabs phyi sgrub mi drag zhan nyi shu tsam byung /tse rin bu lag tu ja sag gung ma hā pā la sku mched gnyis dang e phu dkon mchog rgyal mtshan rnams kyis gtsos dpon blon mi drag brgya phrag du ma chibs bsur 'byor rim gyis grong sde so so'i ja zhu dang mjal ba mang po'i don mdzad bzhin par phebs/ nyi shu dgu'i nyin ja sag gung gi sa sne zin par gung gi lha khang dang nā e phu'i lha khang em chi'i lha khang so so'i bla ma las sne grwa ba mang po dang e phu rnam rgyal srun gsum tho yon bstan 'dzin dar rgyas sogs dpon blon mang po bcas rta pa brgya phrag du ma rim gyis 'byor/ the me khe'i lha khang du ja zhus thog dad 'dus kyi ser skya stong phrag tsam la bla ma mchod pa dang byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs kyi lngags lung phyag dbang dang bcas 435

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i ཿnga 'bum/gnang lha khang la ming zhus par dge legs rab rgyas gling zhes btags/ ye phu rnam rgyal gyi yā mon du dge 'dun gyi ser sprengs dang bcas 'byor phyi nyin bcag mal mdzad/ a ke dbang rgyal dang tha bo nang rnam thar mchod rten dkar po'i tā bla ma dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ dem chi dge bskos bcas drag zhan mang po rim gyis 'byor dad 'dus kyi skye pho mo nyis stong brgal bar phyag dbang sogs rgyas par gnang / e phu rnam rgyal spun gsum gyis gtsos ser skya lnga brgya skor la rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i rjes gnang stsal/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gcig la e phu rnam rgyal gyis maṇ+ḍal kha btags bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gyis sna drangs te gos dang dngul na bza' shel gyi snod spyad sogs 'bul ba gya nom pa brtan bzhugs lugs su phul/ e phu'i gcung gnyis kyis kyang rang rang gi khyim du shis bajod zhus phebs zhor la ye phu'i ke ke'i dur thog tu brab sngags dang yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i shis brjod ljags bsngo bcas gnang / e phu'i lha khang du ja zhus thog bla dpon mang pos gtsos ser skya stong phrag brgal par skyabs 'gro'i khrid gnang / thu sa lag chi gung on dur hu dang thu sa lag chi ching thog tho hu sogs tha bo nang mang po zhig chibs bsur 'byor the me chi'i ho tho la mjal ba lnga brgya tsam la sgrol ma dang byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs kyi lung phyag dbang bcas gnang / sbyin bdag ja sag gung ma hā pā la dpon blon gyi 'khor dang lha khang so so'i bla ma las sne bcas ser skya drag zhan stong phrag nye bas chibs bsu bskyar ma dang lab tse zhig yod pa'i nye 'dabs su ras gur chen po phubs par gdan drangs te gsol ja dkar spro zhus/ nyid nas lab tse la kha btags bsgron nas dpang bstod mdzad de nas gyog 'phyang mi brgyad kyis btegs te chibs rags kyi mdun du rol cha sna tshogs dang mchod rdzas du ma thogs pa'i rta pa tshar du dngar zhing / 436

༄7/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /dpon blon rnams kyis rta thog nas mda' 'phong byed pa sogs bkur ste rim gro dang dga' ba'i rtsed 'jo sgyu ma'i mig 'phrul lta bu tshar du dngar zhing yā mon gyi sgo drung nas dge 'dun mang pos ser sbrengs dang / skye pho mo'i tshogs pa mang pos gus 'dud kyis mdun bsus te bkur ste chen pos pho brang dbus mar gdan drangs dkar spro'i dga' ston zhus thog mi drag rnams kyis mjal kha zhus/ de nas nyin kha shas kyi ring dad ldan gyi skye pho mo shin tu mang po bar ma chad du byung par phyag dbang mtshan dang gzungs sngags sogs so so'i phan yon go bde la yid 'phrog pa'i gsung bshad re dang sprags te rna lam du sgogs shing dge bskul gyi dam bca' 'dzin du gzhug pa dang dge tshogs chud mi 'dza' ba'i phyir bsngo bas rgyas gdab sogs spyan dmigs nan tan gyi sgo nas chag med du mdzad/ gung dpon po'i rim gror rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi gtor zlog bsgrubs shing dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga mdzad/ dpon po sku mched rnams kyis gtsos bla dpon ser skya lnga brgya tsam la gdugs dkar zhal phyag yongs rdzogs kyi rjes gnang stsal/ tshes lnga'i nyin em chi'i lha khang du gdan drangs te bla ma dge 'dun gyi thog skya ser gyi khrom stong phrag nye bar bstan pa'i 'jug sgo skyabs 'gro'i khrid skyabs yul rnams kyi yon tan dang de lakhyabs su 'gro tshul theg pa thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par skyabs 'gro'i phan yon dang bslab bya sogs go ba bog chod dulter ba smin rgyas su gnang / de nas ca kher chi sangs rgyas skyabs kyis khyim du bsnyen bkur zhus thog bla dpon ser skya nyis stong brgal bar phyag rdor gtum po khyung lnga'i rjes gnang bka' chos dkyus ma'i skor phyag dbang bcas gnang / tshur 'khoranas gung gi a khu tho yon bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyi gshag tu bzhugs/tshes drug la tho yon gyis gtsos ser skya lnga brgya tsam la spyan ras gzigs phyag 437

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/bzhi pa'i rjes gnang stsal dngos 'bul spam mtho ba phul/ gung gi dgon pa bkra shis chos 'khor gling du bla dpon ser skya stong phrag gsum lhag pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid gzab bshad dang gung dpon pos gsar bzhengs byams chen gyi lha khang du gdan drangs pa bzhin shis par brjod pa'i me tog char du bsnyil/ dge slong rgya mtshos sger 'bul gzabs shing 'dod don zhus pa'i 'dun pa bskangs/ sngar mi bdun lcebs nas shi ba'ikhron pa zhig tu sri 'dul zhus bar gsang bdag lospri pā la'i sngags kyis bcun cing spyan dmigs gtad pas zil che ba zhig byung la de phyin chad sri kha yang rbad kyis chad a ke dbang rgyal gyi ri khrod du gdan drangs nas der bzhugs/ phyi nyin gsar bzhengs tsan dan jo bo'i sgu brnyan la rab gnas mdor bsdus mdzad bla dpon 'ga' zhig la chos rgyal gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang la/ ri khrod du ming zhus par ngo mtshar rmad byung bkod pa'i gling zhes btags tshur 'khor te dbang rgyal rang nyid kyi khyim du zhag gnyis bzhugs/ gzhi byes kyi nyan mkhan mang por gcod stan thog gcig ma'i khrid dang spyan ras gzigs seng ge'i sgra'i rjes gnang stsal/ tshes dgu'i zhogag sbyin bdag gi rim gror dge 'dun brgya lhag gis bka' 'gyur klog pa'i tshogs dbur phebs/ a ke dbang rgyal la spad kyis brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te dngos 'bul dgu tshan dgu btegs/ de nas gung gis be+e mon du gdan drangs nas gsol ja zhus thog gung ma hā pā las maṇ+ḍal gyi dod dngul srang bzhi brgya sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol chibasata gnyis nor bu don yod zhags pa bcas dgu tshan gcig / rdor dril dang ḍā ma ru rten khebs sogs mchod rdzas kyi rigs dgu tshan gcig /dngul srang brgya dang nyer lnga las bsgrubs pa'i snod spyad dgu tshan gnyis/438

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /shel dang dkar yol gyi snod spyad gu tshan gcig / gos chen sna tshogs dgu tshanaganyis/ gcan gzan gyi pags rigs dgu tshan gnyis/ bu la gan dgu tshan gcig / gos khug sna tshogs dgu tshan gcig bcas dgu tshan bcu gcigagis mchod sprin ngo mtshar ba spros/ / de'i steng nas ca khrir chi sangs rgyasaskyabs kyis rje nyid sku tshe brtan cing sbyin bdag rnams kyi tshe bsod rgyas pa'i gsol 'debs skyabs 'jug nan tan zhus par bab 'brel gyi bka' lan bzang po gnang / pe zi'i ho sho'u'i smon lam bla ma'i dgon pa nas mkhan po bkra shis bstan 'dzin tha po nang mgon po skyabs dang 'bum pa skyabs bsod nams stobs rgyas ngo g.yog rnams gdan 'dren du 'ongs pa bzhin sbyin bdag gung 'khor bcas kyis chibs skyel ja thab dang bcas phebs/ lo'u hu'i gung on dur hu'i bu chos skyabs rang bzhin sogs tha bo nang 'ga' zhig dang tho'u ha'i lha khang gi bla ma las sne rnams chibs bsur 'byor/ the gu su chog thu'i khyim du mjal ba bdun brgya tsam dang tho'u ha'i lha khang du mjal ba nyis stong brgal ba byung bar phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang tha po nang tho gu tsha'i khyem du bzhugs/ tshes bcu'i zhog ka sbyin bdag gis gtsos tshogs pa drug brgya tsam la skyabs 'gro'i khrid gnang / tha po nang tho ga chi'i khyim dang de ga'i lha khang du rim par babs te lha khang du ser skya sum stong brgal bar byin rlabs dang dkyus chos kyi thog dzam bha la dkar ser nag gsum gyi chu sbyin mgon po phyag drug pa dang mgon dkor gyi gtor chog rnams kyi ljags lung stsal/ tha po nang thu lag thu'i khyim du gung tshigs dang thu sa lag chi ching thog thu hu'i khyim du zhag bzhugs gnang te so so'i don mdzad mjal ba stong phrag brgal bar phyag dbang sogs gnang / bcu gcig gi zhog ka thu sa 'a ga chi'i lha khang du byams pa'i sku brnyan la rab gnas mdor 439

༄/ /gung bang bstan ba'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/bsdus mdzad cing bla dpon ser skya lnga brgya tsam la tshe dpag med kyi rjes gnang dang sgrol ma dkar ljang gi lung phyag dbang bcas stsal/ tha po nang don grub kyi lha khang dang mchod rten dkar po'i lha khang du rim par babs te dad ldan rnams chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad cing thu sa lag chi gung on dur hu'i yā mon du gdan drangs nas der bzhugs/ bcu gnyis kyi zhog ka gung dpon pos gtsos skya ser bzhi brgya skor la 'jigs byed kyi rjes gnang stsal sbyin bdag gung gis gzhis len 'bul la gzabs/ gung gi lha khang du shis brjod gnang zhing ming zhus par gsang sngags bde chen gling zhes btags/tha bo nang rnam thar gyi khyim du rim gro zhig bsgrubs shing der bzhugs/ bcu gsum la de ga'i lha khang gi bla gra rnams kyis bsnyen bkur dang chos 'brel zhus/yon hu'i chu chen gyi 'gram nas e phu rnam rgyal gung on dur hu thu sa lag chi ching thog tho hu sogs dpon blon mang po zhig phyir slog ja lang smon lam gyi khyim du gung bab thog bla dpon ser skya sum stong brgal bar rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang stsal tho yon bstan 'dzin dar rgyas ngo g.yog phyir slogaphur han thu'i rab 'byams pa yar 'phel tho yon bstan pa rab rgyas sogs grwa pa mang po dang e phu dge legs bsam grub tha bo nang dbang phyug dang sto ti sogs dpon blon mang po rim gyis 'byor/ e be+e cang ki'i grong sder mjal ba stong phrag tsam dang gu shri chos rin chen gyi lha khang du ser skya stong phrag gnyis tsam byung zhing snga phyi'i mjal ba drug stong brgal ba byung yang lam 'gyang ba sogs la thugs snang mi mdzad par de rnams la rjes su brtse ba 'ba' zhig gis phyag dad bka' chos dkyus ma'i rim pa cung zad kyang chad lus med pa gnang bas mun sros te chu tshan kha'i thu bed dge slong gi lha khang du mtshan mo babs/bcu gnyis la thā zi ku'i mkhar gye nye 'dabs su pe zi 'chi med rdo rje'i tsha bo a 440

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /ke rat+na ki rtes gtsos tha po nang 'ga' zhig dang o lān go'i lha khang gi bla ma las sne chibs bsur 'byor/ a ke rat+na ki tis nyid nas rim gro gnang ba'i thugs rje la brten nas ri dwags kyi sa char 7gong mas bdag rkyen du bka' zi ser po gnang zhes bka' drin legs 'bul zhus/ dka' bcu mkhas mchog gi ri khrod du rten gsum la rab gnas mdzad cing / mi rin dharma dha tu'i khyim du gzhi byes kyi bla dpon ser skya mang po zhig la mgon po bar chad kun sel gye rjes gnang dang mjal ba nyis stong nye bar phyag dbang bka' chos gnang / thu sa lag chi tshe brtan dang thu sa lag chi don grub sogs dpon blon mang po chibs bsur 'byor bur han thu'i dgon par phyag phebs te nyin gsum bzhugs/ ja sag gung gi chibs skyel ba tho yon 'jigs med nyi ma dang tsa n+t+ra kirte a ke blo bzang chos skyong dang mi bskyod e phu dkon mchog rgyal mtshan ho sho'u lha khang dang em chi'i lha khang gnyis kyi las sne sogs drag zhan brgyad cu skor phyir slog / smon lam bla ma'i gdung zhugs 'bul dang sbyang chogasku gdung mchod rten la rab gnas dang bla brang du dge mtshan spel ba'i chos rnams mdzad/ sbyin bdag grwa rigs rnams kyis gtang rag gi 'bul ba gya nom pa btegs bzhugs ring la phyogs 'dus kyi mjal ba drag zhan mang por phyag dbang chos bka' sogs gang 'dod du stsal/ thu med pe zi'i gdan 'dren pa cwa phu tā bla ma sbyin pa dar rgyas tha'i ji phu'u shu'u mi rin sin pe leg ja lang bzhi cang gi brgyad khun tu bcu gcig yul mi dang bcas drag zhan brgya lhag gis zhon rta shing rta khyer 'ongs pa bzhin bco brgyad kyi nyin dgon pa nas thon/ tha bo nang skal bzang dar rgyas kyis gdan drangs pa'i don mdzadade tha bo nang 'bum pa skyabs kyi khyim du bzhugs/ snga phyi'i mjal ba sum stong brgal bar phyag dbang bka' chos chag med du stsal/ bcu dgu'i 441

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/zhog ka skya ser sum brgya skor la skyabs 'gro'i khrid dang sher snying gi lung gnang / 'bum pa skyabs kyis 7gong ma'i ri dwags kyi zhabs phyi lo sum cu tsam bsgrubs kyang bdag rkyen gang yang ma byung bas yi mug ste dpyid ka rje nyid phebs dus ched gtad kyis skyabs 'jug dang bka' bsgo zhus par brten ston 'dir rma bya'i sgro gnang byung ba'i dga' ston legs 'bul gzabs/pur han thu'i mkhan po bla ma tas thung zhabs drung phyag mdzod dge legs rnams phyir log / sngags ram pa dpal ldan gye ri khrod dang bsod nams stobs rgyas kyi lha khang du rim pas shis brjod mdzad cing lha khang du ming zhus par phan bde rab rgyas gling zhes btags/ der dad 'dus kyi mjal ba chig stong nye bar sher snying dang rnam rgyal gzungs ring gi lngags lung stsal/dge rgyas rgad po'i khyim du mjal ba lnga brgya tsam la seng gdong ma'i lngags lung dang cul chin gyi lha khang du nang so tshang thu sogs ser skya stong phrag nye bar 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi lung gnang / a sa ral thu'i khyim dang dem chi phun tshogs kyi lha khang du rim pas shis brjod mdzad cing lha khang la ming zhus par bkra shis rab rgyas gling zhes btags/ yong gong smon lam bla ma ngo g.yog dang 'jigs byed skyabs dpon po blon 'khor mang po bcas mjal b.raslebs snga phyi'i mjal mi lnga stong lhag pa phyag dbang chos 'brel gyis tshim par mdzad/ ho tho che chung spyi mang gis pa ga ho tho'i lha khang du 'dus nas bsnyen bkur zhus shing der bzhugs/ nyi shu'i zhog ka ser skya'i khrom mang po la seng gdod ma'i lung gnang / dem chi ting 'dzin nyi ma'i lha khang du grwa ba dang hwa shang do'u si spyi 'dus kyis gsol ja dang mjal kha zhus lha khang la ming zhus par bkra shis dge 'phel gling zhes btags/ 'dir skya ser gyi tshogs pa nyis stong brgal ba dang da lan bu lag tu mjal mi drug brgya tsam byung ba 442

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bcasasnga phyi'i mjal ba bzhi stong nye bar phyag dbang bka' chos ma chad par gnang / sgyung gnas stong phrag re sogs dge ba rgya chen po khas len mkhan mang du byung ba la shin tu dgyes pa'i gzebs bstod dang dam bca' mthar 'khyol ba gal che tshul gyi bka' nan mdzad/ cho lo ching g.yas g.yon gnyis kyispyi ming gis ja lang ba thu'i khyim du 'dus nas zhabs tog zhus pa'i don mdzad/ nyi shu gcig la de ga'i lha khang du tshogs pa bdun brgya skor la bla ma mchod pa'i ljags lung gnang / a ke rat+na kirte dang tsan+d+ra pā la 'bum pa skyabs ong gong smon lam bla ma srad rgyud mkhan po lha ram pa rdo rje snying po sogs bla dpon mang po phyir log / thu med pe zi'i ho sho'i cwa phu ta bla ma rdo ram pa ngag dbang shes rab lha ram pa ngag dbang rdo rje dem chi grags pa 'od zer sogs dgon pa'i dem chi dge bskos grwa rigs mang po dang thu sa lag chi the gu su cho ga thu ca khir chi mi 'gyur tha'i ji bka' 'gyur skyabs sogs dpon po che chung drug tog can mang po bcas rta pa brgyad cu skor chibs bsur 'byor/wang gi te sho'u sha par thu'i lha khang du mjal mi drug brgya skor dang thu med kyis sne o lan ho sho'u'i lha khang du lha ram pa dag dbang rdo rje sogs grwa pa rnams kyis gdan drangs thog dang 'dus kyi bla dpon ser skya pho mo khri phrag long bar spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang mtshan dang snying po'i phan yon gzab bshad kyisgo nas ma ṇi'i bzlas lung phyag dbang sogs rgyas par stsal/ snga phyir lo dgu bcu lhag lon pa'i rgad po gnyis kyis tshe g.yang phul bar mtshan dang gzungs sngags rna lam du sgrog par mdzad/ lha khang der dpe cha mang po yod pa'i sho ka li zhig bdug pa phyag tu blangs te de ring 'di nas thu med kyi sa sne zin pa yin pas ho sho'u 'di ga'i phyis 'byung gi rten 'brel brtag dgos gsungs nas kha phyes par rtsang ba mkhan po'i mgur gyi nang gi / byas ni lha 443

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'isgraname'i gsung 'bum/chos rang byas yod/ / sgom ni phyag chen rang bsgoms yod/ / dang myal bar skyes kyang 'gyod pa med/ / ces pa'i tshigs rnams thon byung bas lha chos kho na byasaphyag chen kho na bsgoms nas dmyal bar skyes na sman dug tu gyur/ lha bdud du babs/ rgyu 'bras go log tu song ba yin pas de las spyong chen po dang 'gyod pa chen po ci yod/ ho sho'u 'di gar ci 'dra'i rim gro bsgrubs kyang phan yon dang 'bras bu dzi lta ba bzhin 'byung dka' zhes pa'i brda yin pa 'dra gsungs nas thugs rtog gnang ba phyis su de kho na bzhin byung / na yan thas ja lang dang cang ki sman bla skyabs so so'i khyem du shis brjod mdzad de o'u mu rin gyi chu brgal nas ja lang tshe dpag skyabs kyi khyim du bzhugs/'di nyin mjal ba shin tu mang zhing de dag spyi khyab tu phyag dbang bka' chos dang sger du rang rang gis bka' bsgo skyabs 'jug lngags bsngo sogs gar zhus thams cad 'dod mos ltar stsal pas zhag sar nam gyi sum cha rdzogs pa'i tshod tsam las ma 'byor/ nyer gnyis la cang gi tshe thi chi dang lu'u shi pā dang pi lig thu so so'i khyem dang na rīn su por ga'i zhabs drung chos rje'i lha khang rnams su rim pas gdan drangs te rjes gnang lung sogs zhus pa'i re ba skong bar mdzad/ snga phyi'i mjal ba drug stong brgal bar phyag dbang chos 'brel dkyus ltar gnang zhing mun sros la thu sa lag chi the gu su chog thu'i khyim du 'byor/ nyer gsum gyi zhog ka thu sa lag chi sogs bla dpon ser skya bzhi bcu skor la dzam dkar gyi rjes gnang stsal gzhis len gsol ston 'bul nod gzabs/ thu sa lag chi'i tsha bo rab 'byams pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug la chos rje'i cho lo gnang skya ser gye khrom lnga stong brgal bar bka' chos dkyus ma'i thog ltung bshags kyi cho ga'i lung phyag dbang bcas stsal/ cang ki ye rem thes kyi khyim dang thu sa lag chi'i lha khang cwa phu tho yon shes rab dpal 'byor gyi 444

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /lha khang rnams su gdan drangs pa'i don mdzad cing snga phyi'i mjal ba sum stong brgal bar phyag dbang chos bka' gnang ste cha gan gol gyi tha'i ji rab brtan gye khyim du mtshan mo 'byor/ dka' bcu blo bzang don grub yon mchod gnyis tsam la mkha' spyod ma'i dmigs rim gyi khrid lkog chos su stsal/ nyer bzhi'i zhog ka ser skya sum stong tsam la mdo sdud pa'i lung gnang tha'i ji tshe dbang dang tshe dbang skyabs gnyis kyi khyim du rim pas shis brjod dang 'jal ba bdun brgya tsam la rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyinasreg sgo drug pa'i gzungs kyi lung gnang / gor pan su bor ga'i tā bla ma ngag dbang lhun grub dge bskos dem chirnams dang pe zi'i dgon pa'i zhabs drung ye shes 'jigs med tho yon blo bzang rin chen sogs nang so dka' ram dem chi grwa pa mang po zhig rim gyis 'byor/ sha ra'i pu lag la tha'i ji shag sha pad kyi khyim du zhag bzhugs thog mjal ba chig stong tsam byung ba bcas snga phyi'i mjal ba lnga stong nye bar phyag dbang sogs gnang / nyi shu lnga la tha'i ji shag sha pad gza' mi rnams la sgol ma'i rjes gnang stsal/ khā tha'i ji hu thog gi khyim du mjal ba lnga brgya tsamadang chi ba ga thu'i khā khu sel gyi khyim du ser skya lnga stong brgal ba byung ba rnams la phyag dbang sogs rgyas par stsal/ pe zi'i su me'i grwa tshang bla ma rdo ram pa ngag dbang bkra shis dge bskos dka' ram 'ga' zhig dang pe zi'i ho ro'i tha'i ji rat+na dang ma hā bā la sogs dpon po che phra bdun dang tog can mang po bcas rta ba brgyad cu skor chibs bsur 'byor/ de nas rim gyis grong sde'i mjal ba stong phrag bzhi lhag phyag dbang sogs kyis tshim par mdzad degor pan su por ga'i lha khang du 'byor/ thu med pe zi'i tshe brtan bkra shis dpon blon brgya phrag du ma'i 'khor dang bcas pa chibs bsur 'byor nas mjal kha zhus/ mtshan mo khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen 445

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'isgronama'i gsung 'bum/pos zung 'jug mngon du mdzad pa'i dus chen dge ldan lnga mchod chen mor grags pa'i gling me 'bul ba dang bstun te dmigs bsal can gyi zhal 'don dngaspyan dmigs nan tan gnang / nyi shu drug gi zhog ka lha khang gi bla grwa rnams kyis gtsos ser skya sum stong brgal bar bla ma mchod pa'i lung stsal/ci ran thas ja lang dang ja lang i thi gel ja lang na son tshang so so'i khyim dang de ga'i lha khang du rim pas gdan drangs pa'i don mdzad snga phyir mjal ba drug stong tsam la phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang / thu sa lag chi rnam rgyal dang tha'i ji 'ga' zhig chibs bsur 'byor ba yod kyi ja lang chos 'phel gyi khyim du bzhugs/ nyi shu bdun gyi zhog ka ja lang gza' mi rnams kyis gtsos ser skya lnga brgya tsam la seng ldeng nags sgol gyi rjes gnang stsal/ jo bo'i su me sogs lha khang 'ga' zhig gi bla ma las sne mang bo dang pe zi'i ho ro'i tā thi ji grags pa sogs thi'i ji bdun gzhan tog can mang po bcas rta ba lnga bcu skor chibs bsur 'byor/ bsod nams skyabs kyi khyim dang de ga'i lha khang thog tho hu dang chos rin chen so sos khyim rnams su gdan drangs nas 'dod chos zhus pa'i re ba bskangs shing ha ra tho go thu la mjal ba nyis stong lnga brgya skor dang /khus then bu lag tu sum stong tsam dang jo bo'i su me'i nye 'dabs su lnga stong tsam bcas snga phyi'i 'jal ba chig khri chig stong brgal ba phyag dbang bka' chos kyis tshim bar mdzad de nam gyi gung thun du gleb pa'i tshod la jo bo'i lha khang du babs/ nyi shu brgyad kyi zhog ka zhabs drung ye shes chos bzang sogs grwa mang dang dad 'dus kyi mjal ba nyis stong brgal bar bla ma mchod pa'i lngags lung gnang / lha khang der bod chos sog skad du bsgyur nas dbyangs rta thams cad bod chos ltar 'don gyin yod par dbu mdzad rnams la chos 'don bcuganas gsan par mdzad/ mong gol cin pe li'i mi sna ja lang mo lon 446

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /thos ngo g.yog 'byor nas mtshams zhu phul/ tha'i ji bsam 'grub rdo rje'i a ke rnams dang de'i lha khang gi ja hu bla ma dge bskos dem chi tha'i ji 'jigs med kun bzang ja khir chi phun tshogs rin chen sogs bla dpon mang pos rim gyis chibs bsu zhus/ tha'i ji phu'u shu'u'i khyim du ja zhus thog skye pho mo'i khrom sum stong tsam 'dus ha thun e ji dang thas thas bsod nams dpal bzang pe zi dpon po thu sa lag chi tha'i ji blon po drag zhan stong phrag nye bas chubs bsu bskyar ma dang ja thab zhus/ de nas pe zi'i yā mon gyi sgo drung du skye pho mo'i tshogs pa stong phrag mang po dang dgon pa'i dge 'dun stong phrag nye bas gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs mchod rdzas sna tshogs tshar du dngar zhing /'bud dkrol gyi rol mo'i bye brag du ma dang dri zhim po'i spos 'dren gyis mdun bsus te pho brang dbus mar gdan drangs nas gsol ja dkar spro zhus/dgon pa'i gling du pe zi'i sdod gnas rnying bar bzhugs gnas gra bsgrigs bgyis yod pa bzhin der bzhugs/ mjal ba lnga stong tsam 'dus shing snga phyi'i mjal ba khri phrag long ba rnams la phyag dbang chos 'brel rgyas par gnang /phyi nyin dgon pa'i 'du khang du gdan drangs nas gsol ja'i thog dge 'dun mang gis mjal kha zhus/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che'i gzim khang du phebs nas bzhugs khri la kha btags phul te mjal kha zhus/ gzhi srung ba rnamasakyis gsol ja dang dkar spro zhus thog pe zis gtsos bla dpon mi drag brgya phrag tsam la 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che bod nas bzhed don lhun gyis grub nas myur du chibs kha bsgyur ba'i bden tshig gsol 'debs dang rje nyid kyi zhabs brtan gsol 'debs kyi lung gnang / dgon pa 'di nyid dpon gong ma rnams kyi dus nas thun mong ma yin par bkra shis 'khyil gyi dgon lag lta bu yin pa'i rten 'brel la dgongs te rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad 447

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/pa rin po che'i gsol 'debs de nyid phral du dpar la bkod nas dgon pa'i tshogs su mang 'gyed dang bcas 'dzug par mdzad/ zla ba bcu gcig gi tho rangasakhar nam zla'i dus tshod dang mtshan mo'i smag 'thib pa sogs kyi snang tshul la brten thugs la skyo shas drag po 'khrungs te de ma thag mgur du bzhes pa ni/ bka' drin dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad las lhag pa/ / khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po lā li ta badz+ra/ / bdagasnying pad+mo'i dbus su byang chub bar bzhugs la/ / blo sna chos la phyogs pa'i byin rlabs shig stsol dang / / nam zla dbyar dus skyid du tshor ba de thal song / / grang ngad reg pa tsha pa'i rgun dus kho sleb byung / / nam gzhug shar ba'i spang rgyan sngo chung gi gtad so/ / lha khang khra mo'i dkon mchog mchod gral de snyogs ran/ / sha khrag lang tsho rgyas pa'i gzhon dus de thal song / / skra dkar gnyer mas khebs pa'i rgan khog de sleb byung / / dus mthar skyes pa'i ban chung ser gzugs kyi gtad so/ / dben dgon khra mo'i rang shong spyil chung de bzang ngo / / 'khri shing nags tshal thams cad lo 'dab kun brul song / / lhung lhung 'bab pa'i chu klung 'khyag gong du 'dril byung / / gsung snyan bsgyur mkhas bye'u 'jol mo yi gtad so/ / lho rong mon gyi yul gyi nags gseb de legs so/ / kha yi so 'phreng dkar po phal cher ni lhung song / / smra ba ldib pas tshig 'bru mi gsal dus sleb byung / / kha bdes chos bshad mkhas pa'i ban chung gi gtad so/ /smra bcad gsang sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod de legs so/ / khri gdugs 'od stong 'gyed pa'i nyi ma de nub song / / srod kyi dus kyi mun pa tshab tshub de slob byung / / dgos med rtsed mos g.yeng ba'i bsam med kyi byis pa/ / khang phug ma las bde mor gnyid du rang yur ran/ / dbang po yul la spyod pa'i nus pa kun nyams song / / dran rig mi gsal rjed nges mun pa de 'thab 448

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /byung / / sna tshogs spros pas ngal ba'i gsal rig gi shes pa/ / chos dbyings sprosabral ngang du gzim na rang legs so/ / nyin gcig tshe 'di'i yul snang bkra lam pa 'di nyid/ / thib kyis nub nas sngon chad cha rgyus rang med pa'i/ / gnas ngan zhig tu rang nyid gcig pu ru 'gro dus/ / re sa gzhan med badz+ra wā ra hi mkhyen no/ / zhes pa ste bris bsu ba mang po lam ltos par 'di lta bu thol byung du gnang ba ni phyi rol gyi snang ba thams cad gdams par shar cing / mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa mdud grol ba rje btsun bzhad pa'i rdo rje lta bu'i khyad chos ngo mtshar phul du che ba zhig go / pe zis gtsos pa'i bla dpon ser skya nyis brgya skor la bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dam can gtor chog dang sman chog gi lung rnams gnang / ha ma ka pe zi'i sras gsum pa tha'i ji 'jigs med kun bzang gis gdan drangs nas gsol ston gzabs shing khong gis gtsos ser skya drug cu skor la skyabs 'gro'i khrid gnang /chos yon du maṇ+ḍal sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dngul srang brgya tham pa yab pe zi'i bsngo rten du dngul srang brgya tham pa phul/ dpon mo pad+ma dha ra dang tha'i ji ma hā pā la yum sras kyis gdan drangs nas zhag gcig bzhugs shing rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang stsal bar yon 'bul gya nom pa btegs/ cwa phu tā bla ma rdo ram pa ngag dbang shes rab gtsos bla ma dka' ram bcu skor la dam can gyi rigs gtad gnang / tha'i ji phu'u shu'u dngatā han tas sogs mi drag bcu skor la bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa dang bsgrub bya lnga la dge bsnyen lnga bcu nga brgyad la rab byung brgyad cu la dge tshul brgya dang sum cu so lnga la dge slong gi sdom pa sogs 'bog par mdzad de lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bdud rtsi'i mchod sbyin bkye/ nyin kha shas kyi ring 'dir dad 'dus kyi mjal ba bzhi khri chig stong tsam phyag dbang chos 'brel 449

༄/ /gung ca bstanaba'izlanaḥ gsung ཿma/gyis tshim par mdzad cing sger mjal zhu mkhan mi drag du mar yang bka' bsgo gsung brtag sogs so so'i mos pa bzhin stsal/ tshes bdun rje nyid kyi 'khrungs skar yin pas dpon slob kha shas kyis 'a go ba'i lha lnga'i gsol mchod btang / de nas yā mon gye pho brang dbus mar gdan drangs bla grwa mang pos maṇ+ḍal dang zhabs brtan gye bden tshig gsungs te zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan par bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa dang chabs gcig tu sbyin bdag pe zi tshe brtan bkra shis kyis dngul srang lnga bcu'i maṇ+ḍal sne 'dogs can/ gser zangs las grub pa'i tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan tshun lnga re yod pa dgu tshan gcig tshe mdo gser bris kyi glegs bam gser zangs kyis byang chub mchod rten bzang gos dras drub kyi bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dbyar dgun gyi na bza' dang sku'i nyer spyad cha tshang shel dang dkar yol gyi spyad pa byi ru'i sdong po sgam chung can sogs rten 'byung gi 'bul ba spam mtho ba dang /ha thun e ji dang thas thas pe zi'i a khu tha'i ji kun bzang 'jigs med ca khir chi phun tshogs rin chen sogs nye rigs tha'i ji rnams rang rang gi dpon mo sras sras mo bcas dang / thu sa lag chi ca khir chi mi rin sogs blon po tog can rnams dang / dgon pa'i cwa phu tā bla ma che chung gnyis grwa tshang bla ma dge bskos dem chi las sne dka' ram sogs gzhis sdod kyi bla dpon blon 'bangs che gras skor gang yod dang / har chin wang yab sras tā gung yab sras a ke pur+ṇa pā la o'u han zan pe zi har chin gung on dur hu sogs ho sho'u 'ga' zhig gi dpon po so so'i el chi bcas mi drag brgya phrag mang po mu mthud nas rang rang so so'i 'byor tshod kyi sku gsung thugs rten shel dang dngul gye snod spyad gos chen dang dngul rten khebs dril gdan cod paṇa sogs che 'byor chung 'byor gyi 'bul ba gya nom pa dbyar gyi char sprin bzhin du 450
