༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsangagasum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /gtibs/ sbyin bdag pe zis nyin gsum gyi ring khrang zhi'i rtsed mo bstar zhing gzhi byes kyi mgron rnams la gsol ston rgyas pa zhu ba gnang / tshes brgyada'i mong gol cin pe li'i gdan 'dren pa tha bo nang dkon mchog yar 'phel dka' bcu ngag dbang shes rab ja lang mo lon thos cang gi drug khun tu gnyis la mi sogs drag zhan drug cu skor zhon rta shing rta dang bcas slebs/tshes dgu'i nyin chibs bsgyur gnang bar pe zi dpon pos tha'i ji pur god dang tā han tas dka' bcu bstan dar nang so shag sha pad ja lang gnyis khā gnyis bcas skya ser sum cu skor zhabs phyir gtong ba gnang / pe zi rang nyid dpon blon gyi 'khor dang bcas skyel thung zhus dge slong rnam thar gyi gshag tu ser skya sum brgya skor la sgol ma dkar lngang gi lung dang gang gan gyi lhakhang du mjal ba stong phrag gnyis lhag la phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang ste der bzhugs/ tshes bcu'i zhog ka lha khang gi bla grwa rnams la skyabs 'gro'i khrid gnang / tha'i ji ba ta rang gos dang tha'i ji bla ma skyabs so so'i khyim du mjal ba chig stong re dang i khe yo lwan gyi grong sder mjal ba bzhi stong tsam byung ste snga phyi'i mjal ba drug stong brgal ba phyag dbang chos 'brel gyis tshim par mdzad cing na son the gu su'i khyim du bzhugs/ mong gol cin pe li'i a ke che ba dge 'dun skyabs ngo g.yog sum cu skor dang sku skye ngag dbang rgya mtsho'i grwa tshang bla ma lha ram pa bzang bo dar rgyas ngo g.yog rim gyis 'byor lha ram pa 'di nyid slob gnyer bzang ba zhig yin pas nyi ma mang po'i bar du zhabs phyi zhus par thugs brel gyi sangs bar rnams su chos kyi 'bel gtam mang du 'phel/ bcu gcig la tha'i ji ar bang hu dang dka' bcu chos rin chen sogs grong sde'i mi skya ser lnga brgya skor la bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid stsal/ha ra'i grong sder mjal ba nyis stong lhag byung bar phyag dbang chos 'brel 451

༄/ /gung thangangastan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/gnang shes rab rgya mtsho zer ba'i rgad po lo dgu bcu lon pa zhig gis tshe g.yang phul bar mtshan dang gzungs sngags rna lam du bsgrags/ dka' bcu ngag dbang don grub sogs dka' ram 'ga' zhig gis bla ma'i rnal 'byor chig brgyud ma'i lung dang dmigs rim gyi dogs gcod 'ga' zhig zhus par dogs lan yid tshim pa stsal/ phebs lam du mongagol cin pe li'i su me'i sku skye ngag dbang rgya mtsho pe li'i tho yon 'jigs med rnam rgyal dem chi gnyis dang dge bskos gnyis sogs grwa pa sum cu skor chibs bsur 'byor/ pe li'i sa snezin nas cur gād kyi grong sder phyogs nas 'dus pa'i mjal ba stong phrag bdun tsam byung bar phyag dbang bka' chos rgyas par stsal pur nam rgad po'i khyim du bzhugs/ bcu gnyis la hu bi la gan blo bzang dkon mchog dang puranam rgad po sogs grong sde'i mi rnams la bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid lung gnang / phebs lam du pe li'i a ke gnyis pa dkon mchog dpal bzang ngo g.yog sum cu skor dang cha gān di yun chi'i dgon pa'i tā bla ma blo bzang don grub las sne dka' ram ngo g.yog nyi shu skor gyis rim pas chibs bsu zhus/wār thu dang cha kho'ur thu'i grong sde 'ga' zhig gis sang zhus thog skya ser stong phrag tsam la mjal kha dang chos 'brel gnang / sbyin bdag pe li dpon blon gyi 'khor bcas rta pa brgya phrag du ma chibs bsur 'byor te ja thab zhus der skye pho mo'i khrom lnga stong tsam 'dus par nyi ma 'phyi zhing rlung 'tshub che bas skabs med pa lta bu yin kyang mtshan dang gzungs sngags rna lam du sgrogs bzhin pa'i sgo nas phyag dbang ma chad par gnang rim gyis bai li'i yā mon du 'byor/ phyi nyin zhal nas mdang nga'i rmi lam du nged dpon g.yog cha med kyi dgon pa zhig tu 'gro rtsis kyis nags nang du 'gro gan yod par phebs byams bkalaba'i dre'u 'drog nas phebs byams la skyon byung ba zhig rmis pa ci yin 452

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /gsung / hor chin ping thu wang gi dpon mo pu rtse ngo g.yog brgya skor ched gtadakyis mjal du 'ongs par 'dod mos bzhin spyan ras gzigs mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang bcas pa'i dbang bka' drin gnang / tha po nang puja ri ka dang dharma dha tu sogs gzhis sdod kyi tha bo nang bdun dang blon po che chung thun mong nas zhus ngor zhu mkhan rnams kyis thog drangs te skye pho mo'i tshogs pa bdun stong tsam la spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi'i rjes gnang / de'i mtshan dang yig drug gi phan yon gzab bshad ma ṇi'i bzlas lung sgyung gnas dang yigadrug sogs dge ba khas len bcug ste dge rtsa spyan ras gzigs la sgrub pa'i mchod par 'bul ba dang bsngo smon gyi mtshams spyor nan tan mdzad/dge slong dad pa zer ba lo bdun cu don brgyad lon pa zhig gis sngar rje nyid kyiskra mdun du sgyung gnas stong phrag gnyis gsum srung rgyu khas blangs pa las stong phrag gnyis dang bzhi brgya bsrungs zin pa rnams sgrub pa'i mchod par phul cing 'phro sgrub pa la tshe yis lcog rgyu'i skyabs 'jug dang dge ba rdzogs byang du 'gyur ba'i ljags bsngo zhus par dgyes tshor chen pos legs so ched du brjod pas dbugs dbyung dang bsngo smon sogs yid tshim par stsal/ pe li dpon po yum sras rnams la klu dbang rgyal po dang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rjes gnang pe li'i a ke dkon mchog dpal bzang gis zhus ngor bla dpon nyung 'dus la dpal mgon zhi rgyas dbang gsum gyi rjes gnang rnams bka' drin stsal/ pe li dpon pos na chin mang po stobs rtsal 'gran du 'jug pa dang khrang zhi 'khrab pa sogs mtho ris men ga'i zlos gar lta bu'i gzigs mo sna tshogs na lam du bstar ba dang bcas ston chen zhus shing / dngos 'bul du dngul srang bzhi bcu'i maṇ+ḍal sne 'dogs can sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol shel gyi me long che ba gsum dngul srang lnga brgya sogs 453

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/spam mtho ba btegs/ sngar gdan 'dren pa 'ongs dus rje nyid nas nyi ma kha shas tsam las yun ring bzhugs mi thub tshul gsungs pa thams cad kyis thos yod pas 'dir nyin bdun bzhugs ring la nyin re bzhin thag nye ring sna tshogs nas mjal ba mtha' yas pa dbyar gyi shā 'od rdol pa bzhin du lung de 'ongs pa zhib tu rtsi bas rngo mi thogs kyang rags rtsis tsam la'ang bdun khrir nye ba byung / de thams cad la'ang phyag dbang dang dkyus ma'i chos sbyin chad med du gnang bar ma zad yul lugs kyis mjal ba'i nang nas sger du bka' bsgo zhu mkhan ha cang mang bar de dag phyogs gcig tu sdod bcug nas bcu phrag kha shas re yong ba dang phyag dbang mtshams mdzad de bka' bsgo re gnang zhing / mjal kha tshar rag la de 'dra'i skor thang mang po byung bar mjal ba byings la phyag dbang skor thang so sor bka' bsgo spel mar gnang dgos pa byung zhing gsung brtan gis ljags bsngo mi zhu mkhan med pa lta bu yin la/nam zla dgun du song bas nyi mthung zhing grang ngad che stabs shin tu 'o brgyal yang de la ci mi snyam par de dag gi rgyud la dge ba'i sa bon sna re thebs kyang ci ma rung snyam du thugs brtse ba 'ba' zhig nye bar bzhag ste thams cad kyi re ba skong bar mdzad/ hor chin wang bsod nams stobs rgyas kyi mi sna thu sa lag chi dam chos phas than tā bde legs ngo g.yog 'byor nas de ga'i ho sho'u la gdan 'dren gye snyan gsan phul bar thu med kyi sbyin bdag rnams kyes yun ring sdod dgos tshul nan tan che na'ang khas blangs med pas gal te de gar sdod dgos par shar tshe dbyed ka phebs chog tshul gnang / cha gan di yan chi'i dgon pa nas tā bla ma blo bzang don grub tshogs chen dbu mdzad dang dge bskosasde ba dka' ram che gras ngo g.yog lnga bcu skor 'ongs nas dgon par gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul bar sngar gyi thugs rmis la cung zad thugs 454

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /ngogs gnang nas zhal len ma gnang ba la dpon po rnams kyis yu tshugs mtha' skyel zhus pas rib tsam phebs rgyu'i zhal len gnang / brtswa brgyad kyi nyin 4mon nas chibs bsgyur gnang dus mjal ba tshan chen po 'dus yod par sngar rgyun ltar yā mon gyi sgo drung du bsgrigs pa la zhal nas mjal ba phebs lam du 'phreng bsgrigs te nged kyis phyag dbang byed/ khyed tshos phebs byams mjal ba'i phar sner khyer shog gsungs pa bzhin mjal ba sgo drung nas brtsams te phebs lam du phreng bsgrigs pa la nyid kyis phyag dbang gnang bzhin par zhabs thang du phebs/ mgyog sbyang ba rnams kyis phebs byams dre'u la bkal nas mjal ba'i phar sner khyer ba lam du dre'u drog ste phebs byams snang nas bcos long ma byung bar pe li'i 'gyog sbyang du bzhugs te phebs dgos pa byung bas sngar gsung ba'ang rmi lam gyi zol gyis zhabs 'brang rnams la brda sprad par snang ngo / / 'di nyin ja lang rgyal mtshan gyis khyim du gdan drangs nas der bzhugs mjal ba stong phrag gsum lhag byung bar phyag dbang sogs gnang / bcu dgu'i zhog ka ja lang gza' mi tshang mar rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi rjes gnang stsal 'bul nod gzabs/ bur ga su thas grong bar mjal ba stong phrag gnyis tsam 'dus par bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi lung khrid gnang / phebs lam du cha gān di yān chi'i hu bil gān dgon pa'i tā bla ma dang las sne dka' ram dge tshul slong rta pa brgya phrag brgal bas chibs bsu dang ja thab zhus/ dgon pa'i nye 'dabs su mchod rdzas dang rol cha thogs pa'i dge 'dun mang po'i ser sprengs kyis mdun bsus te di yān chi'i bla brang du babs/ de'i mtshan mo glo bur du stod 'tshang lta bu'i bsnyunazug che ba zhig byung ste nyin zhag gsum gyi ring bskungs par gzhi byes thams cad tsha drag gis dgon pa'i tshogs chen dang sngags pa grwa tshang sku skye ngag 455

/ /gung thangabastanapa'i na 'igasung༄ma/dbang rgya mtsho'i grwa tshang rnams su zhabs brtan mang po dang bla brang nas lta ram pa bzang po dar rgyas dang gu shrī tā bla ma bsam grub nyi ma sogs zhabs brtan pa tshan mang pos rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi gtor zlog dang dpal mgon dang lcam sring gi bskang gso 'chi blu dang mdos chog sogs zhabs brtan stobs chen nyin mtshan bar ma chad du bsgrubs/ bskun gzhi cung zad dwangs pa dang thag ring gi mjal ba stong phrag mang sgug sdod byas yod par brtse bas gzigs te mtshan dang gzungs sngags sgrog bzhin phyag dbang gnang / rim gyes bsnyun gzhi lhag med du dwangs pas slob ma dang sbyin bdag thams cad dga' spro rgyas/ bla brang gi tshom chen du hu bil gan bla mas gtsos dgon pa'i bla ma dge 'dun dang pe li yab sras sogs dpon blon skya ser gyi tshogs pa nyis stong tsam la sgol dkar 'od zer drug sbrags kyi rjes gnang dang chos grwa nasabla ma dge 'dun tshang mar dmigs brtse ma dgu skor dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi zab khrid gnang dgon pa 'dir 'chad nyan 'phel zhing bla ma dka' ram sku yon can mang bas khrid kyi skabs dang rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro gnyis ka la gzab bshad lung rigs kyis brgyan pa rgya cher gnang bas gsung zur re res kyang sgro 'dogs mang po gcod cing blo skyed gsal sang nge ba yid ngor bde lhan gyes 'gro ba re byung bas blo gros kyi rtsal dang ldan pa rnams chos kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i mos gus tshad med pa rnyed/ bsdus grwa nas dbu ma bar gye 'dzin grwa so so nas chos grwa pa re re bgro gleng gtong bcug ste gzigs rtog mdzad/ a ke dkon mchog dpal bzang sogs su ser nyi shu skor la rta mgrinagasung sgrub kyi dmigs rim gyi khrid dang gzhan yang zhu mkhan so so'i ngor lam sgron dang lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum sgo drug pa'i gzungs byams smon cha bzhi'i gtor ma tsha gsur sogs chos tshan thor bu mang du gnang / thugs 456

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bag phab nas dge bshes 'ga' zhig dang chos kyi 'bel gtam mang du 'phel zhing / khyad par du thang ring lha ram pa bzang po dar rgyas dang rtsod pa mang poganang bar lha ram pas lung zhig drangs pa na lung de nyid phyir drangs te sgrubabyed gnang bas rje rang gi dam bca'i rgyab skyor du song nas lha ram pas lan ma thebs par rtsod pa pham pa'i tshe lha ram pas da res nga bdag po ngan nas lag cha dpa' po'i lag tu shor song ba ma gtogs lung de yin rgyu kho po'i sgrub byed du 'gro dgos rgyu yin zhes zhus pas thams cad bzhad gad theg ge ba byung / phyogs de'i mi chen zhig shi nas gdon 'dre 'jigs su rung bar skyes pa zhig gis mtho brtsams pa la rta mgrin gyi lha sngags la brten pa'i srung ba mdzad pas rje nyid sku 'khor dang bcas pa gang la'ang gnod 'tshe chen po byed ma nus/ der ma zad de skabs thugs brel che bas long ma byung ba ma gtogs dmigs gnad kyis bcun na 'dul sla tshod du 'dug ces zhal nas gsung /tshogs chen dang mtshan nyid grwa tshang sngags pa grwa tshang so so'i 'du khang du gdan drangs te gsol ja dkar spro zhus shing cha gan di yān chi'i hu pil gān gyis dngul ma sne 'dogs can sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol shel gyi yu ring zhig gis thog drangs pa'i shel snod mi 'dra pa dgu/ rta dang rnga mong dgu srang brgya'i rtsis kyi dong tshe bcas brtan bzhugs lugs su phul/nyer lnga'i nyin dgon pa nas chibs bsgyur gnang be+e li dpon po yab sras dang di yān chi'i hu bil gān skya ser gyi 'khor bcas rta ba brgya phrag mang pos chibs skyel dang ja thab zhus/ yo thog gi grong sde dang hu pi thu'i pu lug gi seraskya thams cad kyi don mdzad de tha bo nang mi 'gyur gyi khyim du bzhugs mjal ba nyis stong nye bar phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang / pe li'i a ke dkon mchog dpal bzang dang tho yon 'jigs med rnam rgyal tha bo nang tog 457

༄/ /gung bangabastanaba'i naḥg4 babum/can mang po zhig phyir log / nyer drug la ja lang tshe dpag dang thu med khun tu hu pi thu tha'i ji bka' 'gyur so so'i khyim du spyi sger gyi bsnyen bkur zhus pa'idon mdzad cing tha'i ji rnam rgyal gyi khyim du bzhugs/ nyi shu bdun la sbyin bdag de nyid kyis gtsos pa'i ser skya nyis brgya skor la tshe dpag med kyi rjes gnang stsal/ khun tu jo'un na so thu dang cang ki dkon mchog skyabs so so'ikhyem du gdan drangs thog tshogs pa mang po phyag dbang chos 'brel gyes tsham par mdzad de da lan thasakyi khyim du bzhugs/ nyi shu brgyad la khyim der skya ser brgya phrag mang po ladzam sar gyi rjes gnang dang men tu'i khyim du dzam dkar gyi sgrub thabs dang chu sbyin gyi lung gnang zhing thu ge mel dang tshang thu so sosakhyem du gdan drangs pa'i don mdzad de pe zi tshe brtan bkra shis gtsos drag zhan gyi bsu ba ser sbrengs dang bcas sngar gyi bzhugs gnas su phyag phebs/ pā rin wang dang o'u han thu sa lag chi wang 'jigs byed skyabs dpon po so so'i mtshams zhu pa 'byor/ mong gol jin gyi chibs skyel pa tha bo nang dkon mchog yar 'phel dang yukhri ṣa ja lang gnyis sogs tog can bcu lhag dang cha gān ti yan chi'i dgon pa'i dka' ram 'ga' zhig u lā dang bcas phyir log / rje nyid rang yul du mgyog sa par thon bzhed kyis ho sho'u gzhanarnams su nyi ma kha shas re las ma bzhugs shing 'di nas kyang phral du 'khor rtsis gnang bar sbyin bdag rnams nas lo gcig min rung lo phyed bzhugs dgos tshul snga ma nas nan tan che bar ma zad 'di res tshes gcig gi nyin pe zi dpon pos gtsos dpon blon che gras skor dang lha khang gi bla gra che gras thams cad 'ongs nas mgrin gcig gis gsol ba nan tan btab pas ngo bzlog ma nus par dpyid bar du bzhugs rgyu'i zhal len gnang / har chen wang gi ho sho'u nas zhabs phyir 'ongs pa'i drag zhan byings rnams phyir 458

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /slog / ca khir chi phun tshogs rin chen gza' mi rnams kyis gzim gshag nas mi 'khrugs pa'i rjes gnang zhus te 'bul nod phul/ tha'i ji dge legs gyi ma dang hu pil gān ye shes 'jigs med tha'i ji don grub gsum gyis gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus pa'i thog rim pa bzhin du khyung khra'i rjes gnang lam sgron sogs chos tshan 'ga' zhig gi lung rnam rgyal lha dgu'i rjes gnang bcas stsal/ tshes dgu nas pe zi'i yā mon du nyid dpon slob lngas sku mtshams bsdams nas sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga gsungs/ bco lnga'i nyin sku mtshams grol te pe zi btsun mo dang bcas par so sor 'brang ma dkar mo'i rjes gnang stsal pe zis maṇ+ḍal kha btags dngul srang sum brgya sogs phul/ mtshan mo gza' 'dzin byung bar dmigs bsal gye thugs dam gnang / zhal nas 'di ga'i skar ma lta mkhan la blo rtse mi 'dug de ring gza' 'dzin yod na sku rim sgrub rgyu snga gzhugs su bsnur mchog mod/ sku rim 'grub pa dang gza' 'dzin sgo bstun don ci yod ces cung zad thugs dogs gnang ba phyis su pe zi 'di nyid zla ba gzas zigopa ltar gzhan gyi bsnyad gcor la brten nas ja sag gi thob shor song ba de la dgongs par snang / bcu drug nas sbyin bdag grwa rigs 'ga' zhig gis gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus par tha'i ji grags pa dang gsang bdag rdo rje'i lha khang gibla grwa rnams la rim pa bzhin thun drug rnal 'byor gyi khrid lung dang rnam rgyal lha dgu'i rjes gnang / tha'i ji the gu su cir ga lang gi skor la bka' chos dkyus ma'i lung / tha'i ji phom phos kyi skor la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang / btsun mo ut+pa la tha'i ji grags pa rdo rje dang ye shes rdo rje bzod pa rgya mtsho rnams kyi khyim du tshogs pa mang po la rim pa ltar bzang spyod kyi lung rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rjes gnang skyabs 'gro'i khrid sogs stsal/459

༄/ /gung bang bstanapa'i name'i gsung ཿma/tha'i ji tā han tas kyi khyim du ser skya'i khrom mang por drag po gsum dril gyi rjes gnang dang de'i sgrub thabs sogs chos tshan 'ga' zhig gi lung gnang /hor chin bsod nams stobs rgyas wang gi mi sna ja lang nyi ma ngo g.yog gdan 'dren gyi ang nyan du 'byor par de ga'i wang gi yab mes rnams rje nyid kyi sku gong ma'i sbyin bdag gi dwangs ma yin gshis 'byon rgyu'i zhal len thag chod gnang / nyi shu gsum la sbyin bdag pe zi pho brang du phebs rgyur lam chos su khro bo 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi rjes gnang stsal/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gi dgung lo bdun cu'i 'khrungs skar gyi dga' ston la rten 'byung gi 'bul ba gya nom pa dang chabs gcig par/ 'gyur med lhan skyes bde ba chen po'i gar/ / dag pa'i brtan g.yo cir yang 'char ba'i 'phrul/ / ston mdzad dang po'i mgon dang dbyer med pa/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mo'i drung / / 'gro ba'i phan bde'i chu skyes 'dab ma brgyar/ / grol byed dam pa'i nyi ma sngon rabs grar/ / legs byas rang 'od 'byin pa'i me khyer gzugs/ / rtarma badz+ra bdag gisamachid 'di gsol/ / zhes sogs dgyes pa'i mchod sprin du 'gyur ba'i zhu yig zab cing brling la snyan ngag gi rgyan du mas spras pa sdeb spyor dang bcas pa zhig 'a bul bar phyag mdzod shi dar nang so'ang pe zi dang lhan du gtong bar mdza da/ de'i phyi nyin nas mi rin sin pe lig dang tha'i ji pur god tha'i ji ma hā bā la rnams kyis rang rang gi khyim du gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus/ ma hā bā la'i khyim du tshogs pa mang por sor 'brang ma'i rjes gnang stsal/ nyi shu bdun nas ho sho'u thun mong gi rim gror khros nag mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i gtor zlog btsugs te nyi shu dgu la rje nyidakyis gtor zor 'phen pa gnang / der dgug gzhug gi skabs thams cad kyis mthong bar 'tshub ma mang po phyogs phyogs nas 'ongs te shog ling la 460

༄7/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /thim 'gro ba lta bu byung zhing / rje nyid kyi mnal lam la'ang mi ro phyed tshig pa dang yongs rdzogasartsag nas sol bar song ba sna tshogs shig mi nag po lcags kyi khyem thogs pa zhig gis phyogs gcig tu spungs nas 'jog pa'i thugs mis byung ba rnams ni mngon spyod gnad du song ba'i mtshan mar mngon/ gnam gangal pe zi'i gzhung nas zhabs phyi pa rnams la bags rtsag re gnang zhing rje nyidanas kyang sku'i gam du bcar sdod kyi tog can bcu gcig dang de mchi lnga gnyer ba sogs ser skya lnga bcu skor la go bab kyi gnang sbyin stsal/ lo mjug 'dir har chin ho sho'u lnga dang / o'u han na'i man sogs thag nye ring gi ho sho'u so so nas wang gung tha'i ji tha bo nang blon chen mang pos mi sna ched mngags dang / ho ra'i nye 'khor gyi dpon blon sbyin bdag so so nas gsol tshigs la sha dang shing tog tshod ma rigs mi 'dra ba dang 'bras dang gro phye sogs za ma'i bye brag sna tshogs 'bul mkhan zam ma chad du byung / dgung lo lngabacu pa me rta'i lo gsar tshes kyi nyin pe zi'i a ma dang btsun mo ho ro yas masakyi dpon blon che phra dgon pa'i bla ma dka' ram grwa ba mang pos gzim gshaganas lo gsar gyi mjal kha zhus/ sbrul gyi dus su nyi 'dzin byung bar dmigs bsal gyi bzlas sgom gnang pe zi'i yā mon du gdan drangs nas lo gsar gyi dga' ston zhus thog maṇ+ḍal kha btags tshe lha'i sku brnyan nor bu don yod zhags pa bcas phul te rten 'brel bsgrigs/ tshes gnyis la nyid dpon slob kyis dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i dam tshig bskang gso gsungs/de nas sbyin bdag mang pos rim pas gdan drangs te bsnyen bkur 'bul nod zhus par tha'i ji bka' 'gyur skyabs ca khir chi mi 'gyur ja lang dkon mchog thugs rje gsum gyi skor la rim pa bzhin tshe dbang dang sgrol ma'i mngon rtogs dang bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi lung phyag rdor gtum po khyung lnga'i rjes gnang 461

༄/ /yo thang ba na pa'i nalo gsung ཿma/sdug bsngal sel ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs kyi lung gdugs dkar gyi rjes gnang rnams stsal/ grwa tshang bla ma ngag dbang bkra shis khu dbon la klu dbang rgyal po'i rjes gnang / ṭā phu bla ma rdo ram pa ngag dbang shes rab la dbal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs kyi rjes gnang bcas stsal/gzhan yang pe zi'i nu bo tha'i ji yar 'phel mi rin ji rang thas ja lang zla ba bzang po ja lang sangs rgyas skyabs ja lang sin o ye thu ja lang thub shin ja lang po yan ar bid hu ja lang rab brtan ja lang rnam rgyal cang ki pad rang gos/ cang ke ho co li dka' bcu ngag dbang bkra shis tho yon shes rab dar rgyas dge slong ba yan nang so shag sha pad thu ped dge slong bcas gdan 'dren pa so so'i gshag tu rang rang gi 'dod chos kyi char phab cing gzim gshag nas kyang snga phyir nyan mkhan mang nyung ci rigs la lung khrid sogs bka' chos thor bu mang du gnang / bsgrub bya nyer brgyad la dge bsnyen sum brgya bcu bzhi la rab byung brgya go gsum la dge tshul nyis brgya nga dgu la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa'i bka' drin bskyangs nas tshangs spyod kyi dpal la bkod de thar pa'i rgyal mtshan mngon par bsgrengs/ tshes brgyad dang bco lnga bcu drug rnams la dgon pa'i cho 'phrul smon lam gyi gsung chos smon lam du gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs te gzhi byes kyi bla dpon blon 'bangs drag zhan gyi tshogs pa stong phrag du mar gsung chos su brgyad dang bco lnga'i nyin lam rim gyi bshad pa dang / bcu drug gi nyin bla ma'i rnal 'byor don gnyis lhun grub ma'i zab khrid/ smon lam gyi mgon du phebs nas spyi'i bsngo ba dang bde smon bstan 'bar ma sogs phyag len bzhin du gnang / nyid nas dge 'dun la mang 'gyed gya nom pa btang zhing sbyin bdag grwa rigs rnams kyis kyang 'bul nod rgya chen po btegs/ bco brgyad kyi nyin pe zi'i cu'un su me'i smon lam gye 462

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /tshogs dbur gdan drangs de ga'i dge 'dun rnams dang sbyin bdag tha'i ji grags pa rdo rje ye shes rdo rje sogs skya ser gyi tshogs pa stong phrag phyed gnyis tsam 'dus par gson gshin gyi don du bsngo ba dang bde smon dang bstan 'bar ma sogs mthun 'gyur dang bcas pa dkyus bzhin du gnang / cwa phu blas rab 'byams pa sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs grwa mang dang sbyin bdag rnams kyis gsol ston 'bul nod gzabs/ sbyin bdag har chen wang gi mi sna khā polan chi tā gung gi a ke dpal 'byor a ke pur+ṇa pā la spun gnyis wang gi lha khang gi dem chi sogs rim gyis 'byor te lo gsar gyi mtshams zhu phul/skabs 'dir lo gsar gyi mtshams zhur bla dpon che phra dngos dang tshab ci rigs zam ma chad du byung / u la su the g.yas g.yon gyi sbyin bdag rnams kyisagadan 'dren gyes snyan gsan phul yod pa bzhin tho yon chos rje ye shes dang tha'i rje dbang rgyal sogs mi drag 'ga' zhig u lā khyer 'ongs te bcu dgu'i nyin chibs bsgyur gnang / lo'u tang gor lo dbu lag chid kyi grong sde so sos ja zhus thog skye bo brgya phrag mang po la phyag dbang chos 'brel sogs gnang / lha khang la mi zhu par phan bde'i gling zhes btags/ lar dag dngadage slong dkon mchog nyi ma so so'i gshag dang ha dar gyi lha khang las bu'i lha khang rnams su rim pas babs te ser skya thams cad kyi 'dod pa skong bar mdzad/ las bu'i lha khang la ming zhus par dpal 'bar gling zhes btags/ tha'i ji dharma tā ti dang ma hā pā la sogs rta pa bco lnga skor chibs bsur 'byor/ thu sa lag chi yar 'phel gyi lha khang du dge 'dun gyi ser sbrengs dang bcas phyag phebs/ dad 'dus kyi mjal ba nyis stong brgal bar phyag dbang dang gzungs sngags bsgrags pa sogs dkyus bzhin gnang /'dir nyin kha shas bzhugs ring la sbyin bdag rnams kyis gdan drangs nas 463

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name' gsu 'bum/zhabasatog 'bul nod zhus par thu sa lag chi yar 'phel de la ge ring gos tha'i ji tha'i ji rnam sras tha'i ji dge 'phel gyi skor sogs la rim pa ltar bde mchog dkar po tshe dpag med klu dbang rgyal po bde mchog rnams kyi rjes gnang / tha'i ji badz+ra dang tha'i ji sin jo la tha'i ji dge ba'i dpal sogs kyi khyim dang thu sa lag chi'i lha khang rnying ba de la ge re gos tha'i ji'i lha khang tha'i ji rnam sras kyi lha khang rnams su lung khrid sogs 'dod chos thor bu rang rang gi mos pa bzhin sul/ lha khang rnying bar bde ldan bsam 'grub gling dang rnam sras kyi lha khang la bkra shis 'bar ba'i gling zhes pa'i ming btags/nyin bzhin dad ldan gyi skye pho mo shin tu mang po mjal khar 'dus par phyag dbang chos 'brel gyis tshim par mdzad/ sbyin bdag pe zi tshe brtan bkra shis pe cing nas phyir slebs te mjal kha zhus nas tshe lha'i sku brnyan dang nor bu don yod zhags pa sogs rten 'brel gye rdzas 'ga' zhig phul/ nyer drug gi zhog ka 'du khang du thu sa lag chi yar 'phel sogs tha'i ji rnams dang tho yon chos rje ye shes dang hu pe la gan ye shes chos bzang sogs lha khang gi grwa mang dang / sbyin bdag drag zhan ser skya sum stong tsam la spyi chos su spyan ras gzigs mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang bcas pa'i dbang smin rgyas su stsal/sbyin bdag grwa rigs rnams kyis so so nas gang 'byor gyi bdog pa spel/ de nas tsong u la su the la bla dpon mang pos skyel bsu dang bcas chibs bsgyur gnang ste tha'i ji dharma dha tu'i khyim du phyag phebs/ dad 'dus kyi mjal ba nyis stong nye bar phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang / phyi nyin de ga'i lha khang du ser skya'i tshogs pa stong phrag brgal bar phyag dbang bka' chos dkyus ma'i skor bzang spyod kyi lung stsal/ tā tha'i ji'i lha khang gi bla grwa rnams dang tha'i ji a tsa ra tha'i ji ma hā bā la so sos gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur dang chos 464

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /'brel zhus tā tha'i ji ye ned khe'i khyim du bzhugs/ lo dgu bcur nye ba'i jo mo gsum gyis tshe g.yang phul bar mtshan dang gzungs sngags rna lam du bsgrags/ phyi nyin tā thu'i ji sogs de ga'i tha'i ji rnams dang grwa rigs sbyin bdag chig stong lnga brgya skor la spyi chos su rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang stsal/ spyi mang gis 'bul ba phul/ de nas pā rin grong pa'i po rong gos dang pu lag chid kyi ja lang a chi thu cang gi ma hā ra ti el deb rnams kyis rang rang gi khyim du gdan drangs nas spyi sger gyis 'bul nod dang chos 'brel zhus/yu sun bu lug gi lha khang 'bub rgyu'i gnas gzigs mdzad/ las had g.yas g.yon gyi chi shi bā dang khun tu po yan ta la'i khyim du skya ser gyi tshogs pa bzhi brgya tsam la mdo sdud pa'i lung gnang zhing der bzhugs/ nyer dgu la khun tu bsod nams dang i la go tshan so sos khyim du gdan drangs pa'i don mdzad cing hwa' shing zer ba'i lo brgyad cu gya drug lon pa zhig gis tshe g.yang phul bar mtshan dang gzungs sngags bsgrags/ bad cha gan the'i lha khang du tho yon dka' bcu bstan 'dzin sogs skya ser gyi tshogs pa stong phrag phyed dang gnyis la sman chog bsdus pa dang mgon dkar gyi gtor chog sogs chos tshan 'ga' zhig gi lung gnang lha khang spo rgyu'i gnas gzigs mdzad/ de nas pe zi'i dgon par phyag phebs zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la pe zis yā mon du gdan drangs/ pe zi tshe brtan don grub dus las 'das pa'i nyin skar dang bstun nas kun rig gi cho ga gsung / sngar lcang skya rin po che'i 'khrungs skar gyi dka' ston du btang ba'i mi sna rnams 'byor nas zhu shog gi lan phul ba gzigs te/ zhal nas lcang skya rin po che'i gsung gi dbyibs sngar dang mi 'dra ba zhig 'dug pa ci yin gsung / a lag shā wang gi mi sna sa ban don yod dang mkhar sngon tham ka bla ma'i mi sna gnyer ba 'jam dpal rnams 'byor 465

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/nas yar lam rang rang gi gnas su gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul bar wang gi mi sna la sku rim sgrub rgyu'i rim pa rnams bla ma gzhan zhig la sgrub tu 'jug pa'i zhal bkod gnang / bod dang a mdor skur rgyu'i yi ge bsgrigs shing 'di lo bla ma byams pa'i sprul sku dang har chin tho yon mthu stobs nyi ma gnyis lha ram pa'i gtong sgo gtong rgyur dngos po'i mthun rkyen phon che tsam bskur ba gnang / slob ma sbyin bdag 'ga' zhig gis gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus par dge legs nor bu'i skor dang tha'i ji rana'i skor la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang dang sgrub thabs kyi lung / tha'i ji bkra shis tshe ring tha'i ji ma hā pā la tha'i ji gaste ja lang nan chung ja lang 'jam dbyangs ja lang thu ge sel ja lang sha jin ja lang ār+ya ja lang mus le bu thug chi cang gi thog tho mo lo rnams kyi khyim dang / tho yon chos 'od zer gyi lha khang rnams su 'dod chos thor bu so so'i mos pa bzhin yid tshim par gnang / tshes bcu'i nyin dpon mo dkon mchog dpal mo dang bsod nams dpal bzang gnyis kyis zhus ngor mi drag nyung 'dus lanā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sibyu ra'i byin rlabs bka' drin stsal dpon mo gnyis kyis dbang yon gzabs/ 'di nyin nas dka'abacu bstan dar dang nang so rgya mtsho sogs kyis zhus ngor skya ser drag zhan brgya phrag mang po la 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi gdams pa'i bka' babs grags che ba lnga'i yogyal gnyan tshem bu pa nas brgyud pa tshem bu dmar khrid du grags pa'i gdams ngag zab mo bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len tshang pa'i zab gnad du ma dang bcas nyin gsum gyi ring gsung bshad zab cing rgya che ba stsal te snod ldan gdul bya'i rgyud kyi yol go man ngag nor bus phyur bur gtams/ gzhan yang dka' bcu ngag dbang don grub kyis zhus pa bzhin rdo rje sems dpa'i rjes gnang dang tor ma brgya rtsa'i khrid rgyal dbang 466

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bskal bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i sgrung gnas cho ga'i lung de'i phyag len dang dmigs rim gyi khrid/ gzhan yang zhu mkhan so so'i ngor lam sgron dang thun drug rnal 'byor 'jam dbyangs zhi khro sbrags sgrub sogs lung thor bu du ma bcas gnang / ho sho'u'i spyi chos su lam rim gyi khrid sems bskyed mchod pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang chen rnams zhus par zhal bzhes gnang yod pa bzhin/ bcu bzhi'i nyin dgon pa'i 'du khang du sbyin bdag pe zi ma bu rnams kyis gtsos ho sho'u'i dpon dpon mo blon 'bangs rnams dang /dgon pa'i bla grwa tshang ma bcas ser skya'i khrom khri phrag brgal bar spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang gi sta gon dang / bco lnga'i nyin dbang gi dngos gzhi gnang ste zhing mchog bde ba can po ta lar bgrod pa'i gzhung lam yangasapor byas/ bcu drug la bkwan tung shi re thus zhus ngor skya ser sum brgya tsam la 'jam dpal nag po'i rjes gnang stsal/ bsgrub bya brgyad dge bsnyen dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi tshangs par spyod pa'i brtul zhugs la bkod/ bcu bdunanas dgon pa'i 'du khang du dgon pa'i bla ma dge 'dun pe zi ma bu rnams dang ho ro'i dpon dpon mo blon 'bangs phyogs nas 'dus pa'i bla ma dka' ram gu thi sogs bka' chos don du gnyer mkhan ser skya sum stong tsam la dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam po che byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i dmar khrid bde lam gyi bka' chos dbu btsugs te nyin rer chos thun yun ring po re gnang ste nyi shu'i nyin sbyor ba'i chos drug grub pa'i mtshams su har chin wang gi mi rin bstan 'dzin gye nad gzhi bab lce bar wang la zhus te khā rdor rgyal gdan 'dren du btab zhing mi rin kyang snga ma nas skyabs btsal ba'i sbyin bdag yin pas mi 'byon kha med byung bar bshes gnyen bsten tshul man chad har chin nas phyir phebs nas gnang rgyu byas te 467

༄/ /gung bang bstan ba'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/lam rim gyi bka' chos mtshams mdzad/ em chi blo bzang sbyin pas gshag tu gdan drangs nas gsar bzhengs kyi rten mang por rab gnas zhus/ di yān chi ngag dbang dge legs kyis zhus ngor skya ser brgya phrag kha shas la bla ma'i rnal 'byor dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid 'pho khrid dang bcas gnang /gdan 'dren pa brel ba che na'ang skabs 'dir pe zi'i ho sho'u nas yong god kyi smon lam bla ma lha ram pa rdo rje snying po bur han thu'i ku thi 'od zer tho yon dge legs rab rgyas sogs grwa ba nyi shu skor rje nyid kyi gsung 'bum gyi lung nyan par che gtad kyis 'ongs shing cwa phu tā bla ma sbyin pa dar rgyas kyis kyang snga ma nas nan tan zhus yod pas nyi shu gcig nas zhu ba bo rnams kyis gtsos sngar gyi chos nyan pa byings bcas bla dpon ser skya nyis stong nye bar rje nyid kyi gsung 'bum gyi lung dbu btsugs nas nyin rer chos thun yun ring ba gnyis re gnang zhing / sangs bar du bla ma dka' ram che gras la gsung bka' rgya ma'i lung gnang ste nyer bzhi'i nyin lung grub par mdzad/ nyer lnga la drag zhan mang po'i bsu skyel gyi spros pa dang bcas pe zi'i ho ro nas thon hwa' shing tha'iji'i grong sde dang pā rin dka' bcu gsung rab nyi ma sogs kyis gdan drangs pa'i don mdzad thu sa lag chi yar 'phel gyi khyim du bzhugs/ nyer drug la thu sa lag chi sogs skya ser mang po la 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i sgrub thabs sogs kyi lung dang tha'i ji tshe dbang gi khyim du sgrol dkar gyi lung gnang / cha gan gol du yo'u han zan pe zi sogs dpon blon lnga bcu skor mjalache 'ongs o'u han the'i ji dpal 'byor dang har chin ha ba na bstan 'dzin gnyis kyi khyim du rim par zhag bab gnang / cho'u thu'i ri khrod gong mar su bil gān sirnyi pā la sogs kyis 'dod chos zhus pa'i re ba skang /cho'u thu'i dgon par zhabs drung bod du slob gnyer la song yod pas gzhis 468

༄༅/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /sdod kyi chos rje nang so sogs kyis gsol ston 'bul nod gzabs shing dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid zhus pa bzhin stsal/ lo'u hu'i chu chen du wang chen mo nas rje nyid phebs rgyur ched dmigs kyi zam pa gsar du 'jog dgos tshul yul mi rnams la bkod khyab mdzad pa bzhin so so nas shing cha sogs bsdus te zam pa brtan po btsugs yod pa'i steng nas byon/ zam pa las mi rnams la gnang sbyin dang rna lam du mtshan dang gzungs sngags bsgrags nas bsngo smon mdzad/ kun dga'i khyim du skya ser gyi khrom la phyag dbang sogs gnang zhing der bzhugs/ de nas sbyin bdag chin wang dang tā gung yab sras kyis gtsos dpon blon du ma'i chibs bsu rim pa mang po dang bcas gnam gang gi nyin wang gi be+e mon du 'byor/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gcig gi nyin sbyin bdag wang gi tsha bo maci badz+ra la 7gong ma'i tsha mo ke ke gnang ba gsar du 'byor yod pas a ke dang ke ke gnyis kyis yid bzhin 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu res thog drangs rten 'byung gi 'bul ba dang bcas phyag dbang zhus/ sngar shi dar nang so lcang skya rin po che'i 'khrungs skar la mngags dus rje nyid nas lca skya rin po che la ri bo rtse lngar mjal nas bka' chos 'ga' zhig gsan bzhed yod tshul zhus par bzhed don ltar 'grub dka' tshul gnang ba bzhin da res wang pe cing nas yong dus lcang skya rin po che nas rje nyid rang yul du 'byon rgyu'i phebs rdzongs su gser zangs las bsgrubs pa'i tshe dpag med kyi sku khru gsum pa gcig tshe dpag med kyi bris thang che ba gcig mdzod gos spus legs yug bzhi 'go snam dmar ser gyon 'dangs gnyis wa nag dang bu la gan bubs bcu gcig dngul srang lnga brgya kha btags chos 'don bcu bag lnga bka' shog dang bcas bskur ba gnang ba rnams wang chen mo nas rtsis 'bul zhus/ de nas nyin bcu lhag gi ring 'dir bzhugs te mi rin bstan 'dzin 469

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgron 'i gsung 'bum/la rkyen sel gyi rim gro 'ga' zhig bsgrubs kyang phan skyed med par rim lod kyis bab byu bar song ba na rna lam du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang gzungs sngags zab mo yang yang bsgrags shing dus las 'das pa'i rjes su nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang 'brel bar lho sgo dang 'pho ba sogs gnang ste ngan song gi skye sgo bkag nas mngon mtho nges legs kyi lam la sbyar/ nyin gsum gye ring cho ga dang smon lam sogs gsungs te mjug tu nye 'brel shul na gnas pa rnams la bkra shis pa'i phyir khyim du dge mtshan spel pa'i cho ga mdzad/mi rin sho'u mar spun gsum gyis bsngo rten 'bul ba'ang gzab rgyas phul/de dus dgon lung ba hor dum ngag dbang tshul khrims zer ba'i sgyung gnas rgyun du srung mkhan gyi bla rgan zhig har chen du yod par sngar wang zhabs drung gis lta rtog gnang gi yod kyang zhabs drung rang yul du thon rjes rje nyid nas harachin wang gi skyed tshul du sdod bcug ste 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen gnang nas sgyungaganas bsrung yod pas gzugs po cung zad ma bde bar nyin gcig rje nyid nas blo bur du nged rang hor dum bla rgan gyi nad 'dri la 'gro dgos pa 'dug ces kho'i sdod gnas su phebs bar/ bla rgan dga' drag nas bka' bsgo zhus pa gnang zhing mjug tu mtshan dang gzungs sngags zab mo rna lam du bsgrags/ sgyung gnas bsrung ba'i phan yon sogs dad pa gsos 'debs kyi bslab ston mang po gnang ste tshur 'khor nas bzhugs gnas su glebs dus bla rgan kyang gshegs song bas/ de'i gnas tshul phyis su wang zhabs drung rin po ches gsan te ma cig gi lung bstan du/ zla ba rgyal mtshan mdo khams smad du 'byung / / zer ba rje nyid yin par dam pa 'ga' zhig gis gsung 'dug pas bla rgan gyis sgyung gnas mang po bsrungs pas spyan ras gzigs dngos kyis rjes su bzung ba red gsung 'dug / wang yum sras rnams la phyag rdor 470

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /drag po sum dril dang dpal mgon zhi ba'i rjes gnang stsal/ bcu bzhi'i nyin slar yang rim gyis thu med du chibs bskyod de bcu drug gi nyin bka' 'gyur su me'i hu thal gan gyis gdan drangs thog ja sag gung gi shog thu sa lagachi ching thog tho hu dang gung gi nu bo ma hā yā na e phu dkon mchog rgyal mtshan sogs dpon blon mang po mjal du 'ongs/ ha sa dag dang per khe nu chu gun rnams kyi bla dpon mang po rim gyis 'byor nas rang rang gi gnas su gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul/ hu pi la gan gtsos skya ser nyis brgya skor lasgol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang ser skya'i khrom mang po la phyag dbang sogs gnang / bcu bdun la khus the sun lha khang dang ha'i dag gi tā bla ma ngag dbang rin chen gyi lha khang du gdan drangs pa'i don mdzad cing ha'i dag gi yi khe su me la bzhugs/ ser skya sum stong tsam la bla mchod dang bar do'i 'phrang sgrol gyi lung phyag dbang bcas gnang / lha khang la ming zhus par phan bde dar rgyas gling zhes btags/ nu chu gun gyi thu sa lag chi sin cing thu sogs tha bo nang bdun dang per khe'i lha khang gi tā bla ma dang tha bo nang 'ga' zhig do lon no bur gyi tha bo nang kha shas bcas rim pas chibs bsu zhus/ bco brgyad la hu pil gan ye shes dpal 'byor gyi lha khang du phyag nas 'thor zhing ming zhus par 'gro phan dam chos gling zhes btags/ hu pi la gan bsod nams rgya mtsho ma 'tsho bas grwa pa rnams kyis lha khang gi nye 'dabs nas gsol ja dang bsngo rten phul bar ljags bsngo gnang lha khang la ming zhus par dge rgyas lha khang zhes btags/ char su the'i lha khang du ti yān chi rdo rje dang tha bo nang payan tshang sogs spyi mang gis gdan drangs nas spyi chos su 'jigs byed kyi rjesaganang zhus pa bzhin tshogs pa nyis stong tsam la rjes gnang phyag dbang bcas gnang / mi 'ga' zhig dge bsnyen bsgrubs per khe'i su me la 471

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/bzhugs shing tā bla ma nam mkha' gzugs gzhi ma bde bar rnam 'joms kyi sgo nas bkru byabs srung gsum mdzad/ dge bsnyen dang dge bsnyen ma'i sdom pa zhu mkhan kha shas byung ba'i 'dun pa bskang zhing skya ser stong phrag nye bar phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang / bcu dgu la tha bo nang a mo gha sirnyi'i khyim du gdan drangs pa'i don mdzad de rim gyis skyel bsu mang po dang bcas nu chu gun du 'byor/ tha bo nang a nan+ta spun gsum gyis gdan drangs nas chos 'brel zhus/ bla dpon mang pos sna drangs pa'i skya phreng ser 'phreng dang bcas hu bi la gān tā bla ma thub bstan dar rgyas kyi gshag tu babs/ tha bo nang dam chos sogs kyis rang rang gi khyim du gdan drangs nas 'byor 'khos kyibasnyen bkur dang bdog pa yod 'bul lta bu nus pa rnams so sor 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ thu sa lag chi sin cang thu'i khyim du bla dpon ser skya nyis stong brgal bar sgol lngang gi rjes gnang dang ba ku la nang so'i gshag tu skya ser nyis brgya tsam la khyung khra'i rjes gnang nang so blo bzang dge 'dun la bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid lung / lha khang du dan pe zi'i ho sho'u'i grwa pa 'ga' zhig gis zhus ngor ser skya brgya phrag mang po la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang rnams stsal/ pho mo nyi shu rtsa gsum dge bsnyen pha ma dang rab byung sogs su bsgrubs/ hu bil gan tā bla ma thub bstan dar rgyas kyi 'dod mos bzhin nyan mkhan bcu skor la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang gnang khong gis maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gyis sna drangs te dngos gtsang ba'i 'bul ba gya nom pa brtan bzhugs lugs su phul/'dir nyin gsum bzhugs ring la dad 'dus kyi skye pho mo khri phrag nye ba phyag dbang chos 'brel gyis tshim par mdzad/ thu med pe zi'i ho'i sho'i tha'i ji ma hā ba la dang ja lang gsum cang gi khun tu u la mi u yā dang bcas 'byor par 472

༄7/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /har chin wang gi skyel mi rnams yu lā shing rta dang bcas phyir slog / nyi shu gnyis la de ga'i bla dpon mang po'i chibs skyel dang bcas thon nu chu gun ho tho'i dge slong lhun grub kyi lha khang dang de ga'i spyi mang gi lha khang du rim par phebs te mjal ba rnams la phyag dbang sogs gnang / dge slong lhun 'grub kyis lha khang la ming zhus par bkra shis dge 'phel gling zhes btags/thu med pe zi'i sa sne khus then ho sho'i grong sde dang dka' bcu thub dbang bstan 'dzin gyi lha khang bu lag thu'i tha'i ji chos 'phel sogs kyis khyim du gdan drangs pa bzhin rim pas babs nas so sor 'dod chos dang phyag dbang gis tshim par mdzad ja lang tshe ring gi khyim du bzhugs/ nyer gsum la u shin grong pa'i tha'i ji stobs chen gyi khyim du skya ser nyis brgya skor la sman chog bsdus pa'i lung dang du rul gyin grong par skya ser lnga brgya skor la sgrol ma dkar ljang dang khyung khra'i sgrub thabs kyi lung gnang / thu sa lag chi the gu su chog thu la phyag rdor gtum po khyung lnga'i rjes gnang dang gsar bzhengs byams pa'i sku brnyan la rab gnas rta thog ma mdzad/ tha'i ji don grub kyi khyim du skya ser nyis brgya skor la gtor ma brgya rtsa dang chab gtor sogs kyi lung dang tha'i ji mi ngag thu'i khyim du tshogs pa nyis stong tsam la klu dbang rgyal po'i rjes gnangasnal cing der bzhugs/ nyi shu bzhi'i nyin tā pā shing du yul ji zer ba'i rgad po lo brgyad cu gya lnga lon pa zhig gis gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur dang skyabs 'jug zhus par mtshan dang gzungs sngags bsgrags par mdzad/phyagadabang zhu mi nyis stong tsam byung / grong pa de ga'i thor ba ma thar pa'i byis pa bcu lhag tsam gyis skyabs btsal bar sna tshogs yum gyi bka' bsgo gnang / kheb the jo bo'i lha khang du gdan drangs thog dge bshes bla ma skal bzang bzod pa slob gnyer bzang zhing lo brgyad cu brgal bas gsung gling 473

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/mang du 'phel/ chi ba ga thu'i dge slong shes rab kyis ri khrod la ming zhus par phan bde dar rgyas gling zhes btags/ lha khang gi bla grwa rnams kyis gtsos pas tshogs pa stong phrag gsum la mdo sdud pa'i lung gnang / de nas a nan bu lug gi lha khang du chos rje brtson grus dang tā tha'i ji gaste sogs skya ser gyi tshogs pa sum stong nye bar tshe dpag med kyi rjes gnang dang 'jam dpal nag po'i sgrub thabs kyi lung gnang / nyer lnga la grong ba de ga'i tā tha'i ji gar+bhe dang tha'i ji bsod nams dar rgyas cing ki skal bzang bā la rnams kyis rang rang gi khyim du gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs nas gang zhus kyi re ba skong bar mdzad/ bkra shis 'byung lha khang du chos rje cho me ga dang tha'i ji ol jo bos sogs skya ser lnga brgya skor la rten 'brel bstod pa'i lung dang po ro ho sho'u'i grong bar chos rje ngag dbang sogs skya ser gyi tshogs pa lnga brgya skor la 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po'i lung gnang / khu beng the'i ar pin tshang / su'u ke'i grong sde spyi mang / chad men gyi chos skyabs/ ha ra'i bu lug gi stobs ldan rnams kyis rim pas gdan drangs par so so'i 'dod pa skong bar mdzad de mang nong kyi lha khang du bzhugs/ 'di nyin phebs lam du ja zhus mang ba dang snga phyi'i mjal ba drug stong brgal bar khrom tshogs so sor phyag dbang bka' chos dkyus ma'i skor chag med du gnang bas zhag sar nam gyi sum cha dang po rdzogs pa'i tshod tsam du 'byor/ de nub rlung 'tshub shin tu che zhing lam yang ngan pas 'phrang lam nas grwa ba zhig thog tshad gsum tsam yod pa'i dam grog cig tu lhung yang skyon cung zad kyang ma byung bas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur pa ni mo'u 'gal gyi bus khyim bdag dpal skyes g.yang kha nas lhung ba bskyab pa dang / g.yag ru'i skor tshom du rje btsun gyis ras chung ba g.yang sa las bskyab par bshad pa dang cha 'dra ba zhig yin par snang / nyer 474

ro༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /drug gi zhog ka rab 'byams pa blo bzang dar rgyas kyis zhus ngor ser skya sum stong nye bar rdo rje sems dpa'i rjes gnang stsal/ shel ded kyi dge slong nam mkhas gshag tu gdan drangs thog snyin bdag pe zi tshe brtan bkra shis 'khor bcas dang hu pe zi'i tsha bo a ke rat+na kiti ngo g.yog rnams chibs bsur 'byor/de nas rim gyis ar ban ger gyi ba yan the gu su dang bog lod kyi khun tu don grub sogs ja zhus pa 'ga' zhig gi don mdzad/ bsu ba dang mjal ba mang po'i spros pa dang bcas pe zi'i hor la phyag phebs/ phyi nyin nas sngar gyi lam rim gyi 'phro gnang bar ser skya drag zhan sum stong brgal ba la sbyor ba'i chos drugayan chad sngar gnang zin kyang chos nyan pa gsar ba yang mang po 'dus yod pas de dag la lam rim cha tshang du 'jug pa'i ched du mgo nas bshes gnyen bsten tshul dngos gzhi bar du sa bcad ma stong pa'i bshad pa mdor bsdus tsam dang / bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas bshad pa je rgyas su btang nas nyin rer chos thun yun ring po re gnang ste zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bzhi'i nyin mjug grub par mdzad/ tshes lnga'i nyin 'du khang chen mor sbyin bdag stobs 'byor can rnams kyis mchod pa rnam lnga dpag tu med pa bshams te sngar gyi chos nyan pa'i steng du dad 'dus kyi skye pho mo mang po bcas mi lnga stong tsam la sems bskyed mchod pa gnang ste dpon slob tshang mas bzang spyod dang byams smon bstan 'bar ma 'ur chems kyis gsung nas bsngo smon gyi mtshams spyor rgyas par mdzad/ bka' chos 'dir phyogs tha dad nas bla ma dka' ram dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po 'dus pa yin pas go ba skyed cing yid 'khul ba'i bshad pa rtsal 'don gnang bas thams cad blo sna chos su bsgyur tshab che zhing nang nas blo mchog tu gyur pa mang po rgyal pa'i bstan pa yongs rdzogs la nges pa gting tshugs pa'i bag chags khyad par can thebs pa byung /475

༄/ /gung thangabastan ba'ithonama' gsung 'bum/tshes drug la grwa tshang bla mas zhus ngor sngar gyi chos nyan pa rnams la bla ma mchod pa'i khrid mdor bsdus tsam dang gsang 'dus rgyud gzhung gi lung bcas chos thun gnyis la gnang / spyi sger so so nas chos yon kyang spam mtho ba btegs/sngar gyi bka' chos kyi sangs bar rnams su a ke rat+na kirtes zhus ngor lha mo ku ru kul+le'i rjes gnang / dka' bcu ye shes chos 'dzin gyis zhus ngor mgon po snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang dang mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid lung /di yān chi blo bzang ye shes kyis zhus ngor dam can gyi rigs gtad nyan mkhan nyung shas re la gsang stabs su gnang / cwa phu bla ma sbyin pa dar rgyas kyis gshag tu gdan drangs nas 'dod chos zhus pa'i re ba bskangs/ gur pan su por ga'i rgya dpon tshe dpag ched gtad kyis mjal du 'ongs par mjal phrad mdzad/ bkwan tung khu re'i shi re thu bla ma'i mi sna dem chi 'jam dbyangs smona'im ngo g.yog 'ongs nas khu re la gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul bar hor chin la 'byon zhor du phebs rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang / tshes bdun gyi nyin dka' bcu ye shes chos 'dzin la spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang dang nang so sbyin pa sogs grwa pa 'ga' zhig la dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i 'pho khrid gnang / tshes brgyad la dge bsnyen gnyis rab byung bzhi bcu zhe lnga dge tshul bzhi bcu zhe gnyis bsgrub par mdzad/ tshes dgu'i nyin bsgrub bya drug cu re bdun bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por bsgrubs te tshangs spyod yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpal la bkod/ har chin wang dang e phu bde legs bzang po gnyis kyis ched du mngags pa'i mi sna 'byor nas/7gong mas nyid gang du bzhugs pa yang yang bka' 'dri gnang gin 'dug pas hor chin la phebs rgyu bshol nas 7gong mar mtshams zhus shig byed dgos tshod snang la/ lcang skya rin po che yang sku shin tu bsnyel yod 'dug pas 476

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bsnyun 'dri la ri bo rtse lngar yang thog cig gi 'byon dgos tshul zhus par rje nyid nas thugs 'tsher chen po gnang ste/ lcang skya rin po che'i bskun zhu la ri bortse lngar 'gro rgyu'i bab 'brel yod na'ang mi lhas sogs gang thad la ba ltas na song yang mjal e thub mi shes pa 'dug / 7gong ma'i mtshams zhur song nas sna thag gzhan gyi lag tu 'jog don med/ hor chin du yang mi 'gro da ni mgyogs par rang yul du thon pa dga' gsung nas gong gsal gyi phyogs gang du'ang phebs rgyu'i spros pa ma gnang bar har chin du 'byon rgyur thugs thag bcad/ zhal slob nang ma 'ga' zhig gis mnal ltas ci 'dra byung zhus par dus phyis nub cig nged kyi rmi lam du rgya mkhar zhig gi srang bar lta bur khang ba chung du zhig tu nged dang 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa lhan du bzhugs 'dug pa la glo bur du lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa phebs nas nged thag ring po zhig tu 'gro ba yin pas khyed gnyis 'dir 'dug pa la dngos phrad du rib tsam 'ongs pa yin gsung kha btags ring po re gnang byung / nged nas lan du kha btags shig 'bul dgos bsams btsal pas phral du ma rnyed/ de'i ring la lcang skya rdo rje 'chang rgyang ring po zhig tu phebs song 'dug pas sems shin tu skyo ba zhig byung gsungs/ tshes bcu'i nyin dgon pa'i tshogs par mang 'gyed btang nas lcang skya rin po che'i zhabs brtan du bka' 'gyur sogs sku rim 'ga' zhig bsgrubs/ tha'i ji tā han tas sogs mi 'ga' zhig la dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang stsal/ bcu gcig la pe zi'i rim gror ku ru kul+le'i sbyin sreg gnang dpon mo u khin pas sogs mi drag sum cu skor la rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyi khrid stsal/ bcu gnyis la hor chin bsod nams stobs rgyas wang gi gdan 'dren pa rnams 'byor kyang lcang skya rin po che'i snyun 'dri la 'byon rgyu'i zol la bsnyad nas phebs mi thub tshul 477

༄/ /gung thang bstan bzlaname'i gsung 'bum/gye rgyu mtshan thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas gsungs pas el chi rnams kyis kyang bya thabs ma rnyed par phyir log / bcu gsum la pe zi dang a ke 'jigs med kun bzang ca khir chi phun tshogs rin chen sogs nye rigs tha'i ji rnams dang cwa phu bla ma gnyis hu pi la gān bla ma bcas bla dpon che gras skor la nyid nas gsol ston gnang ste phan tshun mthun dgos pa'i zhal bkod bslab ston gnang / bcu bzhi la pe zi ma bu rnams la lha mo 'od zer nan ma'i rjes gnang rtsal/ bco lnga'i nyin 'du khang chen mor gdan drangs nas brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te sbyin bdag pe zis dngul srang brgyad cu'i maṇ+ḍal sne 'dogs can sku gsung thugs rten gyis sna drangs/ bzhugs gdan rgyab yol ched gnyer gyis bsgrubs pa'i na bza' nyer spyad kyi skor tshang ma dngulasrang stong phrag gcig phebs byams khebs ldan dre'u gnyis bcas dang /gzhan yang ha thun e ji dang thas thas nye rigs pa'i ji dpon dpon mo sras sras mo so so nas dngos gtsang ba'i 'bul ba rnam grangs mang zhing rgya chen po phul/ 'dir 'dus pa'i ser skya'i tshogs pa sum stong brgal bar phyag dbang gnang / hor chin du phebs zhor la mong gol cin pe lis gdan 'dren zhu rtsis yin kyang der phebs ma byung bar pe lis ched mngags kyi mi sna dem chi blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang po'i tā su cug thu ngo g.yog 'byor nas rje nyid dgung lo lnga bcur phebs pa'i dga' ston du dngul srang sum cu'i maṇ+ḍal sne 'dogs can/ sku gsung thugs rten nor bu don yod zhags pa gos chen yug kha shas ri me che ba gcig khug ma sna tshogs sgam chung can dngul srang brgya 'bul rgyu bskur ba rnams phul/ pu lag thu'i cang gi bo yan del ger gyis gzimagashag nas bsnyen bkur dang kho rang gi lha khang la ming zhus par dge legs rab rgyas gling zhes btags/ nyi ma kha shas 'dir phebs rgyur nye bas 478

༄༅/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /ho ro yas mas kyi dpon dpon mo sogs sbyin bdag drag zhan mang pos gzim gshag nas gsol ja dang phebs rdzong 'bul mkhan lam ma chad pa byung /bco lnga'i phyi dro har chin wang gi mi sna 'ongs nas lcang skya rin po che zhing gzhan du dgongs pa gtad pa'i gnas tshul snyan du gsol te srang sum cu'i maṇ+ḍal kha btags bcas phul nas myur 'byon gsol 'debs shig gi ljags rtsom zhus pa phral du gnang / de'i tshe bla ma'i yon tan dang bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i stobs kyis thugs ha cang skyo drag pas gdung shugs bzod glags med pa 'khrungs te gsol ba 'debs pa'i mgur dbyangs shig thol byung du gsungs pa ni/ gnas dag pa mkha' spyod zhing khams nas/ / dpal te ru ka dang dbyer med pa'i/ / pha drin can rol pa'i rdo rje khyed/ / bu mgon med nyam thag bdag la dgongs/ / lo zil gnon me rta'i sa ga'i zla/ / tshes mig gi grangs nyin 'jam dpal gyi/ / gnas dwangs bsil lhun po rtse lnga nas/ / pha bla ma glo bur zhing gzhan gshegs/ / ris med pa'i bstan dang 'gro ba yi/ /phan bde ba'i srog gi rtsa ba chad/ / mtha' dbus su 'khod pa'i skye 'gro kun/ / mgon skyabs bral long ba thang skyur bzhin/ / sgos gang gi drin gyes 'tsho ba bdag / 'jigs che sar skyel mas por ba bzhin/ / pha 'bral thabs med pa khyed dang bral/ / drin bsam zhing gdung shugs me ltar 'bar/ / mchog thun mong dngos grub kun stsol pa'i/ / rje yid bzhin nor bu de ring stor/ / rgyud dge ba'i nor gyis stong pa yi/ / sprang bdag gi dbul ba su yis sel/ / nyon mongs pa'i tsha gdung sel byed pa'i/ / pha sprin gyi phung po dbyings su yal/ / rgyud tha ba skam po rlan byed pa'i/ / byin rlabs kyi gru char su la re/ / chos legs bshad 'od zer stong 'gyed pa'i/ /rje nyin byed dbang po zhing gzhan nub/ / rgyud ma rig mun pas ches sgrib 479

/ /gung bangabastanaba'ithoname'i ཿngababum/pa/ / sel byed kyi snang ba su yis stsol/ / sku'i ba sbu gcig tsam mchod pa yang / / dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas mchod pa las/ / ches lhag pa'i bsod nams zhing de stor/ / nga tshogs bsogs zhing mchog gang la byed/ / chos mdo rgyud dka' gnad dpyod pa'i tshe/ / blo the tshom sgro 'dogs mdud pa kun/ / gsung gcig gis bkrol ba'i mgon de gshegs/ / da dka' gnas dogs gcod su la 'dri/ / lam mdo sngags nyams len gnad 'gag dang / / gegs sel thabs bogs 'byin gdams pa kun/ / don 'khrul med 'doms pa'i bshes dang bral/ / da nyams rtogs brdar sha su la gcod/ / rkyen bar chad ngan pas gtses pa'i dus/ / mthu byin rlabs stobs kyis sel re ba'i/ / rje bla ma zhing khams gzhan du gshegs/ / da bdag gis rkyen sel su la re/ / 'chi nges pa'i nad kyis thebs pa'i tshe/ /gsung lhang lhang thos su re ba yi/ / pha bla ma dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ / nga phyi ma'i lam sna su yis 'dren/ / mi bdag gi khong pa'i nang gi snying / / rje bla ma mchog de glo bur stor/ / bu snying med 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon du/ / sdug bsngal gye cho nge 'debs 'di dgongs/ / mi bdag gi dpral ba'i dbyings kyi mig / pha thugs rje can de zhing gzhan gshegs/ / bu blang dor lta ba'i mig long bas/ / gnas ngan 'gro'i g.yang kha 'grim 'dir dgongs/ / zhal mjal res brtse ba'i gzigs stangs mdzad/ / phyag 'jam zhing mnyen pa spyi bor bzhag / gsung snyan pas blang dor 'doms pa de/ / da mthong thos bral bas yid re skyo/ / 'brog nyam ngar lus pa'i bu chung gis/ / rang ma la 'o dod 'bod pa ltar/ / mgon skyabs bral dharma badz+ra bdag / yid gdung ba'i shugs kyis smre ngag shor/ / mgon khyed la brtse ba'i spyan mchis shing / /rgyud ring nas gsan pa'i snyan mnga' bas/ / gnas dag pa'i zhing khams 480

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /gar bzhugs kyang / / nyam thag pa'i gdung dbyangs 'di dgongs shig /yul phyogs 'di'i gdul bya ma lus pa/ / mgon skyabs dang bral ba'i ngang tshul 'di/ / pha khyed kyi thugs rjes ma dgongs sam/ / nged yal bar 'dor ba ci ltar rigs/ / sngon dus mtha'i bstan 'gro'i don mdzad par/ /thugs bskyed cing dam bca' mdzad pa bzhin/ / deng myur du mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i/ / zhal bdag cag mig gi bdud rtsir ston/ / khong gnam sa'i dbang phyug gong ma che'i/ / dpal bstan srid zung 'brel rgyal mtshan rtser/ / mgon khyod zhabs nor bu legs bkod nas/ / ris med pa'i bstan 'gror phan bde stsol/ / skyabs bsru med dkon mchog byin rlabs dang / / ma mkha' 'gro chos skyong mthu stobs dang / / las rgyu 'bras rten 'brel bden stobs kyis/ / don smon pa yid bzhin 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di ni ris su ma chad pa'i bstan 'gro yongs kyi phan bde'i rtsa lag gcig pu bka' drin 'khor mtha' ma mchis pa'i 'dren mchog dam pa khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams 'dul ba'i ched du gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim tshul bstan pa'i gtam thos ma thag tu mgon po gang gi bka' drin gyis nye bar 'tsho ba madharma badz+ra gyis gdung ba'i shugs kyis smre ngag thol byung du bton pa'o/ / zhes so/ /bla ma dran mgur de nyid kyi sgo nas gsol 'debs nan tan rgyun chags gnang bas nub gcig mnal lam la rdo rje 'chang de nyid byon nas thugs brtse ba'irnam pa'i dbu la phyag gis byil byil mang po dang 'gram par zhal sbyar te sems gdungs par ma byed gsung ba zhig byung bas/ rang gi mos gus kyis byung na bla mas nam yang 'bral ba med par rjes su 'dzin pa 'dug snyam du thugs la mos gus dang dgyes tshor tshad med pa 'khrungs/ bcu drug la rje 481

༄/ /gung thang bamaba'i napo༄ngangabum/nyid har chin du chibs kha gnang rgyur sbyin bdag pe zis dkar zas kyis bkang ba'i gsol phor kha btags srid du ring ba dang bcas phul nas rten 'brel bsgrigs/ nyid nas bzhugs gnas su bzhugs gdan rgyab yol rdo dril ṭā ma ru phebs byams rnying ba bcas rten du bzhag / dgon pa'i 'du khang du gsol ja zhus thog bla dpon ser skya brgya phrag mang po la lcang skya rin po che'i myur 'byon gsol 'debs dang dmigs brtse ma tshe gzungs rnams kyi ljags lung gnang ste rten 'brel gang legs kyis dgon pa nas thon/ sbyin bdagatha zis gtsos pa'i bla dpon drag zhan rta ba brgya phrag mang pos chibs skyeladang ja thab zhus/ jo bo'i lha khang du mjal mi stong phrag tsam la phyag dbang dang ko du ra hu'i lha khang du skya ser drug brgya tsam la skyabs khrid dang /lcang skya rin po che'i myur 'byon gsol 'debs kyi lung gnang zhing der bzhugs/ bcu bdun la grong ba de ga'i a yu shi dang rdo ram pa chos snying po sogs kyis rim pas gdan drangs par so so'i 'dod pa skong bar mdzad/theg su tshang thu'i khyem du bzhugs mjal mi chig stong brgal bar phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang / bco brgyad la ja lang tho nu mal dang sa na cha gon so sos khyim du gdan drangs pa'i don mdzad/ tha'i ji bla ma khu dang ca khir chi mi 'gyur em thu rab 'byams pa sogs chibs skyel ba mang po phyir log thu sa lag chi sin cang thu'i khyim du bzhugs/ bcu dgu la per khe'i bsod nams po ti'i grong ba'i bi tsho chi cang thu dang ja lang dge 'dun so sos gdan 'dren zhus har chin wang gi pur ga su the tshang la zhag bab gnang / nyi shu'i nyin cang ke bka' 'gyur skyabs/ thub pa skyabs tshe dbang skyabs cang ki bā ni rnams kyis rang rang gi khyim du gdan drangs par phebs/ nang so rin chen gyis lha khang la ming zhus par bde ldan bsam 'grub gling zhes btags ho rin 482

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /a yil gyi khun tu yu lem ci'i khyim du bzhugs/ snga phyi'i nyin gsum gyi mjal ba mang nyung ci rigs la phyag dbang sogs chag med du gnang / nyi shu gcig la de ga'i lha khang du dge slong tshe dpag sogs tshogs pa lnga brgya skor la dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i lung khrid dang lcang skya rin po che'i myur 'byon gsol 'debs kye lung gnang / ja sag sung nu bo gnyis dang go e phu chos e phu sogs dponablon du ma mjal du 'ongs/ khā ar pi ji hu dang jir ga lang sogs 'ga' zhig gis ja zhus byas/ pi chig thu tu bān la wang gi sras che ba don grub tshe brtan dang tha bo nang rdor skyabs sogs dpon blon 'ga' zhig dang /do'u zer ba'i rgya tshang du sbyin bdag wang yab sras dpon blon gye 'khor du ma dang bcas chibs bsur 'byor/ nyi shu gnyis la tā gung yab sras dang a ke pu r+ṇa bā la ngo g.yog gis chibs bsu thab bsu dang bcas gung gi yā mon du babs te gsol tshigs gnang / phu'u shu'u ha pan gyi khyim du shis brjod mdzad de rim gyis sbyin bdag wang gi yā mon du phyag phebs/ phyi nyin thu med zhabs phyir 'brang ba'i tha'i ji yar 'phel dang ja lang dkon mchog sogs drag zhan sum cu skor phyir log / ri bo rtse lngar lcang skya rin po che'i gdung mchod la nang so bstan 'gyur ched mngags gdong mchod pa'i thebs su dngul srang lnga brgya 'bul rgyu bskur/ char dkon par de ga'i chu mig cig tu phebs nas klu sman bcug cing / klu gtor btang bas char zim bu lan mang por babs/ nyi shu bdun la/ sbyin bdag wang 7gong ma'i ri dwags kyi sa cha lta skor la phebs rgyur phyag dbang bka' bsgo gnang / nyer brgyad kyi nyin mai rin deb cor dus las 'das par mkha' spyod ma'i lho sgo gnang / o'u han thul ga'i su me'i bla spyi nas ma ṇi sgrub rgyur gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsar yang yang zhus yod pa bzhin chos rje tshul khrims ngo g.yog 'ongs par lnga 483

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/pa'inyi shu tsam la phebs rgyu byas/ skabs 'dir ho ro'i mi rnams la rims nad cig mched yod par/ nyer dgu'i nyin spyi mang gi rim gror/ dpon slob kha shas kyis lha mo'i bskang gso dang 'azin bcol gnyer gtad gnang bas phral du chad de thams cad dga' bde'ijapal la bkod/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshesagacig gi nyin dbon gnas bde chen rab rgyas gling du phebs nas nyin bco lnga'i ring bcad rgya gnang ste zab mo'i rnal 'byor la gcig tu 'grus par mdzad/ thun mtshams su rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi sgrub thabs bdud dpung 'joms pa'i rdo rje'i sgom rim rta mchog rol pa'i dgongs rgyan lngags rtsom dang / bcu gnyis nas nyin gsum gyi ring la wang yum sras dang bcas par dge ldan phyag rgya chen mo'i khrid nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i gser chos bsam mi khyab kyi sdud rim mkha' 'gro'i gsang gtam gyi khrid sogs gsang zhing sbas pa'i man ngag du ma mnog chos su stsal/ bcu drug la wang yab sras dang lhan cig par yā mon du phebs nyi ma kha shas kyi ring phyogs nye ring nas mjal du 'ongs pa'i drag zhan mang po la phyag dbang ches 'brel gnang / sangs bar du wang yumasras rnams la dpal mgon rgyas pa dang dbang bde mchog dkar po rnam sras mdung dmar can rnams kyi rjes gnang stsal/ wang gi rim gror gdugs dkar zlog chen zhig bsgrubs/ o'u han thul ga'i su me nas dge bskos el deb dem chi rgyal ba nang so bzod pa sogs grwa pa bcu lhag dang ja lang yil go tshan khā a spo ta sogs tog can 'ga' zhig ul mi yu lag dang bcas gdan 'dren du 'ongs pa bzhin nyi shu gcig gi nyin bsu skyel gyi spros pa mang po dang bcas thon/ wang gis a ke i la go tshan dang khā a nan+ta sogs drag zhan nyi shu skor zhabs byur btang / tā gung gi ya mon du gung yab sras la lcang skya rin po che'i myur 'byon gsol 'debs kyi lung gnang zhing dge 484

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bsnyen ma gsum rab byung bsgrubs/ ja lang bstan 'gyur gyi khyim du yong nyod pe zi'i tā bla ma dka' bcu shes rab dang tho yon don grub tshe ring ngo g.yog mjal du 'ongs par 'dod mos bzhin rgyud bla ma dang bla ma mchod pa'i lung ser skya sum cu skor la gnang / da ra'i yoyil du na tsha mched yong bar khyim tshang rnams su gtor rgyu'i phyag nas gnang / lam zhor du gdan 'dren ba dang dad ldan gyi skye bo mang po la byin rlabs dang gsung gi bdud rtsi stsal bzhin phebs te nyer bzhi'i nyin o'u han gyis sne zin par thus lag chi wang gi ake tha'i ji bo yan chog cha dang dkon mchog yar 'phel sogs tha'i ji bcu lhag chibs bsur 'byor tha'i ji dkon mchog yar 'phel gyi khyim du bzhugs mjal pa bdun brgya tsam la phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang / 'di nyin phebs lam pu grong sde mang bas ja zhus mjal ba khrom tshogs tshan mang po byung b.raphyag dbang dang bka' chos dkyus ma chag med du gnang bas bye tshan gyi nang du dpon g.yog thams cad 'o brgyal che tsam byung / thul ga'i su me'i chibs bsu ba chos rje dge 'dun tshe ring dang tā bla ma chos grags sogs las sne grwa rigs mang po 'byor/ thu med tha'i ji gsang bdag rdo rje'i dpon mo ma 'tshams par bsngo rten 'bul mi byung zhing tha'i ji dkon mchog yar 'phel gye yab mes dpon po rnams kyi bsngo rten phul ba la lho sgo'i cho ga gnang / nyer lnga la tha'i ji'i rim gror tshe ring mched lnga'i gsol mchod btang / thu sa lag chi wang kho rang zhe hor du thegs nas med kyang ma dang yum sras rnams kyis yā mon du gdan drangs nas gsol tshigs dang phyag dbang bka' bsgo zhus/tshebartan e phu'i a ke khā thu sa lag chi dang e phu thu sa lag chi so so'i mi sna 'byor nas mtshams zhu phul/ khā yum skyabs dang tha'i ji ar bing hu tha'i ji bstan pa bkra shis khā sangs rgyas skyabs ja lang tshe ldan rnams kyis rang rang gi 485

༄/ /gu bang ba napa'izlanaḥgasungangabum/khyim du gdan drangs par mjal mkhan stong phrag du ma la phyag dbang chos 'brelaganang tshe ldan gyi khyim du bzhugs/ nyi shu drug la gung ji'i ke ken gyi sbyin pa'i khyim dang hu bi la gan shes rab bstan 'dzin gyi lha khang ke ken yā mon gyi lha khang rnams su rim pas gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus/ hu bil gān shes rab bstan 'dzin dang tā bla ma rtson 'grus sogs ser skya'i tshogs pa stong phrag brgal bar dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid lung gnang ke ken gyi lha khang la ming zhus par 'gro phan gling zhes btags mi rin sangs rgyas skyabs kyi khyim du skya ser mang po la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang dang lam rim gsol 'debs kyi lung mjal ba brgyad brgya skor la phyag dbang sogs stsal cing der bzhugs/ thul ga'i su me'i dge bshes bla ma ngag dbang blo bzang bo'u rul su me'i hu bil gan tā bla ma dang hu bil gān chos rje sogs lha khang so so'i bla ma las sne mang po dang tā mal tha'i ji rin chen sogs dpon po kha shas bcas skya ser bdun cu skor chibs bsur 'byor/ nyer bdun la ti yun chi bzod pa'i gshag tu skya ser drug brgya tsam dang mi rin tshe dpagaskyabs kye khyim du skya ser lnga brgya tsam la phyag dbang chos 'brel dang tshe dpagaskyabs gza' mi rnams la sgrol lngang gi rjes gnang stsal/ e phu thu sa lag chi dang e phu tshe brtan sogs dpon po 'ga' zhig chibs bsur 'byor tha'i ji 'chi med rdo rje'i khyim du bzhugs te gza' mi rnams la sdug bsngal sel ba'i sgrol ma'i rjes gnang stsal thul ga'i su me'i tā bla ma thub shin sogs grwa pa bcu skor 'byor/ nyer brgyad la er thas ye sogs dpon blon mang po dang tshe brtan e phu'i lha khang gi khri ba bla ma dang tā bla ma thul ga'i su me'i khri zur dang chos rje dka' ram mang po bcas rta ba brgyad cu skor chibs bsur 'byor/thul ga'i su me'i khri zur rab 'byams pa bsam gtan dang hu bil gan chos rje 486

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /tshulakhrims gnyis kyis gshag tu gdan drangs/ de nas thul ga'i su me'i nye 'dabs su mchod rdzas thogs pa'i dge 'dun brgya phrag mang po'i ser sprengs dang bcas thog mar 'du khang du gdan drangs nas gsol ja dkar spro'i thog blam dge 'dun rnams kyis phyag dbang zhus mjal ba shin tu mang bar phyag dbang sogs rgyas par gnang / ja sag wang thu sa lag chi wang zan pe zi thu shi gung rnams zhe hor du 7gong ma'i mtshams zhur phebs stabs so so'i mi sna rnams 'byor nas mtshams zhu phul/ nyer dgu'i nyin thag nye ring nas mjal du 'ongs pa'i drag zhan mang po'i re ba skong bar mdzad/ skabs shig glo bur du rlung gi 'tshub ma mun pa 'thib ba ltar byung bar rje nyid phyi log tu phebs nas rlung gi phyogs su zhal bstan nas spyan 'bur tshugs su gzigs te thugs dmigs shig gtad pas rlung 'jam du song ste char zim bu babs/gnam gang la tshe brtan e phus khyim du gdan drangs nas gsol tshigs zhus thog tshogs pa stong phrag nye bar phyag dbang sogs stsal/ de nas e phu'i a kes khang ba 'bub rgyu'i gzhi la phebs te gnas gzigs mdzad cing der bzhugs mtshan mo lus sbyin gyi spyan dmigs gnang / zla ba drug pa'i tshes gcig gi nyin gzhi gsar ba la bsang dang dkar gtor btang zhing dge mtshanaspel ba'i cho ga gnang e phus 'bul nod rgya che ba bstar/ phyir lam tha'i ji tshe dpag skyabs dang al than sang gnyis kyis khyim du gdan drangs ba'i 'dun pa bskangs/ tshes gnyis nas rje nyid kyis dbu mdzad de dge 'dunalnga brgya lhag gis ma ṇi ril bu nyin bdun bsgrubs shing de'i mu mthud nas nyi ma gnyis la bstan 'gyur gsungs/ mjug tu dge bshes bla ma sogs bla ma dge 'dun tshang ma dang sbyin bdag tha'i ji dbang phyug rab brtan dang a phu thu sa lag chi e phu tshe brtan thu med pe zi'i thas thas sogs gzhi byes 487

/ /gu bangab nar+sā nayo gsung 'bum/kyi ser skya drag zhan nyis stong brgal bar spyan ras gzigs mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang bcas pa'i dbang gnang / dge bshes bla ma ngag dbang blo bzang dang tha'i ji dbang phyug rab brtan sogs ma ṇi'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis bka' drin gtang rag g.yon du maṇ+ḍal sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol mchod rdzas 'ga' zhig dngul dang dong tshe srang stong phrag phyed gnyis rnga rta nyi shu rtsa bdun yid bzhin 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bcas yon 'bul rngams che ba btegs/ thu med pe zi'i thas thas nas kyang ched gnyer gyis bsgrubs pa'i dbyar gyi na bza' cha tshang ska rags khug ma phyag phyis sogs 'bul ba gya nom pa phul/ rje nyid nas tshogs par mang ja dang kha btags re dong tshe brgya re'i 'gyed gnang / ma ṇi bsgrub ring la nyin rer dad 'dus kyi mjal ba stongaphrag lhag re la phyag dbang dang bka' chos dkyus ma rnams chag med du gnang / thag ring nas ched gtad kyis mjal du 'ongs pa'i mi drag rnams la so so'i mos pa ltar gsung brtag bka' bsgo sogs kyis tshim par mdzad/rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi bsnyen yig dbang chen zhal bzang blta ba'i me long yang ljags rtsom gnang / bstan 'gyur gsar pa gtsos pa'i rten brten pa bcas par rab gnas mdor bsdus mdzad/ bla dpon 'ga' zhig gi 'dod mos bzhin snga phyir mang nyung ci rigs la 'jam dpal nag po dang gdugs dkar zhal phyag yongs rdzogs tshe dpag med seng ldeng nags sgol rnams kyi rjes gnang stsal/ tshes bcu'i nyin na'i man gyi dka' bcu dpal ldan rgya mtsho dang thu med ti yun chi sen khu'u gnyis kyis zhus ngor skal ldan nyung 'dus la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang dang bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid mdor bsdus tsam skog chos su stsal/ bcu gcig la dge bsnyen pha ma bcu bzhi rab byung pha ma brgya dang gcig dge tshul drug cu re lnga bsgrubs skya ser gyi tshogs pa nyis stong 488

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /tsam la phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang / tā bla ma dge 'dun skyabs kyis zhus ngor grwa pa gnyis brgya skor la rta mgrin chos skor nas le tshan 'ga' zhig gi lung gnang / bcu gnyis kyi zhog ka thu med thas thas ngo g.yog la sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang stsal bsgrub bya brgyad cu gya drug la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa phog / su nyid g.yon ru'i wang gi mi sna rab 'byams pa shes rab bzang bo ngo g.yog 'byor nas mdo smad du nam 'byon dus khong tsho'i yu lha har chin wang gi yā mon du glebs rgyu yin tshul zhus par bshol bdun pa'i tshes mgo tsam la yong chog tshul gnang / hor chin bsod nams stobs rgyas wang gi mi sna mi rin thog thol ngo g.yog 'ongs nas yang bskyar gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan nan tan zhus kyang rje nyid nas rang yul du mgyogs par phebs bzhed che bas zhal bzhes ma gnang / yo'u han gyi bla dpon mi tshang 'byor ldan sogs kyi khrod na rang rang gi khyim du gdan 'dren zhu mkhan shin tu mang yang lam zhor gyis phebs chog pa rnams ma gtogs mang mang la zhal bzhes ma mdzad/ bcu gsum gyi zhog ga e phu thu sa lag chi mi bskyod rdo rje la dam can gyi rigs gtad gnang ste thu la ga'i su me nas thon/ tha'i ji dbang phyug rab brtan dang ye phu thu sa lag chi sogs dpon po che phra mang pos skyel thung zhus chi nar thu dang tha'i ji dpal 'byor gyis khyim du gdan drangs/ thul ga'i su me'i chibs skyel pa tā bla ma chos grags dang chos rje gnyis sogs dka' ram dge bskos de mchi dge tshul slong lnga bcu skor gyis dgon pa spyi nas phul ba'i lam rim chen mo bris ma'i glegs bam dang dung dkar bcas phyag tu phul nas rten 'brel bsgrigs/ khā dge 'dun skyabs kyi ja zhus thog thu sa lag chi wang dang thu shi gung blon 'khor bcas chibs bsur 'byor thed ge lag gi lha khang du dad 'dus kyi mjal ba chig stong brgal bar phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang zhing 489

/ /gung ba na ba'izlanama'agasung 'bum/der bzhugs/ bcu bzhi la ja lang yil go tshan dang sho'u mar ol con rnams kyes rang rang gi khyim du gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur zhus/ ja sag pe zi'i mi sna tha'i ji yon tan dang pa khir gyi tā bla ma e phu tshe brtan tā mal tha'i ji rin chen sogs chibs bsu pa mang po zhig 'byor/ tā mal tha'i ji tshe dbang gi khyem du bzhugs shing tshogs pa mang por bla mchod kyi lung dang mjal ba mang po la phyag dbang sogs srul/ bco lnga la pa khir gyi lha khang du skya ser drug brgya skor la dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid lung dang man ju'i lha khang du skya ser nyis stong tsam la lam rim bde lam gyi lung gnang / khā a spo ta dang khun tu gol chi re'i gnyis kyis gdan drangs nas 'dod chos zhus pa'i re ba bskangs/ tha'i ji yar 'phel gyi lha khang du mjal ba stong phrag tsam 'dus par phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang zhing der bzhugs/ bcu drug la tha'i ji yar 'phel gyis khyim du gdan drangs te zhag bzhugs mdzad gza' mi rnams la tshe ring mched lnga'i rjes gnang dang mjal ba gnyis stong lhag la phyag dbang bka' chos gnang tha'i jis gzhis len 'bul nod gzabs/ mjal ba'i nang nas mi zhig gis khang ba gzhi gsar bar spo rgyu'i don skor du skyabs 'jug zhus pa la gzhi gsar ba'i rgyab tu dur zhig yod pa min nam zhes dris parasad tshul zhus shing yang tha'i ji yar 'phel gyis bu tsha gnyis la thor pa mthar pa yin ces skyabs 'jug zhus pa la gcig la snga ma thor ba bud med dam zhes dris par bud yod kyang thor ba yin min mi shes pa 'dug ces zhus pas der tshogs pa thams cad kyis ngo mtshar ba byung / bcu bdun la shar khu'i khā a nan+ta spun gsum gyis gdan drangs thog skya ser gyi khrom stong phrag brgal bar bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid lung gnang / pe zi sangs rgyas rgyal e phu dge 'dun rgyal pe zi bde ba'i rdo rje sogs ya mā thu'i dpon po che phra lha khang 490

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /so so'i bla ma las sne bcas rta pa brgyad cu skor gyis chibs bsu zhus/ khā dge 'dun skyabs dang khā tshe brtan so so'i khyim du phebs te 'dod don bskangs ya mā thu la 'byor te ye phu dge 'dun rgyal gyi khyim du bzhugs/gza' mi rnams la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang dang mjal ba sum stong tsam la phyag dbang sogs gnang / bco brgyad la pe zi sangs rgyas rgyal gyis yā mon du gdan drangs nas gsol tshigs dang 'bul nod gzabs/ ja sag wang bde chen blon 'khor bcas mjal bar slebs wang dang pe zi sogs bla dpon nyung 'dus la gsol 'debs par do'i phrang sgrol gyi khrid dang lcang skya rin po che'i myur 'byon gsol 'debs rnam rgyal gzungs ring gi lung stsal/tha'i ji badz+ra skyabs tha'i gdugs dkar skyabs rab 'byams pa don grub rnams kyis rang rang gi gshag tu gdan drangs nas 'dod chos zhus pa'i re ba bskangs/ de nas pe zi bde ba'i rdo rje'i ya mon du ma bu rnams la spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi'i rjes gnang dang mgon po'i gtor chog gi lung gnang zhing der bzhugs/ khong rnams kyis kyang shangs len dang dngos 'bul sogs gang gzab zhus/ bcu dgu la mi rin li'u shu'i khyim du gdugs dkar zhal phyag yongs rdzogs kyi rjes gnang dang khā del ger tshang dang mi rin bo yan skyabs kyi khyim du phebs/ mi rin pa yan hu thog gi khyim du bzhugs te gza' mi rnams la rta mgrin dang seng gdong ma'i rjes gnang de ga'i ri khrod ba zhig gis bde ba can du skye ba'i man ngag gcig gnang dgos zhes gsol ba btab pa bzhin nyan mkhan nyung 'dus la bde ba can gyi nyal sgom gyi khrid gsol 'debs bar do'i 'phrang sgrol dang tsha gsur gyi lung bcas gnang /nyi shu'i zhog ka mi gsum dge bsnyen dang rab byung bsgrubs tha'i ji dpal bzang gis gdan drangs pa'i 'dun pa bskangs te ya mā thu nas chibs bsgyur 491

༄/ /gung thang bstanaba'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/gnang / zan pe zi dang pe zi sogs dpon blon brgya phrag brgal bas khe rid par du chibs skyel zhus/ der thu shi gung rnam rgyal rdo rje ngo g.yog 'byor nas khe rid kyi ri mgo'i lab tse yod sar gdan drangs pa bsang dang dpang bstod mdzad lab tser ming zhus par pa yan o bo zhes btags/ de nas khā tsin ta mni dang ko pu ji'i khyim du rim par phebs mjal mi stong phrag brgal bar phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang de ga'i lha khang gi nye 'dabs su thu shi gung gis ras gur phubs par gdan drangs nas che ge drangs thog stobs rtsal 'gran pa dang rta rgyug gtong ba sogs byas/ gasnye dang del ger tshang gnyis kyis gdan drangs tā mal tha'i ji thub pa skyabs sogs dpon po 'ga' zhig chibs bsur 'byor cing thub pa skyabs kyi khyim du bzhugs/ phyi nyin tha'i ji srun rnams la sang ldeng nags sgrol gyi rjes gnang stsal tha'i ji dbang rab dang gu ru rig 'dzin so sos gdan drangs par phyag dbang sogs kyis tshim par mdzad/dge bshes ngag dbang blo bzang gi ri khrod du dge bshes rang gi ngor gnang ba'i nyid la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dngos grub bum bzang dang nyid kyi 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs nor bu'i phreng ba rgyal sras thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams kyi lung gnang / su bor ga'i su me'i hu pi la gān gnyis dem chi dge bskos dang bcas chibs bsur 'byor/ su bor ga'i su me nas gsar du gdan drangs pa'i bstan 'gyur la rab gnas mdor bsdus mdzad cing dad 'dus kyi mjal ba stong phrag brgal bar phyag dbang sogs gnang hu bil gān tā bla ma'i gshag tu bzhugs/ hor chin wang gi ho sho'u la gdan 'dren lan mang zhus kyang phebs stabs ma 'grigs par da res wang gis mi sna tho yon skal bzang dang phen yan the'i sogs skya ser drag zhan nyi shu skor ched mngags gtang dngul srang bcu'i maṇ+ḍal sna 492

༄7/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /'dogs can gos chen yug kha shas dngul srang sum brgya bcas 'bul rgyu bskurabami sna rnams kyis brtan bzhugs lugs su phul/ ho sho'u de ga'i wang snga ma 'ga' zhig sku tshe ma brtan par wang 'di pa rje nyid la skyabs bcol nas skyabs 'jug nan tan zhus yod pas skyabs 'jug rgyun ldan gnang rgyu'i bka' bzang po dang byin rten srung ba sogs gzab nas gnang / gzhan yang wang gi a bes rnams dang bla dpon blon po che phra spyi sger nas skyabs rten dang bsngo rten gyi 'bul ba phon chen po bskur ba rnams la bab bstun gyi bka' lan dang byin rten sogs stsal/ nyer gnyis la hu bil gan tā bla mas bskul ngor nyid kyi gsol 'debs tshigs bcad gsar du brtsams te lngags lung dang hu bil gan blo bzang mchog ldan gyi gshag tu lcang skya rin po ches mdzad pa'i tshem bu dmar khrid kyi lung bcas gnang / tā mal tha'i ji rin chen dang tshe dbang sogs chibs skyel ba tha'i ja mang po zhig phyir slog / tha'i ji bo yan thu dang khā ta le'i a lī tas gu thi bla ma khu rnams kyis rim pas gdan drangs par phyag dbang sogs 'dod mos ltar stsal/ o lān u bur gyi lha khang du skya ser spyi mang la phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang zhing der bzhugs/tā mal tha'i ji thub pa skyabs sogs tha'i ji 'ga' zhig dang su bor ga'i su me'i bla ma las sne rnams phyir log / phyi nyin shin tshud kyi su'i khe thu'i khyim du shis brjod dang a gos su me'i tā bla ma ye shes kyis gdan drangs thog skya ser bdun brgya skor la rje nyid kyi 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs dga' ldan lha brgya ma bzang spyod rnams kyi lung gnang / lam zhor du khu reng po ha'i grong sde gong 'og gnyis kyi skya ser brgyad brgya skor dang na rī na gol gyi lha khang du mjal mi lnga brgya skor la phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang / de ga'i man dar hu dang ar bi ca hu ār+ya skyabs ar nes rnams kyis rang rang gi khyim du gdan 493

༄/ /gung tha nga nabazlanalogasung 'bum/drangs pa'i re ba skong bar mdzad/ thu sa lag chi wang 'chi med grub pa thu shi gung rnam rgyal rdo rje sogs lo'u hu'i dpon po mang po chibs bsur 'byor 'di nyin thu shi gung gi yā mon du phyag phebs/ phyi nyin nas thu shi gung ma bu rnams dang thu sa lag chi wang sogs phyogs nas 'dus pa'i bla dpon skya ser brgya phrag brgal bar rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang sta gon dngos gzhi bcas nyin gnyis la gnang / gung dpon pos dbang g.yon du maṇ+ḍal kha btagasagos chen bzhi dngul srang sum brgya yid bzhin 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu sogs dngos 'bul sbam mtho ba btegs/ 'dir bzhugs ring la char chenapo babs bas mjal pa mang po'i spros pa med par o'u hun dge bshes ngag dbang blo bzang thu med dka' bcu blo bzang don grub sogs dang gsung gleng 'phel zhing khong rnams la blo skyed kyi skyes kyang mang du stsal/ thu med dka'abacu blo bzang don grub la mkha' spyod ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid lungadage bsnyen dang rab byung sgrub mkhan pho mo brgyad la sdom pa phog / ho sho'u 'di gar zla ba bzhi pa dang lnga pa gnyis la than pa chen po byung na'ang rje nyid thul ga'i su mer phebs nyin nas bzung ste 'di'i bar du nyin re bzhin char 'jam po re babs shing / de yang ja zhus dang tsha zhag gi sar bzhugs dus dang bstun nas 'bab pa las lam du phebs bzhin pa'i tshe gtan nas mi 'bab pas thams cad kyis rje 'di nyid kyi byin rlabs 'ba' zhig tu 'dug ces ched du brjod pa byung / ho ro de ga'i khā sa'i jir hu'i khyim du rta mgrin gsangasnub kyi sgrub thabs kyi lung stsal/ nyer drug gi nyin thu she gung gi ya mon nas thon dge bshes ngag dbang blo bzang sogs bla ma 'ga' zhig phyir slog / phebs lam du tā mal tha'i ji pad dkar skyabs dang tha'i ji bsam 'grub sogs per khe'i tha'i ji mang po dang har chin wang gi mi sna ja lang rig 494
