༄sa/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /'dzin ngo g.yog rnams rim pas 'byor/ cong thor gyi lha khang dang per khe'i tha'iji dbang po'i khyim tha'i bsam 'grub kyis lha khang dang khong rang gi khyim rnams su rim pas gdan drangs par chos bka' sogs gang 'dod du stsal cingabasam 'grub kyi khyim du bzhugs/ nyi shu bdun la tā mal tha'i ji pad dkar skyabs dang tha'i ji arja sirnyi tha'i ji po yan chog cho rnams kyis spyan drangs par gang 'dod kyi chos sbyin stsal/ thu sa lag chi wang dang thu shes gung ngo g.yog phyir slog / tā bla ma shes rab dang tā bla ma 'od zer rgya mtsho so so'i lha khang du gdan 'dren zhus har chin ja lang pa yan pā thur gyi khyim du bzhugs/ tā mal tha'i ji pad dkar skyabs dang tha'i ji bsam 'grub sogs per khe'i tha'i ji mang po phyir log ja lang gi lha khang du rten gsum la rab gnas rta thog ma gnang / brgyad dgu gnyis la glang chen dal 'gros kyes phebs pa'i lam zhor du khā tshe dpag skyabs dang ja lang the gu su po yan thu sogs sbyin bdag 'ga' zhig dang mjal ba mang po'i re ba bskang zhing /wang gi sras che ba dang gung gi sras gnyis pa thu sa lag chi tshul khrims sogs dpon blon du ma'i chibs bsu bcas zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gcig gi nyin tha bo nang a yu ge'i khyim du babs tā gung yab sras dang a ke pur+ṇa pā la rnams mjaladu 'byor/ tshes gnyis kyi zhog ka tha bo nang gza' mi tshad mar bde mchog dkar po dang rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang stsal/ thu sa lag chi tshulakhrims kyis khyim du gdan drangs par zhag gsum bzhugs/ o'u han gye chibs skyel pa tha'i ji 'chi med rdo rje tā bla ma tshe 'phel nang so bzod pa khā ming ga thu dge bskos dem chi cang ki khun tu sogs skya ser brgyad cu skor yu wa dang bcas phyir slog / sbyin bdag chin wang yab sras 'byor nas phyag dbang zhus thus lag chi gza' mi rnams dang lha skyabs gung gi thas thas sogs 495

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/skya ser sum cu skor la spyan ras gzigs seng ge'i sgra dang khro rgyal gtsug tor 'bar ba'i rjes gnang / thu sa lag chi dang tā gung a ke pur+ṇa pā la rnams la ku ru kul+le'i rjes gnang / tho yon brtan pa'i 'khor lo dang thu sa lag chi gnyis la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang bcas chos sbyin rgya cher gnang / tshes lnga'i nyin gung gi lha khang gi hu bil gan tho yon lnga pa'i lam du gyur pa'i don la gdan drangs par phebs te bsngo smon sogs kyi bka' drin bskyangs/ wang yum sras ke ke rnams dang hu bil gān bla ma tho yon bzhi sogs drag zhan brgya phrag brgal bas chibs bsu thab bsu dang bcas rim gyis yā mon du 'byor/de dus 'du 'dzis thugs sun nas rje rang nyid la rang yul du mgyogs par 'byon pa'i skul ma lta bu'i gsung mgur zhig gnang ba ni/ na bun stong g.yogs gyon pa'i g.ya' ri spug po'i sul na/ / lhung lhung dal gyis 'bab pa'i rdza chu sil ma'i 'gram du/ / bag phebs nyams dga' spyod lam bzhi shong g.yam pa'i spyil bur/ / g.yengs med rnal 'byor spyod pa'i spong ba pa rnams skyid pa/ / nags tshul smad g.yogs klub pa'i spang ri ser po'i mgul na/ /me tog sna tshogs bzhad pa'i ne gseng yid du 'ong bar/ / tsha grang reg pa skyob pa'i rang shod 'jag ma'i spyil bur/ / yang dag 'jog la gzhol pa'i bsamagatan pa rnams dga' ba/ / g.yu yi spu long rgyas pa'i nags kyi sman ljongs dben par/ / bag phebs dal gyis rgyu ba'i ri dwags grogs dang lhan cig / 'bras bu'i khur gyis dud pa'i shing drung grib bsil can du/ /'phags pa'i rigs la gnas pa'i dge sbyong tshogs rnams spro ba/ / chu 'dzin gzhon nus 'khyud pa'i gangs ri dkar po'i lhongs su/ / nyin dang mtshan du khab bu yug 'tshub pa'i khrod du/ / phal bas bsten par dka' ba'i gangs sul bya skyibs phug par/ / gtum mo'i bde drod sbar ba'i rnal 'byor pa 496

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /rnams bde ba/ / sras bcas rgyal bas legs bsngags me tog yang yang 'thor zhing / / sngon byon dam pa rnams kyis rab bsten dben pa'i gnas mchog / mthong chos nyid du zhi ba'i dga' ston myong ba de ru/ / de ring da lta nyid du dongs shig chos kyi rdo rje/ / zhes pa'ang har chin du gnas skabs shig 'du 'dzi sna tshogs kyis yid sun pas dben pa'i yon tan dran te glur blangs pa'o/ / zhes so/ / tshes drug la pā rin chin wang dang e phu bde legs bzang bo so so'i mi sna 'ongs nas mtshams zhu dang phebs rdzong zhus/e phu bde legs bzang po 'di rnam dpyod yangs pa zhig yin pas zhu yig tu lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa ma bzhugs stabs spyir bstan 'gro yongs dang sgos su nged cag grwa slob yon bdag thams cad la re ltos 'cha' sa rje nyid las lhag pa med pas brtse bas dgongs te zhabs pad yun du brtan dgos tshul bcad lhug spel ma'i sgo nas zhus par bka' lan stsal ba ni/ gang thugs zab yangs rin chen 'byung gnas su/ / nyin re bzhin yang gtsug lag chu klung 'bum/ / babs kyang ngoms pa med pa'i ya mtshan gyis/ /mkhas rnams kun dga'i mchod yon bskrun de la/ / phyi tshul dam par rdzu ba'i zlosagar bsgyur/ / smra ba'i lam du chos kyi dbyangs sgrogs kyang / / yid ni mun pa'i mal du nyid log pa'i/ / 'gal 'du'i phung po bdag gis 'di skad smra/ / kye hud 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon gcig pu/ / bka' drin 'khor mtha' bral ba'i bla ma rje/ / mtshan tsam thos pa'i lam du gshegs pa 'dis/ / sems dad ldan kun mya ngan khur gyis non/ / 'gro ba'i phan bde'i srog gi rtsa ba chad/ / thub bstan rgyal mtshan 'degs pa'i yu ba chag / skal bzang pad tshal skyed pa'i nyi ma nub/ / 'di 'dra'i skal ngan khrod du bdag cag lus/ / zhes sogs rdo rje 'chang de nyid zhal ma bzhugs 497

༄/ /gung bang bstanasa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/pas bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i rtsa ba chad tshul dang snyigs dus skye bos log par spyod pa'i mthus/ / dkar phyogs skyong rnams mthu dang stobs bri zhing / /nag phyogs bdud kyi mthu stobs dar drag pas/ / bdud las spyod pa'i skye bo mgo 'phang mtho/ / dgra bgogs sha khrag rol la ches rngams pas kha gdangs mche gtsigs rkan sgra tog pa yi/ / bstan srung rnams kyi dmar blum ye shes spyan/ / sdang mig g.yo ba de yang zum pa snyam/ / ma rungs snyigs ma'i dmu rgod 'di dag gi / rnam par mi 'tsham spyod la thugs phyung ste/ /mgon po des kyang zhing 'di yongs btang nas/ / myang 'das zhi ba'i nags su gshegs par gyur/ / kye hud da ni dus kyi mtha' la slebs/ / skye rgu rnams ni mgon skyabs dpung gnyen bral/ / 'dod lha'i bran gyur dregs pas myos pa 'gas/ / rang 'dod gzu lum spyod pas lugs gnyis dkrugs/ / spyi stoms khrims kyang khas drag phyogs su yo/ / chen por rlom rnams chags sdang mtshon rtse gtod/ / nyam chung rnams ni srog kyang rang mi dpang / / kun kyang ngang tshul mi brtan glog ltar 'gyu/ / zhes snyigs dus kyi ngang tshul gsungs shing / tshul des thugs gting nas skyo bas dben par rtse gcig tu sgrub pa la thugs phyogs pa'i tshul ston pa ni/ kye ma snyigs ma'i skyon gyi mtshon rnon pos/ / yang yang snying la rmas pa'i nyam chung bdag / g.yul ngo mthong pa'i sdar ma bzhin 'jigs pas/ / myur du dpen pa'i nags su 'bros par brtsam/ / e ma chags sdang 'du 'dzis rab dbon pa'i/ / ri sul nor bu'i phug yangs nyams dga' bar/ / 'phags pa'i rigs la gnas pa'i bde ba mchog / de 'dra brgya byin la yang yod re skan/ / me tog sna tshogs dga' pa'i 'dzum dkar bzhad/ / ljon shing rnams ni yal ga'i bsil yab g.yob/ / bung pa'i tshogs rnams dga' ba'i glu dbyangs 498

༄za/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /len/ / bya dang byi'u skad snyan rol mo 'khrol/ / steng na chu 'dzin gsar ba'i bla re bres/ / sa gzhi ne+e gsing ma rgad myu gu bkram/ / phyogs kun na bun dar dkar yol bas mdzes/ / khor yug yid 'ong sa 'dzin phreng bas bskor/ / lhung lhung dal gyis 'bab pa'i nyal 'gro dang / / bag phebs ri dwags rgyu ba'i skad gnyis las/ / rang sems mtshog tu zhi ba myong ba'i gegs/ / chags sdang re dogs bskyed pa'i gtam gyes dpen/ / a ho pad mtsho mthong ba'i ngang ba bzhin/ / dben pa'i dga' bdes yid drangs dā ri dra/ /mi med lung pa stong pa'i brag phug tu/ / phyi ma'i lam gyi rgyags phye sgrub tu 'gro/ / zhes gsungs so/ / sbyin bdag wang chen mos ho sho'u'i spyi chos su lam rim gyi khrid cig gnang rgyu'i gsol ba btab pa ltar tshes brgyad nas bzung ya mon nang du sbyin bdag wang yum sras ke ke rnams dang / gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas yab sras a ke pur+ṇa bā la sogs ho ro yas mas kyi dpon dpon mo blon po wang dang gung gi lha khang dang bka' 'gyur su me sogs lhakhang so so'i bla grwa pe zi'i ho shu'u'i srad rgyud mkhan po dang lha ram pa rdo rje snying po bur han thu dang ta lu dgon pa gnyis kyi gu the dge tshul slong mang pos mtshon phyogs tha dad kyi bka' chos don du gnyer mkhan bcas gzhi byes kyi skya ser drag zhan sum stong nye bar lam rim bde lam gyi khrid dbu btsugs te nyin re bzhin chos thun gnyis re gnang zhing / de yang las dang po pa la gtso cher phan pa'i phyir du sngon 'gro spyor ba'i rim pa dang skyabs 'gro las 'bras sogs chung ngu'i chos skor rtsal 'don dang / gong ma rnams la'ang spyi'i khog phubs shing nges pa skyed sla ba'i bshad pa ya mtshan pa mjug tu sems bskyed mchod pa dang bcas yongs su rdzogs pa grub par mdzad/ bka' chos kyi sangs bar du phyogs nye ring nas 'ongs pa'i mjal ba rnams la phyag dbang 499

༄/ /yo nga ba naba'izlanas gsung 'bum/chos 'brel 'dod mos bzhin gnang / ma hā bā las khyim du gdan drangs par ma bu rnams la tshe dbang stsal/ srad rgyud mkhan po dang lha ram pa rdo rje snying po gnyis kyis zhus ngor bco lnga'i nyin bla dpon ser skya brgya phrag mang po la theg chen gso sbyong gi sdom pa dang rab 'byams pa blo bzang gzhon nu gcig pu la ku ru ku l+le'i rjes gnang stsal/ bcu drug la dge bsnyen gnyis dang rab byung brgya dang don gnyis dang dge tshul brgya dang lnga bsgrubs shing / bcu bdun la bsgrub bya brgya dang gsum bsnyen par rdzogs te shar phyogs yangs pa'i dga' tshal bslab gsum ngur smrig 'chang ba'i dge 'dun 'dab brgya'i phreng bas mdzes par mdzad/ pur han thu'i ku thi bkra shis 'od zer dang tā lu'i ku thi bkra shis nor bu gnyis la chos rje'i cho lo gnang nas dgon pa gnyis kyi blo gsar pa rnams la bslab sbyang tshul bzhin byed dgos pa'i zhal ta gnang / su nyid g.yon ru'i wang gi gdan 'dren pa dem chi blo bzang shes rab tha'i ji mi rin bde legs don grub khā del ger ja lang dpal 'byor sogs mi drag zhan brgyad cu u la'i rnga rta dang bcas 'byor/ de nas nyi ma kha shas kyi ring wang gi lha khang dang ho ro'i slob ma sbyin bdag 'ga' zhig gis rang rang gi gshag tu gdan drangs nas gsol ja dang phebs rdzong zhus par 'dod chos skyabs 'jug sogs stsal/ nyi shu gcig la gza' skar 'phrod sbyor bzang bar dpon g.yog tshang ma lam 'bud la phebs nas phyir 'khor skabs wang yab sras kyis wamon gyi sgo drung du mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa'i dge 'dun mang pos ser sprengs kyis mdun bsus te bkur ste chen pos gdan drangs nas gsol ja dkar spro dang legs dar 'bul ba sogs rten 'brel gyi sgo phun sum tshogs pa bsgrig par mdzad/ 'di nyin gung bstan 'dzinadar rgyas kyis gdan drangs pa bzhin gung dpon po la ku ru kul+le dang 500

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /mgon po snying zhugasaganyis kyi rjes gnang mkha' spyod ma dang ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabasakyi lung rnams gnang / phyi nyin gung gi sras gsum pa 'jam dbyangs stobs ldan gyis khyim nas bsnyen bkur zhus/ de'i phyi nyin tha bo nang rdo rje'i khyim du bzhugs te gza' mi tshang mar klu dbang rgyal po'i rjes gnang dang thun drug rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg sogs kyi lung gnang / phyi nyin tha bo nangaphyag rdor gyi khyim du sgrol ma dkar ljang dang gtsug tor 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs kyi lung dang hu bil gān tā bla ma blo gros 'byung gnas kyi gshag tu bla grwa tshang mar bzang spyod kyi lung gnang / nyer lnga'i nyin gung yab sras dang a ke pur+ṇa pā las gtsos dpon dpon mo mang po la lo gyon ma'i rjes gnang stsal/gung dpon pos brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te dngul srang bcu'i maṇ+ḍal sne 'dogs can sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gos chen yug lnga shel spyad kha shas dngul srang sum brgya nor bu don yong zhags pa bcas phul cing btsun mo dang sras sras mo so so nas kyang dngos gtsang ba'i khyad nor du ma phul/ 'di nyin a ke pur+ṇa pā las khyim du gdan drangs par bzhugs zhag mdzad rim gror lha mo rigs byed ma'i sbyin sreg gnang / nyer drug la gung dang puṇi pā la sogs don gnyer can nyung 'dus la stag phu rdo rje 'changagis mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod ma'i skyed rdzogs kyi lung gnang / ha thun nyang nyer gyis khyim du gdan drangs nas der bzhugs/ ja sag gung gi mi sna cang gi the gu su 'byor nas maṇ+ḍal kha btags dang bcas gsar bzhengs byamasachen gyi lha khang la ming zhus par thugs rje kun khyab gling zhes btags/nyer bdun la ha thun nyang nyer ma bu rnams la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnangasnal/ tha bo nang bsam 'grub kyi khyim du sbyin bdag rang dang gung dpon po sogs mi drag kha shas la mgon po bar chad kun sel gyi rjes gnang 501

༄/ /gung thang bstanaskethonatha'i gsung 'bum/dang de'i gtor chog gi lung gnang ste pur+ṇa pā la'i khyim du phebs/ don gnyer can 'ga' zhig la dbyu gu ma'i sgrub thabs dang bsnyen yig bsam gtanags spyor sogs ljags lung thor bu mang tsam gnang / nyer brgyad la pur+ṇa pā la gcig pu la khre ṭa pā la'i rjes gnang de'i bskang bshags kyi lung bcasadang gung yab sras dang pur+ṇa pā la spun gnyis kyis gtsos drag zhan lnga brgya skor la sdug bsngal sel ba'i sgrol ma'i rjes gnang de'i sgrub thabs dang sgrol bstod kyi lung gnang / pur+ṇa pā las ma ṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gos chen yug bzhi mchod rdzas 'ga' zhig dngul srang brgya dang lnga bcu yid bzhin 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bcas brtan bzhugs lugs su phul/ mung khu yul cu'u a ke'i khyim du gza' mi tshang mar rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang stsal te/ tha po nang don grub kyi khyim du bzhugs/ nyer dgu la don grub gza' mi rnams la khyung khra'i rjes gnang dang dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i lung gnang / a ke yil go tshang dang stobs chen gnyis kyis rang rang gi khyim du gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur dang 'dod don zhus/ de nas wang gi ya mon du 'byor gnam gang la sngar zhe hor du 7gong ma'i mtshams zhur btang ba'i mi sna nang so bstan pa rgya mtsho 'byor nas 7gong nas gnang ba'i kha btags nang mdzod sogs phul/ sbyin bdag wang yum sras bcas dang lha khang gi grwa ba 'ga' zhig cha gan su por ga'i tha bo nang rnam thar sogs don gnyer can nyung 'dus la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i skyed rdzogs kyi khrid bka' drin stsal/ bshol zla bdun pa'i tshes gcig la wang gi lha khang du gdan drangs nas grwa pa rnams kyis gsol ston dang 'bul nod phul/lha khang rnams su mchod mjal dang 'du khang du sbyin bdag wang yum sras gtsos pa'i skye pho mo'i khrom nyis stong brgal bar chos spyod nang gi skabs gsum 502

༄༅/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /padang rten 'brel bstod pa sogs chos tshan bcu skor dang lam rim gsol 'debs 'jigs byed dang mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs gtor chog gi lung rnams chos thun gnyis la gnang / khā bo yan chi dang yanan+ta ha ban 'bum tshang khā tsakra khun tu co khi su thu rnams kyis rang rang gi khyim du gdan drangs nas shis brjod zhus/ tshes gsum la rje nyid wang yab sras dang lhan du ri mngon par mthon po'i lab tse la phebs nas bsang dang dpang bstod mdzad cing mda' 'phen dang rta rgyug sogs rtsed mo mang po bstar ba gzigs/nyid rang yul du phebs bskyod nye bar tshes bzhi'i nyin sbyin bdag wang rat+na sirnyis yā mon gyi pho brang dbus mar gdan drangs nas bde mchog dkar po'i sgo nas brtan bzhugs dang 'brel bar dngul srang lnga bcu'i maṇ+ḍal sne 'dogs can sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dngul gyi rdo rje dar tshon sna lnga'i sne 'dogs can dngul las bsgrubs pa'i rgyal srid sna bdun bkra shis rtags brgyad 'dod yon sna lnga/ bzang gos las bsgrubs pa'i phye phur bzhi 'phan che chung nyi shu tham pa shel gyi mar me'i 'od khang spus gtsang cha gnyis rgya dngul dkar po srang dgu brgya shel gyi snod spyad 'ga' zhig sna do'i khu khur khug ma dgu tshan kha shas/ gzhan yang sras sras mo so so nas spus gtsang ba'i 'bul ba gya nom pa btegs te sku tshe zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa dang slar yang ljongs 'dir myur du chibs kha bsgyur ba'i gsol ba nan tan btab par bab bstun gyi bka' lan bzang po gnang / wang chen mo nas rje nyid rang yul du 'byon rgyur dgon lung bar du zhabs phyi sgrub mi gu shri tā bla ma bsam 'grub nyi ma khā yum chung sogs tog can gsum phebs byams kyi drel kha khrid mi bzhi gsol thab kyi do dam byed mi sogs skya ser bco lnga skor dang /mkhar sngon bar du bda'u skyel mi ja lang bstan 'gyur dang khā yo mog thu cang 503

༄/ /gung 4 bstan pa'i sgroname'i khung 'bum/gi bzhi khun tu gsum ul mi u lag gi shing rta bcas dang / gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas dang e phu pur+ṇa pā la so so'i ngos nas tog can 'ga' zhig /do lon no'ur du chibs skyel zhu mi bla ma a ke gnyis dang a ke legs ldan tog can 'ga' zhig lha khang gi dge bskos rab 'byor gung gi a ke dpal 'byor a ke pur+ṇa pā la gung gi lha khang gi tā bla ma sogs skya ser drag zhan brgya phrag brgal ba zhabs phyir gtong ba gnang / wang 'di bas rje nyid rgya nag tu nam phebs dus mkhar sngon nas har chin bar dang de nas pe cing sogs yas mas su 'byon skabs dpon g.yog tshang ma'i zhon rta dgos chas 'dren pa'i shing rta rnams wang ring gi ho sho'u nas thon cing gro chas gang dgos wang gi phyag rdzas thog nas gnang ba dang bzhugs ring la dpon g.yog tshang ma'i nar ma'i gsol chas dang dbyar dgun gyi gos cha tshang gnang thog skabs skabs su brtan bzhugs kyi 'bul nod rgya che zhing spam mtho ba yang mdzad pa dang /dgonalung du yang lo ltar el chi ched mngags dang 'grul zhor ci rigs kyi lam nas dngos 'bul gya nom pa rgyun ldan bskur ba sogs dad pa dang gtong bal 'gran zla dang bral ba khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin dang mtshungs pa zhig go / tshes lnga la wang yab sras thams cad la bde mchog dkar po'i rjes gnang stsal sbyin bdag wang la sku gsung thugs rten sku thang byon legs lnga sogs rten 'byung gi skyes 'ga' zhig gnang zhing sras rnams dang bcar sdod kyisaphyag g.yog zhus mi skya ser drag zhan thams cad la so so'i go bab dang bstun pa'i gnang sbyin dang byin rten sogs kyis tshim par mdzad/ tshes drugal wang gi tsha bo maci badz+ra gyis khang ba gsar bar gdan drangs te shis brjod zhus shing rten 'byung gi 'bul ba 'ga' zhig phul/ sras gzhan rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi khyim du gdan drangs nas gsol ja dang skyabs 504

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /'jug zhus/ tshes bdun la thu med pe zi'i mi sna tha'i ji yar 'phel dang nang so ga sha pad ngo g.yog 'byor nas dngul srang nyi shu'i maṇ+ḍal sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol dngul srang brgya bcas 'bul rgyu bskur ba rnams brtan bzhugs lugs su phul/ snga phyir har chen ho sho'u lnga dang yo'u han pā rin na'i man yong nyod so so nas phebs rdzong dang chibs skyel zhu mkhan bla dpon sbyin bdag dngos dang tshab ci rigs mang po dang / ho ro yas mas kyi sbyin bdag drag zhan ris med gzim gshag nas gsol ja dang 'bul nod 'degs mkhan nyin re bzhin bar ma chad du byung bar bka' chos dang bka' bsgo sman sogs rang rang gi 'dod mos ltar stsal/ tshes brgyad la drag zhan gyi 'khor stong phrag brgal ba dang lhan du har chin chin wang gi yu mon nas chibs bsgyur gnang bar ser skya'i tshogs pa stong phrag mang pos dar 'bod dang chibs rags kyi zhal lan gsum phyir slog pa sogs rten 'brel phun sum tshogs par bsgrigs/ lha khang dang ha cang thag mi ring pa'i sa khod yangs pa zhig tu sbyin bdag wang gis ras gur phubs par gdan drangs nas gsol ja dkar spro zhus/ wang chen mos dkar zas kyis bkang pa'i shel gye mchod jan yid bzhin 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu lha rdzas dang bcas phul nas 'bral mi phod pa'i rnam pa mdzad par der tshogs pa thams cad kyi mig nas mchi ma rang dbang med par 'chor ba byung / wang dang btsun mo tsha bo mdzi badz+ra rnams 'di nas phyir log / meng ge'i a man gyi grong sdes ja zhus thog dad 'dus kyi skye pho mo shin tu mang bar phyag dbang slar gnang rgyu'i rten 'brel mdzad nas ma gnang lung pa de ga'i nang du sgar btab/ dpon po rnams 7gong ma'i ri dwags kyi zhabs phyir 'gro rgyur thug pas wang dang gung gi a ke rnams on dur hogang sogs ho sho'u so so'i chibs skyel pa rnams phyir slog / tshes dgu la 505

༄/ /gung ca bstan ba'ithonasa'i khrung 'bum/meng ge'i la rgyab du gung bab thog hor chin bsod nams stobs rgyas wang gi thu sa lag chi dge skyed dang dar han wang gi mi rin i re khu sogs hor chen ho sho'u bcu ri dwags kyi sa char 'gro mi sum brgya skor gyis mjal kha dang skyabs 'jug zhus tshang thu ta pa'i a man la zhag bab/ tshes bcu'i zhogs ka lha khang gi zhabs drung wang gi tsha bo tho yon tshe mgon dge bskos nang so 'ga' zhig phyir slog / shar ga'i tha bin la gung bab thog tha bin gyi mi rnams la mjal khadang ljags lung gnang a ke mung khe ul ju'u dang phyag rdor bsam 'grub sogs phyir slog / pi chig thu had la ong nyod wang gi a khu lhan skyes skyabs pha bu gnyis e phu dpal 'byor sogs tha'i ji 'ga' zhig dang wang gi mtshams zhus pa ja khir chi sman skyob wang gi lha khang gi khri bsngags ram pa dge legs rgya mtsho pe zi'i lha khang gi khri pa dka' bcu shes rab lha khang gnyis kyi dge bskos dem chi sogs rta pa brgyad cu skor 'byor nas mjal kha zhus ong nyod wang gi ho re'i nye 'dabs kyi sgar thog tu babs/ wang gi a ke dpa' bo rdo rje sogs dpon blon mang pos sgar thog tu gsol ston 'bul nod zhus/ wang dang pe zi'i lha khang gi bla grwa so so dang ho ro 'i nye 'khor gyi mi drag spyi sger gyis gsol ja dngos 'bul btegs par phyag dbang dang gson gshin la bsngo ba sogs so so'i 'dod mos ltar stsal/ skya ser nyis stong brgal par phyag dbang dang lam gtso rnam gsum dmigs brtse ma rigs gsum mgon po byams pas dam bca' rnams dang ma ṇi'i bzlas lung sogs rgyas par gnang /mi zha bo zhig gis grong nas 'phongs snur byas te dka' spyad kyis mjal du 'ongs par thugs brtse bas sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang gzungs sngags zab mo rnams rna lam du sgrog par mdzad/ bcu gcig la gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas gtsos chibs skyel du 'ongs pa'i dpon blon skya ser lnga bcu skor la bla ma'i 506

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /rnal 'byor gyi khrid gnang gung dpon po dang a ke mgon po don grub ngo g.yog phyir slog / yong nyod wang gi nu bo sogs ho ro'i tha'i ji 'ga' zhig gis chibasaskyel zhus/ pā thur gyi la rtsar gung bab thog ong nyod pe zi'i lha khang gi khri ba dka' bcu shes rab sogs grwa pa bcu skor la dbon sa snyan brgyud kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid gnang mjal mi lnga brgya tsam la phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang ying gi lung par sgar btab mjal ba bzhi brgya tsam la phyag dbang gnang / bcu gnyis la thu sa lag chi tshul khrims dang a ke rdo rje sogs chibs skyel pa 'ga' zhig phyir log / de nas phebs lam du he re han gyi gzhi bdag la bsang dang dkar gtor gtong bar mdzad cing be+e han mo dun gye lab tse la dar dkar btags nas dpang bstod mdzad/ khi shig then ja sag gi bla ma kau kya' zhabs drung dang o'u han o ro'i su me'i tho yon chos rje sogs lam zhor du mjal ba drag zhan mang po dang bcas rim gyes bco brgyad la do lon no'ur du 'byor nyin kha shas bzhugs/ lha khang ser po'i tā bla ma ku lu khu khu'i zhabs drung lha khang g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi dge bskes dem chi lcang skya bla brang shi re thu bla sogs bla brang so so'i dem chi gnyer pa ci rigs rimapas sgar thog tu gsol ja dang mjal kha zhus/ lha khang gnyis kyi dge 'dun dang thag nye ring gi mjal ba rnams zam ma chad du byung / lha khang ser po'i tā bla ma dang ku lu khu khu'i zhabs drung sogs 'ga' zhig la nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lcang skya rin po che'i myur 'byon gsol 'debs sogs ljags lung kha shas gnang / mar du su cun gar pe zi'i mi sna khā phun tshogs rin chen su nyidagayon ru'i wang gi mi sna khā blo bzang bkra shis sbyin bdag har chen wang gis zhe hor nas btang ba'i mi sna ha ban pe'i dal rnams rim pas 'byor nas mtshams zhu phul/ wang gi bla ma a ke gnyis dang gung gi a ke dpal 'byor 507

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/e phu pur+ṇa pā la sogs har chin pa dang / nang so shag sha pad sogs thu med pa so so nas dpon g.yog tshang mar gsol ston drangs/ nyid nas kyang de dag drag zhan brgya phrag brgal bar ston mo dang so so'i go bab gyi gnang cha gya nom pa stsal/ nyid dpon g.yog su nyid la phebs dgos par ngos kyi do dam pa gnyer pa dang dos skyel mi har chin pa rnams mkhar sngon du 'gro rgyur chas/de dang lhan du dgon lung la snga 'gros su gtong rgyu'i grwa pa gnyis kyang mngags te phyir lo'i cho 'phrul smon lam rje nyid nas gtong rgyur bla brang gnyer pa la de lugs kyi gra sgrig byed dgos pa'i gsung shog bskul ba gnang / nyi shu bzhi la do lon no'ur nas lha khang so so'i chibs skyel pa dang bcas thon pā shing thu la gung bab thog har chin wang gi tho yon gnyis dang gung gi a ke dpal 'byor e phu pur+ṇa pā la wang gi lha khang gi dge bskos rab 'byor gung gi lha khang gi hu pil gān tā bla ma thu med pe zi'i nang so shag sha pad sogs chibs skyel pa skya ser drag zhan brgya skor gyes rje nyid smad phyogs su slar yang chibs kha bsgyur ba'i gsol 'debs gsar rtsom lung bka' bsgo bcas zhus nas phyir log /nang so shag sha pad kyis rje nyid thu med du bzhugs gnas mdzad pa'i bla brang la ming zhus par chos kyis mngon par mtho pa'i khang bzang zhes 'dogs pa gnang / shan tu'i mkhar shul gyi nye 'dabs sgar btab gnas der sngon hu pi le'i tshe chen hān gyis 'gro mgon 'phags pa gdan drangs nas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad pa'i gnas tshul 'ga' zhig gsung nas thugs skyo ba'i rnam pa mdzad/ smin grol no mon hān gyi gnyer pa sogs yul mi rnams kyis sgar thog nas gsol ja drangs/ de nas rim gyes tsha zhag gi sa dang lam bar du dad ldan mang po byin rlabs dang gsung gi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad bzhin su nyid g.yon ru'i sa sne zin pa dang wang gi a khu tha'i ji mi 'gyur dang the gu su 508

༄7/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /cir ga lang tho yon blo bzang mkhas grub dang rnam rgyal rnams 'byor nas thog ma'i rten 'byung gi gsol ston dang phyag dbang zhus mjal ba sum stong brgal bar phyag dbang sogs dkyus ltar gnang / de nas o lān no'ur la wang gi lha khang gi tā bla ma blo bzang dar rgyas dem chi dbu mdzad dge bsgos thu sa lag chi kun bzang phas than tā thub pa skyabs sogs rta ba brgya phrag dang / cha gan o bo la wang dpal 'byor yar 'phel wang gi a ma ha thun bde skyid tho yon chos rje 'jam dbyangs tho yon 'jigs med rnam rgyal thu sa lag chi ban+de ca khir chi tshe gzungs dpon blon drag zhan brgya phrag du ma chibs bsur 'byor nas gsol ston dkar spro zhus/ gzhan yang su nyid g.yas ru'i chos rje skal bzang bsam 'grub ngo g.yog dang tho yon chos rje'i lha khang gi tā bla ma sogs su nyid g.yas g.yon gyi lha khang so so'i bla ma las sne tha'i ji tog can du ma dang cha har khu be thu o lān gyi dpon po blo bzang bsam gtan sogs chibs bsu pa mang po mu mthud nas byung zhing cha har dpon pos gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gcig la su nyid g.yon ngu'i wang gi dgon par dge 'dun gyi ser 'phreng skye pho mo'i tshogs pa shin tu mang po dang bcasaphyag phebs/ dad 'dus kyi skye pho mo stong phrag mang po la phyag dbang dang dmigs brtse ma rigs gsum mgon po'i snying po byams pas dam bca' rnam rgyal gzungs ring rnams rna bar bsgrags shing ma ṇi'i phan yon gyi gsung bshad dang bcas bzlas lung phreng skor kha shas dang dge ba khas len bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor sogs rgyas par mdzad/ tshes gnyis la wang gi rigs rgyud kyi srung ma rgyal po sku lnga yin par rim gro lam du 'gro phyir nyid dpon g.yog gis rgyal gsol zhig btang / a pa ga tā pe zi'i mi sna khā stobs ldan 'byor nas mtshams zhu phul/ su nyid pe li kun bzang rgyal dang a pa ga tha'i ji pā 509

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/thur sogs ho sho'u thog nye ring gi mi drag zam ma chad du byung bar phyag dbang stsal/ nangs dgung gnyis la phyogs tha dad nas 'dus pa'i mjal ba bzhi stong brgal bar phyag dbang sogs sngar nyin ltar gnang / tshes gsum nas dge 'dun stong phrag brgal bas ma ṇi ril bu nyin lnga'i ring sgrub pa'i tshogs dbur byon te gnad smin bsgrub par mdzad/ mjug tu ho sho'u'i spyi chos su sbyinabadag wang dang tho yon chos rje rnam gnyis btsos bla dpon skya ser drag zhan sum stong brgal bar bla ma mchod pa'i khrid mdor bsdus tsam gnang /sbyin bdag wang gis bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal kha btags dngul srang nyis brgya rnga mong dgu rta dgu nor bcu gcig lug brgya tham pa bcas phul/ ma ṇi ril sgrub kyi sangs bar du nangs dgung gnyis la dad 'dus kyi skye pho mo'i khrom la mjal kha dang chos 'brel sngar rgyun bzhin gnang /a pa ga nyang tshang hu thog thu dpon g.yog 'byor nas dngos 'bul gya nom pa brtan bzhugs kyi tshul du phul bzhugs ring la lugs gnyis kyi gsung gleng 'phel zhing 'dod chos 'ga' zhig kyang stsal/ su nyid pe li kun bzang rgyal gyi 'dun pa bzhin rgyal po sku lnga'i rigs gtad gnang / su nyid g.yas ru'i chos rje skal bzang bsam 'grub kyis lo 'di'i zla ba dang po'i nang du pe cing nas lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje la bde mchog gi dbang dang nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sirdzu ra'i byin rlabs man ngag gi khrid rnams snyan gsan phul bar lcang skya rin po che nas bde mchog gi dbang gnang ste/ mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs dang man ngag gi khrid slar ston gnang chog pa'i zhal bzhes mdzad yod na'ang zla ba bzhi pa'i nang du lcang skya rin po ches gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus pas chos rje skal bzang bsam 'grub mya ngan gyis gdungs yod pa la rje nyid phyogs 'dir phebs pa ston dus dang 'grigs byung bar/ chos rje kho rang gis nyid 510

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /dang lcang skya rdo rje 'chang rnam gnyis ngo bo gcig yin par yid ches nas sngar gyi lo rgyus dang bcas mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs dang man ngag gi khrid kyi gsol ba nan tan du btab par dgyes bzhin zhal gyis bzhes te thugs brel gyi sangs par rnams su chos rje nyid dang tho yon chos rje 'jam dbyangs sogs skal ldan gyi slob ma dka' ram bcu skor la rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sirdu ra'i byin rlabs dang skyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i gser chos 'pho ba bcas kyi khrid ma dang mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thul le ba shin tu zab pa las kyang zab pa dang gsang ba las kyang gsang ba'i man ngag gi gnad bsam las 'das pa dang bcas 'dod dgur stsal te phyi nang mkha' spyod 'grub pa'i skal pa bzang por byas/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus kyi lung bka' drin stsal cing mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod thang mar brdal ba'i dam tshig skong ba'i phyir mjug tu tshogs 'khor rgyas par mdzod/ de dus chos rje skal bzang bsam 'grub sogs tshogs pa thams cad kyis rje nyid la tshe rabs rjes 'dzin gyi skyabs 'jug nan cher zhus pa'i lan du lcang skya rdo rje 'chang de nyid nas dgongs gzhi ci 'dra zhig yin ma shes kyang snga ma ong nyod gzungs skyid dpon mos khong la 'di'i dbang dang gdams ngag zhus par khong rang gis tshar gcig gnang ste khyod rang gis zhe thag pa nas gdams pa 'di nyams len byed tshe thu'u bkwan hu thog thu la 'di'i dbang gdams ngag zhus nas nyan rgyu byung na dgos pa yod ces gsungs 'dug / da res kyang khyed cag la dbang gnang pa'i dus btab pa de'ang nged rang 'di gar yong rgyu thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis gzigs nas da lta'i 'chad nyan 'di la dgongs pa lta bu yin 'dug pas thams cad kyis don de sems la bzhag ste/ gdams pa zab mo 'di lta bu'i 511

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'i sgronasa'i gsung 'bum/sgonas dal pa'i rten la snying po len nges shig mdzad dgos zhes thugs brtse ba'i bslab ston dang bcas bka' lan bzang po gnang / tshes dgu'i nyin wang gi ho ro la phebs wang snga ma 'ga' zhig sku tshe ma brtan par wang chung ba 'dis rje nyid la skyabs btsal ba yin pas nyid nas brtag zhib gnang ste sri gnon tshad ldan bsgrubs na phan che bar dgongs nas de ga'i grwa pa sum cu skor la nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sri zlog gi lung gnang ste tsakra bcu gsum grangs gsog tu bcug / rje nyid sgrub grogs kha shas bcas pas nyin bdun gyi ring rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi gtor zlog dang sbrags nas sri mnan dngos dag bsgrubs te mjug tu gtor rgyag mdzad par shin tu zil che zhing zor bkra legs pa byung / sri mnan gye tsha 'bum brtsigs te nyid rang gis rab gnas mdzad sri mnan gyi skabs sku cung zad ldem tshul bstan kyang sman gyi 'phrod brten dang zhabs brtan 'ga' zhig bsgrubs pas phral du dwangs/ zhal nas 'tshub cha cung zad byung na'ang rim gro gnad dmigs su song ba'i rmi ltas bzang po byung gsung / 'di dus dgug sngags grangs gsog pa'i skabs su mchod dpon ngag dbang sbyin pa'i mthong snang la hom khung nang du sdom che chung grangasakyis mi lang bas gang yod par mthong na'ang slar gar song cha med du gyur 'dug pa ni gnod byed mngon sum du bkug ste khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs kyi zhal du bstab pa'i mtshan mar mngon/ gzhan yang 'jigs byed zhi ba'i sbyinasreg dang dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga sogs gnad smin mdzad/ sbyin bdag wang gis gsol ba btab pa bzhin wang ma bu gnyis dang thu sa lag chi gnyis blon po che gras skor tho yon 'jam dbyangs sogs bla ma dka' ram mang po dang bcas skya ser nyis brgya skor la tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang chen sta gon dang bcas gnang ste nyi bu'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dga' ston 512

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /gyis ngoms par mdzad/ sbyin bdag wang gis dbang yon du maṇ+ḍal kha btags dngul srang nyis brgya dang lnga bcu gos chen mang nug yug gnyis pu la gan bubs bcu rnga mong drug rta lnga bcu nga bzhi nor bzhi bcu lug nyis brgya lnga bcu bcas phul/ de nas tho yon chos rje dang bsnye thu sa lag chi sogs don gnyer can nyi shu skor la nyid kyis bsgrigs pa'i rta mgrin chos skor dang gzhan yang chos tshan thor bu mang po zhig gi lung chos rje skal bzang bsam 'grub sogs la gtum mo'i khrid/ pe li dpon mo dang a ke rnams la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang tho yon mgon po la sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang sogs zhu mkhan so so'i ngor chos bka' du ma char du bsnyil/ wang gi ma rab byung bsgrubs te ming blo bzang sgol mar btags/ bka' chos sogs kyi sangs bar du dad 'dus kyi mjal ba rnams la phyag dbang chos 'brel sogs 'dod mos ltar stsal/ lo brgya lon pa'i rgad po zhig gis tshe g.yang phul bar mtshan dang gzungs sngags rna lam du sgrog par mdzad/ wang gtsos pa'i ho sho'u'i mi drag rnams tshogs nas nyi ma gnyis kyi ring gsol ston dang chi ge drangs te shed can rnams stobs rtsal 'gran pa dang gzhon nu rnams kyis mgrin bsdebs nas glu len pa rta rgyug gi pang dang skyen pos mda' 'phongs sogs chen po hor gyi yul gru'i rang spol gyi rtsed 'jo du ma'i gzigs mo bstar/sbyin bdag har chin ching wang rat+na sirnyi zhe hor nas bsnyung gzhi drag pos thebs nas gsung brtag zhu mi btang ba 'byor par sku tshe brtan pa'i smon tshig ljags rtsom mdzad cing brtag lan dang phyag sman srung ba bcas gnang ste/zhal nas wang yab yum ri bo rtse lngar song ste yum gyis btsun ma byas nas phyag skor byed kyin yod pa zhig mis pas wang gi bsnyung gzhi de ci 'dra yong gsung nas thugs 'tsher gnang ba bzhin/ phyir lo wang yum bcas ri bo rtse lngar 513

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i na 'i gsung 'bum/phebs pa'i sa nas wang grongs te yum btsun ma'i ngang tshul 'dzin par gyur pas thugs rmis ji lta ba bzhin byung 'dug / nyer brgyad kyi nyin slar yang dgon par gdan drangs nas gsol ston dkar spro zhus wang gis gtsos skya seragyi tshogs pa mang por bla ma'i rnal 'byor dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i bshad lung gnang / har chin tā gung gi cang ke nan chung dang ye phu pur+ṇa pā la'i ha ban ming gan ngo g.yog rang yul du log / nyer dgu la wang rnying pa'i dpon mo bde skyid dang sring mo tho yon 'jigs med rnam rgyal rnams kyis gdan drangs nas gsol ston dang 'bul nod phul/ sbyin bdag rnams la bla ma'i rnal 'byor dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang sgrol ma dkar ljang gi bstod pa byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs rnams kyi lung gnang / gnam gang gi nyin khe bi tha'i ji chos rgyal dang tā bla ma blo bzang dar rgyas spun rnams kyis lam thog tu bzhugs gur phubs par gdan drangs nas gsol ston 'bul nod gzabs shing 'dod don zhus pa'i re ba bskangs/ der mjal ba stong phrag lhag 'dus par phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang / sbyin bdag wang dpal 'byor yar 'phel ma bu rnams dang tho yon chos rje thu sa lag chi gnyis sogs chibs skyel pa brgya phrag du ma phyir log / ho sho'u 'di gar zla ba gcig bzhugs ring la mtshan mo'i thugs dam du lus sbyin gyi spyan dmigs gtso bor mdzad pa dgongs gzhi khyad par can zhig yod snang ste yul phyogs 'dir rje nyid ma phebasagong du lo kha shas kyi ring spyo 'bog sogs mi phyugs kyi nad rims dang mi shis pa'i mtshan ma mang po byung 'dug kyang / nyid phyogs 'dir chibs kha bsgyur bar nye ba'i skabs gdon nad kyis myos pa'i nad pa 'ga' zhig gis shar phyogs nas rwa co gnam la thug pa'i bla chen zhig yong gi 'dug pas nged cag 'gro rgyu yin zer byung zhing ma 'gyang bar de dag kyang nad las grol song 514

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang cho4kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /zhes ho sho'u rang gi mi 'ga' zhigagis nyid la dngos su zhus snang ba ni sngon rwa lo tsā ba phyogs 'ga' zhig tu phebs skabs de'i gnas bdag dang mi ma yin mang po yul nas thon song pa'i lo rgyus dang rnam pa mtshungs so/ / gang ltar yang rje 'di pas zhabs kyis bcag ste bkra shis dang dge mtshan spel pa'i spyan dmigs rgya gang che mdzad par brten de phyin chad nas nyer 'tshe ngan pa rang zhir song ba thams cad kyi mthun snang du grub pas rgan gzhon mtha' dag mos gus dbyar gyi chu mtsho bzhin du rgyas par gyur to/ / zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gcig la su nyid g.yas ru'i sa sder mjal ba stong phrag kha shas 'dus yong par bka' chos dkyus ma dang rnam 'joms kyi gzungs bzang spyod sgol ma dkar ljang gi lung phyag dbang bcas stsal/ lā kyā zhabs drung dang thu sa lag chi skal bzang tha'i ji nor bu sogs rta ba du mas chibs bsu dang bcas lā kyā zhabs drung gi u ger gdan drangs nas der bzhugs/ zhabs drung dang thu sa lag chi sogs yul mi'i spyi chos su drag po gsum dril gyi rjes gnang dang bka' chos dkyus ma'i skor phyag dbang bcas gnang / zhabs drung gis gzhis len 'bul ba gzabs shing thu sa lag chi skal bzang dang mi rin tha'i ji nor bu sogs yul mi spyi sger nas kyang 'byor 'khos kyi 'bul ba gzabs/ tshes gnyis la tho go thu'i su yol tha'i ji skal ldan dang bde legs srun rnams kyis bsnyen bkur zhus thog skya ser gyi tshogs pa sum stong nye bar bzang spyod kyi lung dang phyag dbang sogs gnang / chos rje skal bzang bsam grub dang tā bla ma blobazang dar rgyas sogs bla ma dka' ram 'ga' zhig gis rje nyid kyi gsol 'debasagasar rtsom dang sgrol dkar dang bde mchog dkar po'i bstod pa'i lung zhus nas phyir log / rim gyis su nyid tā wang tshe ring mgon po dang nu bo thu sa lag chi rig 'dzin mgon po tha'i ji dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs dpon 515

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/blon rta ba brgya skor gyi chibs bsu dang bcas hor go'i su me dge spyid gling du babs/ tā wang gis gsol ston zhus thog maṇ+ḍal kha btags bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gyis sna drangs te dngos 'bul gya nom pa btegs/ wang yum sras dang nye rigs tha'i ji rnams la bka' bsgo gsung brtag sogs so so'i bzhed mosaltar gnang zhing skya ser gyi khrom nyis stong tsam la phyag dbang chos bka' bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor dang bcas rgyas par stsal/ de nas sa tshigs so sor yul mi drag zhan du ma'i bsu skyel dang ja zhu mjal ba mang po'i spros pa dang bcas rim gyis phebs/ ci ba ha lang thu zer ba'i sa char mjal ba brgya phrag kha shas byung bar phebs byams nang nas gzungs sngags sgogs bzhin mjal kha gnang bas mjal ba zhig gi phyag rten nga la dgos gsung blangs nas bzhugs gdan 'og tu bcug / de rjes yang mjal ba tshan gcig yod par mgron gnyer gyis zhu rtsis byas nas song yang lus sbyin gyi spyan dmigs gnang gin 'dug pas zhu stabs ma 'grigs/ de nas le bar kha shas 'das pa'i mtshams su phebs byams phob gsung ste thams cad kyis phebs byams phab par rje nyid nas yul mi rnams la snga ma sa cha 'dir khyim tshang zhig bsdad nas rjes shul med par song ba min nam zhes dris par/ snga ma mi che ge mo zhig bsdadanas khyim tshang gi mi rnams tshad rims kyis rjes shul med par song ba yin ces zhus/ yang yul phyogs 'dir mi zhig rta thog nas lhung nas shi ba min nam dris par sngar rdo rje cang ki zer ba rta thog nas lhung ste shi ba yin zhes zhus shing sngon byung de dag mngon shes kyis gzigs te thol byung du gsung phebs pas der 'khor mtha' dag ngo mtshar dang dad pa'i sa la gnas par gyur/ snga sor phyag rten logs su bzhag pa'i mjal ba de'i rjes su mgo med pa'i mi zhig 'brangs nas 'ongs kin 'dug pa ci yin gsungs te zhag sar 516

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /phyag rten de glud rdzongs su bzhag nas glud rdzong zhig bsngo bar mdzad/ 'di nyid nas bzung nyi ma mang po'i bar du sgar thog gi grwa pa rnams la gdugs sher seng gdong ma'i bzlog bsgyur 'gro gang che bsgrub tu bcug cing nyid rang gis kyang lus sbyin gyi thugs dam rgyun ldan mdzad/ hu bil gān skal bzang bstan rgyan dang slob dpon bla ma'i hu bil gan nang so ye shes rnams kyis rim pasagadan drangs/ tha pon hu tog gi lha khang du hu bil gan bstan 'dzin rin chen dpon po blo bzang tshe brtan sogs grwa mang dang dar han ku ba'i hu bil gan sogs phyogs nas 'dus pa'i ser skya stong phrag brgal bar dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid dang du ra bed pā rang gi khyim du tshogs pa mang po la sman chog bsdus pa'i lung gnang / khu be+e thu o lan du dpon po bsam gtan gyi ñtsā/ /rdo ṭ+wāṃhān dīdīn ba dīlha| snoXs ༵ na ṭ+wāṃr rta ༵dīdī /dide ṭ+wāṃX dī ༷ṭ+wāṃX dbang dang mtshan dang gzungs sngags rna lam du sgrog par mdzad/ mur gu chig lha khang gi zhabs drung ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs lhun 'grub tā bla ma blo bzang seng ge dur ped tā bla ma ngag dbang phun tshogs slob dpon sbyin pa o lān bla ma das ga'i tā bla ma dkon mchog sman ram pa chos rje blo bzang skal bzang ho'u ching gu thi bzang po phun tshogs sogs phyogs tha dad kyi bla ma sku skye dka' ram gu thi mang po dang / tha'i ji tshe dpag ja lang rgyal mtshan sogs mi drag mang po rim gyis 'byor nas rang rang so so'i 'byor tshod kyi 'bul ba phul bar phyag dbang dang 'dod chos sogs kyis tshim par mdzad/ zhabs drung ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs lhun 'grub kyis gsol ba btab pa bzhin gong gsal gyi bla ma dka' ram mang po la dge ldan phyag chen gyi khrid dang dpon po bsam gtan gyis zhus ngor sbyin bdag rnams kyi thog ser skya sum 517

༄/ /gung bang bstanami'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/stong brgal bar spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang dang bsnyung gnasatsho ga'i lung rta mgrin gsang sgrub dang drag po sum dril gye rjes gnang rnams stsal/ dpon po blo bzang bsam gtan dang hā'i ban+de spun rnams kyis bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyal yol dngul srang bdun brgya rnga mong gsum rta pho rgod dgu tshan gnyis nor dgu tshan gcig lug dgu tshan drug bcas phul/ su nyid dang dur ped kyi sa char tsha zhag gar babs su dad ldan gyi mjal ba tshan mang po 'dus shing 'dir bzhugs ring la'ang nyin rer phyogs nye ring nas 'dus pa'i mjal ba shin tu mang po la phyag dbang gi mjug tu bka' chos dkyus ma'i skor dang khas len bskor ba sogs ma chad par gnang / tsang ke pi li gun gyis gdan drangs dem chi rgya mtsho'i ur gar skya ser lnga brgya skor la rta mgrin gsangasgrub kyi rjes gnang dang gtor ma brgya rtsa 'dul brgya mtsho'i snying po'i lung bcas gnang / mkhar sngon gyi tham ga bla ma dang jo po che chung so so'i ja sag lcang skya lha khang gi tā bla ma sogs lha khang so so'i ja sag dang bla ma las sne ngo g.yog / hrun gar pe zi'i tho yon mkhan po tho yon tsaspo thi tho yon rje skal bzang rdo rje ca khar chi dkon mchog sogs thu med dang or du su'i chibs bsu ba rim pa mang po dang bcas/ bco brgyad la mkhar sngon gyi nye 'dabs su dge rgan pā shing la sgar btab ste zhag gsum bzhugs/ thu med cang ki don grub chos 'phel cang ki bstan 'dzin sogs mi drag rnams mjal du 'ongs par phyag dbang gnang / mkhar sngon gyi lha khang so so'i bla ma las sne spyi sger nasasgar thog tu gsol ja dang phyag dbang zhus/ dur ped o lān bla mas lcamasring gi rjes gnang zhus te 'bul nod gzabs or du su ja sag dpon po'i mi sna rab 'byams pa dkon mchog sbyin pa dang mi rin ban+de ngo g.yog 518

ro༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /'byor nas mtshams zhu dang gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul/ su nyid g.yon ru'i wang gi chibs skyel ba ya ke blo bzang don grub nang so rgya mtsho ja lang don grub sogs mi drag bcu skor ul mi u lag dang bcas phyir ldog rgyur byin rten srung mdun bka' bsgo sogs kyis tshim par mdzad/ tham ga bla mas dgon par gdan 'dren zhus pa bzhin zhabs phyi pa byings rnams hūn gar pe zi'i u la'i thog gas pe zi'i shi ne+e jo bo la btang ste nyid dpon g.yog nyung shas shig tham ga bla ma'i dgon par byon nas zhag gcig bzhugs/chosaskyabs ti yān chi'i brag khung du phebs te rten gsum la shis brjod dang gnas gzigs mdzad/ dgon pa'i grwa ba rnams la phyag dbang dang bla ma lnga bcu pa'i lung gnang tham ga bla mas gzhis len 'bul nod gzabs nyid nas kyang dgon par mang 'gyed kyi thebs gnang / rma chu'i 'gram du hūn gar pe zi chi dbang bkra shis sku mched gsum shi ne jo bo'i tā bla ma grwa tshang bla ma sogs bladapon gyi 'khor mang po dang bcas 'byor nas ja thab zhus/ or du su wang gi mi sna chos rje thub bstan ha ban 'jam dpal rdo rje ngo g.yog 'byor te mtshams zhu dang gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul/ nyer bzhi la pe zi'i shi ne jo bo'i dgon par mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa'i dge 'dun gyi ser sprengs dang bcas phyag phebs 'dir zhag lnga bzhugs/ o rad cib ha lang thu dgon pa'i khri ba bla ma tho yon 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho khun de lin su me'i mtshan nyid bla ma dang rgyud pa bla ma sogs phyogs tha dad kyi bla ma dka' ram mang po 'jal du 'byor par 'dod chos sogs kyis tshim par mdzad/ shi ne jo bo'i bla grwa rnams dang phyogs nas 'dus pa'i don gnyer can mang po bcas la skyabs 'gro'i khrid gzab bshad dang lcam sring gi rjes gnang stsal/ cib ha lang thu'i khri pa bla ma lha mo ku ru ku l+le'i rjes gnang lkog chos su gnang / pe 519

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/zi'i nu po thu sa lag chi tshe dbang bsam grub tha'i ji mai rin don grub tha'i ji yar 'phel sogs ho sho'u rang gi dpon blon mi drag mang po dang ta lang tā pe zi'i mi sna o thog mer gen a has thu sa lag chi'i mi sna rnams rim gyis 'ongs nas mtshams zhu dang phyag dbang zhus shing mir gen a has kyis mi snas gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul/ tha'i ji yar 'phel gyis kho rang gi lha khang du gdan drangs nas gsol ston 'bul ba gzabs shing rten gsum la shis brjod zhus/ nyin rer dad 'dus kyi mjal ba stong phrag re gnyis la phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang / nyer dgu'i nyin de nas then te tho yon chos rje skal bzang rdo rjes ur ge la gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur dang 'dod don zhus/ do gos su ma'i zhabs drung thar pa'i rgyal mtshan ngo g.yog mjal du 'byor/ phebs lam du pe zi'i a bas rnams dang a ke 'ga' zhig ho'u thu sa lag chi mi rin gnyis mda' bzhi bcu zhe gnyis kyi ja lang cang ke khun tu thams cad dang / ho'u chin jo bo'i tā bla ma chos rje dka' ram mang po bcas rta ba brgya phrag du ma chibs bsur 'byor nas thab bsu zhus/ pe zi'i ho ro'i nye 'dabs su skya ser gyi tshogs pa shin tu mang pos rol mo'i bye brag dang dri zhim po'i spos 'dren gyis mdun bsus te bzhugs gnas gra bsgrigs bgyis par gdan drangs dad 'dus kyi skye pho mo'i khrom chen por mjal kha dang chos 'brel sogs gnang / pe zis gtsos pa'i sbyin bdag che phra thams cad kyi ho sho'u de gar dgun thog bzhugs dgos tshul nan tan zhus kyang nyid nas lo 'dir dgon lung du 'bab rgyu'i gsung shog sngar bskur zin pas zhal bzhes ma mdzad/ zla phyed tsam bzhugs ring la pe zi'i rim gror sri mnan gnad smin bsgrubs shing mjug tu gtor rgyag gnang khyim du dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga mdzad/ pe zis gtsos pa'i ho sho'u'i bla dpon che gras lnga brgya skor 520

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /la spror ba'i chos drug gi khrid gzab bshad dang gdugs dkar zhal phyag yongs rdzogs rta mgrin gsang sgrub lcam sring rnams kyi rjes gnang 'jam lugs tshe dpag med kyi rjes gnang bcas stsal/ sbyin bdag pe zis gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gos chen mang nu g.yug gsum dngul srang brgya dang lnga bcu rnga mong gsum rta nyi shu nor nyi shu bcas phul/ thu sa lag chi tshe dbang bsam 'grub kyi ho rol gdan drangs nas zhag gcig bzhugs rim gror 'jigs byed kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gnang gzhis len ston mo dang 'bul nod gzabs/ thu sa lag chi'i.a ma ye shes sgron ma dang a bes burnyi ri dang a ke tsan+d+ra shri dang bstan 'phel nyi ma sogs mi bdun la dge bsnyen rab byung dge tshul bcas kyi sdom pa dang lnga la go mi'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa phog / a bes burnyi ri dang lha mo skyid cang cun a ge ca khir chi dkon mchog rnams kyis rang rang gi khyim du gdan drangs nas 'bul nod gzabs par rim gro bka' bsgo sogs stsal/ a lag sha'i wang gi mi sna phas than tā ho tho lo or du su ja sag gi nu bo thu sa lag chi nyi ma rgyal mtshan zhabs drung tā bla ma ngag dbang dpal ldan sogs 'byor nas mtshams zhus dang mjal kha zhus dad ldan gyi skye pho mo mang po 'dus par phyag dbang bka' chos chad med gnang / pe zi'i ho'u chin jo bo'i dgon paragadan 'dren nan che ba bzhin/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu gnyis la pe zi'i ho ro nas thon/ lam zhor du sbyin bdag pe zi'i yab mes kyi dur thog tu gdan drangs par gzungs sngags zab mo rnams dang brab sngags gang ser ma rnams gsungs nas me tog gtor bar mdzad/ u lhan o su la gung bab thog mjal ba stong lhag 'dus shing phebs lam du'ang mjal mi tshan mang po byungabar phyag dbang chos 'brel chag med du gnang bas tha'i ji mi rin don 521

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'izlaname'i gsung 'bum/grub kyi khyim du mtshan mo 'byor/ phyi nyin bcag mal mdzad nas mi rin don grub kyi rigs rgyud kyi don la sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga gsungs shing gza' mi rnams la sgrol ljang gi rjes gnang stsal cing 'bul nod gzabs/ nangs dgung gnyis la dad 'dus kyis mjal ba sum stong brgal bar phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang / bcu bzhi la o'u o su la gung bab thog skya ser gyi tshogs pa stong phrag tsam dang hu bil gan blo bzang tshul khrims kyi ri khrod du mjal ba nyis stong tsam 'dus par phyag dbang sogs rgyas par gnang /us shing pe zi'i mi sna bsod nams chos rje ngo g.yog 'byor nas gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul/ bco lnga'i nyin bcag mal mdzad nas gsar bzhengs thub pa'i sku sogs rten brten par bcas pa la rab gnas mdor bsdus dang hu bil gan gtsos grwa mang la mgado sdud pa'i lung gnang bsnyen bkur 'bul nod zhus tshogs pa stong phrag brgal bar phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang ri khrod du ming zhus par yid dga' chos 'dzin zhes btags/ bcu drug gi zhog ka zhalanas/ mdang rmi lam du rgya mi gas shing khogs pa zhig 'ongs nas nged rang sa cha 'dir jing gir rgya kho'i dus nas bsdad pa zhig yin zhes phyag rten du dar 'jam zhig phul te nga la bza' btung zhig gnang rog mdzod ces lab 'dug pa gzhi bdag gi 'phrul zhig yin pa 'dra gsung nas gzhi bdag la dkar gtor bsngo bar mdzad/ cha gan o su la ho'u chen jo po'i gra tshang bla ma chos rjes gnyis dang dge bsgos dem chi sogs rta pa lnga bcu skor chibs bsur 'byor der gung bab thog mjal mi stong phrag tsam la phyag dbang stsal/tho yon ta'i ching gi ur ge la bzhugs shing tho yon gzugs gzhi ma bde bar rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang mdzad mjal ba chig stong lnga brgya tsam la phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang / o thog tā pe li'i mi sna dge bskos shes rab 522

༄༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /'byor nas mtshams zhus phul/ bcu bdun la bla ma'i 'o bo nas bla ma las sne rnamasakyis thab bsu dang gling 'dabs nas dge 'dun brgya phrag mang po'i ser sbrengs dang bcas ho'u chin jo bo'i dgon par phyag phebs tho yon mkhan podang paṇ+ḍi ta bla ma sogs grwa mang gis phyag dbang zhus/ phyogs 'dus kyi mjal ba sum stong brgal bar phyag dbang sogs rgyas par stsal 'dir nyin bdun bzhugs/ dge 'dun chig stong lnga brgyas ma ṇi ril bu sgrub pa'i tshogs dbu mdzad jo bo'i lha khang du rje nyid chog grwa pa nyer gcig dang bcas rab gnas rgyas pa sbyinasreg dang bcas gnang sbyin bdag pe zis rab yon gya nom pa btegs/ pe zi dpon po a pes rnams dang thon yon mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta bla ma sogs skya ser gyi tshogs pa shin tu mang por dzam bha la dkar po dang klu dbang rgyal po khyung nag rnams kyi rjes gnang dang mdo sdud pa rnam rgyal stong mchod kyi cho ga sogs lung thor bu 'ga' zhig gnang / tho yon mkhan po dang pe zi thu sa lag chi sogs spun rnams nang cung zad ma mthun pa la rje nyid phan tshun 'dum par mdzad de phral phugs su phan pa'i zhal ta zhib par gnang /paṇ+ḍi ta bla ma sogs bla ma dang grwa ba 'byor ldan bcu lhag gis rang rang gi gshag tu gdan drangs nas 'bul ba phul te shis brjod zhus/ shi ne jo bo'i zhabs drung hang gin dge slong ngag dbang blo bzang dar had dge slong ngag dbang shes rab rnams kyis rang rang gi lha khang la ming zhus par rim gyes 'gro phan rab rgyas gling theg chen bshad sgrub gling theg chen chos 'phel gling zhes btags/ nangs dgung gi rigs la mjal mi stong phrag gnyis gsum re chad med du byung bar phyag dbang chos 'brel sogs rgyun gyi phyag bzhes bzhin thugs brel che chung dang bstun nas rgyas bsdus ci rigs ma chad par mdzad/mjalapa'i nang nas rang rang gi 'khos bstun gyes dge ba rlabs che ba khas 523

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/len mkhan dang srog gcod chad sogs sdig pa re gnyis spong par khas len mkhan mang po byung / mi drag 'ga' zhig gis sngar mi mang la khral log bkal ba dang dbang shed kyis rgyu nor rdzas mang po blangs pa rnams rje nyid kyi sku mdun du 'gyod bshags phul te slar de 'dra'i las mi byed pa'i khas len phul/or du su wang gi gdan 'dren pa chos rje thub bstan thu sa lag chi 'jam dpal rdo rje ho sho'u'i mi rin ngo g.yog 'byor te/ nyer bzhi'i nyin ho'u chin jo bo'i dgon pa nas thon par sbyin bdag pe zis dge bskos skal bzang chos ldan dang ja lang phun tshogs bkra shis ngo g.yog dgon lung bar du zhabs phyir gtong ba gnang / dpon blon skya ser thams cad kyis sgol dkar gyi bstod pa'i lung zhus te pe zi dpon po dang a bes rnams phyir log / tho yon mkhan po tsan+ta thi mtshan nyid bla ma dang tā bla ma chos rje dka' ram mang po thu sa lag chi tshe dbang bsam 'grub mi rin don grub ca khir chi dkon mchog sogs bla dpon drag zhan brgya phrag brgal bas chibs skyel ja thab zhus/ phebs lam du or du su'i wang tshe brtan pā pas lo smo pa chos rje skal bzang grags pa sogs rta pa lnga bcu skor dang ta lad tā pe zi bstan pa dar rgyas yab sras pe zi'i nu bo thu sa lag chi don grub rab brtan sogs rta pa brgya phrag brgal bas chibs bsu zhus/ o'u la'i shi li'i lha khang du tho yon chos rje bzang po dar rgyas sogs de ga'i grwa mang dang mjal ba nyis stong nye bar dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang bzang spyod kyi lung bka' chos dkyus ma phyag dbang bcas gnang zhing der bzhugs/ ta lang pe zis lha khang gi nye 'dabs su phying gur phubs par gdan drangs nas gsol ston zhus thog dngul srang lnga bcu'i maṇ+ḍal sne 'dogs can gos chen mang nug gnyis dngul srang sum brgya dang lnga bcu rnga mong lnga rta pho rgod sum cu bcas phul/ be+e zi 'khor bcasal rnam rgyal ma'i 524

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /gzungs ring gi lung dang bka' bsgo skyabs 'jug sogs bzhed mos ltar gnang / o shi ba'i lha khang du dka' bcu blo bzang dar rgyas sogs mjal mi chig stong lnga brgya skor la phyag dbang bka' chos gnang / zhi bar sku skye dpon g.yog dang wang gi thu sa lag chi dbang ldan ja khir chi tshe ring skyabs a bes che chungagi mtshams zhu 'bul mi rnams 'byor/ de nas wang gi ho ro la mchod rdzas thogs pa'i dge 'dun gyi ser sbrengs dang bcas phyag phebs phyogs 'dus kyi mjal ba nyis stong brgal bar phyag dbang sogs sngar rgyun ltar gnang / mtshan mo lnga mchod kyi gling me dang bstun dmigs bsal kyi thugs dam mdzad/ hūn gar pe zi'i ja lang bzang po dang gang nā sogs chibs skyel ba tog can dgu u lā dang bcas phyir log / dgon lung bla brang gi nang so sbyin pa dang thar ba gling gi grwa rgan phur tsha dka' bcu ngo g.yog 'byor nas mjal kha zhus par gnas tshul gye bka' 'dri zhib tu mol/ ho sho'u de gar lo kha shas kyi ring mu ge dang than pa 'khrug long sogs mi shis pa mang po byung zhing wangasnga ma'i gdung rgyud kyang chad par ho sho'u'i che phra thams cad kyis skyabs btsal nas/ da lta'i wang chung ba'i tshe srog brtan pa dang ho sho'u la bde skyid 'byung ba'i ched dmigs kyi rim gro dang skyabs 'jug gnang dgos tshul nan tan zhus pa bzhin nyid dpon g.yog gis rta mgrin gtor zlog dang sbrel nas sri mnan tshad ldan bsgrubs te nyi ldog gi nyin gtor rgyag mdzad/ wang snga ma'i dus su gtug sher brgyab nas cham la phab pa'i mi drag cig khong khro'i ngang nas tshe 'phos pa'i rkyen gyis dpon blon 'ga' zhig la dngos su thug pa'i mthong snang byung zhing mthong mkhan de dag kyang glo bur du shi 'gro ba sogs mi shis pa'i mtshan ma chen po byung ba 'di res sri mnan bsgrubs phyin nas gar song 'dir song med par rang zhir song 'dug pas chos dbyings rnam par mi 525

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/rtog pa'i ngang du bskyal ba gor ma chag go / wang gi ur ger dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga dang wang dang a bos che chung thu sa lag chi gnyis ca gir chi sogasaskya ser gyi tshogs pa chen por skyabs 'gro'i khrid dang dzam bha la dkar po'i rjes gnang stsal/ chos yon du maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gos chen yug gsum dngul srang lnga brgya gzim gur cha tshang rnga mong gsum rta sum cu bcas phul/ ho sho'u'i mi drag rnams nang cung zad ma mthun par yod pa la phan tshun 'dum par byas nas chos srid kyi bslab ston zhib rgyas stsal te bde 'jam yug gcig tu mdzad/ mi rin mung khe gza' mi rnams kyis rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang zhus te 'bul nod btegs/ lo ts+tsha ba chos rjes gtsos pa'i cha gān er gi'i lha khang gi grwa mang gis gzim gur nas brtan bzhugs phul te phyag dbang chos 'brel zhus/hang kin pe zi'i mtshams zhus pa cang ki u bug thu 'byor nas rnga mong gcig rta bzhi phul/ gzhan yang ho sho'u tha dad nas ched gtad kyis mjal du 'ongs pa'i bla dpon ser skya drag zhan mang por nyin ltar phyag dbang chos 'brel rnams ma chad par gnang / ja sag gi gdan 'dren pa zhabs drung ye shes rgyal mtshan chos rje ngag dbang chos grags mi rin dpal bzang rdo rje ngo g.yog 'byor par/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum la wang gi ho ro nas thon/ khā tshog tshos dang khā ba yan ta le'i gnyis kyis rim pas gdan drangs/sbyin bdag wang thu sa lag chi gnyis ca khir chi sogs dang mer gen chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta bla ma'i hu bil gan sogs chibs skyel ba byings rnams phyir slog /phebasalam du ja sag gi a ke skal bzang rdo rje thu sa lag chi'i a ke bstan 'dzin rdo rje ngo g.yog dang rim gyis ja sag dbang rgyal tshe brtan rdo rje tho yon tā bla ma ngag dbang chos ldan thu sa lag chi ca khir chi blon 'khor mang po dang 526

ro༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bcas pa'i rta thab kyi bsu ba ngur sprig 'char ba'i dge 'dun ser sprengs dang bcas de ga'i lha khang du phyag phebs/ tshes bzhi'i zhog ka dad 'dus kyi mjal ba nyis stong brgal par phyag dbang chos 'brel sngar rgyun ltar gnang /wang gi chibs skyel ba lo tsā ba chos rje phas than tā pā dag sogs mi drag 'ga' zhig phyir log / dmag gi rim gror chung sri a nan bsgrub pa gnang / tshes bdun rje nyid kyi 'khrungs skar yin pa dang dgung lo lnga bcu'i dga' ston chen po yin pas ja sag gi lha khang du dge 'dun pa brgya rtsa brgyad la ja thug dang 'gyed gnang nas tshe chog gsung du bcug / nyid dpon g.yog gis 'go pa'i lha lnga'i gsol mchod btang 'khrungs skar gyi ston mo ja sag dpon pos dad mos kyis thugs khur blangs nas byas pa yin pas rje nyid 'du khang du bkur ste chen pos gdan drangs te/ ja sag dpon po thu sa lag chi gnyis sogs dpon blon che phra thams cad tā bla ma dang zhabs drung gnyis sogs bla grwa rnams dang / or du su wang ta lad tā pe zi hūn gar pe zi u shing pe zi so so'i la chi dang o thog a has thu sa lag chi'i a ke rdo rje mi 'gyur sogs phyogs tha dad nas 'dus pa'i skya ser gyi tshogs pa shin tu mang pos dngos 'bul rgya chen po spyan lam du bstar te zhabs brtan gyi bden tshig brjod pa dang chabs cig tu ja sag dpon pos maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol na bza' cha tshang gos chen mang nug yug gsum dang mdzod gos yug gnyis dngul srang brgya/ or du su wang gis dngul srang lnga bcu rnga mong gcig rta brgyad/ el chi gzhan rnams kyis kyang dpon po so sos bskur ba'i dngos 'bul ci rigs phul te zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa'i gsol ba nan tan du btab par tshig bkra legs pa'i zhal bzhes bzang po gnang / ja sag dpon pos rje nyid gtsos pa'i gzhi byes kyi 'grul 527

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/ba drag zhan thams cad la gsol ston gzab rgyas thog rol mo sna tshogs bsdebs nas glu len pa dang stobs rtsal 'gran pa mda' 'phen pa sogs rtsed mo mang po bstar/ tshes brgyad la dpon blon rnams kyis gtsos skya ser gyi khrom chen por dzam bha la dkar po'i rjes gnang dang de'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi lung bcas stsal/tshesadagu la ja sag dpon pos ur ge la gdan drangs nas gsol ston zhus par dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga mdzad dpon po gcig pu la ku ru kul+le'i rjes gnang / bla ma rnams dang dpon blon thun mong la dben sa snyan rgyud dang srad rgyud lugs so so'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid mdor bsdus re gnang /sbyin bdag dpon pos brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol gos chen gnyis dngul srangadrug brgya rta pho rgod sum cu bcas 'bul ba spam mtho ba btegs/ ja sag gi nu bo thu sa lag chi nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyes gdan drangs nas gsol ja dang shis brjod zhus/ 'dir bzhugs ring la nyin re bzhin mjal kha dang chos 'brel yang chag med du gnang / u shing pe zi'i gdan 'dren pa car go chi chos grags pa phebs than tā mung khe ci wango g.yog 'byor pa bzhin tshes bcu la de nas thon/ paṇ+ḍi ta'i 'du khang du tho yon tā bla ma ngag dbang chos ldan ku thi chos rje'i hu bil gan sogs bla grwa rnams kyis gsol ston dang rten gsum la rab gnas zhus ser skya lnga brgya tsam la phyag dbang sogs gnang /ja sag dpon po yab sras thu sa lag chi gnyis tho yon tā bla ma sogs chibs skyel ba byings rnams phyir slog / pa yān no'ur gyi nye 'dabs su gung bab thog mjal pa stong lhag la phyag dbang chos 'brel gnang / u'u shing pe zi po yan tha'i/ lha ram pa mkhan po blo bzang rdo rje pe zi'i nu bo tho yon skal 528

༄7/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /bzangathu sa lag chi chos 'phel sogs rta ba brgya phrag brgal bas chibs bsu dngadage 'dun gyi ser spreng4dang bcas u shing pe zi'i ho rol phyag phebs/tsonagar pe zi'i tho yon chos rje skal bzang ja sag gi zhabs drung ngag dbang dpal ldan mi rin don grub sogs chibs skyil ba mang po phyir slog / 'dir zhag lnga bzhugs ring la pe zi dpon po dang mkhan po bla ma sogs ser skya brgya phragamang por rta mgrin gsang sgrub dang khyung nag gi rjes gnang thog ma'i blo sbyong gi bshad lung gzhi gsum cho ga sogs chos tshan thor bu 'ga' zhig gi lung dang mkhan po bla ma sogs don gnyer ba nyung 'dus la gtor ma brgya rtsa'i khrid sogs chos kyi bdud rtsi mang du spel/ sbyin bdag pe zis maṇ+ḍal kha btags sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gdan rgyab yol na bza' nyer spyad gos chen yug bcu dngul srang bdun brgya bcas brtan bzhugs lugs su phul/bsod nams chos rjes gzim gshag nas bsnyen bkur zhus pe zi'i dgon pa spyo nas kyang gsol ja dang dngos 'bul zhus/ mi rin tshe ring rdo rjes lha khang du ming zhus par phun tshogs bde ldan gling zhes btags/ snga phyi'i nyin mjal pa stong phrag mang po 'dus par phyag dbang chos 'brel rgyas par gnang thugs brel gyi sangs par rnams su mkhan po blo bzang rdo rje dang chos kyi gsung gleng mang du 'phel/ bco lnga la de nas thon te khā dharma'i khyim du ja thab gra sgrig bgyis par babs mkhan po bla ma dang pe zi dpon po thu sa lag chi chos 'phel sogs chibs skyel pa drag zhan brgya phrag brgal bas gsol ja dkar spro zhus te phyir log / bar zhag gcig gis o thog thu sa lag chi mer gen a has kyi ho ro la phyag phebs te or du su wang gi yus jing tha'i ji bstan 'phel sogs mi drag 'ga' zhig yul mi u lā dang bcas phyir slog / a has thu sa lag chi gzugs gzhi ma bde ba la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi sgo nas dug dbyung 529

༄/ /gung thangabastan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/dang bka' bsgo phyag sman sogs gnang yang nad kyis gzhi zin tshar pas bzlog tu med par gzigs te rdo rje 'jigs byed dang nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgo nas khrus dbang dang brab sngags dang za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg grangs bsags nas sdig pa sbyangs pa'i spyan dmigs gnad smin dang dur 'debs kyi gnas gzigs kyang mdzad/ gza' mi thun mong du rnam rgyal ltadagu'i rjes gnang de'i sgrub thabs bzang spyod sher snying gi lung bcas gnang khyim du dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga mdzad sbyin bdag gis gzhis len dang 'bul nod kyangagang rgyas zhus/ har chin nas rje nyid kyi dgung lo lnga bcu'i 'khrungs skar gyi dga' ston du sbyin bdag chin wang ran sirnyis khā tsakra ngo g.yog dang /gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyis khā dharma kā ma ngo g.yog ched dmigs kyis btang ba rnams 'byor nas brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs te sbyin bdag chin wang gi dngul srang lnga bcu'i maṇ+ḍal sne 'dogs can sku gsung thugs rten bzang gos las bsgrubs pa'i bzhugs gdan rgyab yol bla bre pang khebs cod paṇa dngul srang dgu brgya sna dam legs pa bzhi gos kyi khug ma rgam chung do/ dri bzang thum po can rgam chung do shing thog dang bu ram rgam chung drug yid bzhin 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu sne 'dogs can/ gung bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyi sgrol dkar gyi li sku gcig tshe dpag med kyi li sku dgu tshe mdo mchod rten gos chen sna tshogs yug bcu dngul srang brgya g.yu dang byi ru'i phreng ba gnyis ma nu'i sna dam gnyis me tog tam pe gnyis spos por gnyis don yod zhags pa/ e phu pe zi bde legs bzang pos sprol dkar gyi li sku gcig tshe dpagagi zhal thang la ñtsa'i a yu brgya phrag gi thang ga tshe dpag mtshan brgya'i mdogaser zangs kyi rnam rgyal mchod rten nor bu don yod zhags pa bcas 'bul rgyu bskur ba rnams dang / gzhan yang wang dang gung gi dpon mo a ke 530

༄/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung ke ke rnams dang / ho sho'u'i dpon blon bla grwa che chung mang pos bskur pa'i rten 'byung gi 'bul ba chesamang du yod pa rnams 'bul lam zhus par 'byor lan phral du bsgrigs te el chi dang lhan du sbyin bdag dpon po rnams la mtshams 'drir grwa pa gnyis gtong ba gnang mkhan po cha gan bla ma ca khir chi at+pa sirnyi dpal dar gling gi bla ma dbu mdzad rnams mjal du 'ongs par phyag dbang sogs 'dod mos ltar gnang zhing mtshan mo ca khir chi pha bu gnyis la lus sbyin gyi spyan dmigs gnang snga phyi'i nyin dad 'dus kyi mjal ba stong phrag mang po la phyag dbang chos 'brel sngar rgyun ltar chag med du gnang / nyer gcigagi nyin de nas thon ul ju'u thu chas dam la gung bab thog dpal dar gling gi mkhan po tā bla ma blo bzang ngag dbang mtshan nyid mkhan po rgyal mtshan bkra shis thu sa lag chi brgyad stong ba sogs drag gzhan mang po 'ongs te dgon paspyi nas gsol ston spyi sger gyi phyag rten phul/ skya ser kyi tshogs pa mang por phyag dbang dang 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i sgrub thabs kyi lung gnang /ha rab thal du zhag bab thog o thog wang gi btsun mo dkon mchog tshe ring sras mo gnyis bcas dang cha gan bla ma so so nas zhabs tog 'bul ba phul te bka' bsgo skyabs 'jug zhus/ nyer gnyis la a ke skal bzang rdo rje'i khyim du phebs tshogs pa mang po laphyag dbang chos 'brel gnang / su khe zhes pa'i sa char a has thu sa lag chi'i ho ro bsnur rgyu'i gnas gzigs dang byin rlabs mdzad/ der bkra shis zer ba zhig gis gsol ja dang dkar zas khyer 'ongs nas mjal kha zhus par mi 'di'i ming bkra legs pas rten 'brel bzangagasungs pa phyis kyi brgyud pa la ja sag yong rgyu'i 'byung 'gyur mkhyen pa'i gsung yin par mngon/ de nas tsha zhag gar babs su dad 'dus kyi skye pho mo bgrang gis mi lang ba phyag dbang dang chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad 531

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i name'i gsung 'bum/bzhin du rim pas chibs bskyod/ cang ke mgon po bkra shis kyis lam thog nas gsol ja zhus te kho rang nad tshab chen gyis mnar nas 'chi la khad byung bar rje nyid la dad pa rtse gcig pas gsol ba btab par rmi lam du gsol ja zhus sa 'dir nyid dang mjal nas byin rlabs zhu ba zhig rmis phyi nyin nas nad kyi zug gzer je 'jam du song ba yin/ da cha rje nyid ma gtogs skyabs re sa gzhan med ces nyam thag pa'i smre sngags bton nas skyabs btsal bar bka' bsgo dang mtshan dang gzungs sngags rna lam du sgrogs par mdzad/rma chu bud nas pur ga su tha'i la a lag shā wang gi mi sna mi rin ban byung rta yul dang bcas 'byor cing o thog mi rin 'byung gnas kyis skyel mi nang so ngo g.yog rta ul dang bcas mthun rkyen zhus/ a mdo nas chos bzang ri khrod kyi gnyer ba dpon po 'jam dbyangs 'dul ba dgon gyi spyi gnyer ngo g.yog / a lag sha wang gi thu sa lag chi 'jigs byed tha'i ji gnyis ha ban mai rin dang yā mon gyi dgon pa'i em chi chos rje dem chi gnyis dge bskos dbu mdzad ngo g.yog rnams rim pas chibs bsur 'byor te dpon blon rnams kyis em chi'i o su nas ja thab zhus/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la yā mon du 'byor nas ba ye bka' 'gyur ba'i khang par bzhugs gnas mdzad/ wang gi nu bo gung dang chi ye thu sa lag chi tshe dbang yi shi ke ca khir chi sogs dpon blon rnams dang dad ldan gyi skye pho mo du mas mjal kha zhus/ wang nyid shā mkhar gyi cang jun la bsdad yod pas dngos mjal ma thub kyang sngar nas bkod 'doms byas yod pa ltar blon po rnams kyis shangs len gsol ston sogs gang rgyas dang / gos chen sna tshogs yug bdun rnga mong bzhi rta lnga bcas phul/ sngar gdan 'dren pa yong skabs rim gro 'ga' zhig lus par thugs brel gyis long skabs med pas bla ma gzhan re re sgrub tu 532

༄/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /chugs zhes bka' phebs yod pa bzhin ma 'gyang par btegs/ ho sho'u nas zhon rta dang khal 'gel pa'i rnga mong yul mi dang bcas pa'i gra sgrig kyang le thogs med par zhus/ or du su u shing pe zi'i car go chi sangs rgyas rdo rje sogs tog can bdun ja sag gi chos rje ngag dbang rgyal mtshan dang gzhan tog can gsum a has thu sa lag chi'i cang ki mi rin 'byung gnas kyi nang so rnams yul mi u lā dang bcas phyir ldog rgyur byin rten srung mdud gnang sbyin gyis tshim par mdzad/ tshes bzhi'i nyin de nas thon te bum pa thu la zhag bab thog dwags po hu thog thu kun sgrol no mon han gyis dgon par gdan 'dren zhus kyang gdan sar 'bab rgyu'i dus kyis gtugs pa dang lam bgrod dka' bar brten phebs ma thub pa la mgron gnyer dang gnyer pa ngo g.yog 'ongs nasagasol ston dang 'bul ba 'ga' zhig phul cing dgon lung bar du khal 'gal rgyu'i rnga mong lnga bcu ja'i sang ngag dbang tshul khrims sogs skyel mi bdun bcas mthun rkyen zhus/ phar yang mtshams zhus pa btang nas sku skyos 'ga' zhig 'bul ba gnang / tho sun nas lo dgu bcu go drug lon pa'i jo mo zhig gis tshe g.yang phul bar mtshan dang gzungs sngags rna lam du bsgrags te rta gcig gsol ras gnang thung ke nas u lā brje dgos par nyin gnyis bzhugs/ tshe dbang thu sa lag chis khyim du gdan drangs nas gsol ston dang 'bul ba gya nom pa btegs shing 'dod don zhus/ mjal ba mang pophyag dbang chos 'brel gyis tshim par mdzad/ tā ke ta la zhag bab thog dgon lung gi bsu ba dang po spyi gnyer che ba khri pa wang bla brang chu bzang rdo ba bla brang rnams kyis mi sna btsan khang gnyer ba bla brang rang gi gnyer pa dge legs thar pa gling gi bla brang gnyer ba dang spyi gnyer tha'i ji nor bu gzhis ga'i da ro ga 'ga' zhig bcas skya ser sum cu skor 'byor nas mjal kha zhus par gnas 533

༄/ /gung thang bstanapa'i name'i gsung 'bum/tshul gyi gsung gleng 'phel/ bco lnga'i nyin nyi ma shar ba dang tha'i ji rnam rgyal rdo rjes gser zangs las bsgrub pa'i byams sku khru phyed dang do long ba zhig mchod rdzas 'ga' zhig dang bcas phul te tshe 'di phyi'i skyabs 'jug zhus par tha'i ji gza' mi rnams la bka' bsgo dang zhal bzhes yid tshim pa stsal/zhal nas/ nged rang sog yul du lo gsum gyi ring 'brel ba thogs pa rnams la byams pa dam bcas pa'i gzungs rna lam du bsgrags nas rgyal pa byams pas rjes su 'dzin pa'i smon lam nan tan btab yod pas da res sog po'i sa sne nas thon khar mjal pa'i tha ma zhig gis phyag rten du byams pa'i sku phul byung ba rten 'brel ma bsgrigs rang 'grigs red ces dgyes tshor phul du che ba mdzad pa ni stabs legs tsam dang tshig bkra mdzes byed tsam ma yin par nges pa'i don du bla ma'i thugs rje byin rlabs dang slob ma'i mos gus ya ma bral bas rgyu tshogs pa las 'bras skyes par/ / rjes su dpog pa gang yin pa/ /don gzhan la ni mi ltos phyir/ / de ni rang bzhin yin par brjod/ / ces pa ltar rten 'byung bsrub med pa'i gshis kyis skal ba dang ldan pa'i skye bo 'brel ba thogs pa mtha' dag rje btsun bla ma dam pa nyid kyis sa mkhan mdzad de mi pham mgon po'i mdun sa dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin du 'khrid par 'gyur pa'am/ ma 'ongs pa na byams mgon rgyal ba'i nyi ma 'jig rten du shar ba'i tshe srid pa'i 'ching ba drungs phyung ste thar pa bla na med pa'i khang bzang mchog tu gzhug par 'gyur pa'i dan rtags bslu ba med pa yin no/ /smras pa/ rgyal blon 'bangs sogs skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi/ / rgyal mtshan mngon par mtho ba'i rtse mo ru/ / bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po khyod bkur bas/ / mchog thun dngos grub 'dod dgu char du bsnyil/ / bsnyen bkur sbrang rtsi'i snye mas dud pa yi/ / dad ldan pad+ma 'bum gyi zur phud 534

ro༅/ / rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum pad+ma dkar rmad byung /la/ / byin rlabs 'od kyi ri mo gcig car du/ / 'god pas snying gi mun sel nyin mor byed/ / gang la gang 'tsham snyan smra gling bu'i sgras/ / ma 'dris riskyes rnams kyang bag pheb byed/ / byin rlabs dri ngad ldang ba'i sman sbyor gyes/ / bro 'tshal nyen pa'i lus kyi gdung ba phrogs/ / rdzas sngags ting 'dzin tshogs pa'i chu lon gyis/ / gdon bgegs 'byung bzhi'i nyer 'tshe shā 'od bzlog / 'byung 'gyur gsal ston lung gi sgon me yis/ / lam gol 'phyan pa'i yid kyi mun pa sel/ / mi rtag nges par 'byung ba'i skul lcag gis/ / bag med rnams kyang blo sna chos su bsgyur/ / byin rlabs a snyi khye ñtsa'i chab sprengs pas/ / ma dag sgo gsum nyes pa'i dri ma sbyangs/ / smin grol yang dag lam bzang khrid dmigs kyis/ / sku gsum go 'phang nor bu'i gling du khrid/ / khyad par skal ba mchog gi gdul bya rnams/ / rdo rje btsun mo'i dga' ston mgron du bsus/ / mdor na 'gro ba spyod pa'i sgo mo mtha' yas ji snyed pa/ / de snyed thabs mkhas thugs rje'i 'jug pa mtha' las 'das pa yis/ / ma lus 'gro ba'i dbugs 'byen mdzad la nam yang mi ngal ba/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gdung 'tshob gcig pu 'dren pa khyod min su/ / nya gang zla ba rgyas pas sa dga' ltar/ / gang la gang 'tsham bka' dang sman dpyad thabs/ / dbang bka' zab rgyas man ngag mtha' yas bcas/ / gzhan phan mdzad bzang pha mtha' bsam las 'das/ / zhes rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mda' bdag rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsang gsum rmad du byung ba'i mdzad bzang 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal gyi cha tsam gtam du byas pa rtogs brjod pad+ma dkar po las/ 7gong ma'i bkas gser gyi rgyal khab tu lan gsum pa phebs shing gang la gang 'tsham gyi 'gro don bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad tshul gyi 'dab ma ste bcu gcig pa'o/ / / /535

spyi khyab jus 'god pa/ tsha lag tshe ring rgyal/ju zo tho1 ོ ma 1khyazhu chen pa/ blo gros sbyin pa/ṣ+ṭha 11 tsho0 ༅rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ 'brug mo skyid/tsho4zo thatshodzamadzes cha jus 'god pa/ garma rdo rje tshe ring /zom yo ོ zo jo༄7/ / gung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/(cha)gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes brtsams/ mi rigayodape skrun khang gis bskrun zhing 'grems spel byas/(pe cin ho phing li byang lam ang 14pa/ sbrag ang 100013kha par ang grangs 581ma5khya)pe cin kreng ta'o par khang nayopar btab/20yolo'i zla 1par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/2ཿ6lo'i zla 1par pe cin du par thengs dang po brgyab/deb tshad 85077ma116877 1 2 dpar shog 17 125dpar grangayo)skyi1—2 sam deb rer sgor 34 25
